tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig zhib 'jug

tei:div.tei:p: byaḥ/bka'agu/ //shā chi/hā sbya 7717shā 0'aḥcuXng060jib jing 505533 7 bci kho zhugaX 50 yokhog
bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig zhib 'jugarnam sras kyis brtsams/mi rigs dpe dzin khang /

dkar chagale'u dang po/ bod kyi deng rabs brtsams sgrung /sa bcad dang po/ brtsams sgrung thung ngu'i 'phel rim mdor bsdus/ ( 1)sa bcad gnyis pa/ brtsams sgrung thung 'bring gi skor/ ( 4)dang po/ don grub rgyal dang khong gi brtsams sgrung 〈〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog〉〉 (5)gnyis pa/ tshe ring don grub dang kho'i brtsams sgrung / ( 14)gsum pa/ a smyon bkra shis don grub dang kho'i brtsams sgrung / (24)bzhi pa/ rang sgra dang kho'i brtsams sgrung/ (32)sa bcad gsum pa/ brtsams sgrung ring gras kyi skor/ (43)dang po/ spyi bshad/ (43)gnyis pa/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈skal bzang me tog〉〉 (48)gsum pa/ glang mdun dpal 'byor dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈gtsug galu〉〉/ (61)bzhi pa/ bkra shis dpal ldan dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈phal ba'i khyim tshang gi skyid sdug〉〉 (73)lnga pa/ stag 'bum rgyal dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈snying 'jags kyi rtswa thang 〉〉 (83)drug pa/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈rgyal ba'i 1

'jig rten du nyul ba'i gtam rgyud〉〉/ (89)bdun pa/ bkra bha dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa〉〉/ (95)brgyad pa/ nag po skal bzang dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈klu 'bum mi rgod〉〉/ ( 104)dgu pa/ bstan pa yar rgyas dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈thag ring bi sbra nag〉〉 ( 110)le'u gnyis pa/ bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngags bcad dang po/ spyi bshad/ (116)dang po/ bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngag gi byung 'phel/ (117)gnyis pa/ tshigs bcad snyan ngag dang rang mos snyan ngag ( 121)gsum pa/ deng rabs snyan ngag gi brjod gzhi 'dem sgrug la rang dbang che ba ( 128)sa bcad gnyis pa/ bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngag gi rab mdzes spang thang du 〈〈dpyid kyi bdag mo lha las babs pa〉〉 (135)dang po/ snyan rtsom gyi nyams dang 'gyar bas phan sam ra ra ra tshogs pa/ (135)gnyis pa/ gangs 'dabs nas 'thor ba'i 〈〈dung sems kyi thegs ma〉〉/ ( 141)gsum pa/ gna' deng snyan ngag rgyud skud las 'phos pa'i 〈〈skya rengs lha mo'i 'bod bad〉〉/ (151)sa bcad gsum pa/ bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngag 'phel 2

rgyas lo rgyus las 〈〈lang cho1re rbab chu'i〉〉go gnas dang de'i shan shugs/ ( 159)dang po/ sdug snang gis khyer ba'i snyan ngag dang snyan ngag gi sdug snang / ( 171)gnyis pa/ rmongs sad thob pa'i mi rabs gcig gi 'bod sgra/ ( 180)gsum pa/ gangs 'dabs nas chas pa'i 〈〈lho bzhud kyi chu 'dzin〉〉/ ( 197)sa bcad bzhi pa/ lo ngo stornga gi rmi lam/ (203)dang po/ rgyab ljongs dang 'brel ba'i gtam/ (203)gnyis pa/ snyan ngag gi nam mkha' yangs par phyes shing skar tshogs kyi 'od snang drag tu 'tsher/ (209)gsum pa/ 〈〈snyan ngag sga mig chu 〉〉rsā thang la bstims pa/ (221)bzhi pa/ 〈〈dung sems kyi 'dab ma 〉〉las bzhad pa'i snyan ngag (228)le'u gsum pa/ bod kyi deng rabs lhug rtsom/sa bcad dang po/ spyi bshad/ (232)sa bcad gnyis pa/ mtsho bod mtho sgang gi rang byung mdzes sdug bris pa'i lhug rtsom gyi skor/ (239)sa bcad gsum pa/ bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus bris pa'i lhug rtsom gyi skor/ (251)sa bcad bzhi pa/ mi rabs gsar pa'i snying stobs dang re snyeg bris pa'i lhug rtsom gyi skor/ (264)3

sa bcad lnga pa/ ba res dang kho'i lhug rtsom bsdus deb 〈〈sngon mo spang las 'khrungs pa'i sems kyi rol mo〉〉 (271)sa bcad drug pa/ ldong yon tan rgya mtsho dang kho'i lhug rtsom bsdus deb 〈〈skad cha'i lang tsho〉〉 (281)le'u bzhi pa/ bod kyi deng rabs zlos gar/sa bcad dang po/ zlos gar gyi gnas tshul mdor bsdus/ (295)sa bcad gnyis pa/ glu gar la g.yur du za ba'i grub 'bras blangs pa/ (300)sa bcad gsum pa/ bod kyi glu bro zlos gar chen mo la dga' 'os pa'i grub 'bras blangs pa/ (319)sa bcad bzhi pa/ gtam brjod zlos gar gyi myu gu la skyes stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba (333)sa bcad lnga pa/ rang rgyal gyi glog brnyan lo rgyus steng gi bod skad kyi glog brnyan dang po/ (354)le'u lnga pa/ bod kyi rtsom pa po'i tshogs pa/sa bcad dang po/ dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i rtsom stegs/ (362)sa bcad gnyis pa/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom pa po'i tshogs pa/ (370)sa bcad gsum pa/ 6 snyan deb gsar pa ni snyan stegs 'degs pa'i ka gdung yin/ (375)

le'u dang po/ bod kyi deng rabs brtsams sgrung /sa bcad dang po/ brtsams sgrung thung ngu'i 'phel rim mdor bsdus/drang bden gyi tshe srog gsar pa thob 'go rtsom pa'i klung go'i sa gzhi chen por re ba'i ljang mdog cig rgyang ring nas shar 'ongs pa dang / 'das zin pa'i dus su 66'ur 'ur g.yugs pa'i 'khyag grang dang bu yug :de brjed nges kyi lhags rlung la bskur te nam yang phyir mi ldog pa'i lam du ded cing / mi rnams kyi yid sems lhod shig shig ngang drod skyid dang bde snang zhig la rol bar 'dod pa'i re ba shugs drag tu 'chang ba'i dus rabs nyi shu ba'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i dus 'gor/ bod yul yongs la rtsom rig gsar pa'i yo lang che ba'i dus skabs shig red la/ lhag par brtsams sgrung la mtshon na rtsom rig kun las lam du chas snga ba'i rtsom lus shig red/dus skabs gsar pa'i bod yig gi brtsams sgrung thung gas ni don grub rgyal dang glang mdun dpal 'byor sogs kyi sne khrid 'og 'phel rgyas mgyogs shing grub 'bras chen po blangs/ nga tshos lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi sgrung thung gsar rtsom gyi 'phel rim la bltas na/ rtsom pa po mang pos 'tsho ba dngos la gzhi bcol te rang rigs kyi bsam pa'i 'khyer so dang khyad chos/ spyi tshogs kyi 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes ltar gson nyams ldan zhing gzugs su bkod pa'i thabs kyis dga' skyo chags sdang gsal ba'i bod mi'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon yod pas/ klog mkhan rnams la sngar med kyi dga' ba bskyed/ der ma zad rtsom — 1 —

pa po dag gis srol rgyun gyi rtsom stangs rkyang ba'i bkag rgya las brgal nas nang don dang rnam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / brtsams bya'i dus rabs kyi khyad chos la gtsigs 'dzin byas te/ bden snang gi 'bri thabs la brten nas dngos shugs brgyud gsum gyis bod rigs sa khul gyi gya gyu dang rtog 'dzing ldan pa'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon yod pas bod kyi 'tsho ba'i dri ngad stug po zhig gis khyab/bod kyi brtsams sgrung la mtshon na dus skabs gsar pa'i brtsams sgrung lta bu'i bsam blo'i nang don ha cang phun sum tshogs po can zhig da phan byung ma myong / dus de nas bzung yun ring po'i rtsom rig gsar rtsom las rigs su khyab pa'i yang ma dag pa'i ngos 'dzin dang bkag rgya rnams gtor te rtsom pa pos brtse dung dang / phugs bsam sogs mtshon pa'i brtsams chos rang mos kyis gsar rtsom byas chog pa'i rnam pa bzang po zhig shar/ brjod bya'i gdam bkod la'ang dus rabs kyi snying don dang / gna' deng gi 'tsho ba'i rnam pa/mang tshogs kyi snying khong gi 'bod sgra/ drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs kyi gnad don sogs mtshon gang thub byas pa dang / de dag las dpal 'byor sgrig gzhi legs bcos byung rjes kyi rnam pa gsar pa bris te spyi tshogs legs bcos dang ya rabs kyi bsam spyod la bskul ba'i 〈〈me tog ldum ra'i nang gi klan kunapokyedang 〈〈rgyu 'bras med pa'i mna' ma 〉lo7dang 〈〈dngul gyi sor gdub 〉〉sogs byung ba dang / brtsams chos de dag gis mi chos kun spyod kyi zur tshad nas 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi mi sdug pa dang nyes spyod kyi dri mas yongs su gos pa'i mi rnams la kun spyod kyi rgol gtam drag po btang yod/ de bzhin du chang rag gi 'du 'dzir g.yeng nas las la mi brtson mkhan la kha rdung gtong ba dang /shes bya'i gnas sbyangs te shes ldan mi snar gyur par bsngags pa brjod pa'i 〈〈phugs bsam 〉momedang 〈〈gangs dkar lha mo'i 'khreng sems 〉lo7sogs la — 2 —

mtshon na/ rtsom mkhan de rigs kyis bod rigs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du rang gi mig zung gtad de spyir btang gi 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi spyir btang gi mi sna'i gshis rgyud dang sems khams/ bya byed sogs kyi thad nas spyir btang ma yin pa dang don chung ma yin pa'i gnad don sngog 'tshol byas shing / de ni bod mi rigs kyi mtshan snyan dang / mdun lam/ 'cham mthun bcas la gal 'gangs che zhing 'brel ba zab po brjod yod/ 4 rig gnas gsar brje chen po ’ yi skabs su/ 44g.yon 9gyi chab srid lam phyogs kyis rgya che'i bod rigs mang tshogs la gnod 'tshe dang sdug bsngal tshad med btang ste mang tshogs kyi lus sems la sos dka' ba'i rma shul chen po bzhag pa mtshon pa'i 〈〈dpe tshab sprod pa 〉pomedang / 〈〈thugs 'phrad〉〉khro) 〈〈sdug 'bras 〉lomi sogs sems rma'i brtsams sgrung gis smyo ham gyi lo zla'i nang byung ba'i mi chos dang 'gal ba'i smyo ham gyi bya ngan la skyon zhib dang 'gyod bshags byas pa dang / chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus slar gso byas pa'i go skabs dang bstun nas chos lugs kyi phyi gos gyon te mang tshogs la mgo skor gtong mkhan lha sprul sku midang tsa grub thob pa mi dang / de min rmongs dad kyi bsam blo'i dra rgyar tshud pa'i mi ni 'tsho ba'i khrod nas byung dang 'byung bzhin yod te/de ni bod rigs sa khul du gnas pa'i gnad don tshabs chen zhig tu gyur yod pas rtsom pa po rnams kyis rmongs dad kyi 'du shes kyis mi rnams la bzos pa'i gnod rkyen rnams brjod gzhi byas te 〈〈sprul sku 〉pokyedang / 〈〈grub thob pa〉〉khro) 〈〈lha ba 'dre ston〉〉khros 〈〈bdag gi khu bo 〉lo1sogs brtsams nas spobs pa chen po'i ngang mgo skor gtong mkhan la dgag rgyag dang rmongs dad mkhan la slob gso dang dran skul btang / srol rgyun gyi 'du shes dang bsam blo gsar pa'i bar gyi 'gal ba ni mi'i rigs spyi tshogs spyi la khyab pa'i snang tshul zhig yin pa dang / pho mo gnyen sgrig gi rang dbang brtson len byed pa brjod — 3 —

bya'i bstan don gtso byas pa'i brtsams chos ni mi rigs so so'i rtsom pa po mang po zhig gis brtsams yod/ rang re'i bod la mtshon na spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas byung nas dus rabs gsar pa zhig tu slebs yod na'ang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bsam blo'i 'du shes kyi lhag ro 'ga' shas ni da lta'i bar du da rung gnas yod pa red/ bsam blo'i 'du shes des gzhon nu pho mo rnams kyi 'tsho ba dang / re smon/ brtse dung sogs kyi thad la ya nga ba'i gnod 'tshe tshad med thebs kyin yod pas 〈〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog 〉tsho7sogs brtsams te dus skabs gsar pa'i bod rigs gzhon nu rnams kyis srol rgyun gyi 'du shes dang rjes lus kyi goms srol thams cad legs bcos btang ste bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba gsar pa brtson len byed par skul ma btang yod pas/ brtsams sgrung de dag la dus rabs kyi nyams 'gyur dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan zhing rtsom stangs kyi cha nas kyang bod mi rigs kyi rtsom srol rgyun 'dzin dang phyi nang rtsom rig gi legs cha bsdus yod pas brtsams chos yag shos kyi gas su bgrang chog par snyam mo/ /sa bcad gnyis pa/ brtsams sgrung thung 'bring gi skor/bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa dar ba dang bstun nas rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi ldum ra'i nang du rgan dar gzhon gsum las grub pa'i rtsom pa po mang po zhig gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis thon pa dang / lhag par bsam blo yar thon dang / khor yug gsar par 'phrod sla ba dang shes bya gsar pa lobs sla ba'i na gzhon rtsom pa po khag cig thon dang thon bzhin yod pa de dag las/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi thad la 'bras bu g.yur du za ba blangs pa ni don — 4 —

grub rgyal la sogs pa yin pas na/ nga tshos 'dir khong nyid gtso byas pa'i rtsom pa po re 'ga' zhig gi gsar rtsom gyi brgyud lam dang brtsams chos 'ga' ngo sprod mdor bsdus shig byed rgyu ni brjod bya dang 'brel ba che zhing dge mtshan che snyam ste 'chad par bya ba la/dang po/ don grub rgyal dang khong gi brtsams sgrung 〈〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog〉〉don grub rgyal ( 1953 1985) ni mtsho sngon zhing chen gcan tsha rdzong gi mi yin/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i dus 'gor bris pa'i 〈〈'bol rtsom zhogs pa'i skya rengs 〉lo3zhes pa'i deng rabs rtsom rig phyogs bsgrigs kyi deb chung dang po de bton rjes bod rigs kyi klog pa po rnams la bag chags gting zab bzhag khong gis bris pa'i brtsams chos de dag grangs tshad tsam ma zad spus tshad kyi thad nas kyang tshad mthon por slebs yod de/ 〈〈le lo can dang brtson 'grus can 〉lo1dang 〈〈pad mtsho 〉snokhyalta bus rang cag kha ba ri pa'i gzhon nu tsho'i gsar thon tshan rig shes bya dang / rig gnas slob sbyong gi snying rus mtshon pa dang / 〈〈'brug mtsho 〉mokhyalta bus bod rigs slob chen gyi gzhon nu mas rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas dang rtswa thang gi mi rabs rjes ma gso skyong byed phyir rang nyid kyi thob shor dang bde sdug la bsam blo mi gtong ba'i spyod tshul bzang po dang snying stobs la bstod bsngags tshad med byas yod/ lhag par lo rabs brgyad cur zhugs rjes/ bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon/ gan su'u bcas su rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi dus deb dpyid dus kyi myu gu ltar thon pa des/ khong gi gsar rtsom bya gzhag gi rta pho la'ang rgyugs sa'i thang lam yangs shing rgya che ba zhig btod pas lo ngo drug tsam gyi ring la rim bzhin gzhon nu pho mo'i brtse dung gi chu — 5 rdo

rgyun lhung lhung 'bab cing / pha mas phru gu'i gnyen don rang 'dod ltar thag gcod byed srol gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bsam blo rnying pa'i lhag ro sun 'byin byed pa'i brtsams sgrung 〈〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog 〉〉dang /tang gi chos lugs dad mos rang dbang gi srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol byung ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas rgyal bstan gyi snyan grags la gnod pa dang mi dmangs mang tshogs la margo skor gtong ba'i skye bo nyung shas kyi tha shal spyod tshul la sun 'byin dang ther 'don byed pa'i nang don can gyi brtsams sgrung 〈〈sprul sku 〉〉dang / rang nyid bcu drug lang tsho dar la bab cing gang byas gang yong thams cad a ma'i byang khog nas skyes ma thag tu yod pa ltar las pha mas ji ltar byas te rang nyid cher bskyangs pa sogs la drin du ma sems par da dung pha ma la 'khon 'dzin gnag sems byed pa dang rang gis bya log spyod log ma tshang ba med pa byas mthar ya nga ba'i gnas su lhung ba'i 〈〈rgyu 'bras med pa'i mna' ma〉〉/ lhag bsam rnam par dag cing lhad med bza' tsho'i brtse dung dang / pha ma bu phrug gi brtse dung mtshon pa'i 〈〈sha dang rus pa'i brtse dung 〉〉/ mes po'i dus nas chags pa'i khyim dud dang mi sger gyi rtsod gzhi'i gcong nad yod pa rnams deng rabs kyi gzhon nu dang khog rgya che ba'i mi rnams kyis sel bar nus pa mtshon pa'i 〈〈'brong stag thang 〉〉dang khro1 kyag kyog gi 'tsho ba dang / chab srid kyi drag rlung khrod mi chos dang lha chos gnyis phan tshun 'gal zla dang gcig gyur gyi tshul du gnas par byas shing / phyi tshul zhi bar gnas kyang nang sems su brtse dung gi rba rlabs 'phyur te/ mi tshe la gting zab pa'i sgo nas shes rtogs byung ba brgyud bsgrags byas yod pa'i 〈〈tshul khrims rgya mtsho〉lo7dang / mes po tsho'i rig gnas dang lo rgyus mdzad rjes la yid tshims shing / de dag kho na ngom nas sdod pa las dus rabs dang lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo mdun du rgyu ba'i lam bu gsar pa'i steng du 'gro rgyur da — 6 —

dung yang the tshom dang rnying zhen gyis mgo bo rmongs nas sdod mkhan la dran skul byed pa'i 〈〈rkang lam phra mo 〉〉sogs brtsams sgrung dang lhug rtsom gyi brtsams chos khag sum cu tsam bkod yod pa ni lta rin dang dpyad rin yod pa sha stag red/don grub rgyal gyi brtsams chos kyi grub 'bras gtso bo ni brtsams sgrung yin pa dang / brtsams sgrung mang che ba'i nang du pho mo'i brtse dung gi brjod bya gtso bor byas te spyir btang gi zhing pa dang / 'brog pa/ shes yon can sogs bris yod pa ltar/ sgrung 'bring 〈〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog 〉〉tu'ang bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed byas tshun gyi dus skabs shig gi bod spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul la do snang byas te/ dwangs gtsang gzhon nu pho mo'i brtse dung gi chu rgyun lhung lhung 'bab par pha bong bzhin bgegs su song ba'i pha mas phru gu'i gnyen don thag gcod byed srol gyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bsam blo rnying pa sil bur gtor 'dod kyi kun slong gis/ 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi dpe mtshon ldan pa'i don rkyen mang po zhig 'phyor 'bri byas te/ dus rabs nges can zhig gi lo rgyus snang tshul mtshon yod pa ni rtsom 'di'i rgyab ljongs su ngos bzung chogabod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi zhib 'jug la cung snga mo nas zhugs pa'i bde skyid 'tshos 〈〈sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu 〉skokhyazhes pa brtsams te/ don grub rgyal gyi brtsams chos khag dang lhag par kho'i sgrung 'bring 〈〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog 〉〉la dpyad gtam cung gnad du 'gro ba zhig spel 'dug ste/ khong gi sgrung 'bring 〈〈sad bcom 〉〉ni sa gnas kyi khyad chos mod cing brtse dung zhib 'bri byas pa'i brtsams sgrung zhig yin zhing / chung dus nas mnyam du nar son pa'i mi sna na gzhon pho mo zung gi brtse dung bris yod/ lha skyid dang tshe ring gnyis kyi thog ma'i brtse dung gis sngon bsus nas ma 'ongs par re bas khengs pa nas 'go brtsams shing / mjug mthar mi gshis kyi zhan cha dang rnying — 7 —

zhen du song ba'i srol ngan gyis bzos pa'i skyo gar gyis mjug sgril par byas yod/ nga tsho lha skyid dang tshe ring / lha mo/ rig yag jo mo sgrol ma sogs kyi nang sems kyi zhing khams su zhugs nas bltas na rgyus mnga' che zhing brtse dung yod pa lta bu'i phyi yul gyi zhib 'bri las/ re gsal re yib kyi ngang nas rtsom pa po'i lta ba de mngon thub cing / 'tsho gnas dang brtse dung / srol rgyun gyi goms srol sogs kyi 'grel bshad de bstan yod/ stobs shugs gang zhig gis da dung ma bzhad pa'i me tog gi gang bu de bcom pa yin nam/ de ni gdug rtsub che ba'i srol rgyun yin nam/ yang na rnyog 'dzing ldan zhing nga tsho'i lus steng du ma gzhi nas yod pa'i 'tsho ba'i khor yug khrod kyi goms srol gyi ngan shugs yin/ gang ltar 〈〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog 〉〉de brtse dung gi skyo gar kho na ma yin par/ mi gshis khrod nas byung ba'i sdar ma dang / sgor sems/ rmongs mun sogs kyis grub pa'i 'bras bu kha bo de yin pa bstan yod/ lha skyid kyi lus dang grib ma lta bur gyur pa'i mdza' grogs tshe ring gi lus steng du/ rtswa thang gi 'brog pa pho gsar lta bu'i drang bden kho na gnyer zhing dga' na dga' phod cing sdang na sdang thub pa'i snying stobs med cing / tha na zhing pa nyam chung zhig gi zas gos las ci yang mi sems pa'i sems khams kyang brjod dka'/ yin na'ang kho'i lus steng du bab chags dang / las la brtson pa/byang sems ldan pa sogs kyi gshis rgyud dang ldan la/ sa gnas dang zhing pa'i 'du shes kyis bskyed pa'i shes sgo la brten nas rang gi thob thang las brgal ba'i blo skyed dang / las dbang de rtswa ltar mi 'dor ba sogs kyi gshis rgyud sna tshogs shig ldan/ kho rang mdun lam gyi ched du lha skyid dang kha bral te zog gi sman pa zhig tu gyur pa nas/ kho'i brtse dung gi me tog kyang de dang bstun nas nyid par gyur/ kho ni bshad phod cing sgrub phod pa zhig min pa dang / kha zhe mi mthun pa'i gshes rgyud de lha skyid kyi gzhung drang zol med dang / zhum med snying — 8 —

stobs/ dga' phod snang phod kyi rang gshis dang bsdur tshe/ kho rang cung nyam chung gi tshul du snang / lha skyid ni rtsom pa pos gsar bzhengs byas pa'i a mdo'i zhing las sa khul gyi bod rigs bu mo zhig gi gzugs brnyan yin zhing /'di la me tog lta bu'i bzhin ras ldan la/ las la brtson zhing gshes 'jam gzhung drang gi bu mo zhig yin/ kho mor rang gi a phas gnyen rtags brgyab nas tshe ring gi phu bo rig yag la gnyen sgrig byed dgos pa'i skabs su/ a pha'i bka' dang las dbang la mgo bo skur mi 'dod cing / zhing pa'i bu mo zhig la ldan dka' ba'i snying stobs kyis ngo rgol byas te 'khyags sib sib kyi 'jig rten lugs srol gyi khrod du/ kho mo 'chi lam du ded kyang / phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas yong ba'i dka' ngal dang rna bar gzan pa'i mi kha sogs kyi mdun du phyi nur tog tsam ma byas par/ da dung drod 'khol 'khyil ba'i brtse dung gi klong na/ a pha'i bka' bkyon dang srol rnying gi gnya' gnon 'og smre sngags gang yang ma bton/ las dbang gis kho mo slar yang mi tshe'i g.yang gzar du ded rung / kho mor dwangs gtsang dri bral gyi gshis ka las med pas 'jig rten gyi rnyog 'dzing dang spyod ngan la g.yol mi shes pa dang / de'i rkyen gyis/ mi gzhan gyi dog brdzis thebs nas mthar gar 'gro gnas med du gyur pa'i lha skyid jo mo rgan gras shig gi rjes 'ded dgos pa byung rung / da dung ma 'ongs pa dang bde skyid/ sdug bsngal dang som nyi bcas kyi pha mtha' ru re thag chad pa'i yid sems kyis khengs na'ang / nam yang yal thabs bral ba'i bcos min gyi brtse dung dang zhen chags kyis/ da dung rtse gcig tu tshe ring phyir slebs par re sgug byed pa ma zad/ sngar bzhin sdug bsngal gyis khengs pa'i khor yug tu 'tsho ba gsar par re 'bod byed kyin yod/lha skyed kyi lus steng du/ nga tshos skyo gar gyi dri mas khengs pa'i tshe srog de mthong thub la/ thengs re re'i skyo gdung gi rgyang 'bod dang / yang nas bskyar — 9 —

du nang sems kyi brtse dung la g.yo 'gul thebs pa brgyud nas/ tshe srog dang brtse dung la bcangs pa'i re snyeg gi sems pa de sngar bzhin kho mo'i ya chung khog pa'i nang du mchong lding byed kyin yod/ kho mo'i 'di 'dra'i nyams pa med pa'i tshe srog gi me lce de/ srol rgyun gyi ngan shugs dang 'tsho ba'i khor yug gis bskrun pa'i bsam blo'i gnon shugs 'og yal ba med pa'i mi gshis kyi 'od snang 'tsher ba'i snang brnyan 'di lta bu zhig gnas thub pa'i rin thang ni/ rtsom pa pos mi gshis kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos dang rang byung gi mi dang rang nyid bar gyi 'gal zla'i rtsa ba de gzhir bzung nas slar yang bud med la ngos 'dzin byas shing / phra zhing zhib pa'i 'bri thabs kyis sems khams kyi yul ljongs de thengs re re bzhin dran snang du shar ba'i brgyud rim khrod/ lha skyid kyi brtse dung gi 'tshol steg dang thob shor gyi brgyud rim de hril gyis mtshon yod/ kho mo'i gshis rgyud 'jam yang u tshugs kyis khengs pa'i rang gshis des las dbang gi lung bstan la mi nyan par/ rgyun par u tshugs kyis mi'i rang dbang gi thob thang dgos pa'i re ba bton/ 'di lta bu'i 'jam rtsub gnyis ldan gyi gshis gas bod rigs bu mo rnams kyi blo brtan 'gyur med kyi tshe srog gi 'dun pa de mtshon yod/ lha skyid dang sgrol ma/ lha mo bcas kyi bltas tshod kyis 'jam por snang ba'i phyi'i rnam pas kho mo tsho'i lus steng du rang sor gnas pa'i skyo mdog ldan zhing 'gyur ba med pa'i bod rigs bu mo tsho'i gshis 'jam/ lhad med/ blo khog che ba/ mi che'i 'jigs snang la kha gtad phod pa'i sems khams shig ngang gis rtogs thub/ don grub rgyal gyis bu mo 'di dag gi gshis ma'i 'bri bzhengs kyi steng / thugs khur dang gdung sems zab mo bcangs yod pa ma zad/ da dung gting zab pa'i spyi tshogs kyi don snying dang rgya che ba'i 'tsho ba'i khor yug rnams gzhi gcig tu 'dres par byas yod/de ltar brtsams sgrung 'di'i brjod bya'i bstan don yang / gtso bor phru gu — 10 —

mngal na yod pa'i dus nas gnyen rtags brgyab pa des mtshon pa'i srol rgyun gyi bsam blo rnying pa dang / lugs srol ngan pa des mi rabs phyi ma'i na gzhon pho mo gnyis kyi brtse dung la ji ltar bgegs bar chad byas pa dang / nga tsho'i mig lam du bgegs thebs pa'i mjug 'bras snying rlung 'khrug pa de gsal por bstan pa snying por bzung nas/ bsam blo rnying par sun 'byin dgag rgyag dang / rang dbang rang 'thad kyi brtse dung la re 'bod byed pa'i brjod snying gting zab sar bskyal yod la/ lugs srol rnying pa'i nag nyes dang der dgag pa'i tshad kyang je drag tu btang yod de/ brtsams sgrung du tshe ring dang lha skyid kyi zol med pa'i brtse dung gi chu rgyun la kho gnyis kyi pa'i sngon chad kyi kha dan btsan po'i brag rdo'i bar chad 'khel bas mthar kha phye ma thag pa'i lha skyid kyi lang tsho'i me tog bar chad sad kyis bcom pas rang gi yul du log mi 'dod la/ rang gi rtsed grogs kyi sar yang 'gro ma phod par lhag bsam dag pa'i jo mo zhig bi rjes su mi 'gro ka med byung skabs/ kho mo'i gangs dkar gyi sems su dogs pa 'di 'dra zhig skyes pa ste/ tshu bu mo ma'i mngal na yod dus gnyen gtam sde ba'i dkyil nas bshad pa'i pha ma tsho la zhe khrel yod dam/ lus rten pha mas bskrun kyang rang lus rang la mi dbang ba 'di bod kyi srol rgyun yin nam/mi yizhes dang / de bzhin lha skyid kyi a mas rang gi bu mos gnag la snum pa'i skra lo bcad nas rang khyim du yong mi 'dod pa'i gnas tshul shes nas phun tshogs la 'khang ra byed skabs lha skyid kyi a phas da dung gnya' rengs kyis de ni bod kyi srol yin la phas bu mo'i gnyen sgrig thag gcod mi chog pa ci yod ces bshad par/ dbang mtshos/ 6 kha gdangs na dpe/ btsums na srol/ byis pa ma'i mngal na yod dus bu bu mo gang yin mi shes dus/ gnyen gtam pa de bod kyi dpe yin nam/mi (gong mtshungs)zhes pa'i dri ba dag ni lha skyid kyi a pha phun tshogs dang tshe ring gi pha nyi ma la bton pa'i dri ba tsam ma — 11 —

yin par de ni srol rgyun rnying pa de dag la mi mos par gnyen sgrig rang mos kyi re ba byed mkhan gzhon nu'i mi rabs shig gi re 'dun mtshon pa dang phru gur rang dbang med par pha mas phru gu'i gnyen don btsan shed kyis thag /cohā byed pa'i srol rgyun der gnad du 'khel ba'i dogs gzhi bslangs pa ga wa// grub rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung 'bri tshul thad la'ang rtsom so sor khyad chos mi 'dra ba dang 'bri tshul mi 'dra ba re yod de/ brtsams sgrung so so'i mi sna'i snang brnyan bkod 'bri byed skabs kyang tshang ma lugs kong gcig nas thon pa ltar min par mi sna re rer so so'i gshis ka dang / sems khams/ 'du shes/ phugs bsam/ gtam spyod/ 'jig rten lta tshul bcas mi 'dra ba re yod pa 〈〈sad kyi bcom pa'i me tog 〉〉la mtshon na/ brtsams sgrung de'i nang gi gshis rgyud mi 'dra ba'i mi sna tshe ring dang / lha skyid/ rig yag lha mo/ jo mo sgrol ma/ a pha phun tshogs bcas mi sna gtso bo rnams la sgrung gi go rim ltar rang gi brgyud rim bshad du bcug pa des/ gshes rgyud mi 'dra ba'i mi sna re re'i sems khams rgyus mnga' byung nas 'tsho ba ngo ma'i bag chags mngon par phyungs par byed pa dang / byung rim sgrig 'god kyi cha nas/ gtam rgyud kyi rjes shul gsal bar mngon 'dug ste/ tsa yul dus tshang ma cig car gsal por ngo sprod pa'i khyad chos yod la/ mi dang bya ba yul ljongs sogs gtam rgyud thur du bkram pa'i go rim khrod chu la kha ba bzhin bstems shing 'thim par byas te byung rim 'bur du thon pa dang / de yang mgo mjug tshang zhing gong 'og thel la/ dus tshod kyi go rim gtsor bzung ste 'god pa zhig kyang yin/9yi khong gi brtsams sgrung la de lta'i gtam rgyud kyi khyad chos ldan/khong gi brtsams sgrung gis skad cha'i zhib 'bri brgyud nas klog pa po rnams la dran snang gi rang dbang dang tshig mdzes sdeb legs kyi nyams la — 12 —

rol thub pa'i zhing khams rgya chen zhig skrun bzhin yod de/ tshe ring gi mig lam gyi lha skyid kyi snang brnyan zhib 'bri byas pa ni bzhin ras dkar gsal zla ba'i ngos na/ rgod kyi gshog pa brkyangs 'dra'i smin ma zung gis mdzes shing /de'i 'og tu rnam rig gis khengs pa'i spyan gnyis ni chu yi 'od gor 'khyil ba ltar khra chil ler 'dug ring zhing stug pa'i smin ma'i 'og tu lkog gyur gyi mdzes sdug cig sbas yod pa ltar snang la/ dkar la dmar mdangs rgyas pa'i mkhur tshos zung ni smin drags pa'i ku shu gnyis dang mtshungs pa sogs kyis mi la dga' snang zhig dbang med du sbyin 'ongs/ mos mtha' phrug khras brgyan pa'i ras lwa rnying pa zhig gyon na'ang bab chags dang tshul ldan gyi nyams 'gyur sngar bzhin ma yal bar da dung tshe ring gi brtse ldan gyi gung ba dbang med du lha skyid kyi me tog gi 'dab ma'i steng du phyogs la/ tshe ring gis lha skyid nas gnang ba'i dngul gyi mdzub dkris de lag tu bzung ste bde skyid kyi snang ba dang / brtse dung la re smon byed pa de ni gcan gzan gyis sha la sgug pa'am rngon pas ri dwags la sgug pa nang bzhin dal ba dal bu'i gom 'gros khrod nas yod tshad rang gi sems su 'thims/miyi'adi 'dra'i 'jam zhing spro ba 'phel ba'i zhib phra'i tshig sbyor gyis na gzhin pho mo'i ngo tsha'i gos kyis sgrib pa'i brtse dung de'i rnam pa dang ro bro ma nyams par mngon ston byas pa dang / 66rang bzhin lhun gyis 'bab pa dang bab chags kyi brtul zhugs bzung ste rta 'do ba'i 'tsher skad dang 'bri thul ma'i ngur sgra/ zhing rnang ma'i bar gyi rngul khrag dang khyim go kha'i bar gyi dgod sgra sogs 'tsho ba spyir btang ba dang bye brag pa gang rung 'bri ba'i ngal ba dang du blangs yod/mi spyi don grub rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung gi skad cha de rtag tu brtsams sgrung khrod kyi mi sna'i snang brnyan la brten yod pa las brjod bya dang kha bral nas logs su gtan nas song med/ khong gi brtsams sgrung du 'os — 13 —

'tsham gyi gtam dpe dang thun mong ma yin pa'i skad cha'i sgyu rtsal bkol nas brtsams sgrung gi nyams 'gyur gzengs su thon par ma zad/ nang don yang phun sum tshogs par byas yod/ khong gis go sla zhing sbyor ba mdzes pa/ gson nyams ldan zhing tshor snang gsar pa ster ba'i phal skad la brtson len byas te/skad cha'i thabs rtsal gyis mi sna'i gshis rgyud kyi khyad chos dang / 'tsho ba'i goms srol/ rig gnas kyi mngar bcud sogs mtshon yod la/ lhag par 〈〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog 〉〉nang du/ khong gis 'os shing 'tsham pa'i ngang nas bod kyi srol rgyun gtam dpe dang / legs bshad sogs kyi nang gi tha snyad bkol te mi sna'i gshis ka brko bzhengs byas yod pa ni dper na ra sde 'go skyong na khog pa yangs dgos/ rgod po khrid na mthur mda' ring dgos/’6 stag dmar yag nags la mchongs rung nyal sa tshang dang / bya rgod pos nam 'phang bstad kyang 'bab sa brag red/mi mis mi bza' mna'/ khyis mi bza' lcags/mi pho rab tshig thog 'phar ba rjes thog mi sogs gtam dpe 'di dag gis mi sna'i rtog 'dzing ldan pa'i sems khams kyi yid 'gyur sna tshogs ston thub pa ma zad/ zhing grong gi brjod byar ran pa'i skad cha spyi'i gdangs kyang thon par byas yod pa red/gnyis pa/ tshe ring don grub dang kho'i brtsams srung /tshe ring don grub (1961wa )ni mtsho sngon zhing chen ho nan sog rigs rang skyong rdzong gi mi yin/ dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs drug cu pa'i dus smad nas bzung smyo rig gsar mi gyi god chag chen po myangs pa'i krung go rgyal khab 'dir bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed dang dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyi jus thabs lag tu bstar bas/ bod yul 'di yang 'phel rgyas kyi phyogs su gom pa rim gyis spo 'go brtsams la/ srid jus kyi gu yangs dang sgrig srol gyi — 14 —

sgyur bkod/ las 'gan gyi brje sgor dang sbrags te yang dag ma yin pa'i gnas tshul dang snang tshul mang po yang mgo bo dgyes shing myu gu 'bus 'go brtsams la/ tshe ring don grub kyi rtsom gyi brjod bya yang tag tag de nas 'go brtsams/mi zhig rtsom pa po ru 'gyur ba dang rtsom zhig ngag gi sgyu rtsal du 'jog rigs pa la cha rkyen dang grub cha mang yang / rang gi lta ba dang dran snang /dga' sdug la spyi tshogs kyi don snying ci zhig yod pa dang / des klog pa por dbos pa ci 'byung ngam shugs rkyen ci thebs bcas kyi thad nges par bsam blo gtong dgos/ ma mtha' yang rtsom pa po tshad ldan zhig la nges par 'di'i phyogs kyi khrel gzhung gi 'du shes yod dgos/ 'di ni rtsom pa po zhig la 'dzoms dgos pa'i cha rkyen med du mi rung ba zhig yin la/ brtsams chos la klog 'os kyi rin thang yod med kyi gtso gnad cig kyang yin pas/ rtsom pa po dang klog pa po'i 'brel ba'i rmang gzhi thog ma yang yin/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon par byed skabs/ ya rabs kyi dpung gnyen dang ma rabs kyi gdong 'gog tu langs te spyi tshogs legs bcos la bsam blo gtong ba ni rtsom pa po'i ches rtsa ba'i 'gan khur zhig yin la/ rtsom pa po'i kun spyod legs min 'jal byed kyi tshad gzhi zhig kyang yin/ tshe ring don grub kyis brjod bya'i gdam gses dang rtsom stangs sogs kyi thad nas phyogs 'dir ha cang mthong chen byas yod/ 'gan khur gyi 'du shes de la brten nas khong gi rtsom gyi brjod bya ni rang dang klog pa po'i thun mong 'tsho gnas kyi spyi tshogs khor yug de dmigs gzhir byas thog klog pa po rnams kyi 'tsho gnas dang bde sdug gi phyogs la bsam gzhig gzab nan byas pa las byung ba'i 'char sgo dag yin la/ de yang khor yug der 'tsho ba'i mi mang shos kyis go ci thub la dmigs te rtsom lus brtsams sgrung gi rnam pa dang tshig sbyor phal skad dang mthun pa spyad — 15 —

yod pa ni kho'i rtsom hril po'i khyad chos shig tu snang /ya rabs la gzengs bstod dang / ma rabs la sun 'byin byed pa ni rtsom pa po'i 'gan khur gal chen zhig yin/ de las kyang ma rabs dang nor skyon la sun 'byin byas pa na sgyu rtsal gyis bzhengs pa'i snang brnyan de dang mtshungs pa'i mi ga ge mo'i mtshang la phog thug 'byung bas/ 'gan khur gyi 'du shes shin tu che ba'i rtsom pa pos ma gtogs dang du len mi spobs/ tshe ring don grub ni 'di lta bu'i rtsom pa po zhig ste/ khong gi brtsams sgrung phal che bas spyi tshogs gyi yar thon la bkag 'gog byed pa'i goms srol rnying pa dang / rang nyid kyi 'os mthun thob thang dang khe dbang srung skyob byed mi phod pa'i sdar ma/mi dmangs kyi dad sems la rang mkho'i rkang stegs 'cha' ba'i ham pa can/sna lcags kyi kha phor :sbyin lug gis 'dzin pa'i las byed pa/ khrims lugs la rdog brdzis gtong mkhan 66khrims 'dzin pa / phu nu'i srog rtsa gcod pa'i nang dme mkhan sogs tha shal lugs 'gal can la mdung rtse gtad nas sun 'byin btang 'dugakhong gi brtsams sgrung 〈〈legs nyes 'byed pa'i gtan tshig 〉〉dang 〈〈med〉〉/ 〈〈re chad〉〉/ 〈〈chu rkyal〉〉/ 〈〈ca ne 〉〉sogs kyis dus skabs 'di lta bu'i spyi tshogs gnas tshul dngos de rgyab ljongs byas pa ste/ tshan rig lag rtsal gyi dngos phan rang bzhin che nas che ru song bas spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi gom stabs kyang je mgyogs su song / yin na yang deng rabs tshan rig dang rgyang thag ring ba'i mtho sgang pa rnams sngon thon sa khul dang rgyang thag je ring nas je ring du 'gro la/ rgyu mtshan ni deng rabs kyi spyi tshogs khor yug dang bstun pa'i 'du shes zhan pa'am yang na deng rabs spyi tshogs kyi 'phel 'gros dang mi mthun pa'i goms srol gyi 'ching bas rkang lag bsdams pa yin phyir/ gu dog srol rnying rnams 'phel rgyas kyi gegs su gyur par sun 'byin byas yod/— 16 —

khong gi brtsams sgrung gi 6 zhing khams nam yang gsham gyi skyo gar gyi kha dbugs khrod du gnas te/ yid kyi dad mos rnam dag gis stong pa'i gzugs phung zhig phyogs bzhir 'khyams/ mi tshe'i skyo gdung dang 'u thug ni kho tsho rang gis rang la bsam bzhin bgyis pa'i zhags pa bzhin nam char yang rang gi skor bskon par gra sgrig byed cing sngar bzhin mun pas khebs/ kho tshos bzod bsran dang brtson 'grus la brten nas kun slong brtan po'i dad pas tshe gang gi smon lam rgyag dus/ ci byed 'di byed mi shes pa'i skyo gdung las shul du lhag mi 'dug kyang / kho tsho ji 'dra'i bde ba la ang / yod tshad de 'dra'i dga' snang gis dang du blangs byung / tshe ring don grub kyis mi sna 'di dag re re bzhin khol du phyungs nas/ sbrid pa dang rtogs sad/ mchog gyur dang tha shal/'jon nus dang rdzun ma cha bsgrigs te klog pa po'i mig lam du bstar byin yod/mi yi ces pa ltar rang cag gi rtsom pa pos dngos yod 'tsho bar yang dag pa'i mig zung gis lta phod pa dang / 'tsho ba'i khrod du dngos su gnas kyang gnas lugs dang mi mthun pa'i snang tshul la dgag rgyag dang / ma brtag ma dpyad pa'i rmongs dad la skyon brjod drag po gtong ba'i spobs pa sa gzhi las brtan zhing nam mkha' las mtho ba red/de ltar nga tshos tshe ring don grub kyi brtsams sgrung gi brjod bya gdam sgrug byed stangs nas bsam blo'i bstan don la gzhigs na/ dus rabs sngon ma'i dus smad tsam nas bzung chos lugs dad mos kyi rang dbang lo ngo du mar shor ba'i dad ldan rnams 4 dad skom mi drag pos ded de brtag dpyad kyi bsam blo gang yang mi gtong bar rmongs tshod kyis dad gus bgyid pa'i rba rlabs che ru mched pa des/ dpal 'byor gyi ham khe gnyer ba'i mi sna skor zhig la 'byor phyug rgyas pa'i go skabs legs po byin pas/ chos lugs la kha g.yar zhing rgyu nor la sems gtad pa/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul khrims la rdog brdzis — 17 —

gtong bzhin thar pa la thod brgal byed pa/ bstan pa sna bshad sgrub mi kyis mi spel bar lha mthong 'dre btul gyi ya mtshan spel ba/ ra lam gyi bden pa bstan pas mi 'dren par lag gi rgyu nor blangs te 'dren khul byed pa mang du byung /de lta bu'i skyon mtshang sun 'byin gyis dad ldan la dogs zon bslangs pa dang / brtsams sgrung nang gi a lags 'brong lta bu ni 'di'i phyogs kyi mtshon dpe red/ kho'i brtsams sgrung khag gcig gis dngos gtso smra ba'i lta ba bzung ste mi rnams la mi tshe la gces shing tshan rig la brten dgos pa'i 'bod skul byas par ma zad/ chos pa zhig gi ngos nas bshad na yang bsam gzhig gi rin thang mi chung ba'i dri ba mang du bton yod/bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi sos ku'i bsil rlung mtho sgang du g.yug pa dang chabs cig bod spyi tshogs su'ang dpal 'byor gyi dbul phongs de chab srid kyi go sa snyeg byed ma rtsa byed pa'i 'du shes la 'gyur ldog byung ste/ srid 'dzin 'go khrid nyung shas shig gi khrod nas kyang rang gi chab srid kyi go sa de rang nyid la 'byor phyug spel byed lag cha byed pa'i srol lugs phyin ci log pa gzhan zhig gi mgo 'bus pas/ thob go sa dang rgyu sgor mo la ham sems skyes shing / thob go sa des rang gi 'byor ba spel ba dang rang gi 'dod don sgrub pa/dngul sgor gyis thob go sa blu ba/ rang dbang dang brtse dung rgyu nor la brje ba'i rlung nag cig 'ur 'ur mched/ chos lugs dang srol rnying / lkog za ham 'phrog sogs tshul min gyi spyod stangs kyi dbang gis nyams nyes byung zhing rang dbang shor te ci bya gtol bral du gyur pa'i nyam chung dang / yang na mi lus dang brtse dung gi rang dbang brtson len byed mi phod pa'i sgyid lug can/mdun lam la bsam gzhigs med pa'i mig rgyang thung ngu can/ tshul min la bzod sgom bsten pa'i sdar ma dag la khong gi smyug 'og nas gzhar yang tshe srog thob pa dang klog pa po'i spyan sngar 'dren thub par byas/— 18 —

nga tshos tshe ring don grub kyi brtsams chos la zhib tu bltas na/ khong gi brtsams chos kyi kun spyod kyi ya rabs dang 'gan khur gyi 'du shes shugs drag cig mi sna'i byed sgo dang byung rim zhib 'bri byas sa dag na mthong thub pa ma zad/ khong gis dbang chen dang stobs ldan gyi tshul min dang btsan shed la 'ud bstod dang ngo sos mgo bo mi skur la/ nyam chung dang nyes med la thub tshod dam rgyang bkyed mi byed pa'i dpa' ngar dang snying rje can zhig yin pa'ang tshor bar 'gyur zhing / 6 gzhan la gnod skyon bzo ba'i spyod lam la bzod sgom bsten pa ni nyes spyod de'i dpung gnyen byas pa yin/mi ( e 'in lan ti'i 〈〈rang btsan ring lugs pa gsar pa'i gus srol lta ba 〉〉) zhes pa'i tshul la bsams te bag yangs mi bsten pa'i khar nyes med dang ya rabs kyi sngon gral du langs nas ma rabs dang nyes skyon la mdzub mo 'dzugs pa'i ngal ba khur 'khyer gyi lhag bsam zhig kyang mthong thub/ de bas brtsams chos nang sna phugs bsam gyi phyogs ston bzung mi ( sgyu rtsal rtsom rig la no per bya dga' ster ba'i rtsa don zhig ) nas mi'i rigs 'tsho gnas kyi dar rgyas la do snang byas 'dug yang na/ tshe rin don grub ni rtog dpyod la dga' ba'i mi zhig yin la/ yang sgos su skyon mtshang 'byin pa la dbang po rno ba'i mi zhig kyang red/ de yang gzhan la skyon 'dzugs dang rang la ngo so brjod pa tsam ma yin par 6 nad mkhris pa'i sman la zhim po med/ sha tsha ba'i gtam la snyan po med mi pa yi lhag bsam zhig yin nges/ kho'i rtsom la bya dga' mang po thob pa dang klog pa po mang po zhig kho'i rtsom la dga' ba yang kho'i 'gan khur pa'i lhag byisaswā 'di la tshad mtho'i gdeng 'jog byas pa'i mtshon rtags shig tu the mi ma tshe/ ri/ nga don grub kyi sgrung 'bring 〈〈ra lo 〉〉la mtshon na/ rtsom pa pos spyi tshogs kyi 'phel 'grib sna tshogs dang 'tsho gzhes kyi lo rgyus dkyogs mtshams — 19 —

re re nas thob pa'i legs nyes bzang ngan gyi myong rtogs gzhir byas/ 'tsho ba'i yul khongs thams cad nas 'dor len dang gdam gses gang nus byas te/ ches mngon gsal dang gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi mi 'dang ba'i cha thams cad blang dor yod pa'i sgo nas legs par mtshon te spyi tshogs legs bcos dang kun spyod lugs mthun can du bsgyur 'dod kyi bsam blo de ra lo'i steng du mngon yod de/ brtsams chos nang gi mi sna gtso bo ra lor mtshon na/ 66'tsho ba'i myong brgyud re re'i khrod nas bslab bya blangs nas rang nyid 'phel rgyas gtong ma thub la/ 'gal 'du'i gdong gtugs re rer rang gshis 'gyur bcos byas te 'dun ma gsar pa 'tshol snyeg byed ma thub pas chung ngu'i dus kyi ra lo dang rgas pa'i dus kyi ra lo'i bar snabs kyi sbom phra tsam las gzhan 'gyur ldog gang yang med miXpa de gtso bo kho la brtson 'grus dang snying stobs med phyir gzhi gang nas kyang rtsa ba tshugs ma thub pas dus kyi 'phel 'gros ji ltar mgyogs na'ang 'dra/ 'tsho ba'i 'gal 'du ji ltar drag na'ang 'dra/ ra lo'i mi gshis la 'gyur ldog dang 'tsho ba'i bgo skal gsar pa zhig byung rgyu ni da rung nga tsho dang rgyang thag cung ring po zhig red/ rtsom pa pos 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi 'gal 'du dang bzang ngan yag btsog gi cha mang po zhig ra lo'i steng bsdus shing / phra zhib kyis zhib 'bri byas pa'i thabs la brten nas klog pa po'i bsam blo mtha' med pa'i mdo dbus mtho sgang shar rgyud kyi 'brog pa'i rtswa thang du khrid cing nyams su myong ba dang /phyir 'dang rgyag pa/ rang gi dran snang sna tshogs rgyun bsring bar byas/ lus po dang sems pa/ 'tsho gnas dang 'dun pa'i bar gyi 'gal ba ni ra lo kho nar yod pa'i nyams myong skya bo tsam min par nga tsho mi re re'i mdun du lhags pa'i dka' ngal yin/〈〈ra lo 〉〉ni tshe ring don grub kyi brtsams sgrung khag las cung legs — 20 —

'grub byung ba'i brtsams sgrung zhig yin pa dang / mi sna gtso bo ra lo'i snang brnyan la dpe mtshon gyi don snying ldan zhes smras chog rtsom pa po'i sgyug 'og gi ra lo ni 'tsho ba'i dmigs yul mi gsal zhing 'dang rgyag mi shes pa/ lta spyod phyin ci log cing mi tshe'i phugs re yongs su bral ba'i mdo med nus med cig yin rkyen mi tshe'i 'dun ma'i go skabs re rer 'ja' tshon dang rmi lam ji bzhin stong 'dang gi khrod nas yal ba'i mi sna zhig tu bzhengs bskrun byas yod de/ 〈〈sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu 〉〉las kyang kho ni rang la yid chad dang rang bkur/ nyon mongs dang btang snyoms su 'jog pa/ rang 'dod can dang khog rgya can/ skyug bro ba dang sems bzang ba bcas mnyam du 'dus shing nam yang rang snang rang gis skyid du 'jug la gang la gang bstun byed mkhas pa zhig yin zhes pa dang / kho chung dus nas pha ma'i gnyor skyong dang bral ba'i dwa phrug sdom po zhig yin na'ang / ra lo 'tsho sdod byed pa'i khor yug der phun sum tshogs pa dang go skabs kyis yongs su phyug pa'i spyi tshogs yar thon zhig bi dge mtshan 'dzoms stabs/ sdom po'i 'tsho ba skyong ba'i kho yang slob grwar bskyal ba dang / mag par bsdad pa/ mna' ma blangs pa/ grwa ba byas pa sogs 'tsho ba'i re ba gsar pa thengs mang po byung myong / 'on kyang ra lo ni rang gis rang la yid chad pa zhig yin pa'i stabs kyis chung dus nas a pa'i brtse ba shor/ lhan skyes nas sdar ma snying chung ste/ lo bcu kha'i nang du'ang rta'i rgyab tu kha bub log nas 'gro ba las lcag gis bskul mi nus/ zhes pa ltar yin/gzhan rnams kyis slob chung lo lnga'i nang mthar phyin na'ang ra los lo brgyad la bton pa'i mthar nam gung la skyes ma'i dge rgan gyi nyal khang gi sgo brdungs pa'i rkyen gyis phyir pha yul du bskyal/ gzhan gyis bshad bshad nas 'gro sgo ci yang gtong mi dgos pa'i mag par bsdad rjes/ 6 nga ni khyod tshang gi bdag po las yun ring gi g.yog po min/mi zhes pa la brten nas lugs — 21 —

mthun gyis ngo rgol byas/ bud med des ra lo'i ngor bltas nas gzhan dang gnyen bsgrigs pa'i dgod gtam dang zur za mtha' chod pa byas mod kyang /ra los bltas na de ni phal cher kho dang 'brel ba cang med pa ltar snang / 'di lta bu'i dgod bro ba'i gnyen sgrig gis ra lor sdug chen po skyel mi thub/ rgyu mtshan ni ra lo nam yang za ri zi ri'i ngang rang gi lto ba'i ched du 'tsho la/ mi'i lhan skyes kyi dgos mkho las gzhan de las 'phags pa'i bsam blo'i dgos mkhor bsam blo mi 'khor bas gting zab cing ro kha ba'i brtse dung gang la'ang kha phyogs khom med/ kho rang la ches ran pa ni grwa sar 'gro rgyu de red/dgon par ja thun gsum por 'dang rgyag mi dgos par nyin re bzhin phal cher 'bras legs shos dang mar/ rgum 'brum/ sha bcas las grub pa'i bsod snyoms brgyag chad pa re bza' rgyu yod/ ra los tshe 'di ji ltar skyel rgyu mi shes la skye ba phyi ma de bas kyang rgyang thag ring zhing ci byed cha ma 'tshal/ khos de lta bu'i dgon pa'i 'tsho ba dngos gnas bsran thabs bral/ ra mos ston pa'i na bza' gyon pa ni 'khor bar nges 'byung skyes pa ni ma yin gyi 'tsho ba mu mthud du skyel stangs kyi rnam pa bsgyur ba tsam yin pas/ 'tsho ba'i gnad don thag chod tsa na sngar bzhin rang tshod rang gis mi zin par gyur/ kho dgon pa'i 'dul khrims la mi gnas par gtsang po'i phar ngogs su 'jig rten gyi bde ba 'tshol du phyin/ mjug 'bras ni ra lo dgod bro la ngu 'chor ba'i khrims rmongs kyi tshul bzung ba'i brtse dung gi zlos gar thengs gnyis par gzhan gyi khyo ga'i tshab tu bsdad pa'i skyo gar bsgyur/ khos pho ba'i don du bzhon pa gcig po de'ang mi btsong thabs med byung mod/ gnam 'og na gson thabs gtan nas med pa'ang ma yin te/ mi tshe'i 'gyur bag re re'i klong na ra lo'i lhan skyes kyi sems pa bzang po dang bden pa bskyangs nas gzhan la rogs ram byed pa'i gshis ka da dung 'gyur med/ snying rje zhing khong khro'ang langs pa/— 22 —

dgod bro la ngu yang 'chor ba'i ra lo'i gnyen thengs gsum pa bud med khrims rmongs shig gi khyo ga'i sku tshab tu bsdad pas/ bud med de zla drug gi ring btson du 'dug dgos mod/ gzhung rgyud drang ba'i ra los kho mo'i dam bcar yid ches te/ re bas brtas la brel ba 'tshub pos kho rang gi brtse dung bi ches mtha'i gnas mal la sgugasgrung 'bring 'di'i brjod bya'i bstan don ni/ rtsom pa pos ra lo lta bu'i mi mdo med cig gi gshis ga'i khyad chos 'bri bzhengs byas pa brgyud bod mi'i gshis rgyud steng gi ches nag phyogs kyi cha ste/ 'tsho bar mtha' gcig tu re snyeg med par chu 'khyag kha yi rtsam skya ji bzhin 'tsho ba'i kha ru lung ma bstan du 'phyo ba'i mdo med phugs med kyi gshis spyod la mtshang 'byin gting zab mo byas pa dang / rang re'i mi rigs 'di dus rabs dang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel phyogs ji 'dra'i dza drag ldan na'ang bag 'khums su gnas pa'i tshul las sad rtog dang mdun skyod kyi lam la zhugs thabs bral ba'i gegs su song ba ra sprod byas shing / tsa 'das pa'i lo ngo brgya phrag mang po'i lo rgyus 'phel rim khrod chos chos su ma song zhing 'jig rten 'jig rten du ma song ba'i khag 'gel ring lugs kyi lta spyod 'chal po zhig bod mi dmangs khrod nas dar/ 'dod chung chog shes dang 'jig rten la snying po med par 'dod pa'i chos pa'i lta spyod 'ga' 'jig rten le lo mkhan rnams kyis dang len dang g.yo khag dkri sa byas/miX des na bod mi rigs dar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro dgos na/ mi su dang su yin rung rang nyid spyi tshogs kyi khur bo zhig tu mi 'gyur bar brtson dgos la/ dus nam yin yang dus rabs kyi rjes su mi lus par 'tsho ba gsar pa dang / spyi tshogs gsar pa zhig la snyeg dgos pa'i re ba'ang bstan yod/rtsom 'di las gtam rgyud kyi byung rim bltos bcas kyis btang snyoms su bskyur te/ mi sna'i gshis ka bzhengs bskrun bya ba ang dang por bzung bas/— 23 —

rtsom pa pos yul can gyi byed nus ches cher spyad de/ byung rim gyis mi sna'i gshis ku'i bzhengs skrun la zhabs 'degs dang / ra lo'i 6 mi tshe :las ches mtshon stobs yod pa'i dum bu 'ga' 'dems sgrug sgas spang blang chen po dang / las snon chen pos mi sna'i gshis ka spyi gzugs su sgrub yod/ der ma zad rtsom 'di spro gar gyi tshul du bris pas spyir spro gar yin mod/ 'on kyang 'di spro gar kho na zhig ma yin par/ spro gar gyi tshul du bris pa'i skyo gar zhig dang / spro gar rang bzhin gyi skyo gar gyi gshes ka bzhengs skrun byas pa zhig yin pas/ skyo spro gnyis ka rtsom 'di'i nang tshad mthon po'i sgo nas gcig gyur byas yod pa zhig yin/ lu'u zhun gyis gsungs pa'i 6 skyo ste kho'i sdug bsngal la snron/ khro ste kho'i sgyid lug la khro mi zhes pa ra lo dang nga tsho la'ang shin tu 'phrod pa gsum pa/ a smyon bkra zhis don grub dang kho'i brtsams sgrung /a smyon bkra shis don grub ( 1967wa 〉ni mtsho sngon zhing chen khri ka rdzong gi mi yin/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs dgu bcu'i nang dpe skrun byas pa'i brtsams sgrung phyogs bsgrigs 〈〈ston gyi rang sgra 〉〉'grem spel byas tshun/ rgya che'i klog pa po spyi dang sgos su rtsom rig la dga' ba dag gis bsngags brjod kyi me tog bar med du stor bzhin mchis/'dir nga tshos a smyon bkra shis don grub kyi 〈〈ston gyi rang sgra 〉lo7gtso byas te brtsams sgrung spyi'i sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs dang bsam blo'i nang don gnyis kyi thad ngo sprod mdor bsdus byas na/a smyon bkra shis don grub ni rgya bod gnyis ka 'dus sdod byas yod pa'i rong ma 'brog gi sa cha zhig tu skyes shing / kho rang nar son pa'i khor yug gis kho'i yid la srol rgyun rig gnas kyi bag chags zab mo zhig bzhag yod la/— 24 —

deng rabs shes rig gi 'du shes kyang na gzhon 'di'i snying khong na drag tu khol cing mchis te/ kho rang dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi rma klung dang zhing grong gi srang lam brgyud nas me 'khor gyi nga ro dang kha par gyi bgro gleng / 'phrin gtong 'phrul chas kyis yig cha skyel ba'i 'jig rten zhig tu slebs/ kho'i 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim ni rtsom pa po zhig la mtshon na rin thang gzhal du med pa'i bang mdzod cig tu gyur yod pa dang / nang sems kyi dung zhen dang tshor snang sbyad sbya zhig sgrir du btegs nas rang nyid song zin pa'i lam bur phyir blta da bdī sdus kā/nga 〈〈spyang kyi lug rdzi dang kho'i chung ma 〉snyozhes pa'i nang du gtam rgyud 'di 'dra zhig bshad yod de/ lug rdzi tshe los rang gis 'tsho skyong byed bzhin pa'i lug khyu srung skyob byed ched spyang rgan ma zhig bsad cing / tag tag spyang rgan ma de ni sa de'i gzhi bdag a myes srin po'i sgo khyi yin pa red/yang gcig bshad na khos nor 'khrul gyis rang gis tshe gang bor ri dwags rngon sa'i a myes srin po'i sgo khyi bsad par brten/ a myes srin pos kyang kho'i drin lan log 'jal gyi sbyor ba der rgol lan slog phyir zhag ma gcig gi ring la kho'i lug khyu na sha bzan ya med bcu tsam yod pa spyang phrug rnams la gsod du ba/sna ngo mar/ gtam rgyud 'di 'dra ba bod khul du rlung ltar grags shing /gzhi bdag gang zhig la phog thug btang ba las mi de la chag sgo ga 'dra byung tshul gyi gtam rgyud ni bod dmangs khrod du ga sa ga nas go thub/ gal te kho'i brtsams sgrung ni tshad 'di 'dra zhig tu bsdad yod pa'i dbang du btang na/ de ni bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig 'tshol sdud byas pa tsam du zad la/ de'ang khyad mtshar gyi rngon las thengs shig las ma 'das pa lta bur gyur 'duga.a smyon bkra shis don grub kyi rtsom rtsal la mkhas pa'i cha de/ khos sgrung la — 25 —

khyad mtshar gyi tshon mdangs zab mo zhig byugs pa'i dus mtshungs su/ bsam bzhin du legs 'grub byung ba'i khungs sne zhig bskungs yod la/ khungs sne de ni mi sna gnyis kyis grub yod cing / gcig ni lug rdzi tshe lo'i chung ma khams mtsho dang gzhan zhig ni slob grwa chen mo ba 'jigs byed red/mi sna 'di gnyis kyi bkod sgrig gis srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng rabs dpal yon gnyis ka zung 'brel gang legs byas yod pa'i mtshungs su kha gtad du langs su'ang bcug yod la/ mi sna 'di gnyis kyi nus par brten nas brtsams sgrung rang ngos las gtam rgyud kyi byung rim khyad mtshar ba'i cha de 'bur du thon par byas 'dug de bas nga tshos nam yang brtsams sgrung las gtam rgyud kyi byung rim la snang chung byed mi 'os te/ rgyu mtshan ni gtam rgyud de dag dmangs khrod kho nar byung ba las rtog 'char dang rtog bzo byas pa gtan nas min/ kho bo'i lta tshul la a smyon bkra shis don grub kyis deng rabs brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom thabs shes dang bod dmangs khrod kyi gtam rgyud gnyis sgril thag gcig la brgyus pa de ni gsar rnyed cig red 'dod/1 sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs kyi thad tshig sbyor mdzes shing mtshon thabs gsar pa bsten pa/rtsom yig gang 'dra zhig yin yang / legs grub byung yod med kyi tshad de thog mar yi ger dag cha yod med dang tshig gi sbyor ba mdzes mi mdzes kyi steng nas gzhal dgos te/ a smyon bkra shis don grub song zin pa'i rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi bshul lam la bltas tshe/ khos thengs dang por dus deb tu spel ba ni brtsams sgrung ma yin par tshigs bcad snyan ngag red/ bod kyi tshigs bcad snyan ngag legs po zhig 'bri dgos tshe smyug rtsal nges can zhig yod dgos pa ni ma mtha'i rmang gzhi yin/ a smyon bkra shes don grub la de'i phyogs nas cha rkyen gang yag cig 'dzoms yod par brten/ snyan ngag gsar rtsom gyi — 26 —

ldum ra'i khrod du'ang kun gyi mig la mdzes pa'i snyan rtsom gyi me tog tshom bur byas te gso skyong byas yod pa dang / phyis su brtsams sgrung la mos pa je cher song ba dang bstun nas/ mang tshogs kyi skad char mthun zhing snyan ngag ji khyad chos 'bur du thon pa 'i tshig bi sbyor bar brten nas brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom byas pas na/ klog bde zhing sdeb legs pa/ spus dag cing snyan cha ldan pas thun min gyi dbyangs 'gros shig rgyud skud phra mor rang chas su yod pa lta bu'i khyad chos brtsams sgrung 〈〈tshe srog gi 'bod pa 〉lomibaklags na rtse thog gi bu ram ltar yang bskor bskyar bskor du myong rgyu yod pa dang / rtsom pa pos thog mtha' bar gsum du gang zag gnyis pa'i ngag sgo bkol nas gsar rtsom byas pas na/ brjod don gsal ba'i tshig rkang re re bkod sgrig 'tshams pa'i byung rim re re'i 'phel 'gros dang bstun nas lu gu rgyud ltar spel pa'i tshul ni ha cang mngon gsal dod po zhig go/a smyon bkra shis don grub kyis nam rgyun mi rigs gzhan gyi mtshon thabs gsar pa sdud len byas khar/ bod mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig la gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang bar brten/ de dag las brtsams sgrung 〈〈mi rkyang gcod pa 〉lo7ni sems khams dngos yod ring lugs kyi mtshon thabs bkol nas bris yod de/ grub mtha' 'di 'dzin mkhan gyi rtsom pa po rnams kyis gtso bo mi sna gang zhig bi nang sems kyi 'gal bar don dngos dang mthun pa'i zhib dpyod gtong ba'am/ yang na 'gal ba ltag sprod du gyur pa'i don gcig gam du ma dmigs su bzung ste/ rgya je che dang gting je zab tu zhib 'bri byed pa zhig yin la/ brtsams sgrung 'dir mtshon na yang nags srung phul byung can mi rkyang gcod pas mtshan mor shing sdong brku ru 'ongs te brag kha nas lhung ba'i pha gsod kyi lag dmar mi sdom seng ngo lag la chud skabs/skyob bam mi skyob kyi cha la nang sems su 'gal ba sna tshogs byung ba ste/ sgog — 27 —

pa'i phyi shun re re bzhin bshu ba'i tshul gyis mi sna'i snang brnyan zhib 'bri mdzad nas/ mi rkyang gcod pa'i bsam pa'i 'jig rten brgyud nas kho'i snang brnyan de gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas bzhengs 'dug 'dir rtsom pa pos gtso bo thun mong ma yin pa'i khor yug nang du thun mong ma yin pa'i mi sna gang gi bsam blo'i 'gyur ldog zhib 'bri byed pa las/ brtsams sgrung gi byung rim dang mi sna'i phyi lus kyi rnam/ pa bcas la snang 'jog cher mi byed par/ de las ldog ste mi sna'i bsam blo'i 'gyur ldog dang nang sems kyi kher lab zhib 'bri byas nas rtsom pa po'i 'tsho ba'i lta tshul de ston bzhin yod/ song gsal dang bsdur tshe sgrung 'bring 〈〈ston gyi rang sgra 〉〉ni 'phrin yig lus can gyi brtsams sgrung yin pa shes sla ste/ brtsams sgrung hril po skye khungs dang rang gshis/ las gnas mi 'dra ba'i slob grwa chen mo ba bzhis phan tshun yi ge bskur ba brgyud nas lo rabs dgu bcu pa'i bod khul gyi 'tsho ba de gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas zhib 'bri byas yod pas/ phun sum tshogs pa'i spyi tshogs kyi kun mthong me long zhig tu grub 'dug brtsams sgrung 'dir mtshon na gtam rgyud kyi byung rim rtog 'dzing can dang mi sna'i snang brnyan gson nyams can/da dung mi sna gtso bo re re'i gshis ka 'bur du thon pa'i thad zhan cha dang mi 'dang sa cung tsam yod kyang / 'bri thabs ni bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi khyab khongs su byung ma myong bas na/ 'phrin yig lus can gyi brtsams sgrung gather sbyong tāng 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i thad shugs rkyen chen po thebs par ga na2 trī sna/ /dag gi 'du shes rnying pa las mthar te gsar pa dang sngon thon la phyogs pa'i bsam blo mngon pa/a smyon bkra shis don grub kyi brtsams sgrung phal che ba ni 'das zin pa'i gtam rgyud rnying pa'i 'dam rdzab tu zug med par/ kho'i sgyug rtse las rang — 28 —

'bab kyi tshul du bzhur 'ongs pa ni bod kyi deng rabs 'tsho ba'i nang si mi gsar don gsar red/ de bas mi sna gsar pa de dag bis bsam blo gsar pa mtshon bzhin yod pa dper na 〈〈'pho 'gyur 〉lo1nang bi tsha bo stag phrug dang /〈〈sangs ljongs/ rnam shes kyi 'jig rten 〉poyikhrod kyi bu mo tshe sgron/ 〈〈g.yul bcag pa'i gtam rgyud 〉posanang gi bu yi dam sogs mang yang / re re gleng na mang bar dogs pas 'dir bsam blo gsar pa gsar rkyang mtshon pa'i sgrung 'bring 〈〈ston gyi rang sgra 〉〉las cung zad spros na/de yang 〈〈ston gyi rang sgra 〉〉ni a smyon bkra shis don grub kyi brtsams sgrung phyogs bsgrigs nang bi yig 'bru ches mang zhing ldebs grangs ches mang ba'i gras shig yin te/ brtsams sgrung 'di'i nang du rtsom pa pos skyes khungs dang las khungs/ rang gshis dang ngang rgyud/ las ka dang las dbang mi 'dra ba'i slob grwa chen mo ba bzhi'i bsam blo'i bkod pa mngon par mtshon yod/ de dag las kun mkhyen 'jigs med ni mthing smug sbra yi nang du nar son pa'i 'brog pa dkyus ma zhig gi bu yin zhing / slob grwa chen mo'i yo'an krang gi sras mo dang brtse dung gi 'brel ba yod pas 〈〈ge sar 〉〉zhib 'jug khang du sdod thub pa byung / rang gi thos rgya dang shes rgya je cher gtong slad dbyin yig mu mthud du sbyong bzhin yod par ma zad/ zi ling gi sna mi rkyang tshogs pa : yi gras su zhugs te mkhar grong du nar son pa'i bod rigs las byed pa'i bu bu mor mi rigs slob gso myong bar byed ched/ las zhor gyi dus tshod bed spyod gnang ste slob chung gsar pa zhig sgrig 'dzugs kyi don du 'bad pa lhur len byed bzhin yod/ a lags 'jam dbyangs ni chung dus nas dwa phrug tu lus par brten/ a khu mchog gi gzigs skyong 'og slob grwa chen mo'i sgo them brgyud thub pa byung ba zhig ste/ chung ma bu phrug gis dam du bcings pa'i khar las bgos kyang bsam thog tu ma yong mod/ rgya bod yig sgyur gyi las la mkhas par ma — 29 —

zad/ zhi dul bag yod can zhig yin pas kun gyis blor 'bab pa zhig go /spyi tshogs 'tsho bar zab zhugs byas pa dang sgos su khul chos lugs cus nang du las sgor byas pa nas bzung / bsam blo la gnam sa bla 'og bsgyur pa 'dra ba'i 'pho 'gyur byung ste 66ston pa ya sangs rgyas/ nga tsho mi rigs 'dis mi rabs nas mi rabs su khyed nyid skyabs kyi dam par brtsis te/ bstan pa rin po che srid mthar skyong ba'i ched du rang gi gces pa'i srog kyang phangs med du 'bul bar byed na/ nga tsho mi rigs 'di dang 'di'i sgo zog la kha ba'i 'dab ma tsam gyis gnod skyon chen ngo/ thebs kyang / khyed sku mi mngon dbyings su bzhugs nas snying rje'i 'od zhags da dung mi rkyong ba ci yin nam/ bla ma ya sprul sku/ nga tsho mi rigs 'dis pha ring nas bu ring bar khyed kyi sprul ba'am yang sprul mgon gyi dang por bzhag ste/ mchog sku zla ba sngar las rgyas ched rang la mkho dgu'i rin chen ma lus zol med du 'bul bar byed na/ nga tsho mi rigs 'di dang 'di'i sgo zog gis shi sason gnyis kyi sbrel mtshams su mtha' mjug bi 'phag 'tshag brgyab 'dug kyang / khyed nyid bla brang gi yang phug tu bzhugs nas mig mdun gyi thams cad snying rje'i yul du mi dgongs pa gang gi phyir/mi⑨ zhes pa lta bu'i dri ba bton 'dug pa dang / myang tsha chos sgron ni rdzong mkhar du yod pa'i las byed pa'i khyim tshang zhig gi bu skal ma yin zhing /dus rabs gsar pa'i bod rigs bud med rnams kyi 'thus tshab du'ang bgrang chog bsil ldan bod kyi mi rabs rjes ma rnams gso skyong bya slad/ mos bsam bzhin du dge rgan gyi bya ba bdams nas rang gi pha yul du log ste rgyun ldan gyi slob khrid bya ba'i zhor du/ rang gis rtsom yig 'bri ba'am yang na dge grogs dang slob ma rnams la rtsom skul byas te bsam blo gsar pa'i skor dril sgrog byed bzhin pa dang / sprel rgan blo bzang ni mkhyen rgya yangs pa'i rdzong dpon zhig gi bu ste/ chung dus nas ma rabs pra tshags kyi las la goms na — 30 —

yang rig pa thod pas rgya yig gi chu tshad ha cang mtho la/ a pa'i mngags bkod ltar phyogs yongs nas cha rkyen zhan pa'i yul tsho zhig tu phyin pa nas rim bzhin bsam blo la 'gyur ldog byung ste/ 'brog pa mang tshogs dbul thar phyug sgyur gyi lam du 'khrid ched khe las bzo grwa 'dzugs par nus shugs yod dgu 'don bzhin pa bcas lags so/ /brtsams sgrung nang gi mi sna 'di bzhi bo'i 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim mi 'dra ba'ang / kho tshos bod rigs mi dmangs kyi mdun lam 'tshol ba'i bsam blo gsar pa ni chu brgya zam 'dus kyi tshul du snang ba ste/ slob gso yi spus tshad ji ltar mthor 'degs gtong ba dang / tshan rig dang mthun pa'i rig gnas gsar pa ji ltar nang 'dren byed pa/ thabs sna tshogs la brten nas dpal 'byor gyi sgo glegs ji ltar phye ba/ da dung bod mi'i nang khul gyi mthun sgril ji ltar dam 'dzin byed pa dang / dmangs yongs kyi spus ka je mthor btang nas rjes lus kyi zhwa mo ji ltar g.yugs par 'bod skul bzhing yod pas/ mi la slob gso dang yar skul gyi nus pa ches cher thon 'dugs bye/na bkra shis don grub kyi brtsams sgrung nang du 'du shes gsar rnying par gyi 'gal ba mtshon pa can gyis tshad nges can zhig zin yod de/ dper na 〈〈gces phrug sga ched du 〉〉dang 〈〈btson ma zhig gi snying gtam〉〉/ 〈〈g.yul bcag pa'i gtam rgyud〉〉/ 〈〈drin chen ma〉〉/ 〈〈sems nad〉〉/ 〈〈tshe srog gi 'bod pa〉〉/ 〈〈'pho 'gyur〉〉/ 〈〈nga dang sgrol ma rnam gsum gyi gtam rgyud 〉〉sogs yod pa red/ 'di ni bod kyi deng rabs spyi tshogs dang 'brel ba dam zab yod pa ste/ 'gal ba'i gzhi rtsa phar ded na srol rgyun gyi 'tsho bar zhen chags che ba'i rgan rabs pa dang deng rabs 'tsho ba'i 'du shes drag pa'i gzhon rabs pa'i bar gyi bsam blo'i 'thab rtsod cig red/ de yang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba ni 'gyur ba'am 'phel ba'i rnam pa can zhig yin pas na/ rnying pa ma — 31 —

dor tshe gsar pa mi 'byung la/ gsar pa ma byung tshe 'phel rgyas zer ba'ang yod mi srid pas/ rang re mi rigs gnas yul 'di stobs 'byor mnga' thang ldan pa zhig tu yong ba'i re smon che ba'i rtsom pa po rnams la mtshon na/ dus nam yang dus rabs kyi sngon du skyod bzhin pa lags pas/ kho tsho'i brtsams chos nang nghru baspyad bya 'di rigs mang du 'byung ba ni dus kyi bu mos byin pa'i bso skal go trī du kā/nga zin pa'i brtsams sgrung kun las kyang 〈〈nga dang sgrol ma rnam gsum gyi satam rgyud 〉〉ni yid 'gugs kyi nus pa che zhing slob gso'i rin thang nges can ldan la/ 'du shes gsar rnying par gyi 'gal ba thabs mkhas kyis mtshon par byed pa'i brtsams sgrung zhig ste/ brtsams sgrung hril ngo 'bod ming dang po tsa nga mi dang sgrol ma gsum bar 'brel ba yod la 'bras bu med pa'i brtse dung bi skyo gar la brten nas/ thabs mkhas kyis bod kyi spyi tshogs su rgyun mar 'phrad pa'i 'du shes rnying pa gsum la brtsams sgrung gcig gi nang du dgag rgyag mdzad yod par ma zad/ 66ngas mi 'tsho ba gsar par re snyeg ji ltar byed pa dang / srol rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i gzeb dra'i nang ji ltar 'phag 'tshag rgyag bzhin pa'i spobs sems kyang mngon par mtshon yod do//bzhi pa/ rang sgra dang kho'i brtsams skung /rang sgra ( 1964wa )ni mdo smad thung te rdzong khongs kyi mi yin/ ming dngos la tshe rgyal zer/ nga tsho 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i yul gru 'di la gangs dkar po shel gyi mchod rten 'dra ba gangs dkar ti se dang / 'brog la phyi gangs/ tsa ri tra/ jo mo gangs dkar/ rong chen kha ba dkar po/ a chen gangs/ rma rgyal sgom ra sogs kyis bskor bas gangs ri ra bas bskor ba'i yul ljongs zhes thogs pa dang / dus tshigs bzhi bor rab dkar kha ba'i mdangs mi 'gyur — 32 —

ba'i gangs ri'i 'dabs su 'tsho ba'i mi rigs 'di la sha za gdong dmar bod dam byang phyogs kha ba can gyi mi zhes rjod kyin 'dug mi rigs 'di la de lta bu'i ming zhig thogs pa de rang nyid gnas pa'i sa cha'i khyad chos la rag las pa smos mi dbos kyang / de la rab dkar kha ba las lhag pa'i sems lams yag po zhig dang / ngang rgyud gyong ba'i skye bo ma rungs pa 'dul ba'i mnā stobs dang dpa' ngar yod pa la 'brel ba gtan nas med pa zhig kyang ma kā/ma rig ni skad char brten nas sgyu rtsal snang brnyan bzhengs skrun byed pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin na/ nga tsho'i sgyu rtsal gyi ma lag 'grub byed ni gangs 'dabs kyi mi sna'i gzugs brnyan 'di'i steng du 'jog dgos shing / brtsams sgrung gi byung rim ni dbyin ji'i brtsams sgrung bi gzhung lugs smra ba hphu si this gsungs pa ltar rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba'i steng du 'jog dbos na/ de lta bu'i rgyu dang 'bras bu yang gangs 'dabs kyi gtam rgyud nang gnas pa dang / nga tsho klog pa po rnams kyis brtse dung gi ngar ma yal bar btsal na mi rnyed pa ga la srid de/ lha smyug rtse nas khrag dang mchi ma 'dzar ba'i minyubartse dung gi zegs ma yang gnas der stor yod pa dang / rtsom pa po'i lhad med pa'i bsam blo dang phugs bsam yang de las lhang la 'bud srid pas sna spyir btang du rlabs chen gyi rtsom pa po rnams ni bsam blo ba yin pa dang / phul du byung ba'i brtsams chos ni sgyu rtsal gsar gtod tsam du ma zad/ gcig nas sgyu rtsal gsar rnyed dang / gnyis nas 'tsho ba gsar rnyed/ gsum nas rang nyid gsar snyed kyang yin/mi yi zhes pa ni dngos 'brel don dngos dang mthun pa zhig red/rang sgra'i brtsams sgrung phyogs bsgrigs 〈〈gangs 'dabs kyi gtam rgyud 〉lo7la khyon bsdoms brtsams sgrung thung 'bring bcu phrag tsam bsdus yod la/ de dag gis gangs ri'i 'dabs kyi mi rigs 'di'i chab srid dang / dpal — 33 —

'byor/ rig gnas/ 'du shes 'dzin stangs/ pho mo'i brtse dung / mi rigs 'di'i dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos te/ drang ldog gi u tshugs/ 'tsho ba'i 'gal zla bcas mtshon 'dug cing / gtam rgyud de dag gi phugs su rtsom pa ngo/sa rang re'i spyi tshogs la bcangs pa'i bsam blo sbas 'dug pa dang / rang re'i mi rigs 'di lo ngo stong phrag mang po'i ring la kher rkyang dang bskyar bzlas/dbul phongs kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du gnas pas de las mgyogs myur du 'bral ba'i phugs sems kyang sbas yod/bod 'di bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bran g.yog spyi tshogs nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs kyi thod brgal byung ba'i dus rim ni shin tu rtog 'dzing ldan pa zhig dang shin tu rno ngar ldan pa zhig red/ bod kyi spyi tshogs steng gi dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul gyi 'gal ba dang / dbang bsgyur gral rim dang dbang bsgyur myong mkhan gral rim bar gyi 'gal ba/ phyug po dang dbul po'i bar gyi 'gal ba/ chos lugs grub mtha'i bar gyi 'gal ba bcas ni gangs ri'i 'dabs kyi mi rigs 'di'i sha dang / pags pa/ rus pa/khrag rgyun bcas la 'dres te khyab yod pa dang / mi rigs 'di'i 'gal ba de 'dra'i khrod nas lo ngo brgya phrag mang po la 'tsho ba rol ba'i rkyen gyis 'gal ba de das ni bsam pa'i 'du shes shig tu gyur yod pa dang / dus yun ring po'i spyi tshogs kyi thon dngos 'dis dus rabs gsar pa'i gzhon nu mang po zhig gi sems su sne du ma nas rma kha bzos shing bzo bar byed/ 〈〈pha yul gyi lam phranasteng na 〉skokhyazhes pa'i sgrung thung de ni spyi tshogs 'tsho ba de 'dra zhig rgyab ljongs byas pa mngon sum gyis grub 'dug dus rabs gsar pa'i gzhon nu pho mo 'di gnyis kyi brtse dung gi bgegs de lo rgyus kyis sprad pa dang / kho gnyis kyi rigs 'di'i bag la nyal ba'i 'du shes kyang nem thabs bral na yang / mi sna 'di gnyis kyi sems kyi rma kha dang bsam pa'i 'dun ma de mig chu'i lam — 34 —

nas mtshon par byas pas mig chu de la lkog gyur gyi stobs shugs 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig yod pa zhar la rtogs thub/de ltar brtsams sgrung thung gras 〈〈tshe thar gyi rang gtam 〉lokhyazhes pa de ni rang re'i 'tsho ba'i 'gal ba mtshon pa'i dpe ris gson nyams ldan pa zhig yin/ de las rdzi bo dang tshe thar bar gyi brtse dung zhib 'bri byas yod par ma zad/ kho gnyis bar gyi 'gal ba'ang zhib 'bri byas yod/ rdzi bo tshe thar la de 'dra dung ba'ang 'tsho ba yin/ 'tsho ba'i ched du tshe thar gson gsur la phud pa'ang 'tsho ba yin/ de la srog chags mi'i gzugs su bkod pa'i gtam rgyud ces bya zhing / rtsom pa pos spyir btang gi sgo phyugs lug cig gis gangs ri'i khrod kyi mi rigs 'di'i bsam spyod mtshon par byas pa ni lug dang bod mi'i bar du thun mong ma yin pa'i 'brel ba dam po yod pa'i rkyen red/ rdzi bos lug gi ched du lug tshe thar du btang ba min la/ rdzi bo rang gi ched du lug tshe thar du btang ba'ang min/ yin rgyu ni ma myes ( gzhi bdag ) kyi ched du yin pa ste/ 66de ring nas btsongs na rin mi len/ bshas na sha mi za/ lus bal rtsid bregs te thag pa mi brgyu/ rgyab pags pa bshus te slog pa mi bzo/ gson na shi na bdag po a myes khyod las med/mi ⑩ ces pa'i cho ga'i skabs kyi tshig 'di dag gis shes thub/ rdzi bo tshe thar la byams shing tshe thar yang rdzi bo la shin tu brtse zhing dung / yin na'ang ru gong ma'i 'os blangs dmag dang kho tsho'i bar du rtswa sa rtsod res byung bas da gzod tshe thar gson gsur la 'phud dgos byung mod kyang / rtsom pa pos rdzi bo'i mi chos dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod der dgag pa til 'bru tsam yang brgyab med par ma zad/ rdzi bo la tshe thar gyi ched du mig chu thigs pa gcig bzhur ba'ang bris mi 'dug yin na'ang / rtsom pa pos nyam chung nus med kyi tshe thar gyis sems gtam brjod pa'i tshul gyis rdzi bo'i mi chos dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod der dgag pa gting zab mo brgyab yod par ma — 35 —

zad/ go rim ldan zhing dngos yod 'tsho ba'i don snying ldan pa'i byung rim gyi bkod sgrig la brten nas rdzi bo dang rdzi bo bran du bzung ba'i a skyes kyi ngan mtshang brtol nas dgag pa brgyab yod/ gtam rgyud 'dis mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba thag gcod byed tshul zhig bstan pa red ces bshad chog mod/'on kyang / mi'i rigs kyis rang nyid 'phel rgyas su gtong ba'i ched du rgyun chad med par 'bad 'bungs byed pa dang / mi dang srog chags gzhan gyi khyad par yang bsam blo la brten nas rang nyid 'phel rgyas su gtong mi gtong gi steng nas 'jog pa dang / de yang 'phel rgyas ni spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i 'gal ba las byung bas nga tsho gdod ma'i spyi tshogs nas ya rabs tshul ldan gyi spyi tshogs su slebs pa'i go rim khrod ji 'dra'i 'gal zla'i phung po sgril ba'i lo rgyus shog lte mang po zhig bris yod pa red ang / yin na'ang / 'tsho ba'i khrod du byung ba'i 'gal ba la las 'phel rgyas la grogs byed pa dang / 'gal ba la las 'phel rgyas la gegs byed pas nga tsho'i rtsom rig gi 'os 'gan ni skyon spong dge sgrub dang / snyigs dor bcud len/ blo gcig sems gcig gis mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu de yin pas rtsom pa po'i bsam blo yang gtam rgyud khrod kyi phyogs de dag la thim yod pa dang / rdzi bo dang tshe thar bar gyi 'brel ba zhib 'bri byas pa brgyud de bod mi'i nang khul gyi 'brel ba dang brtse dung mtshon par byas shing / ru gong zhol bar gyi don rkyen zhib 'bri byas pa brgyud de mi rigs nang khul gyi 'phel rgyas mi phan pa'i 'gal ba mtshon par byas/〈〈tshul khrims rgya mtsho 〉pokyeni rang sgra'i brtsams sgrung phyogs bsgrigs kyi tshab mtshon rang bzhin ldan pa'i brtsams sgrung zhig yin par snyam/ de ni rtsom pa pos deng rabs bod kyi rtsom pa po don grub rgyal gyi rtsom 'phror lus pa'i brtsams sgrung 〈〈tshul khrims rgya mtsho 〉〉zhes par kha skong byas pa yin pas de la don grub rgyal gyi rtsom rig gi bsam blo 'dres yod pa smos mi dgos mod/ 'on — 36 ge

kyang / bsam blo de gnyis chu dang 'o ma bzhin cha yongs nas 'dres pa zhig gtan nas min/ 'dir kha skong byed skabs rtsom pa pos gtam rgyud 'di'i khrod du gsar bzhengs byas pa'i mi sna gtso bo tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i steng gi las rgyu 'bras dang / 'tsho ba dngos kyi las rgyu 'bras gnyis kyi 'gal ba zhib 'bri byas pa la brten nas 'tsho ba gsar pa zhig la re 'bod byas yod pa dang / 'tsho ba dngos las byung ba'i 'gal rkyen sna tshogs dang mi rigs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs kyis dus rabs gsar pa'i mi dmangs dge rgan khong gi 'tsho ba dang mdun lam la phog thug chen po btang ba'i brgyud rim zhib 'bri byas yod/ rtsom pa pos phyogs mang po dang sne du ma nas gsar bzhengs byas pa'i mi sna 'di bod kyi dpe mtshon mi sna zhig tu sgrub bzhengs byas 'dug ste/de yang nang rang mos kyi brtse dung skyong mkhan dang phyi rgyu 'bras kyi bya ba sgrub pa'i a khu tshul khrims rgya mtsho ni nga brgyad lo'i mi sems zang zing du bsgyur ba'i lung bstan rdzun ma'i g.yo 'og tu tshud ma thub la/ yin min go ldog gi 6 rig gsar mi gyis kho'i lta ba yang bsgyur ma nus/ yin na'ang / khong gi lus steng gi tang dang mi dmangs la blo dkar ba'i bsam pa dang / las rgyu 'bras kyi lta ba ni chab srid la ji 'dra'i 'gyur ldog byung zhing dus rabs la ji 'dra'i dar rgyad byung na yang 'gyur ba med par ma zad/ da dung khong gi rdo rje dang 'dra ba'i gshes rgyud 'gyur med dang / kha btags dang 'dra ba'i ngang rgyuda'ajam po/ rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba'i yon tan mdzod kyis phyug pa'i mi bla med cig gsar bzhengs mdzad pa de don du dus skabs gnyis sam rig gnas gsar rnying gnyis kyi sbrel mtshams na yod pa'i bod kyi dpe mtshon mi sna zhig gsar bzhengs byas pa red/rtsom pa pos tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i gtam rgyud zhib 'bri byas pa brgyud nas a khu tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i lus steng gi las rgyu 'bras dang 'tsho ba dngos — 37 —

kyi las rgyu 'bras kyi 'gal ba dmar rjen du bstan cing / 'gal ba de'i khrod du gnas pa'i tshul khrims rgya mtshor dus rabs kyi 'gros dang bstun nas yid sems la 'pho 'gyur byung na'ang / khong gi las dbang de gro btab na gro dang /nas btab na nas ltar da lta'i skyid sdug sngon gyi las la ltos/ phyi mar bar 'gro rang gi sems la ltos zer ba'i dpe tsam min zhing / bsam pa ji ltar bzang na las rgyu 'bras dang mi 'tshams pa'i sbyor ba de ltar kho'i lus steng du gcig 'phro gcig la byung ba bstan pa las/ rtsom pa pos dus rabs kyi dar rgyad mtshams su 'greng ba'i bod pa rnams la/ rang gi rin chen gser las lhag pa'i lag pa gnyis la re ba las las rgyu 'bras la re ba'i dus min pa dang / rang gi lag zung la brten te 'jig rten gyi khams sgyur bkod dang /dka' spyad 'bad brtson/ rang kha rang gso/ rang stobs rang spel byed pa las dpe cha'i steng kho nar yod pa'i las rgyu 'bras la skyabs 'jug zhus na nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di 'phel rgyas la 'gro mi thub pas/ dus rabs gsar rnying gnyis kyi thel mtshams na lus pa'i bod pa dag gis rang re'i mi risas 'di myur du rmongs gnyid las bslangs te/ shes rig ldan pa dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ tshan rig bcas phyogs yongs nas sngon thon mi rigs kyi gras su snyeg par re 'bod byas yod/de bzhin du rtsom pa pos gtam rgyud kyi byung rim zhib 'bri byas pa brgyud nas bsam pa dkar zhing las rgyu 'bras brtsi ba'i a khu tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i 'tsho ba dang / mdun lam/ sems khams bcas la las rgyu 'bras kyis phog thug chen po btang ba dang / nga brgyad lo'i dus zing / 6 rig gnas gsar brje mi yi rlung 'tshub bcas dus gzer mang po zhig la kho'i sha khrag gdos bcas kyi phung po brgyud na'ang / bod mi'i mi chos kyi rtsa ba las rgyu 'bras blo nas ma dor zhing lag pas ma bskyur ba 'di gtam rgyud 'di'i grub 'bras — 38 —

chen po zhig yin par ma zad/ rtsom pa pos gna' bo'i bod kyi rig gnas de deng rabs spyi tshogs su gnas thub min gyi nyams sad las byung ba'i bsam blo'ang yin/ gtam rgyud mjug bsdu tshul la bltas na rtsom pa po'i bsam blo'i mig rgyang yang mthong thub ste/ tang dang mi dmangs la blo dkar ba'i bod kyi mkhas pa 'dis bden pa'i ched du ci la'ang mi skrag cing / khong gis 6 gsar brje dpa' mo'i nyalas rgyu 'bras dang 'gal ba'i bya spod de zhi ba chos bshad kyi sgo nas 'gog ched yin min go ldog pa'i 46dmar srung dmag mi gi g.yo 'og tu tshud pa dang / 6 gsar brje dpa' mo mi ni rang gis dus yun ring mor btsal dang 'tshol bzhin pa'i gangs dkar 'tsho yin pa rtogs rjes myur du gtam rgyud kyi mjug bsdus te a khu tshul khrims rgya mtsho rtsom pa po'i ngag tshab pa byas te klog mkhan rnams la lo rgyus kyi 'dri tshig de 'phangs pa red/ yin na'ang / a khu tshul khrims rgya mtsho dang gsar brje'i dpa' mo ste gangs dkar 'tsho gnyis kyi brtse dung gi lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo 'di 'gog thub bam/ lus kyi sha khrag yongs su gna' rabs rig gnas kyis khyab pa'i tshul khrims rgya mtsho ni sna rig gnas gsar brje chen po mi yi gar stegs steng 'grengs thub bam/'di ni rtsom pa pos klog mkhan rnams la dus rabs gsar par bod kyi 'tsho ba'i rig gnas gnas thub min la 'phangs pa'i 'dri tshig cig yin la/ rig sanas gsar rnying gnyis kyi dza drag sga 'gal ba mtshon pa'i rtsom pa po'i bsam blo dang lta ba yang yin zhes bshad chog go /brtsams sgrung phal mo che ste lhag par sgrung 'bring dang sgrung ring ni gnas skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dang rtsom pa po'i bsam blo mtshon pa'i me long lta bu zhig yin zhing / des lo rgyus kyi dus skabs nges can zhig gi dpal 'byor dang chab srid/ rig gnas/ spyi tshogs kyi yul srol goms 'dris/ chos lugs kyi cho ga lha bsang klu mchod sogs mtshon par byed pa dang / rtsom pa po — 39 —

zhig la mtshon na rang gi brtsams chos kyi brjod byar gyur pa'i spyi tshogs de la cha rgyus zhib mo zhig yod dgos pas/ bod kyi rtsom pa po zhig yin tshe/ deng rabs kyi cha lugs goms srol/ 'gro 'dug nyal 'chag bza' btung yo byad sogs dngos po'i 'tsho bar rgyus lon yod dgos pa ma zad/ rin thang lta ba dang mdzes dpyod sems khams/ bsam blo phugs bsam sogs bsam pa'i 'tsho bar yang myong tshor rnal ma zhig dgos rgyu red ma gtogs/ kha bde lce bde tsam dang gtam rgyud sgrig shes pa tsam gyis brtsams sgrung mi yong ba kho thag red/ rtsom mkhan rang sgra lags ni bod spyi tshogs kyi ches nye sar bcar nas brjod bya bdams pas kho'i brtsams sgrung de rgya che'i klog pa por mtshon na mar rtsam gyi dri zhim 'thul bas/ ha cang snying nye zhing ji ma bden snyam pa'i blo 'gog med du sbyin par byed/ kho'i brtsams sgrung gi khyad chos dang po yang bod kyi spyi tshogs la rgyus che ba'i steng na yod snyam zhing / kho ni 'char snang ban bun dang rnam rtog za zi tsam la brten nas rang mos kyis gtam rgyud sgrig mkhan gyi gras su mi gtogs te/ tha na kho'i brtsams sgrung 〈〈'dre rkang to 〉〉dang 〈〈'pho 'gyur〉〉/ 〈〈tshul khrims rgya mtsho 〉〉sogs su zhib 'bri byas pa'i khor lug dang sde ba/ sde mi'i 'gro 'dug nyal 'chag dga' kha 'khyer so thams cad dngos yod 'tsho ba'i snang tshul dang gcig du 'dres pas brtsams sgrung la gson shugasab ཿkā ༵ kā/ rnyi/ mi sna dang khor yug sogs rtsom pa po'i mos ngo tsam ma yin par dmigs yul yod pa'i sgo nas gdam ka dang zhib bzhengs byas pa yin pas de dag la dpe mtshon gyi nus pa ldan pa smos ci dgos/ gzhung lugs dang lag len gyi myong ba ltar na/ khor yug dang mi sna la tshab mtshon gyi nus pa ji ltar rgya che zhing gting zab na brtsams chos kyi rin thang yang de ltar che ba gdon mi za/ rang sgra'i khyad chos gnyis pa ni mtshon don rgya che ba de red/ kho ni — 40 —

rang 'dod ltar khor yug 'bri ba dang gang mos ltar mi sna bzhengs pa'i brtsams sgrung mdzad po dag gi gras su med/ kho'i brtsams sgrung khrod kyi khor yug dang sde ming / sa cha/ tha na dar lcog tsam la yang mtshon don gting zab yod la/ mi sna'i ming dang / kha brda/ tha na lag pa'i phyag rgya tsam la yang mi rigs spyi dang yang na rig gnas snang tshul mtshon pa'i zil shugs ldan/mdor na rang sgra'i brtsams sgrung las 'tsho ba bden par brjod pas shes rtogs kyi rang bzhin dang slob gso'i rang bzhin sogs thon 'dugadapyad gzhi'i yig cha/()glang mdun dpal 'byor gyi 〈〈me tog ldum ra'i nang gi klan ka 〉〉ces pa 1980lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb gsum par gsal/67don grub rgyal dang tshe ring don grub kyi 〈〈rgyu 'bras med pa'i mna' ma 〉〉zhes pa 1983lo'i 〈〈rdzang char 〉〉deb gnyis par gsal/po ()lha rgyal tshe ring gi 〈〈phugs bsam 〉〉zhes pa 1994lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb dang ra ga/byeX4/sa mo don grub kyi 〈〈gangs dkar lha mo'i 'phreng sems 〉〉zhes pa 1996lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb dang por gsal/po ()rig 'dzin gyi 〈〈dpe tshab sprod pa 〉〉zhes pa1983lo'i 〈〈rdzang char 〉〉deb dang ༵ ga//trī/ tshes gsum nyi'i 〈〈thugs 'phrad 〉〉ces pa 1986lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb ba pa// pa~X/ mchog sga 〈〈sdug 'bras 〉〉zhes pa 1982lo'i 〈〈sgrang char 〉〉deb bzhi par ga///rdo/na grub rgyal gyi 〈〈sprul sku 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1981lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb gsum par bsal/9trepir thosas kyi 〈〈grub thob pa 〉〉zhes pa 1986lo'i 〈2sbrang char 〉〉deb gnyis — 41 —

par ga~X/ ring don grub kyi 〈〈lha ba 'dre ston 〉〉zhes pa1997lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈tshe ring don grub kyi brtsams sgrung phyogs bsgrigs 〉〉kyi shog ngos 20par gsal/(1rnam sras kyi 〈〈bdas bi khu bo 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang bis2006lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈kyas kyog tu 'bab pa'i lung chu 〉〉zhes pa'i shog ngos241war45bar gsal/〈yi(3(spre(snye(spre (1(mitshosatsho'itsho〉6)mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2000lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈don grub rgyal gyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs 〉〉su gsal/(yi2006lor si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang bis dpe skrun byas pa'i bde skyid 'tsho'i 〈〈sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu 〉〉zhes pa'i shog ngos60par gsal/tuste2006lor kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i chos skyong gi 〈〈rang grol zhib 'jus 〉〉zhes pa'i shog ngos196par gsal/yonayona.a paṇa gyi 〈〈 ra lo mi zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung la dpyad myong rob tsam byed pa 〉〉2007lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉tu gsal/tsho'itsho〉rkyugyetshoyi0stetshoyi0〉tsho)1999lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i a smyon bkra shis don grub kyi 〈〈ston gyi rang sgra 〉〉ru gsal/tshonatshoyi2005lor mi risas dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i rnam sras kyi 〈〈dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi brtsams sgrung la dpyad pa blo sasar dgyes pa'i dga' ston 〉〉zhes pa'i shog ngos73par gsal/tsho'itsho〉'gro(1(11999lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang bis dpe skrun byas pa'i tshe rgyal gyi 〈〈sangs 'dabs kyi gtam rgyud 〉〉du bsal/

sa bcad gsum pa/ brtsams sgrung ring gras kyi skor/dang po/ byu bshad/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs lnga bcu nas brgyad cu'i bar gyi lo ngo sum cu tsam gyi ring la bod rigs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal ni ha lam stong char lus pa'i tshul du snang zhing / brtsams sgrung ring po'i gsar rtsom ni de bas kyang yid skyo ba zhig ste lo ngo sum cu'i ring 'bru rdog gcig kyang bsdu rgyu ma yong ba'i lo nyes byung ba red/ des na nga tshos 'dir gleng bar bya ba'i dus rabs nyi shu pa'i smad kyi bod kyi brtsams sgrung ring po zhes pa de ni 6 rig gnas gsar brje mi mjug sgril rjes bod rigs kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal de lo rgyus kyi dus skabs gsar pa zhig tu slebs pa dang / dus skabs 'di'i nang mi rigs rang gi skad dang yig thog nas spel pa'i sgrung ring thog ma 〈〈skal bzang me tog 〉pokyeces pa 1982lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas te bkram pa nas bzung da bar du bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon/ kun su'u sogs su brtsams sgrung ring po khyon bsdoms pas rnam grangs bcur son pa tsam dpe skrun 'grem 'tshong byas pa red/ dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi sgrung ring la lo ngo nyi shu tsam gyi lo rgyus las med na'ang de ni lo rgyus steng gi dus skabs gang zhig gi lo nyi shu gang rung bas kyang bsdur thabs med pa zhig ste cha snyoms byas na phal cher lo gnyis re'i nang sgrung ring gcig brtsams grub byung nas par skrun byas pa red/ bod kyi rtsom rig byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus steng ( sgrung ring gi cha nas ) 'di lta bu'i grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs pa'i dus skabs shig gtan nas byung ma myong zhes nga tshos mgrin pa gzengs su btegs nas smra spobs pa yin/ de ltar dus skabs de'i ring gi sgrung ring gi grub 'bras gtso — 43 —
