byas te legs po'i phyogs dang zhan pa'i cha sogs la khyon yongs nas gdeng 'jog dang dpyad brjod cig byed rgyu ni kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi gnas su mchis la/ nye lam dus rabs gsar pa'i bod rigs kyi sgrung ring dang de'i 'phel phyogs kyi gnad don thad la yang rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 'thab phyogs dang de min klog pa po sogs gang thad nas lta tshul mi 'dra ba re yod pa ni smos ci dgos/ des na lo ngo sum cur nye ba'i nang thon pa'i bod kyi sgrung ring gi spyi'i khyad chos dang nang don sogs brjod pa la/mi rigs shig gi rtsom rig gi grub 'bras dang rtsom rig 'phel rgyas kyi mtho dma' mtshon byed ni gtso bo sgrung ring yin pa dang / mi rigs de'i rtsom rig 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i re ba'ang sgrung ring steng bcol yod/ nga tshos bod kyi brtsams sgrung ste gtso bo sgrung ring byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus la phyi mig bltas na/6 rig gsar mi mjug rdzogs pa nas da bar du mtsho sngon dang bod ljongs/kun su'u/ si khron sogs su rtsom mkhan glang mdun dpal 'byor dang bkra shis dpal ldan/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar/ bstan pa yar rgyas/ stag 'bum rgyal/tshe ring don grub/ nag po skal bzang / bkra bha bcas kyis mtshon pa'i bod kyi sgrung ring rtsom pa po'i dpung khag gi thog ma'i rmang gzhi chags yod pa red/ de ni bod kyi brtsams sgrung 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i ches che ba'i skul shugs yin/yin na'ang deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi 'go tshugs pa cung dal bar brten/ sngon thon mi rigs gzhan dang bsdur na sgyu rtsal gyi thad dang brtsams chos kyi grangs ga'i thad sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad he bag nges can zhig yod la/ de las kyang brtsams sgrung hril po'i cha nas bshad na sgrung ring sdusar /ma ni ha cang shugs zhan pa'i gnas su lhung yod pa tshang mas khas na kānas na/ 'ang nang don gyi thad nas dus rabs nyi shu pa'i smad du brtsams — 44 —

grub byung ba'i bod kyi sgrung ring gi bsam blo'i phyogs lhung hur por song ba ni bcings grol thob pa nas byung myong med pa dang / dus yun ring po'i nang rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed ring du grub pa'i yang mi dag pa'i ngos 'dzin dang bkag rgya rnams gtor te rtsom pa por brjod bya'i gdam gses dang / nang don dang rnam pa/ phugs bsam sogs la rang mos kyis rtsom 'bri byas chog pa'i gnas bab bzang po zhig thon zhing / brjod bya'i thad nas kyang dus rabs kyi snying stobs dang / gna' deng gi 'tsho ba'i rnam pa/ mang tshogs kyi snying gtam/ drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs kyi gnad don sogs mtshon gang thub byas yod de/ rtsom pa po rgan gras kyis gtso bo spyi tshogs rnying pa'i bod kyi gnas tshul dang bcings grol byas pa'i snga gzhug gi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon pa cung mang / sku zhabs glang mdun dpal 'byor gyis brtsams pa'i sgrung ring 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉zhes pas bod rnying pa'i dus kyi grong khyer lha sa brjod byar bsten nas/ mtho bka' blon nas dman sprang po'i bar gyi rim gras khag gi mi sna'i bar gyi sne mang rnyog 'dzing gi 'brel ba dang / kho tsho'i bsam pa'i gting gi 'char sgo/ de bzhin spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dang dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul la gzhigs pa'i 'tsho ba'i skyid sdug dag bkod yod/ bod yig tu bsgyur pa'i sgrung ring 〈〈skal bzang me tog 〉〉gis 1950lo'i zla 10nas 1951lo'i zla 10bar gyi lo 'khor gcig gi dus tshod nges can dang 'bri chu'i rang grub 'gag btsan nas lha sa'i gna' mkhar bar gyi sa cha dmigs bsal can skor zhig bdams pa dang / bcings grol dmag tsho chung ru khag gi rgya bod mi rigs kyi bkod 'doms pa dang 'thab mo bas dka' sdug dang dmag 'khrug gi thabs jus bzang po zhig brgyud rjes/ 'dzam gling la g.yo 'gul gtong nus pa'i lo rgyus kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i bya ba gal chen te lha sar dpung bskyod byas pa'i skor ha cang gnad 'khel gyis bris te klog pa — 45 —

por cung rags bsdus kyis ngo sprod byas/rtsom pa po dar gzhon rnams kyi sgrung ring gis 6 rig gsar migyis bod kyi spyi tshogs la bzos pa'i chag sgo dang / bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed nang byung ba'i mtho sgang gi mi gsar don gsar bris nas phyogs yongs dang cung cha tshang ba'i sgo nas bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa yongs rdzogs mngon mtshon byas yod de/ rtsom pa po bkra shis dpal ldan gyis brtsams pa'i 〈〈phal ba'i khyim tshang gi skyid sdug 〉〉ces pa des gtso bo dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byas pa nas 'go brtsams te gtsang khul gyi zhing pa'i bu mo tshe brtan lha mo'i khyim tshang gi gnas tshul de lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi go rim nang du bzhag nas/ zhing pa'i khyim tshang phal ba zhig gi 'tsho ba'i skyid sdug mtshon pa dang / rtog zing gis khengs pa'i 'gal ba bris pa brgyud lo ngo sum cu'i ring gtan 'jags min pa'i chab srid dang / nyams zhing rgyad pa'i dpal 'byor/ tshul min ngan rengs kyi spyod pa/re gtad la cha 'jog med pa'i spyi tshogs snang tshul rnams ji bzhin bskyar du mngon yod/ mi'i bsam blo'i 'du shes sogs kyi 'gyur ldog dang lhag par tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs rjes zhing las sa khul du thog ma'i 'pho 'gyur chen po byung ba bris nas drang bden des ngan rengs las rgyal thub cing / 'od snang des mun nag las rgyal thub pa'i lo rgyus kyi ldog med chos nyid gsal por bstan pa ni dngos yod la mthong chen dang 'tsho ba'i 'gro stangs khas len byed pa'i dngos yod ring lugs kyi bsam blo ni brtsams chos kyi mgo rnga bar gsum du mthong thub/ zhing sde'i bsgyur bcos khrod goms 'dris rnying pa bgegs rkyen du langs na'ang tshe brtan lha mo sogs kyis 'tsho bar re ba ches cher bcangs pa'i dbang gis dka' khag dang rang steng gi zhan cha mthong thub pa nas/ zhing sde'i bsgyur bcos la dga' snang 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis gsar byung bya dngos — 46 ge

de bgegs rkyen las rnam par rgyal zhing gzi 'od ldan pa'i mdun ljongs mngon pa la re bas khengs pa mtshon yod/de bzhin du sgrung ring 〈〈snying 'jags kyi rtswa thang 〉〉gis lo rabs bdun cu pa gtam rgyud kyi rgyab ljongs su bdams te/ lo bcu'i zing chas 'brog khul gyi rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i las dbang dang bsam blo'i snang tshul/sems khong gi 'jig rten la bzhag pa'i gting zab pa'i rma kha sogs ci nus kyis mtshon thabs byas yod/ gtam rgyud kyi byung rim 'phel rgyas su song ba dang bstun nas rtsom pa pos 6 krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa mi yi rjes kyi 'brog khul gyi rnam pa de brjod bya gtso bor bzung ba dang /'brog khul gyi phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam pa zhib brjod byas te/ 'brog khul gyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ de dang mnyam du byung ba'i rtog 'dzing che ba'i spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba sna tshogs mtshon yod/ brtsams sgrung khrod kyi dbang ldan rdo rje'i skyid la sdug pa'i las dbang des thog mtha' bar gsum du klog pa po'i yid sems bkug cing / rnyog rdzob che ba'i 'gal ba des gtam rgyud kyi brjod bya gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas bstan/bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig brtsams chos las sgrung ring gi brjod snying la sngog 'don dang gsar 'byed ched po byas yod de/ rtsom pa po rnams kyi rtsom 'bri'i smyug rtse de nam yang gung khran tang gi 'bo khrid 'og bod rigs mi dmangs 'tsho ba gsar pa'i bdag por gyur pa'i tshul la bstod bsngags dang /mi rigs mthun sgril dang mnyam 'brel la bstod bsngags/ spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi mi gsar don sasar bcas la bstod bsngags byed pa'i phyogs su gtad pa dang / tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dngos de ni bri bya'i nang don gtso bo byas nas srol rgyun gyi rtsom rig ltar dpe gzhi'i snang brnyan rgyal po dang btsun mo/ yang na lha dang lha mor byed pa'i rtsom tshul rtsa ba nas bsgyur — 47 —

ba red/ de las ldog ste mes rgyal 'dzugs skrun dang srung skyob byed pa'i bya bzhag khrod kyi sngon thon mi sna dag brtsams sgrung ring po'i nang gi mi sna gtsor bor bzung nas 'bri bzhengs byas pas brtsams chos kyi dngos yod don snying ches cher ldan par byas/ mdor na/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la dus rabs kyi khyad chos shugs drag pa dang rin thang gi tshad gzhi gsar pa ldan pa ni/dus skabs gsar pa'i brtsams chos kyis thog mtha' bar gsum du mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba dang spyi tshogs ring lugs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i dar cha mthor bsgrengs byed bzhin pa'i mtshon rtags de yin/ rtsom rig ni sgyu rtsal gyi snang brnyan la brten nas don dngos mtshon par byed pa dang / deng rabs can bzhi 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i dus rabs kyi re ba dang /spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i 'phel phyogs gtso bo rnams sgyu rtsal gyis mtshon par bya dgos pa ltar/ bod kyi sgrung ring 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉dang 〈〈snying 'jags kyi rtswa thang 〉〉/ 〈〈rkyal ba'i 'jig rten du myul ba'i gtam rgyud 〉〉sogs las gzhas dang gtam rgyud/ ka bshad/ bsang mchod sogs bkol cing / rtsom gyi nyams 'gyur thad deng rabs kyi khyad chos dang rgyun srol rig gnas kyi 'du shes zung 'brel gang legs byas yod pa red/gnyis pa/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang kho'i srung ring 〈〈skal bzang me tog〉〉1 gsar rtsom brgyud lam ngo sprod pa/bod rigs rtsom pa po 'jam dpal rgya mtsho ni 1943lor si khron zhing chen dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul 'ba' thang rdzong du 'khrungs/'ba' thang ni bod du ming grags che ba'i sa khul zhig yin/ der nam zla'i cha nas che 'bri chu'i lho rgyud misnyan grags ldan la/ sgyu rtsal gyi thad du'ang sna sgor — 48 —

bro'i pha yul mi zhes su bsngags brjod byed kyin yod pa ma zad/ shes rig gi phyogs nas kyang rgya bod kyi 'brel 'dris ha cang che ba'i sa khul zhig yin pas/cha rkyen kun 'dzoms kyi khor yug de las 'jam dpal rgya mtshos byis dus kyi 'tsho ba bskyal/ de bas khong la bod rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi gso skyong /ba ༵ dang / rgya bod skad gnyis la'ang sbyong brdar phun sum tshogs pa zhig ba 'atā/ma dpal rgya mtshos lo bcu gnyis kyi steng slob chung gi bslab bya mjug rdzogs rjes/ 1950lo'i zla 10par/ dbus gtsang du dpung skyod byed pa'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag tu zhugs/ dpung bskyod byed zhor dang lam las zhor/ sbyong brdar byed zhor dang / mang tshogs kyi bya ba sgrub zhor byas te lo ngo gcig lhag 'gor rjes lha sar 'byor/ lam bar du zhing sde dang 'brog sde/ dgon pa/ gangs ri mthon po/ rtswa thang 'jam po/ grang ngar che sa sogs la dngos su brgyud de zhing pa mang tshogs dang 'brog pa mang tshogs/ dge 'dun pa skor zhig dang kha brda byas par/ kho tshos sdug bsngal la dmod pa dang bde skyid 'tsho bar re snyeg chen po byed pa des kho'i sems la nam yang brjed dka' ba'i bag chags zab mo zhig bzhag lhag par dbus gtsang du chab srid dang dmag don/ dpal 'byor/ bsam blo sogs la phyogs gang thad nas ha las shing hang sangs pa'i 'thab rtsod rab dang rim par byung ba mig mthong lag zin du gyur pa las kho'i rtsom rig gsar rtsom la 'tsho ba'i rmang gzhi rgya chen po zhig bting /1952lo'i lo stod nas 1953lo'i lo mjug gi bar du/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho bod rang skyong ljongs dmag khul gyi las byed pa'i slob grwar zhugs te slob sbyong byas/ skabs der stes dbang gis kho'i lag tu 〈〈dpa' bo dpa' mo gsar pa'i gtam rgyud 〉〉ces pa'i rgya yig gi dpe cha zhig yong ste yang yang du — 49 —

bklags pas/ gtam rgyud nang gi mi sna gtso bo'i bya spyod las sems 'gul chen po thebs/ de dang mnyam du dbus gtsang du dpung bskyod byed pa'i lam bar du mi dmangs bcings grol dmag gi rgya bod mi rigs kyi bkod 'thab pa dang rgya che ba'i bod rigs mang tshogs khrod kyi mi dngos don dngos 'ga' dran pas/ kho'i yid sems nam yang bde la 'bab dka' bar gyur/1954lo'i lo 'gor/ kho lha sa nas khreng tu'u lho nub mi rigs slob gling du song ste slob sbyong byas/ de ru bod rigs kyi rtsom rig dang rgya rigs kyi rtsom rig krung go'i rtsom rig phyi rgyal gyi rtsom rig sogs brtsams chos ming grags can 'bor chen zhig bklags/ brtsams sgrung gsar pa gang bklags na'ang /kho'i mig lam la 'jig rten gsar pa zhig gsal por mngon pa lta bu'i snang tshul byung bas/ khos kyang brtsams sgrung re bris te rang nyid kyi mthong thos dran gasdom ddhi che ba'i mi dmangs dang dus rabs 'di'i spun grogs tshor bshad 'a da1 9dī/0lor/ 'jam dpal rgya mtshos lo mang po'i ring gi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi rmi lam de dngos su lag len du mtha' 'khyol byed ched/ thog mar brtsams sgrung 'bri ba'i gra sgrig byas/ 1961lor khos rgya yig gi yig 'bru khri nyi shu lhag yod pa'i ma yig bris te blo mthun rgan pa skor zhig la phul te gzigs su bcug pas/ tshang mas khor lhag bsam rnam dag gis skul ma btang / de nas khong gis rang la yid ches skyes te mu mthud du gzab nan gyis bris pa ma zad/ yang yang dag bcos byas/ 1963lor/ phal cher sgrung ring gi ma yig cig legs 'grub byung ste krung go na gzhon dpe skrun khang du bskyal/ rtsom sgrig pas ha cang mthong chen byas te gom gang mdun spos sgos bzo bcos bya dgos pa'i re ba zhib phra bton/ 1979lor/ khos ma yig la bzo bcos byas te mi dmangs rtsom rig dpe skrun khang du bskyal/ de ltar lo ngo — 50 —

nyi shu'i ring du dka' spyad 'bad brtson byas mthar 1980lor kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈skal bzang me tog 〉〉(rgya yig ) deb dngos su dpe skrun byas/ de ni 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i ming grags che ba'i rtsom zhig yin pa ma zad/ bod mi rigs kyi deng rabs rtsom stegs steng bod rigs kyi rtsom pa pos bris pa'i sgru nga ring ches thog ma'ang yin/ de dang mnyam du/ 'jam dpal rgya mtshos rang nyid kyi bod yig sga gnas bab yag po spel ched mu mthud du hur brtson byas te/ bod yig gi lam nas snying bsdus dang gson nyams ldan par bzo bcos byas te/ 1982lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas/ khong gis yig rigs gnyis kyi lam nas gsar rtsom gyi 'bras bu g.yur za ba zhig blangs pa sa/ spyi tshogs steng nas mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig gis bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor/1980lor/ 'jam dpal rgya mtshos krung go'i spyi tshogs tshan rig gling grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig zhib 'jug khang gi zhib 'jug pa gzhon par rgyugs sprad pa brgyud nas bsdu len byas pas/ khos phyogs gcig nas bod kyi rtsom rig zhib 'jug dang phyogs gcig nas mu mthud du rtsom rig gsar rtsom byas/ lo ngo bcu'i ring la/ khos sgrung ring chen mo 〈〈ge sar sgrung 〉〉la zhib 'jug byas te 〈〈ge sar gyi thog ma'i dpyad pa 〉〉zhes pa'i dpe deb cig dpe skrun byas pa ma zad/ dpyad rtsom bzhi bcu lhag kyang 'grem spel byas/ dus mtshungs su zhib 'jug pa wu'u be dang mnyam 'brel gyis 〈〈tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa 〉〉zhes pa'i sgrung ring gsar rtsom mdzad pa dang/ 〈〈ge sar sgrung kha tshang 〉〉zhes pa'i dpe cha gsum brtsams pas/ tshan rig zhib 'jug dang gsar rtsom phyogs gnyis la 'bras bu g.yur za ba blangs/ deng skabs khong ni zhib 'jug pa dang / krung go'i rtsom pa po mthun tshogs kyi tshogs mi/krung go grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom pa po'i tshogs gtso gzhon pa/ rgyal yongs kyi — 51 —

〈〈ge sar 〉〉las don tsho chung gi tsu'u krang bcas yin/2 bde skyid kyi 'tsho bar re zhing snyeg pa'i spen pa/brtsams sgrung nang bi mi sna gtso bo'i snang brnyan gyis spyi tshogs nges can zhig gi rang bzhin mtshon pa ni brtsams sgrung gi khyad chos gtso bo yin/brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈〈skal bzang me tog 〉〉ces pa'i nang du rtsom pa pos khyon bsdoms mi sna lnga bcu lhag tsam gsar bzhengs byas yod mod/ 'on kyang rtsom pa pos mi sna thams cad kyi snang brnyan phra zhibakyis ma bris par brtsams sgrung nang gi mi sna gtso bo'i snang brnyan de dmigs su bkar te bkrag mdangs ldan pa zhig bris shing / mi sna gtso bo spen pa'i lus thog nas mi rigs kyi khyad chos gsal por mngon stabs mi rnams kyi yid la nam yang brjed dka' ba'i bag chags gting zab cig bzhagasgrung ring 〈〈skal bzang me tog 〉〉'go tshugs ma thag tu rtsom pa pos lo rgyus smra ba'i 'bri stangs spyad nas sngar dmyal ba'i yul lta bur 'tsho ba skyel bzhin pa'i rgya che'i bod rigs zhing bran rnams kyi ya nga ba'i sdug bsngal dang /zhing bran lam lugs kyi mun nag lo rgyus gnas tshul rgyas shing zhib par bris nas de'i mur sgrung nang gi mi sna gtso bo spen pa dang bud med lha sgron gyi skor rim bzhin mtshon par byas/ spen pa ni mi rabs nas mi rabs su bran g.yog byed mkhan zhing bran dbul po'i bu phrug cig yin zhing / kho la mnga' bdag chen po ye shes dang tshe dbang bsam grub sogs kyi mnar gcod tshad med phog pa ma zad/ dbang sgyur gral rim gyis kho glud 'gong du yang brdzangs pa red/ spen pas dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba de lta bu bskyel bas mthar thabs zad de 'chi dgos pa'i bsam tshul yang skyes/ yin na'ang skabs der spo bo zla bas rtag tu bshad pa'i gser gshog can gyi lha bya dang lha dmag de dag dran pa dang / pha bstan 'dzin gyis sprad pa'i glo gri/ bu mo lha sgron gyi brtse dung bcas — 52 —

kyis slar yang 'tsho 'dod kyi stobs shugs dang re ba rnyed pa dang / lhag par bo bcings 'grol dmag la zhugs rjes tang ji slob gso dang / ru gtso li gang bi bslab bya/ 'thab 'dzing pa rnams kyi rogs ram bcas kyi 'og rim bzhin gung khran ring lugs kyi go rtogs ldan pa'i 'thab 'dzing pa zhig tu gyur to/ /spen pa ni mnga' bdag chen po tshe dbang bsam grub kyi gri kha nas thar te spang rgyan gzhis gar slebs/ spen pas lo na chung dus nas dka' sdug che ba'i 'tsho ba rol zhing / lo gsum la slebs dus mnga' bdag ye shes kyis kho'i dpral bar khyi tham zhig brgyab/ mnga' bdag rnams kyis bran g.yog dbul phongs rnams la snying rje gtan nas med mod/ 'on kyang zhing bran dbul po phan tshun bar gyi brtse dung ni gting dpag bral ba'i rgya mtsho ji bzhin zab/spen pa spang rgyan gzhis kur slebs nas bran g.yog lha sgron zhes pa'i bu mo de dang 'phrad nas kho gnyis bar gyi dung sems je zab tu 'gro bzhin yod pa'i skabs der mnga' bdag ye shes dang skal rdor gyis bod skyod bcings 'grol dmag bod ( dbus gtsang ) la yong du mi 'jug rgyu'i bsam ngan bcangs shing / chos lugs bed spyad nas mang tshogs la mgo skor gtong phyir spen pa glud 'gong du brtsis te yul de nas mthar skyod btang mthar spen pas ni ya nga ba'i 'tsho ba rol dbos byung ba dang / lhag par mi yul 'dir 'tsho thabs bral ba'i dus su slebs pa ni skabs de'i rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs rnams kyi skyo sdug gi las dbang dngos bris byas pa zhig yin la/ spen pa'i gshis ku'i khyad chos dang bsam pa'i 'phel rim gyi gzhi bting ba'ang yin no//rtsom pa pos mi sna'i gshis kur mi rigs kyi snying stobs ldan du bcug par ma zad/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos kyang mtshon par byas yod/ si ta lin gyis gsungs don 4 mi rigs kyi khyad chos yod pa'i mi rigs gshis ka ni dus skabs la ma ltos par gral rim thams cad dang 'brel ba med pa min zhing / de'i rang — 53 —

bzhin thog tu dus rabs nges can zhig gi gral rim gyi don dang ldan pa dang /mi rigs shig gi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen mtshon pa'i rtags mtshan ldan/mi ② zhes pa ltar rtsom pa pos sgrung rtsom du gsar bzhengs byas pa'i mi sna 'i snang brnyan gtso bo spen pa de dpa' ngar ldan pa'i dpa' po'i gzugs su ma bkod kyang /rgyas shing zhib pa'i thog nas sngar bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas bab dang / gral rim so so'i bar gyi 'brel ba/ lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul bcas dngos su mtshon nus pa'i mi sna'i snang brnyan zhig tu gsar bzhengs byas pas klog pa po rnams kyi mig lam du don snying ldan pa'i lo rgyus kyi dus rabs shig mngon par byas yod/spen pa ni chos lugs kyi shugs rkyen thebs pa'i zhing bran zhig yin pa dang / khos sprul sku bla ma rnams kyis 6 dpral ba'i steng bi gnyer ma gsub rgyu med/ las la 'khel ba'i don de zlog thabs med mices zer ba de dag la yid ches byed kyin yod la le'u gsum pa'i nang spen pa'i bsam par 6 mi drag tshos nga ni nyes can gyi phru gu dang klud 'gong du rdzong 'os pa'i mi zhig red ces zer ba ma zad dngos su bsdangs byung / nga shi ba'i rjes su dmyal ba'i gting du 'gro rgyu las gzhan med ces zer mod/ 'on kyang skad cha de tsho bden pa yin nam/ mi ngan tshe dbang bsam grub dang / skal rdor/ ye shes sogs kyis mi la gshe gshe dang gnod 'tshe kho na gtong ba ma zad/ tha na nyes med la nyes 'dogs byas nas dmar gsod btang ba sogs bya ngan ci rigs sgrub yod rung / kho tsho shi ba'i rjes su bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skye thub zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ gal te mi gsod kyi gshed ma rnams bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skye thub pa yin na sdug myong mkhan dbul po rnams shi rjes dmyal bar 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ dngos gnas nga tsho ni las ngan bsod zad kyi mi zhig yin nam miXsnyam nas sprul sku bla ma rnams kyis bshad tshul la dogs — 54 —

pa 'ang zos myong / lhag par mi ser rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las skyob pa'i gser gshog can gyi lha bya dang / pha bstan 'dzin gyis sprad pa'i glo gri/ dgra sha len pa'i re 'dun la sogs pa dran nas rmongs dad dang zhing bran lam lugs la dogs pa skyes te 'tsho ba gsar pa'i lam bu zhig 'tshol dgos pa'i bsam pa bcangs/ gzhan yang spen pas brjid nyams che zhing mdzes sdug ldan pa 'i yul ljongs de dag mthong tshe bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba yid la shar nas rul sungs mun nag bi zhing bran lam lugs la 'khon sems bcangs te nga tsho bod ljongs kyi gangs ri 'di 'dra'i brjid chags pa dang / nags tshal ni 'di 'dra'i mdzes sdug ldan pa/ sa gzhi ni 'di 'dra'i thon khungs phyug pa zhig yin mod kyang nga spen pa ni sdod sa'i sa dang 'dzul sa'i khung tsam yang med pa ci yin nam zhes rang gis rang la dri ba 'don bzhin du dgra sha len sems kyi khong khro'i me lce drag tu mched de dpon ngan dmyal bar ma bsdangs na/ dbul phongs lha yul du 'gro dka' zhes spobs pa chen po'i ngang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs la dgra zlar bzung zhing 'jig rten gyi gtam dper 6 gtam lan po med na lkugs pa red/ dgra lan po med na snar ma red/mices grags pa ltar ngas dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi las rang byed dgos snyam nas dgra sha len rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ de nas spen pa bcings 'grol dmag la zhugs mod/ 'on kyang zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs dang las dbang smra ba'i bag chags de spen pa'i bsam pa'i 'ching sgrog tu gyur nas bsam blo'i bkag rgyar tshud pa ste/ dper na spen pa dmag la zhugs rjes khos gyon 'os pa'i lham ma rnyed stabs yid la rang dman gyi 'du shes shar nas ye shes dang skal rdor gyis nga la 'phya smod kyis ra pho rog la skra dkar skye mi srid/las ngan pa khyod la bde skyid 'thob mi srid mi ces zer ba de dag nga'i rkang par bltos na bden pa 'dra zhes snyam/ yang khos dmag chas gyon dus 'thab — 55 —

'dzing pa zha'o sung gis srung 'khor 'grol rtsis byas par khos zha'o sung la ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ mdza' brtse'i dung sems lhag par zab pa'i lha sgron la yid nas dga' mod/ 'on kyang rang dman gyi 'du shes skyes nas lha sgron dang mnyam du 'tsho ba bskyal na lha sgron la bgegs dang bar chad yong nges snyam gyi yod/ de rjes dmag dpung bi ru gtso li gang dang 'thab 'dzing pa rnams kyi slob gso dang rogs ram/ rang sga yid mthun pa'i mdza' grogs lha sgron gyi sems gso/ dmag dpung gzhis kur slebs nas byung ba'i 'gyur ldog la sogs pas spen pa'i bsam blor rim bzhin 'gyur ldog byung ste bod rigs mi dmangs rnams yar langs bcings 'grol thob nas bde skyid dpal dang ldan pa'i 'tsho ba gsar par rol dgos na/ tang gi 'go khrid dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi rogs ram la brten dgos pa dang / rang nyid yar langs nas 'thab rtsod byed dgos pa las lha bla ma su zhig gis kyang rogs ram byed mi thub/ mi dmangs kyi 'thab 'dzing pa zhig gis srung 'khor la brten nas rang nyid srung skyob byed dgos don ni de bas kyang mi 'dug snyam nas rmi lam las sad pa bzhin du rgya mo rngul chu'i 'gram du spen pa ni las dbang smra ba'i 'ching rgya las thar nas gsar brje pa zhig tu 'gyur 'go tshugs pa de mtshon/ spen pa'i bsam blo'i 'gyur ldog la brgyud rim yod pa ste/khos thog mar rang nyid bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol rgyu'i bsam blo bcangs pa dang / rjes su kho'i bsam blo'i go rtogs je mthor gyur nas rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs kun gyi bde skyid la sems khur byed pa dang / bcings 'grol dmag dang mdza' brtse btsugs/ dper na le'u bco lnga pa'i nang spen pas rtsam pa za mkhan gyi nang nas mi yag po dang sdug po yod pa ji bzhin 'bras za mkhan gyi nang du'ang mi yag btsog sna tshogs yod pa red ces bshad pa de ni kho'i sems gting gi skad cha yin/ spen pa'i mes rgyal gcig gyur dang rgya — 56 —

bod mthun sgril gyi ched las don bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgrubs pa'i brgyud rim bris pa'i thog nas gung khran ring lugs kyi go rtogs ldan pa'i snang brnyan zhig klog pa po rnams kyi mig mdun du bstan to/ /〈〈skal bzang me tog 〉〉nang gi mi sna gtso bo spen pa'i bsam pa'i khyad chos dang gshis ka ni spen pa'i bya spyod dang bshad pa'i skad cha/ bsam pa'i dran tshul/ lus kyi nyams 'gyur la sogs pa gzhir bzung ste dmigs bsal gyis rgyas shing zhib mor bris nas mtshon yod/ sgrung rtsom de'i nang du bzhengs pa'imi sna gtso bo spen pa'i snang brnyan ni sngar bod kyi 'tsho ba'i gar stegs thos skye bo kun la sems 'gul thebs pa'i 'khrab gzhi zhig dang mtshungs par zhing bran nang gi dpe mtshon du 'os pa'i snang brnyan zhig yin pa dang / spen pa'i skyo sdug ni dus rabs de'i rgya che'i zhing bran gyi skyo sdug yin zhing / spen pa ni las dbang smra ba'i 'ching rgya las thar te gung khran ring lugs kyi phugs bsam ldan pa'i mi rabs gsar pa zhig tu gyur pa ni bod rigs mi dmangs rnams rmongs gnyid las sad pa'i mtshon rtags yin la/ spen pa ni brtan zhing 'gyur ba med pa'i 'thab 'dzing pa zhig tu gyur te bde skyid 'tsho ba'i bgrod lam thog tu bskyod pa ni rgya che'i bod rigs mi dmangs bde skyid 'tsho ba'i lam du bskyod pa'i mtshon rtags kyang yin/3 8〈skal bzang me tog 〉〉gi brjod bya'i bstan don/ sgrung ring 〈〈skal bzang me tog 〉〉ni dbus gtsang du dpung bskyod byas pa zhib 'bri byas pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos 'bur du thon pa zhig yin la/der dpe cha sna gnyis yod pa la/ rgya yig la yig 'bru khri bzhi bcu lhag dang bod yig la yig 'bru khri nyi shu lhag yod/ skabs dang po'i rgyal yongs grangs sdorsha / zlo/sa kyi sgrung ring gzengs bstod byed pa'i dpyad bsdur khrod bya — 57 —

brtsams sgrung bi kha byang la 〈〈skal bzang me tog 〉〉ces 'dogs don ni/skal bzang me tog ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi ches mdzes sdug ldan pa'i ming mdzod nang bi tha snyad cig yin/ thos ma thag ha cang snying nye zhing yid sems cig car du 'phrog par byed cing / rtsom pa pos gson nyams ldan zhing /bod mi rigs kyis yid smon byed pa'i skal bzang me tog ces pa kha byang du bdams nas/ bod rigs mi dmangs kyis mi rabs nas mi rabs bar re snyeg byed pa'i 'tsho ba'i phugs bsam mtshon pa red/brtsams sgrung 'dis dngos yod ring lugs kyi mtshon thabs spyad pa dang / gtam rgyud gcig la gcig 'brel te byams brtse dang ldan pa'i sgo nas tang gi mi rigs srid jus la lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi rgyal kha thob pa dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gi byas rjes rlabs chen dang yar langs zhing bran gyi mgyogs myur 'phel rgyas/ rgya bod mi rigs gnyis kyi bla med mdza' brtse/ stod nyi ma lha sa'i dpyid dpal sogs la bstod bsngags byas yod la/des brjid nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul pas dbus gtsang bcings 'grol la bkag 'gog byas pa'i lkog g.yo pham par btang ba dang / zhing bran gyi rkang lag la bskon pa'i lcags sgrog thog mar grol ba/ bod rigs nang khul du mthun sgril mi yong ba'i rnam pa thog mar rtsa med du btang ba/ skar lnga'i dar dmar nam mkha'i nyi ma bzhin nam yang 'dzam gling gi spyi gtsug na 'od 'tsher ba/ gangs ri dang rtswa thang steng du skal bzang me tog rnam par bzhad pa/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin mo thengs dang por zhing 'brog gi dngos yod 'tsho ba'i nang du slebs pa sogs 'dzam gling yongs kyi mi rnams kyi mig lam du gsal por bstar yod/brtsams sgrung gis bod ljongs bcings 'grol byas pa'i skabs de'i lo rgyus skor mi rnams la bskyar du bsam blo gtong du bcug pa dang / nam yang rgya — 58 —

bod mi rigs kyi dpa' rgod tshos sger sems med cing zhum pa bral ba'i snying stobs dang dpa' ngar chen pos mdun skyod byed pa'i gsar gtod kyi snying stobs la dran gso zhu rgyu'i thad don snying gal chen ldan pa red/2 〈〈skal bzang me tos 〉〉bi sgyu rtsal khyad chos /brtsams sgrung gis mtho sgang bi rnam pa dang bod rigs kyi khyad chos/ chos lugs kyi bsam pa'i brtse dung sogs bris yod la/ bris pa rnam par dag pa dang spro ba 'phel ba/ sason nyams ldan pas rtsom pa por 'tsho ba'i phyogs kyi rtsa ba'i shes byar cung byang cha yod pa mtshon yod pa dang / brtsams sgrung du da dung ngo mtshar ba'i lha sgrung ngag rgyun dang mi dmangs la spro snang ster thub pa'i gtam rgyud bris te/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang sgyu rtsal gyi yid 'phrog nus pa sngar bas je cher btang yod/ rjod byed tshig bi cha nas brtsams sgrung gis bod rigs spun zla'i rnar snyan zhing yid dbang 'gug pa'i dmangs glu dang gtam dpe mang po zhig bkol te brtsams chos gyi rnam pa ha cang gsar pa dang skad char nus pa yod pa'i thog nas mi rigs kyi goms srol ha cang 'bur du thon par byas yod pas/ de ni rtsom pa pos dmangs khrod rtsom rig dpyad gzhir bzung ba'i rtags mtshan zhig yin pa dang / mthong chen byed 'os pa'i rtsom 'bri'i nyams myong zhig kyang red/dmangs glu dang gtam dpe de dag ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyis bsregs bcad brdar gsum byas nas grub pas yig 'bru re re mtshar sdug yid du 'ong ba dang tshig tshom re re snyan zhing 'jebs la mtshon nus kyang ldan/rtsom pa pos gser dang 'dra ba'i skad cha skor zhig bdams te brtsams chos nang bris pa ni brtsams sgrung la phra rgyan btab pa bzhin snyan ngag gi nang don ldan la brjod don yang bla lhag tu bstan/ dper na/ spen pa smag nag cing 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas su sbas yod dus/ mun pa 'thibs pa'i nags — 59 —

klong stug po'i khrod nas lha sgron gyis mgrin pa gzengs su btegs te che bye'u chung nam mkhar 'phur rung / /sa rub na tshang la slebs yong / /lug g.yang dkar ri 'gor bkram rung / /sa rub na slas la slebs yong / /nga'i sems kyi mdza' bo gcig pu/ /phyir yong rgyu med pa ci yin/ /:zhes blangs pa'i glu skad snyan mos/ thang stong du grogs med kher rkyang du lus pa'i spen pa dngos su mdza' mo'i gam du slebs su bcug spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nyam thag pa'i sdug bsngal rjod pa'i skabs su/ 8 bu mo lha mo las kyang mdzes la/ lha mo'i rtsam khu mtsho mo las kyang dwangs/ mi zhes pa'i sdug glu de thos pas/ zhing bran dbul phongs la snying rje tshad med skyes pa dang / bkres ltogs bzod dka' ba'i dka' sdug bi gnas la gdung sems skyes/ yang gzhon nu rnams rtswa thang du 'dus nas snying gtam bshad dus rang nyid kyi sems steng gi skad cha dmangs glu'i nang drangs te phan tshun len res byas pas/ bu mo lha sgron gyis kyang rang gi dga' grogs kyi gon pa hral hrul yin pa mthong bas yi mug pa'i tshul gyis rang byung khams kyi mdzes ljongs la bltas te 6 nam mkha'i sprin pa dkar po/ /dkar 'jam lug bal yin na/ /nga yis cung tsam blangs te/ /khyed la rgyan gos bzos chog /mdzes pa'i sngo ljang rtswa thang / /gal te phrug rgyu yin na/ /nged kyis 'dom 'ga' dras nas/ /khyed la phyi ba bzos chog /'on te zhing bran bu mor/ /phrug rgyu lag mthil tsam med do/ /mi zhes blangs pas/ spen pas kyang myur du 4 sprin dkar lta bu'i bal 'jam med na'ang / /khyod kyi sems pa sprin dkar las kyang dkar/ /rtswa thang lta bu'i phrug rgyu med na'ang / /khyod sems bdag la me tog las kyang mdzes/ / zhes blangs/ glu tshig 'di bklags rjes klog pa pos bod rigs gzhon nu rnams kyi lhad med kyi brtse dung dang chu shel lta bu'i sems pa mthong thub/ ci— 60 —

gsum pa/ glang mdun dpal 'byor dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈gzug g.yu 〉〉gcigartsom pa po'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus/sku zhabs glang mdun dpal 'byor ni 1941lo'i zla 11par bod ljongs kyi grong khyer lha sa ru skyes shing / 1948lo'i lo stod la rgya gar du dbyin yig slob par phebs/ 1959lor krung dbyang mi rigs slob gling nas slob mthar phyin la/ khong gis 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉'don thengs dang po'i steng 〈〈gsar bzhad rig gnas dpyid dpal la bstod pa 〉〉zhes pa'i brtsams chos thog ma spel ba nas bzung / 〈〈me tog ldum ra'i nang gi klan ka 〉〉dang 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉sogs kyi brtsams chos so sor zhing chen dang ljongs lnga'i gsar rtsom bya dga' dang krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs rtsom rig gsar rtsom bya dag1/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom bya dga' ang dang po bcas lo byib/ sa lnga bcu pa'i nang pe cin krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwar slob sbyong byed ring rgyal khab phyi nang gi brtsams sgrung grags can mi nyung ba zhig bklags pa dang / de tsho'i nang don dang rtsom tshul gyi sgyu rtsal/ de bzhin mi sems 'gul ba'i tshig sbyor bcas kyis yid dbang rab tu 'phrogs pas slob gseng tu brtsams sgrung yang yang klog dgos pa lta bur gyur/ rjes sor las kur zhugs rjes kyi las zhor dang/ yang na 66rig gnas gsar brje mi yi dus su zhing rar ngal rtsol byed pa'i lo shas ring gi las gseng du skabs der dug rtswar brtsis nas bkag rgya byed pa'i bod yig gi lo rgyus 〈〈deb ther dkar po 〉〉sogs gzhan nas bshus te zhed snang gis lkog tu bltas pa dang / lhag par 〈〈mi la ras pa'i rnam thar 〉〉dang / 〈〈gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod〉〉/— 61 —

〈〈gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud 〉〉sogs phul byung brtsams chos mang por slob sbyong byas pa brgyud rang rigs kyi mes po rnams kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi 'od stong 'phro ba'i shul bzhag de lta bu las/ rtsom rig bi rang bzhin dang snyan 'jebs kyi tshig sbyor sogs gang gi thad nas kyang gzhan la yid smon skyes nas rang nyid mog por sdod dgos pa zhig ye nas ma yin pa ngos zin byung nas/ rang nyid kyis bod yig gi thog nas rtsom srol slob sbyong byas/ skabs der rtsom yig kha shas bris yod kyang dus deb thog tu 'god rgyu'i bsam blo lta zhogagazhan la'ang ston ma phod par me phung du btab/ rjes sor 〈〈gsar bzhad rig gnas dpyid dpal la bstod pa 〉〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig bris te rtsom sgrig khang la bskur ba dang / ma 'gyangs par dus deb steng bkod pa des khong gi gsar rtsom la skul lcag chen po thebs pa dang / rgya che'i bod rigs klog pa po rnams la rang nyid kyi skad yig gis bris pa'i sgrung deb mang tsam yong ba'i skyes su 'bul ba'i slad du/ spyi lo 1980lo'i zla3pa nas 'bo btsugs te 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gras de 'bri 'go brtsams la las zhor rang du bris nas 1983lo'i zla 11par rdzogs shing / 1989lor bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa red/ brtsams sgrung 'di ni bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang ba nas bzung / thad kur bod yig thog nas bris shing dngos su dpe skrun byas pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gras thengs dang po yin zhing 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉thog tu mu 'brel gyis bkod pa dang / ma 'gyangs par rgya yig tu bsgyur/ deng skabs phyi rgyal pas khong tsho'i skad yig tu'ang bsgyur yod pa red/gnyis/bod mi'i dad sems las mched pa'i gtam rgyud rnying pa zhigartsom pa po'i skyes sa dang skyes khungs sogs kyi dbang gis khong nyid bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa'i rim gras mtho dman kun la cha rgyus gting zab cig — 62 —

yod pas/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs byung ba'i gtam rgyud ya nga ba zhig gson nyams ldan pa'i yi ger bkod 'dug ste/ lho kha'i zhing bran phun tshogs kyi pha de nyid ma pham g.yu mtsho la gnas skor du phyin par/ khos mtsho 'gram nas spus dag pa'i gtsug g.yu zhig rnyed cing de gong ma lhas gnang bar snyam ste khyim gyi nor bur brtsis yod/ gnas tshul 'di ni de ga'i rdzong dpon gyis shes rjes thabs 'jam rtsub sna tshogs spyad nas gtsug g.yu de lag tu lon thabs byas kyang / phun tshogs bza' zla gnyis kyis ji ltar yang ma byin pas kho rang btson du bcug dpal ldan gyi a ne g.yu sgron gyi rogs ram 'og kho rang btson las bros te khams sde dge phyogs su phyin/ phun tshogs kyi chung ma 'dzoms pa nad kyis 'chi khar mos 6 a pho phun tshogs/ khyed kyis 'di ( gtsug g.yu ) jo bo'i sku mdun du phul nas 'u gnyis kyi bu dpal ldan skyid po yong ba'i smon lam 'debs rogs mi zhes kha chems bzhag yod par/ phun tshogs kyis kyang kha chems ltar du/ gtsug g.yu rum du bcug cing bu dpal ldan khrid nas ri chu khri stong brgal te gtsug g.yu de jo bo chen por phul/gtsug g.yu 'di de 'phral lha sa'i mi dpon gyi rgyu nor du gyur la/ skabs de ni sa dbang chen mos bu 'gyur med grags pa la bla g.yu zhig 'tshol ba'i skabs yin/ de nas mi dpon gyis sa dbang chen mo'i chung ma'i ming po mda' dpon brgyud nas gtsug g.yu de sa dbang chen mor phul la/ bde blag gis gzhis ka gnyis kyang brje thub pa byung / gtsug g.yu 'di dpon khag 'di dag gi lag nas mu nas mur brgyud de 'gro ba la/ cang ma 'gor bar mda' dpon gyi dga' rogs gsal sgron gyi lag tu tshud/ mda' dpon gyis gtsug g.yu'i bdag po ngo ma bu dpal ldan gyis dgra sha len par dogs nas/ lkog g.yo zhig bshams pa 'di ltar/ mda' dpon gyis gsal sgron la gtsug g.yu de dpal ldan gyi mthong sa nas gos thum dmar po zhig tu bcug ste dpal ldan la — 63 —

mda' dpon gyi sar skyel du bcug mda' dpon gyis bos thum gyi kha phye nas bsam bzhin yar slog mar slog gis 'tshol khul byas rjes/ dpal ldan gyis gtsug g.yu brkus par bsnyad btags nas dpal ldan btson du bcug ste med brlag gtong rtsis byas/ yin na'ang dpal ldan gyi grogs mo bde skyid kyis gtsug g.yu da dung gsal sgron gyi lag na yod pa mthong zhing / don de dpal ldan la btson nas bshad/ nyin zhig la/ dpal ldan gyis sa dbang chen mo'i mdun nas mi dpang nor dpang tshang ba'i sgo nas gtsug g.yu'i gsang ba brtol bar byas/ mi tshogs mang po'i mdun nas sa dbang chen mos kyang mda' dpon la chad pa gcod khul dang / der ma zad dpal ldan kyang btson grol btang /don gyis mda' dpon dang mi dpon sogs dpon sa nas ma phab par/sngar bzhin nyam chung dmangs kyi las dbang la kha lo sgyur mkhan dang / dpal ldan la'ang rang dbang ngo ma thob med/ mjug mthar/ mda' dpon gyi mche sder gyis yang bskyar kho rang bskyabs shing / kho dang mnyam du lha sa dang gyes te mu mtha' med pa'i gangs spangs kyi phyogs su chas so/ /sgrung ring 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉ni dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur byas tshun bod rang gi skad yig thog nas brtsams pa'i brtsams sgrung ring gas kyi thog ma yin pa dang / des bod kyi dus skabs gsar pa'i rtsom rig gi skyed mos tshal du bkrag mdangs rnam par bkra zhing dri bsung kun tu 'thul ba'i me tog gsar pa zhig bzhad par byas/ sgrung ring 'dis grong khyer lha sa khor lug gtso bo byas shing / mi sna gtso bo dpal ldan gyi gtsug g.yu 'dren thag byas te/ mtho bka' blon nas dman sprang po'i bar gyi rim gas khag gi mi sna'i bar gyi sne mang rnyog 'dzing gi 'brel ba dang / khong tsho'i sems gting gi 'char sgo/ de bzhin spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dang dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul mtshon thub — 64 —

nga 'i 'tsho ba'i skyid sdug 'dra min bris pa ma zad/ de snga'i lha sa'i rdzong rgyab zhar 'phen gyi byed sgo rim gas khag dang skye bo'i bar gyi gus zhabs lugs srol/ sku drag gi gsol tshigs gtong lugs/ phru gu zhig gis dge rgan bsten skabs kyi stabs bde'i mdzad sgo sogs yul srol goms gshis mi nyung ba zhig mtshon pa brgyud nas klog pa po'i mig lam du bod ljongs kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa'i rags dbyibs bstan yod pas brjod bya rgya che zhing gting zab la rtsa ba'i khyad chos bzhi tsam mchis pa rim pa ltar bkod na/1 bod mi'i phyir mi ldog pa'i dad sems mngon pa/bod du nang bstan dar ba dang sgos su mtho rim dbang 'dzin tshogs pa sa nang bstan rgya cher spel bas/ chos lugs kyi 'du shes mang po zhig spyi'i sgoms srol dang mi rnams kyi kun spyod 'du shes su gyur cing / de bzhin du bod mi'i sems gting nas tshur snang ba'i 'jig rten de'ang nang bstan gyi chos gzhung dang gnyis su ma mchis te/ 'jig rten gyi steng 'tsho ba ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'ba' zhig las bde ba'i so skabs ni nam yang mi ldan par yid ches pa ni bod spyi'i bsam blo'i 'byung gzhi zhig tu chags yod pa red/ de lta bu'i bsam blo'i rting skul 'og phugs re dang 'dun ma/ bde skyid bcas yod tshad kyi yod tshad rgyang ring lkog gyur gyi yul zhig la bcol te re bas brtson len byed cing / gnas der bgrod pa'i lam grogs dam pa ni dam pa'i lha chos bsgrub rgyu las gzhan gang yang ma mchis pas na 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉yi rtsom pa pos kyang de lta bu'i bsam blo'i bag chags kyi thog drangs pa ste/ a pha phun tshogs kyis rang gi bza' zla 'das ma'i kha chems bsgrub ched rang gi 'tsho rten phran yod rnams blos btang zhing / rin thang bral ba'i gtsug g.yu de lha sa'i jo bo'i sku mdun du 'bul phyir nad kyis mnar bzhin du bshul ring lam gyi ngal ba bzod par byas nas pha bu gnyis lha ba'i 'gram du 'byor ste — 65 —

gung thang lha mo sogs la 'dod don 'grub pa'i 'phrin bcol zhus pa dang / phyi nyin lha sa'i jo bo'i mdun du slebs nas dad gus chen pos gtsug g.yu 'bul ba'i smon lam zhus te tshe rogs kyi zhal chems 'grub par byas/ yin na'ang lo stong phrag gcig lhag gi ring byams dang snying rje'i smon lam btab pa'i lha sa'i gling 'dir a pha phun tshogs rkang pa 'dzugs sa'i sa med pa ltar gyur pa ste/ rdzong dpon gyi btsir gnon ma bzod par yul byol gyis khams sde dger gzhis chags skabs/ tshong dpon dgra lhas srog bskyabs pa dang thon khar dngos po'i rdzongs pa byas pa sogs bcos min gyi rogs skyor gnang ba dang / yang phun tshogs dang dpal ldan pha bu gnyis gung thang lha mor 'jal nas drag char byung skabs mi tshang zhig gi sgo g.yab 'og tu char byol byas pa na mi tshang de'i khyim 'dzin mas nyam thag pha bur snying rje bskyangs tshul dang /gtsug lag khang du phun tshogs snying nad 'phar lding gis dran pa thor nas 'gyel ba'i tshe grong khyer nang bi sems bzang rgan mo 'ga' zhig gis gsur bdug sogs nad las grol thabs dang ja ster ba sogs snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa'i phan grogs/ dpal ldan g.yog tu sdod skabs kyi khyim mtshes a pho bkra shis dang bde skyid gnyis phan tshun nyen kha'i gnas nas skyob res byas pa sogs bris te byams snying rje dang las rgyu 'bras rtsi ba'i mi rigs 'dir dad pa che zhing gzhan phan gyi kun slong rnam dag cig yod pa'i byung rim bris pa las gsal ston byas pa dang / mi sna de tsho'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gshis rgyud dang 'gul skyod kyi thog nas klog pa por bod mi dmangs kyi dmigs bsal du gyur pa'i sems khams dang kun spyod gsal zhing dag par bstan/2 bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nag nyes la sun 'byin byas pa/rtsom rig brtsams chos yag po zhig yin phyin/ spyi tshogs kyi yul srol — 66 —

goms gshis mtshon pa ma zad/ gral rim khag gi 'brel ba dang mi rnams kyi bsam blo sogs brjod pa dang / rdzun nyes dme gsum la smad par byed de/〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉yi rtsom pa pos spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nang gi dbang shed dang khrims log bris te ma rabs dpon ngan dag gi khrims min lugs 'gal gyi nyes spyod sun 'byin byas pa ste/ rdzong dpon gyis phun tshogs bza' zla gnyis kyi lag nas gtsug g.yu 'phrog rtsis kyi khrims dang mnar gcod byas pa ma bzod par yul gyar bya dgos par thug pa dang / bran mor brnyas bcos byas tshul/ g.yo thabs sna tshogs la brten nas bran mo'i phru gu 'phrog pa dang sa dbang chen mo'i lha sras 'jigs med grags par bsgyur ba/ g.yo thabs de dag gi ngan 'bras bsub phyir sman log btang nas bran mo phyi ma'i lam du bsdangs pa/ dpal ldan la nyes med nyes 'gel gyis khrims la sbyar ba dang lkog gsod byed rtsis byas pa/ bka' khrims dang rgyu dngos brje ba sogs spyi tshogs rnying pa'i dpon rigs mang po'i spyod tshul dang / bu mo bde skyid khrom srang nas bod dmag gis rdung drud byas tshul sogs sne mang rnyog 'dzing gi gnas tshul bris te skabs de'i dpon rigs mang po'i tshul min spyod tshul dang / dmag mi'i spyod chul/ rim gras khag bar gyi 'brel ba/ ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi ya nga ba'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab bcas rkyen dang sprel nas gson nyams ldan par bkod pa des klog pa po'i yid dbang med du bkug nas skabs rer khong khro langs nas mig rtsa dmar por 'gyur ba dang / skabs rer mig chu khrum khrum du bzhur yong ba de'i thog nas rtsom pa po'i rtsom rtsal gsal bar mngon no/ /lhag par le'u drug par rdzong dpon des bran mo'i byis pa lha sras rdzun mar bsgyur rgyur dmigs te dmar 'byar 'phrog sems kyis bslu brid byed skabs ma g.yu sgron gyi tshig lan du/ gcig nas dpon po'i las ka gang skul 'thus tshang mi 'grub pa'i dngangs skrag dang / gnyis nas 'gro — 67 —

blos mi bzod par dpon po'i bka' bkyon dang phru gus ma 'bod kyi ngu sgra gnyis bsdebs nas nyin mtshan kun tu sdug bsngal gyi thobs su tshud rgyu'i mtha' 'bras sogs ya nga ba'i dngos don de lta bu ji ma ji bzhin 'bri thub pa ni rtsom rtsal la mnga' dbang 'byor ba las gzhan/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nyams myong gis ha cang phyug pa'ang shes thub/3 rig gnas goms srol phun sum tshogs pa/rig rtsal phal mo che ni gnas skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dang rtsom pa po'i bsam blo mtshon pa'i me long lta bu yin zhing / des lo rgyus kyi dus skabs nges can zhig gi dpal 'byor dang chab srid/ rig gnas/ spyi tshogs kyi yul srol goms 'dris/ shul bzhag rig dngos/ dmangs khrod rig gnas bcas mtshon par byed de/ 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉yi rtsom pa pos spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i mdzes ris gsal por bris pa ni/ sa dbang chen mo'i gzim shag gi gsol tshigs skabs gzim shag de'i rgya sgo chen po'i g.yas g.yon gyi 'dogs khyi'i jig nyams nas bzung gzim khang thog shod bar gsum dang / khor yug gi shing sna me tog la sogs ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa zhib phra dang / sku mgron mtho 'bring mi sna so so'i rgyan gos gzab 'phyor gyi skor/ bal bo dang kha che sogs phyi'i mi sna/ tshong pa dang mi drag rnams la gnas bab dang 'tshams pa'i ngo so dang phyag mgron sogs kyis bsu ba zhu ba'i bo rim dang phan tshun gus 'dud zhu tshul/ 'khri khungs so so'i zhabs phyi dang zhal ta ma rnams kyis gsol ja dang zhal tog sogs sne len zhu ba'i yo byad 'dren pa sogs kyi 'gro 'ong / skabs bstun nyin gung gi gsol tshigs bod zas 'bul gshom/ phyag mgron sogs sne mo ba rnams kyis mnyes bzhes zhu skul sogs kyi lam lugs/ glu gzhas tshogs pas snyan 'jebs rol mo'i bye brag 'khrol zhing nang ma'i zhabs gzhas 'bul ba la sogs dang / lha ldan chen mo'i gtor rgyag gi mjug tu lo ltar 'tshogs — 68 —

pa'i rdzong rgyab zhar 'phen gyi nyin mor lo gcig gi gling ga'i spro skyid kyi 'go ma brtsams pas/ lha sa'i grong mi rnams rang rang 'khos 'byor la gzhigs pa'i rgyan gos kyi gzab 'phyor spras shing / gdan gur dang bza' bca'i rigs dang ja chang la sogs khyer nas lha klu'i dga' tshal gyi phyogs su bar ma chad par bskyod pa dang / skabs de'i mi rnams kyi chas gos ji ltar spras tshul/ yul ljongs kyi bkod pa/ sgar gur sgrig stangs/ bka' shag sa dbang rnam pa dang /mi tshogs 'du long / rgyug 'phen rtsal 'gran gyi rta ba'i grangs rtsis bsher ba sgrosas sbyang gi bka' bsgugs bsgyur byed stangs/ 'phong rgyugs sogs kyi drag rtsal 'gran pa'i gzigs 'bul/ ltad mo ba rnams rgyug rtsal dang 'phen rtsal la ha las pa'i bstod bsngags dar dir sgrog pa'i tshul/ 'phong rtsal skyen pa rnams la gzigs gzos gnang ba sogs kyi gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin du bkod pa des sgrung gi 'byung rkyen 'phel rim gyi zhor la skabs de'i spyi tshags kyi goms srol dang / dpon rigs tsho'i 'tsho ba skyel stangs/ mi rigs kyi yul srol goms gshis/ dmangs khrod kyi 'gul skyod sna tshogs bcas gsal rtogs thub pa'i dge mtshan ldan 'dug4 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉yi brjod bya'i bstan don dang sgyu rtsal rin thang skor/brtsams sgrung 'di'i ming la 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉zhes btags par nang don gamigs bsal zhig yod de/ g.yu ni rtsa che ba'i rin po che'i rigs shig yin pa dang / bod rigs mi dmangs kyis gna' snga mo'i dus nas rin po che'i rigs 'di rgyan cha rtsa chen zhig tu brtsis nas ske rgyan nam gtsug rgyan du 'dogs bzhin yod/ brtsams sgrung gis kyang bod mi rigs la gsal cha yod cing rin thang che ba'i gtsug g.yu thun mong ma yin pa zhig gi gtam rgyud brgyud nas spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs su byung ba'i sha dang khrag gi lo rgyus rabs dang rim pa zhig sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas bskyar du mngon pā ste/ dpal ldan dang a pha phun — 69 —

tshogs/ bde skyid/ a pha bkra shis bcas dang / bdag med phru gu 'khyam po'i tshogs shig las bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs spyi tshogs nang gnas pa'i zhing bran tsho'i ya nga ba'i 'tsho ba dag ji bzhin du ri mor bkod pa dang / sems pa bzang zhing kun spyod legs pa'i bu mo ye shes mkha' 'gro dang sgor sems kho na'i dbang du gyur pa'i bud med brnab sems can de dang /bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi 'go ba mda' dpon dang /mi dpon/ sa dbang la sogs ngan dgu tshang zhing byol song dang gnyis su med pa'i rigs/ rkun jag sga tshul du gnas pa'i tshong ba dbang 'dus sogs mi sna du ma'i snang brnyan bzhengs skrun bgyis pa gson nyams ldan zhing mig ngor ji bzhin 'char thub/ rtsom pa pos zhing bran khyim tshang zhig bi ches skyo ba'i las dbang de bris par brten nas/ dbang sgyur mkhan dag gi phyi 'jam gting gnag dang / zol sbyor khrel med kyi ngan spyod dang ham sems/ g.yo sgyu/ ma rabs gdug rtsub kyi ngo gdong dang skyug bro ba'i rang gshes sogs dmar rjen du bton pa dang / dus mtshungs su/ 'tsho ba'i don dngos mang po zhig dang mi sna'i rang bzhin mi 'dra ba sna tshogs kyi 'gal 'thab thar chags su bris te/zhing bran tshos rim bzhin su dgra bo dang su grogs po yin pa ngos zin nas/rang rtogs kyis ngan par 'gog rgol bgyis nas rang dbang dang bcings 'grol gyi lam 'tshol ba gsal por bris yod/brtsams sgrung 'di'i mtshon don nam nang don gyi cha nas spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs bod kyi dpon 'bangs mtho dman bar ma'i mi rnams bzang ngan sna tshogs kyi 'brel tshul lam/ de dag gi bsam spyod sogs spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul khyab che tsam mtshon pa'i sgo nas mun nag gi phyogs la ther 'don dang /btsan dbang dang khrims med la 'phya smod/ rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam khrims yod/ bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba bcas la re smon byed pa ma zad/ sngar srol dus ston — 70 —

khag gi byed sgo 'ga' zhig kyang mngon par mtshon pas spyi tshogs der cha rgyus yod pa'i mi rnams dang spyi tshogs zhib 'jug pa rnams kyi thugs la 'bab pa'i gsar rtsom yag shos shig red/sgrung ring 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉ji ltar brtsams grub byung ba'i skor la sku zhabs glang mdun dpal 'byor lags kyis 'di ltar gsungs myong ste/ 6 rtsom tshul thad la bod kyi rgyun srol rtsom rig 'bri srol bed spyad pa ma zad/ mi rigs gzhan gyi khyad rtsal yang bed spyod byed gang thub byas pa dang / zhing chen dang sa gnas 'dra min gyi bod risas spyi yis gzigs bde ba'i ched du skabs rer dgos dbang la gtugs pa phud lha sa ba'i yul skad bed spyod gtong mi dgos pa gtso 'dod byas thog zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi dbos mkhor dmigs te/ mngon brjod dang rgyan gyis bcings nas brjod don gang yin mi rtogs pa'i phyogs lhung du ma shor ba byas nas 'bri rtsom byas pa yin/brtsams sgrung dpe skrun byas nas 'grems spel byas rjes bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon gyi klog pa po kha shas nas phyag bris byung ste/ gdeng 'jog chen po gnang / mi② zhes pa ltar/ rtsom pa pos bod kyi gna' rabs brtsams sgrung dag gi nyams 'gyur dang deng rabs brtsams sgrung gsar pa'i mtshon stangs gnyis zung 'brel byas shing / brtsams chos nang gi mi sna so so'i gshis lugs dang kun spyod/ bsam sbyor bzang ngan tha dad du gyur pa las byung ba'i 'gal 'du de rlung gis g.yos pa'i rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs ji bzhin rim bzhin rtog 'dzing tsha ba dang dza drag tu song ba'i thog nas nyams dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bris yod pa dang / gtam rgyud hril po'i 'gal 'du thog mar byung tshul 'dra chags pa dang / bar gyi 'phel rim la mi rnams 'tshab 'dzub dang / mi sna'i gnas bab dang bya spyod la sems khral dang yang na khong khro/ 'ga' zhig la dga' 'bod dang re 'ga' snying rlung 'khrugs pa byed dgos pa dang /co mtha' ma'i mjug — 71 —

sgril stangs de dngangs 'tshab kyis mnar ba'i klog pa po'i sems pa lhod shig shig tu 'gro mi thub na'ang re ba'i sa bon gson po zhig sbas pa'i zol gyis bris yod pas brtsams sgrung de bklags pa'i rjes la yid kyi dbang po cig car du 'phrogs pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin ldan/ dpal ldan ni brtsams sgrung nang bi mi sna gtso bo dang ngo mtshar can gyi zhing bran zhig gi dpe gzhi yin/brtsams sgrung 'di las gtso bo dpal ldan gyis chung dus dka' sdug myong ba bris pa ste/ khos rdzong dpon dang mda' dpon/ sa dbang chen mo sogs la blo gtad rgyab rten byas kyang ngan g.yo dang log khrims las gzhan gang yang ma thob pa ma zad/ tha na rang gi srog kyang shor ba'i nyen khar gtug pa red/ de bas khos rang la yid ches dang rang dang skyes khungs gcig 'dra yin pa'i phu nu dag la rgyab rten byas na/ da gzod rang dbang gi 'od zer dang ma 'ongs pa'i bde skyid mthong thub pa'i blo gdengs brtan por tshugs pa'i gnad don dag rtsom pa pos thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas bris yod/ skabs 'gar kha gsal yid gsal gyi thog nas rgyu mtshan rtsa ba dag gcig gcig gnyis gnyis kyis ngo sprod byas yod pa ni/ dper na/ mda' dpon gyi g.yo zol dang nag nyes la mtshang 'byin byas pa dang / bde skyid kyi sems dkar dang zhum med sogs bris pa ha cang gson nyams ldan zhing zhib phra yin/ skabs 'gar gab smyug gi 'bri thabs la brten nas gnas tshul gyi kha 'khor phyogs tsam dang yang na khungs sne tsam ma gtogs gsal 'debs byas med mod/ 'on kyang / klog pa pos skabs bab kyi bstan bya bgam mi dgos par yid kyi mtsho mor nya bzhin 'khor 'ongs te/ sa dbang chen mo'i ngo gnyis ma'i rang bzhin dang / g.yu sgron gyi smyo tshul dang shi 'das sogs skad cha nyung bsdus kyis bris pa de'ang klog pa po'i yid la gsal sha dod por 'char thub pas sgyu rtsal 'bras bu mi dman pa thob yod/ 'di ltar bris pa'i dmigs bya ni dpal ldan gyi snang brnyan gsar — 72 —

bzo byed rgyu de yin zhing / dpal ldan snang brnyan bab chags shing gson nyams ldan pa mi sna zhig tu bzhengs skrun byas pa red/mdor na/ 〈〈gtsug g.yu 〉〉yi rtsom pa pos bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom thabs kyis deng rabs rtsom rig la zhabs 'degs zhu ba dang / de bzhin deng rabs brtsams sgrung 'bri thabs kyis srol rgyun gyi rtsom 'bri'i thabs shes la brtsi bsrung byed dgos pa'i blang bya don thog tu 'khyol ba byas yod pas/ bod kyi brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom thad mig dpe lta bu'i nus pa thon 'dugabazhi pa/ bkra shis dpal ldan dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈phal ba'i khyim tshang gi skyid sdug〉〉bkra shis dpal ldan ( 1962— ) ni bod ljongs gtsang khul rin spungs rdzong khongs ram pa zhes pa'i lung par skyes/ 1982lo nas rtsom rig brtsams chos 'bri 'go brtsams pa dang da lta'i bar brtsams sgrung gis gtsos 'bol rtsom dang snyan tshig dngos 'bri rtsom rig rtsom rig dpyad brjod sogs mang po zhig bod yig dus deb dang tshags par thog spel/ gzhan yang brtsams sgrung ring gras 〈〈phal ba'i khyim tshang gi skyid sdug 〉〉dang sgrung 'bring 〈〈rgyud skud steng gi rnam shes〉〉/ sgrung thung bdams bsgrigs 〈〈phyi nyin gyi gnam gshis de ring las legs pa yong nges 〉〉zhes pa sogs mang po dpe skrun byas yod/ sgrung ring 〈〈phal ba'i khyim tshang gi skyid sdug 〉〉ces pa 'bri don dang rgyu mtshan ni bkra shis dpal ldan gyis 'di ltar bshad myong ste 4 bdag ni rlung rta de tsam med mkhan zhig yin/ chung dus dus bab dang khyim tshang gi dka' ngal nyis brtsegs kyis bdag dpe deb klog pa'i rgya sgo nas phyir 'then pa dang zla ba rer gla phogs sgor bcu gcig yod pa'i dmangs btsugs slob grwa'i dge rgan byed pa'i lo brgyad kyi ring kyag kyog dang blo la mi 'bab pa'i gnas — 73 —

tshul mang po zhig dang mu mthud de 'phrad/ rtsom pa po grags can zhig gis 6 rang gi mi sna'i las dbang skyo bo'i kha gsab kyi tshul du mi'i mi tshe ni blos bslangs pa ltar gyi dga' drag pa zhig ma yin la slos bslangs pa ltar gyi sdug drag pa zhig kyang ma yin zhes bris yod pa de rang cag gi thams cad sdug bsngal du lta ba'i nang bstan dgongs pa dang bsdur na de ni dngos yod dang cung thag nye ba yod cing / mi gang 'dra zhig yin na'ang 'tsho ba'i nang kyag kyog dang dka' sdug ci tsam dang 'phrad na'ang de'i sems nang gi re ba rta rnga tsam las med kyang de ni 'dor mi rung ba zhig red/ bdag la ma gzhi rig gnas sbyong ba'i skal ba ma byung yang 'tsho ba'i nang mang po zhig bdag gi slob grogs tsho'i sngon du myong rgyu byung ba de yang a ne snye mo dang snang sa'i tshul du zad/mi ①ces pa ltar rtsom mkhan khong nyid mtsho bod mtho sgang gi ches phal ba'i grong tsho zhig tu gnas shing 'tsho ba'i myong tshor dngos des khong la phal ba'i grong tsho'i nang gi phal ba'i khyim tshang gi skyid sdug ste 'tsho ba'i 'og rim na 'tsho ba'i 'bangs mi dkyus ma ba'i 'tsho ba 'bri bar skul ma chen po thebs pa rtsom mkhan khong nyid kyi skad chas zhus na/6 bdag gi las skal dman pa'i mi sna spo bo tshe ring dang skal bzang /bkra shis don grub dang tshe brtan lha mo sogs ni bdag gi rnam shes dang dam por thel yod pa dang kho tsho re re ni bdag sga rab tu 'khol ba'i khrag rgyun gyi rba klong dang lhag bsam dag pa'i brtse sems kyi rkang rjes lags/ dus dang rnam pa kun tu khong tsho'i sems kyi dga' skyo dang 'tsho ba'i skyid sdug ni 'du shes med pa'i gnam gyi gshis ka dang bstun nas 'gyur ldog 'gro ba dang bdag grong khyer du 'byor ba dang khong tsho ltar gnam la bltas nas 'tsho ba gtong tshod byed pa'i las dbang dang bral nas lo bcu grangs song mod/ 'on kyang bdag gi sems kyi thag pa'i sne mo gcig sngar bzhin glang gnyis la — 74 —

gnya' bstad de sa zhing rol du rmo ba'i sa gzhi nag po de dang bral med do/ /bdag gi las skal dman pa'i mi sna'i nang sha rgyags pa gcig kyang med pa dang sha bri thabs kyi thad la 'gro song gtan nas gtong mi dgos par de bas kho tsho tshang ma sha rid cing bzhin gyi steng du lo tshod dang mi mnyam pa'i gnyer ris kyi grog shur 'then pa zhe gcig yin mod/ khong tsho tshang mar 'dod chung chog shes dang gzhung drang sems bzang gi kun spyod bzang po re yod pa ma zad/ pham nyes ci tsam byung yang rang byung khams chen po dang dpa' ngar chen pos 'thab phod pa'i snying stobs re yod/mi du ces so/ /rtsom pa po gang nyid ni 'tsho ba'i phyi shun brtol nas nang gi ngo bo la dpyod mkhas pa zhig yin pas/khos 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi sne mang rnyog 'dzing gi 'gal ba'i 'phel tshul gsal ston byas nas/ brtsams chos kyi mtho nas mjug bar du dngos yod ring lugs kyi khyad chos mngon du bcug yod de/ sgrung thung phyogs bsgrigs 〈〈sang nyin gyi gnam gshis de ring las legs pa yong nges 〉〉zhes pa dang / 〈〈phal ba'i khyim tshang gi skyid sdug 〉〉gnyis ni rtsom pa pos gting zab cing rngam mthug pa'i zhing sde'i 'tsho ba'i myong tshor dang / bod kyi spyi tshogs la bsam gzhigs gting zab dang zhing pa tshor brtse sems rnam dag bcangs pa'i yig thog gi sgyu rtsal nying khu yin/1yozhing pa rnams kyi re ba dang ngar sems de brtsams chos khag gi srog tu gyurā krad shi / dpal ldan khong yun ring du zhing sder 'tsho ba rol stabs/'das zin pa'i lo zla'i nang chab srid rlung rlabs kyis zhing sde'i dpal 'byor la gtor brlag tshabs chen btang ba dang / zhing pa'i 'tsho ba dang sems rgyud la dka' sdug dang gnod 'tshe du ma zhig bzos pa dngos su mig gis mthong ba dang / de'i mtshungs su zhing pa'i gnyom chung nyam ngan las snying rus brtan — 75 —

po zhig dang / zhi dul lhod 'jam las blo rtsa ngar po zhig dka' zhing sdug pa las re ba'i me phung zhig sbas pa'i zol gyis 'bar bzhin pa'i spyod lam la nyams tshor mngon sum du skyes par byas thog bcos bsgyur gyi 'brug sgra lho nas grags rjes/ khos phyogs gcig nas zhing pa'i lus sems na gnas pa'i hur brtson dang gsar gtod kyi rang bzhin la nyams zhib gting zab byas shing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas tshor ba myur ba'i sgo nas kho tsho'i mdun du lhags pa'i dka' khag sna tshogs shes tshor byas pa des/ khong la spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos mtshon pa dang zhing par bsngags brjod byed pa'i gsar rtsom gyi kun slong rnam dag cig skyes par byas so//de ltar khong gi brtsams sgrung phyogs bsdus las 〈〈phyi nyin gyi gnam gshes de ring las yag pa yong nges 〉〉zhes pa ni/ bod rigs zhing pa tshos rang byung khams dang 'thab pa'i spobs nyams gsal mtshon byas pa'i ri mo lta bu zhig yin/ rtsom pa pos phra zhib kyi byung rim rabs dang rim pa'i zhib 'bri la brten nas/ las la brtson zhing ngang rgyud gtsang ba/ snying rus che zhing yar thon la 'bad pa'i zhing pa rgan po zhig gi mchog gyur gyi snang brnyan bzhengs pa dang / goms srol du gyur pa'i stobs shugs dang srol rgyun gyi lta tshul rnying pas zhing pa rnams kyi rkang lag sngar bzhin 'ching sdom byed pa'i gnas tshul gsal rjen du bris 'dugabartsams sgrung nang gi mi sna gtso bo skal bzang bkra shis ni zhing pa rgan po zhig gi dpe gzhi yin/ skal bzang bkra shis kyi khom long med tshul dang brel zing che tshul 'bri skabs kho rang nangs snga langs dang dgung 'phyi nyal byed pa/dus tshod la gser bzhin gces pa/ khyim mi yongs rdzogs las la skyel ba bcas gsum 'bur thon du bris yod/brtsams sgrung gis skal bzang bkra shis kyi ngal dub dang dka' sdug — 76 —

'bri skabs/ sa zhing rmo ba'i glang gog gnyis ngal bas mnar nas dbugs lhem lhem byed pa dang kha nas wu ba thon pa'i ngang tshul bris nas skal bzang bkra shis kyi zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs mtshon pa ste lha kho rang ngal dub kyis mnar ba'i khar nyi 'od rab tu tsha bas rngul chu'i thigs pa ma de'i 'og nas zags pa dang stod la gyon pa'i 'og 'jug dreg pas 'tshos pa de'ang rbad de rlon pa chags yod pas 'og 'jug de'ang phud de stod hreng mar thon mi zhes pa mthong 'phral ji 'dra'i zhum pa med cing brtson sems ldan pa zhig red ang snyam/ mi'i tshor snang du 'di lta bu'i snying stobs yod tshe/ dka' khag ji 'dra zhig gis kyang gnon mi btub la/ 'jigs snang skye mi srid pa'i ngar shugs sbyin par byed/skal bzang bkra shis kyis gnam gshis kyi 'gyur ldog la sems khur byed tshul 'bri skabs/ zhing pa rgan po des char chu dus thog tu 'bab pa ni lo legs 'byung ba'i gzhi rkang dang / than pa dang ser ba sogs ni gnod 'tshe dang mu ge'i 'byung gzhir mthong ba bris nas/ zhing pa rnams kyi dga' skyo chags sdang gi brtse sems mtshon pa'i nang lta tshul rnying pa gsal 'byin byas yod de/ sna sa zla'i dus tshod ran pas grong mi rnams kyis yul lhar gsol mchod byas pa dang / char 'bebs kyi cho ga byed pa/ lha gsol klu gsol byed pa bcas gang yod ci yong byas/mi ② de nas yang nyin zhig kho tshos rnam kun ltar gzhi bdag dang klu rgyal gsol rjes sbal ba dang sdig rwa bzung nas dmar 'dzing byed du bcug bshad srol ltar na kho gnyis kyi dmar 'dzing de sbal ba thob na char ba 'bab rgyu yin pa dang sdig rwa thob na than pa bstan gyi yod ( gong mtshungs 〉 ces pa'i bya spyod kyis zhing pa rnams kyi re 'dod mtshon pa ma gtogs/ don dngos thog gnam rgan mar sems 'gul thebs mi srid pa red/ gzhan da dung ser ba 'gog thabs ni de bas mtshar snang che ba — 77 —

ste/ ser 'gog mkhan gyis sngags bzlo ba ma zad/ khos da dung mang tshogs la ser ba 'gog pa'i gsang thabs shig bslabs mod/ 'on kyang mtha' 'bras ni ya nga zhing yid skyo ba'i gnas tshul byung ba de klog pa pos de snga dngos su mthong ba dang dngos su myong zhing brgyud pa ltar snang ba ma zad/ rmongs dad dang nor 'khrul gyi lta ba la dgag pa tsha thag chod pa zhig bskyon yod/ brtsams sgrung gi mjug tu skal bzang bkra shis kyis gnod 'tshe dang god than mang ba'i lo der kha gtad nas spobs pas brang khog rab tu khengs pa'i ngang mdun phyogs kyi ngos mi snyom zhing kyag kyog gi ri lam la rgyang lta byed cing /skyes pa pho yi khog rgya yangs tshul gyis 4 tshe gang gtan grogs nyes na nyes pa yin/ lo gcig lo tog nyes na nyes pa min zer ba ltar 'di lo lo nyes byung yang sang lo shar rgyu yod pa yin/ da ni sems khral byas kyang phan thogs ci yod/ de las sang lo lo legs yong ba'i ched du sa bkrab gnam bkrab byas na yag gi red/mi ces smras pa ni/ dngos thog dka' sgrub byed pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng tshugs pa'i yid du 'ong ba'i phugs bsam 'ba' zhig dang brtsams sgrung gi ches 'od 'phro ba'i gnas yang 'di yin te/ zhing pa'i sems khams kyi man ngag de ji ma ji bzhin bris pa red/〈〈phal ba'i khyim tshang gi skyid sdug 〉〉ces pa 'di khong gis lo ngo bdun brgyad kyi dka' ba spyad de brtsams pa'i sgrung ring dang po yin la/ 'di'i nang don gtso bo ni dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byas pa nas 'bo brtsams te gtsang khul gyi zhing pa'i bu mo tshe brtan lha mo'i khyim tshang gi gnas tshul de lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi go rim nang du bzhag nas/ zhing pa'i khyim tshang phal ba zhig gi 'tsho ba'i skyid sdug mtshon pa dang / rnyog zing gis khengs pa'i 'gal ba bris pa brgyud lo ngo sum cu'i ring gtan 'jags min pa'i chab srid dang / nyams shing rgud pa'i dpal 'byor/ tshul min ngan rengs kyi spyod pa/ re gtad la cha — 78 —

'jog med pa'i spyi tshogs snang tshul ji bzhin bskyar du mngon yod/ mi'i bsam blo'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs sogs kyi 'gyur ldog dang lhag par tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs rjes zhing las sa khul du thog ma'i 'pho 'gyur chen po byung tshul bris nas drang bden de ngan pa las rgyal thub cing / 'od snang de mun nag las rgyal thub pa'i lo rgyus kyi ldog med chos nyid gsal por bstan pa ni dngos yod la mthong chen dang 'tsho ba'i 'gro stangs la'ang khas len byed pa'i dngos srid ring lugs kyi bsam blo de brtsams chos kyi mgo rnga bar gsum du mthong thub/ zhing sde'i bsgyur bcos khrod goms 'dris rnying pa bgegs rkyen du langs/ na'ang tshe brtan lha mo sogs kyis 'tsho bar re bas khengs pa'i tshul gyis gsar du dar 'go tshugs pa'i zhing sde'i dpal 'byor rnam pa'i dka' khag dang dga' snang 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur bris pa'i nang gsar byung bya dngos de /byi /bye /la zhing gzi 'od ldan pa'i mdun ljongs la re bas khengs pa brtsams sgrung nang du phra zhib kyi byung rim rabs dang rim pa'i zhib 'bri la brten nas/ las la brtson zhing ngang rgyud 'jam pa/ snying rus che zhing yar thon la 'bad pa'i zhing pa tshe brtan lha mo dang / don grub/ phun tshogs sogs kyi mi sna'i snang brnyan bzhengs pa dang / de bzhin du lhag rdor dang sgrol ma lta bu'i u tshugs gnya' rengs dang dus rabs kyi nyes can du gyur pa'i mi sna'i gzugs brnyan bzhengs skrun byas pa las/ soms srol du gyur pa'i stobs shugs dang srol rgyun gyi lta tshul rnying pas zhing pa rnams kyi rkang lag sngar bzhin 'ching sdom byed pa'i gnas tshul gsal rjen du bstan/ brtsams chos kyis bden dngos kyi tshad mtho ba'i sgo nas gtsang khul zhing pas dmigs bsal gyi cha rkyen ga ge mo'i 'og dka' tshegs ngang mdun du bgrod pa'i rkang — 79 —

rjes re re bzhin mngon par mtshon pa la/ nga tshos phyogs gcig nas zhing pa'i skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar zhing / gnam sa 'gengs pa'i ngar shugs/ rgyud legs bzhin gtsang gi gshis ka mthong thub pas sems gting nas brtse zhing gus pa'i tshor snang bskyed cing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas mi rnams la ji lta bu'i sgo nas zhing pa tshor rogs ram byas nas kho tsho'i lus steng dang sems steng gi khur bo lci mo de mar phab rgyu ni mig snga'i kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi las 'gan zhig yin pa gsal 'debs byas pa red/brtsams sgrung las lhag rdor dang sgrol ma/ rdo rje sogs mi sna'i gshis ka bris pa brgyud nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi lhag ro dang srol rgyun rnying pa'i stobs shugs la ngo rgol byas pa dang / a ma bde sgron dang spen pa sogs bris nas spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam blos zhing pa'i thon skyed chung ba'i 'du shes bcos bsgyur byed pa'i dngos yod kyi gnad don bton pa dang / de bzhin du tshe brtan lha mo dang don grub/ phun tshogs lta bu bris nas bden 'tshol dka' sgrub dang spyi sems che zhing sgor sems chung ba'i snang brnyan brko bzhengs byas par ma zad/ srol rgyun gyi spyod bzang dang bsam blo gsar pa dag phan tshun 'dres shing thim pa'i zhing pa rgan rabs dang 'tsho bar phugs bsam dang re bas yongs su khengs pa'i zhing grong gi na gzhon gyi skyes stobs kyi dpal bris pa red/ de ltar brtsams sgrung 'di'i grub 'bras gtso bo ni/ bden dngos yod pa'i sgo nas bod ljongs kyi zhing pa rnams zhing bran lam lugs nas spyi tshogs ring lugs spyi tshogs su phyin pa'i lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ldog de bskyar mtshon byas pa dang / gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang bod ljongs zhing grong gis lo ngo sum cu'i dka' sdug brgyud de mdun bskyod kyi lam du gom kha bsgyur ba'i snying stobs mtshon pa red/2 brtsams chos kyi sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs thad kyi mtha' dpyod 'ga'/— 80 —

〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa'i brtsams chos bdams bkod dang de dag gi bshad pa 〉rnomezhes pa las dpyad 'jog gnang ba de ni kha dpe la nad gso ba'i sman la zhi/ po med paste dang sha tsha ba'i gtam la snyan mo med ces pa ltar cung /sbyirsha sdi sa dīkā du/di 'i/ mtshon bya lo ngo sum cu lhag gi bod ljongs kyi 'tsho ba yin la/ skabs 'di'i lo ngo sum cu 'di rang ga ba'i dus tshod cig ma yin par/ chab srid kyi 'pho 'gyur rabs dang rim par 'byung ba'i dus shig yin/'pho 'gyur de re re ni mi'i bla srog la nyams tshod len pa lta bu dang / mi'i rang gshis mngon gsal du 'bud byed kyi 'gag rtsa re yin/ khor yug khyad par ba 'dis spyir na rtsom gyi mi sna'i gshis ka gsal rjen du 'bud par byas te/ mi sna'i bla srog dngos mthong bar bya ba la rgyab ljongs nges can bskrun yod/ 'on kyang brtsams sgrung 'dis tshe brtan lha mo'i khyim tshang gi gnas tshul rkyang ba mtshon pa las/ bye brag pa'i gnas tshul 'di spyi tshogs kyi khor yug chen po'i khrod bzhag ste mtshon par byas pa shin tu nyung / de bas brtsams sgrung nyid bab lci ba can du gyur med la/ lo rgyus kyi tshor snang yang mi btsan/gnyis nas 'bri bzhengs dang lhug brjod bar gyi rtsod sgrub 'brel bar blang dor byas pa cung zad mi 'dang / spyir brtsams sgrung zhig yin tshe de'i nang na mi sna'i 'du byed dang sems khams sogs kyi zhib 'bri dang rtsom pa po'i lhug brjod kyi gtam gnyis sbrags shing sbrel te yod pa zhig yin/ zhib 'bri'i cha des rtsom de nyid gson nyams dod po can du byas te 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris gsal bar byas shing dbang yul du 'char ba 'dra bya ba yin/ rtsom pa po'i lhug brjod kyi gtam gyis 'tsho ba'i gtso bo ma yin pa'i phal ba'i skor la 'phral gyis phyin par byas te rtsom nyid nyog med ngos gtsang du bya ba dang / brtsams sgrung gi byung rim dang gtam rgyud rang bzhin la shugs snon dang rgyab skyor bya — 81 —

ba yin/ 'di gnyis bar gyi rtsod sgrub 'brel ba dang len byas pa legs tshe rtsom nyid klog rin yod pa can du 'gyur nges yin/ sgrung ring 'di bklasas pa'i nga tsho'i myong tshor chen po zhig ni/ lhug brjod kyi gtam mang ste zhib 'bri'i skor shin tu nyung ba de red/ rtsom nang gi 'tsho ba phal che ba rtsom pa po nyid kyis nga tshor thad kur brjod par gyur pa nyid las/ zhib bris kyis 'tsho ba'i brnyan ris gsal por byas pa shin tu nyung / de bas sgrung ring 'dir mtshon na gtam rgyud kyi shas che ba las brtsams sgrung gi shas chung bar snyam/gsum nas zhib 'bri byas yod pa 'ga' zhig kyang rtsom gyi mi sna'i bab dang mthun pa'am mi sna'i nyams myong ngam mi sna'i dbang ngor snang ba lta bu min par/ rtsom pa po rang ngos gyi snang ba kho na yin/ dper na le'u dang po'i tshan pa bzhi pa lta bu/ khos rta rgyugs skabs kyi gnas tshul bris pa spyir zhib mo ma yin zhes bshad mi rung / 'on kyang de'i skabs kyi gnas tshul mang po zhig 'brel med lta bur snang / de'i rgyu mtshan ni gtso bo rtsom pa pos rang cha nas rta rgyugs skabs kyi gnas tshul zhib tu bris pa nyid las/ skabs de'i gnas tshul de ltar du zhib tu bris pa las mi sna'i sems khams 'bri ba dang gshis ka mtshon pa la phan thogs par 'gyur ba zhig ma yin/ de bas zhib 'bri'i skor de la gson nyams ldan pa zhig min par cho med ro med du gnas yod la/ klog pa por rang lus de ru 'khod pa 'dra ba'i tshor snang 'byung dka'/de ltar mi 'dang sa 'ga' yod pa 'dra yang / kho'i rtsom rtsal phyogs kyi sgrig 'god kyi nus pa des rtsom gyi mgo rnga bar gsum 'brel yod sra chags su byas shing rgyud gcig par byas yod pas na/ yig 'bru gang la sdebs grangs mang yang brtsams sgrung nyid gsog gsob nyog rdzob can du ma gyur par/ sgrig gzhi'i bkod sgrig dang skad cha sogs kyi ngos nas bshad na sgrung ring gi khyad chos ma 'chol bar yod/ sngon med stong pa'i gzhi nas 'di lta'i 'bras bu mi — 82 —

dman pa len thub pa nga tshos nam yang rjes su yi rang byed la/ lo'i lo bdun brgyad kyi dka' spyad snying stobs la de bas kyang rjes su yi rang byed/ lhag par bod kyi sgrung ring bi lo rgyus la mtshams 'di nas 'od zer stong dang ldan par bgyis zhes brjod na thal mi che bar snyam/ zhes pa'i dpyad 'jog gis sand 'bag gtso bo dag brjod yod par 'dod do//lnga pa/stag 'bum rgyal dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈snying 'jags kyi rtswa thang 〉〉/stag 'bum rgyal (1966wa )ni mtsho sngon zhing chen kos nan rdzong du skyes/ 1987lo nas bzung gsar rtsom byed 'go brtsams shing / brtsams chos gtso bo ni sgrung ring 〈〈snying 'jags kyi rtswa thang 〉〉dang mu 'brel brtsams sgrung 〈〈nag zhar sde ba'i gtam rgyud〉〉/ sgrung 'bring 〈〈mi rkyang gcod pa'i gtam rgyud khrod kyi sgrol ma〉〉/ sgrung thung 〈〈sdug gi lo ma chang gis bangs pa min〉〉/ 〈〈sgo khya〉〉/ 〈〈nyin gcig gi cho 'phrul〉〉/ 〈〈yar ngo'i zla ba〉〉/ 〈〈phugs bsam〉〉 〈〈kho rang lan pa yin nam〉〉/ 〈〈nam gung sga mgron po〉〉/ 〈〈mi rabs gsum gyi rmi lam 〉〉sogs mang ngo //stag 'bum rgyal ni 'brog khul du skyes shing 'tshar longs byung la/ 'brog khul du bya ba bsgrubs pa dang 'brog pa mang tshogs dang mnyam du skyid sdug mnyam myong gi 'tsho ba rol bas/ des kho'i 'brog mir dmigs pa'i bsam blo dang 'du shes skyed sring byas/ de bas rtswa thang gi 'brog mi'i las dbang dang 'tsho ba'i 'gyur ldog kho tsho'i khor rkyang gi bsam blo'i 'du shes dang rtog 'dzing che ba'i brtse dung gi dra rgya bcas rang shugs kyis kho'i brtsams sgrung gi bsam blo'i nang don gtso bor gyur/ stag 'bum rgyal gyi brtsams sgrung gi khog 'bubs legs shing mi sems sgul thub pa'i dpe mtshon gnad don rnams — 83 —

'brel yod mi sna'i dga' skyo 'du 'bral gyi 'gal rkyen khrod rjen par bton yod/ brtse dung gis khengs ba'i skad chas nus shugs ci yod kyis mi sna'i sems khong gi 'jig rten phyir mngon par byed cing / rtag tu rang nyid kyi brtse dung dang mi sna gtso bo'i myong tshor mnyam gcig tu bsres yod pas/ kho'i ༵༵༵sa sgrung la yid sems sgul thub pa'i nus shugs chen po ldan par gyur brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom khrod/ stag 'bum rgyal gyi sgrung thung gsar rtsom la sngar byung ma myong ba'i lo legs shig byung / lhag par brtsams sgrung las bsam blo'i rang bzhin dang sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang ches 'bur du thon par mtshon yod/ dper na/ 〈〈gna' gzhas 〉〉dang / 〈〈sgo khri〉〉/ 〈〈sdug gi lo ma chang gis bangs pa min 〉〉sogs kyis kho'i 'tsho ba'i thad kyi shes bya sasar pa dang go rtogs gsar pa/ gdeng 'jog gsar pa bcas mtshon zhing / brtsams chos de dag gis rtswa thang gi 'brog mi'i las dbang dang dngos yod 'tsho ba brjod bya byas te/ spro sems khol ba'i ngang nas bod rigs mi dmangs kyi mchog tu gyur pa'i bsam blo dang bla na med pa'i kun spyod la bsngags brjod mdzad yod pa ma zad/ da dung dus rabs gsar pa'i mi rnams kyi las dbang dang srol rgyun bsam blo'i zlos gar rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ldog mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba bcas legs sgrig byas yod/ de dang mnyam du gang nus ci lcogs kyis 'tsho ba'i zur mi 'dra ba dang mi sna'i 'tsho ba'i snang tshul zhib 'bri byas pa brgyud nas bya dngos kyi ngo bo dang lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs/ mi sna gtso bo bcas mtshon pa dang / bod mi rigs kyi 'das zin pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i las dbang la bsam gzhigs btang yod/ brtsams chos 'di dag gi rgyu cha gdam gses byas pa legs par ma zad lta ba gsar pa yin la blo bkod phun sum tshogs/sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs kyi thad nas kyang bod rigs kyi ngag rgyun dang gtam — 84 —

rgyud kyi khyad chos rgyud 'dzin byas yod la/ rgyal khab phyi nang dang mi rigs bzhan pa'i phul byung rtsom rig gi legs cha sdud len dang / lhag par spobs pa chen pos deng rabs ring lugs pa'i brtsams sgrung bsar rtsom gyi mtshon thabs sang legs spyad yod/sgrung ring 〈〈snying 'jags kyi rtswa thang 〉〉zhes bya ba 'di ni de sngon 〈〈sgrang char 〉〉dus deb tu mu 'god byas shing bya dga' thob myong ba'i 〈〈rnam shes 〉〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung de'i rmang gzhi'i steng rgya che'i klog pa po'i re ba ltar bzo bcos dang kha snon byas pa yin pas/ nang don sngar las rgya che zhing phun sum tshogs pa dang yig grangs kyi cha nas sngar las ldab gnyis tsam gyis je mang du gyur/ sgrung ring 'di mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab btsugs nas lo 'khor lnga bcu lon par legs skyes su phul ba'i dpe tshogs su bdams shing dpe skrun byas/〈〈snying 'jags kyi rtswa thang 〉〉zhes pa ni krung go gsar pa dbu brnyes tshun mtsho sngon zhing chen du thad kur bod yig gis brtsams pa'i sgrung ring thog ma yin pas/ nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring mtsho sngon gyi bod kyi rtsom stegs steng blangs pa'i grub 'bras chen po zhig red ces brjod chog brtsams sgrung 'di'i gtam rgyud ni lo rabs bdun bcu pa dang brgyad cu pa'i skabs bod rigs 'brog khul du byung ba zhig red/ mi sna gtso bo dbang ldan rdo rje zhes pa'i na gzhon der g.yon phyogs pa'i gnod 'tshe thebs pas/ khos rang yul rgyab tu bskyur nas gzhan yul 'grims dgos pa byung / sa mtha'i yul gru kun tu khos ma rtsa nyung ba'i khe tshong re rgyag pa nas 'go brtsams te dka' spyad 'bad brtson byas mthar rim gyis ma dngul cung tsam bsags/ tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su 'brog khul gyi rnam par 'gyur ldog chen po byung bas/ kho'i kher rkyang gi 'tsho ba mjug sgril — 85 —

nas slar yang rang yul du log ste/ pha yul mi dmangs kyi ched du mi rabs du mar bkag rgyas bcings pa'i rtswa thang la tshong zog dpal 'byor gyi dpyid rlung lding du 'jug rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ kho rang pha yul du los rjes/ khos rang gi ma dngul gyis tshong khang dang slob grwa sogs btsugs te gzhan phan gyi bya ba bsgrubs pa ma zad/ sde ba'i 'go khrid de rgyal khab gzhan pa'i phyugs las sa khul la blta skor byed du song ste bsam blo dang nyams myong brje res byed du bcug skabs der dbang ldan rdo rje dang kho'i chung dus kyi rtsed grogs/ da lta slob chung gi dge rgan byas yod pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo gnyis kyi bar la brtse dung zab mo chags/ 'on kyang / kho gnyis kyi rnam dag gi brtse dung der srol rgyun stobs shugs dang sa de'i dbang che ba'i mi skor zhig gis bkag 'gog byas/ yin na'ang / na gzhon deganyis kyis btsan phyug gang gis kyang bslu mi thub la 'jigs zil bstan yang mgo mi skur ba'i spobs pa zhig bcangs te skyug bro ba'i rnam pa der mdung rtse kha sprod kyis 'thab rtsod byas/brtsams sgrung gis lo rabs bdun cu pa gtam rgyud kyi rgyab ljongs su bdams te/ lo bcu'i zing zing gis 'brog khul gyi rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i las dbang dang bsam blo'i snang tshul/ sems khong gi 'jig rten la bzhag pa'i gting zab pa'i rma kha sogs ci nus kyis mtshon yod/ byung rim 'phel rgyas su song ba dang bstun nas/ rtsom pa pos tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes kyi 'brog khul gyi rnam pa de brjod bya gtso bor bzung ba dang / rtog 'dzing che ba'i 'brog khul gyi phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam pa zhib brjod byas te/ 'brog khul gyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ slob gso sogs kyi thad dga' 'os pa'i 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba dang / de dang mnyam du byung ba'i rnyog 'dzing che ba'i spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba sna tshogs mtshon par byas yod/ dus rabs dang — 86 —

khor yug mi 'dra ba'i nang gi dpe mtshon mi sna gsar bzhengs byas pa ma zad/mi sna'i rang gshis dang las dbang zhib tu bris pa brgyud nas dus rabs kyi 'gyur ldog dang zang zing gi spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa dang / gnyen sgrig rang dbang la bkag rgya sna tshogs bzos tshul gsal rjen du bton te/ gtam rgyud nang gi mi sna gtso bo dbang ldan rdo rje dang sgrol ma dkar mo gnyis kyi brtse dung rnam dag mtshon par byas yod/ mi sna gtso bo dbang ldan rdo rje'i skyid la sdug pa'i las dbang des thog mtha' bar gsum du klog pa po'i yid sems bkug cing / rnyog 'dzing che ba'i 'gal ba des brtsams sgrung gi bstan bya gson nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas mtshon yod/nga tsho'i mi rigs ni gna' nas bzung spyang grung ldan la dpa' ngar che zhing / bab chags shing las la brtson pa'i mi rigs shig yin pas brtsams bya'i nang du 'os 'tsham gyis mi rigs kyi yul srol goms gshis dang / bsam pa'i 'du shes/ rang byung khams bcas zhib 'bri byed pa des rtsom rig de mi rigs can du 'gyur ba dang / de dag gis mi rigs de'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam pa dang / mi rabs nas mi rabs su rgyun 'dzin byas pa'i yul srol goms gshis dang / de'i shul rgyun gyi rig gnas dang thun mong gi bsam blo'i khyer phyogs sogs mngon yod/ de'i thad la 〈〈nying 'jags kyi rtswa thang 〉〉du mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang / yul srol goms gshis/ mi rnams kyi bsam pa'i 'du shes dang brtse dung / bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig bcas mang po zhig bkod pas mtsho bod mtho sgang ni sna gru gar gyi rgya mtsho : yin zhes pa'i khyad chos gtso bo 'di 'bur du thon yod/ spyir mi rigs dang sa gnas kyi khyad chos zhes pa de mi rigs de'i khyad chos ldan pa'i skad cha dang glu/ kha mtshar bshad pa sogs la brten nas mtshon bzhin yod pa ltar/ sgrung ring 〈〈snying 'jags kyi rtswa thang 〉〉du'ang thog mar skad cha'i thog nas mtshon yod de/— 87 —

dper na/ dbang ldan rdo rjes mdang dbongagi rmi ltas ngan pa de bzlog ched 66khos mtha' 'khor nas ong ba 'thu shing su ru phon po zhig khyer yong nas bsang khri'i steng gi thal ba bdal nas steng du su ru bzhag de'i steng du ong ba blugs rjes rlung gi rgyu phyogs nas me bsgos pa na me lce 'ur rer mched byung /de nas khos rum nas 〈〈rgyal mtshan rtse mo 〉〉yi dar lcog de blangs nas dar shing zhig gi rtser btags/ skabs der bsang khri'i steng bi ong ba yang me bgos 'dug pas bsang khug las rtsam pa dang / 'bru/ shug pa/ ka ra/ sil tog 'dres ma'i bsang rtsi me 'gor blugs/ 'o ja'i shel dam zhig gi kha phye nas phyed tsam 6 tshir : sgra dang bcas bsang rtsi'i 'gor chab kyis mchod cing de'i 'phro ma steng phyogs su mchod zhor du bsang khrir skor ba byas te bsang mchod bton/mi zhes bris 'dug pa de bsang gtong myong ba zhig phar zhog tha na mthong yang ma myong ba'i bod skad go tsam gyi klog pa po zhig gis bltas na'ang yid la ri mo bzhin gsal ler shar 'ong thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni/ com pa po kho rang 'brog khul du skyes shing byed sgo de rigs la shin tu cha rgyus yod pa'i khar brtsams sgrung gi tshig la mkho med kyi spros pa spangs te gnad du khel zhing go bde ba'i ngag gis brjod pas sgyu rtsal gyi grub 'bras de 'dra zhig blangs song ba red/sa gnas kyi khyad chos ni rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom gyi rang gshis dang gdangs dbyangs grub byed kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo zhig yin/ rna byang du song yod pa'i skad cha dang mig byang du song yod pa'i mdzes ljongs dag gis brtse dung gting zab tu gtong bar bsam yul 'das pa'i phan nus 'don thub ste/ mi sna gtso bo dbang ldan rdo rje dang sgrol ma dkar mo sogs kyi tshab byed rang bzhin gyi bya byed dang tshab byed rang bzhin kyi skad rnams bltas ma thag tu rang ga ba'i skad cha zhig yin pa 'dodaga'ang / zhib tu brtag tshe mi sna'i — 88 —
