sems khams dang /gshis ku'i khyad chos bcas bla lhag gis mtshon yod/drug pa/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈rkyal ba'i 'jig rten du nyul ba'i gtam rgyud〉〉/rdo rje mkhar (1958wa )ni reb song smad pa phyogs kyi nag rgyal sde bar skyes/ 1980lo nas rtsom yig spel 'go brtsams pa dang / da lta'i bar brtsams sgrung dang snyan ngag cig rtsom/ dpyad rtsom/ mgur glu bcas khyon bsdoms brtsams chos sum brgyar nye ba tsam bris pa bod khul gyi dus deb so so'i steng bkod pa dang / nyis stong gcig gi lor khong dang gleng mol byed skabs/ khos 6 sngar bdag gis brtsams sgrung dang / lhug rtsom sum brgyar nye ba tsam bod kyi dus deb dang tshags par gyi steng du bkod kyang / deng sang rtsom yig mang po zhig gi kha byang brjed 'dug 9 zer/ gang ltar rtsom pa po 'di bas mi tshe'i bshul lam 'grim pa'i skabs su gangs ri'i khrod du rkang rjes shig 'jog pa'i las la rab tu brtson zhing / 〈〈snyan ngag byis pa'i 'jug sgo 〉〉dang /〈〈gab tshig gsar bsgrigs〉〉/ 〈〈rnam shes kyi dgod sgra〉〉/ 〈〈rgyal ba'i 'jig rten du nyul ba'i gtam rgyud〉〉/ 〈〈mgon po bkra shis kyi snyan ngag phyogs bsgrigs 〉〉('gyur yig )sogs deb bdun dpe skrun byas nas rgyal yongs kyi sa gnas khag tu bkram/ kho'i brtsams sgrung 〈〈gnyen don 〉〉dang / snyan ngag 〈〈mchu nag khu ta〉〉/ 〈〈snying gtam〉〉/ 〈〈gser gyi gdu bu 〉〉sogs la ljongs dang zhing chen rim pa'i bya dga' thob/rgyal khab phyi nang gi deng rabs rtsom rig las rgyun du mi rigs rig gnas lo rgyus kyi khungs dang rtsa ba 'tshol snyeg byed bzhin yod/ rtsom mkhan rdo rje mkhar gyis skar mda' bzhin rgyang ring du bzhud zin pa'i lo zla de dag phyir dran dang / lo rgyus steng gi dpa' bo'i mi sna de tsho'i steng du mi rigs kyi ma — 89 —

'ongs pa'i re ba gsar pa bcol te brtsams sgrung thung 'bring ring gsum brtsams pa des nyin re bzhin 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i bod kyi rtsom rig gi brjod bya'i nang don phun sum tshogs pa dang nyams 'gyur ldan par byas/rtsom mkhan nyid kyis sna sgrung ring 'di ni klog pa ngo rnams la legs nyes kyi dbye ba 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod dang / dka' ngal gyis nyams par mi nus pa'i snying stobs/ spang blang la 'khrul ba med pa'i thabs shes/ blo rig si sgo mo 'byed pa'i shes bya sogs blo'i rgyan du ster thub pa zhig min na yang / klog mkhan rnams kyis sgrung ring 'di'i nang nas la rgya'i me tog dang / spyi sems kyi dri zhim/ yab mes kyi zhabs rjes sogs rnyed thub :ces gsungs pa ltar/〈〈rkyal ba'i 'jig rten du nyul ba'i gtam rgyud 〉〉gtso byas pa'i brtsams sgrung gzhan pa rnams las/ gting zab kyi sgo nas rgya mtsho dang nam mkha' ltar gting mtha' bral ba'i bod kyi rig gnas nang dus yun ring por bsags shing rgyun bskyangs pa'i mi rigs kyi gshis ka mtshon thub pa dang / mi rigs 'di'i lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i ring sga tshe srog gi bden pa'i ngo bo bri thub pa ni/gtso bo rtsom mkhan gyis mi rigs 'dir myong tshor dang shes rtogs byas pa dang / dus dang rnam pa kun tu kho tsho'i bde sdug gi 'tsho ba rang steng du blangs pa la )pa rshaX/ rdo rje mkhar ni bod kyi rig gnas dang lo rgyus la mkhas shing rtsom mkhan grags can zhig yin pa las gzhan/ kho'i khrag rtsa'i nang rgyud bzang bod kyi zungs khrag tsha mo'i rgyun de ma nyams par rgyu bas na/ dus nam dang yul gang du gnas rung kho'i gsar rtsom gyi bsam blo'i zhabs zung kha ba'i khrod du 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i gshin sar btsugs nas/ yul de'i nam mkha' dang sa gzhi/ rang byung khams kyi mdzes sdug de bzhin du khar ma ṇi chag med 'don pa dang / lag pas ma ṇi 'khor lo bar — 90 —

med bskor ba'i bod mi rnams kyis gzhan phan dang byams sems kyi 'dzum bag nam yang gdong la bskyil 'dug pa sogs la mnyam snang 'jog pa ma zad/ bsam gzhig gi chibs rta'i srab kha 'das pa'i phyogs su sgyur ba de bas kyang gtsigs chen du bsam bzhin yod/sgrung ring 〈〈rkyal ba'i 'jig rten du nyul ba'i gtam rgyud 〉〉ni gangs can bod kyi rig gnas dang lo rgyus/ lhag par nga tsho'i yab mes rnams kyi ring byung ba'i don rkyen dang bya 'gul/ lo rgyus kyi mi sna so so'i snang brnyan rnams gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang byung rim 'phel rgyas kyi phreng thag la brgyus yod pas na bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus 'phel tshul gyi rags bris sgrom gzhi zhig tu brjod kyang thal mi che bar snyam/ rtsom mkhan gyis mtshon don gting zab pa'i mi sna gangs phrug ces pa zhig gsar bzhengs byas pa dang / de stod dbus gtsang nas smad mdo khams bar gyi yul phyogs gang la'ang bslebs myong ba dang / bod rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po nas dga' ldan pho brang bar gyi lo rgyus mi sna su dang gang la'ang zhal mjal myong zhing / mtho dma' bar gsum kun dang 'grogs pa bris nas sngar dang da lta'i spyi tshogs steng gi ngan shugs la rnag thog khab gtsag gis 'phya smod byas yod de/ 6 de nas rgyal dbang dang bu gangs phrug gnyis kyis mi rnams khang par bsus te ston mo bshams shing /zhabs bro rtsen/ gar 'khrab/ glu blangs/ rol mo dkrol ba la sogs pas sdun bsus te thams cad rtse bar byed/ dga' bar byed dga' ba'i gtam kun gleng bar byed/ tshogs thog der gangs phrug gis bdud rgyal ha la mgo dgu dbang du bsgyur pa'i srin po'i grong khrer gang du yod pa'i gnas tshul thos par gyur cing / nam phyed kyi bar du rtsed 'jo rnam pa sna tshogs la rol ba dang /mthar mi rnams kyis bu gangs phrug gi mdun sar rin po che'i skyes mang po ri rab ltar srungs kyang gcig kyang ma blangs par phyir bdag po rnams la sprad — 91 —

mi pa dag bris te rtsom mkhan gyis spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang gi mi rnams gangs phrug lta bu yin na ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam blo 8 gal srid bu gangs phrug ni da lta'i 'go khrid pa dang sprul sku zhig yin na mang tshogs mtha' dag gis bsngags pa brjod pa'i gzhi nyid du 'gyur bar nges shing / gal te spyod lam gtsang mas 'tsho ba'i mi zhig yin na skyes bu rgan gzhon kun gyis mngon lkog gnyis nas bstod pa gor ma chag yin na'ang mi yul gyi gnas tshul de nyid 'grul khang 'dir 'tshogs pa'i mi rnams kyis ma rtogs par phan tshun la gyes phyag phul nas rang rang gi shag tu 'gro bar brtsams so/ /:zhes pa las nga tshos rtsom pa po nas rmi lam gyi 'bri thabs spyad de rkyal ba'i 'jig rten zhig bris na'ang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dngos de mtshon gyi yod pa rtogs thub/brtsams chos kyi 'gor zu khyod kyis rmi lam rmis shing / ngas kyang rmi lam rmis pa dang / rmi lam ni spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul ci rigs rkyen sna tshogs pa'i stobs la brten nas byung ba'i 'phrul snang zhig yin par grags kyang / de ni 'phrul ba'i snang ba kho na tsam min par mngon sum 'tsho ba klad pa'i nang du ji ma ji bzhin du shar bar brten nas byung ba yin zer ba bden nam/ gal srid bden na bu gangs phrug gi rmi lam de yang 'ja' tshon ltar 'dzin rgyu ci yang med pa'i stong ba zhig min pa lta bu zhig tu snang ngo / /:zhes pa ltar/ brtsams sgrung du rang bzo ma yin par dngos gnas rmi lam rmis pa'i 'du shes shig skye srid pa ni rtsom pa pos rmi lam gyi thabs spyad nas sgyu rtsal snang brnyan zhig gsar skrun byas pas red snyam/ gang yin zhe na/ bod kyi rtogs brjod dang rnam thar/ gna' rabs brtsams sgrung sogs na rmi lam la gtogs pa'i byung rim yod na'ang / gtam rgyud hril po rmi lam gyi tshul du bris pa ni brtsams sgrung 'di ma gtogs pa'i sgrung ring ni da lta'i bar mthong ma thub pas so/ /des na rmi lam gyi 'bri thabs spyod dgos don ni brtsams sgrung gi — 92 —

brjod bya la rag las pa ste/ bod mi rigs kyi 'das ma 'ongs da lta gsum gyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba mtshon dgos na bu gangs phrug lta bu yul dus las thod rgal byed thub pa'i phugs bsam nang gi mi sna zhig la brten dgos/brtsams chos nang 8 sngon chad bod mi ni rjes lus dang dmu rgod/ rig gnas dang tshan rig mi slob/ nang la rtsub kyang phyi la 'jam/ phrag dog che zhing blang dor la rmongs/ ces yid pham pa'i tshul gyis/ deng sang tshan rig dar ba'i rtse mor son pa'i mi rigs shig tu re zhing snyeg pa'i 'dod blo sba gsang med par bstan pa dang / re ba'i zhing khams su gnas pa'i mi rigs de lta bu phyogs yongs nas stobs dang ldan pa/ ya rabs tshul mthun zhig tu 'gyur dgos na/ thog mar khyod rang bod mi zhig yin sa nas bod mi rigs la sha tsha ba dang snying nye ba byed pa las mi rigs rig gnas dang srol rgyun bzang po 'dor mi nyan par rgyun 'dzin bya dgos zhes bstan pa dag ni brtsams sgrung 'di'i 'bri bya'i nang don gtso bor gyur 'dug ste/ bgres po des tha mag cig 'then gyin yod pa yin nam ci/ bzhin ras kyi thad drang na 'khor zhing g.yo ba du ba'i phung bo chung ngu zhig yin zhing / khos lag pa g.yug g.yug byed bzhin du phung bo par 'ded tshur 'ded byed par brtson bzhin na re/lha we/ pha yul mi skyid dam/mi sna pha yul skyid kyang mi rnams tha shal ba rkyang rkyang red/’//mi rnags ji ltar tha shal ba yin nam/’66de dag mi ma red/ khyi rgan rgya le red mices bgres pos zhe sdang dang bcas te smras pa nang bzhin/ sgrung ring 'di'i brjod bya'i snying po yang gong gi bsam blo 'di dang 'brel thabs med de gtso bo bod mi'i rnying zhen dang /'brog pa'i sa rtsod nang dme/ dpon ngan gyi rul sungs bcas la dgag rgyag — 93 —

dang / zur za byas pa 'dis/ gcig nas phyi rabs pa dag la bod kyi lo rgyus steng byung ba'i don dag yag btsog tshang mar rgyus lon byas te ma 'ongs par bsam gzhigs gtong dgos pa'i re ba bton pa dang / gnyis nas gna' deng gnyis su byung ba'i ngan spyod dang bag 'khums kyi bsam blor kha rdung byas te rmongs sad kyi dril brda btang /spyir btang du brtsams sgrung gi mgo mjug bar gsum du mi sna'i 'gal ba sna tshogs zhib 'bri byed dgos shing / mi sna'i rang bzhin 'phyor 'bri byed pa ni brtsams sgrung gi 'os 'gan dang po yin/ de yang brtsams sgrung ni snyan ngag dang 'dra bar yul dus kyi tshad bkag med de/ sgrung ring 〈〈rkyal ba'i 'jig rten du nyul ba'i gtam rgyud 〉〉mi sna gtso bo gangs phrug gis lo rgyus kyi dus skabs so so'i srid phyogs kyi rgyal po dang bka' blon sogs dang / chos phyogs kyi bla sprul sogs la zhal mjal gnang ba'i byung rim gyis gsal bar mtshon thub cing / 6 phyi dro'i dus la bab kyang a lags dbal mang tshang dang / nang chen khag gi bla ma dang / stod sog gi mi rnams dang bcas pa phyag mdzod zha ra khrid 'ong bar sgug 'dug mi ces pa dang / tsa zhogs pa'i nyi zer gyi 'og tu rdo las brtsigs pa'i pho brang bkod pa shin tu mdzes pa zhig mchis shing / de'i ming la pho brang phying ba stag rtse zer ba dang / rgyang nas bltas na de ni brtsigs pa mi 'dra rang bzhin gyis skyes pa lta bur snang / pho brang de'i 'dabs su mi brel rta brel 'tshub be/ rta brel sga tshags hrug ge mi mang po 'dus te 'ong zhing /pho brang gi nang du khri dang 'bol lcog khrigs se yod cing / gung gdan/ stag gdan/ dom gdan/ spyang gdan/ grum gdan sogs ma bris ri mo 'khyug cing khra chem mer 'ja' tshon shar 'dra zhig bkod pa dang / rgyal po gri gum btsan po dang blon po rnams kyis rang rang 'os bab kyi gdan khri mnan te bzhugs pa sogs yul dus kyi thod chal che na'ang klog pa pos sems su rdzun dang — 94 —

shob red snyam nas lta mi 'dod pa'i bsam blo mi skye ba dang / de bzhin brtsams sgrung khrod kyi mi sna dang don rkyen rnams don dngos la tho gtugs mi dgos pa'i khyad chos gzhir bzhag ste/ rtsom pa po'iphun sum tshogs pa'i kun rtog dang blo bzo la brten nas nyams myong dang myong tshor mi 'dang ba kha gsab byas te/ phyogs sgo mo nas bu gangs phrug gis mtshon pa'i mi sna'i snang brnyan khag gson nyams ldan pa dang phun sum tshogs pa/ spyi tshogs kyi don snying ldan pa'i dpe gzhi zhig tu bris yod/mdor na/ rtsom mkhan gyis gsar rtsom byed pa'i brgyud rim khrod/ khong tshos 'tsho ba la lta stangs ji lta bu zhig 'dzin pa dang sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs ji 'dra zhig bed spyod byed rgyu'i thad la rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba re dang rtsa don mi 'dra ba re yod pas/ gsar rtsom thabs shes kyang mi 'dra ba red/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyis yod pa bskyar bzo'i kun rtog dang med pa gsar skrun gyi kun rtog gnyis zung 'brel byas shing gtso bo 'char yan ring lugs kyi 'bri thabs zlo /rten pas/ klog pa po su zhig gis bklags kyang mtshar snang mi skye ba mi bdun pa/ bkra bha dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa〉〉/bkra bha'am bkra shis tshe ring ( 1963wa ) ni mtsho sngon zhing chen gung ho rdzong du skyes/ lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i dus smad tsam nas bkra bhas gsar 'god pa'i las ka khyad par ba de la brten nas spyi tshogs 'tsho bar zab zhugs byas pa dang / khong gis rgyun par gzhi rim la bcar 'drir 'gro ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas bod rigs zhing 'brog gi 'tsho ba dngos la zhugs pa dang / rang 'gul gyis sa gnas so so'i yul srol goms gshis rgyus lon byed — 95 —

pa dang mang tshogs kyi bde sdug dang re 'dun la shes rtogs dang sems khur byas pas/ kho rang rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi lam la skul ba dang / lo bcu phrag gcig lhag gi ring la 'bad pa lhod med byas par brten/ khos snga bzhug tu sgrung ring 〈〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa 〉〉dang sgrung 'bring 〈〈ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha 〉〉sgrung thung 〈〈dngos grub rgya mtsho〉〉/ gzhan da dung lhug rtsom dang snyan ngag rtsom rig dpyad brjod/ sgyur rtsom bcas rtsom yig mang po zhig bod khul gyi rtsom rig dus deb dang tshags par steng bkod pa dang 〈〈sgrol ma nyer gcig 〉〉ces pa dpe skrun byas/1 〈〈sgrol ma nyer gcig 〉〉gi rab mdzes bkrag mdangs/rtsom mkhan bkra bhas gsar rtsom gyi smyug rtse nam yang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang btsugs 'dug pas khong gi brtsams chos skor zhig gis spyi tshogs khrod kyi nyes phyogs la ther 'don byas yod de/ dper na mu 'brel brtsams sgrung 〈〈sgrol ma nyer gcig 〉〉nang bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bsam blos bod rigs bud med kyi 'tsho ba dang re smon/ brtse dung sogs kyi thad la ya nga ba'i gnod 'tshe tshad med thebs pa de rtsom mkhan bkra bhas rtsom pa po zhig la khyad du mnga' zhing spyi tshogs 'tsho bar lta zhib byed pa'i spyan zung gis lag mthil gyi rdzas bzhin gsal por mthong yod la/ khos rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi thabs rtsal gsar pa zhig la brten nas brtsams pa'i mu 'brel brtsams sgrung yig brgya ma 〈〈sgrol ma nyer gcig 〉〉gi gsum pa 〈〈sems khong gi zug gzer 〉〉zhes pa las pho mchog mo dman gyi srol rgyun 'du shes dang goms srol rnying pa mkhregs 'dzin byed mkhan du gyur pa'i khyo gas 'tsho bar dga' zhen dang ma 'ongs par re bas khengs pa'i sgrol ma'i bcos min brtse dung gi me tog de blun rmongs dang khrims med/ rtsub spyod kyi ser bas bcom par byas pa la khong khro'i ngar skad sgrog bzhin ther 'don byas shing mi rabs rjes ma rnams la de — 96 —

lta bu'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba dang bod rigs bud med rnams kyi brtse dung gi me tog khyo ga'i gcar rdung gi sprin nag 'og nas yongs su thar te nam yang mtho sgang du bzhad pa'i smon lam btab pa red/dus skabs gsar pa'i bud med kyis dus rabs kyi gom 'gros dang bstun te rig gnas shes bya la brtson bzhin rang nyid kyi ma 'ongs pa dang phugs bsam gyi ched du 'bad brtson byed bzhin yod mod/ 'on kyang skye bo khag gcig gis bud med ni rang la g.yog byed mkhan dang bu bu mo skyong byed kyi yo byad tsam zhig tu brtsis pa las bud med kyi mdun lam dang ma 'ongs pa sogs la sems khur spu tsam yang mi byed/ 〈〈sgrol ma nyer gcig 〉〉ces pa'i brtsams chos nang gong gi gnas tshul de rigs la mtshang 'byin dang deng gi spyi tshogs su gnas pa'i pho mo'i go sa mi mnyam pa'i bsam blo rnying par kha rdung drag po btang / spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dang khyim tshang 'tsho ba'i khrod nas bud med kyi go gnas sngar bzhin dma' ba/ lhag par bud med rnams kyis rang la dbang ba'i go sa brtson len byed dgos pa'i bsam blo gsar pa de mtshon zhing / bsam blo gsar pa de ni dus rabs 'di'i bud med rnams kyi sems gting gi re smon yin/ bsam blo'i 'du shes rnying pa sngar bzhin gnas pa'i dus rabs 'di'i nang / de lta bu'i brjod bya'i bstan don la gting zab pa'i spyi tshogs don snying ldan pa red/de ltar rtsom mkhan bkra bhas brtsams pa'i mu 'brel brtsams sgrung yig brgya ma 〈〈sgrol ma nyer gcig 〉〉ni bod kyi rtsom rig dang lhag par dus skabs gsar pa'i brtsams sgrung lo rgyus steng gi mu 'brel brtsams sgrung yig brgya ma thog ma yin pas/ mu 'brel brtsams sgrung gi stong cha kha bskangs pa'i thad nas smras na'ang don snying gal chen ldan pa red/bkra bhas brjod bya bod rigs bud med yin pa'i brtsams chos kyi kha — 97 —

byang la 〈〈sgrol ma nyer gcig 〉〉tu btags par mtshon don nges can zhig yod de/ bcings 'grol byas rjes su/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros dang bstun nas bod rigs bud med kyi spyi tshogs go gnas la 'pho 'gyur chen po byung yod na'ang / mig sngar da dung rgya che'i zhing grong dang 'brog khul du 'tsho ba'i bud med gang mang zhig srol rgyun ltar khyim tshang gi las ka lci mo phrag tu blangs te bran g.yog lta bu'i 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod pas/ las ka lci zhing so gnas med pa ni kho mo tsho'i thun mong gi gnas bab cig red/ rtsom pa pos dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi snang tshul de rigs la bsam gzhig zhib mo btang bas/bod rigs bud med kyi las dbang la ngos zin zab mo byung ba/ 〈〈sgrol ma sa pha chang 〉〉zhes pa'i nang du a pa'i sems su 6 ra ma zog min pa dang bu mo mi min pas mi slob grwar 'gro ba ni nyes chad cig la brtsis te/ slob lo ran pa'i dus su slob grwar mi mngags thabs med dang / kho mo lo bcu bzhi la son skabs/ a pha chang gis bzi rjes 6 mna' bcad bza' zla gnyis gis zhu ba yang yang byas 9pa na/ khong gis ngo bzlog ma thub par gnas la byin pa sogs kātsho ba dngos kyi rtsam dri ma yal bar bris pa de dag gis gsal por mtshon da/ bod mi rgan gzhon kun gyis 'khor ba'i btson ra las sgol ba'i skyabs mthon du sems pa'i yi dam gyi lha mo sgrol ma la sku mdog dang theg mtshan nyer gcig yod par/ rtsom pa pos dngos yod kyi rig gnas snang tshul 'di gzhir bzung ste/ bod rigs bud med kyi las dbang gi phreng thag byas pa dang / dpe gzhir rung ba'i sgrol ma'i ming can gyi bud med nyer gcig gi las dbang gi gtam rgyud re re srad bu la brgyus pa na/ sgrol ma'i thugs rje'i skyabs 'og na 'tsho ba'i bod rigs bud med rnams kyi las dbang ni 'di 'dra zhig yin 'dug snyam pa'i tshor ba zhig skye ba dang chabs cig snying khong nas sdug bsngal — 98 —

dang skyo gdung gi zug gzer sna tshogs langs nges yin/zur za dang dgod bro'i rang bzhin ldan pa'i brtsams sgrung yig brgya ma 〈〈sgrol nyer gcig 〉〉dpe skrun byas pa des/ bod kyi brtsams sgrung gsar rtsom thad thun min gyi khyad chos dang mtshon thabs gsar pa'i rtsom srol zhig phye ba dang / 〈〈sgrol ma nyer gcig 〉〉gi rtsom pa pos krung phyi'i brtsams sgrung yig brgya ma'i legs cha bsdu len byas te/ tshig nyung zhing don 'dus pa/ skad cha nyung ngu'i sgo nas 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi spyod ngan lugs 'gal rnams gson nyams dod po'i ngang klog pa po'i mig lam du mngon par byas shing / mtshon thabs kyi thad nas zhib 'bri de tsam med par gtso bo skya 'bri'i thabs shes la brten nas gson nyams ldan pa'i gzugs brnyan gsar bzhengs byas pa red/2 gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i mi sna chung ngu'i las dbang /sgrung 'bring 〈〈ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha 〉〉zhes pa'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo rin chen rgyal kha'i mes po ni rgyal khams 'grims pa'i sprang po zhig yin la/ kho'i spo bos rang khyim gyi 'tsho stangs de bsgyur ched/ ldong ru dpon po la mgo btags te gtan 'dug byas mod/ kho mor za 'dod 'thung 'dod las las 'dod 'phag 'dod med pas/ sngar bzhin slong mo byas te 'tsho ba rol/ ra bha 'dre mig nar son rjes/ rang khyim gyi 'tsho ba rol stangs de yongs su bsgyur ched/ thog mar gzhan la ga yog byas te 'tsho ba rol bar 'bad mod/'on kyang khyim bdag gi mnar gcod la brten nas 'tsho ba rol stangs de rgyun 'khyongs byed ma thub pas/ rku yi las la mi zhugs thabs med byung / lhag par shis tshang tsho bar nang 'khrug byung rjes tsho ba kha thor tu song ba dang bstun nas/ ldong ru dpon pos rang gi mnga' khongs rgya bskyed pa dang a lags mkha' lding tshang gis rang gi lha sde je mang la gtong grabs byas/ skabs der/ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rgyal kha gnyis gas btsan mgon lag ring — 99 —

grogs la bkug ste shis tshang tsho ba'i tham ka brkus pa ma zad hūṃ nag me 'bar gyi rta khyu ded pa na/ hūṃ nag me 'bar khong khro langs te rtswa gzugs mngags/ kho gnyis kyis mkha' lding tshang gi bkod pa ltar rtswa gzugs phyir bzlog ste shis tshang dpon phrug tshe ring gi dmag sgar dang hūṃ nag me 'bar gyi chos sgar rdul du brlags pas/ bla dpon gnyis ku'i re ba ji bzhin du 'grub song ba dang ra bha 'dre mig la'ang brgya dpon gyi go sa thob mod/ ra bha 'dre mig ni 'tsho ba rol stangs gsar pa de la lobs yod pas sems khams la 'gyur ldog byung ba dang / lhag par rang la lus 'brel yod pa'i bu mo de rang gi pha gcig ma mi gcig pa'i sring mo yin pa shes rjes kho rang smyos nas rang mgo rang gis mi thon par gyur/ gtam rgyud 'dis de lta bu'i spyi tshogs nang rkun ma nam yang rkun ma sbyong bla dpon nam yang bla dpon yin pa'i lugs srol la dgag pa brgyab rtsomad pa/ pos sgrung thung dang sgrung 'bring rtsom skabs dmangs khrod gtam rgyud khrod kyi byung rim nang 'dren byed kyin yod de/ khong gis 〈〈ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha 〉〉blos bslangs byed skabs/ kho rang la cha rgyus yod pa'i dmangs khrod gtam rgyud khrod kyi rkun jag byed pa'i byung rim 'dra mtshungs rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa dang chabs cig bod yul du ge sar sgrung dar khyab che ba dang / ge sar gyi shul rdzas su grags pa'i ri chu dang lha khang /lab rtse sogs dang / de bzhin sngon gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams la yang srid ngos 'dzin rgyu yod pa'i gnas tshul dngos de dag la dmigs nas/ ge sar gyi sla nga dang shing khri rgyal po'i mda' shul/ dga' sde chos skyong ber nag gi sku skye sogs brtsams chos su nang 'dren byas pas/ brtsams sgrung gi byung rim de mi rigs rang gi sems khams dang mthun sbyor byed thub pa byung / 〈〈ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rgyal kha 〉〉nang dmangs khrod gtam rgyud kyi byung rim blangs — 100 —

pa cung mang na'ang / lhug brjod byed lugs thad brtsams sgrung gi rtsom gshis ma nyams pa'i cha rkyen 'og tu dmangs khrod rtsom rig gi mar dri dang rtsam dri de rgyun 'dzin byed gang thub byas yod/ dper na/ 8 da skabs/ stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyi mnga' 'bangs khrod du mgo na sde khrims dang tsho khrims med pa ni ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis kho na red mi ces brtsams chos kyi 'go bzung ste/ ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis ku'i khyim tshang gi gnas tshul dang spyi tshogs go gnas/ shis tshang tsho ba'i nang 'khrug stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar dang a lags mkha' lding tshang gi 'char bkod/ kho gnyis rku la chas pa'i go rim sogs 'phro rim 'phror mthud nas lhug brjod byas pa rnams chu chen gzhung na 'bab pa lta bu'i khyad chos ldan pa de gtso bo dmangs khrod gtam rgyud kyi khyad chos sdud len byas pas red/sgrung ring 〈〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa 〉〉las/ srin po g.yu rngog ni rang byung khams kyi mtshon byed dang / nyi ma lha sa ni chos lugs kyi mtshon byed red/ 'gro ba mi ni rang byung khams chen po'i bdag po dang de la sgyur bkod byed mkhan yin bzhin du rang byung khams la gzugs med kyi sems can re gnas par snyam ste/ de la bkur bste byed pa'ang rang sems kyi 'phrul snang la bkur bste byed pa kho na las ma 'das/ de las gzhan bod rigs ni dmangs yongs kyis chos lugs la dad pa byed pa'i mi rigs shig yin la/ mi mang po zhig gi dad pa ni chos gzhung la go ba legs po byung ba dang / nges pa don gyis 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la zhen pa log cing rigs drug kun la snying rje tshad med skyes pa'i mtha' 'bras shig gtan nas min/ kho tshos dad pa byed pa ni dmyal ba'i mnar gcod bsal ba dang phyi ma'i bde sdug bsam pa kho na tsam yin pas/ dad pa de ni bdag gces 'dzin gyi 'du shes 'dres pa'i dad pa zhig yin zhes brtsams chos kyis dngos shugs gang rung nas ston ci thub byas — 101 —

yod pa dang / mi rnams kyis bde sdug gi 'tsho ba'i brgyud lam ring mo ded de tshe srog gi mas mtha' la son pa'i skabs su/ 'chi ba'i 'jigs snang je cher song ba dang bstun nas/ tshe srog gi rin thang je chung la 'gro ba dang / dad pa'i stobs shugs je che nas je cher 'gro ba red/ 〈〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa 〉〉las/ stong dpon nyi ma rgas dus srin po g.yu rngog gi phrag dog la 'jigs pa med par lha sar 'gro ba ni sems khams kyi 'gyur ldog cig yin la/brtsams sgrung gis zur dang ngos du ma nas 'gyur ldog de phyir mngon pa dang /de bzhin du a ye sgrol ma dang a khu klu skyabs sogs dbus la 'gro ba'ang bod mi'i tshe srog gi rin thang lta ba des sems la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i mtshon rtags las ma 'das/ nga tshos sgrung ring 'di lta klog byas na/ bod mi'i dad pa'i stobs shugs dang tshe srog gi rin thang lta ba dag dpung du bsdebs nas klog mkhan gyi sems la gtse bar byed pa ma zad/ rdo pha bong chen po gnyis kyi bar la btsir ba'i snang ba ster ba'i brjod don zab mo de dag rim bzhin sems su myong thub pa yin/3 brtsams sgrung gi sgyu rtsal grub 'bras/lar brtsams sgrung legs po zhig 'bri na/ thog mar spyi khog legs po zhig 'bubs dgos la/ de nas spyi khog de la 'brel yod kyi byung rim sna tshogs 'os mthun gyis sbyor sgrig byas na/ rang gshis 'bur du thon pa'i mi sna'i snang brnyan gsar bzhengs byed thub pa ma zad/ brtsams chos kyi brjod don lhag lus med par mngon mtshon byed thub/rtsom mkhan bkra bhas 〈〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa 〉〉yi spyi khog bkod sgrig byed skabs/ brtsams chos kyi dad pa'i stobs shugs dang tshe srog gi rin thang lta ba de legs par mtshon ched/ mi rabs bzhi yi gtam rgyud ring mo de dum bu gnyis su bgos nas/ khungs sne zung ma'i brtsams sgrung gi spyi khog — 102 —

de gtan 'bebs byas rjes/ 'brel yod kyi byung rim sna tshogs 'os mthun gyis bkod sgrig byas pa na/ brtsams chos kyi 'tsho ba'i rngam kha je mthug la song ba dang / bsam blo ni rang tshugs thub cing gnad du khel ba zhig tu gyur/〈〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa 〉〉yi 'go khungs ni srin po g.yu rngog gi nye 'khor du dud khyim gnas med pa'i dus rim de la gtugs yod cing /skabs der yul de gar mi gnas mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gzhi bdag ma rungs ba de la phrag dog che ba dang / slob dpon padma 'byung gnas bod la ma phebs bar du de nyid 'dul ba'i dus la ma babs pas rang dgar bzhag pa dang 'brel ba dam po yod/ snang tshul 'di bod mi'i lo rgyus brgyud rim ring mo'i khrod du byung myong ba'am/ 'byung chog pa'am/ 'byung srid pa zhig yin med/de rang byung khor yug gi gnas lugs dngos dang gtan nas mi mthun/ bod mi rnams phyi'i snod kyi 'jig rten la 'jigs pa de ni rang sems rang nyid la 'jigs pa'i snang tshul zhig yin la/ skyabs mgon thun mong ma yin pa zhig gi mthu stobs la ma brten na/ nam yang rang byung khams kyi bran g.yog byed pa tsam du zad de/ de dbang du bsdus nas bed spyod byed pa'i 'du shes dang spobs pa zhan pa red/ mkha' lding chos kyi rdo rje tshang gis srin po g.yu rngog zhi ba'i thabs kyis chos 'og la btsud par byas pa dang / de'i yang srid mkha' lding chos dbyangs rdo rje tshang gi yon bdag dud khyim skor zhig khrid yong ste srin po g.yu rngog gi nye 'khor du gnas bcas pa na/ stod kyi 'khyam po dang /smad kyi sdom po/ dpon po'i khrims la 'gal ba'i nyes can/ tsho ba nang 'khrug slong ba'i gyod pa sogs snga gzhug tu sa 'dir yong nas zhes byung ba ltar gnas 'di nas 'dug sdod byed pa'i spobs pa skyes byung ba'ang rgyu mtshan de la thug yod/ 'on te/ kho tsho srin po g.yu rngog gi phrag dog la 'jigs te/ dbus la 'gro phod mkhan ha cang nyung / snang tshul 'di ni rang byung khams la mi las — 103 —

gzhan pa'i sems can zhig gis bdag po byas yod par yid ches te/ de la phog thug gtong ba'i spobs pa ma byung ba red/ a khu nyi ma dang a ye sgrol ma/a khu klu skyabs sogs snga rjes su lha sar 'gro phod pa ni dad pa'i mthu las byas pa yin la/ rtsom pa pos brtsams sgrung gi byung rim bkod sgrig byed skabs/rang byung khams kyi 'jigs snang dang dad pa'i stobs shugs dag srog shing byas te go rim ldan par bsgrigs yod/brgyad pa/ nag po skal bzang dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈klu 'bum mi rgod〉〉/nag po skal bzang (1955wa )ni mtsho sngon zhing chen rma lho khul reb gong rdzong gi glang rgya sde bar skyes/ dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i 'go tsam nas rtsom yig 'bri 'go brtsams pa dang / 〈〈bod kyi la gzhas rags gleng 〉〉gis mtshon pa'i dpyad rtsom 'ga' yang de dus spel ba yin/ bod kyi rtsom rig las brtsams sgrung ni lo rabs bdun cu pa nas bzung 'phel rgyas chen po zhig byung dang 'byung zhin yod na'ang / pho mo'i brtse dung dang lo rgyus/yang na mtshar gtam dang dgod gtam bskyed de sgrung thung 'bri ba las brtsams sgrung gzhan dag ha cang nyung ba'i gnas tshul mi legs pa de/ nag po skal bzang gis mthong thub pa sgos bod la'ang mi rigs gzhan dang mtshungs par btsams sgrung gi sgrung sna phun sum tshogs po zhig tu 'dzom dgos par dmigs te/ khos rang gi rnam dpyod kyi rtsal la brten nas bris pa'i 'dre bshad sgrung 'bring 〈〈thed sha langs pa'i mtshar gtam 〉〉dang / drag rtsal thad kyi sgrung ring 〈〈klu 'bum mi rgod〉〉/ deng rabs mtshon chas drag 'thab byed pa'i sgrung ring 〈〈dmyal zangs nang na ku re med 〉〉ces pa sogs kyis dpyod ldan pur thogs rnams la blo bskyed mi dman pa thob pa dang / de bzhin bod — 104 —

kyi rdom rig bang mdzod du sgyu rtsal gyi dkon nor mi nyung ba zhig kha snon byas pa kā/ma rig gi brtsams chos gang dang gang yin na'ang brjod bya rang rkya thub pa cang shes rta pho 'dra ba zhig dgos mod/ 'on kyang rta mchog de sgyu rtsal gyi sga srab kyis ma brgyan na khrom ra la khrid kyang lta mkhan ni med do/ /nag po skal bzang gis bris pa'i 〈〈klu 'bum mi rgod 〉〉ni brjod bya dang byung rim/ sgyu rtsal bcas kyi thad gang nas bltas na'ang klog pa po rnams kyi yid dbang 'phrog thub pa zhig yin te/ klu 'bum mi rgod kyi ngag rgyun ni dmangs khrod na dar khyab ha cang che la/ phal cher lha sgrung dang mtshungs shing bod kyi lo rgyus steng dngos su byung myong ba dang / drag rtsal gyi las la mchog tu byang ba'i mi sna gtso bo ru 'bri bzhengs byas yod/ rtsom mkhan gyis mi sna 'di dkar phyogs drang bden skyong mkhan dang / nag phyogs ma rungs ba tshar gcod byed mkhan gyi dpa' bo blo rig dang drag rtsal la mkhas pa zhig tu bris 'dug klu 'bum mi rgod dwa phrug tu lus pa dang / dwa phrug nas 'tshar longs byung ba/ de nas stod nyi ma lha sar song ba/ lha sa nas rgya gar dang bal yul/ rgya nag sogs sa cha la song ba'i khungs sne de ded nas gtam rgyud kyi byung rim bkram pa na bod gna' rabs kyi yul srol goms 'dris dang mdo dbus mtho sgang gi mdzes ljongs sogs glog brnyan ji bzhin lta mkhan gyi mig lam du drangs pa dang mnyam du/ dge ba'i las ni dge bas skyongs/ /sdig pa'i las na sdig pas chod/ /ces pa'i lta ba ltar klu 'bum mi rgod ni nam yin yang rgya che ba'i mi dmangs kyi phyogs nas ka langs langs byas te/ mi dmangs la gnod 'tshe gtong mkhan thams cad gcig kyang ma lus par tshar gcod byed pa'i mi rigs kyi dpa' bo zhig yin pas/ khos bsgral ba'i a lnga dang gzugs med skya thub/ rgyal mo sems skyid sgrol ma/ dha twa dzo/ thung he sogs la mtshon na sdig gi — 105 —

kha ma gang ba gcig kyang med/dpa' bo yin yang sha khrag las grub pa'i mi gson po yin par brten/rtsom pa pos pir rtse nas bu mo gnyis kyis klu 'bum blor babs pa bris yod mod/ 'on kyang de ni g.yag sna khu tshur dang btsan sgrig ma yin par mi gshis dang spyi tshogs dngos la mthun pa zhig red/ klu 'bum ni rta rig rig gi 'phongs la zhon pa dang / mo rig rig gi ske la 'khyud pa zhig gtan nas ma yin par zhe 'jig rten snang ba'i dungs sems ni kun da bzang mo la phar phul tshur phul byas nas chu dang 'o ma bzhin du 'dres yod na'ang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi spyi tshogs des sha steng gi pags pa gson bshus dang mdzub mgo'i sen mo gson bkog byas te klu 'bum dang kun da bzang mo gnyis btsan gyis kha bkar ba red/ skyo ba'i zlos gar gyi sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs la brten nas 'jug bsdus pa des bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs kyi 'phyor lwa thams cad re re bzhin bshus te mche ba gtsigs te mi sha la rngam pa'i kha ngo sogs gsal lhang nger dmar rjen du bton yod par ma zad/ sgyu rtsal gyi brjid nyams kyang 'bur du thon yod pa red/rtsom pa pos brtsams sgrung du gna' rabs bod kyi drag rtsal dang de'i rnam grangs sogs kyang bris yod pa las/ rang re'i gangs can pa la'ang drag rtsal yod pa ma zad/ sngon chad shin tu dar che ba'ang rtogs thub pa dang / phyis su nang pa'i chos lugs dar bas de'i phyogs la dang dod de tsam mi byed pa sogs kyi rkyen gyis rim bzhin nyams dmas su gyur/ yin na'ang dmangs khrod dang grub mtha' 'ga' rer gsang stabs kyis gnas shing mi rabs nas mi sdubs bar brgyud sprod byed bzhin yod pa deng sang yang phal cher de ltar na/ spyir drag rtsal gyi dawang ba gtum pos phas kyi rgol ba mtha' dag zil — 106 ge

gyis gnon par 'gran pa'i do zla kun nas bral ba dang / gnyom chung mtha' nas skyong bar byed pa la ri dwags kyi rgyal po gdong lnga pa dang yang dag mtshungs pa'i bden srong dpa' po'i byung ba brjod pa'i brtsams chos gzhan med pa ma yin te/ 'jig rten na ches ring bo'i sgrung rabs chen mo 〈〈ge sar sgrung 〉〉lta bu yin/ yin na'ang snyan ngag tshigs bcad ma'i rnam par brten pa ma yin la/ brtsams sgrung rkyang ba'i rnam par zhugs shing bden pa'i gser zhags ring rkyong dang / snang ba'i dgra la kher mchong / gnyom chung dmigs med brtse bas skyong ba'i dpa' rgod mtshon pa'i brtsams chos la 〈〈klu 'bum mi rgod 〉〉dang por bgrangs na gzur gnas pa su zhig som nyi'i dra bar 'gro/dpa' yang dpa' la stobs kyang che ba/ bden gyi gzhung shing ring du srong ba/gnyom chung gi dpung gnyen du 'greng ba/ spyir btang gi mis do zla mi 'ong ba zhig yod 'dug pa ni lo rgyus mi sna klu 'bum mi thod kyi byung ba dngos yin shos che/ de ni 'ud chen pos brjod pa'i dmangs khrod gtam rgyud kyi sa bon kyang los yin snyam pa zhig blo la 'gog med du 'char/blo la shong dka' zhing lha sgrung gi brjod tshul yongs su 'dres pa'i gtam rgyud de gong smos sa bon de'i rmang gzhi'i thog mi rnams kyi mgrin tshab tu langs pa'i dmangs khrod ngag rgyun mthud pa po rnams kyis bskrun cing mthun pa yin par yang the tshom med/ glang chen du mar gsil nas bkal kyang theg min mi shes pa'i 'bras srungs rgyab ri'i ngos kyi pha bong chen po de klu 'bum mi rgod kyi tshogs chen 'du khang gi sgo chen gcod spyad yin pa dang / des bcad pa'i tshe grwa mang phyi la ma thar kyang bsam blo mi thongs rgya thongs brgyud nas 'phur 'ongs pa'i brjod tshul sogs mi la 'byor ba'i bya spyod min pas lha sgrung gi brjod tshul 'jog rgyu las 'os med/ngag rgyun na gnas pa'i gtam rgyud de las mi rnams la btsan gnyom gyi — 107 —

dbye ba dang / dbul phyug gi khyad par/ rigs rus kyi mtho dma' zhig med na ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam tshul mtshon pa yin la/ de ni 'os mthun gyi 'dod tshul zhig dang / spyi tshogs lam lugs bzang pos mi rnams la rang gi bsam 'dun rnams phal cher skong thub pa'i bya ba zhig kyang red/ yin na'ang rin po che la mchog dman dang / gur gum sman la rab 'bring yod pa ji bzhin btsan gnyom dbul phyug mtho dma' sogs rtsa ba nas med par gtong rgyu ni rtsa ba nas 'grub pa zhig min te/ dngos po'i chos nyid bzlog rgyu ni yong mi srid pa'i phyir/ mi rnams kyis gtso 'dzin mi sna dang dpa' bo rnams la bcangs pa'i re ba de 'dra ni bab chags dang spyir btang ba'i 'dod tshul zhig yin/ chab srid bde 'jags dang / dpal 'byor gong 'phel/ mi dmangs mthun sgril bcas byung ba'i skabs su mi dmangs kyi 'os mthun re ba skong thub pas na/ mi rnams kyis klu 'bum mi rgod lta bu'i mi sna e 'byung la re ltos gtan nas byed mi dgos pa ni bde skyid cig yin/sgrung 'di'i rtsom pa pos bsam bkod phun sum tshogs pa la brten nas gtam rgyud kyi byung rim rnams tshar du dngar bar bsgrigs pa dang / le'u snga ma dag la bltas pa tsam gyis phyi ma dag la lta 'dod kyi 'dun pa 'gog thabs bral ba dang / mi sna'i las skal dang don gyi 'gag gnad la sems khur byas nas yid kyi khur por 'gyur pa/ skye stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i mi sna'i gzugs brnyan la bden drang gi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ mi sna'i gshis ka mngon gsal can rnams ni rang rang gi spyod pa dang ngag tshig smra brjod las mtshon par byas pa/ klu 'bum rang nyid kyi ming zur la mi rgod kyi 'bod stangs dor pa med kyang don du spyi la phan pa'i nor bu dang / dgra mgo 'joms pa'i tho ba dang / rang phyogs skyong ba'i dpung gnyen bcas yin pa'i drang phyogs dpa' bo zhig tu bzhengs skrun byas 'dug la/ sgyu rtsal nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa — 108 —

tsam la bslebs 'dug pa dang / dpa' bo dang ya rabs la kha mig yar lta byed dgos pa'i slob gso'i don snying gis phyug pa/ sdar ma dang ma rabs la sdig mdzub ston dgos pa'i ngar skul du 'gro ba/ bden pa dang mdzes pa la kun gyis yid smon 'cha' dgos pa/ rdzun phugs dang mi sdug pa gnyis brtol byed dang 'gog byed la bsam blo'i ral gri rno dbal ma nyams pa dgos tshul bcas dngos shugs brgyud ci rigs la mngon yod pa'ang klog pa po blo zhib mo can rnams kyis nyams su myong thub/ 'di dag ni brtsams sgrung 'di gtam rgyud de dang mi 'dra ba'i ngo bo'i 'byed chas yin par snyam/drag rtsal gyi thad nas klog pa po skor zhig la brtsams sgrung 'dis mi rigs gzhan gyi drag rtsal gyi khyad chos du ma zhig bod kyi steng la btsan sbyor byas 'dug snyam pa'i tshor ba bskyed kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ thog mar sgyu rtsal brtsams chos kyis gzhan la lad mo byas pa'i cha yod chog cing / gzhan gyi legs cha rang nyid kyi zur rgyan du 'dren chog pa'ang smos ma dgos/ drag shul gyi sbyor ba brtsams pa la drag rtsal med du mi rung la/ brtsams chos nang du'ang / 6 spyir bod la mtshon na pho rtsal sna dgu'am lus rtsal drug shes na dpa' rgod yin yang / nags khrod na shing tsan dan lta bu dang / mi khrod na mi ge sar lta bu yod srid pas/ khyod rang sun snang ma skyes par re re bzhin slobs zhes rnal smyon nas gus phyag 'bul bzhin pa'i klu 'bum la mu mthud du/ rtsal sna re re la zhib tu dbye na rnam grangs ha cang mang / mtshon cha la gtso bo mda' gri mdung gsum yin yang / zhib tu dbye na de'ang dgar rgyu mang / tha na gri gcig pu'i mtshon cha la sna kha bcu phrag 'ga' yod/ ces gsungs nas sngar bzhin du snga dro klu 'bum la gri g.yug tshul/ mda' 'phen tshul/ mdung sgyugs tshul sogs bslabs/mi 0 zhes pa dang / de yang drag shul gyi rtsal rigs 'di ni lus kyi nus stobs ches 'os 'tsham gyi bsgyur pa'i sgyu 'phrul — 109 —

zhig dang / drag po'i mtshon chas sgyur ba'i thabs rtsal ches legs pa zhig la bo rung bar snyam/ lo chig stong tsam la nye ba'i snga rol nas thun mong ma yin pa'i drag chas dang drag rtsal bod la dar yod pa 〈〈ge sar sgrung 〉〉las rjes su dpog thub/ dper na dga' sde'i skyogs rdo dang de'i 'dor rtsal dang / zha lu dkar po'i 'gu zi dang de'i g.yug rtsal dang / 'dan ma'i nyag phran dang de'i 'phen rtsal sogs lta bu ste/ de dag gzhan la bsdur na rnam pa 'dra sa yod kyang ngo bo dang khyad par so so yin/ gang ltar klog pa po rnams la spro ba 'phel byed dang / brtan pa 'phrog byed dang / snang ba sgyur byed du drag chas kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag dgol du bcug na yang rung ba nyid de/ de'i phyogs nas 〈〈klu 'bum mi rgod 〉〉kyi rtsom pa pos snying stobs chen pos bod dang mi rigs gzhan gyi gna' deng gi drag rtsal byed stangs sogs brtsams chos su bkod pa shin tu legs par ma zad/ rang gi rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dar spel dang gzhan pa'i bzang cha nang 'dren bcas byed pa'i thad don snying gal chen ldan pa red/dgu pa/ bstan pa yar rgyas dang kho'i sgrung ring 〈〈thag ring gi sgru nag〉〉bstan pa yar rgyas ni bod ljongs nag chu sa char skyes/ khong gis dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas bzung rtsom yig spel 'go brtsams pa dang / srol rgyun gyi bkag rgya las brgal nas gsar gtod kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i brtsams sgrung mi zhung ba zhig spel ba des bod kyi rtsom rig dar rgyas dang gong du spel bar legs skyes chen po phul yod/ 1995lor brtsams sgrung thung 'bring phyogs bsgrigs 〈〈byang thang gi mdzes ljongs 〉〉zhes pa dpe skrun byas pa dang / deb 'di'i nang gi sgrung thung 〈〈sde stod stag shar gzhon pa'i glu — 110 —

sgra 〉〉dang /〈〈stag nag〉〉/〈〈mgo ras kyis btums pa'i bu mo〉〉/ 〈〈chung po ral zing 〉〉dang / sgrung 'bring 〈〈tsu thang gi dbus nas gangs ri zhig 'phags 〉〉zhes pa sogs kyis klog pa po la bag chags gting zab bzhag pa ste/ tsa 〈〈mgo ras kyis btums pa'i bu mo 〉〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung de da lta 'brog khul gyi skye bo 'gas dmangs sgrung du brtsis te phan tshun bshad res byed bzhin yod/yang rdzong dang grong tsho la la'i 'go 'dzin gyis nam rgyun sna nga ni chung po ral zing las skyo bas dgongs pa zhu rgyu yin/ chung po ral zing ni thog mar las kha'i nus shugs zhan yang mes rgyal nang khul du slob sbyong byas nas 'jon thang che tsam chags 'dug nga ni de ltar mes rgyal nang khul du slob sbyong la 'gro ba'i re ba med pas ci nas kyang las gnas las dgongs pa gnang rogs zer ba sogs sems na khong gi brtsams sgrung de dag ni rang re'i 'brog khul gyi 'tsho ba dngos de tshad mtho'i sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas drangs pa zhig yin/ ⑪zhes pa ltar rtsom mkhan bstan pa yar rgyas kyis rgya che ba'i 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi bsam pa'i 'khyer so dang dga' kha gtad phyogs sogs mtshon phyir/mang tshogs kyi 'tsho bar zab zhugs dang nyams len/ kho tsho dang dga' sdug mnyam myong byed pa dang / 'brog pa rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i mdun lam la sems khur dang bsam gzhig byed par brten/ kho'i brtsams chos ni byang thang gi 'brog dmangs la mtshon na yid dbang 'phrog pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi nus pa ldan pa ma zad/ ma 'ongs pa'i lam bu'i steng dpa' ngar cher bskyed kyis mdun du bskyod par skul lcag tsha thag chod pa zhig kyang gzhus pa ni brtsams sgrung gi grub 'bras che shos shig red snyam/bstan pa yar rgyas kyi 〈〈khrag gi gzegs ma mkha' la 'phyo ba'i gangs ri dmar po 〉〉zhes pa'i sgrung ring gi dum bu 'ga' zhig 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉steng bkod myong zhing klog pa po dang zhal mjal byung ba red/ phyis su — 111 —

sgrung ring de 〈〈thag ring gi sbra nag 〉〉ces par ming bsgyur te mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa red/ brtsams sgrung 'di dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dus mjug nas dus rabs nyi shu'i dus 'go'i bar bod byang thang gi yul ga ge mo'i g.yang phyug ces pa'i tsho ba chung chung zhig gi zhi 'jam de sgrung nang gi mi sna gtso bo dbang chen la sogs kyis rtsa ba nas dkrogs pa ste bod dmag bcu gnyis bsad de me mda' bcu gnyis thob pa des sde tsho de'i zing zing dang 'khrug rtsod kyi 'go brtsams pa ste/ g.yang phyug dang thag mi ring bar gnas pa'i zla thang tsho ba'i btsan rgod kha sho zer ba des rang gi sring mo dbang chen gyi mna' mar gyur par zhe sdang gting nas langs te/ byang thang gi jag pa dang ngan 'brel byas te zho ltar chags pa'i g.yang phyug tsho ba de khrag ltar dkrugs shing / dga' skyid dpal gyis phyug pa'i g.yang phyug tsho ba ru dbang chen pha bu ma gtogs tshang ma lnga lam du btang ba dang / mthar dbang chen pha bu gnyis byang nas byang du bros byol byas pa de khungs sne byas te sde tsho de'i dar rgyad dang 'phel 'grib skor bkod 'dugalo rgyus kyi chu bo drag tu rgyugs pa'i rlabs phreng khrod du tsho ba'i bar mi gsod rta 'ded kyi gnas tshul mang po da lta'i bar rgyun ma chad pas/ byang 'brog tu/ zu khyi tshag tshag zug na sgo nas lta/ ki lhang lhang byung na dmag la 'gro zhes mi rta go 'grig dang gro rgyags rang grabs kyis dmag la 'gro ba'i gra sgrig ang gsar byed pa ma zad/ gnyen sgrig na pha bu yo gros/ dgra byung na rang blo kher gcod ces dmag brda thos ma thag tu rta snga zin phyi zin gcig shor gnyis shor gyis phreng ba lung chad pa ltar mchongs srol yod pas/ri gtam pha la mi 'dri/ gros ma la mi bsdur/ bla ma la mo lung mi zhu bar 'gro dgos pa ni skyes pa pho yi 'gan 'khri gal chen zhig tu brtsi ba dang dus rtag tu rang srog 'dor rgyu'i gra sgrig dang / skyes pho rab shi sa dmag dman mo rab rgas sa — 112 —

gnas zhes gzi brjid du brtsi ba'i srol rgyun gyi goms gshis dag rtsom gyi mgo mjug bar gsum du mthong thub ste/ rong pa sde gsar gyi sde dpon lha rgyal dang ya med spun brgyad kyi drag po'i dmar 'dzing dang / g.yang phyug tsho ba dang btsan rgyal kha sho jag tshogs bar gyi dmar 'dzing sogs kyis bod mi nang 'khrug gzan pa'i rtsub spyod kyi phyogs de mngon mtshon byas yod pa red/brtsams sgrung 'di'i mtshon don gyi cha nas spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs su bod kyi tsho khag so sos rang rang gi tsho ba'i mtshan snyan dang / lhag par sde 'go tsho 'go skyong mkhan dag gis rang gi khe dbang gi ched du mngon lkog ci rigs kyis phan tshun la btsan dbang bkol ba dang dmar gsod byed pa/ khrims med lugs 'gal gyi bya ba byed pa bcas la 'phya smod dang / rang dbang dang khrims yod/ byams sems dang snying rje/ bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba bcas la re smon byed pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs kyi byang 'brog gi mi'i bsam spyod dag mngon par mtshon yod pas skabs de'i spyi tshogs la cha rgyus yod pa'i mi rnams dang spyi tshogs zhib 'jug pa rnams kyi thugs la 'bab pa'i gsar rtsom yag shos shig red /gzhan yang rjod byed tshig gi cha nas/ 〈〈thag ring gi sbra nag 〉〉gis deng rabs klog pa po'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i rtsom thabs shig nged tsho'i bgo skal du gnang bar ma zad yul skad kyis bcings med pas deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom la skul lcag thebs shing / lo rgyus steng gi rang gzhan thun mong lha'i ༵la byung brtsams chos dang gnyis su med pa'i spyi tshogs kyi phan 'bras na bkā/mas sgrung gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos kyi dbang gis rgyun par yul skad dang lung skad bkol te tshad ldan min pa'i tshig sbyor 'byung mod/'on kyang 〈〈thag ring gi sbra nag 〉〉gi skad cha phal che ba mdo dbus khams — 113 —

gsum yongs kyis go zhing / gzhas tshig sogs 'ga' zhig la dbus skad sogs 'dres yod kyang gzhan gyis mi go ba med la snyan cha dod pa dang / sa gnas kyi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa'i khram glu dang dmangs gzhas khag ni tshig don gyi rgyan sna tshogs kyis phyug cing dga' skyo chags sdang gi nyams thon pas/ mkhas rmongs bar gsum gyis rang rang dang 'tshams pa'i bro ba myong rgyu yod/ dper na/ brtsams chos kyi nang du/ 6 bu khram pa nga la mgo sbra med/ /dgung a sngon khram pa'i mgo sbra red/ /bu khram pa nga la 'dug gdan med/ /sa dog mo khyam pa'i 'dug gdan red/ /bu khyam pa nga la dpung rogs med/ /bo'u khra ring khram pa'i dpung rogs red/ /bu khram pa nga la glo rta med/ /rkyang ga ma khram pa'i 'gro jogs red mices pa dang / sngon chad byang thang du khram pa mang po yod la khram glu ni byang 'brog khul du sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur 'dug khram pa'i khrod du 'ga' zhig ni 'go dpon btsan po'i bka' khrims srung bar ma 'dod pa dang / la la ni 'tsho ba dbul bas jag tu gyur pa dang yang kha shas ni gdod ma nas chags pa'i 'brog pa'i bskor bskyod kyi 'tsho ba dang ri dwags rngon pa'i khram la zhugs te dpa' rtags ston pa sogs 'byung khungs 'dra min sna tshogs yod kyang / khram pa ni 'brog mo rnams kyi lkog tu sems pa 'chor sa dang 'brog gzhon rnams kyi lad mo byed yul du gyur pas/ mtha' gcig tu khram pa zhes nag chen dang mi ngan la brtsi ba'i srol ni med/mdor na/ 〈〈thag ring gi sbra nag 〉〉ces pa'i sgrung ring 'di'i nang du byang 'brog gi dmangs srol dang dmangs gzhas mang po bkod yod pa dang /dmangs srol dang dmangs gzhas de dag la khor lug gangs ris bskor zhing khyon yangs pa'i rtswa thang du 'tsho ba skyel zhing phyi rol yul dang 'brel 'dris dkon pa'i yul dus las grub pa'i khyad chos 'bur du thon 'dug— 114 —

dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/(nye()'jam dpa la rgya mtsho'i 〈〈skal bzang me tog 〉〉zhis pa mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1982lor dpe sgrun byas pa las gsal/0yi〈〈si ta lin gyi gsung rtsom saces btus 〉〉zhes pa mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1976lor dpe skrun byas pa las gsal/()glang mdun dpal 'byor gyis phran la bskur ba'i rang nyid kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus //྅)/ bkra shis dpal ldan gyi 〈〈bdas dang bdag bi las skal dman pa'i mi sna dngaskad yig 〉〉byes pa 1998lo'i zla 5pa'i tshes 16nyin gyi 〈〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar chogārsha 〉waXng sdo/༵ lda/ na gyi 〈〈phyi nyin gyi gnam gshis de ring las yag pa yong nges 〉〉zhes pa1991lor si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa las sasal(/)bdud lha rgyal gyi 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa'i brtsams chos bdams bkod dbyi de dag gi bshad pa 〉〉zhes pa kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1998lor da sku/ /sna ༵ /sdu pa/sdu /sga 〈〈klu 'bum mi rgod 〉〉ces pa si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1997lor dpe skrun byas pa las gsal/(yinor bu bkra shis kyi ( 〈〈chu 〉〉zhes pa'i brtsams sgrung bklags pa'i myong tshor phran lja ༷ bye/ ༵/ 2003lo'i zla 8pa'i tshes 30nyin gyi 〈〈mtsho sngon bod yig sasar 'gyur 〉〉— 115 —

le'u gnyis pa/ bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngags bcad dang po/ sbyi bshad/rig gnas dar snga ba'i mi rigs shig la mtshon na/ snyan ngag ni mi rigs de'i blo gros rigs shig gi mtshon byed yin la/ blo gros de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis mi rigs de'i phyi rabs par lam ston dang / 'dzam gling mi rigs gzhan dag la'ang bla na med pa'i yid zas rigs shig bskrun pa yin zhes bshad chog phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na/ snyan ngag byung ba ni mi rigs de'i bsam blo'i gsar gtod cig dang / mi rigs de'i shes rig 'phel rgyas kyi gom stabs chen po zhig kyang yin/ bod mi rigs la dus yun ring po'i lo rgyus dang ngo mtshar ba'i rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod de/ snyan ngag mkhan po'i smyug rtse las thon pa'i brtsams chos phul du byung ba dang dmangs khrod rtsom rig grags can gang yin yang de ni rang rgyal lam 'dzam gling rtsom rig spyi'i skyed tshal dbus kyi bod kyi mdangs ris mtshon pa'i me tog ngo mtshar ba zhig red/dus rabs gsar pas lo rgyus gsar pa bskrun cing / rtsom rig gsar pa skyed pa chos nyid du grub yod pa ltar tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la slar yang skyes stobs kyi dpal thob pa'i dge mtshan nyams dga' ba zhig shar/ de yi mtshon rtags gtso bo ni de snga snyan grags med pa'i rang rigs na gzhon snyan ngag pa skor zhig char rjes kyi myu gu bzhin 'tshar longs byung ba dang / de dag gis rang gi skad dang — 116 —

yi ge la brten nas gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang snyan ngag gi lam nas dngos yod 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i gsar rtsom gyi lam zhig btod pa ma zad/ da dung rang nyid kyi gsar rtsom lag len dngos las mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad dang yi ge la brten nas gsar rtsom byed rgyu de ni bod kyi rtsom rig mi nyams gong du spel ba'i thabs lam nyag gcig yin pa ra sprod byas/ snyan ngag pa de dag gis dus rabs gsar pa'i bod mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba gsar pa dang bsam blo gsar pa/ rnam par dag cing drag tu 'phyo ba'i brtse dung / mi rigs kyi dus rabs kyi snying stobs dang re snyeg spyi tshogs ring lugs la bstod bsngags/ bcos bsgyur dang phyi phyogs su sgo 'byed pa'i lam phyogs rgyun 'khyongs/ de min mi rigs kyi goms srol bzang po dang chos lugs srid jus la sogs par rjes su yi rang byed pa'i deng dus kyi snyan ngag phul du byung ba mi nyung ba zhig brtsams shing /de dag las deng dus bod rigs mi dmangs kyi bsam pa'i brtse dung dang / spyi tshogs dang 'tsho ba gsar pa'i 'tshol snyeg ma 'ongs par bcangs pa'i phugs bsam bcas gsal por mtshon yod pas klog pa po rnams kyis dang len dang dga' bsu byed bzhin yod/dang po/ bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngag gi byung 'phel/bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngag gi byung 'phel brjod pa la dus rabs dang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas dang 'gyur ldog ni ha cang gal che ste/ rang rgyal la mtshon na tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su/ bsam blo bcings 'grol dang phyi phyogs la sgo 'byed kyi srid jus lag bstar byas pas/ dmangs yongs kyi bsam blo de goms srol rnying pa dang sna g.yon mthal che ba'i sgrog las thar te/ bsam pa'i blo sgo sngar las hur por song zhing / mig gis 'dzam gling la lta ba dang / sngon — 117 —

thon la lta ba/ 'byung 'gyur la lta ba'i 'du shes mngon par 'phel te rgyal yongs kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso byas pa'i las rigs so sor dpyid kyi dpal yon lta bu'i dge mtshan gsar pa zhig shar ba dang / dus mtshungs su rang re'i bod la mtshon na'ang rgyal yongs kyi gnas tshul ji bzhin bsam blo bcings 'grol dang sngon thon la rjes snyeg byed pa'i mi rigs do khur gyi bsam blo tshad mi 'dra ba'i ngang mthor 'degs byung / rgyu rkyen de lta bu zhig la brten nas srol rgyun rig gnas mtha' dag dang 'du shes gsar pa'i bar la 'gal ba dang phog thug byung ba/ som nyi 'chang ba/ yi mug cing blo pham pa/'tshol zhib byed pa sogs kyi dus skabs shig byung ba red/bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngag kyang 'di lta bu'i lo rgyus dang chab srid kyi rgyab ljongs 'og byung ba ma zad/ deng rabs snyan ngag pa'i bsam blo'i brtse dung mtshon stangs thad thun min gyi khyad chos mngon pa ni rtsom pa po so so'i sems khams la rag las te/ 66snyan ngag bya ba 'di snyan ngag mkhan po'i sems gting nas thon pa'i nying bcud yin pa las/ rang dgar byung ba'i mchil thegs yin mi srid/mi0ces pa ltar/ lha snyan ngag ni rtsom rig gi nang tshan zhig yin/ rtsom rig tu gyur tshad sems kyi rtsol ba la brten nas byung /gna' rabs kyi dga' snang dang sdug snang gi sems khams kyis deng rabs kyi dga' snang dang sdug snang gi sems khams kyi tshab byed mi thub/ deng rabs pa'i sems khams su deng rabs kyi dga' snang dang sdug snang gi gnas stangs sna tshogs kyis khengs yod/ de la de'i sems khams kyi khyad chos yod do/ /mi ②des na nga tshos brjod pa'i deng rabs snyan ngag thon pa'i sems khams ni da lta'i gnas stangs kyis thag bcad pa zhig yin/phyi phyogs su sgo phye ba dang bstun nas bod rigs spyi tshogs su'ang mi chos kun spyod dang / mdzes dpyod lta ba/ chos lugs 'du shes sogs srol rgyun gyi — 118 —

rin thang 'du shes thams cad dang yongs su 'gal ba'i tshul du mngon byung ba dang / na gzhon rtsom pa po mang po zhig snang tshul de las blo pham skyes shing khong khro langs pa dang / kho tshos sna mi rigs kyi la rgya dang mi dmangs kyi brtse dung snyan pa'i dbyangs su gyer ba'i las ni snyan ngag pa'i snying rtsa'i nus pa yin la/ skul slong byed yul dus rabs hril po'i bsam blo yin/mi duzhes snyam par ma zad/ sna snyan ngag ni las skal tshor snang byung ba'i bden rtags gsar pa zhig dang / bden rtags gsar pa de nyid rtogs pa'i dam tshig kyang yin/mi duzhes pa lus sems zung gis nyams su len zhing / 6 rnying zhen bag 'khums la ngo rgol gyis / sna da lta 'bad 'bungs hur brtson dgos / lha mi rigs la rgya ma shor cig mi sogs yid la brnag pa'i tshor 'du sna tshogs mdangs ma nyams shing dri ma yal bar thad kur brjod/ rtsom pa po'am snyan ngag mkhan la thun mong ma yin pa'i sdug bsngal zhig yod de/ de ni rang gi sems khams mtshon byed kyi smyu gu des rang gi sems khong gi khong khro'i me lce mar mnan nas ngo la rdzu bag gi 'dzum gnyer zhig bsdus te/ lkog za byed mkhan dang dbang shed 'tshong mkhan/ mgo skor gtong mkhan/ khrims med lugs med pa dag la bstod glu blangs te zur za dang mtshang 'byin ma byas na spyi tshogs kyis dang len mi byed pa de yin/ ngan pa khrims la sbyor mi thub kyang dmod tshig dang mtshang 'byin gyis sems khong gi sdug bsngal 'don thub pa de yang 'u thug gi bde skyid cig yin/ bod kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po rnams la mtshon na/ dus skabs 'di'i sems khong gi sdug bsngal ni phal cher bod kyi lo rgyus steng snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyis thengs dang por myong zhing brgyud pa'i bsam pa'i 'thab rtsod dza drag che ba zhig yin rgyu red snyam/de ltar snyan ngag ni rtsom mkhan gyi sems khams la rag las par the tshom skye mi dgos pa'i sgrub byed du da dung 〈〈snyan ngag gi bla srog bshad pa 〉〉lasakhya— 119 —

66snyan ngag ni mi'i rigs kyi sems gting nas thon pa'i gdangs dbyangs yin te/ ma yis byis par nu zho bsnun pa'i dus/ spro sems dbang med 'khol ba'i snyan glu len/ byis pa bde mor gnyid du yur ba'i tshe/ re ltos ngag glu snyan mos yid sems gso/ yar la bdud rtsi nying khu 'dren pa'i dus/ tshe ring bde skyid yong ba'i smon glu len/ gnyen grogs rgyang ring bgrod pa'i skyel ma la/dpa' snying 'dzum drug rgyas pa'i ngar glu len/ so nam zhing las gnyer bar skul ba la/ dung brda dwangs mos yid sems skul bar byed/ dga' ston steng ba'i rtse dga'i bzhad sgra yang / bde skyid 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i snyan ngag yin/khros 'khrugs rngam pa'i gad rgyangs sgrog pa'i tshe/ khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i snyan ngag 'byung / dga' bde snying nas 'gog med 'phyo ba'i dus/ 'jam mnyen yan lag gar la ngang gis rol/ skyo shas bsam pa dbang med skye ba'i dus/ gdung sems mig chu ngu 'bod ngag las 'byung / spro sems mtsho mo rab tu 'khol ba'i dus/ dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur lus kyi dgye skur 'byung /snyan ngag ni/ mi'i rigs kyi sems gting nas thon pa'i gdangs dbyangs shig ma yin nam/mi zhes pa dag las rtogs par bya'o/ /bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngag ni mkhas dbang dor zhi lags dang snyan ngag pa don grub rgyal sogs kyis mdzad pa'i 〈〈dpyid kyi bdag mo lha las babs pa 〉〉dang 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉sogs kyis mtshon par byed cing / snyan rtsom de dag 〈2sbrang char 〉〉sogs dus deb steng thog mar spel ba nas da bar lo ngo sum cur nye ba tsam las song med na'ang dus yun thung thung 'di ni thun mong ma yin pa'i 'tshol zhib kyi dus yun zhig dang dka' khag ldan pa'i dus yun zhig yin la/ dus yun thung thung gi 'phel rgyas go rim khrod/ bod rigs shes ldan mi sna rnams kyi lhag bsam rnam dag ngang skyed sring 'og deng rabs snyan ngag 'di gsar skyes kyi myu gu ji bzhin lang tsho'i rang stobs 'bar ba — 120 —

dang blo spobs mkha' la bsnyegs nas rang gi 'tsho gnas dang go gnas/ thob thang sogs bden dpang gsal po byas yod de/ lha snyan ngag ni nor 'dzin dga' ma'i bcud mngar las byung ba'i dri ldan me tog cig dang / gangs dkar chab rom las thon pa'i bdud rtsi bsil ma zhig sa'i go la'i khongs nas thon pa'i me phung zhig dang / 'od 'bar nyi gzhon sgeg mo'i zer ma zhig bcas yin par ma zad/ brtse dung gi sras mchog dang / brtse dung la phul ba'i nu zhi'ang yin/mi0zhes snyan ngag gsar pa'i brtsams chos khag la dga' bsu chen po thob pa dang / snyan ngag la dungs shing zhen pa'i rtsom pa po dag gis mi rang nyid kyi thob shor gleng ba dang / gcam bu'i tshig gi bstod pa/ snar ma'i mya ngan gyi mig chu 'don pa'i rtsom srol ngan pa'i zhwa mo rma klong ring mo'i gzhung la bskyur nas/ mi rigs kyi las skal dang dus rabs kyi 'os 'gan/ mi rabs gcig gi las dbang rang gi phrag la blangs nas brjod pas bsam blo rgya che ba dang yar thon gyi rang bzhin bla na mtho ba mtshon zhing / dus rabs gsar pa'i shes ldan rnams la 'bod skul dang skul lcag gi nus pa tshad med thon yod/gnyis pa/ tshigs bcad snyan ngag dang rang mos snyan ngagabod kyi rtsom rig las snyan ngag gi lus gang la mtshon na'ang rang steng nas cha tshang dang legs 'grub kyi phyogs su 'phel dgos pa ma zad/ de'i nus stobs dang srog zungs gnas ched nges par 'phel 'gyur byung dgos pa zhig yin/ nga tsho'i mtha' 'khor du mi skor zhig gis nam yang snyan ngag gi rtsom stangs gsar pa la rgyab skyor byed pa dang / de dang ldog phyogs su langs pa skor zhig gis nam yang srol rgyun gyi rtsom stangs rgyun 'dzin byed bzhin yod/yin na'ang gzhon skyes snyan ngag pa mang po zhig gi khrod du snyan ngag gi tshor ba rnon po can zhig yin na rang mos snyan ngag 'bri nges can yin par 'dod — 121 —

pa'i bsam blo dbyar gyi mtsho mo bzhin 'phel bzhin yod pas/ blo yul las 'bongs pa zhig la rtsom rgyun ring zhing snyan rtsom gyi gral 'bor sdod pa'i 〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉gi ring lugs 'di la/ da lta dar yun thung zhing rtsom rgyun spra rmang gzhi zhan pa'i rang mos snyan ngag 'dis 'gran 'dzugs kyin yod pa da/srol rgyun gyi rtsom thabs gtso bo tshigs su bcad pa'i snyan ngag ni gna' bo'i dus dang tha na gdod ma'i dus kyi ngag gi sgyu rtsal zhig ste/ de ni rig gnas thams cad kyi nang du rtsom rig 'go tshugs pa'i mtshon byed cig yin/a me'i ri kha'i rtsom lus smra ba de na rjo ya'i (ba'iba'i0107) 〈〈rtsom lus ring lugs gsar pa'i skor gleng ba 〉〉zhes pa'i nang du/ tshigs bcad ni nga tsho'i deng rabs kyi gnas skabs te/ snang tshul gyi dbye ba shin tu phra ba'i dus las ldog ste/ snyan ngag dang chos lugs/ lo rgyus/ rol dbyangs/ sgyu 'phrul bcas kyi bar la khyad par cher med pa'i dus la gtugs thub/ de dag tshang ma nyin rgyun gyi rjod ngag ma yin pa'i mdzad sgo dang cho ga'i rjod ngag ste/ dbyangs rta ldan la sngags kyi byed nus kyang ldan pa'i tshigs bcad du grub yod/ tshigs bcad ni rtsa ba'i cha nas yi ge ma dar sngon gyi ngag rtsal zhig yin la/ yi ge gsar gtod ma byas sngon la rjod ngag blo la 'dzin bde bar byed pa'i thabs lam zhig yin/ sbyangs stobs can gyi glu pa'am snyan ngag mkhan dag gis spyi tshogs shig gis rgyun nyar byed 'dod pa'i byung ba rnams dang bsam blo rnams te/dper na/ tsho ba'i lo rgyus dang sgyu 'phrul gyi cho ga lta bu rnams tshigs bcad du bsgrigs nas blo yi dran pa'i snod du 'jog pa yin/ yi ge ma byung ba'i sngon la/snyan ngag mkhan dang snyan ngag gnyis so sor 'byed mi thub cing / de gnyis ka kho tsho'i rig gzhung gi thun mong gi dran snang gi tshab mtshon yin/de bas tshigs bcad ni rna dbang dang 'brel ba'i ngag rtsal zhig yin/ de — 122 —

la bshad mkhan dang nyan mkhan gnyis dus gcig la 'dzoms pa dgos nges yin la/ phyogs de gnyis ka snyan ngag klog pa'i skabs skud pa'i skya ya ltar gcig tu 'brel yod/ tha na nye rabs kyi yi ge rten gzhir gyur pa'i rig gzhung gi nang du yang tshigs bcad kyis nam yang rjod ngag gi sgra gdangs de ches gal che ba'i gnas su brtsis yod/ tshig lhug ni sgra mi dbyung bar khu sim pos klog kyang rtsom de'i tshor ba cha tshang myong thub/ snyan ngag ni de las ldog ste/ snyan rtsom gang zhig gi tshor ba ma nyams par myong ched/ nges par sgra byung nas bklags te rna bas thos dgos pa dang / tha na blo la yang 'dzin dgos pa yin/ji srid rna bas nyan pa la bde ba de srid du ngag tu brjod pa la yang bde ba yin no/ /da lta'i bar du snyan ngag sbyong skabs blor 'dzin bde ba dang ngag tu rjod bde ba nam yang gtsigs su 'dzin no/ /srol rgyun gyi snyan ngag khrid thabs 'dis rtsom gyi brjod don gzhan rgyud la thad kur 'jug pa dang thun mong gis longs su spyod thub pa'i sgyu rtsal gtso gnad du 'dzin/ tshigs bcad snyan ngag la dga' ba'i mi 'bor je nyung du 'gro bzhin pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo zhig ni tshigs bcad snyan ngag gis rna shes kyi slob sbyong rtsis med du btang nas de'i tshab tu mchan dang mchan 'grel/ rtsom pa po'i skye khungs kyi mi rabs/ bla rgyud slob rgyud sogs bzhag pa las byung bar nges so//rang mos snyan ngag ni bltos bcas kyis deng rabs kyi ngag gi sgyu rtsal zhig yin zhing / yi ge'i gzugs su 'bebs pa ni de'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin/rang mos snyan ngag gis mnyan bya'i nyams 'gyur mi 'dor na yang / snyan ngag ngo ma yin na de 'dor mi thub te/ des de yi rjod ngag rnams shog bu'i steng la sgrig stangs 'dra min don du gnyer/ sngon ma'i snyan ngag dang mi 'dra bar rang mos snyan ngag mang che bas snyan ngag gi mig shes la mngon pa'i yi ge'i tshig mtshams la dang dod byed/ yongs grags su ches snga ba'i rang mos snyan ngag ni — 123 —

mgur glu'i rtsom stangs dang nye bar snang zhing / mgur glu de rigs do mnyam pa'i tshigs bcad kyi rgyun la mi gnas na yang tshig gi sdeb sbyor gyi rjes su 'brang bar byed/ snang tshul 'di rang mos snyan ngag 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉la mngon yod de/ snyan ngag gyer klog la cung mkhas pa zhig gis gyer cing klog na snyan rtsom 'di'i rna shes kyi sgra mtshams tshor thub min la the tshom gang yang med/rang mos snyan ngag nang du shog bu'i ngos kyi tshig gi sgrig dbyibs de mnyan bya sgra yi sgrig rim la dgos nges can yin pa mthong thub pas/ rang mos snyan ngag cig tshig lhug tu bkod bstar byas na de la 'gyur ba chen po thebs/ de'i tshig gi gcod mtshams rnams sngon ma'i skabs las gzhan zhig tu 'gyur/ tshigs bcad snyan ngag ni de las ldog ste de'i rtsa ba'i tshig gi gcod mtshams dang de'i do snyoms bcas rang sor gnas pa yin/de bas rang mos snyan ngag dang tshigs bcad snyan ngag gnyis la 'byung rkyen dang dar khyab/ dmigs yul bcas phyogs so so nas khyad par che stabs/srol rgyun gyi tshigs bcad snyan ngag gi rkang pa dag rang mos snyan ngag tu bstar ba ni/ deng rabs snyan ngag ces pa'i tshig ris kyi tshon mdangs la zhen mos byed pa tsam las don du de'i rang bzhin dang / khyad chos/ ngo bo/ zab gnad sogs kyi skor la phyi tshul tsam gyi go ba ma gtogs med pa'i rtags red/snyan ngag gsar pa yin min gyi dbye ba de tshig rkang rang mos yin min tsam gcig pus 'byed mi thub/ gtso bo snyan ngag la srog dbang gsar pa ste gang zag gi rgyud kyi sems khams gsar pa zhugs yod med la blta dgos/ srog dbang gsar pa zhugs ma thag tshig sbyor gsar pa yong ba'i nges pa med/ yin na'ang srog dbang gsar pa des ji tsam na tshig sbyor gsar pa 'byung ba'i sngon brda gtong ba yin/ rgyu mtshan ni/ srog dbang gi lus stobs rgyas na tshig sbyor gyi phyi gos rnying pa mi ral rang ral yin/— 124 —

deng rabs bod kyi tshigs su bcad yod med gang rung gi snyan ngag klog skabs de'i nang du nga tshos thog mar mthong thub pa ni/ bod mi rigs kyi brtse dung dang mdun bskyod kyi gom sgra yin/ snyan ngag de dag gi rjod tshig dang gzugs brnyan re re bod mi rigs kyi ma 'ongs pa'i mdun ljongs dang bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba yin la/ de'i nang du bag 'khums dang rnying zhen/ rjes lus kyi rkang sgrog sil bur gtor nas pha yul 'dzugs skrun gyi g.yul ngor bskyod pa'i snying stobs chen po re re bzhin mthong thub/rang mos snyan ngag dang tshigs bcad snyan ngag gi khyad chos la da dung rtsom gyi kha byang 'god stangs thad nas kyang khyad par ha cang che ba 〈〈mi rabs gsar pa'i snying khams kyi 'phar lding 〉〉las bshad pa gnad du khel 'dug ste/〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉gi shugs rkyen thebs rjes su bod kyi rtsom ming la 'gyur ldog byung yod do/ /rtsom ming phal cher la khyad gzhi dang khyad chos kyi grub cha gnyis su phye chog dper na/ 〈〈deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs 〉〉lta bur mtshon na/ deb ther ni ming gi khyad gzhi'i grub cha/ dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs ni de'i khyad chos kyi grub cha yin/ de'i skor gyi ming tshang ma khyad gzhi las khyad chos gal cher brtsis yod/ dper na/ 〈〈legs bshad gser phreng 〉〉zhes pa 'di khyad gzhi de ming gi khyad chos yin yang bstan bcos 'di ming 'di'i steng na grags yod pa ltar ro/ /khyad gzhi'i grub cha de brtsams chos gang gi brjod bya dang / khyad chos kyi grub cha de phal cher brjod bya gang zhig rjod byed dang brjod stangs/ klog pa po'i blo ngor thon pa sogs kyi yon tan yin/ming 'di'i skor la 'phrad yong skabs nga tshos da skabs kyi tshags par dang dus deb sogs kyi steng na tshong rdzas cha 'phrin bsgrags skabs tshong rdzas de'i yon tan sgrog pa de dag yid la shar yong /brtsams chos kyi mkhan pos rang gi brtsams chos de klog pa po'i cha nas — 125 —

ji 'dra zhig yin min la ma ltos par brtsams chos de'i yon tan thag bcad tshar yod/ 'di ni da skabs kyi rig gzhung gi 'gro stangs las mgo mjug ldog yod/ da skabs kyi brtsams chos rnams gzhal bsdur dang de'i rin thang gdeng 'jog byed mkhan ni klog pa po yin/ klog pa po rnams kyis brtsams chos de bklags rjes rang gi blo ngor bskyed pa'i tshor snang dang / brtsams chos gzhan dang bsdur ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos zur 'don byas rjes de'i yon tan la gdeng 'jog byed pa yin/ yin na'ang gdeng 'jog byas pa'i yon tan de brtsams chos gang gi ming gi cha shas su nam yang mi slebs/ klog pa po rnams kyis brtsams chos de ma mjal sngon du mdzad pa po rang gi brtsams chos kyi yon tan la gdeng 'jog byas/ der ma zad gdeng 'jog byas pa'i yon tan de brtsams chos kyi ming gi cha shas su thon pa ni lo brgya phrag bcu gsum pa'i nang 〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉bod du dar tshun brtsams chos la ming 'dogs stangs kyi khyad chos shig red 'dugadeng skabs ming 'dogs lugs 'di la spyir rtsom rig gi khyab khongs tshang mar 'gyur ldog 'byung bzhin yod/ deng rabs snyan ngag gi khyab khongs su phyogs yongs nas 'gyur ldog byung yod pa dang / rtsom lus gsar pa byung ba dang mnyam du ming 'dogs stangs kyang gsar pa zhig khyer yong ba red/ lhag par snyan ngag gsar pa'i rtsom pa po rnams kyis kho tsho'i snyan ngag de dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs ltar snyan min dang / mkhas pa'i rna rgyan nam mgul rgyan du 'gro min sogs bsam blo yang gtong gi med la de ming gi cha shas gtso phal gang la yang slebs med/ kho tsho'i bsam blo gtong yul ni kho'i brtsams chos kyi nang du thon yod pa'i dmigs bsal gyi yid 'gyur dang / tshor ba/ bsam blo rnams dang de dag rang gi blo ngor gang la brten nas yod pa'am yang na de dag phyi'i dngos po gang zhig gi steng nas sbyar ba'am sbyin thub pa/ yang na de — 126

dag rang gi brtsams chos kyi nang du'am com ming du rjod ngag gang gis gsal ba dang shugs drag gis ston thub pa bcas phyogs gsum yin/ gang gis gsal ba dang shugs drag gis ston thub pa bcas phyogs gsum gyi yid 'gyur dang bsam blo/ tshor ba ni ming 'dogs pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa yin/skabs 'dir slebs skabs nga tshos srol rgyun brtsams chos dang snyan ngag gsar pa'i bar gyi ming 'dogs stangs kyi khyad par gtso bo zhig 'don thub/de ni srol rgyun brtsams chos kyi ming rnams rtsom pa pos klog mkhan gyi tshor snang la ci yong tshod dpag byas nas btags yod pa dang / snyan ngag gsar pa rnams la rtsom pa po rang gi sems rgyud gzhir bzhag nas ming btags yod/snga mas brtsams chos klog pa pos do snang ji ltar yong bar bsam blo btang nas ming btags yod la/ phyi mas rang gi sems rgyud gang gis dang ji ltar mngon thub yod pa la bsam blo btang nas ming btags yod/ srol rgyun brtsams chos kyi ming la rjod ngag ring po re dgos pa dang snyan ngag gsar pa'i brtsams chos kyi ming la ming tshig gcig gam tshig thung gcig gis chog pa yang gong gsal gyi rtsa ba'i khyad par de la thug yod/ snga ma'i skabs su ming gi khyad gzhi las khyad chos gtso bor gyur yod cing khyad gzhi gcig la khyad chos 'ga' re 'byung srid/ khyad chos gcig brjod pa la yang tshig tshogs 'ga' la ma brten par ming rkyang zhig gam tshig dum res gsal por mi thon/phyi ma'i skabs su ming gi khyad chos la khyad gzhi gal cher 'dzin zhing tha na khyad chos la ming gi go gnas tsam yang mi ster/ khyad gzhi ni nam yang gcig las med pas ming la yang tshig tshogs 'byung don med/

gsum pa/ deng rabs snyan ngag gi brjod gzhi 'dem sgrug la rang dbang che ba/deng rabs bod kyi snyan ngag pa'i bsam blo'i phyogs lhung la 'khrug cha dod cing hur por song tshul de 'dra ni bcings 'grol thob pa nas byung myong med pa dang / dus yun ring po'i nang du snyan ngag gsar pa gsar rtsom byed pa'i nang du grub pa'i yang dag min pa'i ngos 'dzin dang bkag rgya rnams gtor te rtsom pa por brjod bya dang nang don/ rnam pa bcas bdams shing /phugs bsam dang re smon sogs kyi brjod bya rnams rang 'dod kyis rtsom 'bri byas chog pa'i rnam pa bzang po zhig shar zhing / snyan ngag gsar pa'i brjod bya'i thad la dus rabs kyi snying stobs dang / gna' deng gi 'tsho ba'i rnam pa/mang tshogs kyi sems gting gi dran tshul/ drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs kyi gnad don sogs mtshon gang thub byas yod pa ste/ de dag gi nang du phyi phyogs sgo 'byed kyi srid jus lag bstar byas rjes kyi rnam pa gsar par bstod bsngags dang / chang rag gi 'du 'dzir g.yeng nas las la mi brtson pa las byung ba'i nyes don dang bslab bya/ shes bya'i gnas la brtson te shes ldan mi snar gyur pa/ btsan dbang gi gnyen sgrig la ngo rgol dang rang dbang gi gnyen sgrig la blo kha phyogs pa/ lha rig gnas gsar brje mi yi god chag dang / skabs de'i spyi tshogs thog gi smyo ltag sgo nas 'dzul ba mi la sogs pa'i tshul min spyod lam ther 'don byas pa sogs spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod du gnas pa'i gnad don la mtshang 'byin byas yod pa ma zad/ brtsams chos de dag la dus rabs kyi nyams 'gyur dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan zhing bod mi rigs kyi // byi/ kā rdokā /la rgyun 'dzin dang phyi lugs snyan ngag gi legs cha'ang sdud —9128 —

snyan ngag gsar pa spel ba'i nyin de nas bzung bsam blo'i khyab khongs nang snyan ngag gi brjod bya phun sum tshogs pa dang srog dbang gsar pa zhig gis zin pa'i khyab rgya je cher gtong bar brtson len byed pa'i las 'gul bslangs pa red/ chab srid dang chos lugs kyi lta ba'i 'ching thag las grol ma thag snyan ngag dang snyan ngag mkhan la thog mar skyes pa'i tshor ba ni rang nyid sngar gyi 'jig rten las che zhing gsar pa zhig gi nang la 'gro dgos pa de yin/mkhas dbang dor zhi lags kyis/lha phyi snod 'jig rten nang bcud sems can gyi//rigs gzugs rang bzhin rnam 'gyur khyad chos dang / /bsam pa'i 'du shes khyad par mtha' yas pa/ /rtsom rig gter brgya brdol ba'i 'byung khungs yin/ /mi②zhes gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du deng rabs kyi gzhon skyes snyan ngag pas sdurnyi / kye grogs po/snyan ngag la dgyes pa'i grogs po/snyan ngag de gar yod shes sam/snyan ngag de dpe deb las ma 'tshol/'tsho ba'i klong na 'dug godape thog gi bshad sgros tsam la/snyan ngag dngos su ma sgoms/mi du'adi las byung ba'i 'tsho ba ni/ mi bye brag pa'i nang sems rgyud dang / mi dang mi'i bar/ mi dang spyi tshogs bar/ mi dang rang byung khams bar gyi 'brel ba bcas phyogs bzhi la go dgos pa dang / de dag la snyan ngag gi mig dbang slebs dgos pa dang / de dag las snyan ngag la tshe srog gi stobs shugs dang — 129 —

lus zungs 'tshol dgos pa yin pas na/ deng rabs snyan ngag mkhan gyis rang gi sems khams de nang sems dang phyi'i 'jig rten gnyis char sngar las rgya bskyed byung ba yin/ kho tsho'i sgyug rtse de mi'i sems khams la skyod skabs/chab srid dang chos lugs kyis phyi thum shig brgyab yod pa'i sems kyi phyi rim tsam min par/ de brtol nas 'gro ba mi'i gnyug ma'i nang rim gyi sems shig yod pa de la slebs par byed/de bas deng rabs snyan ngag mkhan gyis/zu dang po'i na chung gi brtse dung //dwangs bsil chu ngogs kyi zla ba//lag pas 'dzin rgyu zhig med kyang //sems pas 'gog thabs rang mi 'dug/ngas ni phebs shog rang ma smras//khos kyang bka' zhu yang med mod//jo jo gsang stabs kyis phebs te//snying gi khang chung du 'dzul byung /khyazhes snyan ngag nang pho mo zhen 'brel mtshon pa'i ma bcos pa'i sems kyi dga' snang dang 'dod brtse sna tshogs pa ri mo'i dbyibs gzugs su bkod de brnyan ris kyi rnam par klog pa po'i spyan sngar slebs yod/deng rabs snyan ngag pas brjod gzhi zhig snyan rtsom du spel skabs/ chab srid dang chos lugs kyi lta ba zhig gzhir bzung ba min par rang gi sems rgyud kyi tshor ba dang bstun pa yin pas brjod gzhi gcig la don snying dang de mtshon stangs 'ga' re 'byung srid/ dper na don grub rgyal gyi 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉dang rin chen bkra shis kyi 〈〈rbab chu 〉mokhyazhes pa'i snyan rtsom gnyis kyi brjod bya thun mong du rbab chu yin yang / de gnyis las mngon pa'i dgongs — 130 —

don dang de'i mtshon stangs tha dad du byung yod/ snga ma'i nang du rbab chu'i rang bzhin brjod de bod rigs gzhon nu'i lang tsho mngon yod cing / phyi mas rbab chu g.yang la mchong ba'i skad cig ma'i snang tshul bzung ste mdun skyod kyi mi tshe la 'jigs nyen che yang de la ma bshol bar de nyams su myangs na mdun skyod kyi lam rnyed thub pa'i bstan don brjod yod/brjod gzhi gcig la mi che'i go don tha dad du sbyin thub pa las gzhan da dung brjod gzhi gcig la yul dus tha dad la ltos te rnam pa tha dad du bskrun thub pa 'di yang deng rabs snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyi brjod bya rgya cher 'gro ba'i rgyu rkyen gcig yin/ nga tshos bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngag gi brjod bya'i nang don la bltas na mkhas dbang dor zhi'i 〈〈dpyid kyi bdag mo lha las babs pa 〉〉dang / skal bzang rdo rje'i 〈〈dus rabs la phul ba'i shis tshig 〉lo1dang / chab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring gi 〈〈gangs ljongs ma yum〉〉khro'i o rgyan rdo rje'i 〈〈rmi lam〉〉khu〉 bkra shis phun tshogs kyi 〈〈mtsho khri shor rgyal mor phul ba'iglu dbyangs 〉lo1lta bu srid jus gsar pa'i 'aka' drin gyis gangs ljongs snod bcud ma lus par 'gyur ldog gsar pa byung ba'i rnam par bstod pa dang / bshad sgrub kyi 〈〈yum bu bla sgang 〉skokhyadang / dur bu rnam grags kyi 〈〈'bod pa'i g.yab mo 〉〉khu〉ljang bu'i 〈〈rna thang gi mgyogs bris 〉lo1lta bus pha yul gyi khyad par ba'i yon tan dang rang byung mdzes rnam gyi bslu brid nus pa la bstod pa/ don grub rgyal gyi 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉snokhyadang / reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyi 〈〈glag rgod 〉skokhyalta bus mi rigs kyi snying stobs dang phugs bsam/re smon mtshon par byed pa dang / 'ju skal bzang gi 〈〈dungs sems kyi 'char snang 〉lomidang / lcags mo 'tsho'i 〈〈yod tshad skya thing nger〉〉khuyi ljang bu'i 〈〈g.ya' shing gi lo ma〉〉khu〉 sdong chu shel gyi 〈〈sgrol dkar 'tsho〉〉khu〉 chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gi 〈2drod yal ba'i sor gdub 〉lo1sogs kyis pho mo'i bar gyi — 131 —

brtse dung mtshon par byed cing / tig ta'i 〈〈gru ga gzhan zhig nas mthong ba'i 'jig rten 〉lomidang / gangs rtsen gyi 〈〈khyi smyon 〉lomilta bus tshul ldan ma yin pa'i ma rabs kyi lugs la dgag pa/ lag ldan gyi 〈〈mos 'dun 〉lo7dang /padma tshe ring gi 〈〈'bar zhun 〉poyisogs mi tshe'i lta tshul la zhib 'jug byas pa'i gtam dang / de bzhin dpal mo'i 〈〈ngas ni gangs kyi me tog 'thu zhing 'gro 〉lomidang / rom dkon mchog gi 〈〈dzi bo'i glu dbyangs 〉tshokhusogs rtswa thang gi bsung zhim 'thul ba'i glu sgra dang / mkhas grub kyi 〈〈dus bzhi'i so nam byed lugs mtshon pa'i tshig phreng ngag gi rol dbyangs 〉poyidang / rin chen bkra shis kyi 〈〈zhing pa ston ka 〉skoyidang / rams tshe sgo'i 〈〈zhing grong gi snyan ngag 〉tshomilta bu zhing grong gi snye ma'i mgo lcog ldem pa'i dga' snang / dbyar gyi mdzes sdug dang dbyar gyi mtshon mdangs rnam par bkra ba/ gzhon skyes zhing pa pho mo rnams kyis gsar gtod kyis snyan ngag pa'i drag tu lding ba'i snyan ngag gi dung ba bslangs pa/ 'phrin khyung gi 〈〈lha sa/ rgyang thag ring ba'i grong khyer kher rkyang zhig 〉lo1dang / 'ju skal bzang gi 〈〈grong khyer 〉skokhyalta bu grong khyer gyi rnam pa gsar pa'i 'khrug cha sogs brjod kyis mi lang ba yod/ des na brjod bya'i nang don rgya che zhing phun sum tshogs pa ni bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngag pas thog mar 'tshol ba'i lam bu nyag gcig yin/dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/()()6)()()yi dam tshe ring gi 〈〈snyan ngag gi bla srog bshad pa 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1993lor dpe skrun byas pa'i (bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈com dpyad gtam tshogs 〉〉〉zhes par gsal/6)padma 'bum gyi 〈〈mi rabs gsar pa'i snying khams kyi 'phar lding 〉〉zhes pa a me shā / sbya /sdo bye/ /shāl yog la rtse dpe mdzod khang gis 1990lor par du btab pa'i — 132 —

91dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo'i 〈〈snyan tshig rig pa'i shes bya gnad bsdus kyi don 'grel shes bya'i gnad gsal 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1993lor dpe skrun byas pa'i (bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈snyan ngag gi rnam bshad 〉〉〉ces par gsal/()nor sde'i 〈〈snyan ngag de gang na 'dug shes sam 〉〉zhes pa 1989lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb gnyis par gsal/khu'i'aju skal bzang gi 〈〈dung sems rlabs kyi zegs ma 〉〉zhes pa si khron mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gis2001lor dpe skrun byas pa las gsal/por ga////na chen bkra shis kyi 〈〈rbab chu 〉〉zhes pa 1999lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb dang (1skal bzang rdo rje'i 〈〈dus rabs la phul ba'i shes tshig 〉〉1980lo'i 〈〈mtsho sngon po 〉〉zhes par gsal/(yichab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring gi 〈〈gangs ljongs ma yum 〉〉zhes pa 1986lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb gnyis par gsal/〈yi.o rgyan rdo rje'i 〈〈mi lam 〉〉zhes pa1991lo'i 〈〈lho kha'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb gsum //kā py-i rshaX/ phun tshogs kyi 〈〈mtsho khri shor rgyal mor phul ba'i glu dbyangs 〉〉zhes pa 1986lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb gsum par gsal/zhonabashad sgrub kyi 〈〈yum bu bla sgang 〉〉zhes pa 1994lo'i 〈〈sgrang char 〉〉deb gsum par ga//༵/ra bu rnam grags kyi 〈〈'bod pa'i g.yab mo 〉〉zhes pa 1991lo'i 〈〈sgrang char 〉〉deb dang por gsal/43ljang bu'i 〈〈ca thang gi mgyogs bris 〉〉zhes pa 1985lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb dang // // kā/ba rgyal gyi 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉zhes pa 1983lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb gsum ༵༵ shā kāX/ rdo rje mkhar gyi 〈〈glag rgod 〉〉zhes pa1986lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu — 133 —

rtsal 〉/snyikā tyalnga' par ska kās /za/nga gi 〈〈dung sems kyi 'char snang 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs /shā // /ṭā gis 1994lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈gangs 'dabs kyi sems pa 〉〉zhes tukyelcags mo mtsho'i 〈〈yod tshad skya thing nger 〉〉zhes pa 1990lo'i 〈〈gangs rgyan me tog 〉〉deb gnyis par gsal/6〉ljang bu'i 〈〈g.ya' shing gi lo ma 〉〉zhes pa 2001lor bod sngongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈snang bu'i rtsom btusawa snyan ngag deb 〉〉las gsalatsho/ naldong chu shel gyi 〈〈sgrol dkar 'tsho 〉〉zhes pa 1995lo'i 〈〈rdzang char 〉〉deb bzhi pa lasatsho /sduX/ pa rta mgrin tshe ring gi 〈2drod yal ba'i sor gdub 〉〉ces pa1990lo'i 〈〈sgrang char 〉〉deb gsum par gsal/6〉tig ta'i 〈〈gru ga gzhan zhig nas mthong ba'i 'jig rten 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rig/no dpe skrun khang gis 199'gyulor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈gangs 'dabs kyi sems pa 〉〉 zlo ṅgi pa/ ཿ/ ༵/ 〈〈khyi smyon 〉〉zhes pa 1988lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb gsum par gsalatsho/'ilag ldan gyi 〈〈mos 'dun 〉〉zhes pa 1988lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb gsum par gsalayo/ napadma tshe ring gi 〈〈'bar zhun 〉〉zhes pa 1990lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb gnyis par ga//lda/pal mo'i 〈〈ngas ni gangs kyi me tog 'thu zhing 'gro 〉〉zhes pa mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2005lor dpe skrun byas pa'i snyan deb 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉gi shog ngos 215lha/ ro/sa /ko/na mchog bi 〈〈dzi bo'i glu dbyangs 〉〉zhes pa1989lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsomarig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb bzhi par gsal/— 134 —

0stemakhas grub kyi 〈〈dus bzhi'i so nam byed lugs mtshon pa'i tshig phreng ngag gi rol dbyangs 〉〉zhes 1996lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsomarig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb gnyis par gsal/de tsho'ibyin chen bkra shes kyi 〈〈zhing ba ston ka 〉〉ces pa 1991lo'i 〈〈sgrang char 〉〉debadabye /kā/ rnyil bho/'i 〈〈zhing grong dang snyan ngag 〉〉ces pa 2000lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉zub dacho 'bye / zloX /gi 〈〈lha sa/ rgyang thag ring ba'i grong khyer kher rkyang zhig 〉〉ces pa 1988lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb dang por gsal/sa bcad gnyis pa/ bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngag gi rab mdzes spang thang du 〈〈dpyid kyi bdag mo lha las babs pa〉〉/dang po/ snyan rtsom gyi nyams dang 'gyur ba phun sum tshogs pa/snyan rtsom ni ches snga ba'i rtsom lus shig yin par ma zad/ shes rig phun sum tshogs pa'i mi rigs shig yin na phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan rtsom yod cing / snyan rtsom byung ba nas bzung de ni rna bar snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i glu sgra zhig dang 'dra bar rtag tu mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba dang 'grogs shing mi'i rigs la bsam pa'i rgyags phye 'di tsam bskrun zhes sus kyang tshod dpag byed dka'ar/nga re bod mi rigs ni lo rgyus ring po ldan zhing / 'dzam gling thog shes rig dar snga ba'i mi rigs shig yin pa bzhin/ gna' snga mo nas snyan rtsom yang phun sum tshogs po yod par ma zad gnam 'og kun tu grags pa'i snyan rtsom yang mi nyung ba zhig yod/ de'i phyir gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i gnas 'dir 6 snyan ngag gi zhing khams midang smyo glu gar gyi rgya mtsho zhes bsngags brjod kyi yul du gyur yod/ snyan ngag gi rig pa 'dir mtshon na/ gdod ma'i — 135 —
