dus kyi dmangs gzhas la sogs ngag rtsom gyi rnam pa nas yig thog gi tho 'god de gna' bo'i tun hong yig rnying khrod du byung ba'i mgur dang snyan ngag de nas tsa snyan ngag me long mi bod la dar ba nas bzung / snyan ngag ces pa ni snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i ngag gi sbyor ba zhig la ngos 'dzin byed bzhin yod la/ brjod bya'ang rtsom pa po'i rang dbang gi yid 'gyur sngon du mi 'gro bar sngar nas goms shing thag bcad pa bzhin bris te/ bskyar zlos yang zlos byed pa'i srol zhig dar ba red/ 'tsho sdod kyi gnas bab dang rig gnas khor lug gi dbang gis 〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉gi lugs kyi rgyan gyi spras lugs dang tshig la snyan cha btod thabs bcas kyi thad nas rim byon mkhas pa dag gis zhun brdar byas 'og da lta par zhog 'byung 'gyur gyi dus nam yin rung de las brgal dka' ba'i gnas su slebs yod/ de lta bu'i grangs 'bor dang sgyu rtsal zung gi thad lta rin dang dpyad rin yod pa'i bod kyi snyan rtsom la dbye zhib dang phyogs bsdoms byas na rtsa ba'i cha nas lugs gnyis su dbye chog ste/gcig ni sho lo ka gcig gi nang du tshig rkang phan tshun bar tsheg khyim grangs snyoms dgos pa sdeb sbyor gyi lugs dang mthun pa ste sdeb sbyor lugs kyi snyan ngag dang / cig shos ni sho lo ma'i nges pa med pa'i tshig rkang phan tshun bar tsheg khyim grangs snyoms mi dgos par gang bder rang mos ltar 'bri chog pa'i rang dbang can gyi snyan ngag gi lugs yin/nga tshor dus yun ring ba'i snyan ngag gi lo rgyus dang / brtan cing brling ba'i gsar rtsom gyi rmang gzhi yod na'ang de tsam gyis mi chog ste/ dus rabs gsar par glu sgra gsar pa dgos shing shes rig la bogs thon zhing rig rtsal gyi ral kha 'gran pa'i deng gi dus 'dir snyan ngag mkhan po rnams kyi smyug rtse las rin po che gser gyi thigs pa lta bu'i brtsams chos thon zhing 'thon pa las/ slob dpon chen mo dor zhi tshang gi 〈〈dpyid kyi bdag mo lha las babs — 136 —

pa 〉〉ni khong nyid kyi snyan rtsom las tshab byed rang bzhin gyi brtsams chos su brtsi rung ste/ snyan ngag gi rig par blo'i 'jug pa yangs pa'i deng rabs kyi skye bo zhig yin tshe/ snyan rtsom 'di mig gi ltad mo dang yid dbang gso ba'i zas su ma gyur pa ha cang nyung / nga tshos snyan rtsom 'di mgo nas mjug bar du klog thengs rer/ dus rabs sngon ma'i smad du krung go'i sa gzhi chen por byung ba'i bde sdug gi gar stabs re re bzhin slar yang mig lam du mngon pa dang / de dang bsdongs nas blo mi bde ba'i skyo sems kyi mnar gcod drag po'ang mi thebs pa med/ de ni snyan rtsom 'di'i nang rtsom mkhan khong nyid kyi shugs drag po'i tshor 'du ste/ 'tsho bar bcangs pa'i phugs 'dun dang / pham sems/dga' skyo bcas 'o chu 'dres pa ltar 'byed dka' zhing / rlabs kyi 'degs 'jog ltar 'phyur 'jags kyi ngang du gnas pa'i rkyen gyis so/ /rtsom mkhan khong nyid yun ring du bod kyi dngos yod spyi tshogs su 'tsho bzhes gnang stabs/ 'das zin pa'i lo zla'i nang chab srid rlung rlabs kyis bod kyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas la gtor brlag tshabs chen btang ba dang / bod mi'i 'tsho ba dang sems rgyud la dka' sdug dang gnod 'tshe du ma zhig bzos pa dngos su spyan gyis gzigs te/ brjod bya gsar pa dang thugs gzhigs gsar pa zhig gis mig mdun gyi spyi tshogs la 'pho 'gyur byung ba'i phyogs sgo mo dang / dus rabs de'i nang gi mi rnams kyi dga' skyo chags sdang /snying khong gi 'bod sgra dang 'dun pa/ bod khams gsar pa 'dzugs skrun byed pa bcas la dus rabs gsar pa'i snying stobs dang re ba'i srog gi mchog sbyin pa ni snyan rtsom 'di'i khyad chos gtso bo yin/〈〈dpyid kyi bdag mo lha las babs pa 〉'o0zhes pa ni/ bod rigs mi dmangs kyis dus yun mi thung ba zhig tu re zhing snyeg pa'i 'byor phyug ldan pa'i 'tsho ba dang dad mos rang dbang gi spyi tshogs shig mngon sum du shar — 137 —

ba'i dga' tshor dang dran tshul gsal mtshon byas pa'i ri mo lta bu zhig yin/snyan rtsom hril po tshan pa gnyis su dbye chog ste/ tshan pa dang po 6 nor 'dzin bu mos za 'og gos gyon 'bru bcud me tog rgyan spras shing /mi zhes pa nas smyo rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis glog zhags ltar bcibs gser rnga khur nas lha las babs/ /mizhes pa'i bar gyi tshig rkang bcu drug po'i nang du dus skabs shig la dga' bde'i dpal la 'gran zhing / mthun 'grig zho ltar chags pa smyo rig gnas gsar brje'i : rlung dmar mi 'dod bzhin du drag tu lding zhing khrag bzhin dkrugs pa ni/ 6 ston gyi longs spyod ci dgar rol pa sad dang lhags pa'i gdug rtsub dang / dgun gyi chom rkun tshogs rnams mi bzod sems kyis dpung 'jug byas mi pas/ gling 'di'i mkha' ngos ma lus mya ngan gyi du sprin nag po zhig gis mnan 'ong ba ste/ zu mi yi 'jig rten 'chi bdag dbang bsgyur skye dngos rnams ni phal cher bkum mi par byas pa'i snang tshul ya nga ba shar pa la/ 6 'jig rten mes pos spyan chab bsil 9 pa dang mi rnams kyi snying la skrag 'jigs mi bzod pa zhig sbyin pa bris yod/tshan pa gnyis pa ni smyo lam du bskyod pa'i ngal bar ma 'dzem phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i mthas gtugs pa/ /mi zhes pa nas mjug gi bar te/ tshig rkang nyer bzhi'i nang srid jus gsar pa'i dpyid dpal ra sum rtsen gnas nas mi yi yul du mishar ba na/ yul phyogs kun tu dgun ljongs kyi 'khyag grang brgal zhing bde skyid dang rang dbang gi dpyid dus ngang gis slebs 'ong ba'i rnam pa gsar pa de gson nyams ldan par bkod pa dang / rtsom mkhan gyis phun sum tshogs pa'i 'char snang dang shugs drag pa'i tshor 'du/ ngo mtshar ba'i gzugs 'god sogs la brten nas lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i dus 'go'i bod spyi tshogs kyi 'gyur ldog de srog dbang zhugs pa'i 'tsho ba'i ri mor 'phyor 'bri byas shing / sna dus skabs mi 'dra ba gsum la byung ba'i krung go'i spyi tshogs — 138 —

kyi 'pho 'gyur de thad kur mi brjod par yid la sems shing de dang 'dra ba'i dpe ston ka dang dgun kha/ dpyid ka bcas dus tshigs gsum du rang byung khams chen por 'gyur ldog sna tshogs byung ba'i snang tshul gyi steng du bsdus de brjod ②par gzugs snang gi khyad chos mngon par thon yod pa ma zad/brtsams chos nang 'char yan ring lugs kyi mtshon thabs spyad de smyo sgra brgya pa yis grang ngar gcan gzan phyogs mthar bskrad cing nor 'dzin ma/ /gnyid las slong zhing nyal 'gro'i bu mos rngul dang dri ma 'khrud phyir rgyug /mices 'char snang phun sum tshogs pa la brten nas 'tsho ba dang byung rim phra rab la blo kha mi phyogs la/ bya dngos kyi gdod ma'i rnam pa'ang gzhir mi 'dzin par/don dngos kyi gnas tshod dang snang tshod las brgal ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i 'bri stangs kyis klog pa po'i yid dbang 'phrog par byed/snyan rtsom hril po dus rabs kyi tshor 'du drag po dang mi rigs shig la bcings pa'i lhad med brtse dung gis zin cing / khag khur gyi sems dang 'byung 'gyur la rgyang lta byed pa'i phugs bsam dang re smon ni tshig dang yig 'bru re rer 'khod cing / ngo mtshar ba dang yid myos pa/ brtson snyeg bcas mnyam 'dres kyi tshor snang las klog pa por smon pa gtong ba'i tshor snang ཿskye/ cing / mi tshe dang 'jig rten la go ba gsar pa zhig len par skul bar da 6 /nor 'dzin bu mo'i mig gi rdzing bu rab dga'i mchi ma g.yo ba las /'thor ba'i sil ma mu tig dog pa mkhur tshos padma'i lto bar 'dril//mnyen lhug yal ga'i lag pa brkyangs nas dpyid kyi bdag mo'i mgul byer // /sa/ /khyod nyid gtong bar mi bya bdag gi gtan grogs mdzod ces — 139 —

ces pas snyan rtsom gyis nga tsho tshang mar rang rang gi 'char rtog gi stobs che chung ltar yun ring du smon zhing snyeg pa'i sang nyin te 'jig rten gsar pa zhig la brtson snyeg byed du 'jug pa ni phugs bsam gyi lag len yin/ snyan ngag mkhan pos brjod 'dod kyi dmigs yul de mngon sum du bstan zhing par la blos btags shing gnas spar ba ste/ bod gangs can gyi 'byung 'gyur dang ma 'ong ba'i bde skyid de smyo dpyid kyi bdag mo'i misteng spos pa dang /byams dang snying rje'i bdag nyid du gyur ba'i gzugs brnyan nang bod mi ri/sa da~X lhag par gnas der 'tsho ba'i mi rnams kyi re ba nyag gcig po ba masdu da(wa/ kyi bdag mo lha las babs pa 〉〉la re smon gsar pa ste rtsom pa po'i gshis kyi sems khams gsar pa zhugs yod pa ni/yi/ / 4 skye dgu'i re ltos mig ni 'bum phrag dpyid bdag gdong la gtad pa re 'dod skong phyir bdag mo de nyid lus ni bye ba phrag brgyar sprul//'o zo'i kha dang thong gshol rtse mo rtsom pa mkhan gyi snyug gu'i rtser/ /ri mo pa yi tshon snod nang dang glu ma rnams kyi mgrin pa'i dkyil/ /tshan rig rtog zhib byed mkhan dag gi rnam dpyod ral gri rnon po'i sor//rgan po rnams kyi thod gnyer bar dang byis pa dgod pa'i mdzes kong du//'dod ldan na gzhon pho mo'i mig dang bung ba'i mgrin sgra snyan mo la//daXd kyi bdag mo sdug gu ma de'i gzugs kyi rnam pa mngon par gsalazhe/sa/ rtsom mkhan rang sems kyi nyams snang ngam spyi tshogs su 'khol ba'i spro sems dang bde skyid de nyams 'gyur 'bum gyis phyug pa'i phyi rol yul gyi — 140 —

bkod pa tshan rig rtog zhib mkhan dang bod mi rgan po/ na gzhon pho mo sogs kyi rnam 'gyur dang sbyar te/ spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa zhig phyir phyung ba dang bstun nas snyan ngag gi zhing khams de mngon par bton pa na/ klog pa po rnams kyi snang ngor dga' zhing skyid pa'i tshor snang zhig sbyin par byed/ 'jig rten gyi mi rnams ni rang bzhin gyis sdug gi mun pa dwangs shing skyid pa'i mtsho mo 'khyil bar dga' ba'i chos nyid de/ rtsom pa po'i tshor snang dngos ma dang myong snang rnal ma'i gzugs su 'phos pa dang / 'bangs phal ba'i bde sdug gi sems khams de dngos su tshor ba dang / rnyed pa dang / zin pa lta bus mi sems myos pa'i glu dbyangs tshan pa gcig snyan pa'i ngag tu lhang lhang gyer ba red/snyan rtsom 'di tshig gi dam lhod dang ran la/ go sla zhing brjod bde ba/zlos skyon gyi cha kun nas spangs te dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug dang tshig gi snyan ro ldan pa/ snyan gzhung du bshad pa'i yon tan bcu'i nang gi snyan pa'i yon tan sogs ldan pas/ rjod byed kyi tshig rnams khar bde ba lce thog gi bu ram dang /snyan dbang gi bdud rtsir gyur pa ma zad/ tshig dang yig 'bru re re'i bar na skyid la re zhing sdug la smod pa'i 'dun ma mngon par byas yod do//gnyis pa/gangs 'dabs nas 'thor ba'i 〈〈dung sems kyi zegs ma〉〉/gangs 'dabs kyi snyan ngag pa 'ju skal bzang (1960wa 〉nimatsho sngon mgo log tu skyes shing / 1977lo nas bzung snyan ngag gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs pa dang / mig sngar brtsams 'bras gtso bor snyan ngag gi gzhung la dpyad pa'i 〈〈snyan ngag gi rnam bshad 〉〉dang / snyan rtsom phyogs bsgrigs 〈〈gangs 'dabs kyi sems pa 〉〉/ 〈〈dung sems rlabs kyi zegs ma 〉〉bcas par bskrun byas yod/ de las kyang gal che ba ni khong gi 〈〈bdag dang bdag gi — 141 —

gsar rtsom skor gyi bsam gzhig thor bu 〉rosprezhes pa las khong gi gsar rtsom gyi snying stobs dang spobs pa na tshod dang 'grogs nas ma smyo rgas pa ’ ma zad/ldab 'gyur gyis 46'phar zhing lding ba mini bod gangs can gyi gsar skyes klog pa po rnams kyi skal ba sbom pa'i ltos su che bar snyam zhing / khong gi snyan ngag phyogs kyi re snyeg dang ngos zin de bcos ma min pa'i dpe tshad du son par brten/ kho rang slob grwa'i sgo chen nas dang po spyi tshogs la 'jug 'go rtsom pa'i tshe/ khe tshong nor skyed kyi rlabs sgra shang shang sgrog pa'i dus la khel kyang / de la do snang dang rtsod len byed pa'i khom long med par/ snyan ngag pa yis rnyed pa'i tshor ba dang mtshan nyid smra bar rnam dpyod rtsal la brten cing / rlabs rgyun de dag rdog pas mnan nas/ spyi tshogs la dpyad zhib dang mi rigs kyi las /bang 'tshol snyeg byed pa'i mtshan nyid dang snyan ngag gi bya gzhag la shar sa rī/sa nga/ ga gi srog shing ni nam yang rang gshes dang bden drang yin la/de 'bri mkhan gyi snyan ngag pa'ang nam yang rang gshis kyi sar 'greng la bden drang gis 'tsho/ snyan ngag par rang gshis yod pas da gzod rang rkya 'pher ba'i bsam blo yod par gyur la/ snyan ngag pas tshe gcig lus gcig la/tshe srog gi sgra dbyangs ngo ma'am 'tsho gnas kyi bden pa mi bu rang gi gshis lugs ltar mdzes sdug gis gyer ba dang / snyan ngag pa'i mig 'od gtod sa'ang gtso bo rgyu dang dbang gis bskrun pa'i rgyas spros kyi 'tsho ba min par/ spyi tshogs kyi ches dma' rim na 'tsho gnas kyi ched du 'phag 'tshag byed bzhin pa'i tshe srog nyam chung dag gtso bor bzung yod/ de dang de'i dbang gis/ 'ju skal bzang gis sgang pa bod kyi 'dun ma bsam zhing 'jig rten spyi lugs kyis srog ltar mthong chen gtsigs chen byed pa yod tshad la ji mi snyam par lta ba'i snyan ngag pa'i 'tsho stangs byung ba red/— 142 —

snyan ngag pa kho rang nyid kyis 6 nga rang rtsom rig gsar rtsom la 'jug pa'i dmigs yul lam dgos pa bshad na/ thog mar dga' phyogs dang mos pa zhig yin la/ da lta bsam na rang gi mi tshe'i rin thang mngon du 'gyur ba zhig gi ched du'ang yin pa 'dra ste/ nga 'di ru skyes/ nga 'di na yod ces sgrog pa'i mngon 'dod cig yin kyang srid mod/ ngo tsha bzhin smras na bod mi rigs la ga shed cig nas cung tsam re phan e yong snyam pa'i 'dun pa ni dang po nyid nas yod cing da lta'i bar 'dor ma myong / byis blo zer ba de tsho 'di lta'i bsam tshul zhig la bstan pa 'dra mod/ nga la ni de byis blo yin pa la 'gyod gnong ci yang med de/ 'gyod pa ni byis blo de yi ched du 'bad 'bungs dang rtsol ba bsten ma thub pa de la 'gyod/mi(gong mtshungs )ces pas khong gis snyan ngag 'bri ba'i dmigs yul dang dgos ched sogs gsal por bstan 'dug pa ni/ snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring gis 6 rang gi mi rigs la dga' ba'i spro sems de ni/ nga'i snying gi khrag dron 'phyur ba'i gdangs snyan yin/ rang gi mi rigs dar rgyas gtong ba'i 'gan khur de ni nga'i sems kyi rgyud mangs brdung ba'i rol dbyangs yin/ de'i phyir/ ngas rang gi mi rigs skul slong byed pa'i rol cha skrun dus/ tsham tshom med par rang gi bla srog bzhus pa'i dwangs ma de rgyu cha byas pa yin/mi⑤zhes pa ltar/ 'ju skal bzang gis kyang rang mi rigs la zhen pa'i 6 bla srog bzhus pa'i dwangs ma snying khung du sbrum nas bris pa'i snyan ngag tu dus rabs dang mi rigs 'dir bcangs pa'i brtse dung khengs yod pa red/ khos nam yang spyan zung lo rgyus bshul lam ring mor cer te phyir 'dang dang bsam gzhig bgyis pa las brjod gzhi'i nang don gsar pa zhig rnyed gang thub byed de/ rang mos snyan ngag 〈〈bla ri 〉〉yi nang du/ spyi tshogs dang rang byung khams kyi rtag brtan dang 'gyur ldog khrod shugs drag pa'i sems khral gyi bsam blo skyes nas/— 143 —

tsa gna' bo'i rmu thag dum bur chad pa las/byang thang du lhung ba'i bla srog gson po zhig la/ngag rgyun dang gangs rdul yang yang babs pas/lha sgrung gi phung po gtos che ba zhig tu chags/miXzhes dang / lo rgyus ni yun ring la bar stong du lus sdod mi byed la/ dus tshod kyi 'gros kyang gang 'dod ltar ldog 'khor byed mi srid pas/ yid du 'ong ba'i gna' bo'i rmu thag gi lha sgrung gis gzi 'od lam lam 'tsher ba'i tshe srog gang mang zhig khyer song mod/ da dung yang gnam 'og 'di nas mgo bo gnam la btegs nas 'tsho bzhes byed mkhan dag gis/lha go khyab dang glegs bam yun gyis rul ba/zangs rag dang gter rdor gyur/rlung rta dang dar lcog la byang rlung gis gtses drags pas/phyi nang nges med sgyur cing kha phyogs yang yang 'tshol/dang po'i tha tshig gi sne las/gsol kha dang ki bswo yis drag tu bskul kyang /rmi lam la 'jigs pa bstud mar bsnan pa tsam/ ( gong mtshungs )lo rgyus la phyir mig lta ba dang bsam gzhig byed pa ni gangs can pa'i bu dang bu mor skyes pa dag gi 'os 'gan los yin/ mi rigs gang 'dra zhig yin yang de'i lo rgyus steng gzi dpal cham cham spros pa'i dus yod myong la/ nyam nyes dang ngo tsha/ tha na pham kha khur ba'i dus kyang yod myong / de ni lo rgyus rgan po'i mi tshe'i brgyud rim yin la/ lha dbang shed dang stobs shugs kyi sha tshugs rngam po de/ byis sgrung gi zhing na 'gyur rdo'i gzugs su bslangs/mi②zhes pa las nga tshos bslab bya blangs shing nyams myong bsdoms nas 6 phyi nang nges med sgyur cing kha phyogs yang yang 'tshol mi ba 'di da dung yang nar ma son pa'i — 141 —

byis pa bsam med cig gi rtsed mor mthong mi 'os so/ /lo rgyus kyi rma kha dang gzi brjid de dag mig gis mi gnon pa dang bsam blos mi khebs pa ga la bya rung twe mi stang ༵ 'i/ /de ni lo rgyus la 'gan mi 'khur ba'i bya spyod cig red de/ma/ rten gi zuXkā rnyi/ga shor ba'i nam mkha' ru/tshes ru 'khyog po zhig 'khyog la 'phyang /ri zhol gyi lhas 'dabs na/la gzhas za zur sgrog pa'i gzhon nu mas/ri chu la mas skyon shor ba mi shes la/dpyid dus kyi khu byug ni mgrin pa mig chus brnangs bzhin/sems pa gso ba'i ku hu rtag tu sgrog ( gong mtshungs )bla ri'i lo rgyus kyang mi rigs 'di'i lo rgyus yin pa dang / 'das pa'i dus kyi bla ri'i brjid rngam dang dbang thang yang dus tshod kyi 'gros dang bstun nas stabs stabs por yal song ba red/ 'das zin pa'i lo zlas gsar skyes gzhon nu rnams kyi sems khong gi gshin sar sdug snang gi sa bon gang yang sbas ma thub/ tshe srog gi go rim ni 'di ltar myur zhing ya nga ba zhig tu snang la/ gshis dul dang re smon gyis nam yang don dngos kyi tshab byed mi thub pas/ mi rnams kyis nam yin yang 'das pa'i dus de brjed mi 'os/ snyan ngag ni mi rigs kyi sems sgra yin la/ snyan ngag pa ni mi rigs de'i blo dkar ba'i bu phrug yin pa smos ma dgos shing / khos ma yum gyi nu zho'i bcud la rol ba'i mtshungs su 'gan 'khri'i 'dun pa brtan po zhig dang 'os 'gan lci mo zhig phrag steng du blangs yod pa red/'ju skal bzang gi dmigs bya mngon 'gyur byung ba la mthun rkyen mang — 145 —

po yod na'ang / bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus rig gnas la go ba gting zab chags pa dang 'brel spyi tshogs dang / mi rigs/ dus rabs bcas la 'chang ba'i 'gan 'khri'i 'dun pa brtan po zhig yod cing / 〈〈ka rtsom gnod sbyin pho brang dkrug pa'i 'phral 'khor 〉〉sogs bklags na rtogs sla ste/ zu pa tra'i ris bzhin 'khyog pa'i (yo can tshos mthon po'i go sa sgor gyis nyo/ /pha mes brla rus rdung ba'i rkang 'dren dag rang rigs dbu 'phang sgor gyi don/ /ra bzang lug bzang brtsad pa'i tha ma la ci yang mi bzang sgor mo bzang / /la rgya mgo rna bzung ba'i mthar thug la gang yang mi zin sgor mo zin/ /sha khrag gdos bcas lus la grub zin nas nga dang khyod la khyad mi 'dug /mi ces skabs de'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod du dbang cha dang mtshan snyan ris med du spyad de rgyu nor gyi 'dod pa skong ci thub byed pa'i spyi tshogs snang tshul dag la 'phya smod dang zur za byed pa las rang rigs la 'chang ba'i dung zhen dron mo zhig tsha lam mer mngon pa dang / snyan ngag gi rig rtsal bslabs pa'i gangs can pa rnams la bslad pa med pa'i brtse dung shugs chen rtag tu 'chang yod pa ni ches gtso bor gyur ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig go/'ju skal bzang gis 6 nga tsho'i gsar rtsom gyi rtsa don ni/ bod rang gi phun sum tshogs pa'i rtsom rig gi ngo bo dang khyad chos rgyun 'dzin byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan gyi rtsom rig legs cha nang 'dren dang tshur len byed cing / de'i khar gtso bo rang nyid dam mi rabs 'di'i gsar gtod cig cis kyang yod par byed rgyu de yin snyam/ de las kyang rgyun 'dzin ni zang gzhi dang / gzhi 'cha' sa'am rkang 'dzugs sa byed cing /tshur len ni thabs lam dang byed thabs shig tu 'dzin pa dang / gnad 'gag ni gsar gtod byed rgyu de yin la/ gsar gtod ces pa'ang sngar lugs bskyar zlos 'ba' zhig min cing / gzhan lugs la lad zlos kho na'ang min — 146 —

pa'i brtsams chos legs po klog pa pos dang len dang dga' mos byed pa zhig la go na chog snyam/ ngas de sngon de ltar lab cing bris myong la/ rang gis kyang de ltar e 'khyongs bltas myong / brtsams chos 'ga' zhig srol rgyun kho na ltar bris chog la/kha cig lad zlos gyi tshul byas kyang mi rung ba ga la yod/’ ces pa ni khong rang gi gsar rtsom nyams myong las grub pa'i sdom tshig yin tsa na/ 'ju skal bzang gi gsar rtsom 'du shes dang gsar rtsom byed thabs yin pa'ang smos ma dgos te/ sgyu rtsal gsar gtod kyi gnad 'gag ni 4 gsar pa mi zhes pa'i yig 'bru 'di gtso bo yin na/ khong gis nam yang gsar gtod kyi gom mtshams 'jog ma myong ste/ dmangs khrod dang srol rgyun byed thabs la spobs pa chen pos 'dor len bgyis te rang nyid kyi khyad chos grub pa byas/kho'i snyan rtsom 〈〈smon pa'i phugs bsam 〉〉ni 'di'i thad nas khyad chos cung 'bur du thon pa'i brtsams chos shig yin snyam/tsa dpyid gsum mtshar sdug me tog chal chil du bzhad pas//a lce'i dbu lo mdzes pa'i rgyan cha tsam yong na//na chung sor mo'i mtshon gyis tshal ba ru 'phangs kyang //'gyod med btang snyoms chen po'i gzhi dbyings su btang chog /dbyar gsum snum stug yal 'dab dpag tshad du rgyas pas/ /a jo'i sku ngal gso ba'i tshad skyob tsam yong na/ /tsha gdung me dug drag pos brtse med du gzir yang / /bskang med zhi ba chen po'i gzhi dbyings su btang chog /ston gsum smin legs 'bras bzang phang phung du dud pas/ /rmo bo'i zo mdangs gso ba'i bcud len tsam yong na/ /rno ngar rnga zor gdug pos 'jing ba nas bcad kyang //— 147 —

phangs med dga' ba chen po'i gzhi dbyings su btang chog /dgun gsum yal ga'i kho lag phyogs med du brkyangs pas/ /spo bo me stobs gso ba'i drod len tsam yong na//reg gcod sta gri ngar mas dum bu ru gtubs kyang / /lan med bzod pa chen po'i gzhi dbyings su btang chog /khyad par ring ba'i rtse mo nam mkha' ru bsnyegs pas//nu sring bu tsha dgyes pa'i skas gdang du sgyur te//rgyu skar do shal len pa'i rkang stegs shig yong na//re blo gting nas tshim pa'i dga' ston la rol 'gro//mi duzhes pa dang / ra snyan ngag pas khol du phyung ba'i rgya che zhing khod yangs pa/blos gtong phod pa'i mi rigs snying stobs kyi rtsa ba gcig tu sgril yod/ dpyid zla tha ma'i dus su/ lo zlas rdog brdzis thebs pa'i sa gzhir/ dus kyi 'khor lo med pa'i sdong po zhig yod/ me tog gis bu mo'i 'dzum mdangs brgyan myong la/shing 'bras kyis 'dzugs mkhan la drin lan mjal myong zhing / sdong lo skam pos kyang mi rnams la drod khol sbyin myong / dgun kha slebs la nye dus/ sdong po dag skam tshar na'ang sdong rgan 'di kho na 'gyod pa skyes kyi med par ma zad/da dung rang nyid rmang rdo zhig tu gyur nas rjes rabs pa rnams rang gi rtse la 'khyud de 'od 'tsher ba'i nam mkha'i skar ma 'dzin par smon/’ 0khos rang gi re snyeg dang 'dod dgongs de gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir lo ngo stong phrag du mar rtsa ba zug pa'i sdong rgan zhig gi steng 'phos shing / de ni mi rigs 'di'i brgyud myong ba'i lo rgyus dngos ma zhig ma yin nam/ snyan rtsom du sngon pa'i gzugs kyis bla na ma mchis pa'i phul byung gi bsam pa'i 'jig rten zhig gcal tu bkram/ rang nyid skyong ba'i mi rigs dang sa gzhir sems gting — 148 —

nas dga' zhing gus pa'i rnam 'gyur ha cang zhi ba'i nyams kyis mngon 'duga'aju skal bzang gi snyan rtsom khrod dus nam yang 'bur du thon pa'i khyad chos gtso bo zhig ni khengs skyung dang zhi dul gyis phyug pa ma zad/ srol rgyun dang deng rabs zung du 'brel ba de red/ sgyu rtsal gyi tshor rtog dang dus rabs kyi 'os 'gan bsam blos phyug pa'i snyan ngag pa su yin rung / dus rabs kyi bsam gzhig rgyab rten du byas pa'i rang gi skad char thun mong min pa'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang brtse dung gi srog rtsa yod dgos shing / brtsams chos kyis tshur snang byas pa'i 'tsho ba dang bsam blor bden lugs kyi gshis rgyud tshang dgos pa red/khong gi snyan ngag ni sgyu rtsal gyi rim pa shin tu mtho ba'i khar dpyid dpal dang por phebs pa ltar kun nas gsar pa'i nyams 'gyur yang ldan ste/khos srol rgyun dang rang zhen tshig ring thung gang gi lam nas bris kyang / bsam bzhin du tshig bcos pa dang / btsan shed kyis 'gros bskyogs pa'i shul tsam mi mthong la/ khong gi snyan ngag ni gna' bo'i snyan ngag dang 'dra bar mtshan nyid gshis lugs zab mo'i snying bcud dang ldan yang / bro med kyi tshig gog gyong bo dang / 'brel med kyi brjod bya 'khrugs po nam yang mi 'byung bar/yang na shag shag bzhur ba'i dwangs bsil gyi chu phran ltar snyan la yi gar 'ong zhing / yang na lang long du 'bab pa'i gtsang chen gyi rba rlabs bzhin brjid la blo kha skyed/ res 'ga' gsal zhing bab chags pa dmangs khrod kyi glu gzhas dang yang 'dra ste/ sgyu rtsal myong stobs kyi rim pa mi 'dra ba tshang mar zur dang byis mi 'asbyi ba so so nas tsha mngar skyur gsum gyi ro khyad mi 'dra ba gang rung na rdorsha /shā/ 〈〈gangs 'dabs kyi sems pa 〉〉dang 〈〈dung sems rlabs kyi zegs ma 〉〉sogs kyis srol rgyun snyan ngag gi 'bri thabs spyad de snyan ngag — 149 —

pas rang gi mi tshe dang 'tsho bar bzung ba'i lta tshul dang re ba mtshon la/〈〈gnod sbyin pho brang dkrug pa'i 'phrul 'khor 〉〉sogs kyis dus skabs 'di'i spyi tshogs steng nad yams bzhin mched pa'i snang tshul dag la zer 'don dang sun 'byin byed sems mtshon yod/ de dag brda dang mngon brjod kyis gos 'phyor mnabs pa ma yin par kha gsal zhing go bde la/ nang don gting zab pa'i srol rgyun gyi nyams 'gyur rgyun 'dzin byas khar deng rabs kyi bsam blo'i tshe srog brtan po zhugs yod/ lhag par rang mos snyan ngag 〈〈dge 'dun chos 'phel 〉〉dang 〈〈skur rtsi las gzhibs pa'i mngar kha 〉〉sogs deng rabs snyan ngag gsar pa'i rtsom stangs bed spyad de sngar 'das lo rgyus la phyir dran dang mi rigs kyi las dbang la 'tshol rtog snyan ngag pa zhig gi myong tshor dang khur sems/ mi tshe'i 'char snang sogs klog pa po'i mig lam du ri mo ji bzhin mngon thub pa'i brtsams chos mang du spel la/ rnam pa gsar pa'i brtsams chos de dag la mdzes dpyod kyi rin thang ldan pa'i steng / nye sa nas 'tsho ba'i gsar byung gi rnam par 'tshol zhib byas pa'i dus rabs kyi brtse sems shugs drag mtshon pa red/mdor na/ 'ju skal bzang gi snyan ngag ni lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i dwangs gtsang chu phran zhig dang mtshungs par gangs ljongs dus rabs gcig gi snyan ngag gi bzhin ras bkrus shing / lus sems dang ba 'dren pa'i dri bzhon gsar par 'dra ste deng rabs rtsom rig gi nam mkhar skyod pa'i snyan ngag gsar pa'i sgro rkang legs par bsgrigs pas/ khong gi grub 'bras la do snang byed mkhan mang nas mang du 'phel bzhin mchis so//— 150 —

gsum pa/ gna' deng snyan ngag rgyud skud las 'phos pa'i 〈〈skya rengs lha mo'i 'bod bar〉〉57lha rgyal tshe ring (1962wa ni mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi khri ka rdzong du skyes shing / kho rang skyod bzhin pa'i lam bu de'i steng nas snyan ngag pas bsam gzhig gi gom stabs kyang sna tshogs sgyur 'go brtsams pa dang / khos rang gi tshor snang dang rtog 'char gleng skabs sna thang smug sbra khyim las nyi 'od kyi brtse zhen dang lhags rlung gi gdug rtsub res mos su myangs pa dang / gna' bo'i shing khang las lo zla'i zhabs rjes dang mes po'i blo gros rnyed byung ba ma zad/chu len bu mo'i bgrod bskyod las de dag gi gzugs byad kyi rol sgeg dang bslu brid mthong la/ stag shar gzhon nu'i dpung sha las de dag gi rtsal shugs dang dpa' gdeng mthong ba dang / ri rab kyi 'gying stabs las/ pho rgod kyi brtan brling mthong / chu rgyun gyi bzhur 'gros las sgeg 'ching ma'i zhi dul rnyed pa yin/milizhes pas/ nga tshos lha rgyal tshe ring la snyan ngag pa zhig la yod 'os pa'i tshor rtog dang brtse sems ldan pa shes par ma zad/ tsa 'od 'tsher bar byed pa thams cad rin chen min pa dang / so ston par byed pa thams cad grogs po min pa rtogs shing mi ( gong mtshungs )zhes pa sogs las khong nyid la snyan ngag pa zhig la mkho ba'i spobs pa dang chags snang gi tshor ba gsal zhing mi 'chol ba zhig yod pa'ang shes thub/rtsom rig brtsams chos la brjod bya'i don gyi nyams gal che ba bzhin du rjod byed tshig gi nyams kyang gal che ste/ rje tsong kha pa chen pos/ sna don bzang ba la yid 'phrog tshig sbyor gyis/ /spras par gyur na ches cher mdzes par 'gyur/ /:zhes gsungs pa dang /〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉du/6 snyan pa nyams ldan tshig dang ni//— 151 —

dngos po la'ang nyams gnas pa//sbrang rtsi spyod pas sbrang rtsi bzhin//gang zhig blo ldan dga' byed pa'o//mi zhes pa ltar/ snyan ngag ni skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi khongs su gtogs pas/ phyi nang snyan ngag gang zhig gi sgyu rtsal zhib dbye'i gom pa dang po ni skad cha'i zhib dbye yin pa dang / snyan ngag gi dbyangs kyi mdzes pa dang yid yul gyi mdzes pa sogs yig 'bru dang skad cha'i bar gnas yod pa red/ snyan ngag pas sgyu rtsal gyi thabs rtsal du ma bsres sbyor gyis yid brnyan bzhengs bskrun byas te/snying khong gi brtse dung nying bsdus kyis glu ru len bzhin yod/ lha rgyal tshe ring gi snyan ngag la snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi mdzes pa 'bur du thon 'dug ste/ngam nag mtshan mos 'khyud pa'i rgya ru gnyid la yur ba'i gangs ri ya/ /da ni khyod kyi mtshar sdug 'dzum dkar 'jig rten dpyid du dgod la ran/ba/ dag gis ma rig mun pa'i srin mo dmar ser me la sgron bzhin du//sgyur//yul gyis rnam par bskal ba'i shar nas zhabs skyes gar stabs 'di ru sra 'thas 'khyag rom sbubs su smra brjod yun ring bcad pa'i gtsang chab ya//da ni rtogs pa sad pa'i snyan 'gyur glu sgra gsang mthor sgrogs par gyis//gyi rang la dbang ba'i sngon skyod rkang stabs kha btags bzhin du skyod par sa/da/ ni yang yang yid la bcags pa'i re smon gzhi nas mngon sum gyur//— 152 —

dud smug klong du 'khyil ba'i rum na sdur ba 'dren pa'i grong sde ya//yid kyi mkha' la 'thibs pa'i bying rmugs shes rtogs glal mos gtor bar gyis//da ni khod snyoms gshin pa'i sa zhing dgun gyi 'ching rgya las grol bas//brtsamakhyu/nga/ dkar mdzo rnams dor du sdeb la dpyid kyi rmo 'debs gsar du ri skyes me tog rmi lam mdzes pa'i rgyan du rmi ba'i na chung kye//da ni kun nas 'byings pa'i skra lo chu bo'i 'gram du shad par gyis//1 yun ring ngo 'dzum gnag pa'i bzhin gyi lhad med spro 'dzum grol bar ma dasgo/da/ kyi lang tsho'i mdzes sdug spyom phyir nyi gzhon shar gyi grong las 'ongs//zhes pa dang / 〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉nang bstan pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan gyi sbyor stangs ltar tshig dang tha snyad kyi bsdebs lhag par 'grig cing 'phrod par spel yod pa ma zad/ deng rabs kyi gdangs mtshams dang grim lhod/ 'degs 'jog sogs 'dres mar spel bas khu byug sngon mos gsung dbyangs sing sing bsgyur ba lta bu'i mdzes pa'i dbyangs kyi nyams 'gyur zhig thon yod pa dang / skad cha'i shong tshad dang ldem shugs bcas la shugs snon brgyab yod pa red/ bod kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag la mtshon na/ snyan ngag gi rtsa ba'i rang gshis de tshig gi mdzes pa lhur len pa'i steng na yod/ tshig de snyan par bya ba'am rgyan gyis brgyan par bya ba gtso bo yin/ lha rgyal tshe ring gi snyan ngag la'ang tshig rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i khyad chos mngon gsal du yod/ kho'i snyan rtsom gyi tshigs su gcod stangs la srol rgyun snyan ngag gi khyad chos 'bur thon du ldan yod pa ma zad/ bskor ba'i rgyan gyi rnam pa can yang mi nyung ba — 153 —

yod pa dper na 〈〈phangs pa'i mchi ma dbang med bzhur〉〉/ 〈2khyod la brjod 'dod kyi 'od lam lam gyi skad cha de 〉〉lta bu sogs/ tshig 'gros lhod pa de yang don gyis dmangs glu'i shan zhugs pa 'dra'o//nga tshos gtam brgya bshad pa'i snying po dang 'o brgya dkrogs pa'i mar lo ste/ lha rgyal tshe ring lags kyi snyan ngag gi dbyangs kyi mdzes pa grub pa'i rtsa gnad ni tshig gi gcod mtshams dang / snyan cha'i sdeb sbyor/ 'jam rtsub/ grim lhod sogs la mnyam snang chen po 'jog pa'i gsar rtsom gshis ka dang rag las pa ma zad/ kho rang chung dus nas dmangs khrod glu gzhas dang gling sgrung gi 'chad gyer sogs la mos shing goms pa'i mthu nus kyis kyang yin snyam/ khong gi srol rgyun dang deng rabs gang gi rtsom stangs ltar mdzad pa'i snyan rtsom gang yin yang ri mo'i sgyu rtsal dang dbyangs kyi sgyu rtsal gnyis kyi lhan 'dzoms shig tu snang la/ kho'i snyan ngag gi ngang rgyud lhod cing gshis ka 'jam pa/ zhi zhing dul ba'i yid brnyan gyi cha dag gtso bo snyan rtsom gyi tshig 'gros lhod pa can du snang ba las byung ba dang / khyad chos 'di dag ni rtsom pa pos yun ring du srol rgyun gyi mdzes dpyod lta ba dang len dang srol rgyun snyan ngag las sdog 'don byas pa'i nyams myong gi rtsal las thon pa zhig red/ 6 mnyes gshin 'jam mnyen gyi mdzes pa dang 'char yan gyi ngang tshul de kho'i snyan ngag gi rtsa ba'i khyad chos yin/ yizhes pa dang / lha rgyal tshe ring lags kyi srol rgyun dang deng rabs kyi thabs gang rung la bsten pa'i snyan rtsom gang yin yang snyan 'jibs dbyangs kyi nyams 'gyur du mas phyug pa'i tshig rkang chu 'dzin dkar po'i gseb gseng du dal bur skyod pa'i yid brnyan chu shel dbang po las 'char brnyan 'brel rtog dang rnam par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i sems byung gi zer phreng phyogs bzhir spro bar byed cing / yid du 'ong zhing lta na sdug pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi zhing khams sheg chags pa ni zhib mor sems na dbyangs kyi mdzes pa — 154 —

dang 'bral thabs med do//lha rgyal tshe ring gi snyan rtsom la bltas na/ 〈〈phangs pa'i mchi ma dbang med bzhur 〉〉zhes pa nas 4 bdag bis bsil ljongs lo rgyus la 'dri gcod lan gnyis byas rjes/ ches mtho ba'i gnas de ru dpral ba thal mos bkab nas rgyang lta byas pas yin/mi⑤zhes pa ltar/ kho'i snyan rtsom gyi bsam blor 'gyur ldog byung zhing mi rigs la sems khral byed kyin gtan 'dun la snyegs/de nas bzung khos rtsom 'bri ba'i dmigs yul dang rang gi 'gan 'khri yongs su shes rtogs byung ba dang / gu dog pa'i smyo bstod tshogs mi kyi sbubs rgya las thog mar dga' skyo chags sdang gi dngos yod 'tsho bar smyug rtse bsgyur cing /snying gtam yod kyang bshad mi phod pa dang mig chu mchis kyang bzhur mi phod pa'i las dbang la bsam gzhig byed 'go brtsams te/6 brjod 'dod pa zhig blos thub rnams la lhug por smras pa dang /len 'dod pa zhig brtse ba chen pos gseng mthor blangs/ ⑫zhes brjod 'dod kyi skad cha rnams gya gyu dang bral ba'i sems dang go bde 'jam mnyen gyi ngag gis klog pa po'i snyan lam du sgrog gin yod/spyir bod kyi ngag rig gi mdzes dpyod khyad chos de zhi 'jam lhod mnyen gyi steng nas yod pa zhig yin/ gdod ma'i gzhi las byung zhing gnyug ma'i rang chas rdzogs pa'i bod kyi dmangs grur mtshon na/ len mkhan pa'i skad ji ltar mtho ba'am ji ltar 'dzer yang nang snying dang 'brel ba'i lhod bag gi cha de yin/ skad cha la snyan cha thon dgos na tshig gi gcod mtshams dang cha ya'i sdeb lugs la mnyam 'jog dgos pa ma zad/ snyan rtsom du bkol ba'i bya dngos kyi ming dang tha snyad la'ang gdam gses yod dgos pa red de/ 〈〈tshangs sras bzhad sgra 〉〉las/ smyo khro ba dang / dmag dpung / g.yul thabs kyi las sogs la bstod bsngags byas na/ don du drag shul gyi nyams 'byung dgos pas sgra — 155 —

bdangs rtsub pa shas che na tshig brjid pa 'byung ba'i rkyen gyis tshig la brjid nyams che/ bstan bcos kyi brjod bya dang / yul dang gnas la bstod pa/springs yig lta bu sogs la sgra gdangs 'jam zhing lhod pa shas cher sbyar na tshig sbyor snyan pa 'i nyams su 'gyur bas na/ tshig ha cang mdzes pa'i khyad chos sogs yod/mi⑤ces gsungs pa ltar/ rtsom pa pos snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor spel ba'i rtsa don bzhin yun ring du gces su bzung bas/ rgyun par rang gi mthong yul du gyur pa'i rtsi shing nags gsum dang / me chu rlung gsum/ nyi zla skar gsum/ rta nor lug gsum/ dbyar dgun ston dpyid/ sa rdo ri brag sogs mang tshogs dang 'brel 'dris dang gsal cha che ba'i bya dngos kyi ming sogs snyan ngag tu 'dren bzhin yod la/ ches 'dris lobs su song yod pa'i tha snyad steng rtsom pa po'i zhen don lhug por zhugs pa byas shing / ming dang tha snyad yongs rdzogs mdzes pa'i chos su byed pa'i rtsom tshul 'dis gshis 'jam gyi mdzes pa'i steng la yid yul gyi mdzes pa bsnan par byas te/ yid yul gyi mdzes pa'i khyad chos de'ang grub par mdzad yod/ klog pa por gsal cha yod pa'i bya dngos kyi ming dang tha snyad bkol ba des klog mkhan rnams rang dbang med par snyan rtsom nang gi brjod yul der bkri bar byed pa dang / gnas de nas rtsom pa po dang mnyam du dga' skyo chags sdang gi sems khams shig myong bar byed pa de don du snyan ngag gi yid yul yin/ de la phyi nang snyan ngag rig pa smra ba rnams kyi bzhed tshul ltar na/ yid yul ni rtsom pa po rang ngos kyi brtse dung dang phyi yul gyi dngos po'i 'jig rten gnyis chu dang 'o ma bzhin phan tshun 'dres pa las byung zhing grub pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi zhing khams shig yin pa dang /gsar du byung ba'i mdzes dpyod rig pa'i gzhung lugs 'dis dus yun ring po'i gsar rtsom lag len khrod kyi nyams myong dang 'bras bu phyogs bsdoms lta bu byas yod do/ /'jig rten gyi mdzes pa yod tshad kyi zer ma'i phreng ba ni — 156 ge

sems rgyud kyi chu shel dbang po las spros pas na/ sems rgyud kyi 'phros pa med tshe mdzes pa'ang yod mi srid de/ su'e tser gyi (371 26khyi'i pu)bsam blo pa chen mo ar me yis rang byung gi yul ljongs leb mo zhig ni sems rgyud gcig bi zhing khams yin zhes gsungs pa dang / na gzhon snyan ngag pa lha rgyal tshe ring lags kyis mdzad pa'i 〈〈skya rengs lha mo'i 'bod brda 〉〉yi nang klog pa po rnams la shin tu gsal cha che ba'i rang byung khams kyi bya dngos tshang ma kho'i sems rgyud kyi dga' skyo mtshon byed kyi zhing khams byas 'dugadeng rabs snyan ngag pa lha rgyal tshe ring lags kyis de ltar snyan ngag gi kha gtod yul dang / kun rtog g.yo stangs/ 'bri thabs sogs rtsa ba'i steng nas snyan ngag gsar pa ra rkang pa btsugs shing / rjod byed dang sgrig gzhi dbyangs 'gros sogs rnam pa'i steng nas srol rgyun snyan ngag dang nye bar btud de/〈〈skya rengs lha mo'i 'bod brda 〉〉yi nang snyan ngag gsar rnying gnyis po'i dge mtshan zung 'brel legs par byas yod/ rtsom pa pos bod kyi spyi tshogs khrod rgyun chags su gyur pa'i bsam blo'i rigs de ha cang spyir btang gi brjod bya sa rdo dang nor lug lta bu'i steng 'phos te/ brjod bde dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug rol mo ltar snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i sgo nas rang nyid dam rang gi grogs po tshor gsong por brjod pa dang / bod spyi tshogs khrod bag la nyal ba'i gsang ba de skad shugs drag pos brjod pa ni/ snyan ngag pa kho rang gis sna nga rang thams cad khong du sbed la mi mos par yod tshad ngag tu 'khrol la dga' ba yin/’zhes pa des phal cher na ha cang phra ba'i dus nas bod spyi tshogs kyi yar thon dang / mi dmangs kyi bde sdug sogs la sems khur gnang gin yod pa sogs gsal mtshon byas yod do/ /

dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/()dor zhi'i 〈〈dpyid kyi bdag mo lha las babs pa 〉〉zhes pa 1983lo'i 〈〈rdzang char 〉〉deb gsum par gsal/khuyichab 'gag rta mgrin gyi 〈〈bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig bi lo rgyus 〉〉zhes pa 2007lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 134par gsal/()()()(nye'aju skal bzang gi 〈〈ljon pa'i phugs bsam 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rig/no dpe skrun khang gis 1994lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈gangs 'dabs kyi sems pa 〉〉 zlo pa/ rshakā lab/zang bi 〈〈bdag dang bdas gi gsar com skor gyi bsam gzhig 〉〉ces pa 1998lo'i zla 7pa'i tshes 16nyin gyi 〈〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur 〉〉du gsal(/)yi dam tshe ring gi 〈〈snyan ngag gi bla srog bshad pa 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs )pe skru/ khang gis 1993lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈rtsom bshad gtam tshogs 〉〉kyi shog sa /yi/snar bye/sa ༵tsho/'i 〈〈sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu 〉〉zhes pa mi rigs dpe skrun khang bi 2006lor dpe skrun byas/〈yi(1(1lha rgyal tshe ring gi 〈〈skya rengs lha mo'i 'bod brda 〉〉zhes pa mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1996lor dpe skrun byas par gsal/(yibadud lha rgyal gyi 〈〈mnyes gshin 'char yan gyi snyan ngag 〉〉ces pa 1999lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 2nyin gyi 〈〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur 〉〉du gsal/(milha rgyal tshe ring gi 〈〈nga dang snyan ngag 〉〉ces pa1998lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 2nyin gyi 〈〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur 〉〉du gsal/(yibase tshang blo bzang dpal ldan gyi 〈〈tshangs sras bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs 〉〉kan /shā ṭwāṃ rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1989lor dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 531par — 158 —

sa bcad gsum pa/ bod kyi deng rabs snyan ngag 'phel rgyas lo rgyus steng 〈〈lang tsho'i zab chu 〉〉yi go gnas dang shan shugs/dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i 'gor/ rang re'i rtsom pa po re gnyis shig gis mi rigs gzhan pa'i rang mos snyan ngag 'bri stangs la slob sbyong dang / de dag la dpe byas te bod yig gi thog nas rang mos snyan ngag 'bri 'go brtsams pa ma zad/ bod rang gi rang mos snyan ngag 'bri stangs kyi lam zhig btsal dang 'tshol bzhin yod pa des bod kyi rang mos snyan ngag 'bri stangs kyi lugs la shugs gsar pa zhig bsnan pa red/ rtsom tshul gyi rnam pa de ni/ bod kyi snyan ngag gi rtsa ba'i rtsom stangs sdeb sbyor gyi lugs dang bstun pa'i srol rgyun snyan ngag las ches cher brgal ba zhig yin/1983lo'i 〈〈sbyang char 〉〉deb gsum par sku zhabs don grub rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉zhes pa thog mar spel ba de ni/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir dbyar gyi thog ma'i 'brug sgra dang / dpyid gsum gyi pho nya ltar snyan ngag gsar pa 'dren pa'i skya rengs lta bur gyur/ de'i rjes bod rigs na gzhon rtsom pa po mi nyung ba zhig gis 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉yi rtsom stangs mig dpe byas te/ snyan ngag gsar pa phon chen po zhig bris pa dang / da phan dus thung lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi ring la bod rigs sa khul du 'bri srol 'di dar khyab ha cang che ba dang / klog pa po'i dga' bsu thob dang 'thob bzhin yod/don grub rgyal gyi 〈〈lang cho'i rbab chu 〉〉yis rang mos snyan ngag gi lam nas rjes lus dang rmongs mun gyi klong du 'khyams pa'i bod rigs mang tshogs gnyid las slong ba'i sta gon mdzad pa dang / srol rgyun snyan ngag gi phyi'i rnam pa nas nang gi rnam shes bar bcings 'grol zhig ma byas na/ rtsom pa po'i — 159 —

dga' ba'i dga' 'bod dang skyo ba'i mig chu/ chags pa'i shab shub/ sdang ba'i ku co sogs dri ma yal zhing mdangs ma nyams par brjod dka' bar mthong ste/ lang tsho'i rbab chu des phyi'i rnam pa nas brtsams te nang rnam shes kyi bar 'ching ba las grol bar 'bad pa red/phyi'i rnam pa'i bcings 'grol des da gzod rtsom pa por bkag rgya ci yang med cing / 'khor ba sdug bsngal du mthong ba'i chos lugs kyi brjod bya ma bris rung rang sems rgya yan du shor ba'i tshor ba ci rigs kyang rang dbang gi lus 'dir brten chog pa'i dga' ba rnyed par ma zad/ rkyen de la byas te sngar bas mu mthud du sngar med gsar sbol gyis sdog 'don dang gsar rtsom gyi tshod lta ci rigs byed pa'i rang dbang la brtson len byed pa'i 6 rbab chu mide nyid mkha' nas thur du gzhol ba'i zil shugs dang / g.yang la mchong ba'i spobs pa sogs yid la rtog bzo'i tshul du shar bar byed la/ sna rbab chu'i lang tsho la co 'dri ba'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i gzhon nu rnams kyi gsar gtod dang rang dbang gi snying stobs gom 'gros mdun phyogs su bsgyur bar stobs shugs 'dzad med sbyin pa red/1 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉la mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i khyad chos kyis phyug trī/ rnams cha rgyus dang goms lobs su song med pa'i snyan ngag gsar pa 'dir de 'dra'i yid 'thad byung zhing dga' mos byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo zhig ni rtsom lus 'dir thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa yin te/ rang rgyal gyi rtsom pa po grags can dbyi to yis sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs thad du nub gling par slob rung la nub gling can du bsgyur rung / 'on kyang gzhi rtsa'i rmang gzhi dang ngo bo rang nyid kyi yin dgos/ zhes pa'i rmang gzhi ni skad dang ngo bo ni rang mtshan pa'i khyad chos la go yang / bod kyi gna' rabs snyan ngag la mi rigs wa 160 wa

rang mtshan pa'i khyad chos nyung ba dang brjod bya'i srog la lad zlos che ba sogs zhan cha mi nyung ba yod pas/ snyan ngag gsar pa 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉yi 'bri srol dar khyab ha cang mgyogs/ rtsom pa po grags can ko ki li yis 〈〈rtsom rig gi srol rgyun 'thab rtsod 〉〉ces pa'i nang du snyan ngag pa ji 'dra'i grags can zhig yin na de la mi rigs kyi khyad chos de ltar ldan pa'ang / khos mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i bsam blo'i phyogs mang 'dzin thub pas yin/ zhes pa ltar no per rtsom rig bya dga' thob pa'i phyi gling pa'i brtsams chos kyi brjod bya mang shos kyang ches spyir btang pa'am ches rjes lus mtha' 'khob kyi yul srol goms gshis dang / sems kyi 'gyur ba sogs mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i khyad chos gtsor 'dzin pa yin/ 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉yi rtsom pa pos mtho snang gi khyad chos yal du ma bcug par bod mi'i mdzes dpyod kyi goms gshis ltar dpe don gang yin yang bod yul gyi ri sul dang / gtsang 'gram/ nags klong / rong 'brog khul gyi dper 'os 'tshams re sbyar te 6 rbab chu'i nyalang tsho'am gzhon nu'i lang tsho de'i mdzes sdug phyi ru bkrams/66kye 'di ni rang bzhin gyi rbab chu dkyus ma zhig ma yin te/brjid cing rngam pa'i nyams/'jigs pa med pa'i snying khyed kyi dus rabs kyi bzhur sgra snyan mos/nga tsho la gzi brjid dang stobs shugs bstsal/ miXzhes mi rigs shig la bcangs pa'i yun ring gi re 'dun de tha snyad snying po med pa dang rdo chag btsan sgrig ltar gyis mtshon pa min par shin tu bab chags pa dang / 6 rbab chu'i mi byed las dang bla med kyi snying stobs kyang mi sems kyi dang ba 'dren pa'i dpe don kyis bstar/ lhag par 'byung 'gyur gyi — 161 —

bdag po ste na gzhon dag nas rdog rtsa gcig sgril dang rbab chu ltar spobs sems chen pos mdun nas mdun du bskyod pa ni ji 'dra'i las gal chen po zhig red ang / nga tsho ste gangs can pa rnams la deng gi dus 'dir rong 'brog dang / grub mtha' sogs phyogs gang mang zhig nas mthun sgril ces pa ji 'dra'i gal chen zhis yin pa'i nges shes su la'ang yod kho thag yin/nga tshos khong nyid kyi 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉bklags kyin bklags kyin dngos su snyan rtsom nang gi mdzes ljongs der slebs pa'am brjod yul mtha' dag mig gis re re bzhin dngos su mthong ba lta bu'i myong tshor 'char thub pa dang / klog pa po rnams la rang nyid kyi mdzes dpyod nyams myong yod zin mod/'on kyang de ni nyi 'od lta bu gsal thag chod pa zhig min par zla 'od dang skar ma'i 'od ltar rab sgrub dang mi mngon pa zhig yin/ myong ba de gsal brjod byed par/glo bur du/ 6 sngo zhing bsangs pa'i nam mkha'/dro zhing 'jam pa'i nyi 'od/ ces pa ste/ shin tu mdzes pa'i phyi yul gyi rnam pa dag rang nyid kyis bshad 'dod kyang bshad ma btub par lus 'dug pa de lhug par brjod yod pa mthong tshe/ klog mkhan rnams la yid rab tu myos pa'i dga' snang dang spyabakā pa zhig sbyin par byed pa bcas ni mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i khyad chos sa 'a/tsho/ ba'i rnam pa dang dga' skyo sogs kyi snang ba dang bstun zhing mtshon pa'i tshig gi mtshams sbyor dang / ring thung / 'gyur khug 'degs 'jog sogs gsal zhing mnyam pa ni snyan zhing 'jibs pa'i khyad chos yin te/sna khyed la 'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs dang /bzhum pa med pa'i spobs pa/— 162 —

genyams pa med pa'i zil shugs/yin/mi 'dzad mtha' med pa'i stobs shugs 'di lta bu zhig ji ltar rgyas pa zhes pa'i tshig gi kha stabs dam zhing grim na'ang / mnyen cha che zhing brjod bde ba/ zlos skyon gyi cha kun nas spangs pas dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug dang tshig gi snyan ro bla lhag tu ldan pa yin/ snyan ngag ni 'jig rten gyi ches snum pa'i skad chas grub pa dang / snyan ngag gi dge mtshan jo mo glang ma'i dbu rtse ji bzhin nam yang 'jig rten gyi mtho sar grong nger 'gying 'dug 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉yi rtsom pa po ni bod rigs snyan ngag pa zhig yin pa'i ngos nas bod zhen bcos min zhig yod pa gzhir bzhag pa'i steng / bod skad gtsang ma zhig dang bod srol yang dag cig shes stabs/ brjod pa'i skad cha rnams drang po dang gsal po/ tshad mthon po dang dag mo'i sgo nas bshad yod pas bod rigs klog pa po rnams dang bar thag je nyer song yod/ g.yar brkus ma yin pa'i mi rigs rang gi tha snyad dag rang gi snyan ngag lha mo'i mgul rgyan du gsol bas ldem 'khyug 'khyug gi sgyu 'phrul klong nas klog mkhan khri stong gi dran 'dzin ma lus 'phrog pa'i chom rkun zhig tu gyur yod pa red/mkhas pa'i dbang po dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ 6 rgya skad kyi skor la shin tu ngan pa zhig ni/ rang re'i mkhas pa thams cad kyis legs sbyar shin tu don zab skad byas te yig 'bru re re'i nang nas don 'dzad med re bton te/blun po thams cad lang la 'chor ba zhig byas/mi ②zhes rgya gar gyi skad bkol ba mchog tu bzung ste tshigs bcad lhug gang rung gis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kyi mtshan gyi thog mar rgya gar skad du zhes rgya gar skad bris pa bstan bcos rnam dag dang khungs btsan pa'i mtshon rtags su brtsi la/ gzhung dngos sam rtsom gyi brjod bya 'bri skabs bya dngos 'ga' rer bod la ming yod — 163 —

bzhin du rgya gar ba'i ming bkol ba ma zad yi ge'ang bkol ba mi nyung ba yod de/ 6 sde pa rin spungs pa'i 〈〈chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam par rgyal ba la phul ba'i zhu 'phrin rig 'dzin pho nya 〉〉zhes par/ gang der dang po'i ngang pa byudma'i/ /zhun ma gaṅgā steng ba'i arga dang / /legs bshad maṇḍar ba'i me tog gis/ /zhes pa lta bu tsheg bar dgu ma can gyi tshig rkang gsum gyi nang du'ang rgya gar ba'i lugs srol dang skad kyi shan chen po zhugs yod de/ beeḍūrya'i dang gaṅgā/ arga/ maṇḍarabacas bzhi tsam bkol bas bod rang gis lta ba las rgya gar bas bltas na don la tshod dpag byed sla ba 'di 'dra shin tu mang / de yang 'jar man dang dbyin ji'i yi ge'i bar la 'brel ba dam yang rtsom dang gzhung 'bri dus skad dang yi ge bsres te 'bri mkhan yod mi srid la yod kyang ga la rung / bod rang gi yi ge bkol te rtsom 'bri skabs legs sbyar gyi skad dang yi ge bkol ba mkhas par bgrang ste mthe bong gnam la gtad na/ bod rang gi skad dang mthun pa'i ming tshig brjod pa spel ba'i gzhung sogs rtsom pa'i dgos pa ci mchis/ lhag par sdug bsngal gyi tshab la legs sbyar gyi skad duḥkha 'bri mkhan de bas kyang mang bas slob 'bring slob mas rtsom sbyong dus duḥkha sogs bkol thub pa slob ma rab la brtsi ba ni skyon chen po zhig yin/miXzhes pa ni don la gnas pa'i bden gtam kho nar mi 'dod dam/nga tshos phyogs ris kyi zhen sems spangs te gong gi tshig rkang re re'i nang legs sbyar gyi ming bkol ba'i snyan tshig rkang pa gsum der zhib tu bsams na/ der thun min gyi yon tan nam dge mtshan 'di 'dra dang de 'dra mchis zhes brjod par mgrin pa'i ngag sgo lkugs par 'gyur ba ma zad/ spyir btang gi don la'ang sgro 'dogs chod dka' ba dang / snyan tshig de bklags pas klog pa po'i lus sems la zad mtha' bral ba'i stobs shugs dang re ba zhig de bas kyang sbyin dka' ba red/ de las ldog ste/ 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉yis bod — 164 —

rang gi skad 4bzlo'i yon tan gyi nying bcud bsdus nas/'groshā tā/ma/ pa'i glu sgra de ni/bod gangs can gyi gzhon nu'i gom sgra red/'od gsal gyi lam chen/gzi brjid kyi las 'gan/bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba/'thab 'dzing gi glu dbyangs/rbab chu'i lang tsho la yal ba med cing /lang tsho'i rbab chu ni de bas kyang nyams pa med/mi ces brjod pa ni mi sems g.yo ba'i rol dbyangs shig dang / mdun du skul ba'i ngar skyed glu gzhas shig min nam/ sems la dran pa med cing lus po nad kyis bzung ba'i nad pa gdan 'byar zhig min na glo mchin gyi bar dang snying khung gi gting nas nyal ba'i ngar shugs kyis bus pa de yar slong mi thub pa ga la srid de/ mi srid do/ /tshor 'du ni snyan ngag pa phal che ba'i snyan rtsom du mngon gyur dang / bag la nyal ba'i tshul du yod pa smos ma dgos kyang / 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉las mngon pa ltar rna bas thos rgyu dang / sems kyis zin rgyu yod pa 'di lta bu ni/ sku zhabs 'das po don grub rgyal gyi snyan rtsom 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉ma gtogs/ phyis byung snyan rtsom gsar pa gang du'ang mthong rgyu nyung bar 'dod/ de'i phyir/ khong gis rtsom stangs 'di'i thad nas bod kyi snyan ngag gsar pa'i gsar rtsom la sngar med pa'i gson shugs dang mdzes chos bsnan yod de/ rtsom hril po'i ngos nas bltas na/ khong nyid kyis bod mi rigs la bcangs pa'i brtse dung sam/ shugs drag pa'i tshor 'du de bkod ma'i chu ltar shag shag tu 'bab bzhin yod la/ de ltar 'bab thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso — 165 —

bo zhig ni bod mi rigs rang gi skad brda'i yon tan la brten pa sha stag go/2 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉yis mi rigs kyi snying stobs dang phugs bsam/re smon bcas shugs drag tu mtshon pa/tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa tshogs pa nas bzung / rgyal yongs dang 'dra bar bod mi rigs kyi bsam pa'i 'du shes thad du sngar bas bcings 'grol thob ste/ rgyun srol gyi snyan ngag 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed pa ma zad/ mi rigs gzhan gyi rang mos snyan ngag la sogs par slob sbyong dang / mig dpe byas nas de tsho'i nying bcud rnams blangs pa dang 'brel/ bod rang gi snyan ngag gsar pa'i 'bri srol zhig gi lam 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉nas gsar du btod pa red/ rtsom tshul gyi rnam pa gsar pa 'di dus rabs kyi rjes su dam por 'brangs shing / dus rabs kyi snying stobs sogs legs par mtshon pa ni dus rabs kyi dgos mkho dang mi rnams kyi re smon dang yongs su 'tsham/ lhag par de sngon dus skabs shig gi ring la bod kyi snyan rtsom gyi nang don bstod pa kho na'i rjes su 'brangs pas/nang don thad rgya chung zhing gu dog pa/ ris su chad pa'i gnas gcig kho nar mnyam snang 'jog pa'i rtsom srol ngan pa zhig chags grabs byed pa'i skabs der/ 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉yis/6 rnying zhen/ bag 'khum/ rmongs dad/le lo nga tsho'i mi rabs 'dir 'jug yul gtan nas med/rjes lus/kla klo/ mun nag log spyod nga tsho'i dus rabs 'dir gnas pa ye nas med/rbab chu ya rbab chu/’zhes dus rabs kyi nyams 'gyur shugs drag cing / mi rigs kyi snying stobs mkha' la 'phyo bzhin pa'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i legs nyes dang bde sdug — 166 ge

la sogs khyab khongs tshang ma mtshon pa'i rtsom srol gsar pa zhig gi dbu brnyes bar byas/snying stobs dang spobs pas rab tu khengs pa'i 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉klog skabs nga tshos thog mar tshor thub pa ni bod mi rigs kyi snying stobs kyi gom sgra yin cardo/dinibod gangatā can gyi gzhon nu rnams kyi lang tsho'i rbab chu red/'di ni dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i bod rigs gzhon nu rnams kyi gsar gtod kyi snying stobs/'thab 'dzing gi nyams 'gyur/lang tsho yi glu sgra red/ ces pa'i tshig dang snang brnyan re re'i nang du rang re bod mi rabs gsar pa de rmongs gnyid las sad pa dang / 'od rnon 'khyug pa'i spyan zung dag gis ma 'ongs pa'i mdzes ljongs la dmigs nas gom stabs chen pos mdun du bskyod pa'i snying stobs gson po re re mthong thub/der ma zad/6 khyed kyi chu shel dang 'dra ba'i sems la'ang /lo rgyus kyi rma kha/dmag 'khrug gi nad rnying /rmongs dad kyi chu bur/rnying zhen gyi rdul phran sogs mchis kyang srid med/ zhes the tshom dang 'jigs snang gang yang med par rnying zhen dang bag 'khums kyi bsam blo rnying par sun 'byin pa dang / nga tsho'i bod mi rigs 'di yar rgyas 'gro dgos na/smyo dus dang mthun pa'i srog gi dbang po ma zhugs na/— 167 —

yar rgyas kyi 'phar rtsa lding mi srid la/sngon thon gyi snying khrag rgyu mi thub cing /mdun bskyod kyi gom pa ni de bas kyang ngo / /mi zhes rnying pa dang srol rgyun kho na don gnyer gyis/ deng dus 'dzam gling gi tshan rig dang rig gzhung la sogs pa'i shes yon gsar pa'i cha 'phrin rnams snang med du bzhag na/ rjes lus kyi rkang sgrog las thar thub rgyu lta zhogami rigs rang la mdun lam gang yang med pa'i bden don gyi tha tshig nan por bsgrags pa dang /4 'gros mnyam pa'i glu sgra de/bod gangs can gyi gzhon nu'i gom sgra red/ ces tshan rig dang rig gzhung gi mkha' lam yangs por bskyod nas gsar gtod dang rtsad zhib kyi snying stobs yangs pa'i blo ldan tshor bstod pa dang 'brel/ dus rabs gsar pa'i bod rigs na gzhon rnams kyi spobs pa dang / phugs bsam/ re smon la sogs mtshon par byas shing / mi rigs dar rgyas yong bar byed pa'i las 'gan rlabs po che de nga tsho re re'i phrag steng du babs pa'i las 'gan zhig yin pa'i brda gsal por sprad nas/ rlabs chen gyi las 'gan de mngon 'gyur yong ched nga tshos sgyid lug mi byed par la rgya brtan pos brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten dgos pa'i bslab bya snying la sim pa gnang 'dugasnyan ngag pa'am rtsom pa po su dang gang yin yang rang gi gshis la nyal ba'i tshor 'du de rten gzhi zhig la gnas ma spor gong gi gnas skabs 'ga' zhig rab rib mi gsal ba dang / 'ga' zhig tshor 'du gzhan dang 'dres nas rang rkya mi thub pa/ 'ga' zhig 'byung sla la yal yang sla bas mi brtan pa/'ga' zhig sems kyi myong ba tsam las mi phal mo ches brjod du med pas mi — 168 —

mngon pa/ 'ga' zhig ya rabs kyi ngo bo dang ldan yang ngan zhen gyis bslad nas mi gtsang ba sogs kyi skyon gang mang zhig yod cing snyan rtsom du de dag spang nas/ gsal ba/ 'bur du thon pa/ dwangs shing gtsang ba bcas kyi rnam pa zhig tu mngon dgos pa dang / 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉la srog dbang gsar pa ste rtsom pa posdi 6ga/sna /kye sems khams gsar pa de zhugs pa red/bosdo gangatā can gyi gzhon nu rnams kyi lang tsho'i rbab chu red khyed la lang tsho'i rngam brjid dang skyes stobs kyi dpal dang ldan pas/ dgun gsum gyi tsag gis khyed kyi sems/mchis la/mi ge'akhyag rom gyi sgrom du 'jug pa'i go skabs ni nam yang ma zhes brjod 'dod kyi dmigs yul de mngon sum du bstan zhing par la blos btags shing gnas spar ba ste/ bod gangs can gyi gzhon nu rnams kyi spobs pa dang gshis ka de 6 rbab chu min steng spos pa dang / rbab chu yi gzugs brnyan du bod mi rigs dang lhag par gzhon nu rnams kyi snying stobs bstims yod/ lus po rbab chu yin yang srog dbang bod kyi yin/ bod mi rigs kyi srog dbang de rbab chu'i gzugs brnyan la gnas spor rjes/ snyan ngag mkhan rang yang rbab chu de la ya mtshar te/sna kye kye/rbab chu yi lang tsho ya/lang tsho yi bab chu/’zhes 'bod skabs snyan ngag mkhan pos rang gi snying khong gi zhen sa de rang rgyud las phral te rbab chu la gnas bcas pa yin/snyan rtsom hril po dus rabs kyi tshor 'du drag po dang mi rigs shig la — 169 —

bcangs pa'i lhad med brtse dung gis zin cing / khag 'khur gyi sems dang spobs pas khengs pa'i phugs bsam dang re smon ni tshig 'bru re rer 'khol zhing / ngo mtshar ba dang yid myos pa/ brtson snyeg bcas mnyam 'dres kyi tshor snang las klog pa por smon pa 'chor ba'i tshor snang bskyed cing / 'tsho ba zhig bis mi tshe dang 'jig rten la shes rtogs dang go ba gsar pa zhig len par skul bar byed de/mi mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i sngon chad kyis da lta'i tshab byed so rung la/ ba tshwa'i dri dang 'grogs pa'i kha sang gis de ring gi skom pa ga la da/ces pas/ snyan rtsom gyis nga tsho tshang ma rang rang gi 'char rtog gi stobs che chung ltar yun ring du smon zhing snyeg pa'i sang nyin te 'jig rten gsar pa zhig la brtson snyeg byed du 'jug pa ni phugs bsam gyi lag len yin/'dir snyan ngag mkhan gyi shugs drag pa'i tshor 'du dang phun sum tshogs pa'i kun rtog la brten nas/ rbab chu'i 'gog med kyi khyad chos sam nyams la bod gangs can gyi gzhon nu rnams kyi rang gshis dang spobs pa/'grog med kyi snying stobs sogs 'gyur ba'i srog zhugs pas/ gson nyams ldan zhing nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pas gtams par gyur cing / klog pa po rnams kyi yid g.yo ba'i shugs dang ldan no/ /dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/gsaladu/ don grub rgyal gyi 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉zhes pa 1983lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉steng ②〈〈dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom 〉〉deb dang po/ 1990lo/ bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang / shog ngos 221pa/— 170 —

()ban de mkhar gyi 〈〈bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom rig gi legs nyes blangs dor gyi cha che long tsam brjod pa〉〉/〈〈krung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉〉/1993lo'i deb 2pa/dang po/sdug snang gis khyer ba'o snyan ngag dang snyan ngag gi sdug snang /ljang bu/ (skyes ming rdo rje tshe ring 1963wa )ni sog rigs yin te mtsho sngon ho nan rdzong du skyes pa dang / dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i nang rtsom rig gi las kur zhugs/ khos bod rgya yig rigs gnyis kyi thog nas rtsom rig brtsams chos spel myong ba las phal che ba 〈〈snang bu'i rtsom btusawa4myug rtsom deb 〉〉dang 〈〈snang bu'i rtsom btus/snyan ngag deb 〉〉ces par bsdus yod/ 2001lor snyan deb gnyis pa 〈〈snyan rtsom gzi mig dgu pa 〉〉par du bskrun/ dka' tshegs che ba'i 'tsho stangs 'di'i 'grul bzhud khrod khong gis rgyal khrag gi bzhur rgyun yod tshad gsar rtsom gyi ched du bstims te/snga phyir sgrung gtam dang snyan ngag lhug rtsom sogs rtsom lus mi 'dra ba'i ༷rtsams chos 'bor chen bris nas bod spyi tshogs steng 'grems 'tshong byas pa da/ljang bus rgyal phyi rgyal nang gang gi rtsom stangs ci zhig spyad nas bris pa yin na'ang dga' skyo chags sdang sogs kyi nyams 'gyur bla lhag gis thon 'dug pa ni/ ljang mdog gi tshe srog gtan du sngo ba'i 〈〈g.ya' shing gi lo ma 〉〉las mched pa'i bcos min snying gi 'phar sgra la yid sems g.yo ba'i nus shugs lhag par ldan la/ gsog gsob dang bcos ma min pa'i brtse dung gi rgyan chang mngar mos gzhon skyes klog pa po grangs med cig myos par byas shing / snyan ngag pas rtog snang gis bskyed pa'i snyan ro'i zhing khams su klog mkhan khri stong mang po zhig khrid song ba dang / sgyu rtsal gyi phyogs nas 'phrod — 171 —

bde gsal brjid dang / snyan 'jebs dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug ldan la/mtshams mtshams su/6 chu thigs kyi dwangs gsal 'tsher ba'i g.ya' lo gnyis/mchu dang mchu phrad pa'i skad cig ma de la/g.ya' lo las dmar ba'i yid sems gnyis 'dres byung /wa sprug thigs dang khrag 'dres pa ji bzhin//le lce dang me lce 'dres pa ji bzhin/ ①zhes blo yul las 'gongs pa'i sgyu 'phrul rtsom stangs kha shas spyad/ gong gsal snyan rtsom dum bu 'di'i tshig sbyor gyi 'gros rgyun ldan du byas na tsa khrag thigs dang khrag thigs 'dres pa ji bzhin/ g.ya' lo las dmar ba'i yid sems gnyis 'dres byung /mi zhes na bod skad rnal mar 'khums shing / gtan tshig dang brda sprod gang la'ang 'gal med mod/ 'on kyang 'dir snyan ngag pas 6 blo las 'gongs pa'i sgyu 'phral gyi rtsom stangs mi te/ tshig 'gros ldog pa'i sgyu rtsal spras stangs kyis skad ༄char lha bar stong mi bskrun pa dang sgyu rtsal gyi ro bro gzhan zhig thon par byas/〈〈so lta dang gzab nyan 〉〉las kyang / 6 nga tshos 'di las myangs pa ni brtse dung zhig lag len du bstar ba'i grub cha zhig gi rang gzugs dang / rtsom mkhan gyis bzhengs pa'i snang brnyan de las go lon byung ba'i rang dbang gi brtse dung zhig gi rin thang yin/ 6 g.ya' shing gi lo ma gnyis dam du 'khyud/dmar chung gi sems pa gnyis gcig tu bsdongs/ de ni bde skyid cig dang rang dbang gi sngon 'gro dang / 6 sems pa gnyis dang yid sems gcig gi thog ma'i gom stabs red/ bsdus brjod dang rab btags las phyi ngos kyi ca g.ya' lo de'i khor yug dang gnas bab/ nyams snang bcas kyis rjo dmar chung gi sems pa mi gnyis kyi rang gshis de mngon mtshon byas yod pa — 172 —

las gzhan/ phyi bkod kyi ram 'degs 'og klog mkhan la'ang rtog 'char gyi bar stong chen po zhig bstsal 'dug mi②ces pas khong gi sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs gtso bo de bstan yod pa red/snyan ngag pa phul du byung ba zhig yin na/ thabs sna tshogs kyis dus rabs kyi 'pho 'gyur dang / 'jig rten pho mo'i brtse zhen/ khor yug nges can zhig gi myong snang / spyi mthun 'gro ba'i kun spyod dang bde sdug mtho dman gyi bar khyad dang btsan gnyom/ rtsom pa po'i bsam blo'i 'khyer so dang mi tshe'i lta tshul/ rin thang lta tshul sogs klog pa po'i zas su bstab dgos med/ sgyu gu'i 'khyug 'gros tsam dang sems kyi 'gyur bag gcig gis thams cad gsal zhib tu brjod thabs med pas/ me tog gcig gis dus tshigs dang / rdul phran gcig gi grub tshul las 'jig rten khams chen po'i gshis lugs shes thub pa ltar/ ljang bus g.ya' shing gi lo ma g.yar te na chung pho mo zung gi thog ma'i dungs brjod kyi sems gshis te/ ngo gnong dang dogs gnas/ sems chung gi yid nyams sogs gzugs can bzhin ri mo'i lam nas mtshon pa dang / 〈〈nga rang sbar chog 〉〉ces pa'i nang du'ang dud 'gro'i rtsi ba brjod gzhir bzung nas de'i rang nyid thal bar 'gro bzhin bod kyi 'brog pa'i sbra gur re re'i nang du 'od snang dang drod 'jam sbyin pa'i khyad chos brjod skabs/ snyan ngag pa grags pa'i rjes su 'brang med par rang nyid 'tsho ba'i spyi tshogs dang rang byung gi khor yug der bed spyod kyi rin thang yod pa'i yul dag bdams nas de dag la gang zag gi rgyud kyi yon tan spor nas gsal ston byas yod/ljang bus nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dngos gzhi'i 'dzin gyur slob gnyer byed skabs/ khor yug gi yul ljongs ma lus yid ngor mdzes shing ra ris ma gos pa zhig tu snang gshis na gzhon snyan ngag pa des spro sems dang brtse dung gis phyug cing / re bas khengs pa'i sgyug rtse mtho sgang gi yul phyogs — 173 —

kun tu spyi tshogs yar rgyas dang 'tsho ba je legs/ bsam blo gu je yangs su 'gro ba'i rab mdzes me tog lhug par bzhad pa'i yul khams su btsugs te/〈〈g.ya' shing gi lo ma 〉〉dang 〈〈dgun gyi bu mos dpyid kyi na chung sbrum 〉〉sogs bris te ma 'ongs par rgyang lta dang / na gzhon rtsom pa po de'i phyi nang gsang gsum ma lus 'phrul snang gi bag la zhugs shing rmi lam gyi zhing khams 'grims/ mtho sgang gi gnas bab dngos ni rig gnas dang dpal 'byor sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas 6 dgun migyi dus tshigs su gnas kyang / re ltos kyis khengs pa'i ra dpyid kyi na chung mngal du sbrum mizhing srid jus bzang po lag tu bstar ba'i bskal pa bzang po'i snga ltos shig gi rang mdangs de'ang gangs ri'i ra bas bskor pa'i ljongs yongs su shar bas/ skabs thog der mdzad pa'i snyan rtsom nang du rtsom pa po'i sems khong las byung ba'i dga' 'bod dang /spyi tshogs 'tsho bar yid ches byed pa'i re ba bcol yod/snyan ngag pa yi dam tshe ring gis lha chags snang gnyis kyis snyan ngag pa'i spro sems kyi me chen sbar ba yin la/ chags sdang gnyis kyis snyan ngag pa'i dbang rtsa'i nus pa sad par byas pa yin/ su zhig gis snyan ngag pa la mdza' brtse las sdang sems med pa yin zhes zer/ du phyi nang snyan ngag pa rnams kyi snyan rtsom gyi shugs drag pa'i rtog 'char gyi klong la nyul zhing ngo mtshar mdzes sdug bkra ba'i yid khams kyi bdud rtsir rol ba'i ljang bus re ba dang mos 'dun snyim pa gang gi tshul gyis spyi tshogs su zhugs pa na/ de ni gzhon nu'i phugs bsam khrod kyi 'jig rten de dang bar thag ring bar bkyed cing / snyan ngag par mi tshe'i dka' sdug lan dang por 'phrad snang shar ba dang / de dang chabs cig sngon chad byung ma myong ba'i 'tsho gnas kyi 'jig nyen zhig kyang snying khong gting la yun gyis 'jab 'ong ba'i tshor snang ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes/ snang tshul 'di dag rnam kun ljang bu'i chags sdang gi me dpung drag nas — 174 —

drag tu sbar byed kyi bud shing lta bur gyur pa dang / dus de nas bzung 6 smra ba je nyung je nyung du phyin cing / kher rkyang gi sdug snang las dbang gi zhing sar btab par lam sang rtsa ba zug nas myu gu 'bus pa des/ snyan ngag pa'i bsam /zhig byerdo stangs dang sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs bcas la shan shugs chen po bsa~X ༵ /khro/ snyan ngag khrod kyi myong rol bya dka' ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi gsang ba dang / ngo mtshar ba'i blos bslangs dang yid brnyan skrun stangs/ khyab che ba'i bsam blo'i bkod shugs/ rtog gzhig rags mos thag bcad pa'i gtan tshigs dang spyi sdom yod tshad kyi dge mtshan phyogs gzhan zhig nas bstan yod de/ 6 gzhan yang 'di phyi dus gsum gzigs pa'i dge bshes bla grwa tshor mtshon na/ rtsom rig ces pa ni khong tshos 6 bzhes sa kyin pa'i sha tshon po dang zho gsar pa/ mar dwangs ma/ sbrang dkar rtsam pa sogs dang 'brel ba med pa'i ldebs ris cho med re yin la/ rang re'i las byed pa tshos kyang zla phogs nyung nyung re am phrag la 'jug zhor 'tsho ba'i kha gsab ste rtsom yon phran bu'i phyir 6 gsar rtsom nya mdzad dus ngag nas 6 mi rigs dang 6 dus rabs mi sgyu rtsal mi dang 8 ring lugs mi sogs gleng na khyod kyis ji ltar dran gyin 'dug sotami①ces pas/ ljang bu ni ljid tig tig gi 'gan 'khri'i 'du shes dang 'jig nyen gyi tshor shes yod mkhan zhig yin pa dang / kho'i sems kyi rta rgod de sdug snang gi sum sgrog phra mos dam du 'chang zhing mnar gyin yod pa ni 66nga yiphrophon che ba'i smeng sems kyi gong bumo re chad dang re ba mnyam 'dres kyi migaskong yi ci yang mi mthong la ci yang mi tshor ba'i( gor ma rdo lta bu'i rma khamo ’()zhes pa las kyang myong tshor thub la/ ltos sa ltos 'jog gis bshad na/khong ni don dam gyi snyan ngag par bgrang chog pa yin/ khong gis spyi tshogs steng gi ngan shugs mtha' dag la rgyab gtod phod pa dang / rang gshis rno zhing blo — 175 —

khog gsal ba can sha stag yin/ kho'i khyad chos gtso bo zhig ni dus ji 'dra zhig dang gnas ga 'dra zhig tu'ang rang gi bla srog 'tshong mi srid pa dang /thog ma nas snyan ngag 'bri dgos byung don yang mi'i dung zhen gyi rang dbang dang rang gshes kyi drang bden/ dwangs gtsang gi khor yug cig gi ched du yin/rtsom rig ces pa de'ang mi tshe sbar nas gsal bar byed dgos pa'i gzab nan gyi 4 bya ba mi zhig tu lta ba dang / mi rigs shig gi ches rin thang bral ba'i gnas dag skabs 'gar mi rabs rjes ma gsod mes gtong byed du 'gro yang srid pas/ 64nga tshos nam yang rang nyid gsal thag chod cig mthong thabs bral bas na mirang dbang bral zhing shes ma gsal gyi ngang rang nyid 64lcags rdang la 'gro ba : de yi mug cing zhe mer ba'i tshe srog gi tsa sbyin sreg ’ cig min na ci yin/ khos rgyun par shugs drag pa'i tshor 'du yis tshe srog gi sgra dbyangs thol gyis drangs shing rang bzhin gyis bzhur 'ong ba rang gi snyan ngag tu 'bri la/ rgyu rkyen mang po'i dbang gis tshor 'du'i 'phyo shugs gnyom dus/khu sum mer mno bsam gtong ba ma gtogs/ snyan ngag ched du sna bzo ’ ba'am btsan gyis 6 sgrig rimi srid pa gshis lugs su chags/〈〈snyan ngag pa 〉〉las/6 kha ba thengs shig babs pa'i mtshan mo derasnyan ngag pa dus zing dang yul byar las skyes byungachos 'khor lha sa dran glu yi gri gu rnon po zhig gisagazhis byes mtha' dag kha phyogs bral ba'i snying tshil ngos sunyams rgyad dang 'grogs pa'i gdung shugs zab mo zhig brkos song ’ ( gong mtshungs 〉khong ni nam yang snyan ngag gi bzhur rgyun mi nyams pa'i snyan ngag pa 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur srid min da dung bshad dka' na'ang / kho rang gi — 176 —

brtsams chos nang bzhin gyi 6 dus zing dang yul gyar migyi 'tsho bzhes de ma gzhi nas snyan ngag cig min nam/ sems pa mtha' dag khe phan gyis bsnad pa'i dus skabs 'di lta bur/6 phrag pa gang rung du khur ba'i 'degs shing gi sne mo gnyis sun gzhon gyi gdung sems shig dang bag yangs kyi mi tshe zhig khur 'dug ( gong mtshungs )ces pa dang / kho'i phugs 'dun gyi gnya' bar bde skyid dang rang dbang gi rdog khres rtsi mo zhig gis gnon bzhin mi che1re bshul lam bgrod pa'i gom 'gros dag dka' sdug gis gzhus nas byes su bsgyur cing / tha na rang gis kyang bshad mi shes la thob yang ma myong ba dang / tha na 'jig rten 'dir yod med kyang bshad dka' ba'i snye dngos po mi zhig sga don du brtson len byed bzhin 'dug kho'i snyan ngag gi sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba yang mthar gtugs na tshor snang ban bun la zha ba'i lkog tu gyur pa'i ham pa'i thob blo de la thug 'dugasnyan rtsom 〈〈nga yi bod 〉〉ces pas 'go brtsams ma thag sna ri rab dang gtsang po'i 'tshang gas khod ma snyoms pa'i spang ljongs chen po zhes bod yongs kyi rang byung khor yug de ri mo'i lam nas ldebs ris chen mo zhig tu bkod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi yang rtser 'tsho ba'i mi rigs zhes snyan pa 'phur don yang 'di nas gsal kha btod la/ nga tshor de lta bu'i yul ljongs yod pas da gzod 'jig rten gyi gru gar kher rkyang du phud pa'ang yin/ ri rab dang gtsang po/ rang byung gi srung yol mthug po 'dis dus yun ring po zhig la nga tsho 'jig rten gzhan dang 'brel ba rbad de bcad pas phyi rol 'jig rten gyi 'gyur ldog dus thog tu shes tshor byung ma thub la/ tha na de rang gi gnas yul dang 'brel ba yod pa'ang ma shes par dus rabs kha shas 'das pa'i nyes — 177 —

dmigs deng gi dus 'dir 'khur dgos byung / ri rab dang gtsang po/ rang byung gi lcags ri btsan po 'dis nga tsho'i rgyal khams 'dir bsam blo gsar pa dang lag rtsal gsar pa 'byung bar gegs byas pa dang / tshan rig gi blo mig ldongs song ba des lan pa los yin/6 ri rab ni 'tshang ga shig shig gi rtswa skya'i tshogs dngagatsang chab chu ni rtswa rkang la 'byar ba'i zil ba dag yin ’zhes pa las rang cag gi mes pos ri rab dang gtsang chu'i phyi tshul gyi ngos zin tsam las de ni zad du med pa'i 'byung khungs dang / bsgrun du med pa'i bed spyod kyi rin thang ldan pa shes ma thub par rtsom pa po yi mug ste/6 spang ljongs 'disko skom than gyis yongs su zin song zhes smre sngags 'dzer 'dzer du bton/ma 'ongs 'byung 'gyur gyi bod ni/ sna smug rgyu'i grong khyer mi lta bu'i re bzhag gis brtas na'ang / lo rgyus steng gi mtshan snyan mtha' dag sna rgyang ring sa nasamo byi'u chu la bying ba bzhinamo grag med ngang yal gyin pa'i mi snang tshul 'dis/ mig sngar gyi gnas bab dang nyen kha glo bur du tshor bar byas shing 'phag 'tshag phran bu re rgyag 'go brtsams pa de ni zu 'brug sgra med pa'i glog dmar zhig gi 'khyug srol mi zhes gangs ri'i 'jig rten 'di'i gson shugs la re ba dang yid ches kyi phu thag thung ba'i bsam blo 'di shin tu nyam chung ba'i tshe srog zhig gi lta spyod du 'khums/bod pa 'dis lo ngo stong phrag gi ring / smyo kher rkyang gi glu gzhas mi len bzhin smyo mtho sa nas tsog pur bsdad de mi zhes lo rgyus la bston 'dzugs pa'i bsam blo zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes 'dug snyam ste/ mtho sgang gi mi bo che ca'adi yar 'greng ma myong ba zhig ga la srid de/ mi srid do/ /brang khog yangs shing dkyel che ba'i gangs ljongs 'di sna yid sems mi skyid pa dag gi na zug 'bri — 178 —

sa'i rtsig ldebs chen po mi zhes pa ni rang gi 'tsho gnas la mthun rkyen gang 'dzoms bskrun dang skrun bzhin pa'i gnas der ngos zin rnam dag cig skyes pa'i snying gtam yin snyam/mdor na/ ljang bus rang nyid kyi sems khong gi bzod dka' ba'i na zug dang skyo gdung / sdug yus sogs kyi tshor ba dang da lta'i spyi tshogs kyi ya nga ba'i rgyab ljongs de nyid thad kur ma brjod par sna gzi mi lta bu'i dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos mnga' ba'i dngos po zhig sga steng du sgor ba dang / de nyid kyi ngo bo ro gcig tu gyur pa'i sgyu rtsal yul khams lhun gyis grub pa des smra brjod las 'das pa'i 'dang rgyag rgyu zhig dang / bro ba myong rgyu zhig klog pa po'i kun rtog 'phro sa'i yul yangs po zhig bskrun yod pa ma zad/ sgyu rtsal dang mdzes dpyod kyi bar snang gsar pa zhig kyang phyes pa red/dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/par gaX//nga bu'i 〈〈g.ya' shing bi lo ma 〉〉zhes pa 1986lo'i 〈〈sgrang char 〉〉deb bzhi 0yilotshe gruswā kyi 〈〈so lta dang bzab nyan 〉〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 200bye/ sdom ṭwāṃ snyi/ ṅgi 〈〈snyan ngag gi bla srog bshad pa 〉〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khas gis 193lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈com dpyad gtam tshogs 〉〉kyi shog ngos 444sbyarasnadris kta'i/ 〈〈com 'bri ba de las sla bo zhig min par sems 〉〉zhes pa 1998lo'i zla 9pa'i tshes 16nyin gyi 〈〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur 〉〉steng gsal/bis naXrshangalo/ sdi spyan skru shā bsdu shāgazi mig dgu pa 〉〉zhes pa zhang gang gyi lang dpe skrun khang

gnyis pa/ rmongs sad thob pa'i mi rabs gcig gi 'bod sgra/o rgyan rdo rje/ smyug ming ljang gzhon (1961wa ni bod ljongs gra nang rdzong gi zhing grong zhig tu skyes/ 1984lo nas rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi lam du zhugs te snga rjes su snyan ngag gtso byas pa'i brtsams chos 'bor chen zhig bod khul gyi dus deb 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dang 〈〈zang char 〉〉sogs kyi steng du spel bar ma zad/ snyan deb 〈〈mtho sgang gi rlung 〉〉gis mtshon pa'i dpe deb gsum dpe skrun byas pas bod kyi lo bcu'i rtsom rig grub 'bras kyi bya dga' dang / bod yig snyan ngag gsar rtsom gyi dmigs bsal rim pa'i bya dga' sogs thob/1 mig chu la 'phyar ba'i kha sang gi gom 'gros lci mo/na gzhon snyan ngag pa o rgyan rdo rje la mtshon na/ khong nyid kyis dngos su myangs pa'i bod mi rigs kyi zhum med kyi dpa' ngar dang / 'gyur med kyis spobs pa/ bag yangs kyi lta spyod/ gshis bzang gi kun spyod bcas kyis kho'i mi tshe la shan shugs gting zab thebs pa dang / mes po rnams kyi myong brgyud las 'phros pa'i sems kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs sdog 'don byed pa ni/ o rgyan rdo rje thog ma'i kha phyogs dang mig gtod dgos pa'i snyan ngag gi zur sne zhig tu nges/ 1991lor gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang nas lo ngo bzhi bcu 'khor ba'i skyes su phul ba'i 〈〈mi lam 〉〉ni skya rengs shar la nye skabs kyi ldebs ris chen mo zhig yin/ srol rgyun gyi thabs rtsal spyad de dus rabs gsar pa dang rnying pa gnyis zhib bsdur byed pa'i lta ba'i thad nas bltas na/ snyan rtsom 'di ni bod ljongs gsar rnying gnyis kyis gcig tshab gcig gis byed skabs kyi nam mkha' yar langs kyi rnam pa zhig yin/ lo rgyus rgan po'i ri ltar lci ba'i gom 'gros kyis dus nam yang kho la gdong — 180 —

phyogs pa'i mi re re'i snying khong sgul bskyom byed pa dang / de ni dus yun ring zhing skyo sdug gis khengs pa'i 〈〈rmi lam 〉〉zhig yin/ rmi lam gyis bzhag pa'i 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje pha lam lta bu'i rjes shul re re bden drang gis gom 'gros bsgyur zhing 'ong ba'i dus kyi rgan po'i lus steng du ri mo bzhin gsal ngo ra bkod 6lta// zlo sadang / nga tsho'i mig lam du mngon pa ni/rshasdo ༵ ṭī thub pa'i sprin nag chen po zhig mal chas su gyon/blta mi nus pa'i lha sgrung ring po zhig sngas su byas/skyur sil sil gyi sems pa de skyur sil sil gyi sems de grang cang cang gi khog tu bcug ste/gdod ma'i gdan steng du 'gre log yang yang brgyab/miXces pas klog mkhan gyi dran shes de lo rgyus kyi mkha' dbyings su khrid cing 'char rtog ni rang dbang thob pa'i gshog zung bzhin dus dang gnas kyi bkag rgya las brgal ba yin/ 'dir rmi lam de'ang mi rnams nub mor mal la nyal zhing gnyid du zhugs skabs rmis pa'i sgyu ma'i zhing khams kyi rmi lam stong ba de ston pa ma yin par/ mi rigs shig gis shin tu bskal zhing dus yun ring ba'i nang tshe srog gi rgyun mthud pa'i go rim khrod lo rgyus rgan po'i gdong la bris pa'i rgyal kha dang yang na pham kha'i skyi gnyer gting zab pa dag yin la/stobs ldan dang nyam nga 'phrad skabs kyi skad cig ma'i 6 mi lam :de yang yin srid/ de ni snyan ngag pas rang nyid kyi mi rigs 'di'i lo rgyus la phyir mig dang bsam gzhig thengs shig byas pa yin/ bod ljongs kyi 'das don der phyir lta byed par phyogs mang zhing nang don yang mi 'dra ba re yod/ snyan ngag pa zhig la mtshon na/ khos mthong chen byed pa ni lo rgyus 'gyur ldog dus — 181 —

skabs kyi 'das zin pa'i dngos yod kyi myong rol zhig dang / brtse dung gi rlabs rgyun bskyoms rgyu thengs shig yin/ da dung dngos yod spyi tshogs 'di'i nang ltos bcas kyis dngos po'i longs spyod zhan na'ang / bsam blo'i 'jig rten khrod kyi brtan tshugs dang / gsar gtod kyi 'dod 'dun mkhregs la 'khyer zhing / rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i snang tshul der do snang byed kyin yod/ dus tshod kyi bzhur rgyun ring mo'i nang / lo ngo bzhi bcu de mig rdeb cig ring 'das shing / bya dngos ji snyed kyis rang gi ngo bo btang nas rang bzhin gzhan zhig la bstems/ yin na'ang mi re re'i tshe srog gi ngos thad nas bshad na/ tshe srog gi go rim ni nyin zhag gi brje res nang rgyun chad med par gzugs gzhi de rgya bskyed thub pa dang / de bzhin du bsam blo'i 'jig rten yang rgyun chad med par yar bskyed dang phun tshogs su 'gro ba'i go rim zhig yin/ 'das zin pa'i lo 'khor la kha gtod dus/ des rmos pa'i sa gzhi'i steng dka' sdug dang / rngul chu/ khrag thigs kyi rjes shul phab yod pa'i dus mtshungs su/ rtsom mkhan rang nyid kyi rdog sne ru gsar sbol byed pa'i bgrod lam de gsar du phye ba yin pas/ ma 'ong bar re snyeg byed pa'i 'od phran zhig lam lam du 'phro/6 mi lam las 'das pa'i rmi lam gyi yul 'di na/ri bo thams cad bu yug gis btums shing /chu mo thams cad kha ba yis bsgrubs te/keng rus kyi lus phung de grang ngar gyis gdungs/stong nyid kyi sems pa de lhags pa yis khyer/rdzogs mtha' med pa'i srin bya'i skad sgras/ri klung la dbang bsgyur pas/mtshams tshigs med pa'i snying kha des rdig sgra dang 'grogs te/— 182 —

dmigs pa med pa'i rnam shes des rlung bu dang 'grogs te/rmi lam las 'das pa'i rmi lam gyi yul du/gtam rgyud nang gi dpyid dpal de 'tshol bar song mi②zhes pa dang / tsa 'jal thabs bral ba'i skyo shas kyis khengs pa'i phyi yul gyi bkod pa las nang sems kyi tshor 'du de bstan par ma zad/ skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi mun nag der rgol sems kyis stong ba'i thabs med 'u thug gi sems 'dun nam/ phyi ma'i bde ba 'tshol ba'i bod mi'i sgyid lug gi sems lams de'ang shugs su rtogs thub pa yin/ lha sgrung gi thog ma'i 'byung rkyen ni mi'i rigs rang byung khams kyi gnod 'tshe ci rigs la rgol thabs bral ba'i 'u thug gi sems 'dun las byung bar mngon/ der brten rtsom mkhan gyis skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi gdug rtsub dang dbang sgyur pa'i rang mdangs de nges gtan gyi spyod tshul tsam mam rnam pa tsam las ma bstan par phyi yul gyi bkod pa dang bod mi spyi'i sems khams shig las phyir phud pas/ klog mkhan gyi snang ngor 'char ba ni spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa tsam min par rang gi pha mes yang mes rnams kyi phyi nang gnyis ku'i snying rje ba'i nyams snang de rang nus ci lcogs kyis slong skrun byed pa'i bar stong bzos yod par snang /miX der mthud nas rtsom mkhan gyis brjod bya gting je zab tu gtong slad/ de'i 'tsho gnas kyi khor lug las phar brgal te gangs can pa'i rig gnas ngang gshis las grub pa'i sems khams de'ang rang gi tshor snes drangs te/ nga tsho'i snang ngor spyi tshogs rnying pa'i skabs kyi ya nga ba'i phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dang / gnas de ru 'tsho sdod byed pa'i nyam chung 'gro ba rnams kyi dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba phyi yul gyi sding la gzer zhing mig tu gtses pa'i gdug rtsub las rol myong bya thub pa na/de lta bu'i mun nag gi spyi tshogs shig ther 'don byed pa la/ mang che bas — 183 —

thad kur spyi tshogs kyi phyi tshul gyi gnas bab re ston pa dang lhan du rang sems kyi khong khro de'ang kha g.yang tsam du sgrog pas/ snyan rtsom mang shos shig rang dbang med par spyi 'gros 'ba' zhig gi 'dam du mi bying rang bying du gyur/snyan rtsom 'dis skyon de dag sel slad/ rtsom mkhan rang gi tshor 'du de phyi yul gyi 'phel 'gyur dang snang tshul sogs la 'o chu bzhin du 'dres su bcug pas lhad med kyi myong snang ster bar ma zad/ shugs la rtsom mkhan rang gi sems byung ci rigs kyang klog mkhan rang rang gi myong rol du ngal med lhun grub tu rdzogs par 61zlo da'abye/snyan rtsom gyi mjug tu'ang /the tshom ci yang med par 'od zer der dam por 'thams shing /de nas bzung / khyod kyi ngo gdong nas nam yang nub pa med pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig phyung /de nas bzung / khyod kyi yid khams su nam yang rdzogs mtha' med pa'i dro skyid kyi rlung bu zhig ldang /miXsnyan ngag pa o rgyan rdo rjes mes po dag gi mchi mas mer ba'i mig zung brgyud nas khong tshos rmi lam khrod 'tshol snyeg byed pa'i 6 nam yang nub pa med pa'i 'dzum mdangs mi dang lha rdzogs mtha' med pa'i dro skyid mi de mthong ba dang / de bas gzhi khyon yangs pa'i 'tsho ba gsar pa zhig gi rgyab ljongs nyer te gnas 'di la nye bar gtug pa dang / da ltar slebs rag tu de'i don du phul zin pa tshe srog kho na ga la yin srid/snyan ngag hril po la mgo nas mjug bar du lab gleng byed pa lta bu'i mkha' dbugs shig gis gtibs pa dang / 'das don dang 'dra mnyam sgos phan tshun 'greng tshugs su bltas shing / phan tshun gyi snang ngor pha rol po kher rkyang du gnas pa'i myong tshor bden pa zhig skyes bar byas/ rtog btags dang — 184 —
