sgo 'dogs thams cad yar klung gtsang por hril gyis bskyur ba dang / dngos ched kyi yol ras chen po'i ngos su bsam blo'i dpal yon snyeg pa las dngos po'i dpal yon de bas kyang mkho zhing 'gangs rtsa che ba'i brnyan ris shig gsal ler mngon yod/ snyan rtsom gyis skya rengs gsar pa'i snga rjes de ji ltar brgal rgyu dang / ji ltar 'tsho ba gsar pa'i khrod kyi 6 nub pa med pa'i 'dzum mdangs :de 'tshol steg byed rgyu bcas la kun rtog gi shugs bskyed sa'i bar stong zhig kyang bzhag yod/lo zla phrag phrag 'das shing / dka' sdug bi char rlung mang po brgyud pa'i bod ljongs kyi log ngo bzhi bcu 'di ltar brgyud zin pa'i mi re re'i dran pa'i rtsig ldebs su dus gtan du brkos yod/ khong gis ma 'ong ba'i lo rgyus la tshon mdangs snum pa'i sgyug kha thengs shig bskor ba ni/ snyan ngag pas gnon thabs bral ba'i brtse dung gi tshor skyom las 'phos pa'i snyan ngag gi rtog khams gsar pa zhig bzhengs bskrun bgyis pa yin/2 rlung gi gshog pa thogs pa'i sems pa/snyan ngag pa o rgyan rdo rje ni rang nyid kyi mig dbang dang blo rig spyad nas bsam blo phyir mngon mkhas pa zhig yin/ mu mtha' bral ba'i rtswa thang dang /dben zhing stong pa'i nags klong dang rdza klong / yangs shing rgya che ba'i thang chen du khos bsam gzhig gtong thengs mang ba ha lam bod ljongs kyi lo zla'i khrod ji ltar rnam shes kyi mjug mtha'i khyim gzhi 'tshol ba min la/ bden dpang zhig gi brgyud rim nang dbang po lnga'i rgyu cha 'tshol ba'ang min pa 'dra/ kho'i rang rtogs de rang nyid dang gnas 'di'i bar mi rigs gzhan zhig dang 'dra bar brtse dung bral zhing rgyang bkyed pa/ gsal cha med cing ngo mi shes pa zhig min pas/ sems khong gi 'tsho gnas 'di mdzes par brgyan ched rgyan spud lta bu'i 'ud bstod mi dgos shing / dus nam yang 'o chu ltar 'dres shing lus srog — 185 go

ltar 'bral med du gnas yod pas zol bcos kyi 'dzum bag kyang ston mi dgos pa red/ gnas 'di ni snyan ngag pa'i ma yum dang lte khrag 'pho sa nyag gcig yin pas/ sa stong lung stong yin na 'dra/ dbul zhing phongs pa yin na'ang 'dra/ tha na mdog nyes skyug bro than skam la shor ba zhig yin yang khos nam yang de g.yugs bskyur byed mi srid de/ sha khrag ltar 'brel ba'i mi med thang stong dang / ri lung mang po'i ltebs khugs de ci nas kyang dang len byed dgos/ khos sems kyi sgra dbyangs shig bris te mi sems shor ba'i sa gzhi der lo ngo mang po'i ring nyar ba'i brtse sems de gnon dka' bar gyur te/ 〈〈mtho sgang gi rlung 〉〉ni 'di ltar lding 'ong ba zhig yin/tshu sems sdug ni sngar nas yod ma myong /gom bgrod re re ni rang dbang gi glu dbyangs re re yin/ngal dub ni nam yang tshor ma myong /dbugs thengs re re ni stobs shugs kyi gzugs brnyan re re yin/’ rjo'adi ni rang bzhin gyi rlung zhig min te/ mtha' yas pa'i rtswa thang dang dben 'jags kyi ri lung / mtho brjid kyi rdza ri bcas la lo ngo khri stong mang po'i snga rol du skor dkyil rgya mtsho las lding 'ongs pa'i rlung yin la/ khos le dbar stong gi lam tshegs la mi 'jom par dka' sdug bi snying rus bskyed cing / rdzu 'phrul du gzhol ba'i gshog zung la brten nas sprin tshogs kyi bang rim gtor nas ri lung dang / rtswa thang / gtsang 'gram/ nags klong bcas su lding ba dang / mtho sgang gi rlung gis nam mkha'i sprin phung re re brtol nas mu med mtha' la bskyod cing / snyan ngag pa'i sems pa'ang rlung la bcibs te dran shes mtsho 'gram la brdabs pa'i rlabs sgra'i khrod 'phags shing / mtsho bod mtho sgang gi la lung dang ri rgyud/ rtswa thang ded nas 'gros gcig tu gnas 'di'i snod bcud kyi khams la mig gis bltas shing rna bas nyan/ thob 'bras — 186 ge

ni 6 dben 'jam gyi gnyid las sad micing / 6 khu sim mer gtan nas sdod mi thub 9pa'i tshor rtog skyed po zhig 'khrungs shing / de ni rtsom mkhan gyi rang gshis ngang gis phyir mngon pa'ang yin te/ rmongs gnyid las sangs shing go rtogs sad pa'i rtsom pa po'i snang tshor du ri grong gi 'gul med nying 'jags dang dal brel med pa'i yul mi rnams la ngar shugs slong ba'i shu sgra tsam 'don thub na'ang snyam pa'i rtog 'gyu zhig gis/ yun ring du sems gting la sbas pa'i bsam 'dun de bkag sdom gyi rgya las thar bar byas shing / snying khong las thon zhing tshe srog gi 'du shes shugs drag pa'i glu snyan mo zhig rlung la bskur ba dang ri lung kun tu khyab par byas/6 nga rang dben 'jam gyi gnyid las sad tshe/khu sim mer gtan nas sdod mi thub/nga rang ri klung gi pang du gnas rgyur shin tu dga'/mi tshos snang med gtong ba'i lung stong du/nga dang spen rtswa'i nyams 'gyur las bus pa'i shu sgra de/grogs med kher rkyang pa'i skyo glu zhig yin la/nga dang ril ma rkang med kyis 'khrab pa'i bro gar de/sa gzhi yi 'khor mtshams ma chad pa'i mtshon rtags shig kyang yin/ ⑥zhes te/ phyi rol yul gyi 'jig rten dang spyi tshogs su rang gi shes pa'i rtog pa 'jug 'dod kyi bsam blo shugs drag tu bstan pa'i rang gzugs shig dang / skad cig ma'i tshor rtog gis shor med du bzung ba'i 'tsho ba dang tshe srog gi rlung bu zhig kyang yin/ snying rlung mkha' la spur nus pa'i rlung chen gyis mir snying stobs 'dzad med cig sbyin nus pa ma zad/ rtsing zhing rgod pa dang 'jam zhing dro ba'i ngang rgyud kyis bla na ma mchis shing skyo snang ldan pa'i tshe srog gi gshis ka ma lus par mi rnams kyi blo ngor bkram pa dang / rlung gis snyan — 187 —

ngag gi khrod du tshe srog gi me lce sbar zhing / 'dug sdod la rang dbang thob tshul gyis dal bur bskyod pa'i shub sgra dang / drag tu g.yugs pa'i 'ur sgras dben 'jam gyi mtho sgang la tshe srog gi gson shugs rgyas par byas pa red/mtho sgang gi rlung gis dus nam yang mtho sgang mi rigs 'di'i gzhi rgya che zhing / rngam brjid ldan pa'i rig gnas bsam blo zhig mtshon pa dang / rlung gi phyir dran dang / rlung gi dung sems/ rlung gi rang gshis ni mtsho bod mtho sgang gi mi'i lo rgyus ma yin nam/ mtho sgang gi mi'i gshis rgyud dang mi rigs kyi snying stobs/ rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi rtogs sad cig yin/ lo zlas brkos shing bzhag pa'i brnyan ris sna tshogs las gangs rin po che ni bar snang la 'gying ba dang / yum bu bla snang ni nub kha'i nyi zer khrod gzi 'od spro/ ri bo'i gtos dang mtsho mo'i 'jings la 'gran pa'i ma ṇi rdo 'bum sogs las blo rig dang snying rus/brtson sems bcas kyi 'od snang lam lam du 'gyed cing / rang byung khams chen po'i snying stobs kyi 'byung gnas 'di nas 'grig bzhin yod pa shes thub pa red/ nga tshos gzhi la grub pa'i dngos po 'di dag las mi rigs shig gi srol rgyun don snying steng gi rig gnas yul khams dang / yul khams de las mthong ba'i khu sim dang / mi sems skul zhing mes po rnams kyi las dbang dang 'brel ba'i rmu thag gi sne gcig mthong thub/rmu thag gi bshad rgyun gyis nga tsho'i snyan ngag par rgya che ba'i bsam gzhigs kyi stong cha zhig phye ba yin kyang srid/ rmu thag gi sne gcig lha'i gshis dang / cig shos mi'i gshis red/ lha'i gshis 'khyer ba'i khams de gtan du mtshar sdug ldan zhing nga tsho'i rnam shes kyi mchod stegs dang / bod mi rigs 'dis smon pa byed sa'i gnas nyag gcig tu gyur/ de lta bu'i gna' bo'i dus nas chad pa'i sems kyi rmu thag gis nga tsho'i snyan ngag par rang byung la brtsi 'jog dang / tshe srog la gces spras/ mi gshis la cha tshang ba'i rgyus lon byed pa — 188 —

bcas kyi rlabs rgyun 'phyur du bcug nga tsho'i snang bar dus rabs kyi 'gyur ldog dang 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim phun sum tshogs po brgyud de mi rabs gsar pa'i bod rigs kyi snyan ngag pa rnams kyis dngos por brten nas 'dod don brjod pa dang / yul ljongs g.yar nas sems khams ston pa'i mtshon thabs rnying pa dag spangs pa dang / 〈〈mtho sgang gi rlung 〉〉gi rtsom pa pos kyang thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas rlung gi byed sgo las byung ba'i nyams snang ci rigs/ sems med rab rtog gi 'bri thabs spel bas snyan rtsom la nyams 'gyur dang mtshon stobs kyis phyug par ma zad/ skyes dngos dang sa gzhi/ chu klung dang spang thang /lhags rlung dang bye thang sogs la 'du shes byin pas/ nga tsho'i rol myong ba'i go rim khrod sems par g.yo skyom thebs sla ba dang / gzugs med kyi zil shugs shig gis rang rtog khrod bslangs zin pa'i gnas yul der khrid cing / skyo sems rtsi mo zhig gi mnar gcod khrod grogs med kher rkyang pa'i skyo glu zhig pha yul gyi snod bcud la blangs pa red/o rgyan rdo rje lags ni mtsho bod mtho sgang du rkang tshugs pa'i snyan ngag pa zhig yin/ gnas 'di ni lha mo dbyangs can ma dang shes rab kyi lhas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog cig dang / lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i ring grangs kyis mi zin pa'i rig pa 'tshol mkhan dang / yul skor ba/ gnas mjal bas zhabs kyis bcags shing / yul 'di'i spro sems 'khol ba'i glu gar gyis dus nam yang kho tsho'i yid dbang 'gugs bzhin yod/ rang cag gi snyan ngag pa ni gnas 'di'i glu ba chung chung zhig ste/ na chung byis pa'i dus nas glu dang snyan ngag la ngos zin snying la sim pa zhig yod pa dang / yul mi rnams kyi snyan 'jebs ngag gi 'gyur khugs dang ngo mtshar che ba'i lha sgrung gis rtsed grogs byas te mnar son pa yin/ 'das zin gyi dka' sdug che yang zhi 'jam dang spro dgas khengs pa'i lo zla'i nang / kho rang dang na tshod mnyam pa'i snyan ngag pa — 189 —

kha shas shig gis mes po rnams kyi sgam zhing dkyel che ba'i blo bag dang / snying rje dang lhag bsam gyis phyug pa'i bsam blo'i bang mdzod cig tu yid 'phrog pa'i ngag rgyun dang glu gzhas la ci dgar rol zhing / dus skabs shig la de ni dka' sdug che zhing kher rkyang bro med kyi 'tsho ba skyel thabs shig tu gyur/ snyan ngag gi pha gzhis 'dir/ kho'i rgyang bzhud kyi snyan ngag la rkang rtsal thog mar rgyas pa smos ma dgos so//o rgyan rdo rje'i snyan ngag 〈〈mi lam 〉〉dang 〈〈grong brdal〉〉/ 〈〈mna' tshig 〉〉sogs gang yin yang / mi rigs shig gi rang byung dang gnas bab las 'phros te rtsom pa po'i shugs drag pa'i myong tshor de mngon mtshon byed kyin yod/ 〈〈mtho sgang gi rlung 〉〉las rjes lus dang bkag rgya ma lus lhag med du gtor ba'i rlung zhig lding 'ong bar re ba byed cing / ri klung kun la ngar skad sgrog cing 'jig rten ma lus skad cig 'joms pa'i lhags rlung gi rang bzhin las rtsom mkhan la rtogs sad thob pa ste/snye byang 'brong rwa rtsed kyi dris lan bar na/thang rgod bye rlung gi 'thab mo'i dkyil na/nga'i dmu rgod kyi rang gshis gsal por mngon/ngas dben 'jam gyi khug kyog dbral zhing /ngas nags tshal gyi yul khams 'goms/’0tazhes pa dang / lo ngo du ma'i ring la 'gyur ldog bral zhing 6 dben 'jam mi du gnas pa'i 6 khug kyog mi zhig la mtshon na/ sa gzhi yom zhing 'jig rten dbral bar byed pa'i drag rlung zhig ldang yong ran du bsam pa dang / de la re zhing sgug pa ni rtsom pa pos 〈〈mtho sgang gi rlung 〉〉la bcol ba'i sems pa nyag gcig yin/ kho'i snyan rtsom 〈〈mna' tshig 〉〉la mtshon na/ rtsom pa pos rang gi mi tshe'i gdam ga dam srung byas shing / 'tsho ba dbul phongs dang — 190 —

'tsho gnas kyi khor lug ngan pa'i dbang gis phugs bsam dang 'dod re mi 'dor zhing / snyan rtsom las go bde gsal brjid kyi skad chas dbang cha dang dngul sgor/ go gnas dang mtshan snyan ji 'dra'i yid 'chor ba'i gnas shig yin yang / de dag gis gang 'dod du rtsom mkhan gyi mi tshe'i bgrod lam la kha phyogs bsgyur mi nus zhes snying gtam gson po zhig lhog lhog 'gul bzhin klog pa po rnams kyi mdun du bzhag pa red/ rang nyid kyi dmigs bya de rang gi bsam blo'i 'tshol snyeg cig tu 'brel ba dang / blo khog yangs shing kha khog med pa dang da lta'i las don 'dir brtson sems ldan pa'i rnam 'gyur bcas las ma 'ongs pa'i 'tsho bar lam gsar zhig 'tshol zhing snyeg pa'i sems 'dun gsal snying du mngon yod/ orgyan rdo rje'i snyan ngag las kho'i yid brten byed pa'i mi tshe'i bsam blo'i 'du shes shig mtshon pa dang / bsam blo'i 'du shes de'i 'byung khungs ni khong rang bskyed cing gsos pa'i mtho sgang 'di dang / mtho sgang der blo sems dkar ba'i kho rang gi brtse dung las byung ba nyid do//3 ngar shugs la bstims pa'i snyan ngagasnyan ngag pa rgan rabs yi dam che ring gis lha snyan ngag pa zhes pa'i mtshan snyan po de ni gces sems las byung ba'i legs skyes shig yin/ snyan ngag pa'i tshe srog gi nus pa ni gces sems las byung ba'i 'bad brtson yin/snyan ngag pa la drag tu 'phyur ba'i sems kyi rba rlabs med pa yin nam/ 'tsho ba'i rba klong 'khyil ba'i khrod du song nas longs su spyod cig de ni dung sems kyi 'byung khungs yin/miXzhes pa ltar/ deng rabs bod kyi snyan ngag gsar pa'i gar stegs steng / o rgyan rdo rje yang na gzhon snyan ngag pa gzhan dag dang mtshungs par gting zab cing nan tan gyi sgo nas rang nyid kyi snyan ngag 'byung rtsa der mnyam 'jog dang do khur byed cing / kho tsho rang gi tshe srog gi ngo — 191 —

bo sbyin par byed pa'i shes rig de la kha 'khor thub pa byas te/ gnas lugs brtsi zhing gzhung rgyud drang ba'i klog pa po'i mig lam du mtho sgang la dung zhing chags pa dang / mdza' zhing brtse ba'i snying gtam glu ru len par ma zad/ mtho sgang gi 'gyur ldog la rjes lus dang rnying pa dor de sngon thon dang gsar pa la 'jug spobs pa'i ngar sems drag po zhig med du mi rung ba'i gnas lugs sogs rang snang du mngon gsal dod por bstan 'dug chos lugs dang dmangs srol/ lo rgyus rig gnas kyi khyad chos gzhan las 'bur du thon zhing dmigs bsal ldan pa'i mtho sgang 'dir 'tsho gnas byed pa'i bod mi rigs kyi phyi yul gnas sdod la mnyam 'jog dang do khur bla lhag byas pas/ snyan ngag pa'i gsar rtsom gyi rtsa ba de sa chu 'dzoms shing nyi 'od dro ba'i mtho sgang gi sa'i gting rim du zug yod pa gzhi nas shes rtogs byung ba'i gsal brda yang nas yang du btang yod/khong gi snyan ngag gis deng rabs mtho sgang mi'i 'tsho ba'i rags dbyibs dang mi che'i myong tshor mtshon pa las gzhan/ khos da dung bab chags dang spyir btang gi mi gshis/ lo rgyus mi snar ma gyur kyang dus tshod skar cha rer nga tsho'i 'tsho bar dgod sgra dang / thugs khur gnang ba'i mi dkyus ma dag la mthong chen byed bzhin yod/ a khu ston pa zhes ku re bzhad gad la mkhas shing 'tsho bar blo gos kyis khengs pa/ bod mi'i dud khyim tshang mas ngo shes shing gsal cha yod pa'i mi sna yin na'ang 'dra/ mdo dbus mtho sgang steng ches rang ga ba'i gzhung lam bzo skrun gyi las ka gang yin rung / kho'i snyan ngag gi tshig phreng re re'i bar gseng du brtse dung gis phyug pa'i par ngos shig mngon la/par ris de dag gis zhi 'jam dang gting zab kyi ngang blo rig bkra zhing gnas lugs brtsi ba/ gzhung rgyud drang zhing bab chags pa/ 'tsho bar spro snang gis khengs pa'i mi dkyus ma dag la 'chang ba'i sems khur dang gces sems — 192 —

de drod lam lam ngang bris yod/dmag 'khrug med pa'i lo rabs la ya mtshar gyi gtam rgyud yod mi srid la/ zhi bde'i lo zlar/ nga tsho'i 'tsho ba'i khrod dpa' bo dang rlabs chen mi sna mi nyung ba nges par du 'byon srid mod/ 'on kyang nga tsho'i khor yug na shin tu mang ba ni mi dkyus ma ste/ nam rgyun 'tsho ba'i khrod 'dod sred kyi dbang du song yang lhad med bab chags kyi rang gshis kyang 'dzin pa'i mi dkyus ma dag red/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i 'tsho ba'i rgyab ljongs khrod/ o rgyan rdo rje yang kho tsho'i khrod kyi mi sna bye brag cig dang / snyan ngag pa'i tshor ba myur mos kho rang la mi'i brtse sems dang / mi gshis zhib 'bri byas na da gzod snyan ngag gsar rtsom la mtha' bral zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i snang brnyan rgyu cha 'don sprod thub pa gsal ston byas pas mi tshad/ 'tsho ba'i bang rim 'di lta bu brtol na gting dpog dka' la 'gyu zhing 'khyug pa'i bsam pa'i 'jig rten zhig mthong thub pa'i sngon brda'ang brgyab/snyan rtsom 〈〈mi chung gi 'gying glu 〉〉dang 〈〈rgod po 〉〉dag gis o rgyan rdo rje'i snyan ngag la dpa' ngar zhum med dang / blo brtan 'gyur med/dka' khag gdong bsu byed phod pa'i snying stobs shig sgron yod/ snyan rtsom du 'di lta bu'i 'dod blo zhig brgyud bsgrags byas yod de/ 'tsho ba'i bgrod lam steng dka' sdug dang bar bgegs 'dzings shing 'khrigs pa'am/ yang na nga tsho rgyun du mi gshis kyi mun nag gi gzhogs ngos shig nas mgo 'thoms na'ang / nga tshor sngar bzhin rang nyid kyi phugs bsam dang 'od zer gyi phyogs su bskyod thub pa'i rtobs shugs zad mtha' med pa zhig mchis zhes pa ni/ri dā dītā /du 'degs nus pa'i pho rgod cig min la/rgya mtsho hub kyis 'dren nus pa'i mthu rtsal ldan pa zhig kyang min/— 193 —

nga rang /'jig rten mi tshogs kyi rgya mchosare khrod na/mngon min chu thigs dang 'dra ba'i nyam chung gi mi chung zhig lags/de 'dra yin na'ang /nga la nga rang gi phugs bsam ldan/nga la nga rang gi brtse dung mchis/nga chu thigs ji ltar chung na'ang /ngas 'tsho ba'i pha bong la khung bu 'bigs thub la/ngas mi tshe'i kyag kyog gi lam bu rkang 'og tu gnon thub/mnyaces te/snyan ngag pa'i mig nang du 'tsho ba la re bas khengs/bslu brid la gzhol ba'i ma 'ongs pa'am/ rtog snang gis bskyed pa'i yul de ji 'dra'i mdzes sdug ldan pa la/ des rtsom pa po'i 'tsho bzhes phugs 'dun de ngar sems kyi 'tshol snyeg dang /nyams med kyi spobs sems shig tu bstims/ da lta dang 'byung 'gyur/ nyam chung dang stobs ldan dag gi mdun du ma 'ongs pa'i 'jig rten thams cad bdud rtsi'i gru char gyis brlan/ re smon thams cad sprang rtsi'i sprin phung gis btums/ 'ja' tshon ris su phab 'dra'i mdzes sdug gi dag zhing zhig gi ched du smyo kyag kyog gi lam bu rkang 'og tu gnon thub mirgyu ma zad/ de ni rdo pha bong yin yang 6 khung bu 'bigs thub 9 pa'i spobs pa zhig gis rtsom pa po'i brang khog thams cad 'gas bar snyam pa'i snang tshor zhig snyan rtsom las mngon/ da lta'i spyi tshogs su'ang mi 'ga' zhig gi bde skyid de mi mang po zhig gi sdug bsngal gyi steng skrun pa dang / gcig gi sdug bsngal de gzhan zhig gi bde skyid kyi 'byung khungs yin/ gcig gi bde skyid ni gzhan zhig gi sdug bsngal gyi 'byung khungs yin/ skabs 'dir snyan ngag mkhan gyis smyo nga rang/ ri bo pang du 'degs nus pa'i pho rgod cig min la mizhes — 194 —

'jig rten khams chen po 'dir snyan ngag pa'i tshe srog de ji 'dra'i nyam chung na'ang / ngar sems drag po bar snang dang spobs pa che ba sa gzhi la mi shong ba'i dpa' bo'i rang mdangs shig ngang gis mngon pa dang / rang gi blo gros dang lag zung la brten nas mi tshe'i rin thang gsar skrun byed pa'i 'dun pa mdzes sdug bkra zhing mu mtha' med pa zhig slong skrun byas yod/snyan ngag pa'i cho lo ni brtse dung gi legs skyes phul ba las byung zhing /snyan ngag gi tshe srog gson shugs ni brtse dung gi rngul khrag yin/ snyan ngag gi khyab khongs su/ o rgyan rdo rje dang bod rigs na gzhon snyan ngag pa gsar pa mang po zhig gis gting zab sgos rang nyid kyi snyan ngag 'byung khungs la gtsigs chen byed pa dang / khong tsho rang nyid kyi tshe srog gi ngo bor 'thims pa'i bsam pa'i khyim gzhir kha phyogs pa dang chabs cig rang nyid dang rig gnas khor yug gcig la gtogs pa'i klog pa po dag la yang kha phyogs te/rang nyid dang gzhan dag thun mong gi skad cha'i brda don steng / hur brtson gyis mtho sgang gi brtse dung gzhi sgrom zhig bskrun pa dang / chos lugs dang dmangs srol/ lo rgyus rig sanas bcas kyi khyad chos 'dzoms pa'i mdo dbus mtho sgang du/ mi rigs 'di'i phyi yul du gnas pa'i dngos yod dang / gting rim du chags pa'i rig gnas ngo bor yang gtsigs chen mdzad cing / khong tshos sems su 'di ltar byas na da gzod snyan ngag pa'i gsar rtsom rmang gzhir dri bzhon dang nyi 'od/ char chu'i brlan bsher bcas 'os 'tsham gyi cha rkyen 'dzoms pa rkyen byas 'tshar longs kyi 'dab ma rgya cher rgyas thub pa gsal por rtogs yod/ de las ldog ste/ ngo bo dang khyad chos 'di las bral na/brtsams chos kyi phyi ngos nas mtshar bo zhig 'phyor 'bri byas yod pa'i rtsom rig gzhan dang 'dra bar/ rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi mya ngam thang du mi bskyod pa'i blo gdeng gang yang med par snyam mo//— 195 —

mdor na/ mi rnams kyis rgyun par gleng rgyur/ don dngos su lha ri dang /lha mtsho/ byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i mdo dbus mtho sgang du gang sar yang lha'i gshis chags yod mod/ 'on kyang khyod la sems khams de yod pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng da gzod gsar rtogs dang / bsres sbyor byed shes min la rag las/ o rgyan rdo rje dang las rigs gcig pa'i grogs po tshor mtshon na/ 'di dag yod tshad ha cang gsal cha dod pa'i ngang khong tsho'i sems khong gi rtsig ldebs su brkos yod cing / smyu gu spyad de bod ljongs lo rgyus kyi kha sang dang de ring sgrel ba dang / khong tsho'i mig 'od rgyang ring gi ma 'ongs par 'khyug cing snyan rtsom dag las lang tsho'i gson shugs rgyu zhing / mtho sgang gi rlung dang 'dra bar gdong la bsus 'ong ngo /dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/()6)()o rgyan rdo rje'i 〈〈rmi lam〉〉/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉las/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1993lo/ shog ngos 305pa dang /306par gsal/()tshe grub kyi 〈〈so lta dang sazab nyan〉〉/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /2005lo/shog ngos 86par bsal/()()(1o rgyan rdo rje'i 〈〈mtho sgang bi rlung 〉〉bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈lang cho'i rbab chu〉〉las/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1993lo/ shog ngos 39pa~X dris sdom/ tshe ring gi 〈〈snyan ngag gi bla srog bshad pa〉〉/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom /ga (pe tshogaX 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉las/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1993lo/0ga ༵ ༵༵/pa ji /spra ༵/mi chung gi 'gying glu〉〉/ bod kyi deng rabs com rig dpe shāshādi ༷༵༵ /sna /sdu chu 〉〉las/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1993lo/ shog — 196 —

gsum pa/ gangs 'dabs nas chas pa'i 〈〈sto bzhud kyi chu 'dzin〉〉/gcan me stag (skyes ming la bsod nams bstan pa/ pur ming la rgyal sras sogs yod 1970wa )ni mtsho sngon zhing chen rma lho khul gcan tsha rdzong lha sa'i grong nas skyes/ khong lo rabs brgyad cu pa dang dgu bcu pa'i mthud mtshams su gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs pa nas bzung / snyan ngag dang lhug rtsom/ glu tshig sogs brgya phrag gsum tsam dus deb dang tshags par steng spel zhing snyan ngag gi skor snyan deb 〈〈lho bzhud kyi chu 'dzin 〉〉nang bsdus yod/〈〈dam tshig yid bzhin nor bu 〉〉las/ 44'jig rten dag na gzhan dbang dang / /bag 'khums lta bu'i sdug bsngal med/ /srid pa'i khams na rang dbang dang / /dad pa lta bu'i bde ba med/ /mi duces pa ltar/ gcan me stag ni rang dbang la yid smon dang bde skyid la re snyeg byed pa rang gshis su chags pa zhig yin stabs/ khos nam yang bsam blo rang dbang dang / smra brjod rang dbang / 'gro 'dug rang dbang bcas la brtson len dang 'tshol snyeg byed pa ma zad/ snyan ngag 'bri rtsom dang 'tsho ba'i rol stangs kyi gom 'gros la bskyar zlos dang ldog bgrod byed par 'dzem dogs dang mnyam snang chen po 'jog pa ni/gsar gtod kyi skul shugs dang 'byung gzhi lta bur song yod kyang srid/snyan ngag pa 'ju skal bzang gis 6 kho ni dben par bsran tshugs shing 'du 'dzi la'ang thugs dgyes pa dang / ngo gnong che tsam yod cing spobs pa'ang gting nas bdo ba/ nam nam zhar gyi don bya phran tshegs dag la rtsis gdab cher med kyang che phyogs kyi 'dun ma brtan po zhig gzhar yang mi gtong ba sogs mi gshis nyis sbrags kyi khyad chos dang ldan pa zhig yin pa 'dra snyam/ gang ltar blo rtse grung la rang bzhin gyis shes rab gsal la/ rtog — 197 —

'char gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod pa dang / bskyar zlos la shin tu mi dga' zhing / gsar snyeg gi 'dun pa shugs drag po dang ldan pa zhig tu nges/ dus mtshungs su rus rkang mkhregs po zhig gi u tshugs la brten nas rang nyid kyi ngos nas 'jig rten 'dir 'greng ba la 'phreng zhen shin tu che zhing / mi yul 'dir yar langs mar 'gyel ci 'dra byung yang bsod nams bstan pa rang byed par 'dod/mi②ces pa dang / rtsom rig smra ba he ker gyis 6 ches rlabs che ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi nus pa ni kun rtog yin/mi zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ na gzhon snyan ngag pa gcan me stag gis kyang kun rtog ni snyan ngag pa'i gsar rtsom gyi tshe srog lta bur mthong yod pa ni kho rang bskyar zlos la mi dga' zhing gsar gtod la bsnyeg pa bcas las rtogs thub/ bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal gyis 6 snyan 'jebs ngag la 'phos pa'i dbyangs bdun gyi/ /dkyil 'khor phang bar 'dzegs pa'i rgyud mangs mkhan/ /ro ldan 'khyog po'i nyams kyi tshig sbyor slad/ /kun rtog gsar pa gsar pa'i gar la 'jug /mi duces pa las gsar rtsom la 'jug pa'i skabs su/ kun rtog gi gshog zung la brten nas/ mtho nam mkha'i man dang dma' rgya mtsho'i yan gyi bya dngos mtha' dag dpe gzugs kyi mtshon dpe ru 'dren dgos pa'i blang bya nan mo bton 'dug deng skabs kyi sems khams rig pa'i gzhung lugs ltar na snang nges ( sems dang dbang por shar ba'i rnam pa ) dang nyams myong la gzhi bcol nas gzugs brnyan gsar pa zhig skrun par byed pa'i sems kyi 'du byed la kun rtog dang / de ni sems la mi dran dgu dran byed pa zhig ma yin par 'das pa'i dus su nyams su myong ba'i bya dngos hril po zhig gam yang na cha shas su gyur pa gang zhig dmigs sa yod pa'i sgo nas yang bskyar dran gso byas shing rgyun yod par byas te/ sems la dran pa de dag gi rnam pa dang ngo bo mi mthun na'ang legs bcos kyi sgo nas snga na med pa'i bya dngos kyi — 198 —

gzugs brnyan gsar pa zhig skrun pa dang / snang brnyan gsar pa de dag gi gzhi dang yan lag spus tshad sogs gang gi cha nas kyang rim bzhin cha je tshang du gtong ba'i yid kyi 'gul skyod cig yin/ gcan me stag gis 〈〈lho bzhud kyi chu 'dzin 〉〉spyang tna med pa gsar skrun gyi kun rtog la brten nas 'char sgo yang snarshar phyo ga ༵ kyi/ mkha' mthar bzhud pa'i chu 'dzin la yun ring cer nas/ngas mtha' mjug gi re smon gang yang zhu ma spobs/shi de dus khyed kyis nga rang khrid de mtsho sngon po'i rlabs rgyun la zhugs myong/'u gnyis gas brtse zhing nem pa'i ljang mdog gi re smon zhig bcangs nga /yin na'ang gsal lhang nger khyed rang phebs song /shul du lus pa ni 'u thug thabs zad kyi skyo 'dzum zhig yin/mi④zhes pa las rtsom pa pos tshugs thub can dang / gsar shas can/ gsar skrun rang bzhin dang ldan pa'i kun rtog la brten nas/ sngar dge rgan gang gi pha yul te mtsho sngon po'i 'gram rgyud du khrid song ste/ rlabs rtser zhon cing spang la 'khyud pa'i sngar yod kyi dran snang de rmang gzhi byas te sgyu rtsal blos bslangs byas nas sngar ma mchis pa'i snang brnyan gsar pa zhig ste 46'u thug thabs zad kyi skyo 'dzum zhig lus pa'i : bsam pa'i yul khams shig skrun pa dang /klog pa po snyan rtsom gyi 'phel rim dang bstun nas dga' ba'i gnas nas skyo yul du 'khrid par byed cing / mthar pham sems kyi rdog khres lci mo zhig gis mnan 'ongs shing dbugs kyi 'byin rngub kyang dka' ba'i snang ba bden pa zhig ster ba ni kun rtog gi tshor 'du shugs drag pa'i rkyen gyis red/6 bsil ba'i dri bzhon zhig gis khyed kyi dkar mdog gi zhal ras — 199 —

btegs tshe/khyed kyi sa gzhi 'dir brtse byams kyi 'dzum mdangs gsar pa zhig bsnana'o /nga kyi/ thig le/ dran pa'i khur bo/khyed nyid 'phur ba'i gshog sgro'i steng lo ngo du ma'i zla 'od dang rgyu skar brtsegs yod pa red ang /ri rab gtsang po khri phrag gi mu mtha' las brgal te/sems med chags med du 'byon rogs/mi( gong mtshungs )zhes pa dang / ma shes pa dang rmongs pa sogs tsha gdug gis mnar ba rnams la shin tu bsil ba'i yon tan gyi dri bzhon gyis skul bar brten nyid kyi gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam dkar pos gnas 'dir 'dzum mdangs gsar pa bsnan pa dang / de ni dran pa'i khur bor lci zhing / slob dpon khyed nyid la mtshon na'ang rgyang bzhud kyi mthun rkyen de 'dra zhig 'grig pa ni zla 'od dang rgyu skar brtsegs pa ste gnyid bcag zas brjed kyis brtson len la gzhol ba las thob pa zhig yin pas na/ gang ltar yang go skabs de ni 'chor du 'jug mi rung zhing 6 sems med chags med du 'byon rogs : zhes sems gting nas smon 'dun zhus pa red/rtsom mkhan gyis gsar rtsom byed skabs/ bla med kyi mi snas kho rang yid 'gul thebs su 'jug pa dang / mdzes sdug gi yul ljongs kyis kho'i yid sems myos par byed la/ mi sdug pa'i bya spyod kyis kho la skyug bro ba 'phel bar byed/ tshul 'di rnams don dngos steng dga' skyo chags sdang gi tshor 'du yin zhing / tshor 'du 'di dag gis bsam gzhig la 'jug par byed la/ bsam bzhig la brten nas tshor 'du'i shugs je drag tu gtong ba yin/ de bzhin du skabs 'dir gcan me stag gis kyang kho'i mig nang gi dge rgan rin po che de — 200 —

snang brnyan bsam gzhig dang tshor 'du sogs la 'brel nas mig nang gi dge rgan nas sems nang gi dge rgan brgyud pa dang / sems nang gi dge rgan de yang snyan tshig gi dge rgan bar brgyud pas da gzod mig gis zin rgyu dang sems kyis myong rgyu yod pa lta bu'i sgyu rtsal snang brnyan 'di grub pa yin/ 'di dag mthar gtugs na kun rtog gis bskyed pa'i 'bras bu dngos yin no/ /sna bdag gi brtse gshin gyi chu 'dzinawa yin na'ang khyed kyi 'gros rim gyi srab kha yang du bkag ste/phyi mig ling ling gis gang la lta/skom gdung gi ri tshogs 'di/ spang thang 'di/ da dung 'khyag grang gi sems pa 'di yod tshad kyis khyed la re sgug byas yod lags/mi( gong mtshungs )zhes pa dang / rtsom pa po'i brtse zhen gyi dran gdung yang rtser slebs pa dang / dper na byis pa lo chung zhig rang gi ma yum dang 'bral khar ngu 'bod byed pa lta bu'i snang tshor ster zhing / phyogs gzhan zhig nas dge rgan bka' drin can der mtshon na'ang rang gi snying dang 'dra zhing da dung shes rig gi stobs rtsal ma rdzogs pa'i sna skom gdung gi ri tshogs 'di/ spang thang 'di ’ dag ni sems kyi bya mo dang 'bral mi thub pa'i bya phrug 'ba' zhig tu gyur pas mig zung phyir mig gi lcags gdang la mi sbrel thabs med yin la/ slob bu'i tshogs la mtshon na 'khyag grang gi sems pa re sgug gi bgrod lam ring mor gtod pa las gzhan ci/ snyan ngag bklags nas mtshams 'dir slebs dus nga tsho'i sems nang du 'bral kha'i skyo gdung gi me lce gcu log gis gyen du 'phyur 'ong ba zhig min nam/ don dam par de ni gcan me stag gi shugs drag pa'i tshor 'du ste/'tsho bar bcangs pa'i phugs 'dun dang /pham sems/ dga' skyo bcas 'o chu 'dres pa ltar 'byed dka' zhing / rlabs kyi 'degs 'jog ltar — 201 —

'phyur 'jags kyi ngang du gnas pa'i rkyen gyis so/ /mdor na/ gcan me stag lags kyi snyan rtsom las snyan 'jebs dbyangs kyi 'gyur khugs dang lce thog gi zhim mngar/ yid dbang gso ba'i ro bcud/phun sum tshogs pa'i kun rtog sogs kyis rab tu phyug pa'i ba gam gsar pa'i lding khang la 'ja' tshon gyis 'khyud pa lta bu'i nyams 'gyur dang mdzes snang mngon yong la/ de bas kyang 'char rtog gi gshog 'og tu gab pa'i 'tsho ba dang mi sems kyi 'jig rten re re/ mi che'i bro ba sna tshogs/ mi'i 'tsho gnas kyi dka' tshegs dang bde sdug ci rigs/ mngon gsal dod po'i snang brnyan re res klog pa po'i snang ngor dga' skyo ci rigs kyi myong tshor bden pa zhig ster bar byed do/ /dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/()mtsho sngon mi rigs slob gling bod rig pa'i sde khag gis2003lor gtso gnyer byas pa'i 〈〈khug rta 〉〉deb gnyis pa'i drang zhen gyi 〈〈dam tshis yid bzhin nor bu 〉〉zhes pa ru /bye~X/999lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 16nyin gyi 〈〈mtsho sngon bod gsar 'gyur 〉〉steng gi 'ju skal bzang gi 〈〈bsod nam bstan pa nga tsho'i dpung grogs shig 〉〉ces pa ru gsal(/)bod mkhas pa mi pham dge legs rnam rgyal gyi 〈〈dbyangs can ngag sga rol mtsho yid kyi ngang mo rnam rtsen tshangs pa'i mgrin rgyan rab dga'i rgyud mangs 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2001lor dpe sgrun byas pa'i 〈〈bod kyi dus rabs rim byung gi com yig gces bsdus 〉〉kyi shog ngos 478par gsal/6tagacan me stag gi snyan deb 〈〈lho bzhud kyi chu 'dzin 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gis 2004lor dpe skrun byas pa las gsal/— 202 —

sa bcad bzhi pa/ lo ngo stong gi sme lam/dka'apyed med rtsom pa po'i snyan rtsom gces btus 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉/dang po/rgyab ljongs dang 'brel ba'i gtam/lo ngo stong phrag gcig lhag gi ring bod kyi bud med snyan ngag pa zhig gis snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di 'dra dang de 'dra mdzad 'dug ces gleng thabs bral ba 'di rtsom rig khyab khongs 'ba' zhig gi gnad don min par 'dod de/gtso bo srol rgyun gyi slob gso'i byed stangs dang 'du shes/mi rnams kyis bud med la bzung ba'i lta tshul bcas la rag las te/ dper na/ bod khyim gcig la bu dang bu mo gnyis skyes tshe bur dpe cha 'don du 'jug pa dang bu mor lag dang las ka : zer nas chung dus nas khyim las tsag tsig la skul ba'i goms srol 'di mdo dbus khams gsum spyi yongs la khyab 'dug pa phal cher gcig 'dra yin zhing / 'jig rten kha dpe la'ang/ smyo ban de 'gro sa dbus dang bu mo 'gro sa gnas zer ba dang / lhag par nang pa'i rjes 'jug pa 'ga' zhig gis 6 bud med la ni yid brten byed pa ste/ /'chi bdag bzhi bo sgo yi drung na sdod/ /mices pa dang / yang ra bud med gzhon nu'i lus ni logs shig tu/ /dri nga ba dang sgo dgu dod pa dang / mi gtsang kun snod 'dra ba dgang dka' dang / /pags pas g.yogs dang rgyan yang longs shig gzigs/ /mizhes dang / yang 6 bud med 'khor ba'i gzhi ma yin/ /ngan song gsum gyis sa bon yin/ /thar ba 'gro ba'i sgo bgegs yin/ /nyon mongs dug lnga'i rgyu rkyen yin/ /mizhes pa sogs bud med la drang snyom min pa'i bsam blo'i 'khyer phyogs mang du byung yod pa dag las bud med la lta tshul gang 'dra zhig bzung yod pa rtogs sla ba dang / bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi bsam blo'i 'du shes 'di rigs kyi shan zhugs pas bod rigs bud med kyi 'tsho ba dang re — 203 —

smon/ brtse dung sogs kyi thad la ya nga ba'i gnod 'tshe tshad med thebs kyin yod pa mig thog tu shar 'dug ste/ smyo dus rabs snga ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa dang dgu bcu pa'i nang / sgang pa bod kyi shes ldan pa'i sde ru 4 pho mo 'dra mnyam : gyi kha g.yang gcig min gnyis min du sgrog pa la/ deng gi char rlabs sgra thams cad zhi 'jags su song zhing / lo rgyus deb ther la gzigs rtog ches cher mnga' ba'i tshul gyis bod la gna' rabs kyi dus su pho mo 'dra mnyam gyi dpe srol bzang po yod rabs lab kyin 'dug dper na/ a phyi gdags lha dkar mo dang 'byo bza' khri ma lod sogs dpe ru drangs nas gsal bshad byed pa lta bu red/ don dam du de ltar min pa mig mthong lag zin yin pas/dngos yod las brling ba'i gtan tshigs btsan po zhig gzhan nas 'tshol dgos don ye nas med/mi①ces pa ma zad/ bsam blo rnying pa'i bag chags de'i stabs kyis bod rigs bud med rang steng nas kyang mo lus su skyes pa 'di mi che'i nyes pa zhig du bsam gyin yod pas/ kho mo tshos nam yang skyes pa rnams dang dbang thang dang go gnas rtsod mi phod la/ tha na rang gi mi tshe dang las dbang la'ang jus gtogs byed mi phod pa red/ gal te 'gran rtsod dang rgol sems kyi snying khams rgya stag la 'gran phod pa can zhig byung na kun gyis lag pa thod par khyer nas mig gor gor dang lce nar nar sgos than ltas su gleng ba dang 'jig rten gyi smod pa drag char bzhin 'khor yong bar nges 'di ni shes rig gi lo rgyus yun ring mnga' zer ba'i gangs can pa'i lo rgyus steng sbyad /gas bud med la bstsal ba'i las dbang nyag gcig yin pa bston du da yi/na/ na'ang / nga tshos bsam blo gnad du phab ste mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus la skor lta zhig byas na/ mtho ba rgyal po'i rgyal thabs dang dma' ba sprang po'i 'tsho thabs bar 'jig rten gyi bud med ni med du mi rung la/ kho mo tsho med na mi'i — 204 rdo

rigs dang mi'i rigs kyi ma 'ongs pa'ang yod mi srid de/ 〈〈mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi rnam thar 〉〉las/ 6 gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /pho mo dman lus khyad par med/ /sems bskyed ldan na mo lus lhag /mi②ces pa dang / mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gis kyang 6 rang gi rang don yul gyi spyi don dang / /rgyal po'i rgyal srid sprang po'i 'tsho thabs sogs/ /che chung bya ba gang dang gang byed kyang / /med du mi rung ba ni bud med yin/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten mya ngam thang bzhin che/ /las mang khur gyis skyes bu nges par skyo/ /de la dga' ba'i spro ba sbyin nus pa'i/ /rtsed grogs bu mo las kyis sprul ba 'dra/ /mthong bas yid dga' gzugs kyi lha mo ste/ /rigs rgyud bzang po bskyed pa'i zhing sa yin/ /sdug pa'i nad g.yog byed pa'i ma ma dang / /skyo ba'i sems gso gtong ba'i snyan ngag mkhan/ /khyim gyi las kun byed pa'i g.yog mo ste/ /tshe gcig rtse dga' skyong ba'i grogs mo nyid/ /mi ces gsungs nas bud med kyi yon tan la bsngags par mdzad pa dang / smyo 'jig rten 'tsho tshis la sha thang chad chad du 'bad pa'i rang cag so skyes phal ba'am mi skya rnams la de ltar ga la yin te/ bud med rnams ni 'tsho ba hril po'am mi tshe skya mo'i gzungs thag dang gzhung rta yin pa bston du med/ ②ces pa dang / don du'ang 'jig rten gyi bud med ni srid kyi mtsho mo dang / 'jig rten steng gi mi re re'i bde skyid kyi gzhi ma lta bu yin pas na/ kho mo tsho'i bsam spyod kyis gna' deng gang gi dus su'ang spyi tshogs sngon du bskyod pa dang 'tsho ba'i khor yug je legs su gtong ba bcas kyi thad thag gcod rang bzhin gyi nus pa gal chen 'don gyin yod/lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs brgyad cu par zhugs rjes/ go rtogs sad pa'i bud med rtsom pa po skor zhig sprin 'og nas thar ba'i rta bdun dbang po bzhin rang nyid kyi 'das ma 'ongs da lta sogs gsal — 205 —

thag chod par mthong thub pa byas shing / mi tshe'i dbang thang dang ma 'ongs pa'i bde skyid kyi ched du smyu gu bzung zhing snyan ngag bris te phugs bsam dang re snyeg glu ru blangs pa red la/ na gzhon bud med snyan ngag pa dpal mo lags kyis 6 ngas rang nyid kyi rtsom btus dpe skrun byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi bzos te las ka 'di'i mgo mjug bar gsum 'gan du 'khur rgyu khas blangs pa yin/'on kyang de ni las sla mo zhig gam dkyus ma zhig ma yin te/ spyir btang bod chol kha gsum na bud med smyug thogs pa mang po 'dug na'ang rang rigs kyi skad yig spyad de pha skad rnal ma'i lam nas brtsams chos spel mkhan nyung la phul du byung ba'i brtsams chos de bas kyang dkon/ de'i stabs kyis thog mar bod khams yongs kyi sa gnas so so'i rtsom sgrig khang dang mi sgor sogs brgyud nas bud med rtsom pa po ci yod kyi mtshan dang las gnas 'tshol sdud byas te rim bzhin sbrag thog gam kha par brgyud nas kho tsho skor zhig la 'brel gtug thub pa byung ba ma zad/ khong rnam pa'i brtsams chos dag kyang de ltar lag son byung ba yin/miXzhes pa ltar/ khong mos dka' tshegs dang 'o brgyal lung pa gang la ma 'dzem par/ snyan deb 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉'di klog pa po rnams dang zhal mjal gnang thub par mdzad par snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhus pa yin/ tshegs sdug dang rngul chu/ sgor mo sogs kyi 'gro gron gang mang zhig btang ste deng rabs bod kyi bud med rtsom pa po'i snyan deb 〈〈bzhi lung 〉〉zhes pa 'di lta bu zhig bsgrigs pa'i dmigs yul dang rin thang thad la/ gtso sgrig pa dpal mo lags kyis 'di ltar bshad de/ 6 gcig nas deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig gi gar stegs su gzhung sgor gnyis kyi cha nas dpe skrun byas dang byed mus yod pa'i snyan rtsom gyi dpe deb char rjes kyi sha mor 'gran na yang / bod kyi spyi tshogs khyon la gzhigs na bud med shes yon can gyi grangs tshad da dung ha cang nyung la 'chad rtsom gyi las la spobs pa rgyas — 206 —

mkhan de bas kyang dkon par brten/ da snga chol kha gsum gyi bud med rtsom pa pos brtsams gnang yod pa'i snyan deb cung 'thus tshang ba gcig kyang rtsom sgrig byas med pa'i stong cha skong thub pa byung na snyam pa dang / gnyis su bud med cho'i bsam blo srol rgyun gyi lta ba ngan pa'i 'ching ba las 'grol zhing spobs pa cher bskyed sgos phrag tu babs pa'i 'gan 'khri dang len byas te dus rabs kyi 'gran rtsod nang zhugs phod pa/ rjes phyogs yang bud med rtsom pa pos spyi tshogs su nus shugs 'don par 'bod skul gtong ba/ gsum du gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs bzhin pa'i slob ma bu mo rnams mu mthud du rang la yid ches kyis rtsom 'bri byed par skul lcag gtong zhing gso skyong byed pa bcas dmigs 'dun la bzung ste grogs mo dang nged gnyis la gzhan gyis ma bskul rang gis dang blangs sgos rang re'i skyes ma blo mthun rnam par yar skul dang sne 'khrid kyi tshul gyis las 'char 'di bzos pa yin/miXzhes gsal kha btod yod/ lo ren gyis kyang 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉gi sngon 'gro'i skabs su/66da bar du skad yig gang zhig nang la yang bod mo'i snyan rtsom phyogs bsgrigs byas med stabs/ 〈〈bzhe lung 〉〉dpe skrun byed pa ni lo rgyus kyi don snying dang ldan pa zhig yin/ deb 'di'i nang la tshud pa'i bod mo 'ga' re nas rang rang gi snyan rtsom phyogs bsgrigs re bton yod/ yin na'ang / da thengs kyi deb 'di ni krung go'i bod rigs kyi yul gru mang po dang tha na phyi rgyal na yod pa'i bod mo gang mang zhig gi snyan rtsom phyogs bsgrigs byas yod pa zhig red/khong tsho'i mi che'i nyams myong 'dra min sna tshogs yin na yang / khong tshos thun mong gi skad yig cig spyod kyin yod stabs/ khong tshos rig gnas kyi zhing khams (deb )'di'i nang du phan tshun shes rtogs byed thub/mi①ces snyan deb 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉bsgrigs pa'i dngos yod don snying dang rin thang la gdeng 'jog mthon po gnang pa don la gnas so//— 207 —

dus rabs nyi shu pa'i mjug tu/ bod rigs bud med rnams kyis dus rabs kyi gom 'gros dang bstun te rig gnas shes bya la brtson bzhin rang nyid kyi ma 'ongs pa dang phugs bsam gyi ched du 'bad brtson byed bzhin yod mod/ 'on kyang skye bo khag cig gis bud med ni rang la g.yog byed mkhan dang bu bu mo skyong byed kyi yo byad kho na zhig tu brtsis pa las bud med kyi mdun lam dang ma 'ongs pa sogs la sems khur spu tsam yang mi byed pa'i gnas tshul ni da yod kyi spyi tshogs su mang po 'byung bzhin yod/ deng rabs bod kyi bud med rtsom pa po'i snyan rtsom gces btus 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉ces pa'i snyan deb nang gong gi gnas tshul de rigs la sun 'byin dang deng gi spyi tshogs su gnas pa'i pho mo'i go sa mi mnyam pa'i bsam blo rnying par dgag rgyag dang kha rdung drag po btang / brjod bya'i nang don 'dis spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dang khyim tshang 'tsho ba'i khrod nas bud med kyi go gnas sngar bzhin dma' ba/lhag par bud med rnams kyi las 'gan dang 'tsho ba'i 'gal zla'i bar nas dka' sdug myong bzhin pa dang bud med rnams kyis rang la dbang 'os pa'i go sa brtson len byed dgos pa'i bsam blo gsar pa de mtshon 'dug bsam blo gsar pa de ni dus rabs 'di'i bud med rnams kyi sems gting gi re smon yin/ bsam blo'i 'du shes rnying pa sngar bzhin gnas pa'i dus rabs 'di'i nang / de lta bu'i brjod bya'i nang don la rgya che gting zab kyi spyi tshogs don snying ldan pa red la/ yang mi rigs kyi las don dang ma 'ongs par rgyang lta byed pa ni skyes pa pho yi 'gan 'khur 'ba' zhig tu mi sems par 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉nang bud med rtsom pa po 'ga' zhig gis snyan ngag gi thabs lam brgyud nas mi rigs 'di'i lo rgyus la phyir lta dang / da lta'i gnas bab dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'gan dbang la mno bsam btang ba brjod byar bzung ba dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis rtsom mkhan rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod byung ba'i — 208 —

ches phra zhing zhib pa'i sems 'gyu dang brtse dung gi thob shor/ gyes pa'i sdug bsngal dang 'dzoms pa'i re sgug sogs lhug por brjod yod pas mi sems g.yo ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi nus shugs ldan pa red/gnyis pa/snyan ngag gi nam mkha' yangs par gyes shing skar tshogs kyi 'od snang drag byu 'tsher/wa dbud med snyan ngag pa dpal lha sogs kyi snyan rtsom ngo sprod byed pa/1 dpal lha dang kho mo'i snyan ngagadapal lha (1961wa )ni bod ljongs su skyes shing / 1987lo nas 'gro brtsams te snga rjes su rtsom rig yig sgyur dang dpyad rtsom/ dngos 'bri'i rtsom rig snyan ngag sogs bris/drang bden gyi srog dbang thob 'go brtsams pa'i krung go'i sa gzhi chen por re ba'i ljang mdog cig rgyang ring nas shar 'ongs pa dang / 'das zin pa'i dus su ca 'ur 'ur g.yug pa'i 'khyag grang dang bu yug mi de brjed nges kyi lhags rlung la bskur te nam yang phyir mi ldog pa'i lam du ded do/ /mi rnams kyi sems pa lhod shig shig ngang drod skyid dang bde snang zhig la rol 'dod pa'i re ba shugs drag tu 'chang ba'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i dus 'gor/ dpal lha ni krung dbyang mi rigs slob chen nas mthar phyin cing mi che'i re ba dang phugs bsam rum gang khyer nas pha yul la slebs/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas gangs ri'i 'dabs su le dbar stong gis chod mod/ 'on kyang dga' 'os pa zhig la/ mtsho bod mtho sgang du gnas pa'i bod la mtshon na'ang 'gyur ldog rabs dang rim par byung dang 'byung bzhin yod pa dang / dus skabs de ni lo rgyus steng rtsom rig gsar rtsom la 'jug pa ches mang ba'i dus shig dang / lhag par du snyan ngag la 'jug mkhan de bas kyang mang ba'i smyo snyan — 209 —

ngag pa'i lo rabs shig yin zhes bshad chog pa yin/ lang cho'i gson shugs dar la babs shing 'jig rten gyi bya dngos ci rigs la bla lhag gi spro bas brtas la/ yun ring du bag la nyal ba'i brtse dung gi tshor ba skra rtse na 'khyug cing / ma 'ong ba'i 'tsho bar re smon gyi 'dun pa shugs drag pa'i dpal lha'ang rang gi dung sems kyi ngar shugs la brten nas sha 'od brdol ba ltar chil tshil du 'bab pa'i snyan ngag pa'i dpung khag nang zhugs pa red la/gzhon nu ma'i 'phrul snang la phyogs pa'i blo dang glo bur du byung ba'i brtse dung gi sems 'gyu 〈〈thog ma'i brtse dung 〉〉la drangs/6 gangs dkar gyi 'dab ma'i ngos shig na/sems pa dang sems pa gnyis bzhur/snying kha'i gson shugs la me lce tshor zhing /yam yom gyi rdzi mas snying khong gi gsang bya grol dus/brtse dung gi zungs khrag gtsang por rgyu zhing /ri rab kyi lhun po dpang du grub/miXzhes pa dang / lang tshos gcun pa'i gzhon nu ma zhig gi thog ma'i dung brjod kyi sems gshis te/ thog ma ni nam yang lhad med pas kha ba'i 'dab ma bzhin phyi gsal nang gsal du chas la/ dus nam zhig nas skom pas chu 'dod ltar re zhing wa mos gra khar 'dzem pa ltar gnas de yun ring du gzhon nu ma'i sems gting la sbed cing da ni thog mar brjod pa ste 6 snying khong gi gsang bya grol mi ba yin stabs/ 'dod 'dun thad kur mngon mtshon bya ba'i spobs pa ri rab bzhin brtan brling du chags na'ang 'dzem dogs dang mngon chung gi spubs rgya yongs su ma grol ba'i gzhon nu ma'i sems khams kyi mkha' ngos rang dbang med par 'jig rten spyi lugs su chags pa'i ngo tsha dang dogs snang gi chu 'dzin srab mo zhig gis g.yogs pas/ sems chung dang gshis — 210 —

'jam la gzhol ba'i rnam 'gyur gnyom po zhig gis thog ma de'i dwangs gtsang dang byid 'ong gi ngang tshul snyan rtsom nang mdzes sdug ldan par mngon mtshon byas sna kā/rtse dung gi zungs khrag gtsang por rgyu zhing /(ri rab kyi lhun po dpang du grub/misnyan ngag pas ri skul mtsho skyom lta bu'i kha g.yang dang dam bca'i khu tshur bsgreng med la/ yin mdog dang zol bcos kyi pus mo sla nga thang la'ang ma btsugs par rang bzhin nyid du gnas pa'i gshes gas brtse dung la blo sems shin tu dkar ba gson nyams ldan pa'i yid brnyan la brten nas brgyud bsgrags byas yod/ phyi rgyal gyi snyan ngag pa zhig gis tshe srog ni thob dka' yang brtse dung gi rin thang de las 'phags zhes pa nang bzhin/ gzhon nu ma'i lus sems kyi rtsa lam du rgyu ba ni tshe srog gi rgyun nyag gcig tu gyur pa'i zungs khrag tsha mo yin la/ sems khong gi gzhon nu de la phul ba'i brtse dung de zungs khrag gtsang por 'dres pa bzhin dus nam yang rgyu ba mi 'gag pa dang mi chad pa/ mi skam pa'i dpang du dus gtan du 'gyur ba med pa'i ri rab lhun po bzhag pa ni/ ji 'dra'i dri bral zhing yid du 'ong ba/ blos thub cing yid brten du rung ba'i snang ngor mdzes shing yid smon 'chor ba'i brtse dung 'gyur med gser lta bu zhig red ang /lha dben 'jags kyi mtshan mo der/sngo ljang gi tshe srog phra mo/sa 'og gi 'bu srin dang 'grogs nas/sbrang char gyi snying gtam la nyan/zhogs pa/ nyi 'od kyi/'dzum zer 'phro dus/sa gzhi de'ang kha dog gzhan zhig mi ( gong mtshungs )

snying 'jags dang zhi 'jam gyi yul yin la/ re smon dang sems 'dun thams cad ji bzhin du grub rjes kyi sems khams shig kyang yin/ rtsom pa pos brtse dung gi than pa byung zhing dngangs 'tshab kyi rnam thar skyong ba'i nyams 'gyur dang ring du bkyed pa'i na gzhon pho mo gnyis kyi bsam tshul de 'bri ba la/ 'du 'dzi dang 'khrugs zing med pa'i dben 'jags kyi mtshan mo zhig gi khor yug slong skrun byas thog mi tshe la re bas khengs shing tshe srog la rin thang ldan la gson shugs rgyas pa ni yid rton thub pa'i brtse dung 'di nyid kyi drin dang / phan tshun mgo skor dang rdzun gtam gyi ca co mi sgrog par sems gting nas 'phros pa'i dbyangs snyan la rol bas yid sems dag bzi zhing tshims 'dug mi lam du'ang steg cing 'tshol ba'i brtse dung gi pho nya phan tshun gyi snying khong du slebs pa na/ 'jig rten 'dis gnam ngo yar la bstan cing sa gzhi dkyel du brkyangs pa lta bu'i bag yangs pa'i snang ba zhig sbyin stabs/ mig lam du mngon pa ni ngo mtshar zhing lta na sdug cing da lta'i bar mthong ma myong yang /yun ring du re smon byas pa'i 'jig rten gzhan zhig gi zhing khams yin/gong gi snyan rtsom las bsung zhim dri ngad kyi nyams snang zhig 'byung la/brtse dung gi chu mig thog mar brdol ba'i na gzhon pho mo zung gi bsam tshul dang dran snang sogs snyan ngag gi lam nas gson nyams ldan par bkod pa dang / mngon chung gi mdzes nyams shig tshig dang yig 'bru'i bar na zol bcos dang bral bar mngon pas/ brtse 'dang gis phyug pa'i klog pa po zhig yin na gnas de ru mdzes pa'i ro zhim la ci dgar rol chog pa yin/2 dpal mo dang kho mo'i snyan ngag dpal mo ( ming gzhan bde sbyin ma'am srin mo sogs yod/ 1968— 212 —

wa )ni mdo smad rkang tsha ru skyes/ 1989lo nas bzung rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs pa dang snga gzhug tu bod kyi rtsom rig dus deb dang rig gzhung dus deb sogs su dpyad rtsom dang snyan ngag lhug rtsom bcas brtsams chos mang po zhig bkod dang 'god mus su mchis/mi rigs shig la dungs zhen ga 'dra yod pa ni gtso bo mi rigs de'i rig gnas dang lo rgyus kyi 'das ma 'ongs da lta sogs la ngos 'dzin byas pa las thon pa'i rang rtogs rang bzhin shugs che ba'i 'gan 'khur gyi 'du shes shugs drag yod med las 'jal dgos/ mi rigs kyi mgrin tshab pa ru bsngags pa'i snyan ngag pa zhig la mtshon na/ de lta bu'i dungs zhen med na mi rigs de'i lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi mdun ljongs dang 'byung 'gyur sogs la sems khur gnad du khel ba zhig byed thabs bral/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas bzung rtogs sad thob pa'i rtsom pa po skor zhig gis bod spyi tshogs kyi 'phel 'gyur dang mdun bskyod kyi gom stabs re re/ lhag par spyi tshogs 'di'i nang 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i bod mi rigs kyi bde skyid dang 'byor phyug bag phebs dang zhi bde bcas la blo sems rtse gcig gis thugs mnyam 'jog bzhin yod la/ deng rabs bod kyi bud med na gzhon rtsom pa po dpal mo ni skor khag de'i nang gi gcig yin/ kho mos bod mi rigs la bcangs pa'i brtse dung dang /bod mi rigs la 'khur ba'i 'gan 'khri/ bod mi rigs kyi phyir 'phyur ba'i zungs khrag bcas 〈〈nga / rang nyid kyi dar cha yin 〉〉zhes pa las mtho ru bsgredagaza shi/da phu/sdo //nā snron rlu/ tsho/dri chen pos lhab lhab du skyod kyin yod/nga tsho thun mong gis gsos pa'i me phung dmar po'i ngogs su 'dzoms dus/ljid tig tig gi brjod bya nam yang drag tu 'bar/ — 213 —

mdang dgong yang zla 'od med pa'i mtshan mo zhig red/phyi rol na 'khyag grang shin tu rno/dgun nam ring mo de la su yang gnyid ma khugamadang dgong /zla 'od med pa'i mtshan mo der/nga dang me tog mang po sems mthun ngang lhan du bzhur/gom stabs 'jam zhing yang mo'i ngang /yur zin pa'i 'jig rten 'di ma dkrog par/smin la ma rnyid pa'i gang bu re re las/zhe mthun pa'i gtam gleng mang po lhug por grol/mi⑨mi rigs kyi mdun lam dang ma 'ongs par sems khur dang bsam gzhig byed pa ni deng rabs kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po rnams kyi bsam blo gsar pa'i bgrod stangs shig yin pa 'dra/ lha mi rigs la lo rgyus yod pa nas rang dbang 'dra mnyam dang thob thang 'dra mnyam thob phyir srog bsdos kyis 'thab 'dzing mtshams 'jog byas myong med la byed kyang mi srid/ 'di ni mi'i rigs kyi ches rlabs che ba'i brtson len dang 'tshol snyeg yin pa lta ci smos/mi azhes pa dang / snyan rtsom 'dis 46zla 'od med pa'i mtshan mo re rer zhes snying 'jags kyi khor lug cig las/ rtsom mkhan gyis stong zhing 'jags la/ grang 'khyag dang smag nag pa'i khor yug cig slong skrun byas thog skabs de'i me phung gi mtha' 'khor du 'dus pa'i pho gsar mo gsar rnams kyi sems khams de mtshon pa dang / slob grwa che 'bring gi slob ma rnams ni tsa ljid tig tig gi brjod bya mi de gleng bar mos pa'i bsam pa ni drag tu 'bar ba'i me dpung dang bsdongs nas mu med stong 'jags kyi mkha' dbyings su mched pa na/rigs rgyud kyi brtse ba glu ru gyer zhing ma 'ongs par 'chang ba'i sems 'dun gyi rkang stabs skoX bro'i dbyangs snyan dang bstun te 'gros mnyam par bsgyur — 214 —

zhing 'khrab pa ni ji 'dra'i stobs shugs kyis khengs pa zhig red ang / 'di ni mi rigs shig gi mdun ljongs skya ris su 'god pa'i gzab rgyas 'du tshogs shig yin kyang srid/ de'i don snying ni gnam sa'i khyon du mi shong la bskal ba ma stong bar du nyams pa med/ gnas de ru 'dzoms pa'i slob ma rnams la mtshon na mi rigs kyi 'dun ma de dus nam yang snying khong gting na 6 ljid tig tig migis mnan 'dug pa'i zu brjod bya mi 'ba' zhig yin pa dang / de la g.yol thabs bral zhing gzur thabs med pa ni rang nyid rang la dungs pa'i lhag sems kyi rus rkang la chags pa'i nying bcud kyis so/ /yin na'ang don dam pa'i do dgung gi mtshan mo 'dir/ 6 phyi rol gyi 'khyag grang shin tu rno ba ni mi 'dod pa'i snang tshul thog tu babs 'dra dang sun snang gis 'khyer ba'i mtha' sne de dgun nam bzhin shin tu ring snang shar/ dngos yod ni de ltar rang sems kyi 'dun ma dang rgyab kyis phyogs pa zhig yin mod/ yang 6 zla 'od med pa'i mtshan mo mi zhig la/ gang ltar kyang mos 'dun gyi 'phal kha 'grig pa skor zhig gis mi rigs dang 'tsho ba'i mdun ljongs la rgyang lta byas pa ni/ brtse dung gi mtsho mo drag tu 'phyur ba zhig ma yin yang / 'jam zhing dben pa'i zla 'od 'og gi mtshe'ur snying gtam gyi chu phran sgra sgrog dang bral bar 'bab pa ltar byas/ de ni sems dang sems kyi brje res gnyom po zhig yin na'ang thang / skabs der rtsom pa pos rang rtogs dang rtogs sad la brten nas tha tshig cig rnyed pa ni/ 6 bu mo/ lhung lhung du bzhur dang / rgyang ring de rgyang mi ring zer mi ba de yin zhing / dus nam zhig la de ni kho mo'i 'tsho ba'i srog snying du'ang gyur tshar ba ma zad/ yod tshad kyi yod tshad spya la bste/ rgyu'i spobs pa snying la bkod pa klog mkhan tshos zhib tu myangs na ra ljizlo ma/kha/na dpal mos snyan rtsom 'di'i nang 66zla 'od med pa'i mtshan — 215 —

mo :zhes pa'i tshig rkang gsum rim par snyan rtsom gyi mgo mjug bar gsum du bkod de tshig don gnyis ka skor ba'i(༅7)thabs rtsal 'bur du thon par byas pas/ brjod bya dang brjod snying gang yin yang mang thal zhing 'chol ba'i snang ba mi ster la/ de las ldog ste nang don gcig bsdus dang gnad du 'gril ba/ bsam gzhig tshags dam pa bcas kyi khyad chos rtsol med du thon 'dug go/ 3 padma 'tsho dang kho mo'i snyan ngagapadma 'tsho/ pir ming 'chi med (1969wa ni mdo smad reb gong yul gyi sa dkyil sde bar skyes/ dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs dgu bcu pa'i stod tsam nas snyan ngag gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs shing / bod khul gyi dus deb ṭwāṃ //pa steng 〈〈khu byug〉〉/ 〈〈zla ba〉〉/ 〈〈'bri mo 〉〉sogs snyan rtsom lnga bcu lhag bod kyi bud med snyan ngag pa'i khrod du padma 'tsho lta bu brtse dung gi 'tsho bar chag 'jig rabs dang rim par byung myong ba zhig ha lam med pas/ rtsom mkhan nyid kyis bud med dag gi 'tsho ba'i skyid sdug dang bud med kyi khe dbang / spyi tshogs go gnas bcas la rtsom mkhan gzhan gyis bsgrun du mi bzod pa'i myong tshor mnga' zhing / kho mo'i snyan ngag nang thog mtha' bar gsum du bud med ni mi yul gyi 'jig rten 'tsho ba'i nang ches nyam nga'i gnas su lus shing / lus sems gnyis kur gnag pa'i dka' sdug sna tshogs kyi gdong mi bsu rang dbang bral ba dang / gnam 'og 'dir 'khor ba sar chags pa nas bzung bud med kyi las dbang de gzhan dbang dang mig chur bsdongs pa'i snang tshul la rgol sems kyi 'du shes drag po 'chang ste/zu khyod kyis gnag snum lan bu thur du 'phyangs par las — 216 —

bda' byas shing /'jig rten 'di shin tu dog pa'i nyams snang gis/sdug yus kyis khengs pa'i las dbang gi 'tsho ba rol/mi 〈smozhes pa dang / zu mos gsar rtsom byas pa'i snyan ngag mang por mi chos dang mi mthun pa'i srol rgyun gyi lta bar rgol ba'i 'du shes drag pa las gzhan/rang bkur rang gces kyi 'du shes kyang rus rkang du sim 'dug 'du shes de lta bu'i 'og mi'i sdug bsngal gyi go rtogs dang der bzung ba'i rnam 'gyur/ tshe srog la 'chang ba'i lta stangs sogs ni deng gi gangs can skyes ma dag gi thun mong gi 'dod blo zhig tu 'khums pas/ mos snyan rtsom gyi brjod bya de'ang bltos bcas su mang po zhig gi mgrin tshab tu bzhag na'ang 'gal ba med/mi (yices pas kho mo'i snyan rtsom gyi phyogs gtso bo zhig bstan 'dugaspyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i ma lag gal chen du gyur pa'i khyim tshang 'tsho ba dang lhag par gnyen sgrig gi 'tsho ba'i nang don gyi snying por gyur 'dug pa'i pho mo zung gi brtse dung la nyam chag shor ba'i bud med rtsom pa po 'di nyid kyis 66'khyag sib sib kyi snying khar spungs pa'i mi 'das zin pa'i lo zla ste ma gzhir 'od snang 'khyug 'os pa'i dus tshod skar cha re re 6 las dbang gi go 'dzol gyi dbang migis 6 mi kha yi lhags rlung khrod mi dang / 6 skyo gzhas dbyangs su bkug pa'i mi mig chu dang 6 lang tsho'i dmar mchod mi kyi zungs khrag gis bskyal bar yid shin tu phangs shing skyo ba dang sdug snang gi mig chu sham sham du 'bab bzhin/sna 'khyag sib sib kyi snying khar spungs pa'i kha ba'i 'dab ma/mig chu las skyur ba'i bsam don re re/brag la deb pa'i rlabs rgyun gyi zegs ma 'thor ba'i khrod du/dran byung ngam/rgyang ring gi skar ma 'od chen/— 217 —

yod tshad gnyid du yur ba'i 'jig rten zhig nas/khyod kyis sems 'gyu dmar po snyim pas btegs te/rkang pa spos par rjes shig yod dgos pa'i gnas lugs kyis/lang tsho'i dmar mchod drag po'i skyo gzhas dbyangs su bkug na'ang /mi kā yi /gas rlung khrod du 'tsher dgos pa'i re snyeg gi mar me sdus /bang/ gi go 'dzol yin du chugs/mi azhes sdug lus dang mi 'dod pa yod tshad las dbang la gtod pa ni dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod thabs kyis sdug pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig yin nges/'jig rten na ches yid du 'ong zhing snang ngor mdzes pa brtse dung zhes pa'i yig 'bru zung las ma mchis la/ snying la rtsub cing rang bzhin mi brtan pa/ kha ngo 'khyag cing khrel gyis 'das pa'ang brtse dung kho nar 'dzoms pas 'jig rten 'tsho ba'i 'khyag bsil dang khor yug gi mi kha rgod pos rtsom mkhan gyis 'tsho baji bcangs pa'i re smon yod tshad re zhig rmeg med du btang ba ltar byas sdu khye/da kyi mig mdun du lhung bzhin pa'i kha ba'i 'dab ma re re/snying sdug lags/nga'i skra lo yin ya/’zhonazhes kho mo'i bde skyid dang brtse dung gi mgo bo 'gal zla dang gyes bral gyi lcags dbyug gis bcom nas chag nyil ler btang na'ang /4 dmar po khrag gis sbrus pa'i re smon gyi rnam shes phra mos/rmi lam gzhan zhig gi rin thang gzhal phyir/snying la 'dzer ba'i 'khyag rlung gyi sgo glegs dal bur brdung dus/— 218 —

zhes / khyatshe dang 'tsho bar yid ches brtan po yod pa dang goms srol rnying par rgol sems kyi 'du shes drag po 'chang ba'i bud med snyan ngag pa 'dis rang nyid kyi mi tshe'i lhag ma der spro sems 'khyud cing re bas khengs bzhin/6 sems pa 'dis nam rgyun 'jam cag ger dran snang zhig bsrungs nas/khyed kyi gom sgrar sgug yod ces pa'i tshig shugs la 'jig rten gsar pa zhig la re zhing snyeg pa'i spobs sems kyi dpung ba gtum zhing / rang 'dun mngon 'gyur la re ltos kyis khengs 'dug 'das dus kyi 'tsho ba'i snyigs ro mtha' dag la rgyang bkyed pa dang bslu brid la gzhol ba'i ma 'ongs par brtson len byed pa'i gom stabs je brtan du btang 'dug 'gal 'du'i sems khams shig dang mi 'bral ka med kyi 'tsho ba'i brtse dung gi chag sgo rabs dang rim par khur ba'i dran gdung zhig gis slar yang dungs sems kyi me ro gting nas gsos pa ni de 'dra'i don dngos la kha 'khor ba zhig red ang /66'u thug gi dga' dgod re re'i 'dzum gnyer gseb tu/rdzogs mtha' med pa'i lha sgrung gi 'char yan sbrum/khyod rang bud sa'i gru kha re re na'ang phrag dog gi shog hrul 'dzing bas/las kyi rtogs brjod zab mos bzhag pa'i gom par yang lci shor/'tsho ba ni 'gal zlas grub cing /mi tshe ma gzhi nas skyo gar yin pa'i nges pa'ang khyod kyis de dus rnyed/’( gong mtshungs )ces pa dang / rnying zhing rgas pa'i lo zla'i bgrod stangs shig gis los yin/ gcig ngo gcig la sun pa'i zol bcos dang rdzun bag gi lha dga' dgod re re'i 'dzum gnyer gseb tu bskyar zlos min pa'i 'tsho stangs — 219 —

gsar pa zhig don du gnyer 'dod kyi 6 lha sgrung gi 'char yan sbrum mi pa ni dung zhen gyi slar gson zhig yin srid mod/ 'on kyang / mi kha dang phrag dog gi tsher mgo nam yang khyod la gtad pas mi tshe yi bgrod par yang lci mi shor rang dbang ci/ nam zhig gi dus na rtsom mkhan gyis mi tshe la mtshan nyid yang dag cig rnyed pa dang / 'das song gi tsha mngar skyur gsum rgyab tu g.yugs te 'tsho ba'i khor yug gsar pa zhig 'tshol ba'i dung sems kyi re 'dun 〈〈rgyang ring gi skar ma 'od chen 〉〉la bcol ba dang / rang sems 'byung 'gyur la phyogs pa'i snang ngo de nga tshos snyan rtsom las ngang gis rtogs 'ong ba red/ /dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/()6)khyung grags kyi 〈〈'tsho ba'i gzhung shing 〉〉zhes pa 2004lo'i 〈〈gangs rgyan me rtog 〉〉deb gnyis par gsal/'u'islob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi 〈〈mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi rnam thar 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe sgrun byas pa'i shog ngos 56par gsaladu/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi 〈〈'dod pa'i bstan bcos 〉〉kyi shog ngos 9par gsal(/)6)zhonarkusprerkunami rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2005lor dpe sgrun byas pa'i dpal mo'i 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉gi shog ngos 2par gsal/(1lo rin gyi 〈〈sngon 'gro'i gtam 〉〉zhes pa mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2005lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉shog ngos 8par gsal/()dpal lha'i 〈〈thog ma'i brtse dung 〉〉zhes pa mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2005lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉shog ngos 11par gsal/6)dpal mo'i 〈〈nga / rang nyid kyi dar cha yin 〉〉zhes pa mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2005lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉shog ngos 228par gsal/0yine'u chung gi 〈〈rang gshis gdung 'bod 〉〉ces pa 2005lo'i 〈〈gangs rgyan me — 220 rdo

tog 〉lha/dī kyā dīkā/'i 〈〈rgyang ring sga skar ma 'od chen 〉〉zhes pa mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2005lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉shog ngos 136par gsal/(yimatsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2005lor dpe skrun byas pa'i tshe grub kyi 〈〈so lta dang gzab nyan 〉〉gyi shos ngos 106par gsal/gsum pa/ 〈〈snyan ngag gi mig chu 〉〉rtswa thang la bstims pa/bde skyid sgrol ma ( 1967wa ) ni mtsho sngon zhing chen ho nan rdzong du skyes shing slob 'bring slob ma'i dus nas snyan ngag spel 'go brtsams/2003lor snyan deb 〈〈snyan ngag gi mig chu 〉〉dpe skrun byas/ kho mo'i snyan ngag skor zhig hpha ran si dang 'jar man gyi yi ger yang bsgyur yod/bde skyid sgrol ma ni lu gu'i 'ba' sgra dang be'u'i ngur sgra/ rte'u'i 'tsher sgra dang mnyam du dwangs gtsang mkha' dbugs dang mdzes sdug me tog char rlung lci 'dam khrod nas nar son pa'i rtswa thang gi bu mo zhig yin te/ 〈〈nga dang 'ba' 'ba' lu gu 〉〉las/6 khyod rang dga' ba'i bdag gi pang du mgo bo snyes byas brtse ldan ma mar phrad pa bzhin/ /de'i tshe bdag kyang yid sems rab myos lag pad zung gis khyod lus brang la dam sbyar te/ /chad med brtse dung yid nas 'phyur bzhin snying nye'i gdong der gces pa'i 'o zhig rtsom pa'i tshe/ /g.yu sbrang phye leb khyu ru bsdebs nas bdag gnyis bskor te 'phur lding zung gi zlos gar bsgyur/ /mi zhes pa dang / 'jig rten de ni ji 'dra'i tshon mdangs rnam par bkra — 221 —

zhing ji 'dra'i zhim mngar dri bsung ldang ba zhig red ang / kho mos g.yu sgang rtswa thang steng skad gsang mthon pos glu blangs pa dang / kho mo'i glu sgra de snum tshon gyi ri mo zhig dang 'dra la/ kho mo ni snum tshon ri mo de 'grub byed kyi tshon /sna // /// yang na de las bzhur yong ba'i snyan 'jebs kyi rol dbyangs nga tshos bde skyid sgrol ma'i 〈〈thog ma'i brtse dung gi 'du bral 〉〉dang 〈〈nga dang 'ba' 'ba' lu gu〉〉/ 〈〈snyan ngag gi mig chu〉〉/ 〈〈a ma'i glen bshad〉〉/〈〈bu bcol 〉〉sogs la bltas na bde skyid sgrol ma'i snyan ngag gi khyad chos gtso bo pha yul rtswa thang la bcangs pa'i brtse dung ngo ma de yin/ kho mo'i dwangs gtsang lhad med kyi byis blos 'das pa'i rtswa thang gi bzhin ras nam yang brjed med par mo rang gi dran par gsal lhang nger shar ba dang / de la brtse dung dang chags zhen tshad med bcangs pas mig sngar gyi snang tshul la rang dbang med par yid shin tu mug ste/〈〈rna thang gi brtse ba 〉〉las/sna nga la gnang rogs zhu ste/khyod kyis/'tsho bcud ma rnyed la bdag med du yan pa'i dkar nag gi sgo phyugs rnamasardza kāng 'a/gyur gyi dri mas bslad de rgyu lam 'gags pa'i mkha' yi dbugs rlung nāXg grwa/'i dug dud nag pos bdug cing gar 'gre sdug bsngal du gyur pa'i sprin phung rnams/tog /zlos pa/ 'i khor yug dog mor gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i mdzes sdug gi me thigasanya sdom pagro'i bzhur rgyun las chad de gang sar snang med du thim pa'i chu — 222 —

yod tshad 'di dag nga la gnongs dang /ngas/ dag gtsang lhad med kyi brtse ba ljang mdog gi sa bon du bsgyur nas/rad byung ma'i skye stobs kyi byin rlabs yod rgu rtsal sprugs byed rgyu lagasazhe// kyepa dang / rtsom pa pos nye ba'i lor 4 kho tshos pha yul dang nga tshor 'gyig khug sna tshogs dang tha mag gi shun sgam/ shel dam stong ba sogs gad snyigs shig las ci yang shul du bskyur ma song / de ltar kho tsho thag ring du bud song / thag ring ni ho tse'i snyan ngag nang gi thag ring ste sus kyang lag pa bsrings te reg thabs bral ba'i gnas de red/mi ②ces pa ltar/ 'brog pa'i rtswa thang sbag btsog gis bslad de nyams dmas su 'gro ba'i tshul der yid shin tu skyo zhing / snying gis mi bzod pa'i sdug bsngal zhig snyan tshig 'di'i tshig dang yig 'bru re re'i bar nas mngon pa ma zad/ 6 ngas/ dag gtsang lhad med kyi brtse ba ljang mdog gi sa bon du bsgyur nas zhes dwangs shing gtsang la yid du 'ong ba/ mdzes sdug ldan pa'i pha yul rtswa thang zhig la re snyeg byed pa'i 'dod blo de brtse dung gi mchu mas bris shing / nga tsho'i 'tsho sdod kyi khor lug cig gi ya gyal rtswa thang la dus gsum gyi las dbang gtad pa'i 'brog mo zhig gi brtse sems kyis khengs pa'i 'bod pa de snyan lam du lhang lhang 'khor yong ba 'dis/ 〈〈rna thang gi brtse ba 〉〉bklags ma thag snying nye ba'i tshor snang sbyin nges par ma zad/ 'brog pa'i bu mo zhig gis rtswa thang la 'chang ba'i re ba dang smon 'dun dag brtse ba'i gdung dbyangs dang lhan du ngang ngam shugs kyis mngon yong / bab chags shing rang bzhin brjod pa'i tshig sbyor dang brtse sems gshis su chags pa'i rlung shugs kyis gzhon nu ma'i dung zhen kha ba bzhin du rtswa thang chen po nyid gnas gzhir gtad pa dang / re ba'i 'od kyis — 223 —

phyug pa'i smon 'dun gyi mig zhags ring po rtswa thang la dam du 'khyud/ 6 ngas/'byor phyug 'dzad med kyi brtse ba thang ma ru brdal nas/ khrel gzhung dang snying rje'i dgos 'dod ci dga' ru ster rgyu lags/mi zhes bsams shing 'dod pa ni gzhon nu ma'i phugs bsam kyi sne mtha' yin la/ rtsom mkhan gyis rang nyid rtswa thang gi bdag mo zhig dang / lhag par gnas 'di'i bu bu mo zhig gi tshad nas zhib mor bsams na/ rang gnas kyi khor yug las sbyin pa'i mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa 'di mi rabs rjes ma'i tshe srog gi rgyun dang rten lta bu yin tsa na/ rtswa thang 'di'i steng 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i mi rnams kyis yul 'di srung skyob dang gces skyong / bdag gnyer bcas byed pa'i don ldan gyi las la skul 'dod pa'i sems 'dun de klog pa po'i blo ngor bkod pa ma zad/ snyan rtsopa 'di'i brjod bya dang rjod byed zung rgya je che dang gting je zab tu btang ba tā/ yul 'di'i brtse sems kyi mthar thug ni ma bu'i bar gyi brtse sems yin la/ a mar gyur pa mtha' dag gis gzhi nas rang gi bu phrug gi sna lus la drod skyid mi dang tsa sems la tshad med kyi brtse ba ster ba dang / 6 sham bha la'i zhing khams mi lta bu'i mi tshe'i bde skyid kyi khor yug cig bskrun 'dod pa'i sems 'dun de bden pa gser dang 'gyur med rdo lta bur grub 'dug pa dang / de ni mi'i rigs spyi la mnga' ba'i lhan skyes kyi sems bskyed cig dang /rigs rgyud cig mu nas mu ru brgyud byed kyi 'brel thag cig kyang yin pa red/'jig rten gyi mdzes pa la rigs mang zhing / ma bu'i bar du mngon pa'i brtse sems las bslangs pa'i mdzes pa der dus gtan du 'dzad med kyi zil shugs ldan/ snyan ngag pa'i myong stobs las mngon pa'i sgyu rtsal rang bzhin gyi brtse sems der/ 'tsho ba dngos las brgal ba'i bden snang yod par ma zad/de ni dus gtan gyi dran gzhi ru 'gyur ba'ang chos nyid cig yin/— 224 —

tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ nar ma son pa'i byis pa'i dus de ni ji 'dra'i lhad med dwangs gtsang gi mi gshis shig red ang / srid pa rgan pos 64bu chung sangs rgyas sa zer ba yang spyi tshogs kyi ra ris ma gos pa'i gdod ma'i dus kyi gshis ka de 'dra zhig la bshad pa yin zhing / de bzhin du bde skyid sgrol mas kyang spyi tshogs kyi zang zing dang rtog 'dzing gi khor yug 'dir 'jigs snang ha cang skyes shing / thog mar sems la thogs pa ni gnyom lag ma rgyas pa'i rang gi bu phrug yin pa dang / ma 'ongs par de'i lus sems la gnag pa'i snang tshul mtha' dag la sdang sems gting nas skyes pa'i zhar la 'gro ba spyi'i sems khams shig bzung ste a ma mtha' dag gi byams brtse gong bur bsgril bas/ snyan rtsom las mngon pa'i tshor 'du yod tshad la snying nye ba'i bden stobs kyis phyug 'dug pa red/ 〈〈a ma'i glen bshad 〉〉las/smyo bu chung lags/ nar ma son cigatshar lwa chung chung la sked rags dam po zhig bcings nas/bsam med kyi gom pa a ma dang 'o ma'i bar nas skyongs/phyi rol gyi 'jig rten ni/dug sbrul smyon pa'i tshang mal yin pas/khyod kyi byis blo dwangs mor dug rlangs phog nges/bu chung lags/ nar ma son/a ma'i brtse 'dang gi drod khol rum la bcug nas/phyi rol gyi yod tshad go thos su ma byung na ji 'dra'i skyid ang /bden rdzun 'khrug rtsod med la dogs gzhi'i dra rgya med/kha yag ngo gnyis med la khyod shi nga gson med/nar ma son pa'i byis pa ni lha las babs pa'i kha btags shig rjo— 225 —

ces pa dang / snyan ngag pas rlabs che ba'i ma yum zhig gi ngos nas bu chung nar son par sems khur tshad med byed pa dang / spyi tshogs steng gi ya nga zhing skyug bro ba'i bya byed mtha' dag dmar rjen du bton nas zur za dang kha rdung drag po btang ste/ dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi rul sungs kyi snang tshul la 'khang sems bcangs pa dang zhen pa log pa bcas ni yun ring myangs pa'i sdug bsngal las thon pa'i go rtogs dang sdug bsngal de las thar 'dod kyi spobs sems shig kyang yin/ shin tu phyug pa'i don dngos kyi 'tsho ba'i nyams myong dang bslab byas nan skul byas pa yin nam ci ste/ ma rabs tha shal la mtshang 'byin dang dgag rgyag gi ya lan sprod pa'i 'dod blo dang spobs sems bzlog med cig snga mo nas yid la brnag 'dug pa dang / 'di las kho mo ni lhad med dwangs gtsang gi rang gshis mnga' zhing 'tsho bar spro sems che ba'i bud med snyan ngag pa zhig yin pa'ang zhar la shes thub/ yang 〈〈bu bcol 〉〉las/6 nam zhig nga'i bu lo'i gom 'gros thog ma/'khyar 'khyor gyis mdun du spo na/sra 'thas kyi mtshan nyid 'jog pa'i sa gzhi yis/nga'i bu lor bde zhing yangs pa'i bgrod pa'i bgrod lam phye la/sa khams kyi rtsub rig sel bar gyis/mi④zhes pa dang / 'jig rten steng a ma'i brtse sems las snying nye ba dang rnam dag cig gang na mchis/ gong gi snyan rtsom dum bu 'di las nga tshos a mas bu phrug la sems khur dang gces skyong byed pa'i 'gan khur de tshor thub la/ a ma'i phugs bsam gyi gzhi ru snying gi dum bur gyur pa'i gces phrug de bde blag ngang spyi tshogs dang mi tshe'i bgrod par bde zhing yangs pa'i lam zhig phye ba dang / mi 'dod pa'i rtsub reg mtha' dag sel bar snying nas smon — 226 —

'dun zhu ba'i brtse zhen dang dran gdung gi chu gnyer tsha mo zhig 'phyur 'ongs spras klog pa po su dang gang gis bklags kyang tshor snang skyid po zhig ster ba da/ bde skyid sgrol ma'i snyan ngag gi brtse dung 'don stangs 'dis kho mo'i snyan ngag la rang grub kyi tshe srog cig chags/ tshe srog 'di ni pho mo'i brtse dung kho na tsam min pa ni snyan ngag pa'i khyad chos kho nar zad de/ snyan deb 〈〈snyan ngag gi mig chu 〉〉la mtshon na 'brog phrug ma zhig gi las dbang btsan po'i mig chu de rtog pa 'char yan ring lugs kyi bkod 'bri brgyud de tshig rgyan phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan ngag gi lam nas rgyas par spros yod/ thor si thes 66sgyu rtsal pas mi gzhan la shugs rkyen gtong bsams na/ kho rang gi gsar rtsom ni zhib tshags kyi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin dgos la/ kho rang yang zhib tshags mkhan zhig yin dgos/mi②zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bde skyid sgrol ma'i snyan ngag la phul du byung ba'i brtse dung gi khyad chos las gzhan/ da dung thog ma'i blos bslangs dang byung rim sogs kyi thad ha cang zhib tshags kyi khyad chos de 'dra zhig kyang thon 'dugamador na/ bde skyid sgrol ma'i snyan ngag gis rang dbang la re snyeg dang rtswa thang la dung zhen/ bde skyid kyi 'tsho bar yid smon byed pa ni mo rang gi 'tsho ba'i goms srol dang zab tshad/ srol rgyun rig gnas kyi zhun sbyangs bcas la rag las pa dang / nam yang drang bden dang ya rabs la lag 'then dang g.yo sgyu dang zol bcos la dog brdzis gtong ba ma zad/ spyi tshogs steng gi ma yin yin mdog gi gdong 'bag ci rigs bshus par ya mi nga ba'i rang gshis shig chags thub pa byung ba ni bud med rtsom pa po zhig gi ngos nas bshad na ha cang khag po red la rin thang yang che snyam mo/ /

bzhi pa/ 〈〈dung sems kyi 'dab ma 〉〉las bzhad pa'i snyan ngaga'abrug mo skyid (1959wa )ni mtsho sngon zhing chen gung ho rdzong du skyes/dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas bzung rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi las su zhugs pa dang / snga rting du 〈〈bod kyi brda sprod rig pa dang snyan ngag las 'phros pa'i gtam 〉〉zhes pa dang 〈〈phyi gling rtsom rig gces bsdus 〉〉zhes pa'i dpe cha gnyis dang / 2006lor snyan deb 〈〈dung sems kyi 'dab ma 〉〉zhes pa dpe skrun byas yod/〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉las/ snyan ngag mkhan bsam dgongs pa ste/ zhes rtsom pa po'i bsam pa ni rtsom gyi dgongs pa yin par bstan pa dang / bsam pa de mchog gyur rnam dag cig yin min yid gshis kyi blo sbyong la rag las stabs pe lin zi khis gom gang sngon spos kyis tsa snyan rtsom gyi rang bzhin sems gyi ngo bo la gson nyams thon pa dang / mngon sum gyi snang yul dang mdzes sdug gi nyams dang ldan par byed pa yin/mi duzhes dang / 〈〈sgyu rtsal gyi rtsa ba'i gnad don 〉〉las/ 6 tshig la bltas na yul ljongs kho na bris pa'i rtsom yin yang / rtsom mkhan gyis yul ljongs kyi mthong snang la brten nas yid kyi nyams snang ci rigs dang / phyi rol yul las snang ba'i sems kyi tshor snang ston par byed do/ / ②ces pa ltar/ snyan ngag ni phyi rol yul gyi dngos po la rtsom pa po'i bsam blo dang tshor 'du zhugs pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa zhig yin tsa na/bud med snyan ngag mkhan 'brug mo skyid kyi rang gshes de kho'i snyan ngag nang sim zhing 'dres yod pa gor ma chag ste/ snyan rtsom 〈〈'khor ba 〉〉zhes par khyad chos de dag mngon 'dug ste/6 snying gi thig le btab pa'i mdza' na mo zer nas//mig gi bdud rtsir 'thung ba'i mdzes zhal rang smin pas//— 228 —

snying chung lu gu 'phur lding zhabs bro la rol bzhin/ /brtse sems 'dzin mar gsang ba'i sa bon zhig btab song / /gdong la blta bar mi bzod dung sems kyi khur bo/ /skad cig 'bral bar mi 'dod zhen sems kyi thag pa/ /phyogs su blta bas mi ngoms 'khreng sems kyi lcags kyu/ /zhe mthun snang ba gcig la gcig 'dres kyi 'o ma/ /’zhes pa dang / rtsom 'di'i brjod bya'i nang don thad nas spyi khyab kyi rang bzhin ldan pa zhig yin te/ 6 pho mo'i bar gyi mdza' zhen ni mi'i rigs kyi brtse 'dun bya ba'i nang gi grub cha gal chen zhig yin pas/ thog ma nas bzung ste mi rigs so so'i snyan ngag pas spyi rdzas ltar nyar ba'i 'jig rgyu med pa'i brjod bya zhig red/mi0ces pa ltar/ bud med snyan ngag pa 'dis mi'i rigs la lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs pa'i mdza' zhen gyi brjod bya de 'dems nas rang nyid kyi myong tshor ri mo'i tshul du bris yod/ snyan tshig nang du 4 snying gi thig le mi de mig gi 6 mdzes zhal mi du smin pa dang / da dung sna mar lo'i khu ba dang 6 'jo sgeg zhal khyim / 6 a sngon dbyings kyi rgyu skar mi sogs brnyan ris la rtsom pa po'i dung sems kyi tshor ba zhugs pas snyan ngag gi yul khams gsar pa zhig bzhengs skrun byas 'dug pa dang / klog mkhan gyis gnas der bsam zhing bsam zhing 'jig rten mthun snang gi khor yug khyon yangs pa zhig la kun rtog 'phros chog pa ni kho mo'i snyan ngag la yid yul phun sum tshogs pa zhig mnga' bas red/gna' deng krung phyi'i snyan ngag rig pa ba rnams kyi bzhed tshul ltar na/snyan ngag gi yul khams ni rtsom pa po rang ngos kyi brtse dung dang phyi yul gyi dngos po'i 'jig rten gnyis chu dang 'o ma bzhin phan tshun 'dres pa las — 229 —

byung zhing grub pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi zhing khams shig yin pa dang / gsar du byung ba'i mdzes dpyod rig pa'i gzhung lugs 'dis dus yun ring po'i gsar rtsom lag len khrod kyi nyams myong dang 'bras bu phyogs bsdoms lta bu byas yod pa dang / kho mo'i snyan rtsom 〈〈skyo gdung gi dran pa 〉〉las lhad med dwangs gsal gyi tshig sbyor gyis bzhengs shing bskrun pa'i yid brnyan gyi tshogs grub du ma las brtse dung gi rin thang dang / brtse dung gi dran pa/ brtse dung gi skyo shas sogs yid yul phun sum tshogs pa dang / rtsom mkhan rang ngos kyi bsam blo'i dung then dang dga' skyo sogs zhugs yod pas yid yul de dag rang gshes can gyi tshul du mngon par byed de/lha mdzes sdug gi chang phor de na/bla 'khyams pa'i rnam shes shig yom yom du skyom zhing /re zhig sdug bsngal mtha' dag ring du bral/ re zhig sdug bsngal gyi khur bo pha mthar bskrad/lham mer 'bar ba'i sgron me'i ngogs su/ya yor 'gul ba'i grub gzugs shigastong ba'i zhing khams de na ra ror bzi/sa sros khu sim du gyur pa'i gling ga na/yang bskyar bor zin pa'i rkang rjes de rnams re re bzhin/dran 'dzin gyi rum la btus/snyan ngag pa re re'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bya dngos la lta zhib byed pa'i goms phyogs dang dga' phyogs/ gshis rgyud bcas kyis yid yul gyi rang gshis grub pa yin pa ltar/ bud med snyan ngag pa 'brug mo skyid kyis mdzad pa'i snyan rtsom gyi bang ba thog mtha' bar gsum du nyams dang yid yul la — 230 —

sogs pas gyur bur gtams 'dug gong gsal snyan rtsom 'di'i yid 'gul thebs pa'i gnad gtso sa de ni brtse dung gi rlabs ris gcig rjes gnyis mthud du mngon zhing snga ma las phyi ma je rgyas je drag tu song ba de yin pa dang /nam rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi byed sgo rang ga ba zhig gi go rim las sems bsam pa'i gting gi lha 'dod don lkog gyur pa de mtshon pa dang / skabs 'di'i pho mo'i dung zhen gyi brjod bya brtsams chos de'i tshe srog gi mchog lta bur zhugs yod pa dang / snyan ngag pa'i tshig nyams la don gyi ro phun sum rdo/sdu ༵ / // /da cha re re'i nang du mo'i brtse dung gi re smon thams cad dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/0ta()6)bde skyid sgrol ma'i snyan deb 〈〈rna thang gi mig chu 〉〉zhes pa zhang kung gyi lang dpe skrun khang gis 2002lor dpe skrun byas par gsal/0yiskyabs chen bde grol gyi 〈〈snyan ngag gi gsang myul ba zhis gi zin tho 〉〉zhes pa 2004lo'i 〈〈gangs rgyan me tog 〉〉deb dang por gsal/()thor si the'i 〈〈dmag 'khrug dang zhi bde 〉〉zhes pa hrang he'i mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis 1982lor dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 245par gsal/6)(1sun yun hri'i 〈〈krung go'i deng rabs snyan ngag klos khrid 〉〉ces pa pe cin slob grwa chen mo'i dpe skrun khang gis 1990lor dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 112par gsal(/)bde skyid 'tsho'i 〈〈sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu 〉〉zhes pa si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2006lor dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 12par gsal/— — 231 —

le'u gsum pa/ bod kyi deng rabs lhug rtsom/sa bcad dang po/ sbyi bshad/spyir lhug rtsom zhes pa bod rang gi srol rgyun ltar na bcad lhug spel ma gsum gyi rtsom stangs gang gi yan lag tu gyur pa ste/ tshigs su ma bcad par lhug par brjod pa'i rtsom dang bstan bcos kun la ngos 'dzin dgos mod/'on kyang nga tshos 'dir 'chad pa ni rtsom rig gi brtsams chos kyi rnam pa'i char gtogs pa ste/ rtsom pa pos nyams snang 'bri ba dang / brtse dung ston zhing /brjod bya'i thad bkag rgya med par lhug mar 'bri ba'i rtsom thung ngu stabs bde de dag la ngos 'dzin byed dgos/bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig khrod kyi lhug rtsom gtso bo tho 'god kyi rnam pa ltar byung ba shas che ba dang / bod kyi gdod ma'i rig gnas sgrung lde'u bon gsum la mtshon na'ang ngag thog nas mi rabs mang po brgyud yod pa gdon mi za mod/ kha ba'i yul 'dir yi ge byung ba nas bzung bod kyi lo rgyus rnams thog mar lhug rtsom gyi rnam pa'i sgo nas tho 'god byas pa zhig yin te/ 〈〈sba bzhed 〉〉dang / rdo ring yi ge tun hong gter yig brag brkos yi ge sogs ches snga ba'i lo rgyus yig cha rnams deng rabs lhug rtsom dang bsdur na thun min gyi khyad chos shig yod pa ni/ rtsom rig dang lo rgyus/ chos lugs sogs rig gnas mtha' dag mnyam bsres kyis 'bri ba'i rtsom stangs de yin/ 66'bri stangs 'di la'ang phyi'i rnam pa rtsom lus kyi cha nas mnyam bsres byas te bris pa dang /nang don gyi cha brjod bya sna tshogs mnyam bsres byas te bris pa gnyis yod/rtsom gyi phyi'i rnam pa'i cha rtsom lus sna 'dzoms yin pa ni/ lha sgrung gi rtsom — 232 —

stangs dang / dngos 'bri'i rtsom stangs/ gtam rgyud kyi rtsom stangs gang rung yod la/ tshig sbyor spel stangs kyi cha nas kyang rkang pas bcad pa dang / lhug pa/bcad lhug spel ma'i lus gang rung mthong rgyu yod/ nang don gyi cha nas sna 'dzoms yin pa ni/ lo rgyus dang / rtsom rig chab srid/ dpal 'byor/ dmag don/ mi chos dang yul chos sogs rig gnas mtha' dag brtsams chos gcig tu 'bri ba'i srol lugs yod pa de'o/ /mi duzhes pa dang / bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom lus kyi ya gyal du gyur pa'i tho 'god lhug rtsom glegs bam gcig las rig gnas kyi rnam grangs mang po zhig mthong thub par ma zad/ rtsom lus kyi rnam pa'ang gang mang zhig ngang gis chags shing 'phel rgyas 'gro ba mthong thub/bod kyi gna' rabs lhug rtsom la mi rigs so so'i gna' rtsom dag la mnga' ba'i thun mong gi khyad chos de dag thog ma nyid nas yod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ 6 'di ni gdod ma'i dus mi rnams kyi bsam gzhig gi spyi'i khyad chos shig ste gdod ma'i sna 'dzoms bsam gzhig gi khyad chos las byung ba zhig yin/ gdod ma'i dus kyi mi'i bsam gzhig ste don spyi'am gtan tshigs kyi bsam gzhig (74644)dang snang brnyan bsam gzhig (7464 )gnyis su gyes med pa'i dbang gis skabs de'i brtsams chos su brjod bya gang mang 'du bar ma zad/ brjod stangs kyi cha nas kyang don rkyen zhib brjod byas pa'i tho 'god lo rgyus rnams kyi bden pa'i ngo gdong gsal bar yod la/ sgro 'dogs rang bzhin che ba'i ngag rgyun gtam rgyud dang 'char yan rang bzhin che ba'i lha sgrung gi zhing khams mtshon pa'ang yod/ rjod byed tshig gi cha nas kyang mgur dang / gtam dpe/ shags tshig sogs dpe 'jog gsal zhing mdzes pa/dbyangs kyi 'gyur khugs dang ldan pa/ ro nyams kyis mi'i yid sems 'gugs pa/ gtan tshigs rang bzhin gyi don brjod nus pas phyug pa/ mi sna'i snang brnyan rnams mig mdun du lhang nger shar ba sogs yod/ mi②ces pas gna' — 233 —
