rabs lhug rtsom gyi ngo gdong spyi ris tsam zhig yid la 'khor thub pa yin/gdod ma'i mi'i de lta bu'i bsam gzhig byed stangs las byung ba'i lo rgyus dang rtsom rig 'dres ma'i khyad chos 'di ni srol rgyun gyi rtsom stangs gal chen zhig yin/ de yang tho 'god lhug rtsom ltar lo rgyus dngos bris pa rnams las/ mang che ba zhig la lo rgyus kyi bden pa'i ngo bo yal nas rtog btags sgyu rtsal gyi cha snang la/ 'ga' zhig dus yun ring por ngag nas ngag tu brgyud pa rnams tho 'god byas pas dmangs khrod ngag rgyun gtam rgyud du gyur/ 'ga' zhig tu lo rgyus don rkyen gyi byung rim rnams zhib 'bri byas pa gsal la/ mi sna dang don rkyen/ dus dang sa gnas/ byung rim sogs zhib cha ldan zhing mi sna'i snang brnyan gson nyams ldan par bzhengs yod pas lo rgyus dang rtsom rig gnyis ga'i rin thang mnyam du gnas zhes brjod kyang chogadus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs bdun cu pa'i mjug tsam nas bzung / mi rigs rang gi rig pa'i dpa' bo'i dpung khag 'bor chen zhig 'tshar longs byung zhing / mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang dus rabs kyi snying stobs gnyis 'dzoms pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos kyang char rjes kyi myu gu bzhin thon/ de'i nang du snga na med pa'i rtsom srol gsar pa zhig ste/ lhug rtsom zhes pa'i rtsom lus byung ba dang / de la rtsom gyi rnam pa dang sgyu rtsal/ nus shugs gang ci'i thad /sa bltas kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mngon par gsal ba zhig na /rngog na lhug rtsom ni rang re'i bod mi rigs la mtshon na deng dus spyi tshogs gsar pa'i nang byung ba'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa gsar pa zhig yin pa dang / ('dir bshad pa'i gsar byung zhes pa ni bod la gna' dus nas lhug rtsom zhes pa 'di med zer ba min gyi/ de ni rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi cha nas rnam pa gsar pa dang nang don gsar pa ste/ dus rabs kyi rang bzhin ches — 234 —

cher ldan zhing / brtan chags kyi rtsom tshul bcas yod pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa gsar pa zhig la bya ba yin/) de ni bod kyi rtsom rig 'phel ba'i sa zhing gshin por chu lud drod gsum gyi mthun rkyen kun nas 'dzoms pa'i gsar rtsom gyi me tog phreng ba lhug por grol ba lags te/ rtsom pa po rnam kyis mu mthud du skyong gnyer legs par mdzad pa dang sgyu rtsal gyi mtho sar drangs nas bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus kyi shes rig dang deng dus kyi rnam pa gsar pa mngon par mtshon par byed pas na/ ma 'ongs par rtsom rtsal gyi 'bras bu g.yur du za ba smin par gdon mi za'o//nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring 'grem spel byas pa'i lhug rtsom dag gi nang du/ la las thun mong ma yin pa'i mtho sgang gi sa khams kyi chags tshul lam yang na mtshan snyan gyi ba dan rgyal khab phyi nang du lhab lhub g.yo ba'i rig gnas kyi mdzad rjes bris shing / la las kun yid cig car du 'phrog nus pa'i yul ljongs kyi mdzes ris dang khor yug gi khyad chos sogs kyi ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan la dmigs nas bstod tshig bris pa dang / la las lo rgyus ring zhing bab chags pa'i gna' bo'i yul srol goms gshis bzang po la bsngags brjod mdzad cing / la las bsdus brjod dam gab tshig gi tshul du spyi tshogs steng gi tshul min gyi bya spyod la sun 'byin dang ngo rgol/ dgag rgyag mdzad la/ la las phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos shig la bsngags brjod byas pa brgyud nas spyi tshogs ring lugs sam tang gi 'go khrid la bsngags brjod mdzad cing / bod mi rigs kyi rnam par bkra ba'i blo gros dang las la brtson pa'i rang bzhin/ mes rgyal la dga' zhen che ba'i bsam blo bcas la bstod bsngags ches cher mdzad/la las rang nyid kyi mthong thos dran reg bris pa brgyud de rang mi rigs kyi mdun lam la sems khur byed pa ste rang nyid kyi yid sems phangs med du bton pas klog pa po rnams la skul 'ded kyi nus pa ches cher thon 'dug— 235 —

'di dag tshang ma srid jus gsar pa'i nyin byed 'og rang re'i mi rigs kyi gsar byung rtsom mkhan rnams kyi blo gros las byung ba'i grub 'bras dngos shig yin la/ deng rabs mi rigs rtsom rig rgyu rtsal gyi 'phel rgyas la'ang skul 'ded kyi nus pa chen po thon yod phyir/ dngos gnas dga' 'os pa dang spobs pa skyed 'os pa'i gnas shig yin par 'dod do//dus skabs gsar pa'i byod kyi lhug rtsom gyi rtsom pa po'i dpung khag ha cang rgya che ste/ khong tsho'i gas su srid stegs steng gi mi sna grags can yod la/rig rtsal las rigs thad kyi snyen ngag pa dang sgrung gtam pa/ 'khrab gzhung rtsom mkhan dang / mkhas pa rgan pa/ na gzhon shes yon can/ bud med rtsom pa po bcas 'dus pa red/ kho tsho rtsom 'bri bar dga' zhing mos par ma zad bod spyi tshogs la 'gan khur 'du shes shugs drag pa'i mi sna dag tu nges/ khong chos gsar rtsom la 'jug cing brjod bya zhig gtan la 'bab skabs/ yul dus kyi tshad bkag med par/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi don rkyen dang mi sna/ rang byung gi yul ljongs/ yul srol goms gshis sogs sna re 'bri ba'am yang na mnyam bsres byas te 'bri ba dang / spyi tshogs kyi don snying rgya chen po ldan pa'i brjod bya rgya chen po dang / yang na nang don nges can zhig ldan pa'i 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi don phran tshegs rnams dmigs su bzung zhing rtog bzo byas te 'bri rung ba'i lhug rtsom gyi khyad chos gtso bo dag la mthong chen gnang gi yod/nga tshos dus skabs gsar pa'i lhug rtsom gyis spyi tshogs la thon pa'i nus pa dang dge mtshan gleng skabs bsam blo 'di ltar btang na 'os snyam ste/ dus rabs sngon ma'i smad tsam nas bzung / mtsho bod mtho sgang ni rgyal khab phyi nang kun gyi mi rnams kyi mig sga lta sa dang yid kyi dbang po gtod yul 'gangs chen zhig tu gyur cing 'gyur bzhin yod pa las/ khong tshos gnas 'dir lo ngo bcu phrag kha shas nang byung ba'i gnam sa bla 'og bsgyur ba lta bu'i 'gyur ldog — 236 —

de rtogs 'dod pa ma zad/ dus yun shin tu ring ba'i gna' bo'i mtho sgang gi shes rig lo rgyus la'ang skom pas chu 'dod bzhin 'jug 'dod skyes shing /bod kyi deng rabs lhug rtsom gyis sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas klog pa po so so'i dgos 'dod skong bzhin yod/1978lo nas 2006lo'i bar ni/ lo rgyus steng gi dus skabs gang zhig gis kyang bsgrun du mi nus pa'i dus shig yin te/ lhug rtsom la mtshon na dus skabs 'di ni mtsho bod mtho sgang gi sa phyogs kun tu rtsom lus 'di'i ljang myug rnam par rgyas shing me tog lhug par bzhad pa/ 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i lang tsho ngom pa'i dus skabs shig yin/ 'dir nga tshos rags rtsis shig byas pa ltar na/ bod yig rkyang rkyang gi lam nas bris pa'i lhug rtsom gyi grangs ka chig stong tsam la bslebs pa dang / 1985lor bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis dpe bskrun byas pa'i 〈〈bod ljongs kyi lhug rtsom bdams bkod 〉〉nang bsdoms pas lhug rtsom 36bsdus yod pa dang / 1986lor dpe bskrun byas pa'i 〈〈bod kyi deng rabs lhug rtsom gdam bkod 〉〉nang bsdoms pas lhug rtsom 37bsdus yod/ 1993lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe bskrun byas pa'i lhug rtsom bdams bsgrigs (bod kyi deng rabs dpe tshogasawa 〈〈kha ba'i rnam shes 〉〉〉nang du bsdoms pas lhug rtsom 57bsdus yod pa dang / 2001gi lor dpe bskrun byas pa'i lhug rtsom bdams bsgrigs (sbrang char lo 'khor 20dpe tshogs 〈〈lhag rtsom padma'i ze'u 'bru 〉〉〉nang lhug rtsom 69bsdus yod/ 2000lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i lha nag pa ba res kyi lhug rtsom phyogs bsgrigs 〈〈sngon mo spang las 'khrungs pa'i sems kyi rol mo 〉〉nang lhug rtsom 48bsdus yod/ 2004lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i ldong yon tan rgya mtsho'i lhug rtsom phyogs bsgrigs 〈〈skad cha'i lang tsho 〉〉nang — 237 —

lhug rtsom 51bsdus yod/ gong gsal gyi lhug rtsom dpe deb drug po 'di dag gis gzhi rtsa'i steng bod kyi deng rabs lhug rtsom 'phel rgyas kyi grub 'bras gtso bo'i phyogs mtshon yod/ 1980lo nas 2005bar gyi lo ngo nyer lnga tsam gyis ring rang cag gi lhug rtsom rtsom pa po'i dpung khag 'di 'bras bu'i khur gyis lci bzhin mi rigs gzhan dang gzhan gyi rtsom pa po rnams kyis dus rabs gcig gam yang na de las ring ba'i dus yun du song ba'i lam der bskyod cing skyod bzhin mchis la/ 1985lor zhing ljongs lnga'i mnyam 'brel gyis bsgrubs pa'i bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig bya dga' dpyad 'dems tshogs 'du'i steng lhug rtsom bzhir gzengs su bstod pa'i bya dga' thob pa dang / 'brel yod dpyad gzhi ltar na 1985lo nas2005bar lhug rtsom bcu phrag gcig lhag la rim pa so so'i bya dga' thob yod pa 'dis deng rabs bod kyi lhug rtsom zhes pa'i rtsom lus kyi gsar rtsom nyams myong dang sgyu rtsal mtshon stangs kyi chu tshad cung mtho ba zhig tu bslebs 'dug pa mtshon no//bod rigs rtsom pa pos brtsams pa'i lhug rtsom 'di rigs kyi brjod bya khyab rgya che ba ma zad/ brjod don gyi zab tshad kyang rim bzhin gting rim du phyin 'dug nga tshos bod kyi lhug rtsom gyi brjod bya'i nang don gyi thad la phyogs bsdoms dang dbye ba tsam phye na/ gtso bo phyogs gsum nas 'chad na 'os snyam ste/ mtsho bod mtho sgang gi rang byung khams kyi mdzes sdug bris pa'i lhug rtsom dang / bod kyi rig gnas goms srol bris pa'i lhug rtsom/ mi rabs gsar pa'i /lha/ ༵ ༵nga re 'dun bris pa'i lhug rtsom bcas su snang ba cung rgyas par — 238 —

sa bcad gnyis pa/ mtsho bod mtho sgang gi rang byung mardzes sdug bris pa'i lhug rtsom gyi skor/nga tsho mtsho bod mtho sgang zhes pa'i sa la dge bcu tshang ba'i gnas 'dir 'tsho na'ang / mtho sgang gi dge mtshan rtogs pa'i mi shin tu nyung la/ lhag par mtho sgang gi khor yug gtsang zhing dag pa me long lta bu dang ri chu mdzes shing sdug pa skyed tshal lta bu dang / dus bzhi'i dbye ba gsal zhing char chu snyoms pa'i gnas mchog tu 'tsho ba rol ba'i skal ba ldan na'ang sems nang log dang grong khyer sogs yul gzhan dang gzhan du shor zhing mtho sgang gi dge mtshan dang de'i khyad chos sogs la bsam blo de 'dra mi gtong ba red/ nang sgos su mtho sgang gi rtsa ba'i rmang gzhir gyur pa'i sa chu nags gsum dang rlung char sprikā gsum la bsam blo'i brtse dung gi 'dun ma bcol mkhan ni de bas nyung dī tsho kā/da mtho sgang la bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ldog byung zhing / gnas 'dir 'tsho ba'i mi rnams ni blo rig gsal zhing kun rtog phun sum tshogs pa/ rtog btags kyi rlabs ris nam mkha'i klong rim du 'phyo ba zhig yin phyin phyi snod kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag dus skabs gsar pa'i lhug rtsom gyi brjod gzhi'i stegs bur nyams 'gyur rdzogs pa'i stangs stabs bsgyur ba dang / rtsom pa po dag la khyad du mnga' ba'i phra zhib kyi blo gros dang tshor 'du drag po'i rkyen gyis bskul te/ yid kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs phyi dngos po'i steng du 'phos shing mtshon gang thub byas pa'i lhug rtsom mang po char rjes kyi sha mo brdol ba ltar byung / dper na/ 〈〈rkang lam phra mo 〉rnomeyis mtsho bod mtho sgang gi sa khams chags lugs la rtog zhib phra zhib gnang yod cing / sa rtsub g.yang gzar gyi brag ri'i steng du khyim gzhi btsugs — 239 —

shing bgrod lam btod pa'i bod mi'i spobs pa sems gting nas khas blangs pa ma zad/ rtsom pa po kho rang yang gnas de lta bur chags pa'i grong tsho khri khri 'bum 'bum nang gi gcig tu skyes pas na chung dus nas bzung ri grong gi bgrod lam nyag gcig tu gyur pa'i rkang lam phra mor rang shugs kyis dung zhen zab mo zhig chags yod/ 6 char ba zim zim du 'bab pa'i nyin zhig la/ngas thengs dang por dpe khug khur te nga tsho'i sde 'dabs kyi rkang lam phra mo de ded nas slob grwar song ba yin/ rkang lam phra mo de ni nga tsho'i sde 'dabs nas thur du skya thag ger yod kyang / nyin der char bas bran par brten snum shig ge/ smug seng nger 'dug lam dkyil kyi rde'u zegs rnams brlan zhing 'jam la/ snum zhing 'od 'phro ba dang / lam 'gram gyi ljon shing thor bu dang / dra ma dang lcang ma la sogs pa char rlung 'jam po'i grogs dang bsdebs nas dal bur g.yo zhing yod pas/ ri rked du phar gug tshur yon gyi tshul du yod pa'i rkang lam phra mo de la'ang srog gi dbang bo zhugs te g.yu 'brug gson po zhig 'khyug ldem byed pa dang a na ma na red/ tsortsom pa pos ri khul du gya gyur 'then pa'i rkang lam phra mo de lo rgyus steng gi ri grong re rer mtshon na bsub tu med pa'i byas rjes dang ngo mtshar bskrun yod tshul bris nas gzhung lam gyi yon tan de las lhag pa dang / mi rnams la re snyeg byed pa'i phyogs gsar pa zhig ston 'dod pa'i bsam blo mngon 'dug rkang lam dang gzhung lam gnyis bris te bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng rabs rig gnas gnyis thabos mkhas kyis mtshon yod pa dang / 6 lam phran 'dis bod gangs can gyi lo rgyus thog mar bskrun te rig dar gyi bod rigs 'di sngon thon gyi ri rtser bskyal pa dang / lnga rig gi glegs mdzod kyis lcags ri bskor te 'dzam gling gi yang rtse nas khyim gzhi btsugs/mi ⑤zhes lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i ring la bskrun cing bsags pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas 'dis rang re'i lo rgyus steng zin pa'i go — 240 —

gnas dang phan yon la khas len gtan khel byas pa dang / skabs 'dir rtsom pa po nyid lo rgyus la phyir mig lta mkhas pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ ma 'ongs pa'i mdun ljongs la rgyang lta byed phod pa zhig tu lags pas/ khong gi sems gting nas shes tshor byung ba ni/ 6 gna' mis btod pa'i rkang lam phra mo 'di rgya che ru gtong ba la sa 'jor gcig brkos ma myong la khem gang yang bcus ma myong /rkang lam phra mo 'di'i thog tu gom pa'i 'degs 'jog ci tsam bsgyur ba ni bgrang gis mi lang na yang / rkang lam phra mo 'di'i phan yon dang / nang sgos su rkang lam phra mo 'di la gzi brjid dang la rgya snon rgyu ni yid la'ang dran ma myong /mi0zhes gdod ma'i dus nas btod pa'i lam phran 'di'i steng du mi rabs du ma zhig gcig rjes gcig gis snyeg ste da lta'i dus su bslebs pa ni rkang lam 'dis bod mi rigs la bzhag pa'i gzi 'od 'bar ba'i byas rjes su kun gyi kha na rlung ltar sgrog gin yod na'ang / mi rigs gzhan dang gzhan gyi gong 'phel bya ltar mgyogs pa'i dus 'dir rang rigs da dung yang 6 khod snyoms shing yangs pa'i gzhung lam gyi bslu brid la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i shes tshor byung / de ni rmongs pa dang rjes lus kyi gnyid las sad pa'i 'bod sgra yin pa dang / 'bod sgra de la ri klung ma lus kyis lags so'i tshig sga me tog ma 'thor yang / ma mtha' yang des nga tsho tshang mar rnying pa dang deng rabs kyi khyad par gsal du bcug cing / bar khyad de nyid med par gtong ba la bsam blo gsar pa zhig kyang bstsal byung /mi⑦yang 〈〈dgu chu'i glu dbyangs 〉lokyekyis mtsho bod mtho sgang gi khyad chos gtso bo ste/ rtsi shing ma lus phun tshogs su rgyas shing chu bo yod tshad lhung lhung du 'bab pa'i mdzes sdug ma lus dgu chu'i steng 'phos te 6 dwangs gtsang gi bzhin/ gya gyu'i 'gros/ lhung lhung gi sgra zhes klog pa po'i mig dang snyan dbang gi lam du mdun bskyod kyi rlabs sgra mkha' la 'phyur cing gson shugs — 241 —

kyi lang tsho dar la bab pa'i chu bo nyams med cig gi gzugs brnyan gsal bar bkod pa dang / der mthud nas 6 de ni gtsang po lhung lhung dal gyis bzhur ba dang mi mtshungs te/ byang phyogs dngul 'brug ring mo zhig nga rgyal gyis ma bzod par sa babs te 'khyug 'gros byed pa'i gar stabs sgyur bar brel ba'i gzugs brnyan 'dzin/mi ②zhes te/ srol rgyun gyi rtsom stangs las ring du brgal ba'i rtsom thabs gsar par bsten nas dgu chu'i glu dbyangs de spyir btang gi glu dbyangs shig dang spyir btang gi chu bo'i rlabs sgra zhig min par bod mi rigs 'dis gna' nas da bar lus kyis myong zhing ngag tu gyer ba'i dga' skyo zung gi lha glu dbyangs mi shig yin pa dang / yang gcig na dgu chu ni gangs ljongs dang nang sgos su rang gi pha yul reb gong phyogs su gnas tshul ci byung gsal bar gzigs myong ba'i blo khog drang zhing ya yo bral ba'i lo rgyus rgan po'i snang brnyan gson nyams ldan par bris nas/ gsar rtsom gyi sgyug rtse thog mtha' bar gsum du lo rgyus kyi rjes su dam por 'brangs shing / bod mi'i snying stobs dang gzi brjid/ stabs nyes dang pham kha sogs phyogs mang po zhig gi thad nas legs par mtshon pa ni dus rabs kyi dgos mkho dang mi rnams kyi re smon dang yongs su 'tsham pa zhig yin/lhag par smyo kye dgu chu lags/ de lta bu zhig yin pa bden pa'i phyir/ khyod ni than pa'i brag ri gtor ba'i gnam lcags kyi thog mda'/ khyod ni tsha ba'i gdung ba sel ba'i 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi/ khyod ni skom pa'i sdug bsngal 'jil ba'i sprang char gyi bsil ma/ khyod ni mun kha'i yol ba rlog pa'i 'jig rten gyi sgron me/ khyod ni gyizhes brjod 'dod kyi dmigs yul de mngon sum du bstan zhing phar la blos btags shing gang zag cig tu sgro btags nas/ las la brtson zhing dpa' ngar ldan pa/ blo rig rno zhing spobs pas khengs pa'i bod rigs mi dmangs kyi gshes ka de sna khyod ni :zhes dgu chu'i steng spos pa dang /— 242 —

dgu chu'i bzhur rgyun gyi gzugs brnyan du bod rigs mi dmangs rnams kyi snying stobs bstims yod/ 'dir rtsom mkhan gyi shugs drag pa'i tshor 'du dang phun sum tshogs pa'i kun rtog la brten nas/ 6 ma 'ongs pasakhyod la lag brda bstan nas 'bod kyin yod cing /khyod kyi 'dun pa dang /re ba/bde skyid rnams ma 'ongs pa'i lag tu bsnams yod pas/ rnying pa'i gram pa dang / rjes lus kyi lung ba/ rmongs dad kyi 'phrang 'gag ma lus phangs med du bskyur nas ma 'ongs pa'i phyogs su rgyugs shig mi①ces rtsom mkhan gyi re snyeg dang smon pa drag tu 'bab pa'i rlabs rgyun la bcol ba dang / dgu chu'i 'gog med kyi bzhur rgyun nam nyams la bod rigs mi dmangs rnams kyi rang gshis dang spobs pa/ nyams med kyi snying stobs sogs 'gyur ba'i srog zhugs su bcug ste/ 6 dgu chu la ma 'ongs sngon mthong gi mkhyen dpyod/ ma 'ongs gsar gtod kyi snying stobs/ rnying pa rgyab bskyur gyi spobs pa/ gsar pa nang 'dren gyi blo gros kun mnga' brnyes pa ni nam yang 'dzad mtha' med cing / 'gyur ba med pa/ nyams pa med pa/ 'jigs pa med pa bcas yin pas/ mdun skyod kyi bshul lam du gnas pa'i dka' ngal gyi ri bo 'bigs par nus shing sdug bsngal gyi 'khyag rom 'degs par spobs/mizhes pa kha ba ri bar 'bod pa'i mi rigs 'di'i rang bzhin nyag gcig tu 'khums shing / de la brten nas kāna' skyis deng bar 'dzam gling shes rig gi mdun gral du gom stabs sgyur nga dīgs rtso/ ma hril por dus rabs kyi tshor 'du drag po dang bod mi rigs la bcangs pa'i lhad med brtse dung gis zin cing / khag khur gyi sems dang spobs pas khengs pa'i phugs bsam dang re smon mngon pas/ klog pa po rnams kyi yid sems g.yo ba'i shugs dang ldan no//〈〈khu ba babs rjes kyi zhogs pa 〉snokhyazhes pa'i lhug rtsom gyi rtsom pa pos — 243 —

dus tshigs bzhi las dgun dus kyi mtho sgang gi rnam pa'i mdzes nyams de zhib 'bri byas pa ni/ smyo kha ba babs rjes kyi nangs snga mo'i zhogs pa zhig la/kun gsal sgeg mo'i lus po la skya thing thing gi chu 'dzin dar zab kyi na bzas kun nas bklubs 'dug pa ni/ nor 'dzin bu mos kha ba'i gos dkar gyon pa la 'gran zhing snyems pa ltar snang / bdag gis lwa ba g.yang sham byas te sdod khang gi phyi rol tu thon nas/ bsil zhing dwangs pa'i mkha' dbugs kyi lus la sim pa ster ba'i reg bya nyams su myong zhing / dkar zhing 'tsher ba'i kha ba'i mdangs bzang gis ri klung kun la khebs pa'i mdzes nyams la gang 'dod du lta/miḥzhes mtho sgang gi kha ba'i dus 'dir 'jo sgeg lus phra ma yis rab dkar du kyu la yi gos bzang legs par bgos pa lta bu'i tshar du dngar ba'i lhun sdug ri bo'i tshogs dang rgya che zhing khyon yangs pa'i thang gzhung ni dngul dkar gyi me long du ma sa la lhung ba lta bur bris shing / mtho sgang gi kha ba'i dus kyi gtsang zhing dag pa'i mkha' dbugs dang dkar zhing dri mas ma gos pa'i kha ba'i 'dab ma bris pa brgyud nas/ phyi gtsang nang gtsang gi khor yug dang kha khog gnyis med kyi mi dang mi'i 'brel 'dris/ phyi gsal nang gsal gyi bsam spyod/ bdag pas gzhan gces kyi lhag bsam bcas rang gshes dkar po yug gcig tu khyab pa'i spyi tshogs srol lugs shig chags par re ba'i bsam pa rnam dag de bstan no//〈〈gangs ri 〉lo1dang 〈〈shel gyi lhun po 〉mokhyasogs la mtshon na/ rtsom mkhan dag gis mtsho bod mtho sgang gi ches 'bur du thon pa'i khyad chos mnga' ba'i gangs ri de brjod byar bsten pa dang / 6 spyir 'jig rten khams kyi mi tshang mar phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos la dga' sdang chags zhen gyi bsam phyogs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs shig 'byung nges pa ni smos ma dgos pa zhig yin te/la la ni rgya mtsho dang gtsang por dga'/ la la ni brag ri dang nags tshal la — 244 —

mos/ la la ni spang ri dang rtswa thang la zhen par ma zad/ g.yang gzar dang gcong rong la 'dun pa 'chang mkhan yang yod srid na/ ngas rang gi dga' phyogs ltar pha yul gyi gangs ri dkar po de la sems kyi gting nas mos pa de ni ha las shing ngo mtshar ba zhig tu 'gyur mi srid snyam/miXzhes rang gi pha yul ste mtsho bod mtho sgang ni 'dzam gling na ches mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas shig tu brjod pa ma zad/ gnas de'i mtshon byed lta bur gyur pa'i gangs ri ni de bas kyang rngam brjid ldan zhing drong nger 'gying ba/ 'dzam gling hril po'i mdzes pa'i tog dang nor bu'i khungs su bsngags pa dang / 6 des mi tshad khyed la spyan zung yang ldan te/ 'jig rten gyi bde ba dang sdug bsngal/mdzes pa dang mi sdug pa sogs la gzigs ched gya gyu'i 'gros dang lhung lhung gi sgra yis ris med du le bar khri 'bum la skyod pa'i rma chu dang 'bri chu gnyis ni khyed nyid gcig pu la ldan pa'i mig 'bras yin no//mi kyizhes pa dang /gangs ri las mched pa'i gtsang chab kyis mi yul la tshe srog gi ljang myug 'bus pa dang gangs can gyi shes rig gis 'jig rten la mig zung sbyin pas mi'i rigs la zhi bde dang bde skyid kyi rten 'brel gnas de nas 'grig pa red/ rtsom mkhan gyis rang gi dungs zhen dang brtse sems kyi me tog dkar po'i phreng ba gangs ri'i mgul dang kha ba'i ljongs su phul yod/ gnas mchog de lta bur skyes thub pa ni nam yang la rgya zhig dang / chung ba'i dus nas bsam pa dge la phyogs shing spyod pa dag par 'jug thub pa byung ba'ang shes rig gi lo rgyus yun ring ldan pa'i pha yul gangs ljongs kyi drin yin par bsam zhing bsam nas bsngags brjod gnang yod pa red/〈〈gro ma'i me tog 〉mokhyadang 〈(āo thang / me tog gi 'jig rten/ 〉〉khya〈〈'dab brgya lhug par grol ba'i me tog 〉snokhusogs la mtshon na/ mtsho bod mtho sgang gi ches mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i dus te dus tshigs bzhi las — 245 —

nam zla'i lang tsho dar zhing ljang mdog gos su bklubs pa/ sgeg pa'i mgrin pa 'khyog cing me tog mgo lcog ldem bzhin dbyar gzhung gi mkha' dbugs 'jam po'i gom stabs mi yul gyi sems ldan re re'i snying khong du bsgyur ba na/mdzes sdug dpal du gtams shing dri zhim g.yang du 'khyil ba'i mtho sgang gi rtswa thang ni lhe mtshar sdug gi bdag po/ dri bsung gi gter chen/ yid 'phrog gi byed po bcas kyi bdag nyid can du gyur mi ⑨yod/ rtsom pa pos 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi dran tshul dang bsam gzhig sna tshogs rtswa thang dang me tog la bcol nas zu rtswa thang du thengs dang por gad pa'i me tog der spobs pa bla na med pa zhig ma mchis na/ skye ga la thub/ nga'i mig 'od slar yang rkang 'og nas rgyang ring la 'phur/ me tog rtswa thang du skyes shing rtswa thang du nyams/ ser sna'i sgrog gis ma bcings par dri zhim gyi bdud rtsi phangs med du sa gzhi chen por phul/ rang lus kyi mdzes dpal gyis rtswa thang sgeg mor dar gos bskrun/ dpyid dpal lha mos rtswa thang la 'khyud nas gar stabs bsgyur pas na/ mdzes sdug de'i byed po khyod nyid yin pa gzhi nas shes thub/miyices pa dang / dngos gnas me tog gis char chu dang zil ba'i khrod du gang bu sbrum zhing / bser bu dang nyi 'od kyi khrod du rtsa lag rgyas te/ rtswa thang gi nyin mo la mdzes sdug gi lang tsho gsar pa phul byung / nga tshos me tog gi lus steng du mdzes sdug dang / gzhan don/ bde skyid kyi ched du rang gi yod tshad blos gtong thub pa'i snying stobs shig mthong thub pa ma yin nam/ de lta bu'i bla med kyi mdzad spyod la sems can thams cad kyis dga' ba'i gus bkur dang rjes su yi rang byed pa smos ma dgos te/6 nyi ma ni khyod la dga'o/ /nyi zer gyi khrag thigs re re khyod kyi lus la 'dren bzhin yod/ zla ba ni khyod la zhen te/ zla ba'i bsil zer gyis khyod kyi snying khams kyi tsha gdung sel bzhin mchis/ sbrang char ni khyod la dungs te/ char ba'i thigs pa re res khyod kyi rtsa lag rgyas par byas/9spyi nga tsho'i 'jig rten 'dir — 246 —

las 'bras dang drang bden med pa zhig ga la yin/ dpyod shes kyis btang ba'i rang byung khams su'ang gzhan phan gyi 'gul bskyod kun la rgyab brten du 'gro ba lta bu'i chos nyid du ma zhig lugs su chags yod pa yin na/ nga tsho bsam blo dang shes rab ldan pa'i 'gro ba mi'i spyi tshogs su smos ma dgos so//〈〈mnyen 'jam rtswa'i glu sgra 〉lo7dang 〈〈nga ni rtswa phran 'di la dga' 〉lomisogs la mtshon na/ rtsom pa pos mtsho bod mtho sgang du ches spyir btang dang ches dma' rim gyi rtswa nyag de dag gi steng du bsam blo'i brtse dung gi 'dun ma bcol nas/ ra rtswa'i nyag ma 'di dag gis go gnas dang rang don mi gnyer bar rang tshugs su nyag ma re re bzhin skyes pas mdzes sdug ldan zhing yangs shing rgya che ba'i rtswa thang 'di grub/ de bzhin du pha yul gyi zhing kha'i mu khar yang skyes shing rgyas/ spyir na sa chu dang dpyid rlung tsam zhig yod na gnas dang yul gang rung du skye bar nges shing rgyas par 'gyur/ yid gzhungs khog yangs kyi rtswa phran 'di dag gis khe grags ham gnyer gyi kun slong gtan du spangs nas me tog dang rtsi shing sogs kyi 'og tu khengs rlom dang bral zhing / shes med tshor med du skyes shing rgyas bzhin 'dug miXces rang bzhin brjod pa'i 'bri tshul gyis/ 6 rtswa rang nyid la gsom dkar ljon shing lta bu'i nga rgyal gyi mgo 'phang dgung la zug med cing gzugs stobs chung la nyam nga ba/ skye bo phal ba'i bgrod byed kyi 'og nas khengs skyung gi rnam 'gyur lham lham ston bzhin mchis shing / rta nor lug gsum gyi 'tsho rten kho nar gyur yod pa dang / skye bo sus longs su spyod 'dod na khor grags 'gul ci yang med par rang lus phangs med du sbyin pa'i snying stobs phul du byung ba ldan la/ rtswa rang nyid la yid 'ong me tog lta bu'i mdzes sdug dang yid 'gugs kyi nus pa med kyang 'gyur med gser bzang lta bu'i sems shugs dang / rdo rje brag ri 'dra ba'i srog snying /dmar po me 'od 'dra 'dra'i spro sems bcas ldan yod/mi yices pa dang / nga — 247 —

tshos 'di las lhag pa'i brjod ngag zhig btsal te rtswa nyag de dag gi rang gshis mtshon dka' bar snyam/ ngo ma/ bsam blo zhib tu btang na rtswa nyag de dag gi rin thang dang bka' drin ni gnam sa'i khyon du'ang shong dka' ba zhig red ces bshad chog 'jig rten sa chags pa nas bzung rtswa'i rigs kyis 'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs dang bla na ma mchis pa'i gshis spyod kyis mi yul 'dir tshe srog gi 'od snang sbyin zhing bde skyid kyi mtsho mo bskyil/ brtsams chos 'di'i nang zur mi 'dra ba du ma zhig bdams nas rtswa'i rigs kyi dka' ba khyad du gsod pa'i snying stobs dang / ngal ba khur du bzod pa'i spobs pa/'tsho ba la dga' zhen dang ma 'ongs par re ltos byed pa'i gshis ka legs par mtshon yod pa ma zad/ rtsom mkhan dag rtswa phran dag la de ltar dga' ba dang mnyen zhing 'jam pa'i rtswa yi rnam pa dang de'i gshis ka la bsngags pa brjod nas bod rigs 'brog pa dag gi bla med kyi gshis spyod dang rang bzhin rnal ma de mngon ston byas yod pa red/lhug rtsom 'di rigs kyi rtsom pa po 6 gal srid 'brog phyogs kyi 'tsho ba la cha rgyus med pa dang / 'brog phyogs kyi rtswa thang la brtse dung zab mo med pa yin na/ kun slong 'di lta bu 'byung mi srid pa dang / 'du shes 'di lta bu skye mi thub par ma zad/ gzugs stobs chung zhing khengs skyungs ldan pa'i rtswa yi rang bzhin dang rin thang la gdeng 'jog 'di lta bu yang byed thub kyi ma red/gnad ka 'di'i thad nas bshad na/ 〈〈mnyen 'jam rtswa'i glu sgra 〉〉ni brjod bya'i don zab pa'i rtsom legs po zhig yin la/ glu sgra de ni rtsom pa po'i sems kyi gting dang glo rgyu'i mtshams nas byung ba'i bod rigs kyi gshis ka ldan zhing / brtse dung gi 'dun ma che ba'i 'tsho ba gsar pa'i bstod glu dang spyi tshogs gsar pa'i 'brog phyogs dang 'brog pa'i rtswa thang gi bka' drin dran pa'i gsal 'debs kyi glu sgra zhig red ces bshad chog mi yices pa dang / de'i — 248 —

sgyu rtsal gyi cha la'ang / 6 〈〈mnyen 'jam rtswa'i glu sgra 〉〉ni cung zad legs par grub pa'i rtsom zhig red/ rtsom pa pos sems ldan gyi khyad chos sems med rtswa yi thog la 'god pa'i thabs lam bed spyad de/ rtswa yi rnam pa dang / rtswa yi ngo bo rna yi rang gshis/ rtswa yi khyad chos bcas khyad chos zhib mor bris yod pa dang / de dag gis 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi rang gshis dang khyad chos mtshon yod/miXces te/ cung gnad du khel ba'i sgo nas dpyad gtam spel 'dug pas zhib 'jug la spro ba yod pa dag gis rtsom yig de la gzigs par 'tshal/〈〈lan gru grong khyer gyi dpyid dpal 〉ponyelta bur mtshon na/ rtsom pa po bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig la cung zad goms yod pa gzhir bzhag ste/srol rgyun gyi rtsom yig 'bri thabs bcad lhug spel ma bkol spyod byas nas rang re'i mes rgyal nub byang gi grong khyer chen po lan gru zhes pa'i yul ljongs kyi mdzes ris dang khor yug gi mdzes nyams ma lus snyan 'jebs dri za'i dbyangs kyis brgyan nas gsal por bris pa ste/ 〈〈gsar bzhad 'dab phreng dgod pa'i bkrag mdangs 〉skoyilas/ thog mar bod kyi srol rgyun rtsom yig 'bri tshul ltar tshigs bcad kyi phreng ba'i me tog gis sngon bsus nas rjes su go rim yod pa'i ngang grong khyer de ni rang rgyal gyi sa phyogs gang du gnas pa dang /sa de'i ri mtho tshul dang sa gtsang tshul/chu klung mang tshul/ljon pa mdzes tshul/ sa yi dge bcu tshang tshul bcas re rer bsngags brjod mdzad de rang byung khams kyi dpyid dpal sgeg mos nor 'dzin khor yug steng gi ljon pa dang me tog 'dab brgya'i tshogs kyi myu gu 'khrungs su bcug pa de dpe byas nas mi rnams kyis tang gi srid jus gsar pa'i nyin byed 'og rang rang las bgos kyi gnas su hur thag rbad chod kyis bya ba sgrub bzhin yod pa'i tshul legs par mtshon yod pa red/mtsho bod mtho sgang gi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam pa dang /srid du 'ong ba'i khor — 249 —

yug lta na sdug pa'i mdzes ljongs sogs brjod byar bsten cing legs 'grub byung 'dug pa'i lhug rtsom cung mang ste/ dper na/ rtswa dang rtsi thog shing dang ljon pa sogs kyi zad med nus shugs dang zhum bral spobs pas go la zlum por ljang mdog gi tshe srog sbyin pa bris pa'i 〈〈ljon pa'i tshal gyi ngo mtshar gzigs mo 〉poyidang / lhun brjid gzi byin 'bar ba'i lhun po dag gi rtse mo dgung du bsnyegs shing / gnam sngon po'i gos chen thang la btings 'dra'i mtsho mo sngo mer 'khyil ba/ rtse mo kha ba'i gos dkar gyis g.yogs pa'i brag ri dang rked par sngon shing gi ska rags mdzes par bcings pa'i spang ri/ dwangs shing gsal ba'i margad mdog can gyi mtshe'u/ cang shes rta mchog gi gom 'gros bser ma rlung la 'phyar ba/ ne tso'i sgro thul gyon 'dra'i spang ljongs yangs pos dbus su dga' spro'i glu dang skyid pa'i bro la rol ba bcas bris pa'i 〈〈gzi rtsa sde dgu'i mdzes ljongs 〉lomidang 〈〈chab cha rtswa thang gi bkra shis glu sgra 〉lo7dang / 'jig rten khams ni ma gzhi nas gsang ba chen po zhig yin la/ 〈〈gsang ba ya mtshan 〉tshomigyi rtsom pa pos nga tsho'i khor yug gi gsang ba khri ma 'bum las bro ba ldan zhing bshad tshul ngo mtshar ba'i brjod bya gcig bdams nas/ thog mar sa de'i yul ljongs kyi mdzes sdug bris nas rim bzhin sa de nas gsang ba ya mtshan ji ltar byung tshul dang / sna dad ldan skye bo bgrang bya'i yul las 'das pa rnams kyi yid kyi brtan pa phrogs dang 'phrog bzhin yod tshul/ mi la las da rung rgyang grags khri phrag du ma'i bshul lam ring po'i dka' ba la ma 'dzems par rkang thang gi las la ji ltar zhugs tshul/mi yilha bya phug ron gyis lha khang gi srung mkhan brtsis tshul sogs bris pa brgyud nas mthar gsang ba ya mtshan de mi rnams kyi 'dren byed yul du gsal rjen du bton pa red/ yang 〈〈rang byung chu tshan mthong ba'i snang tshul 〉poyigyi rtsom pa pos kyang 6 dpyid kyi dpal mo mngon par shar ba'i dus su 'dzam gling gi — 250 —

yang rtse ste mtsho bod mtho sgang zhes pa'i snyan grags kyi ba dan g.yo ba'i byang rgyud du spyi le dgu tsam phyin pa na/ 6 yangs pa can zhes pa'i thang chen po gser gyi me long 'dra ba zhig yod pa de las dus rtag tu lang long du g.yo ba'i bsang dud dang / lhog lhog tu 'phyur ba'i rlangs pa'i gzugs brnyan ngo mtshar can zhig 'dren byed kyi lam du 'char/ de yang rgyang ring nas bltas na mtsho rlabs drag tu 'phyur ba dang mtshungs la/ nye sar bcar tshe dbyar dus kyi smug long dang 'dra ba de ni sus kyang ma bzos lhun gyis grub pa'i yangs pa can gyi rang byung chu tshan zhes pa de yin no/ // zhes rang byung chu tshan gyi khyad chos dang rang bzhin/ phan yon/ 'dzad mtha' med pa'i rang byung gi nus par 'od stong can du 'tsher ba'i glog sgron gyi yon tan ldan zhing / kun la bde skyid skrun pa'i snying stobs dang mtshon bya'i yul du gyur ba'i mi rigs kyi spobs pa dang mi dmangs kyi gsar gtod rang bzhin/ mtho sgang gi mdzes sdug yul ljongs bcas la bsngags brjod mdzad yod/sa bcad gsum pa/ bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus bris pa'i lhug rtsom gyi skor/'dzam gling gi yang rtse dang kha ba'i khrod du 'tsho ba'i bod mi rigs la sa khams chags lugs dang rig gnas lo rgyus/ chos lugs grub mtha' sogs kyi dbang gis mi rigs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos dang thun min gyi goms gshis shig chags yod pa dang / de yis bod mi rigs kyi bsam blo'i 'du shes dang mdzes dpyod lta ba/ mos 'dun phugs bsam/bza' btung gyon chas/ yin min 'dzem bya sogs mtshon bzhin yod/ mi rigs shig gi rtsom rig gi rnam pa gang yin yang mi rigs de'i gnas bab kyi — 251 —

spyi tshogs lo rgyus las byung zhing ches phul du byung ba'i rtsom rig ni mi rigs de'i yul dus nges can zhig gi bden pa smra ba'i lo rgyus yin te/ gnas bab ngo ma mtshon zhing rang gi dga' skyo chags snang sogs brjod pa'i rtsom pa po zhig yin na/ rang nyid kyis 'os 'gan 'khur dgos pa zhig kyang yin dgos/6 lhug rtsom ni spyi tshogs dang mnyam du 'tshar longs byung ba'i rig gnas shig yin mi nyapas/ rtsom lus 'di'i brjod bya yang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi bzang ngan dge sdug kha 'thab pa'i klong nas myong dgos pa'ang gor ma chagadus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi rgan gzhon rtsom pa po khag gcig gis lhug rtsom ste ches thung zhing 'bri bde ba/ don gsal ba/ gnad du khel ba/ rtsom mkhan gyis 'phral du bkod thub pa dang klog mkhan gyis kyang 'phral du mthong thub pa'i rtsom lus de bkol nas mi sna dang bya dngos bris pa dang / rtsom mkhan gyi ngos zin te brjod snying zhig mtshon par byas yod/ lhag par lo rgyus steng gi mi sna dang rig dngos dag 'bri skabs phyogs bsdus kyis mi sna'i rang gshis dang byung rim nges can zhig nas mtshon bzhin yod/ rtsom yig hril po'i sgrig rim cha tshang zhing nang don phun sum tshogs pa/ bris pa'i tshig 'bru nyung na'ang brjod bya'i bsam don cung zab cing go rim gsal ba zhig yin te/ dper na/ 〈〈mi don phug ron gyis dpyad pa'i gtam rgyud 〉lokhyakyi rtsom pa pos bslab bya dang legs bshad kyi rtsom lus zung 'brel gyi mtshon stangs spyad de/ bod mi'i chab srid dang chos lugs/ kun spyod/ bsam blo/ 'tsho ba bcas kyi phyogs la the gtogs byed 'dod pa'i gsar rtsom 'du shes 'chang bzhin/dmangs khrod ngag rgyun bgrang las 'das pa'i nang rang nyid kyi bsam blo mtshon thub pa'i brjod gzhi'i sa bon gcig bdams nas smyo gna' dus rgyal po kun dbang zhes bya ba zhig yod pa'i pha mes thams cad kyis mgo nag mi rnams la dbang bsgyur myong bar ma zad/ 'dab chags bya rnams la'ang dbang — 252 —

bsgyur bar grags rgyal pos de bzhin zhal gyis bzhes nas de ma thag bya skad shes pa'i pho nya rnams bsdus nas/ gnangs nyin nyi ma rtse shar la bya thams cad gcig kyang ma lus par mdun gyi thang chen du 'tshogs rgyu'i brda sbyor bar mngags so/ /mi⑦zhes gtam rgyud kyi byung rim cung cha tshang ba'i nang mi sna gtso bo 'dab chags phug ron smra shes don go mi'i gzugs su bzhengs nas/ 'jig rten mi chos kyi brjod bya gnad du khel ba zhig klog pa po'i mig lam du bstar ba ste/ rgyal po zhig yin phyin rgyal srid ji ltar skyong ba dang 'bangs la ji ltar byams pa/ 'dod chags sogs ma rabs kyi las ji ltar spong ba dang / sgos su bod mi rgan dar gzhon gsum gyi blo sna ya rabs kyi phyogs su bkri bar bya rgyu ni rgyal po'i bla nas blar mchis pa'i 'phrin las su snang ba'i kha ta nan tur byas pa ste/ 6 yang mi rnams kyis btsan po dang gnyom chung gnyis kyi gang mang zer ba la/ phug ron gyis btsan po mang ngo zer/ blon po rnams kyis gnyom chung mi mang bar btsan po ga la mang zhes bshad pas/phug ron gyis gnas 'dir mtshon na de ltar lags kyang / 'jig rten yongs la bltas na btsan po mang ngo / /'on kyang btsan tshod med pa rnams gnyom chung gi phyogs su brgyab na de gnyis mang nyung med do zer/btsun mo dpal 'dzin gyis btsan tshod med pa rnams gnyom chung gi phyogs su rgyag don ci yin zhes dris par/ phug ron na re/ btsan tshod med pa rnams kyis gnyom chung la btsan gnon dang bshu gzhog ya nga ba byas na/gnyom chung rnams 'u thug nas lhan 'brel gyis btsan po cham la 'bebs na/srid na de 'dra'i btsan po gnyom chung dang khyad ci yod zer bas/ blon 'bangs rnams sngar bzhin 'ur zing se song nas/ 'di 'dra'i gnas tshul sngar mang du thos myong la phyin chad kyang 'byung ngo bsams 0gong gi tshan pa las rgyal po zhig la cha mtshon na/ 'bangs phal ba las — 253 —

thugs bkod mdzangs dgos pa dang / rgyal po'i dbang cha rang bzhin ngan zhing lkog g.yo 'chang ba'i blon po sogs kyi lag tu gtod mi rung zhing / rgyal po nyid ni sna bsgyur bar ma sla snyan khung mthug par mdzod/ /phyed tsam khong du bsad nas khong ba bskyed/ /srid kyi mu mtha' ring bas gdod mchi'o/ /btsun mo rnams dang bud med gzhan dag la/ /'dod chags phyir na thugs la btags drags na/ /nga khyod 'dres shing bzang ngan med par 'gro/ /yid ches med pa'i mi la blo ma gtod/ /legs par mi 'ong rang srog 'gums nyen yod/ /mi 0ces pa ltar g.yem dang 'dod la sogs pa'i dbang du song nas/bud med 'phyor ma'i ngag ltar rgyug mi nyan pa gdams nas dmangs bkur bstod 'os kyi rgyal po'i mtshan bzang la brtson dgos pa shugs la bstan/ de ltar ma bgyis na nam zhig gi tshe rgyal po'i gser khri las lhung ste rang sga srog kyang shor nyen che'o zhes mngon sum 'dzem med kyis 'jigs pa'i snang ba bcos min zhig sbyin no/ /lhug rtsom 'di'i nang don 'jig rten mi chos las bod rigs bud med rnams kyi bsam blo dge ba'i phyogs su skul rgyu gtso bor bzung ste/ 'jig rten gyi lugs las blang bar bya ba dang dor bar bya ba gang zhig yin pa gsal por bstan nas ya rabs dang / gtong phod che ba/ byams dang snying rje ldan pa/bza' zla khyim mi phan tshun bar 'grig mthun yong dgos pa bcas kyi bstan bya de mi rnams kyis go bde ba'i gtam rgyud kyi lam nas drangs pas/ bsam snro'i nang don thad ma zad rtsom rig gi rin thang yang mi chung ba zhig yod pa da/yang 〈〈'dzam gling gi khyad mtshar rdo yi glegs bam 〉lo3gyi rtsom pa pos bod gangs can gyi rig gnas lo rgyus bang mdzod dmigs bsal ba bod khams yongs nas ma ṇi rdo 'bum mang du mchis pa las/ hor gter ston chos — 254 —

sgar ram 'od gsal theg mchog chos gling zhes pa'i gsang sngags rnying ma'i dgon pa chung chung zhig yod par 'dzam gling gi khyad mtshar rdo yi glegs bam dang bka' bstan gyi rdo yi glegs bu sogs yod pa bris te/ rang re'i mes po rnams ji 'dra'i rlabs che zhing kho tsho'i mdzad rjes ni bskal pa ji srid bar du nyams pa med par mtho sgang 'dir lhang nger lhan der bzhugs srid par bsngags brjod dang / bod mi'i 'gyur ba med pa'i rtse gcig gi dad sems chen pos tshe rabs dang mi rabs du ma zhig la brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten nas bzhengs shing bzhengs bzhin pa'i ma ṇi rdo 'bum gyi gzi dpal ༵nga rin thang bris nas mi rigs shig gi dad mos dang snying stobs mtshon da/snyan ngag mkhan po yi dam tshe ring gis sna mi rigs so so'i rig gnas tshang ma dka' ba spyad pa'i brtson 'grus med par dgung sngon mthon pos gnang ba min/mi zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rdo yi glegs bur bzhengs pa'i bka' bstan chen mo 'di yang sus kyang rtsol ba ma byas par rang bzhin du grub pa zhig ma yin te/ de ni bod mi dmangs kyi 'gran zla bral ba'i blo rig dang /dpa' ngar ldan pa'i snying stobs/ zhum pa med pa'i brtson sems/ rgyun chad med pa'i ngal rtsol bcas la brten nas legs grub byung ba zhig yin la/ lhug rtsom 'dis bod rigs mi dmangs kyi lo rgyus dang rig gnas gsar rten byed pa'i ༵dun ma brtan po dang 'gyur med snying stobs la bstod bsngags chen po byas ya// 〈〈gtsang khul gyi gnas chen khag la lta skor du phyin pa'i mthong thos 〉mosgokyi rtsom pa pos rang nyid gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa'i ljongs/ bod chol kha gsum gyi ya gyal dbus gtsang dam pa chos kyi chol kha'i zlas phye ba'i nub phyogs myang ljongs stod smad bar gsum gyi gtso'i rgya che'i yul lung rnams — 255 go

su ljongs rgyur phebs skabs rna ba'i bcud dang mig gi dpyid du smin pa'i yul goms gshis lugs dang lha sde chos sde/ dpa' bo'i rtogs brjod/ mkhas pa'i mdzad rjes/ gnas rten 'gangs chen/ rig gnas sgyu rtsal/ gna' shul grags can/ yul thon tshong zog bcas brjod gzhir bkod pa'i tho 'god lhug rtsom cung ring ba de bris pa dang / thos tshod du rtsom mkhan lags kyis lhug rtsom de dag rtsom grub 'byung ched lo ngo kha shas kyi dus tshod spyad de bod ljongs kyi yul phyogs kun tu lta skor du phyin pa dang 'brel yod mi snar 'tshams 'dri byas pa yin zer/ der ma zad bod rgya yig rigs zung gi dpyad gzhi 'tshol sdud dang gdam gses/ cung zhib cha ldan pa'i las snon dang phyogs yongs nas zhib bsdur bcas byas te bod ljongs gtsang khul du dar khyab che ba'i lo rgyus dang dmangs srol/ chos lugs bcas ngo sprod cung gsal po zhig gnang 'dug pas/ lhug rtsom 'di ni bod kyi spyi tshogs nang gi don bya bris pa zhig yin la/ lo rgyus rig gnas kyi zur tshad nas brjod gzhi la lar dgos nges kyi khungs 'ded dang 'grel bshad byas yod pa zhig kyang yin/ snang tshul 'dra min sna tshogs la gsal bshad mdor bsdus byas shing klog pa por zur du ma dang yang dag pa/ tshan rig dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dmangs srol rig gnas kyi kānd don la lta stangs ga 'dra zhig 'dzin par phyogs ston kyi nus pa'ang na kārshag rtsom 'di'i nang brjod gzhi'i nang don gyi sde mi 'dra ba du ma byung ba las/ dang po ni yid du 'ong ba'i yar 'brog g.yu mtsho zhes pa de yin zhing /rtsom mkhan gyis thog mar yar 'brog g.yu mtsho de gnas gang 'dra zhig tu chags 'dug pa bris pa brgyud nas/ g.yu mtsho'i dbyibs dang rgya khyon/ mdzes chos sogs re re bzhin ngo sprod byas 'dug ste/ lha ri bo gam pa la mo'i rtser 'byor ba dang dwangs gsal sngo mer 'khyil ba'i yar 'brog g.yu yi mtsho mo — 256 —

yid du 'ong ba de mig lam du 'char thub/ g.yu mtsho de ni gangs can sā la'i sman ljongs kyi mdzes rgyan du gyur pa'i mtsho ma pham pa dang / gnam mtsho phyug mo sogs dang 'dra bar phyi nang gnyis kyis rtsa cher 'dzin zhing yul gru kun la snyan grags che/ de'i rgyud kyi sa ni dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i dus su btsugs pa'i bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi ya gyal yar 'brog stag lung khri dpon gyi mnga' khongs su gtogs/ mtsho chen de ni yar 'brog sa khongs su chags pas ming la'ang yar 'brog g.yu mtsho zhes su grags/mi⑤zhes pa'i tshig dum 'dis g.yu mcho'i lo rgyus bsdus pa zhig klog mkhan gyi mig lam du gsal por 'god thub pa byung ba ni rtsom pa pos lhug rtsom zhes bya ba'i rtsom lus kyi brjod gzhi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dngos las btsal zhing rnyed thub dgos pa'i gnas der 'bad pa hur thag bgyis pa las thon pa'i 'bras bu 'ba' zhig go/gnyis pa ni myang stod kyi dpal 'khor chos sde chen po de yin zhing /brtsams chos su myang stod ces pa'i sa ming thogs tshul gyi gtam rgyud rnying pa zhig gis thog drangs pas klog pa por bro ba ldan zhing bklags na 'dod pa'i blo ri gzar gyi rbab chu bzhin 'gog med du skyes shing / der mthud nas zu 'di skabs su bshad par bya ba'i myang stod kyi rgyud der sngon bstan pa snga dar gyi dus nas skyes chen mang pos rten dang gsung rab bzhengs nas mngon mtho nges legs kyi gzhi ma bting ba dper na/ btsas phu dang / bye ma'i mda'/ rgya rong bcas kyi gnas su srong btsan sgam po dang / khri srong sde btsan/ khri gtsug lde btsan sogs btsan po rim byon gyi skabs su bzhengs pa'i garnyo la yod pa dang / lhag par dus rabs brgyad pa'i dus dkyil du rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis bod du gdan drangs pa'i slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dpon slob bcas pas de khul du gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor — 257 —

zhing / myang stod ga mo lung na slob dpon gyis yang dag thugs kyi sgrub pa la rgyun ring bzhugs pa'i padma'i sgrub phyug dang / phug pa'i mdun gyi dri zhim 'o ma'i kha dog 'dra ba'i 'bab rgyun de yang sgrub chu tshe chu mar grags/’ ⑤zhes pa dang / lo rgyus rgan pos bzhag pa'i rjes shul re re bzhin klog mkhan gyi snang ngor yang bskyar mngon du bcug pa ni de 'dra'i gzi 'od 'phro zhing spobs pa bskyed pa zhig yin la/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir skyes shing mnar son pa'i klog pa po brtse sems can zhig yin na yid sems 'chor zhing dad pa'i spu long dbang med du g.yo bar byed/ rtsom pa pos sngon chad kyi lo rgyus dang don bya 'bri ba'i zhar la mig gis dngos yod kyi myang stod la'ang zhib tu gzigs thub pa sgos myang chu gsar gzhung ring mo'i stod rgyud kyi nying ro dang rgyang ro/gangs ro/ bar du rgyang dkyil mang gsum/ smad kyi sgrogs lung lcags pa ra bcas kyi yul sde che chung mang po'i longs spyod dang / skad grags che ba'i yul thon tshong zog sna tshogs dper na snam bu dang / grum ze/ sle'u sogs dang / myang smad kyi ther ma/ ske rags/ star zon sogs lo ltar myang stod rgyal rtse dang myang smad gzhis rtse sogs 'du tshogs chen po'i steng yul 'dis mngags pa'i mdza' brtse'i lha rdzas dkar po bsnams pa'i pho nya zhig dang mtshungs par 'dzam gling gi yul phyogs kun tu 'gro bzhin yod/gsum pa ni dpa' rgod rnams kyis phyi dgra bkag pa'i 'thab shul rgyal rtse rdzong ri de yin zhing / 64dpal 'khor chos sde chen po'i shar lho'i ngos kyi rdzong ri'i spo ru mkhar rdzong gi gyang ro rtsig shul gzengs su mngon pa dang /lhag par rdzong ri'i phyogs bzhi'i lcog gi zhig shul de bas mngon gsal du mthong rgyu yod pa de ni spyi lo1904lor bod rigs ser skya mi dmangs rnams kyis phyi dgra dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul dmag dpung 'gog rgol gyis mes rgyal gyi bdag dbang bsnyon med kyi mnga' khongs/ rang nyid skyes sa 'tshar sa'i pha — 258 —

yul srung skyob byed pa'i dga' gdung gnyis ldan gyi lo rgyus le tshan bskrun pa'i gna' shul grags can zhig yin /mi zhes pa dang / dus rabs nyi shu pa'i 'gor bod ljongs yul gru kun gyi ser skya mi dmangs tshos stobs shugs gcig tu sgril nas g.yas gzhogs g.yon 'degs kyis phyi dgra mthar skyod gtong phyir pho zad mo la thug pa dang lag zad dpung la thug kyang 'thab rgol mtha' 'khyol byas pa dang / bod kyi go gnas mtho dma' bar gsum gang gi mi yin yang rang gi pha yul la gces shing dga' ba dang de'i bde 'jags la srung skyob byed pa ni mi rnams kyi 'os 'gan du mthong ba ni 64rgyal rtse gser gzhung phra mor/ /phyi gling ser byas khengs song / /e ma de 'dra mthong dus/ /bsags pa nor gyis gang byed/ / ces pa'i dmangs gzhas nas kyang bod rigs ser skya mi dmangs tshos btsan 'dzul par snang 'dzin dang rang gi mkhar dbang blos btang nas dgra 'thab mtha' gcig bya rgyu'i chod sems gsal por mtshon yod/ rtsom mkhan gyis rgyal rtse rdzong gi 'thab ra'i rjes shul sogs bris te drang bden khur du blangs pa'i dpa' rgod rnams kyis rang srog bsdos te drag po g.yul du zhugs shing / mthar rdzas mdel zad na'ang brag rdo rbab 'gril gyis dgra dmag dang 'thab pa ma zad/ dgra dmag 'khris su bcar mtshams rang gi sha khrag phung po'i grib ma tsam yang dgra lag tu ma sprad par dpa' rgod lag gdang sprel te brag ri'i g.yang du mchongs nas rang gi gces srog pha mes kyi yul gru srung skyob byed pa'i skyes su phul ba'i dpa' bo'i blo spobs la gus sems chen pos bsngags pa brjod yod/lhug rtsom 'di'i nang da dung 〈〈myang smad gzhis ka bsam grub rtse 〉〉dang 〈〈brjid chags nyams dga' ba'i bkra shis lhun po'i dgon pa 〉〉sogs lo rgyus steng bod kyi rig gnas dang / chab srid/ chos lugs kyi rten gzhir gyur cing bod spyi tshogs kyi dar 'phel la byas rjes bla med cibazhag myong ba dang /— 259 —

deng dus kyang gzi 'od chem chem spro ba'i chos sde dang dgon pa/ pho brang dag brtsams chos kyi brjod gzhir bsten pa mang yang rtsom gyi blos bslangs dang sgrig gzhi'i 'god stangs thad thun min gyi khyad chos dmigs bsal ba zhig med pa ltar snang na'ang lhug rtsom gyi khyad chos gtso bo ste/ mtshon byed rgya che ba dang mtshon bya la yul dus kyi tshad bkag med pa/ sgrig gzhir rang dbang che ba'i gnad de dam du bzung nas skabs rer mi sna bris yod pa dang / mtshams rer bya dngos bris yod la/ rtsom thabs su bsten pa'i sgyug rtser brjod bya rgya bskyed pa dang bsdus nas 'bri ba/ yid 'gyur ston pa dang dpyad gtam brjod pa dag gang 'tsham gyis bsres pas klog mkhan gyi sems mtshams tshigs med par skul bar byed/yang lhug rtsom 〈〈nges don gyi nyi ma 〉lo7la mtshon na/ rtsom pa pos mkhas pa'i dbang po tshe tan zhabs drung lags kyi mdzad rjes sa gzhi las dkyel che zhing ri rab las lhun stug pa/ rgya mtsho las gting zab cing / nam mkha' las klong yangs pa de bya dngos bye brag pa ste 'jig rten gyi 'gro ba kun la gnyen du mdza' ba'i nyi ma'i steng spos te sems kyi brtse dung bden pa de bstan yod/smyo rgya khyon gyis yongs su btang ba'i chos dbyangs nam mkha'i mthongs shed na/sprin dkar gyi bla bres dang 'ja' tshon gyi gur khang dang bcas pa'i snang ba'i bdag po zhig yod pa ni 'jig rten gyi sgron me lags/ sa dog mos kyang mi theg khyod 'dzam gling gi mig yin par ma zad/ 'jig rten gyi rgyan yin la/ phyi nang kun gsal gyi gzi brjid dang yon tan gyis bla med 'od zer gyi bdag por gyur pa red/mi ⑤ces te/ brjod gzhir gyur pa'i mkhas pa chen po'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi mdzad 'phrin de brgyud pa'i thabs la brten nas rtsom pa po'i yid 'gyur dang tshor 'du bya dngos bye brag pa nyi ma'i ngo bo dang rang gshis/ nus pa bcas la sbyar nas rab btags dang ting 'dzin/ dpe — 260 —

'god sogs kyi lam nas 'phyor 'bri byas yod par ma zad/ 6 bcu gnyis bdag po lags/ 'jig rten na dpyid kyi dpal yon zer ba de khyod kyi gzi byin yin par ma zad/ dbyar gyi lang tsho dang ston gyi 'bras bzang rnams kyang khyod kyi thugs rje yin/ gaṅgā'iyab kyang khyod dang bral na 'khyag rom gyi phung por 'gyur zhing / dpag bsam gyi ljon pa yang khyod med tshe star gog skam por 'gro tshegs mi 'dug de phyir nyal 'gro bu mos lhung lhung gi glu dbyangs len pa yang khyod la bstod pa dang me tog sna tshogs kyi mgo lcog ldem pa yang khyod la gus 'dud zhu ba yin/mi0zhes nyi ma'i 'od snang dang tsha drod kyi drin las mi yul 'dir dpyid dpal drangs shing tshe srog gi dga' tshal mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig skrun pa dang / yon tan gyi gzhi mar gyur pa'i mkhas chen nyid ni bde skyid kun gyi 'byung khungs dang rtsa lag tu brtan zhing / gang de'i gting mtha' bral zhing 'od stong 'bar ba'i yon tan gyi gzi byin/ nye ring dang chags sdang bral ba'i byams sems kyis bskul te gzhon skyes pad tshal yongs su char du snyil bar bstod pa dang / lhag par mjug gi tshan pa ru 4 nam mkha' 'gyur yang srid/ sa gzhi 'khrugs kyang rung / 'dab brgya pa'i nags klung la nor bu dang / glog gi 'od snang gis zhe nam yang mi tshim/ blo kun nas mi khengs/ nyam chung ba'i dri bzang khang rnams ni gser dngul gyi pad ma ltar rin thang mi che mod/ 'od stong bdag po'i gzi byin phyi'i rang mdangs tsam ma yin par snying gi ge sar smin pa'i gsos su bsten nas rang mnyam bung ba'i tshogs kyi nyer 'tshor bzhad pa la phyi gtsang nang gtsang gi lhag bsam gangs ri'i dpal la 'gran pa lags pas na/ re ba'i mig 'bur gtod sa khyod kho na'o/ /miXzhes da lta'i spyi tshogs su smyo glog gi 'od snang mi lta bu'i mkhas ming 'dzin pa po dag gis gzhon skyes mang po zhig gi shes bya 'tshol 'dod kyi blo tshim dka' phyir re ba'i mig 'bur nam yang khyod dang khyod lta bu'i phyogs su gtad yod ces — 261 —

snying khung du bcangs pa'i 'dod re sba gsang med par phyir bstan pa red/lhug rtsom 'di las 'od zer stong ldan gyi nyi ma'i gzi byin la kha g.yar nas/mkhas mchog gang de'i byams sems dang gzhan phan gyi rang bzhin/ rmongs mun rtsa rlog byed pa'i snying stobs/ sems can brtse bas skyong ba'i lhag bsam bcas la bstod bsngags ches cher mdzad yod pa red/yang dper na lhug rtsom 〈〈khyi 〉snomilta bur mtshon na/ rjod byed tshig gi zhun brdar dang brjod bya don gyi gdam gses gang gi cha nas kyang cung legs grub byung ba'i rtsom yig tu bgrang chog par snyam/ nga tsho klog pa po'i 'dren byed lam du rtsom yig cung yag po zhig thob tshe/ de ni skabs gsum lha yul gyi bdud rtsi sman bcud dang mtshungs la/ 'jig rten mi yul gyi zhim ngar rgun chang dang yang 'dra bar kha mig sems gsum la rol myong gi mdzes tshor yun ring mor sbyin cing / dran shes yul la mtshar sdug gson nyams ldan pa'i gzugs brnyan brjed dka' ba rnams rdo ring bzhin du skrun bzhin mchis/rgyan chang dang mtshungs pa'i lhug rtsom 〈〈khyi 〉〉yi rtsom pa pos spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang rang bzhin tha dad pa'i 'gro ba mi'i ngo bo dang gshes rgyud la rtog tshor rnon pos nyams su myong zhing goms 'dris rig gnas kyi zur tshad nas yin min dang bzang ngan gyi khyad phye nas brjod bya'i snying po gting zab tu btang yod de/ 6 sha khyi/ spyang khyi/ seng khyi/ 'brog khyi/ phyi gling pa'i khyi sogs khyi la rigs mang po dbyi chog mi nyaces klog mkhan rnams kyi mig sngar 64khyi mizhes pa'i kha byang de gsal por bton pa dang dus mtshungs su rgyud pa mi gcig pa'i khyi yi rigs du ma zhig gi khyad chos dang rang bzhin dmar rjen du bris shing / rang bzhin de dag gi dmigs su bsal ba'i mtshon tshul gyi thad la nga tsho'i khor yug tu mi'i sha tshugs su langs na'ang khyi ngan gyi srog gis bzung ba dang / rang 'tsho ba'i don du bden don khyad du gsod thub pa/ rang gi tshe srog — 262 —

pha ma dang bu phrug gi tshe srog gis nyo phod pa dang / rang gi khe phan thob byed la mes rgyal dang mi rigs kyi rang dbang dang la rgya btsong nus pa ste/ mdor na stong gsum gyi 'jig rten khams su de dag las sgor sems che ba med pa dang sgor gyi phung por zhugs pa'i skyug bro ba'i bla srog 'ba' zhig yin gshis dri ngan bskal brgyar mi zad pa khyi gshis dang mi gshis gnyis zhib bsdur gyi thabs la brten nas brjod pa de 'dra'i gnad du khel ba zhig yin/ bdag por blo dkar zhing rang bzhin brtan pa/ rnam rig gsal ba/ ma byin na mi len pa/ don gal la thug na rang srog gtong phod pa'i khyi bzang dag gi gshis ka las nga tshos rin gyis khugs thabs med pa'i dngos po rnams kyi gnyug ma'i rang bzhin mtshar po zhig mthong ba min nam/ rin po che'i rang bzhin dang bsgrun du bzod pa'i khyi bzang po dag gi gshis ka de lta bu ni rgyug khyi dag la gtan nas yod mi srid pas 6 mi khyi 'dra ba dag las khyi mi 'dra ba dag gis mi bzang ngam ⑩zhes pa bden pa'i gtam du mi 'dod dam/tsa khyi'i nang na'ang mi ngan pa bzhin du rku byed pa dang gzha' rgyug byed pa/bdag po'i mi zin par rmug par rtsom pa/ khyim gyi mgon po'i thog la rgyug pa'i khyi ngan yod de/ khyi ngan bkag na mi thub/ mi ngan bzung na mi thub mi ⑩pa'i rang bzhin can mang la/ de bas kyang zhe mer ba ni rgyug khyi de dag yin/ 6 rgyug khyi zhig yin gshis rgyal khab kyi bdag dbang dang rang btsan/ mi rigs kyi la rgya dang khe phan/ yul pha ma'i drin lan/ sha phu nu'i brtse sems/ grogs dam pa'i mdza' mthun bcas ni kho'i yid kyi snang ngor 'char ba ga la srid/ rgyu mtshan ni de dag ngan pa 'dus pa'i phung por grub pa'i phyir/miXzhes dang / skad cha 'di dag gis kha gsal zhing don zab pa'i sgo nas bsam blo'i dgongs gzhi zhig mtshon yod pa dang / mi thams cad la gshis ka dang 'byung ba'i dbang gis dga' skyo chags sdang gi nyam sa 'gyur ngang gis 'byung la/ mi chos spus — 263 —

gtsang gi dri bsung ldang ba'i spyi tshogs kyi khor yug dang bla na mtho ba'i kun spyod dar 'jam gyis bcings pa'i mi rnams kyi spyi tshogs nang du rang dang gzhan/ sger dang spyi zhes pa'i tha snyad dag gnas pa bzhin rang don dang gzhan don yang lugs mthun tshul la gnas pa'i sar sgrub par byed mod/'on kyang 'jig rten kyi skye bo yod tshad de lta bu zhig ga la yin te ma yin no/ /rgyu mtshan de'i dbang gis mi'i bsam spyod la dag min gyi khyad par phye zhing /dus nam zhig la nga tsho'i 'tsho ba'i khrod du'ang 'dod rngam dang phrag dogamangon lkog la sogs pa'i tha snyad du ma zhig thon byung ba dang / rang cag gi rtsom pa pos de lta bu'i rnyog zing che ba'i bod spyi tshogs dngos de nyams su myong ba'i dran tshul de dag mdzes sdug grol ba'i rjod byed kyi dbyangs 'gros snyan mo zhig dang rang dbang bab chags kyi rtsom lus 'tsham po zhig gis gcig gyur gong bu ru mtshon par byas yod/sa bcad bzhi pa/ mi rabs gsar pa'i snying stobs dang re snyeg bris pa'i lhug rtsom gyi skor/deng rabs bod kyi rtsom stegs steng lhug rtsom gyi rtsom pa po rnams kyi bsam pa'i 'du shes thad sngar bas bcings 'grol thob ste/ rgyun srol gyi lhug rtsom gyi rmang gzhi'i steng mi rigs gzhan gyi rtsom stangs la sogs par slob sbyong dang / mig dper bzung nas de tsho'i nying bcud rnams blangs pa dang /rtsom tshul gsar pa'i lam nas brtsams pa'i lhug rtsom de dag tshig gi sdeb sbyor nas dbyangs kyi nyams 'gyur/ sgrig gzhi blos bslangs nas sgyu rtsal khyad gshis/ 6 nang sgos su bden don gyi so kha yang yang bdar nas dngos po'i gshis lugs lhug par bkral ba dang / gnas lugs kyi gsor 'big yang yang bskor nas chos nyid rnal ma gting nas sdog pa'i shes dpyod kyi bsam — 264 —

blo dang tshan rig gi spobs pa de/ mi gshes dang rtsom gshis gnyis char dngos po'i khe phan gyis tshod 'dzin thebs bzhin pa'i bod kyi rtsom stegs nas/gdong mchong gi ru dar bzhin sngon du bshar yod la rno 'od khyug khyug gi mdung rtse bzhin gzengs su thon yod pa red/mi gyide ltar rtsom lus rnying yang rtsom tshul gyi rnam pa gsar pa bsten pa'i lhug rtsom dag dus rabs kyi rjes su dam por 'brangs shing / phyogs mang po nas dus rabs kyi snying stobs legs par mtshon pa ni dus rabs kyi dgos mkho dang mi rnams kyi re smon dang yongs su 'tsham pa zhig yin/dus skabs gsar pa'i bod kyi lhug rtsom khag gcig gis gtso bo mi rabs gsar pa'i snying stobs dang re snyeg mtshon zhing / brtsams chos de rigs kyis phyogs dang zur du ma nas tshan rig dang rig gzhung gi mkha' lam yangs por bskyod nas gsar gtod dang rtsad zhib kyi snying stobs yangs pa'i blo ldan tshor bstod pa dang 'brel/ dus rabs gsar pa'i bod rigs na gzhon rnams kyi spobs pa dang / phugs bsam/ re smon la sogs mtshon par byas shing / mi rigs dar rgyas yong bar byed pa'i las 'gan rlabs po che de rigs 'gro ba mi re re'i phrag steng du babs pa'i las 'gan zhig yin pa'i brda gsal por sprad nas/ rlabs chen gyi las 'gan de mngon 'gyur yong ched nga tshos yid thang mi 'chad pa dang sgyid lug mi skye bar la rgya brtan pos brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsten dgos pa'i 'bod skul nan mo btang yod/lhug rtsom 〈〈mdun skyod kyi gom sgra 〉skokhyalta bur mtshon na/ rtsom pa pos spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i zur zhig bdams nas rang nyid kyi gting zab pa'i myong tshor dang / snying khong nas brdol ba'i dga' skyo chags sdang gi yid 'gyur mtshon pa yin te/ nga rang dpyid ku'i 'dam rdzab kyi lam kyag kyog de'i steng du sa la 'gyel ba dang / mdun skyod kyi rkang ba zung la skyo gdud gi 'dam gyis gos — 265 —

shing dka' sdug gi rma kha bzos na'ang / blo gos kyi mgo 'phang ma smad par sngar bzhin mdun phyogs su lta la rings shing blo spobs kyi snying rtsa ma nyams par sngar bzhin bar med du lding ba bris yod/ der mthud nas/ 6 ngas mdun phyogs kyi lam kyag kyog de'i steng du bltas pa na/ blo spobs kyi mgo bo mthon por bteg cing rnam dpyod kyi dpal 'bar lag tu bzung ba'i dar bab gzhon nu 'gas rngam brjid kyi gom stabs sgyur bzhin mdun du skyod pa mthong bas dga' skyid kyis khengs shing / yang ngo gdong phyir phyogs nas gzhug phyogs su bltas tshe/ nga rang brgyud zin pa'i lam bu de'i steng na rgya mtsho'i rlabs gnyer la 'phya ba'i gzhon nu khri ma 'bum gyis sa gzhi yom yom 'dar ba'i gom stabs sgyur bzhin mdun du skyod bzhin 'dug yin na'ang / phangs pa zhig la 'ga' zhig lam 'gram gyi brtse dung gi me tog la bsnams pas bzi bar gyur nas gom 'gros nyams pa dang / 'ga' zhig gyis lam 'gram gyi rgyu nor gyi shing tog la spyad pas rgyags par gyur nas gom 'gros sgyur thabs bral ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis blun rmongs rjes lus kyi bdud rtsi 'thungs pas thang stong lung stong du 'khyams shing / 'ga' zhig gis rnying zhen gyi mda' gzhu btags nas dben thang ri lung du bde skyid kyi ri dwags rngon par brel/'ga' zhig gis kyag kyog dang dka' sdug gi mdun lam mthong bas dpa' zhum zhing nye 'dabs kyi nags gseb la yib/ 'on kyang / mdun phyogs na nyams 'gyur stong ldan gyi gom 'gros ni bar med du sgyur ba mthong zhing / rjes phyogs na snyan 'gyur 'bum ldan kyi gom sgra ni chad med du grags pa thos pas/nga'i blo gros kyi nor bu la slar yang nyi 'od 'phros shing / zhabs zung gis dpyid ma'i 'dam rdzab kyi lam kyag kyog de rjes su bskyur nas rgyal kha'i phyogs su bsnyegs te song ba dang /miX rtsom yig nang dus rabs kyi nyams 'gyur shugs drag cing / mi rigs kyi snying stobs mkha' la 'phyur gyin spyi — 266 —

tshogs 'tsho ba dngos las mi rabs gsar pa'i re snyig dang spobs pa/ brtse dung bcas shugs drag po'i sgo nas mtshon yod de/ gson nyams ldan pa'i tshig dang gzugs brnyan re re'i nang du rang re bod kyi mi rabs gsar pa de rmongs gnyid las sad pa dang / 'od rnon 'khyug pa'i spyan zung dag gis ma 'ongs pa'i mdzes ljongs la dmigs nas gom stabs chen pos mdun du bskyod pa'i snying stobs gson po re re mthong thub/yang lhug rtsom 〈〈cang shes rta pho 〉〉la mtshon na/ rtsom pa pos rang gi myong tshor zab mo de grogs la gleng 'dod kyi 'dun pa drag po gnon thabs bral zhing / rang gi lta ba mtshon pa'i brjod bya de nyid/ 'khyog por brjod pa'i tshig gis ma spras par rang byung bab chags kyi sgo nas sgrig gzhi stabs bde rang dbang che zhing phan tshun ram 'dregs byed pa'i rtsom thabs spyad nas snying khong du 'phyur ba'i spobs pa dang smon 'dun bris yod de/ 4 ltos dang / mgyogs myur rlung gi sgyu rtsal/ khyung chen lding ba'i gshog rtsal/ rgya stag mchong ba'i shugs rtsal/ glog dmar 'khyug pa'i myur rtsal bcas kyi brtul zhugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i ched du cang shes rta phos sngo bsangs mkha' yi spun zla/ zhi bde rgya mtsho'i do zlar gyur pa'i mtha' yas pa'i rtswa thang du spyang dar ma'i 'jigs pa khyad du bsad/ dgun gsum gyi lhags pa gdong gis bsus/ dbyar gsum gyi char ba lus kyis bkag dpyid gsum gyi mu ge bzod bsran bgyis te sa dog mo 'dom la 'jal zhing / chu gtsang mo thad kyis bcad nas/ rgyugs bang rtsal gyi gar stabs slob bzhin yod/miXces brjod 'dod kyi dmigs yul de mngon sum du bstan zhing / rang gi snying khong gi dungs zhen de rang rgyud las phral te cang shes rta pho'i steng la gnas bcas pa dang / bod gangs can gyi gzhon nu rnams kyi spobs pa dang gshis ka de cang shes rta pho dang rta pho'i bang rtsal nang bstims te/ 4 kye rta pho lags/ khyod ni rjes lus kyi mun pa sel ba'i sgron me/— 267 —

sdug bsngal gyi sprin nag gtor ba'i dri bzhon/ sngon thon gyi bya lam 'dren pa'i gshog pa dang 'dra zhes brjod na klog pa po kun gyis rta phos de lta bu byed mi nus zhes brjod pa'ang gor ma chag mod/ 'on kyang / khyod kyis kyang dka' ba phrag tu khur/ ngal ba khyad du bsad/ bde ba rgyang du bsrings te mi rnams la phan thogs pa'i bya ba 'bad pas don du gnyer ba'i bar kun spyod ni kun gyis bstod pa'i gnas/ bsngags pa'i yul/ dga' ba'i rgyur 'gyur bar gdon mi za'o/ /miXzhes brjod pa ni mi rabs shig gi spobs pa dang / mdun du bskul ba'i ngar glu zhig yin/ rtsom yig hril por dus rabs kyi tshor 'du drag po dang mi rigs shig la bcangs pa'i lhad med brtse dung gis zin cing / khag khur gyi sems dang spobs pas khengs pa'i phugs bsam dang re smon ni tshig 'bru re rer khyab 'dugayang lhug rtsom 〈〈lang tsho'i 'char snang 〉〉gis rtsom pa po zhig la yod 'os pa'i tshor rtog dang brtse sems ldan pa'i ngang che skye stobs ldan pa'i lang tsho dang / chal chil 'phyur ba'i khrag dron/ pha yul gyi tshabs che ba'i gnas tshul bcas kyis bdag gi sems su 'char snang sna tshogs shig skye ru bcug byung /77zhes mi rabs gsar pa'i lang tsho'i gson shugs dang / phugs bsam/ pha yul mi dmangs la bcangs pa'i khag khur gyi bsam blo mtshon pa dang / pha yul gyi 'dzugs skrun dang bde skyid kyi ched du rang gi blo rig dang brtse sems yod tshad 'bul rgyu'i sems thag bcad de/ 6 nga rang lhung lhung gi chu phran byas te pha yul gyi rtswa rkang re re dang sdong rkang re re bzhin brlan par byed 'dod/ nga rang bsil 'jam gyi dpyid rlung byas te pha yul mi dmangs kyi rmongs sems mtha' dag gtsang mar phyags 'dod/ ngas bod ljongs de nyid mu mthud du mes rgyal gyi gces phrug byed du mi 'jug par mes rgyal gyi khyim chen nang du rang stobs rang spel gyis stobs 'byor mnga' thang ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur thub — 268 —

pa byed rgyu yin/ 'char snang ni kha dog sna lnga'i 'ja' tshon dang 'dra ba'i stong bsam yin mod/ de dag re re bzhin ngo mtshar ldan pa'i dngos yod cig tu 'gyur bar smon/’〈yi mi rigs so so'i 'phel rgyas kyi lo rgyus ni byis pa lo chung zhig nar son pa'i brgyud rim dang 'dra ste/ rig gnas dang tshan rig gang gi thad nas kyang ha cang na gnyom pa'i dus su gzhan pa'i rogs skyor gyi lag 'then la brten dgos na'ang / dus nam zhig la slebs tshe lus stobs rgyas shing rang lcogs thub dgos pa'ang chos nyid cig yin/ de ltar min tshe mi rigs de'i 'byung 'gyur dang bde skyid sogs gzhan pa'i lag tu gtad pa dang 'dra bas phugs bsam dang re snyeg sogs gleng ba ni don snying dben pa'i gtam du zad/ 'jig rten gyi mi rnams ni rang bzhin gyis sdug gi mun pa dwangs shing skyid pa'i mtsho mo 'khyil bar dga' ba chos nyid cig tu 'khums na/ pha yul gyi mi rnams kyis lugs dang mthun pa'i sgo nas de lta bu'i 'tsho ba zhig la re skug byed pa'i snang tshul de/ rtsom pa po'i tshor snang dngos ma dang myong snang rnal ma'i gzugs su 'phos pa dang / 'bangs mi phal ba rnams kyi bde sdug gi sems khams de dngos su tshor ba dang / rnyed pa dang / zin pa lta bus mi rigs la sems khral byed pa'i rdog khres lci mo zhig phrag tu khur bzhin rgyang ring ba'i gtan 'dun zhig la bsnyegs/de bzhin du lhug rtsom 〈〈spobs pa 〉〉yi rtsom pa pos rang nyid kyi 'tsho ba'i myong tshor de sa 'og nas sa khar brtol bzhin pa'i gsar skyes ljang myug zhig gi steng du 'phos te/ tsa skabs der ngas shi ma gson gyi ngang mig gnyis phyed tsam phye nas phyogs bzhir bltas pa na rngams 'thug cing 'jigs su rung ba'i smag rum gyi mun dpung chen po zhig gis nga'i mthong lam yongs su bkag nas ci yang mthong mi thub/miXces gsar skyes gzhon nu rnams spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi thob thang dang gnas bab ngo ma ste/ 'jig rten gyi las dang — 269 —

bya ba gang dang ci la 'dun ma gtod skabs gzhon nu rnams la gdam gses kyi khe dbang chung zhing / goms srol dang mi kha sogs kyi khur bo 'degs dka' ba gnya' ru lhung 'ong ba'i rkyen gyis kho tsho'i gdam ga de tshe gang bo'i 'gyod bda'i gzhi ru gyur cing 'gyur bzhin yod pa'ang mig gi mthong rgyu mang yang /rang cag gi rtsom pa po'i bsam blo bag la ma 'khums par lha nga'i steng gi sa rdo 'di dag glo bur du je rtsi la song ste da lta nyid du shi ba dang 'dra/ nyen kha che ba'i skabs der ngas slar yang lus la stobs shugs bskyed pa na da gsar du skyes pa'i myu gu gzhon nu zhig yin pas/ snying stobs dang spobs pa/ brtson 'grus dang rig pa sogs 'dzoms pa'i dus yin gshis/ 'chi khar yang 'phag 'tshag chen po zhig brgyab ste shi chog nga ci la'ang mi skrag 〈nyeces te/ bgegs dang bar chad ji 'dra mang yang dpa' mi zhum pa'i spobs sems bstan pa dang / der mthud nas 6 ngas kyang sngar gyi snying nad de dag rtsa ba nas dor te rgyang ring gi phugs bsam de 'grub ched/ rang chung nus med kyi bsam pa spangs te/ ri rab kyi rtse la rkang stegs 'cha' ba dang / sra mkhregs rdo la rtsa ba zug pa bcas byas te/ char rlung drag por 'dzum mdangs ngom pa dang / srol rnying gi dri ma dang bral zhing / rang dbang dang phugs bsam gyi 'dab ma yangs por bzhad pa bcas byas nas/ dka' ba khyad du bsad/ bde ba rgyab tu bsrings te mi kun la 'bad pas phan btags nas/ thams cad kyi bstod pa'i gnas/ bsngags pa'i yul/ dga' ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba la 'bad par 'dod/miX lhug rtsom 'di'i mgo mjug bar gsum du rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi skyo shas las thon pa'i brtse dung dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dngos las myong ba'i sems kyi sdug lus de ljang myug gsar pa zhig gis sra 'thas kyi sa shun brtol ba'i dka' tshegs dang spobs par sbyar ba dang lhan du/ dga' sdang gi dar cha ma 'dres so sor sgreng bzhin rul song du gyur pa'i goms 'grus stobs shugs — 270 —

la 'phya smod kyi mtshon btab par ma zad/ rang nyid kyi 'dun ma snyeg pa dang /bsam pa dang / brtson pa sogs bya mi phod pa'i mi 'khos chung nyam nga dag la zur za'i mda' mo drag tu bsnun bzhin rang byung gi chos nyid la grogs bcol nas rang gi gshis ka 'bur du thon par byas yod pa red/sa bcad lnga pa/ ba res dang kho'i lhug rtsom bsdus deb 〈〈sngon mo spang las 'khrungs pa'i sems kyi rol mo〉〉/dang po/ rgyab ljongs dang 'brel ba'i gtam/ba res ( 1960wa ) ni mdo smad bong stag nywa nag sde bar skyes shing /6 nga yis gom gsum thog mar spos pa'i nyin mo de nas bzung / ya mtshan yod tshad rtogs 'dod che ba'i byis pa zhig dang 'dra bar mdzes shing sdug la ngo mtshar che ba'i 'jig rten zhig la mig zung dang 'dzum mdangs lhan du gtad de/ rang nyid kyi 'tsho gnas dang rkang lam 'tshol 'go brtsams phal cher rgyu mtshan de 'dra zhig gi dbang gis sam yang na smra mi shes pa'i las skal zhig gis nga ni gom pa re re byas te mdun ngos su ded kyin dang sngon phyogs su bcum bzhin 'ongs dus/’4)zhes pa ltar/ rtsom pa po nyid mi lo bcu phrag kha shas kyi ring la rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi lam la dka' bas zhugs shing / snga phyir 〈〈sgrang char 〉〉dang 〈〈gangs rgyan me tog 〉〉 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉sogs bod yul gyi dus deb kyi steng du lhug rtsom dang snyan ngag bcas rtsom lus so so'i rtsom yig brgya phrag gcig lhag spel ba dang / 〈〈sngon mo spang las 'khrungs pa'i sems kyi rol mo 〉〉zhes pa 'di ni rtsom pa po'i lhug rtsom kyi tshab byed du gyur ba'i bsdus deb cig yin la/ de ni rtsom pa pos spyi lo 1986wa 1996lo'i bar brtsams pa'i lhug rtsom rnams phyogs ga ga tu bsdus pa zhig — 271 —

dang / dus skabs de ni rtsom pa po'i na tshod gzhon zhing sems shugs che ba/'dun pa drag po'i dus su khel 'dug pas gsar rtsom gyi blo rngam po de gnon thabs med par snying khong du 'phyo bzhin yod/ tan tan 〈〈sngon mo spang las 'khrungs pa'i sems kyi rol mo 〉〉'di rtsom pa'i skabs su/ rtsom pa pos sems 'dun chen po zhig bcangs te 'brog sde chen po bong stag gi lo rgyus dang /mtsho nub khul dang tshwa 'dam sa khul gyi sngon chad bod dang 'brel ba yod pa'i sa gnas kyi lo rgyus skor zhig 'tshol sdud dang rtsom 'bri byas pa'i skabs dag kyang yin pas/ skabs de dag la rtsom pa po rang nyid song sa dang bsdad sa nas rang dbang med par zin tho re'am yang na 'char snang re bris pa rnams ni lhug rtsom de dag grub pa'i rgyu rkyen dang rmang gzhi yin la/ lhug rtsom de rnams 'bri skabs kyi sems kyi kun slong dang rgyab ljongs kyang yin/ de bas/lhug rtsom gang mang zhig gi khrod du dus rabs kyi 'phel rgyas dang bod spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i rjes shul dag gsal ler bkod yod pa ma zad/ rtsom pa po pha yul spang gzhung gi ljongs rgyu dang de las 'khrungs pa'i sems kyi 'char sgo/bsam pa'i 'khyer so/ yid kyi brtse dung/ phugs kyi 'dun ma sogs mngon gsal dod po'i sgo nas mtshon par byas yod/〈〈sngon mo spang las 'khrungs pa'i sems kyi rol mo 〉〉yi mjug tu/ 6 sna tshogs ri mor bkra ba'i 'jig rten ni dngos gnas mdzes drags pa'i dbang gis gang sa gang du nga ni rol chog pa'i yul ljongs snang zhing gang sa gang du nga ni song yang chog pa'i rkang lam mchis mod/ ches phangs pa zhig ni nga yi tshad yod pa'i nus pa dang shes rab kyis brtse mdangs kyi lag zung brkyangs te de dag tshang mar 'tham 'khyud byed thabs med pas/ nam dus yin yang 'phreng sems shig dang 'gyod gdung zhig gi khrod nas 'gro dgos byung ba dang / re 'gar tshor snang lci mo zhig la brten nas rjes su bskyur ba'i rkang — 272 —

rjes de ru phyi mig lta skabs/ dgod kha 'chor zhing snying yang rje ba'i byis dus kyi rtsed ra de rnams ma gtogs nga la ci yang med la/ nga la ci yang ston rgyu'ang mi 'dug mi yices te/ nged cag gi rtsom pa po'ang pha yul gyi spang gzhung leb mo de nas rgyab la slog pa gyon zhing lus la mar dri 'thul bzhin lam du chas shing / rang nyid kyi mtha' 'khor dag tu gnas pa'i 'brog pa pho mo rgan gzhon rnams kyi sems khams dang 'tsho stangs la rgyus mnga' dang lta zhib gnang bar yod tshad nang gi yod tshad de 'dra'i nyams dga' zhing zhe 'chor ba zhig yin yang / 6 da dung bar mtshams 'di na phyi yi bkod pas bzos pa'i ha cang bgrod khag po'i kyag kyog bgrang las 'das pa zhig snga phyi rim pa byas te snang la/ de dang 'dra bar nang bcud kyi sems can la rag cing mi rabs kun la sngon nas bzhag pa'i 'du shes dang gtan srol gyi 'gro lugs mang po zhig kyang g.yas nyal g.yon 'dug byas te mchis pas/ nam rgyun du nga la khom pa cung zad byung 'i dus su/ ngas thengs mang por rang steng nas gnad don zhig dang nor 'khrul zhig la phyi 'dang brgyab ri7pa ni kho'i lhug rtsom gyi nang gi sgrig gzhi'i khyad chos gtso bo zhig yin te/ drang bden 'gyur med kyi gshis ka dang myong tshor dngos ma las 'phos pa'i sems khams dag bab chags shing rang dbang gi stobs rtsal rdzogs pa'i lhug rtsom gyi mdzes chas su spras bzhin brjod pa ni 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig yin/gnyis pa/ rtswa thang gi gtam rgyud mtshar po/〈〈sngon mo spang las 'khrungs pa'i sems kyi rol mo 〉〉ni mu mtha' mi mngon pa'i rtswa thang nas gzab 'phyor stong gis spras pa'i bu mo mdzes ma zhig gi snyan mo ngag las dbyangs su gyer ba'i glu gzhas shig dang / yang na/ 'jig rten mi chos la mkhas shing 'tsho ba'i skyid sdug gang mang mang zhig mgo thog tu — 273 —

babs myong ba/ mi yul gyi zlos gar sna tshogs mig gis ltad mor rol zhing myong pa'i rgan po brjod la mkhas pa zhig gi don ldan gtam dang mtshungs bar ngo mtshar ba'i bshad tshul dang ngag rgyun thor bu/ lta na sdug pa'i rtswa thang gi rab mdzes yul ljongs/ nam yang gtogs dka' ba'i rang byung khams kyi 'gyur ldog sna tshogs/ bro ba ldan pa'i 'brog sde dang khyim rgyud so so'i bar gyi gtam rgyud sogs brjod byar bsten yod pa ma zad/ rtsom pa pos 'tsho ba'i nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas dus skabs shig gi bod kyi spyi tshogs ngo ma dang 'brel zhing dus rabs kyi 'phel 'gros dang bsdongs pa'i rtswa thang gi gom sgra de thos shing mthong ba dang / pha yul gyi sbra nag dang rdzi bo/ spang thang du g.yo 'gul byed bzhin mchis pa'i rta nor lug gsum gyi khyu tshogs bcas gson nyams ldan par bris 'dug pa ni/ dper na/ bsdus deb nang gi 〈〈srid pa rgan po 〉〉zhes pa las/ nga tsho'i 'das song gi lo rgyus dang bod mi'i tshab byed kyi snang brnyan lta bu ste/ mi sna gtso bo srid pa rgan po bya ba zhig gsar bzhengs byas te bod mi rigs la bcangs pa'i brtse dung de brjod pa dang / 6 srid pa rgan po ni lus la 'khor gsum gyon pa'i stag shar gyi gzhon nu zhig yin pa dang / rgyab la sgeg chas mdzes par spras pa'i sman shar gyi bu mo zhig dang nar son bzhin mchis pa'i byis pa blo rgod cig kyang red/mi aces srid pa rgan po ni bod mi rigs kyi mtshon byed yin pa dang / rtsom pa po'i 4 sems khong na snying chung bzhin du lding ba dang rtsa lam na zung khrag bzhin du rgyu ba ni srid pa rgan po'i da lta dang 'byung 'gyur te/mi( gong mtshungs ) bod mi rigs kyi ma 'ongs pa de ni re bltas byed sa'i gzhi 'ba' zhig tu gyur 'dug pa bstan no//'dir rtsom pa po lags kyis mthong rgya dang thos rgya/ bsam rgya shin tu yangs pa'i tshul gyis 〈〈bdag gi khyim rgyud 〉〉kyi nang du sngar gyi byung rabs dang rgyu mtshan mang po zhig gsal 'debs dang bslab bya'i tshul du brjod de/— 274 — ri

mi rnams la lugs mthun dang gus bkur/ ya rabs/ 'cham mthun bcas ni rgyal kha'i rtsa ba dang bde skyid kyi gzhi ma yin pa'i gnas lugs gsong por brjod pa dang / a khu bsam gtan dang a khu nyi ma gnyis gtso byas te rigs rus kyi mtho dma' brtsad de 'gal ba'i 'ur zing bzos pa ni/ 6 ru 'dabs de ru snang ba'i phan tshun gyi bar thag nye la tha thor yin pa'i dud khyim rnams dang lung phug cig na mgo khungs gcig las thon te nyi 'od 'phros phyogs shig gis 'od lam lam du phyogs so sor bzhur ba'i chu phran de gnyis ’( gong mtshungs ) khyad ci mchis/ rgyu mtshan gyi gting mtha' ni nam yang 'gyur ba med pa'i ri bo dang brag rdo/ gangs ri dang spangs ri bzhin du gnas pa zhig yin na/ dus yun thung thung zhig gi dar rgud dang 'byor phyug gi dpung ba'i phra sbom gyis bslangs pa'i rtsod gzhi dang 'khrug zing sogs ni phangs sems kyi rgyu ru g.yo zhing 'ongs pa'i sna nag ma zhig ma yin nam/ rang cag gi rtsom pa pos sha nye ba dang zhe brtse pa/ 'dang zhen pa bcas kyi sgo nas 'tsho ba'i gnas lugs bden pa zhig gtam rgyud kyi lam nas sems ngo 'phrod par brjod yod de/ mi yul gyi 'tsho ba kha dog brgya stong du 'tsher ba dang de'i mdzes sdug gis dus dang gnas gang du'ang mi rnams kyi yid sems dbang med du 'gugs pa'i 〈〈mdzes sdug gi bslu brid tshogs pa 〉〉dang / 'dzam gling gi yang rtser gnas bcas shing rigs rgyud spel ba ni ma gzhi nas rlabs che ba'i spyod pa zhig dang zhum pa med pa'i snying stobs shig yin la/ gnas de na bod rigs mi dmangs kyis gna' nas da bar du gsar skrun gnang ba'i gtam rgyud ngo mtshar ba zhig khyab yod pa dang / gtam rgyud de rnams la kha gtod yul zhig yod chog pa dang med kyang chog la/ gtam rgyud de rnams rtog bzo dang dngos gnas gang yin yang tshang ma rtse mo nam mkhar bsnyegs shing dpangs rgya rgya mtshor 'gran pa'i gna' bo'i sa gzhi 'di 5 'du 'dzoms byung — 275 —

zhing / mtho sgang na lhab lhub kyis 'bab pa'i kha ba'i 'dab ma dang 'dra ba'i 〈〈khu nu ri 'dabs kyi gtam rgyud 〉〉dang / snyan ngag gi rtog 'char dang lhug rtsom gyi rang dbang zung du 'brel ba'i rtsom thabs spyad na klog mkhan rnams mtho sgang gi rnam 'gyur dang 'du shes kyi me tog gang sar 'dzum pa'i bslu 'gyur gyi zhing khams shig tu 'khrid 'gro ba'i 〈〈bgres po zhig dang sbra nag cig gi gtam rgyud〉〉/ bod mi rigs kyi ya yo bral ba'i yid gzhungs dang /bcos ma min pa'i dad sems brtan po/ gnas dang yul gang du song yang brtse ba'i zhags pas dam du bcings pa'i pha yul gyi ri chur bsngags pa'i 〈〈sde 'dabs kyi mchod rten 〉〉dang 〈〈song ma tshar ba'i gnas skor〉〉/ 'jig zin pa'i dgon shul dang lab tse'i rjes shul gyis lo rgyus rgan pos bskyur ba'i gsang ba mtha' dag brtol 'dod kyi dran 'char dang bsam gzhigs mtshon pa dang / mi tshe la rin thang che yang sdod yun thung ba bar snang gi 'ja' gzugs nang bzhin phyi rjes med pa'i klong du yal ba dang / snying 'jags kyi khrod du dgon pa'i rjes shul gyis mi rabs rjes mar gtan du brjed mi rung ba'i bya bzhag cig ched du gsal 'debs byed bzhin yod pa dang 'dra ba'i 〈〈dgon shul zhig 〉〉dang / bod mi kun gyis rol zhing brgyud bzhin pa'i dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi bsdus gzugs shig ste/ 6 dus da lta dang 'dra na rta ra ra can gyi ru sde 'dir yong mkhan mang zhing za mkhan dang 'khyer mkhan yang grangs ka med pas khyod kyis de 'dra'i rdzu byed mi dgos (gong mtshungs )zhes spyi tshogs steng gi ham za lkog khyer gyi srol ngan mtshang 'byin byas shing /skyes skyes thams cad stag la skyes pa dang shi shi thams cad gri la zha ba ( shi ba)yin zhes bod mi'i kha na rlung ltar grags pa'i dpa' kher rgod kyi 'du shes ngan pa'i stabs kyis dmu rgod dang rtsub spyod gna' nas da bar nad yams bzhin khyab pa'i ngan gshis dang / nam rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi mi shes shes — 276 —

mdog byed pa'i mkhas pa/ gzhan mgo skor la mkhas pa'i bla btsun/ grags pa skam po gnyer ba'i dpon po/ ma rabs tha shal gyi las la spro ba'i pho gsar mo gsar/ lhag par snar ma dang ngo gnyis/ bla 'tshong can dag gi ngan mtshang gting nas brdol ba ste/ dngos yod spyi tshogs nang gi mi rnams kyi sems pa rta ra ra zhig gi spu mdog dang 'dra bar shin tu rtog 'dzing che ba'i snang tshul gsal por bkod pa'i 〈〈rta ra ra can gyi ri sde 〉〉dang 〈〈'grub dka' ba'i zam pa 〉〉bcas las spyi tshogs steng khyab bzhin pa'i bya ngan spyod ngan dang khrims med lugs med/ ma rabs tha shal gyi snang tshul dngos la zur za dang /mtshang 'byin/dgag rgyag nan mo byas yod/gsum pa/ sgyu rtsal smos kyi dri zhim spang thang nas mched pa/mi rigs shig gi rtsom rig ni mi rigs de'i gnas bab kyi spyi tshogs lo rgyus las byung zhing ches phul du byung ba'i rtsom rig ni mi rigs de'i yul dus nges can zhig gi bden pa smra ba'i lo rgyus yin te/ gnas bab ngo ma mtshon zhing rang gi dga' skyo chags sdang sogs brjod mkhas pa'i rang cag gi rtsom pa po pho nag pa ba res lags kyi lhug rtsom bsdus deb 〈〈sngon mo spang las 'khrungs pa'i sems kyi rol mo 〉〉nang gi brtsams chos mang po zhig ljongs rgyu'i zin tho'am gnas skor lhug rtsom gyi rtsom stangs ltar bris pa cung mang zhing /brtsams chos mi nyung ba zhig tu bris pa'i gnas tshul rnams ni don bya ngo ma'am/ yang na/ rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi khor yug gi 'tsho ba'i khrod nas dngos su byung ba dang myong ba/ brgyud pa bcas yin pas/ mtsho bod mtho sgang du mi rabs nas mi rabs su 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i bod mi ste/ lhag par 'brog pa rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i rol stangs dang bsam pa'i dran tshul/ dga' skyo chags sdang sogs mtshon pa'i brtsams chos yag shos shig yin/ rtsom mkhan gyi dus — 277 —

rgyun gyi 'tsho ba las byung ba'i rang gi 'char snang dang brtse dung/ yid smon dang lta ba zab mo zhig drang por brjod yod/nga tshos ba res lags kyi lhug rtsom dal gyis bklags te rim gyis myangs na rjod byed ngag gi snyan 'jebs dang zhim mngar/ kha dog dang ro bcud sogs kyis phyug pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi snang brnyan re re bzhin mngon yong la/ tshig dang yig 'bru'i bar na mi sems kyi 'jig rten re re dang / mi gshis kyi bro ba sna tshogs/ mi'i 'tsho gnas kyi dka' tshegs dang bde skyid ci rigs/ bde sdug zhim mngar sogs kyi myong tshor bden pa zhig ster bar byed/ com pa po rnams kyi re ba ni rang nyid kyi brtsams chos kyis klog mkhan gang mang zhig gi yid sems dbang med du g.yos nas bsam blor kha lo bsgyur rgyu de las ma 'das shing / 〈〈sngon mo spang las 'khrungs pa'i sems kyi rol mo 〉〉yi skad char bab chags rang byung gi mdzes sdug ldan pa dang / snyan 'jebs go bde dang dbyangs 'gros gsal ba/ brjod bya'i don gnad la gzhol che ba'i khyad chos rang chos su mnga' stabs/ sgyu rtsal gyi ro nyams phun sum tshogs shing yid 'gugs kyi nus pa bla lhag tu ldan pa dang brtsams chos kyi sgyu rtsal rin thang yang rang shugs su je mthor song yod/ dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i snang tshul dang mi rigs kyi mdun lam bar la re smon dang phugs bsam gyis bzhengs pa'i sgyu rtsal gser zam zhig 'phangs pa dang / lta na sdug cing yid du 'ongs pa'i ma 'ong ba'i mdzes ris kyi bslu brid dbang gis klog mkhan rnams kyis rang nyid kyi mi tshe'i lta ba dang rin thang lta bar gzhar yang bsam blo zhig bskor dgos pa byung / dper na/ lhug rtsom 〈〈me tog ser chen 〉〉nang pha yul 'brog phyogs kyi mdzes sdug ldan pa'i 'tsho ba ma lus snang brnyan du bskrun pa dang / mtho sgang gi dri gzhon gyis phyogs kun khyer ba'i me tog ser chen gyi bsung zhim khrod bag la g.yeng ba'i g.yang dkar gyi khyu tshogs dang bgrang las — 278 —
