'das pa'i rdzi bo dag gi sems pa spro ba'i glu gzhas dang 'bod pa/ 'dod blo/brtse dung bcas yod tshad me tog ser chen dang mnyam du mtho sgang gi spang ri dang / bde thang / gtsang 'gram rnams su lhug par bzhad pa ltar bris yod/rtsom mkhan gyi gnas de'i lug khyu dang rdzi bo rnams kyi las dbang dang / las skal/ re snyeg thams cad me tog ser chen gyi zhing khams su sbrel zhing / dpyid gsum kyi sgeg mos lta ba'i chog mi shes pa'i mchor sgeg dang lang tsho ngom bzhin 'jam pa'i stangs stabs gyi ngang nas slebs skabs/ mtho sgang gi skye dngos yod rgu de ma thag gnyid las sad cing skye 'phel gyi bla srog myur du thob pa ni/ lug khyu'i mi lam dang / spra nag gi bsam don ma yin nam/ mtho sgang gi 'jig rten 'dir ches yid du 'ong zhing mtshar du sdug pa'i kha dog cig dang g.yur du za ba'i 'bras bu zhig phangs med du sbyin nas gzi 'od 'bar ba'i tshe srog cig rtag tu rgyun bsrings pa yin la/ de ni ngo ma me tog ser chen gyi phul du byung ba'i gshis ka dang blo spobs yin zhing / de ni mtho sgang gi 'phel 'gyur dang sbra nag gi dar rgyas la mdzes sdug gi dpal yon dang mi nub pa'i tshe srog sbyin mkhan zhig kyang yin pas/ 'dir rtsom mkhan gyis dpe mtshon gyi 'bri thabs spyad de ming grags chung ba'i me tog ser chen re re ni skyes stobs kyi dpal kun rdzogs pa'i mtho sgang gi 'od 'tsher ba'i tshe srog gi phung po re rer bris shing / tshe srog gi phung po re re de yang gser mdog bkra ba'i rmi lam re re ste/ mtho sgang gi 'tshol zhib dang brtson len byed bzhin pa'i phugs 'dun re re yin la/ gnas der gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i re steg cig gi ched du btab pa'i mdzes sdug gi sa bon dang / me tog ser chen bzhin du nam yang mtho sgang du 'dzum pa'i tshe srog gi 'od mdangs yin/gnad don zhig mi rnams la lhug por brjod pa'am mi rnams kyi sems ngor 'dris par bya dgos tshe/ rjod mkhan de'i tshor snang dngos ma dang myong — 279 —

snang rnal ma dag mang tshogs la goms 'dris su song yod pa'i tshig dang tha snyad kyis brjod na da gzod pha rol por rdo brkos ri mo bzhin mi brjed pa'i bag chags zab mo zhig bsgo thub pa yin la/ de las ldog tshe 'ud shob dang byung rgyal gyi gtam du thal bas gzhan yid 'gugs dka' ba ma zad/ don ston gyi nus pa'ang med par 'gyur 'gro bas tshor snang dang myong snang rnal ma de gzugs can bzhin ston rgyu ni lhug rtsom gyi srog tu rung ba yin/ deb 'di'i rtsom pa pos dmigs yul de 'dra zhig snying la bcangs te 'brog pa mang tshogs kyis dus rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod spyod pa'i go bde ba'i skad cha bkol ba shin tu mang ste/ dper na/ smyo nged gnyis ri bo de'i kha sor bud/milta bu dang /zu kha rgyag glo rgyag la bshad mi tshar ba'i skad cha mi ngas rgyal khab kyi bla btsag dgos pa dang 'dra bar nga ni mi med po zhig yin/mi nyag ga dma' mo ’sogs mi rang ga ba rnams la 'dris che zhing snying nye ba/ don gsal zhing brjod bde ba'i tshig dang tha snyad dag gis bris pa dang / lhag par dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe dang kha mtshar sogs tshig gcig gis don brgya ston thub pa'i tshig sbyor gyi nus pa bla lhag gis thon yod pas/ bklags ma thag sems kyi nang rol la spro sing sing gi tshor ba zhig cig car du 'dren par byed/ sna de bas rtsom pa pos shin tu bab chags pa'i phal skad kyis bris pas khong gi lhug rtsom gyis mi rnams kyi blo sgo 'byed thub par ma zad/ gangs can rtsom rig dang nang sgos su lhug rtsom gyi nags khrod du skyes pa'i tsan dan gsar pa zhig dang 'dra zhing lhug rtsom brtsams chos dag la rang gi bsam blo dang rang gi brtse dung / rang gi khyad chos bcas ldan pa dang / lhug rtsom skor zhig rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan la bcings nas bris yod pa/ skabs rer sgro 'dogs dang 'ud brjod kyi sbyo /sna /lha yo/ spyabs sgyu rtsal dang skad cha'i tshig sbyor la legs pa'i khyad che — 280 —

sa bcad drug pa/ ldong yon tan rgya mtsho dang kho'i lhug rtsom bsdus deb 〈〈skad cha'i lang tsho〉〉/dang po/ las kyis rnyed pa'i kher rkyang gi mi tshe/ldong yon tan rgya mtsho ni 1974lor si khron rnga ba ru skyes/ slob chung mthar phyin rjes chos sde chen po sgo mang dgon du zhugs/ lo nyer gsum nas bzung mgo log rwa rgya dgon shes rig nor bu'i gling du da bar dpe khrid kyi las kho na gnyer/ snga rjes su rtsom yig nyis brgya lhag dus deb dang tshags par steng bkod cing gzengs rtags thengs mang po thob/ 〈〈mdzod dge gling ba dgon grong gi lo rgyus 〉〉dang 〈〈ja yul sgo mang dgon gyi gdan rabs〉〉/〈〈dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i snying gtam〉〉/ 〈〈shing bza' paṇḍi ta'i rtogs brjod〉〉/༵ga rtsom bsdus deb 〈〈skad cha'i lang tsho 〉〉bcas dpe deb bzhi dpe skrun rdidhidze sad sdu/ga gi sems khams shig dang khag khur lci mo'i 'dun ma zhigagasal myur shugs drag gi tshor 'du zhig rum nas/ mtho sgang gi bu phrug des mi rigs slob gsor bcol ba'i re ba chen po zhig phrag tu khyer nas kher rkyang du mtho sgang gi yul phyogs 'grims par shin tu spro/ na tshod ma smin kyang phugs 'dun zab pa'i khye'u chung chung / rma klung ring mo dal gyis 'bab pa'i khug so cig na gzi 'od lam lam 'phro yang bgrod pas rdzogs mtha' bral ba'i las gnas shig gi bshul lam ring mor rdog 'gros gtad cing / lhag bsam gtsang ma zhig dang spobs sems mthon po zhig gis mi rigs 'dis rmis ma myong ba'i rmi lam 'tshol phyir byis dus kyi 'phrul snang skyid po de dngos yod kyi sku tshegs sdug pos bsus par mi tshe rin thang gi ljang myug 'di nas 'bus pa — 281 —

dang / kho'i bla srog gi gting rim du da dung yang lkog tu gyur pa ga tshod cig bag la nyal yod pa mi su zhig gis rtogs nus sam/lhug rtsom bsdus deb 〈〈skad cha'i lang tsho 〉〉yi nang du rtsom thung 49tsam bsdus yod cing / rtsom mkhan gyis dngos su myong zhing brgyud pa'i gtam rgyud dag bris te rang gi pha yul la bcangs pa'i brtse sems dang mi rigs shig gi rig gnas rgyab ljongs/ dus skabs gsar pa'i nang bod mi'i sems khong gi 'pho 'gyur/ dngos yod 'tsho ba dang chos lugs mi sna zhig gi bsam blo'i 'gal 'du/ bod mi'i bag la nyal ba'i dge sems kyi rtsa ba/ skye ba snga phyi dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa la bcangs pa'i bsam blo/ bod mi'i sems khong gi mdzes pa dang mi gshis kyi rin thang bcas mngon par mtshon yod pa ma zad/ rtsom pa pos 'gyur ba med cing drang bden la phyogs pa'i rang gshis las kho'i sems gting du sbas pa'i 'dod blo dang phugs re lhug rtsom 〈〈med 〉〉ces pa'i nang gsong bor brjod yod/ 6 spyir yin na 6 med mug chad mi gsum gyi gzungs sngags 'di mi rabs du mar mtho sgang gi rdzi glu bzhin bzlas drags pas ngas yang bskyar bzla 'dod med/ 'on kyang mtho sgang na mang po zhig med pa'i bkres skom ma bzod par 'o dod ring mo 'di 6 'bad pas 'gog pa'i rgyan bzhin du sems dron mo'i zab sa nas shor song /mi⑨zhes pa dang / bdag nyid bdag gi mgon yin te/ /gzhan lta su zhig mgon du bgyi/ /zhes 'jig rten na rang las gzhan skyabs gnas shig mi rnyed pa rang cag gi mnyam med shākya'i rgyal pos gsungs yod pa ltar/ mtho sgang na 'phrul lam med/ mtho sgang na brnyan 'phrin med/ mtho sgang na glog med bcas gnas 'di'i med pa rnams bgrang nas 'grim 'grul dang brda 'phrin gyi bkag rgya las thar 'dod kyi sems shugs dang / srol rgyun rig gnas dang mkhregs 'dzin gyi lta ba las rnyed pa'i nges shes gtsang ma/ bod mi'i gsar gtod kyi snying stobs/ deng — 282 —

rabs rig gnas kyi sgul shugs las thon pa'i tshur len ring lugs kyi spobs sems/ zhum pa med pa'i spobs pa dang brtson sems bcas mngon lkog gang rung nas 'bur thon du bris yod/'gro ba mi 'od snang la dung zhing bde skyid la mos pa nam yang 'dra mtshungs yin mod/ sa mtho chu gtsang gi yul gru 'di rngam nag mun pa'i klong na rang gi lag pa rkyang skum la'ang dngangs skrag skye bzhin kha khu sim mer 'gul tsam 'gul tsam byed pa'i don dngos 'dis mi rigs shig dang rig gnas shig gi 'phel rgyas dang nyams rgyad/ spyi tshogs shig gi ngo bo dang 'gyur ldog mtshon yod pas brtsams chos nang gi mi sna dang / mdzes ljongs/ snang brnyan/'tsho ba bcas la rtog btags dang sgro skur/ 'ud brjod kyi 'bri thabs gang yang ma bsten par rang gi khor yug gi 'tsho ba las thon pa'i don bya ngo ma dang yul ljongs ngo ma/ mi sna ngo ma bris par slob gso'i rang bzhin shugs che zhing lta klog gi rin thang yang je mthor song yod la/ klog pa po rnams la sems shugs 'dzad med cig sbyin pa dang 'dun pa gsar pa zhig gi lam du skul bar byed/ 6 lnga rig mdzes ma'i lang tsho rum ste mtho sgang la dpyid dpal gyi pho nyar 'gro ran pa'i khyed tsho/ dgong tshogs 'di'i pha rol gyi sang nyin dang mnyam du lam la chas dgos/ gangs 'dabs dang gtsang 'gram gyi byis pa mang por ka kha'i rdzi glu gyer bzhin chas dgos/ dung sems dang smreng skyo'i mig zhags ring mo ma yum slob gling du bzhag ste mi yul la stobs shugs 'bul phyir lam la chas dgos/mi ( gong mtshungs )zhes pa 'di the tshom dang 'jigs snang gi dra bar tshud pa'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na rgyang thag ring yang gzi 'od ldan pa'i dmigs 'ben la skul ba'i dung brda zhig min nam/ lhug rtsom bsdus deb 〈〈skad cha'i lang tsho 〉〉ni don du'ang skad cha'i mdzes sdug rdzogs shing lang tsho dar ba'i brtsams chos yag shos shig ste/ snyan zhing — 283 —

'jebs la dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug ldan pa'i tshig dang yig 'bru'i bar na stobs shugs dang re 'dun gyis khengs pas/ gzhon nu gsar skyes rnams kyi yid dbang lhag par 'gug nus pa yin/rtsom pa po nyid ni chil chil 'bab pa'i rma chu'i 'grams ngogs dang mtho zhing brjid pa'i brag ri'i nye 'dabs shig na/ chos lugs rig gnas kyi dri bsung rngam mthug pa'i dgon pa'i khor yug de ru grwa btsun dkyus ma zhig gi 'tsho ba rol zhing mchis la/ kho'i kher rkyang gi 'tsho stangs 'dis bod mi rigs kyi 'das ma 'ongs gsum la bsam blo skor ba'i dus tshod mod po zhig skrun pa dang / rang gi mig dbang rnon po de nam yang bod mi rigs kyi 'dun lam dang 'phel rgyas/ mes pos bzhag pa'i rig gnas 'di'i rin thang dang dge mtshan 'tshol ba'i phyogs su gtod pa dang / bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi lhag bsam dkar po dang spyi sems snyoms po/ byams sems 'jam po/ dad sems brtan po bcas las 'phros te dgon pa'i 'tsho ba dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i bar gyi 'brel ba dang / skya ser gnyis kyi bsam pa'i 'khyer so/ 'jig rten lta sal/ mi tshe'i rin thang sogs zur dang ngos mi 'dra ba du ma nas bstanag rgas/ pa/ bkrag mdangs 'tsher ba'i skad cha'i lang tsho/lhug rtsom bsdus deb 〈〈skad cha'i lang tsho 〉〉yi rtsom pa po ni bod rang gi phun sum tshogs pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng skabs kyi dgon pa'i 'tsho ba dngos la ha cang zhib cha ldan zhing 'dris che ste/ dper na/ 〈〈byams dang snying rje〉〉/ 〈〈btsun pa'i rang tshugs〉〉/ 〈〈gzhan don gyis rdzogs pa'i sku tshe 〉〉sogs las grwa btsun rnam dag cig gi 'dod mos dang bsam dgongs dngos ni sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can bde la 'god 'dod pa'i sems byung nam yang sems la bcangs rgyu dang / phan tshun bar mthong chung dang — 284 —

brnyas bcos/ btsan dbang / 'khrug rtsod mi byed par dus dang gnas gang du'ang byams dang snying rje'i khor yug cig bskrun nas/ yi rangs dang mthun sgril/ rang dbang dang zhi bde sogs kyi brtse 'dzum lhug par grol ba'i spyi tshogs shig la re zhing snyeg par byed/ lo rgyus steng gi rtsom mkhan sngon thon rigs kyis nam yang kho tsho'i gsung rtsom la brten nas spyi tshogs kyi 'gal ba sngog 'don dang / mun nag rjes lus kyi snang tshul la rdung deg khrel dgod byed pa dang / yar skyed kyi don la bsngags brjod dang / mi rnams kyi rlabs chen bsam pa dang / sgyu rtsal gyi spro snang sogs bskyed bsring byed pa bcas kyis spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas 'gro ba'i phyogs la phan nus sgrub pa ltar/ ldong yon tan lags kyis bod mi'i spyi tshogs gnas bab dang 'tsho ba'i rol stangs/ bya ba'i las bgos bcas la ham sems chung bar 'khang sems dang / las bda'/ tha na blo pham pa dang yid mug pa'i tshul gyis 6 sems bsam pa'i gting nas skyo byung / grogs po lags/ khyod kyis pha yul mtho snang gi gnas tshul tsam yang mi shes sam/ mtho sgang na kha ba sngon ltar 'bab cing sbag sbag 'khor lo zhon pa'i pho gzhon snang mtho 'ga' je mang du song ba las gzhan phal cher ma 'gyur gor mo rdo yin/mi(gong mtshungs 〉zhes te/ mi rigs gzhan dang gzhan gyi 'phel rgyas glog las myur ba'i skabs 'dir rang cag la mdun bskyod med pa'am/ yang na rus sbal gyi 'gros bzhin shin tu dal ba 'di las yid skyo ba zhig gang na mchis/ 6 wa spyang gi hab dgod mtho sa dang mdun skyod kyi gom kha dal sa 'dir :zhes bod spyi tshogs dus rabs kyi rjes su lus shing bod mi'i 'du shes rig gnas kyi shan shugs dang khor yug gi 'brel 'dris dbang gis 'gran rtsod kyi ngar sems zhan pa dang don dngos la phyogs pa'i mthong rgya chung ba'i rnam pa 'dir sems khur chen pos lha shes rig la sbyangs brtson zab cing / mi rigs la dung zhen che ba'i pho rgod cig yin na — 286 —

thob shor gnyis ka yod nges kyang / rang gi sto gos tsam gyi ched du 'khor te mi tshe mi gtong bar/ dka' sa khag sa re nas mi rigs yar rgyas la nus pa 'don thub rgyu na rab yin par bsam/mi (gong mtshungs )zhes bod mi rigs kyi 'phel rgyas la nus pa ci mchis gtsang 'bul bya rgyu'i chod sems dkar po yug gcig tu bkrams/lhug rtsom gyi brjod bya dngos yod kyi snang tshul la phyogs dgos pa'i cha nas 〈〈skad cha'i lang tsho 〉〉nang gi rtsom phal mo che ni gnas skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dang rtsom mkhan gyi bsam blo mtshon pa'i me long lta bu yin la/dus skabs nges can zhig gi dpal 'byor dang chab srid/ rig gnas/ spyi tshogs kyi yul srol goms 'dris/ lhag par dgon pa'i rig gnas dang grwa rkyang gi 'tsho ba bcas mngon par mtshon yod/ ldong yon tan lags la mtshon na dus rabs sngon ma'i mjug tsam nas bzung gsar rtsom gyi kun slong gtsang ma zhig gi sne khrid 'og deng rabs bod kyi 'tsho ba dngos dang bsam blo dngos rtsom rig sgyu rtsal la brten nas ha cang gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang dgon pa dang grwa btsun gyi gtam rgyud brjod yod pa de 'dra'i bab chags shing nyams 'gyur gyis phyug pa dang /bcos ma min zhing bden pa la gzas pa zhig yin/brtse sems snum po zhig dang sems 'gyu dron mo zhig gi rten 'brel las/srol rgyun rig gnas kyi ka ba brtan zhing zhi dul gzhan phan gyi mkha' dbugs 'jam por ldang ba'i mtho sgang gi gru ga zhig na 'tsho ba'i myong brgyud las 'phos pa'i dran snang sna tshogs brjod bya'i rus rkang du bkod pa'i lhug rtsom 〈〈nga'i las dbang la brgyus pa'i dus rabs kyi skar tshom 〉〉dang 〈〈a ma'i byams bcu〉〉/ 〈〈dpe khug khur ba'i byis pa lo brgyad 〉〉bcas las/ dge grogs bar gyi mdza' gcugs dang ma bu'i bar gyi byams sems/ dge slob bar gyi brtse 'dang / bza' mi'i bar gyi mdza' mthun bcas don spyi gsal — 286 ge

zhing dbyangs 'gros snyan pa'i drod lam lam gyi tshig gis mtshon yod de/ 6 a ma'i mdzes sdug gi lang tsho me tog 'dra bo bu phrug tsho'i ched du phul zhing / phra ldem gyi sku lus sgyug ma 'dra bo bu phrug tsho'i ched du 'khyog cing skur bas brtse ba mtha' med rgya mtshor 'phos/ bka' drin ri rgyal lhun po'i spun du bzhengs pa nam langs nyi shar gyi tshul du mchis/mi gong mtshungs )zhes pa dang / bod mi thams cad kyi rgyud la srol rgyun rig gnas kyi bag chags zab mo yod pa ltar rang cag gi rtsom pa po yang snying rje che zhing dad pa ldan pa/ las 'bras brtsi ba'i gangs can pa'i sems khams de kho'i bsam blo dang brtsams chos zung gi nang rdzongs kho nar sbas shing / brtsams chos kyi byung rim dang mi sna so so'i bsam spyod dag las nam yang spyi tshogs khor yug dang bod mi'i kun spyod legs bcos kyi brjod snying de gal chen nang gi 'gangs chen du brtsis nas/ mi dang mi'i bar gyi mdza' gcugs/ mi dang rang byung khor yug bar gyi brtse sems/ che bkur chung byams kyi gshis bzang bcas mi rigs shig gi sems rgyud drang mor mtshon pa dang / rig gnas shig gi rgyab ljongs dang mi rigs shig gi sems khams kyi mdzes pa mngon par bstan pa red/〈〈skad cha'i lang tsho 〉〉la spyi nas slob gso'i nus shugs ha cang 'bur du thon 'dug pas rtsom pa po khong bod mi rigs kyi slob gso'i don du nam rgyun kha zhe gnyis med kyis thugs khur gnang mkhan zhig yin pa tshor thub/ khong gi lhug rtsom la gzhan dang thun min gyi khyad chos gtso bo zhig 'bur du thon 'dug pa ni kho'i mi gshis kyi dwangs gtsang dang gsar gtod kyi snying stobs/bden 'tshol gyi spobs pa bcas las mngon te/ smyo snyan ngag pa la snyan ngag dang mtshungs pa'i 'jam lhod lhod kyi gshis rgyud cig dang / dus rabs kyi glu ba byed chog pa'i mgrin pa bde mo zhig mi rigs kyi sne khrid byed phod pa'i snying stobs shig khor yug gnyid las dkrogs thub pa'i gad rgyangs shig spyi tshogs — 287 —

kyi ngan mtshang 'byin thub pa'i ljags rtsal zhig rang nyid bshams ston byed phod pa'i khog rgya zhig 'jig rten sgul shes pa'i sgyu 'phrul zhig mi sems 'gug thub pa'i gnas lugs shig bcas khyad chos de dag 'dzoms na da gzod snyan ngag pa'am rtsom rig pa'i las 'gan gtso bo grub pa red/mi ( gong mtshungs ) ces pas kho'i gsar rtsom lta ba gsal snying du bstan pa dang / rtsom yig mang che ba kha gsal zhing go bde ba tsam du ma zad/ sgyu rtsal gyi thabs rtsal cung mang ba zhig bkol nas gnas lugs gson po zhig la spyi sdom gyi khyad chos mngon par dod pas klog mkhan tshor thad kur skul slong sna tshogs thebs su baḥkā rig brtsams chos kyi rnam pa gang yin yang de'i brjod bya'am grub cha gtso bo dngos yod 'tsho ba yin zhing / rtsom pa po'i sgyug rtse'ang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod nas brdar dgos mod/ rtog btags dang 'ol tshol gyis bzhengs pa'i 'jig rten gang mang zhig kyang rtsom rig gi tshe srog dang 'bral thabs gtan nas med pa'i gnas lugs rnyed pa nas/ ldong yon tan lags dgon sde dang slob grwa/ grong khyer dang zhing sde/ 'brog thang dang rtogs dka' ba'i ri rgyud kyi gsang ba mang por zab zhugs dang 'tshol zhib byas pas kho'i lhug rtsom la tshig sbyor gsal zhing dag pa/ brjod bya lkog gyur zhig la mgo mi 'khor bar kun gyis do khur byed pa'i don de bdams pas dpe gzhi'i tshad du slebs 'dug ces brjod kyang chog ldong yon tan lags ni snyan ngag pa zhig kyang yin pa'i cha nas dus rabs nyi shu pa'i mjug dang nyer gcig pa'i 'go tsam nas bzung kho'i lhug rtsom gsar rtsom la 'gyur ldog gsar pa zhig byung ba ni/ lhug rtsom 'bri ba'i tshe na'ang snyan ngag gi yul don dang / snyan ngag gi zhing khams/ snyan ngag gi ro bro ba bcas la brtson len byed pa'i snang tshul byung yod pa dang / de ni dus thog zhig gi rtsom pa po mang che bas re snyeg byed — 288 —

pa'i gnas shig tu'ang gyur dang 'gyur bzhin yod stabs/ lhug rtsom gyi rtsom srol gsar pa 'di rtsom mkhan 'ga' re ba zhig dang / yang na stes dbang du byung ba min par dus rabs kyi khyad chos dang / rtsom mkhan gyi gsar rtsom 'du shes/ mi rigs kyi mdzes dpyod lta ba bcas dang 'brel ba dam zab yod pa red/ kho'i lhug rtsom 〈〈ston mjug gi dran pa 〉〉dang 〈〈ston rlung lding ba'i mtshan mo〉〉/ 〈〈zla ba mtsho la lhung ba〉〉/ 〈〈zla ba nag po'i pha rol〉〉/ 〈〈yar klung gtsang po 〉〉bcas las yid 'gyur ston pa gtsor bzung yod pas lhug rtsom snyan ngag gi khyad chos mngon gsal du ldan te/ sna yar klung gtsang po/ skar mda' bzhin phyi nang 'gal rkyen phra rags gtor te bzhur/ yar klung gtsang po/ rgod po bzhin gangs ri'i mu khyud brgal te mtha' bral yul khams chen mo'i ngo mtshar 'tshol du chas/ 'gal rkyen gyi pha bong bstud mar spungs kyang /dka' sdug gi 'tshub ma gdong la babs kyang / khyod gser mdog gi nyi ma bzhin lhod kyis bzhud pas/ lo zla du ma'i 'khor skyod kyi khugs pa zhig nas khyod la khyod kyi rlabs sgra chags/ khyod brdol sa'i gangs dkar ri bo'i grags snyan dang gzi dpal yang mtha' med rgya mtsho'i klong yangs nas drag tu 'phyur byung /mi (gong mtshungs )zhes brjod nas bod mi rigs kyi las dbang la kun nas bsam blo gtong ba dang / na gzhon grwa rkyang zhig gi rang tshugs 'bur du thon yod de/ bsam phod pa/ smra phod pa/ sgrub phod pa'i snying stobs shig tshig dang yig 'bru'i bar na me ri bzhin 'phyur bas klog pa po'i yid g.yo ba'i nus shugs lhag par ldan/ lhug rtsom bsdus deb 〈〈skad cha'i lang tsho 〉〉yi mtshon byed kyi thabs dang / sgyu rtsal gyi nyams/ rjod byed kyi tshig bcas gang yin yang rtsom srol rnying pa'i gzhung rta zhig las gyes te gsar pa gsar pa'i lam du zhugs shing / thabs sna tshogs kyis dus rabs kyi 'pho 'gyur dang /khor yug nges can zhig gi lta ba/ kun spyod dang bde sdug sogs nang gi dran — 289 —

snang ci rigs gsal lhang lhang du brjod yod pa red/dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/0)0yibu bzhi bsam pa'i don grub kyi 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig gi drang don brjod pa 〉〉zhes pa/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2003lor dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 126dang 129par gsal/()sgo'i9)()don grub rgyal gyi 〈〈rkang lam phra mo 〉〉zhes pa 1984lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb gsum pa'i shog ngos 1warabar du gsal/(1bde skyid 'tsho'i 〈〈sems pa'i rtsom gyi lam bu 〉〉zhes pa si khron dpe skrun tshogs pa/ si khron mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gis 2006gi lor dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 5par //༵༵〈/yi(yisangs rgyas kyi 〈〈dgu chu'i glu dbyangs 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gis dpe sgrun byas pa'i 1985lo'i 〈〈snang char 〉〉deb gnyis par gsal/(yi(3sgom pa bkra shes kyi 〈〈kha ba babs rjes kyi zhogs pa 〉〉zhes pa masnan sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang ris dpe skrun byas pa'i 1988lo'i 〈〈sgrang char 〉〉deb dang por gsal(/nyarin chen don grub kyi 〈〈gangs ri 〉〉zhes pa 1986lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉//trī sna spyisna kā/ paX/ kyi 〈〈shel gyi lhun po 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe kun byas pa'i 1986lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb dang por gsal/(yi(1rin chen don grub dang rin chen bkra shis kyi 〈〈gangs ri 〉〉dang 〈〈shel gyi lhun po〉〉/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gis 1993lor dpe skrun byas pa'i bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈kha ba'i rnam shes 〉〉kyi shog ngos 251dang 257par gsalarku/namagon po bkra shis kyi 〈〈gro ma'i me tog 〉〉zhes pa kun lho 〈〈zla zer 〉〉rtsom sgrig khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i 1989lo'i 〈〈zla zer 〉〉deb dang por gsal/yonardo rje gcod pa'i 〈〈rna thang / me rtog gi 'jig rten 〉〉zhes pa kun lho 〈〈zla zer 〉〉— 290 —

rtsom sgrig khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i 1989lo'i 〈〈zla zer 〉〉deb gnyis par gsal/6)nyi ma tshe ring gi 〈〈'dab brgya lhug par grol ba'i me tog 〉〉ces pa ni mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1993lor dpe skrun byas pa'i bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈kha ba'i rnam shes 〉〉kyi shog ngos 376par gsal/rkyu1〈yitu mgon po bkra shis dang rdo rje gcod pa'i 〈〈gro ma'i me tog 〉〉dang 〈〈rna thang / me tog gi 'jig rten 〉〉mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1993lor dpe skrun byas pa'i bod kyi deng rabs dpe tshogs 〈〈kha ba'i rnam shes 〉〉kyi shog ngos 383pa ru gas///gcod pa don grub gyi 〈〈mnyen 'jam rtswa'i glu sgra 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i 1984lo'i 〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb gsum shādri /sdu kā/bas kyi 〈〈nga ni rtswa phran 'di la dga' 〉〉zhes pa bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i 1983lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb dang por gsal4/yi'abum skyabs kyi 〈〈nga ni rtswa phran 'di la dga' 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1993lor dpe skrun byas pa'i bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈kha ba'i rnam shes 〉〉kyi shog ngos 75par gsal/tsho'igacod pa don grub kyi 〈〈mnyen 'jam rtswa'i glu sgra 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gis 1993lor dpe skrun byas pa'i bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈kha ba'i rnam shes 〉〉kyi shog ngos 188par gsal/6〉6〉〈〈dpal don grub rgyal gyi gsung 'bum 〉〉zhes pa mi rigs dpe kun khang gis 1997lor dpe sgrun byas pa'i deb gsum pa'i shog ngos 16par gsal/4yichab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring gi 〈〈lan gru grong khyer gyi dpyid dpal 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i 1982lo'i 〈2sbrang char 〉〉deb gsum ༵/ spreg snan/ po'i 〈〈gsar bzhad 'dab phreng dgod pa'i bkrag mdangs 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe sgrun khang gis 1993lor dpe sgrun byas pa'i bod kyi deng rabs — 291 —

rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈rtsom dpyad gtam tshogs 〉〉kyi shog ngos 307par gsal/0yibu bzhi bsam pa'i don grub kyi 〈〈ljon pa'i tshal gyi ngo mtshar gzigs mo 〉〉zhes spri mtsho sngo/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i 1985lo'i 〈〈sgrang char 〉〉ཿba da/bye darsha rno ༵༵ /〈〈gzi rtsa sde dgu'i mdzes ljongs 〉〉zhes pa zla zer com sgrig khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i 1985lo'i 〈〈zla zer 〉〉deb gsum par gsal/rkyunyachab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring bi 〈〈chab cha rtswa thang gi bkra shis glu sgra 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngo/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang sgas dpe skrun byas pa'i1982lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb ga sa //rsha kā kārnyi/ 〈〈gsang ba ya mtshan 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2001lor dpe skrun byas pa'i sbrang char lo 'khor 20dpe tshogs 〈〈kug rtsom padma'i ze'u 'bru 〉〉yi shog ngos 166par gsal/〈tatshe dbang dang blo tshul gyi 〈〈rang byung chu tshan mthong ba'i snang tshul 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngo/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i1988lo'i 〈(sbrang char 〉〉deb ga sa //kā kāpal ba/kra shis chos 'phel gyi 〈〈deng rabs lhug rtsom gyi mtshan nyid rnam dbye dang bcas pa'i rnam bzhag mdor bsdus 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon bod rigs zhib 'jug rdogadī ༷sa dpar btab pa'i 2005lo'i 〈〈mtsho sngon bod rigs 〉〉deb dang po'i shog sa tshon/bye( /dril rgya/la gyi 〈〈mi don phug ron gyis dpyad pa'i gtam rgyud 〉〉ces pa mtsho rdon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i 1981lo'i 〈〈rdzang char 〉〉deb dang ra ga//kā/nga nyi ma 'od zer gyis gter nas bton pa'i 〈〈slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi rnam thar bka' thang zangs gling ma 〉〉zhes pa si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1989lor dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 149par gsal/(yiklu tshang smyug rtsen gyi 〈〈'dzam gling gi khyad mtshar rdo yi glegs bam 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i 1999lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb — 292 —

gsum //dī pa/ kā/sa chos grags kyi 〈〈gtsang khul gyi gnas chen khag la lta skor du phyin pa'i mthogā thos 〉〉zhes pa 1983lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉ba da/bye (yira' kārshal la/sa chos grags kyi 〈〈gtsang khul gyi gnas chen khag la lta skor du phyin pa'i mthong thos 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1993lor dpe skrun bya pa'i bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈kha ba'i rnam shes 〉〉kyi shog ngos 242//( //snyi/sgo/ 'jigs med theg mchog gi 〈〈nges don gyi nyi ma 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe sgrun byas pa'i1991lo'i 〈〈sgrang char 〉〉deb gnyis par gsal4/)gnya' blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi 〈〈khyi 〉〉zhes pa 1986lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈bod kyi com rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb gsum par gsal/4yi4〉4)4yiganya' blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi 〈〈khyi 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe sgrun khang sgas 1993lor dpe skrun byas pa'i bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈kha ba'i rnam shes 〉〉kyi shog ngos 218par gsal/4yine'u chung gi 〈〈rang gshis gdong 'bod 〉〉zhes pa 1985lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈gangs rgyan me tog 〉〉deb gnyis pa'i shos ngos 71par gsal/(14yilha rgyal tshe ring gi 〈〈mdun skyod kyi gom sgra 〉〉zhes pa bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i 1986lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb bzhi par gsalatshu/ natshusmordo rje mkhar gyi 〈〈cang shes rta pho 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 1993lor dpe skrun byas pa'i bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈kha ba'i rnam shes 〉〉kyi shog ngos 184par gsal/〈yi〈yikerma bde skyid kyi 〈〈lang tsho'i 'char snang 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2001lor dpe skrun byas pa'i zang char lo 'khor 20dpe tshogs 〈〈lhag rtsom padma'i ze'u 'bru 〉〉yi shog ngos 290par gsal/— 293 —

〈〈4)kunanor bu'i 〈〈spobs pa 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis2001lor dpe skrun byas pa'i sbrang char lo 'khor20dpe tshogs 〈〈lcag rtsom padma'i ze'u 'bru 〉〉yi shog ngos233par gsal/tsu〉07tsu〉tshunalha nag pa ba res kyi 〈〈sngon mo spang las 'khrungs pa'i sems kyi rol shā 〉〉zhes pa 2000lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i shog sa 3shārnyipa /rag /zlod/ tshe'i 〈〈spang thang nas mched pa'i snyan 'jebs kyi dbyangs rta zhig 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal khang nas dpe skrun byas pa'i 2006lo'i 〈〈mang tshogs sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb bzhi pa'i shog ngos 90par gsal/tumildong yon tan rgya mtsho'i 〈〈skad cha'i lang tsho 〉〉zhes pa mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis 2004lor dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 11par gsal/— 294 —

le'u bzhi pa/ bod kyi deng rarbas zlos gar/sa bcad dang po/ zlos gar gyi gnas tshul mdor bsdus/bod kyi zlos gar ni mi rigs kyi khyad chos mngon gsal ldan zhing tshang mas ltar 'dod la nyan spro ba'i rig rtsal zhig yin/ de ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi rin thang bral ba'i rig gnas kyi nor rdzas shig yin par ma zad//nga rgyal gyi zlos gar sdum ra'i nang gi ngo mtshar ba'i me tog rkang gcig kyang da/srol rgyun gyi go ba len tshul ltar na/ zlos gar ni sems can mgu byed kyi rig gnas shig ste/ sngon byung ba'i gtam rgyud dang lo rgyus sogs kyi mi sna dang lha 'dre sogs mtshon pa'i gzugs su byas te rang rang so so'i skad kyis glu len pa dang bsam pa'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs yang nas yang du zlos shing gar byed pa la zer/ de yang mi sna so so'i bsam pa'i nyams 'gyur skyo ba dang /dga' ba dang / 'jigs pa sogs dgu bo rnams mtshon pa'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur dang ngag gi gdangs mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas gar 'khrab pa dang chabs ci/ de hāng mthun pa'i rol mo rigs bzhi la sogs pa'i ram 'degs byed pa kā sa rsha/ra la dgos pa'i yan lag lnga ni/ mdo 'dzin pa dang / rol mo pa/chas su zhugs pa/ bzhan gad pa/ zlos gar pa bcas yin/ mdo 'dzin pa'am gzhung bshad pa ni/ zlos gar bkod 'doms byed pa po'am zlos gar gyi 'khrab bya'i don gang yin pa de'i gzhung srong ba po ste/ phreng ba skud par brgyus — 295 —

pa'i sne mor spyi la khyab pa'i phreng rdog che ba gcig yod pa der mdo 'dzin pa zer ba dang 'dra/ mdo 'dzin pa med na zlos gar der go rim med pa dang sgrig khrims med par 'gyur/ rol mo pa ni/ mtshon bya'i mi sna rigs mi 'dra ba'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur dang ngag gi glu dbyangs dang bstun nas rol mos ram 'degs byed pa ste/ de la rol mo rigs bzhi yod/ 1 'bud pa'i rol mo ni/ rgya gling dang / gling bu/ dung / shu sgra sogs yin/ na dkrol ba'i rol mo ni/sbug chal dang / sil snyan/ cha lang / ting shag dril bu/ cang te'u sogs/3 rdung ba'i rol mo ni/ rnga chen/ rnga zlum/ rdza rnga kha gcig pa/ rdza rnga kha gnyis ma/mkhar rnga che chung sogs/ 4 rgyud kyi rol mo ni/ pi wang / sgra snyan/ tam bu ra/chin rgyud nyer lnga pa sogs chin gyi rigs mi 'dra ba mang po yod/ de dag kyang mtshon byed mi sna'i lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur dgu bo gang la gang 'tsham gyis ram 'degs byed pa yin/ chas su zhugs pa ni/ mtshon bya'i mi sna mi 'dra ba so so'i chas su zhugs nas gar 'khrab mkhan te/ de la mi sna gtso bo dang phal ba/ram 'degs mi sna bcas yod pa so sor drang phyogs kyi mi sna dang / ldog phyogs kyi mi sna/ bar gnas kyi mi sna bcas gang 'khrab kyang mtshon bya'i mi sna de'i bsam blo dang / lus kyi rnam 'gyur/ ngag gi gdangs bcas legs par mtshon thub min la brten nas/ ltad mo mkhan tshor nyams 'gyur thon pa'i nus pa che chung mi 'dra ba yod pa de yin/ dper na zlos gar mkhan 'ga' zhig gis drang phyogs mi sna mtshon mkhas na'ang gzhan dag mtshon mi mkhas pa'ang yod/ bzhad gad pa ni/ zlos gar gyi skabs lo rgyus ring po zhig nang don du byas nas 'khrab tshe skabs skabs su dgod bro ba'i gtam bshad mkhan te/ de yang drang phyogs kyi mi sna dang / ldog phyogs kyi mi sna/ bar gnas kyi mi sna gsum ga byas chog kyang bod du lha mo 'khrab skabs ldog phyogs kyi mi snas byas pa mang zhing / skabs rer bar bcug le tshan du byas pa'ang yod/ zlos gar pa — 296 —

ni/ zlos gar gyi ram 'degs mi sna ste gtso bo'i mi sna gsum la ram 'degs byas te glu len pa dang / lo rgyus bshad pa/ chas g.yogs pa sogs byed mkhan rnams yin/rang re'i bod du zlos gar tsam po ba ni rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i yar sngon nas yod par nges te/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bal bza' dang rgya bza' btsun mor len skabs bod kyi rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas pas bsu ba dang / dga' ston gyi zlos gar rgya chen po byas pa gtsug lag khang dang po ta la'i ldebs ris su bris yod pa dang / de mtshungs rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs grub nas rab gnas kyi dga' ston nyin mang po'i bar du byas skabs bod 'bangs rnams kyis bro gar glu gzhas rigs mi 'dra ba dang / sgyu rtsal gyi rigs mi 'dra ba mang po bstan tshul bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi 'khor sa'i ldebs bris su bkod yod/bod du skad grags che ba'i zlos gar a ce lha mo zer ba ni/ bod kyi bka' brgyud chos lugs thog mtshan snyan che ba'i grub chen lcags zam pa'am mtshan thang stong rgyal por zhu ba khong gis/ bod sa gnas kyi 'grim 'grul stabs mi bde ba'i dka' ngal sel ched lcags zam khag bcu lhag gsar skrun gnang bar bzhed nas de'i rgyu cha lcags dang 'gro gron sogs sgrub pa'i ched du lho kha'i bu mo spun bdun la bka' bkod gnang ste/ bu mo gnyis kyis rngon pa dang / bu mo bzhis lha mo/ bu mo gcig gis rol mo dkrol mkhan/ grub thob rang nyid kyis rnga rdung mkhan mdzad nas lha mo'i tshogs pa dang po de btsugs/ de las byung ba'i dngos rdzas rnams kyis mthun rkyen byas te lcags zam lnga bcu nga brgyad btsugs par brten ming la a ce lha mo zhes pa'i zlos gar tshogs pa de byung zhing / de nas rim bzhin lha mo tshogs pa mang du 'phel nas dus rabs bco brgyad yas mas su slebs skabs bod du skad grags che ba'i lha mo — 297 —

tshogs pa skyor mo lung pa dang / rgyang mkhar pa/ shangs pa/ gcung pa/ 'bri gung pa bcas byung nas bod kyi zlos gar sngar las gong 'phel du btang zhing / bod kyi zlos gar de la yang sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos dang grub mtha' mi 'dra ba du ma chagasasde/ srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos pho brang po ta la'i pho brang dmar po bzhengs grub pa'i rab gnas kyi nyin lha mo tshogs pas nor bzang gi gzhung 'khrab ston byas tshul 〈〈gser gdung 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi dkar chag 〉〉nang bkod yod/ de'i rjes su rim bzhin 〈〈ras chung dbus phebs 〉〉dang / bod kyi zlos gar chen po brgyad du grags pa las 〈〈chos rgyal nor bzang 〉〉phud pa'i gzhan pa bdun po dang / 〈〈rgyal bu sprin gyi bzhon pa〉〉/ 〈〈rā ma ṇa〉〉/ 〈〈bzod pa'i dbang phyug〉〉/〈〈sbyin pa chen po 〉〉sogs byung /bod kyi zlos gar la gtam rgyud ji lta bu zhig 'khrab ston byed kyang /tsa 'don mi dang / tsa gzhung ’ / smyo bkra shis mi bcas go rim gsum tshang la ma nor bar byed/ 6 'don mi zhes pa ni zlos gar gyi sngon 'gro lta bur snang la rtsom yig cig 'bri na mgor mchod brjod 'jog pa dang 'dra zhing / de yang rngon pa'i 'dul dang / rgya lu'i byin 'bebs/ a lce lha mo gsum gyis grub bo/ /smyo gzhung zhes pa ni skabs bab gang 'khrab ston byed rgyu'i zlos gar gyi gtam rgyud dngos dang /smyo bkra shes mi ni mjug bsdu ba'i rim pa'o//gzhan yang khams kyi ral pa dang / chab mdo'i bro/ mnga' ris dang 'ba' thang gi sgor gzhas/ tshig rgyag 'bras dkar/ shel grong 'brong rtsed/'bag seng sogs mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i zlos gar dang de'i 'khrab gzhung yang mang po yod/yang snyan ngag gi gzhung las bshad pa'i zlos gar ni/ skad rigs mi 'dra ba bzhi'i sgo nas brtsams pa'i 'khrab gzhung dang / skad rigs bzhi'i sgo nas — 298 —

'khrab pa'i zlos gar lta bu ste/ rgyal po dang skyes pa'i cha lugs can gyis so: ta'i skad de legs sbyar gyi skad kyis gtam smra ba dang glu len pa dang / 'byung po gnod sbyin ro langs sogs mi ma yin gyi cha lugs can rnams kyis pi sha tsi'i skad de sha za'i skad kyis gtam smra ba dang / bran g.yog pho mo dang / bzhad gad mkhan la sogs pas gzhan la bsnyad 'dogs pa dang / 'gran zla byed pa sogs kyi skabs a ba st+waṃ sha ste zur chag gi skad dang / bud med kyi cha lugs can rnams kyis yul mi rang bzhin pa'i skad kyis gtam smra zhing lab dgos pa de dag gi bar du mtshams sbyor byed la/ sgo'i mtshams sbyor ni dri ba dang /lan gyi sgo'i mtshams sbyor ni dris lan te/ phan tshun dri ba dris lan gyi rnam pa zhig yod pa'i ming dang / snying po ni/ skabs 'gar blos dpyod pa lta bu'i tshig mang po phan tshun du smras pa'i mthar gros thag bcad pa'i tshul gyis gtan la phab pa la snying po zer/ mi bzod pa ni mtshang nas 'bru ba'i brjod pas de'i rang mtshang la sogs pa'i rnam pas mi bzod pa'am chags pas gzir nas mi bzod pa'i tshul byed pa'o/ /nges pa thob byed ni the tshom dang bcas pa'i brjod pa mang po'i mthar don gcig la nges pa rnyed pa ltar byed pa ste/ de rnams la mtshams sbyor yan lag lnga zhes bya'o/ /de dag thams cad kyi spel stangs glur tshigs su bcad pa dang / lhug pa/ spel ma'i rnam par bkod de rol mo dang bsdebs nas bsgyur pa ste/ smyo de yang lha dang / klu dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / gnod sbyin dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kyi gar dang skad rigs so so'i glu'i khyad par rnam pa bdun te/ ji skad du/ rtsed mo rlom par blang ba ni/ /lnga pa dang ni bar ma'i dbyangs/ /dpa' bo drag po ngo mtshar du/ /drug skyes khyu mchog de bzhin no/ /sa 'dzin pa dang 'khor nyan dbyangs/ /snying rje'i ro la blang bar bya/ /'thab mo 'jigs dang bcas pa la/ /blo gsal dbyangs ni blang bar bya//mi ①zhes pa ltar ro//— 299 —

bod du zlos gar gyi ltad mo'i rigs la skad rigs bzhi tshang ba de 'dra med kyang / skad rigs bzhi'i sgo nas brtsams pa'i 'khrab gzhung ni/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i 〈〈zlos gar gyi bstan bcos yang dag lam du bkra shis pa'i rol rtsed 〉〉ces pa zhig yod pa de'i nang rgya dang sog po/ rgya gar/ bod bcas kyi chos smra ba bzhis rang rang so so'i skad kyi sgo nas chos gtam gleng res byed pa'i rnam pa dang / gzhan yang zlos gar gyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs lta bur brtsams pa ni/ sa skya paca chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉〉dang de'i 'grel ba ngor mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub kyis mdzad pa zhig kyang yod la/ bstan 'gyur du slob dpon tsand+ra go mis mdzad pa'i 〈〈'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar 〉〉dang / slob dpon dga' ba'i lhas mdzad pa'i 〈〈klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar 〉〉gnyis bod skad du bsgyur ba yang yod do//gong du smos pa ni gna' bo'i bod kyi zlos gar 'phel rgyas byung ba'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus shig yin zhing / tang gi krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs pa'i rjes su/ bod kyi rtsom rig phyogs yongs nas dbyar mtsho rgyas pa bzhin 'phel rgyas byung ba dang mnyam du bod kyi zlos gar la'ang gson shugs rgyas te/ glu gar dang / gtam brjod zlos gar/ brnyan 'phrin zlos gar/ glog brnyan/ 'bras dkar/ mgyogs gtam/ dgod bro'i gtam gleng /kha shags sogs byung ba dang 'phel rgyas kyang rgya chen po byung ngo //sa bcad gnyis pa/ glu gar la g.yur du za ba'i grub 'bras blangs pa/〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉las/lha sngon byung gtam las gyur pa'am//cig shos legs pa la brten pa/ /mi ②zhes pa ltar/ deng rabs bod kyi glu gar gyis grub — 300 —

'bras g.yur du za ba blangs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gcig nas lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung dang / gtam rgyud/ sgrung rgyud sogs sngar byung ba'i brjod bya( gtam〉 ngo mtshar ba rnams legs sgrig dang bzo bcos sogs snyigs dor bcud len byas pa dang / gnyis nas spyi tshogs 'tsho ba ni dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'gyur ldog 'byung bzhin yod pa dang mi rnams kyi mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba yang dus rabs kyi 'gyur ldog dang bstun nas 'gyur bzhin yod pas/ brjod bya gsar pa dang rnam pa gsar pa'i sgo nas mi rnams kyi mdzes dpyod kyi re 'dun skong bas red/ de yang sngar byung ba'i gtam rgyud dang zlos gar la bzo bcos dang legs sgrig byed dgos don ci yin zhe na/ tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ sngon byung gi gtam rgyud dang srol rgyun zlos gar las lha sgrung dang ngag rgyun gyi nang don yod pa dang / de dag gis bod mi rigs kyi re smon legs po dang 'thab 'dzing gi snying stobs mtshon la/ dbang sgyur gral rim gyi gdug rtsub dang ham sems la sun 'byin yang byas yod/ de ni srol rgyun rtsom rig gi nying bcud dang mi dmangs rang bzhin yin pa ma zad/ srol rgyun gyi zlos gar dang gtam rgyud de dag da lta'i bar du ma nyams par gnas shing rgya che ba'i mang tshogs kyis dga' bsu thob pa'i rgyu rkyen yang red/ yin na yang / srol rgyun gyi zlos gar dang sgrung rgyud rnams ni gang ltar yang bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs su byung ba dang / ngang ngam shugs kyis dus skabs de'i mi rnams kyi sgyu rtsal lta ba dang rol myong gi goms gshis thim yod la/ tha na dbang sgyur gral rim gyis bed spyod byas pa'am dkyogs bshad kyang byas yod pas deng gi bsam pa'i dpal yon gyi 'dzugs sgrun la zhabs 'degs legs po zhig sgrub dka' bar 'dugasngar bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtse phyag las khungs sam rtse 'phral bde las khungs kyis ma gtogs lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung la bzo bcos gtan nas — 301 —

byed mi chog pa dang / nges par kho tshos zhib bsher gtan 'bebs byas pa ji bzhin 'khyab ston byed dgos par thag gcod byas yod/ de ni dus yun ring por bod kyi zlos gar gsar bzo byed mi nus pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo zhig red/de'i phyir/ bod kyi srol rgyun zlos gar bcos bsgyur byed pa'i 'gan 'khur de ni deng dus su ma gtogs sgrub thabs med la/ bod kyi zlos gar gyi bya ba /nyer mjin rnams kyi phrag la babs shing bshol thabs bral ba'i 'os 'gan ga lharsha zlorno/ bod kyi smos gar legs sgrig dang bcos sgyur byed rgyu ni gzab nan gyi bya ba zhig yin te/ bod kyi zlos gar gyi ma gzhi'i steng nas bcos sgyur byed dgos pa ma zad/ sngar yod kyi sgyu rtsal rnam pa dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos kyang sor gnas byed dgos/ rgyu mtshan ni rang gi srol rgyun rtsa ba nas dor te thams cad gzhan gyi lad mo byas na/ 6 yul dus sgyu rtsal 'jig rten lung rigs te drug po 'di'i rang rang gi gnas lugs dang 'gal mi duzhing / mang tshogs dang kha bral te rang mi rigs kyi khe phan dang mi 'tsham la/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi phun sum tshogs shing thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos kyang nyams par 'gyur/ de bas/ sku zhabs don grub rgyal gyis 6 mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i sngon chad kyis da lta'i tshab byed mi rung la/ ba tshwa'i dri dang 'grogs pa'i kha sang gis de ring gi skom pa ga la sod/ rnyed par dka' ba'i lo rgyus kyi bem po'i lus la/ dus dang mthun pa'i srog gi dbang po ma zhugs na/ yar rgyas kyi 'phar rtsa lding mi srid la/sngon thon kyi snying khrag rgyu mi thub cing /mdun skyod kyi gom pa ni de bas kyang ngo // mi②zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//bod kyi zlos gar la bcos sgyur byed na 6 mkhas brgya 'gran gleng dang me tog mnyam bzhad 〉 kyi kha phyogs kyi mdzub ston la brten nas/ bod mi rigs kyi sgyu rtsal srol rgyun la brtsi 'jog byed pa nan bshad bya dgos/ de ltar byed — 302 —

pa ni srol rgyun gyi yod tshad dang len bya dgos pas ma khyab la/ srol rgyun zlos gar gyi rnam grangs dang 'khrab ston rnam pa sogs la legs nyes kyi shan ma phye bar dar spel byed dgos pas kyang ma khyab/ kha cig gi sems la srol rgyun bod kyi zlos gar rnams yod tshad legs pas bsgyur bcos spu tsam yang byed mi rung la/ gal te bsgyur bcos byas na bod kyi zlos gar gyi cha tshang rang bzhin la gtor brlag byas pa red snyam/ lta ba 'di ni sgyu rtsal gyi 'phel rgyas la 'gal rkyen bzo ba'i lta ba zhig ste/ sgyu rtsal byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus la gzhigs na/ skad grags can gyi sgyu rtsal pa rnams ni sngar srol mkhregs 'dzin byed mkhan min par gsar gtod pa sha stag yin te/ khong rnam pa tshos 'khrab stangs dang dbyangs rta sogs phyogs sgo mo nas gang nus ci lcogs kyis gsar gtod byed bzhin mchis/ sgyu rtsal gyi rigs gang zhig yin rung dus yun ring por gnas dgos na/ 'phel rgyas kyi go rim zhig yod nges shing / sgyu rtsal zhig yin phyin 'phel rgyas ci yang med par sor gnas pa zhig yod mi srid/ 'phel rgyas med cing gong 'phel du mi gtong ba'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin phyin/ de yi sgyu rtsal tshe srog 'gag ste mthar thug chag med du 'gyur nges yin/ de'i phyir bod kyi zlos gar gyi bcos sgyur thad nas 'tshub sha langs te ma brtags ma dpyad par gtum spyod kyi thabs shes mi bkol ba dang / ci bya gtol med du gyur te re sgug gi rnam 'gyur yang 'dzin mi rung / bcos sgyur gyi thabs lam sna tshogs yod la mi mang po'i blo gros bsdur na'ang chog ste/ de dag gi lta ba la gcig gyur 'byung mi dgos na'ang / nges par rgyun 'khyongs byed dgos pa ni/ mthar thug mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis khas len zhing sgyu rtsal gyi 'od snang gsar pa 'phro nus pa zhig yin dgos/dga' 'os pa zhig la bod kyi zlos gar chen po brgyad du grags pa las 〈〈rgya bza' bal bza' 〉〉dang / 〈〈'gro ba bzang mo〉〉/ la〈〈gzugs kyi nyi ma〉〉/— 303 —

〈〈padma 'od 'bar〉〉/ 〈〈rgyal bu nor bzang〉〉/ 〈〈snang sa 'od 'bum〉〉sogs la legs sgrig deb gsar pa byung zhing / phyogs 'ga' nas bzo bcos byas te 'khrab ston byas rjes grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/srol rgyun bod kyi zlos gar legs sgrig byed pa la gsham gyi nyams myong 'di dag mchis te/ gcig nas nang don sngar bas 'du phul che zhing bstan bya sngar las mngon gsal yin/ gna' dus su bod kyi zlos gar ni nyin gcig gam du ma la 'khyab ston byed dgos shing / da lta de las ldog ste chu tshod gnyis gsum tsam la 'khrab ston byas pas chog ste/de yang gsal por bshad na/ sngar zlos gar gcig nyin gsum la lta dgos shing / deng sang nyin gcig gi nang du zlos gar gsum la bltas chog pas/ dus tshod gron zhing deng skabs kyi bya ba'i mgyogs tshad dang yang mthun/ 'khrab gzhung je thung du gtong don ni/ gtso bo bstan bya dang 'brel ba med pa'i byung rim dang 'khyab ston gnas yul dor ba yin sprang / de dang mnyam du mi sna gtso po'i gtam rgyud la shugs snon byas pa'ang gnyinā/ nas lha mo'i sgyu rtsal pa rgan gzhon rnams mnyam 'brel dang shes yon can gyis ram 'degs byed pa ste/ lha mo sgyu rtsal pa rgan gras rnams ni dus yun ring por lha mo'i 'khyab ston la zhugs myong zhing / rnam thar gyi mgrin gug gzhung bsrang rgyu sogs la sbyang goms byung yod pas/ khong tsho'i bsam 'char la brtsi 'jog byed dgos pa ni smos ma dgos/ lha mo pa gzhon gras rnams ni rgan pa dag gi slob ma yin zhing / lha mo'i 'khrab ston la zhugs myong ba dang lta ba gsar pa yang yod pas kho tsho'i bton pa'i re ba rnams shin tu legs/ des na bod kyi zlos gar gyi bya ba sgrub mkhan gyi shes yon can rnams kyi 'gan 'khri ni lha mo'i sgyu rtsal mkhas pas bton pa'i 'char gzhi dang bsam 'char gzhir bzung ste 'khrab gzhung legs po zhig sgrig rgyu de red/— 304 —

gsum nas bod kyi sa gnas so so'i khyad chos dang bstun nas/ mang tshogs kyi rol myong goms srol dang mthun pa'i byed thabs bkol ba/ bod mi rigs ni ljongs zhing lngar bkram zhing / yul skad kyi khyad par nges can zhig yod la/ de bzhin du sgyu rtsal rtsom gshis dang sgyu rtsal grub mtha' yang 'dra mtshungs shig min/ de bas/ bod kyi lha mo bcos sgrig byed pa la nges par rgyu rkyen khyad par ba de dag la yid 'jog byas na/ da gzod spyi tshogs kyi phan 'bras mi dman pa 'byung ste/ dper na/ bod ljongs lho kha'i chu gsum rdzong gi lha mo 'khrab ston ru khag gis 'khrab ston byas pa'i 〈〈gzugs kyi nyi ma〉〉ni lho kha'i yul skad la brten zhing / sa gnas de'i dmangs khrod kyi rgyu rtsal rnam pa bed spyod byas yod pa lta bu'o//bzhi nas bod kyi lha mo'i grub mtha' so so'i legs cha dar spel byas te/me tog mnyam bzhad kyi byed phyogs lag bstar byed pa/ dus yun ring por bod kyi lha mo 'phel rgyas byung ba'i brgyud rim las/ sa gnas so so'i lha mo 'khrab ston tshogs pa la rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos grub cing /'ga' zhig gis 'khyab ston byas pa'i zlos gar phul du byung ba ni sgyu rtsal gyi nying bcud yin pas/ dar rgyas gong spel bya ba las 'dor bya'i rigs min no//gzhis ka rtse'i ngam ring rdzong ni bod kyi lha mo'i shing rta'i srol 'byed thang stong rgyal po'i zug yul yin zhing / sa gnas de'i lha mo 'khrab ston tshogs pa ni gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i ljongs su snyan grags kyi dbyar rnga lhang lhang sgrog pa'i gcung pa'i zlos gar gyi 'thus tshab yin/ tshogs pa 'dis 'khrab ston byas pa'i 〈〈rgyal bu nor bzang 〉〉gis gcung pa'i sgyu rtsal khyad chos rgyun 'dzin byas shing / rnam thar gyi mgrin gug la brjid nyams che zhing yid la 'thad pa/'khrab ston byas pa la gna' nyams bab chags ldan no//srol rgyun zlos gar bcos sgyur byed pa dang mnyam du/ zlos gar gsar pa — 305 —

gsar rtsom byed pa yang dus rabs gsar pa'i nang bton pa'i 'os 'gan gsar pa zhig red/ bod mi rigs ni phyogs gcig nas srol rgyun gyi zlos gar chen po brgyad la dga' zhing dungs la/ ci ltar bltas kyang chog mi shes/ phyogs gcig nas zlos gar gsar pa nye bar mkho bas/ lo ngo bcu phrag 'ga'i ring la lo rgyus zlos gar gsar pa dang deng rabs bod kyi zlos gar mang po rabs dang rim par gsar rtsom byas shing / gna' bo'i srol rgyun zlos gar la rnam pa gsar pa bskrun te/ srol rgyun zlos gar gyi bla na ma mchis pa'i tshe srog gi nus pa mngon pa red/ bod mi rigs la mtshon na sngon byung ba'i gtam ngo mtshar can te/ ngag rgyun dang / skyes rabs/ rnam thar/ sgrung rgyud sogs glang chen gyi rgyab khal tsam zhig yod par ma zad/ da ltar byung dang 'byung bzhin pa'i rlabs chen gyi mi sna dang khyad du 'phags pa'i mdzad rjes kyang bgrang gis mi lang ba zhig yod/ de dag ni bod kyi glu gar sgrig rtsom byed pa la blangs na 'dzad mtha' med pa dang spyad na rdzogs mtha' med pa'i brjod gzhi'i 'byung khungs shig yin phyir/ 〈〈yid 'phrog lha mo 〉〉dang / 〈〈na bza' gong ma〉〉/〈〈btsan po'i pho nya〉〉/ 〈〈rgyal sras nor bzang 〉〉/ 〈〈gser gyi skya rengs〉〉/〈〈gzugs kyi nyi ma〉〉/ 〈〈jam brjid ldan pa'i rdo ring 〉〉bcas kyis kyang brjod gzhi de dag gdam gses byas te grus 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs pa red/ 'dir gtso bo bod rigs zlos gar mkhas pa dpal 'bum rgyal gyis bsgrigs shing rma lho zlos gar tshogs pas 'khrab ston byas pa'i 〈〈yid 'phrog lha mo 〉〉ngo sprod par bya'o//〈〈yid 'phrog lha mo 〉〉ni bod kyi lha mo 〈〈chos rgyal nor bzang 〉〉'phri snon byas te sgrig rtsom byas pa zhig red/ de'i byung rim mdor bsdus ni 'di lta ste/sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga rol tu dri za'i rgyal khams su ljon pa rta mgo zhes pa'i rgyal po zhig yod/ des rin chen do shal 'od 'bar ba de blangs — 306 —

pas/ sprin dang ri klung kun la ma thogs par byang phyogs mnga' ldan rgyal khab tu byung ba'i gnas tshul te/ sprin nag lang long du 'khrigs/ dmag mi skor zhig gis 'bangs mi bu mo rnams btsan gyis 'phrogs/ de dag gi gnyen nye rnams kyis smre sngags dang 'o dod 'bod pa sogs me long du gzugs shar ba ltar snang bar gyur/ der ljon pa rta mgo na re/ 6 bu mo lnga brgya sdug las grol ba dang / /ma rungs nyes can ma lus gtor ba'i ched/ /rin chen do shal khyer nas mar la byon/ /khyed dang nor bzang gnyis kyi bsam don 'grub/ /mnga' ldan bde la 'god pa'i dngos grub stsol/ / ②zhes gsungs te rang gi sha rus las mched pa'i bu mo yid 'phrog lha mo mi yul du mngags/ sa 'brug lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nyin la/ rgyal sras chos kyi rgyal po nor bzang gis lha sras yid 'phrog lha mo khab tu bzhes pas/ btsun mo dpal mo dang a mchod ha ri gnyis phrag dog gis ma bzod par bsam ngan yid la bcangs/ sbyor rtsub lam tu bstar te thabs brgya jus stong gis rgyal bu g.yul sar song shul du a mchod ha ris sngags kyi mthu la brten nas yab chen rgyal po nor chen gyi mtshan lam dkrigs pa dang / mo 'debs khul gyis rgyal po la rnam rtog sna tshogs bslangs te/ rgyal po'i rmi ltas ngan pa dang mnga' ldan rgyal khab la ltas mi legs pa sna tshogs byung ba'i rtsa ba ni yid 'phrog lha mo de nyid lha yis glud du brdzangs pa'i mi'am ci yin par smras pa dang / btsun mo dpal mos kyang rgyal po la dbyen sbyor sel 'jug byas par brten/ yid 'phrog lha mo 'dzin bzung byed rgyur rgyal po 'thad pa byung zhing / dpal mo dang ha ri gnyis kyis bdud dmag khrid de 'dzin bzung byed par brtsams pa na yid 'phrog lha mo rdza ri'i rtse la byon te dri za'i yul du 'phur/rgyal bu nor bzang gis bdud mo dug sbrul la sogs btul te rgyal kha'i ngang rang yul du log pa na/ rgyal po'i pho brang du rkyen ngan byung ste yid 'phrog — 307 —

lha mo sngon nas ljon pa'i yul du log pas/ khong sems sdug gis mnar bzhin yid 'phrog 'tshol du phyin zhing / lam bar du srin po 'jigs su rung ba zhig gis mche gtsigs sder bgrad du mchongs yong ba la/ nor bzang gis srin po dang yun ring la drag 'dzing byas te bsgral/ skabs der rang nyid kyang rmas phog ste dran med du brgyal bar gyur pa la drang srong blo gros rab gsal bya ba thon nas khrus chu gtor te nor bzang gi dran pa gsos pa dang / yid 'phrog lha mos bskur ba'i phyag gdub sprad de dri za'i yul phyogs bstan/ de nas dpag tshad brgya phrag du ma brgal ba'i mthar/ brag gseb cig nas dug sbrul zhig gis dug rlangs btang ba'i gseb nas mdzes ma zhig thon te nor bzang la brtse gdung che khul gyi rnam 'gyur mang du bstan kyang / nor bzang de la ma btud par 'gro bar brtsams pa na/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas dug sbrul mang po thon nas zhags pas bsdams/ nyen kha shin tu che ba'i skabs der nor bzang gi rum nas yid 'phrog ma'i phyag gdub sar lhung bas a sngon dbyings nas 'brug sgra ldir zhing glog 'od lam lam 'khyugs pas dug sbrul de rnams rang sar bros/ yang dpag tshad 'ga' 'das pa'i sar grog mo zhig brgal skabs/ g.yas g.yon gyi ri bo gnyis glo bur du kha 'phrad de 'gro lam bkag pa la/ nor bzang gis brag de shugs kyis gtad pas 'gro lam phyes/ de nas phar song ste chu bo zhig gi 'gram du ngal gso skabs/ mthong grol dang bcas pa'i lha mo gsum gyis dngul gyi bum pa phrag la bsnams te gsol chu len du phebs shing / nor bzang gis mthong grol lha mo ni yid 'phrog ma'i nu mo yin pa shes nas mthong grol gyi bum pa 'phrogs te lkog nas bum pa ru phyag gdub 'phangs/ yid 'phrog mas bum chus khrus byed skabs phyag gdub mthong bas nor bzang phebs pa rtogs shing / nor bzang gis kyang phan tshun gyi bar du dar dkar gyi yol ba zhig gis mthong lam sgrib pa de bcad nas yun ring kha — 308 —

bral ba'i bza' zla dang lhan 'dzoms byung / yin na yang ljon pa rta mgo can gyis rang gi sras mo nor bzang la ster ma 'dod pas thabs bkod sna tshogs 'then pa dang / dri za'i rtsal bo che rnams la rtsal rigs sna mang 'gran du bcug ste bkag 'gog byas na yang / nor bzang kun las rgyal zhing mjug mthar skyes lus rgyan cha sogs gcig 'dra yin pa'i dri za'i mdzes ma tshig stong lnga brgya lhag yod pa'i zhal ngor dar gos kyis btums nas ngos 'dzin du bcug pa la/ nor bzang gis yid 'phrog lha mo gang yin ma shes pas blo dang rig pa bkol nas/lha bdag gis dka' ngal khri phrag khyad bsad de//brtse ba'i grogs mchog 'tshol ched gnas 'dir slebs/ sngon pa'i rgyal pos bsam bzhin bar chad bzos/ /de ring yid 'phrog 'tshol ba dka' drags pas/ /mnga' ldan yul gyi rgyal srid skyong bar 'gro/ /yid 'phrog lha mo sku khams bde bar smon/ /’ ⑥zhes smras te phyin pa na yid 'phrog mas bden par rlom nas rjes bsnyegs byung ba la nor bzang glo bur du kha phyir 'khor nas bzung bas yid 'phrog ma mi ster ka med byung / de nas kho gnyis mnga' ldan rgyal khab tu phyir log pa dang / pho brang dga' ba'i bsam gling gi tshoms chen 'dod dgu 'khyil ba'i nang du mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri 'phang mthon po'i steng du chos kyi rgyal po nor bu bzang po srid khri la mnga' gsol ba dang /btsun mo dpal mo dang a mchod ha ri gnyis la rgyal khrims ltar khrims thag bcad cing / btsun mor bsdus pa'i bu mo lnga brgya bo yid 'phrog ma'i re ba ltar rang rang gi yul du 'gro ru bcug pa'o//glu gar 'di la 'khyab tshan gtso bo bdun dang phal ba gnyis te/ 'go ma tshugs pa'i 'khyab tshanawa mi yul du phebs pa/ 'khrab tshan dang powa lha'i sras mo khab tu bzhes pa/ 'khrab tshan gnyis pawa rgyal bu g.yul sar 'gro ba/'khyab tshan gsum pawa nag nyes che ba'i lkog g.yo/ 'khrab tshan bzhi pawa — 309 —

yid 'phrog mkha' la 'phur ba/ 'khyab tshan lnga pawa rgyal kha'i ngang phyir phebs pa/ 'khrab tshan drug pawa yid 'phrog 'tshol du phyin pa/ 'khrab tshan bdun ṅgilas /spya ḍi pas dang lhan 'dzoms byung ba/ mjug sdudawa lnga brgya sdug las bod kyi lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung brgyad du grags pa las/ sdings chen smyon pa tshe ring dbang 'dus kyi 〈〈chos rgyal nor bzang gi rnam thar 〉〉ni sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs 〈〈dpag bsam 'khri shing 〉〉gi yal 'dab drug cu re bzhi pa 〈〈nor bzang gi rtogs brjod 〉〉la gzhi byas te/ bod rang gi sems khams dang yul srol la mthun par sgrig rtsom byas pa zhig yin pa bzhin du/ 〈〈yid 'phrog lha mo 〉〉yang brjod bya 〈〈chos rgyal nor bzang gi rnam thar 〉〉la gzhi bcol/ bod kyi lha mo'i khyad chos dang rnam pa rgyun 'dzin dang / rgyal khab phyi nang gi glu gar gyi rtsom thabs la zur lta'am sdud len byas te/ da lta'i bod mi'i yul srol dang sems khams dang mthun par 'os 'tsham gyi bzo bcos byas pas/ srol rgyun zlos gar sgyu rtsal gyi lus po la zungs khrag gsar pa drangs pa dang rgyan gos gsar pas brgyan pa red ces brjod kyang rung ngo //〈〈chos rgyal nor bzang gi rnam thar 〉〉du/ byang phyogs mnga' ldan pa dang lho phyogs rigs ldan pa zhes rgyal khab gnyis yod pa la/ lho phyogs rigs ldan gyi rgyal po shag pa gzhon nu zhes pa khro gtum nga rgyal can/ las 'bras la rtsis bsher mi shes pa/ sngon rol bzang po'i ya rabs kyi ngang tshul rnams dor bas/rgyal khab der nang 'khrug dang mu shes lung pa gang zhing 'phro lus rnams dbul por gyur pa'i skabs/ rgyal po rang gis kyang thugs kyis ma bzod par/byang gi phyogs na 'khyil ba'i mtsho mo dang mtsho der gnas pa'i klu'i rgyal po grogs su 'gugs sems kyi log blo bcangs nas sngags pa zhig mnga' ldan padma bla mtsho'i khar mngags/ sngags 'chang des mtsho la gnod pa byed pa'i — 310 —

skabs/ nya pa spang leb 'dzin gyis gri gug gis bsnun te sngags pa bsgral/ klu'i rgyal pos rngon pa'i drin lan 'jal phyir rngon pa klu yul du gdan drangs te mi yi nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung bya ba phul/ de nas rngon pa drang srong chen po blo gros rab gsal gyi sku mdun du sdod skabs/ dri za'i rgyal po'i sras mo yid 'phrog mas gtso byas 'khor 'bum phrag dang bcas pa tshangs pa 'du ba'i khrus kyi rdzing bu ru sku khrus gsol du phebs pa mthong bas/ rngon pas klu yul nas nor bu don yod zhags pa khyer 'ongs nas yid 'phrog lha mo bzung / yid 'phrog lha mo rngon pa'i gtan grogs byed par ma 'thad pas drang srong gi dgongs pa ltar byang phyogs mnga' ldan gyi rgyal po nor bzang gyi btsun mor sbyal ba bri/ yod la/ phyis kyi don rkyen rnams 〈〈lid 'phrog lha mo 〉〉dang phal ra rshanā na/ /〈〈yid 'phrog lha mo 〉〉zhes pa'i glu gar 'di las/ mi'i rgyal po nor bzang dang lha'i sras mo yid 'phrog ma gnyis kyi 'gyur ba med cing lhad med rnam dag gi mdza' ba la bsngags brjod dang / phrag dog gi dug chus kun nas myos pa'i btsun mo dpal mo dang / bsam sbyor ngan pas gzhan la 'tshe ba'i a mchod ha ri gnyis kyi spyod ngan dang gdug rtsub la mtshang 'byin dang zur za byas shing / nor bzang gi brtse gdung gi ched du skyel srid kyi mnga' thang mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin dor te dka' ba brgya phrag khyad du gsod thub pa'i snying stobs dang / yid 'phrog lha mo'i nor bzang gi ched du dri za'i yul gyi bde skyid dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa la mi chags par mi yul du log pa'i brtse 'dang la bstod bsngags byas pa ste/ ji skad du/ smyo dge ba can sman gyi sdong po dang 'dra/ /gang bsten bsten pa kun rgyal nas gda'/ /sdig pa carsha hākā hā /kā ༵ /dri bye// /gang bsten bsten pa kun brlags nas gda'//— 311 —

de yang 'gyur med rnam dag gi brtse 'dang skor la/ 'khyab tshan dang po ru dri rmed dang 'khyab ston 'di ltar mchis te/yid 'phrog ma/ ( klu) sa gzhi yongs la dpyid kyi dpal yon bzhad//'jig rten 'di ni lha yul las kyang mchog/rgyal bu khyed dang 'u gnyis brtse gdung gis//'od 'bar nyi zla'i dpal yang 'phrog par nges//nor bzang / ( gru)mdzes pa'i dpal kun rdzogs pa'i yid 'phrog ma//'gro ba'i don du bdag gi grogs su gyur//khyod min gzhan la bdag gis blo mi rton//dgyes par rol cig nga yi snying gi nor//yid 'phrog ( glu〉khyed nyid mthong bas yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog/khyed nyid mthong ba tsam gyis dbang po rno//nor bzang / ( glu〉khyed nyid mthong bas zas la ro brgya ldan//khyed nyid mthong bas sdug bsngal ma lus zhi//mnyam len/ bdag gnyis 'bral med gtan du gnas par smon//yid 'phrog lhamos rang gi rin chen do shal blangs te brtse gdung zab mo'i ngang nas rgyal sras nor bzang la phul/snyan 'jibs rol mo 'khrol ba/yid 'phrog ma/ rin chen gtsug rgyan do shal 'di//yab rjes bdag la gnang ba yin//mkha' la bskyod pa'i gshog pa dang //rang lus skyob pa'i mtshon srung yin//'di ni nga yi snying dang 'dra//da lta khyed la phul ba yin/khyazhes phan tshun brtse bas 'grogs pa dang / phan tshun mdza' ba'i dam — 312 —

bca' brtan po snying la bkod par ma zad/ yid 'phrog mas rang gi yab kyis gnang zhing / rin thang gzhal du med pa'i rin chen do shal nor bzang la phul ba dang / 'khrab tshan gnyis pa tsa rgyal bu g.yul sar 'gro ba rilas kyang /yid 'phrog ma/ ( glu ) mtsho mo kha ru gser bya cha sgrig byed/ /cha bral gser bya skyo sems drag pos gzir/ /le bar khri yis bdag gnyis dbye mod kyang / /mdza' sems zab mos bdag gnyis 'byed thabs med//mdzub rgyan 'di ni nga yi sems rten yin//blo sems nam yang khyed dang 'bral thabs med//zhes mdzub rgyan nor bzang la phul/ nor bzang gis rang gi mgul dar yid 'phrog mar re ba'i blo gtad mtshon byed du gnang khya'akhrab tshan bzhi pa/ 64yid 'phrog mkha' la 'phur ba mi ru/ dpal mo dang a mchod ha ri gnyis kyis bdud dmag khrid de yid 'phrog ma'i snying tshil len du yong skabs/rgya gar lha mo/ (thugs sems skyo ba'i ngang)g.yang dkar khyu la sred ldan 'phar spyang rgyugs/ /ma rungs: bdud rigs cho 'phrul de ring mngon/ /nga ni mnga' ldan rgyal mo yin na yang / /da lta bdud rigs rgol la bya thabs bral/ /byams ldan yid 'phrog ma yum bdag la gson/ /rdzu 'phrul rang ldan rin chen do shal 'di/ /sras mchog nor bzang bdag la dam bcol la /da ni do shal thogs la myur du songs/ /

( zhes rgya gar lha mos 'tshab 'tshub kyis rin chen do shal blangs nas yid 'phrog ma la sprad pas/yid 'phrog ma sems 'gul thebs pa'i ngang)yid 'phyog ma/ yum gyi do shal bdag la gnang ba 'di//nam 'phang gcod pa'i gshog zung sprad pa 'dra//'di yis nor bzang rgyal bu'i brtse gdung mtshon//kye ma yum chen khyed nyid bka' drin che/khu'izhes pa las yid 'phrog mas nor bzang la phul ba'i rin chen do shal de/nor bzang gis g.yul sar ma 'khyer bar yid 'phrog mar 'phrod du bcug pas/ yid 'phrog ma srog nyen las thar thub pa dang / 'khrab tshan lnga pa ra rgyal kha'i ngang phyir log pa ri las nor chen/ khyed la sngon blangs mdzes ma dpal mo yod//da dung ci tsam dgos kyang blangs na chog/lha mo med kyang lha 'dra btsal kyang chog/ming la mdzes ldan lha mo btags kyang chog/nor bzang / yid 'phrog min pa'i lha yang dgos pa med//yid 'phrog med pa'i rgyal srid dgos pa med//yid 'phrog ma rnyed bar du bdag gis 'tshol//yid 'phrog ma rnyed gzhan du 'khyam rgyu yin/khrosanor bzang gis bdud dpung ma lus pha mthar bskrad cing / mtha' mtshams bde la bkod par ma zad/ rang gzhan kun la gnod 'tshe mi bya bar dam bca' ru bcug ste rgyal kha'i ngang phyir log pa na/ yab yum gtso mdzad pa'i blon 'bangs kun gyis bsu ba rgya chen po byas/ yin na yang / yid 'phrog ma mi bzhugs pa'i gnas tshul rtogs pas ci bya gtol med du gyur pa ste/ nor bzang la mtshon na rgyal srid kyi mnga' thang las gtan gyi grogs mo yid — 314 —

'phrog ma gtso ba bstan yod/dpal mo dang a mchod ha ri gnyis kyi phrag dog dang bsam sbyor ngan pa bcangs pa'i skor la/'khrab tshan dang po 6 lha'i sras mo khab tu bzhes pa ’ zhes pa ru/dpal mo/ nyin/ 'khyams mo yid 'phrog lha mo 'dir slebs pa nas bzung pho brang yongs kyi rje mor gyur/( glu〉 yid 'phrog yid 'phrog nor bzang yid dbang 'phrog /'khyams mo yid 'phrog rgyal mo'i go sar 'phar//nga khyung chen bya mor gyur pa yid re skyo//thabs bkod 'then nas yid 'phrog dong la 'phen//(ha ri yar 'ongs te don 'grub dpal mo'i bya spyod rnams mthong bas kho'i blo khog la shong ba'i nyams kyis)ha ri/ red ya/ rta ma brgyugs sngon la lcags 'phyar dgos/ dgra ma 'thab sngon la blo btsal dgos/dpal mo/ a mchod lags/ dus de ring gi snang tshul tshang ma khyed kyis dngos su mthong ba ltar/ gdon 'dre yid 'phrog lha mo de slebs ma thag tu btsun mor bzhes te/ nga don 'grub dpal mo rgyab tu bskyur pas/ ngas phyin chad nyi ma ji ltar gtong ngam/ha ri/ don 'grub dpal mo/ ma 'ongs pa'i rgyal mo/ rgyal bu nor bzang mi 'gyangs par khri la 'god nges yin la/ 'khyams mo yid 'phrog ma'i mtshan snyan bsdad kyin je cher 'gro nges yin/ gus par 'os pa'i rgyal mo lags/ khyod skyid pa'i nyi ma je thung red ya/dpal mo/ 'o/ de ltar bshad na/ khyod kyi mthu stobs de gnam la 'phur ram sa la 'dzul/ khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis yid 'phrog ma dong la 'phen pa'i nyin — 315 —

ṭwāṃ der/ nged gnyis skyid kyi rta pho mnyam zhon byed/ zhim po'i kha zas mnyam za da/ha ri/ de los yin/da de los yin/ma 'ongs pa'i rgyal mo lags/(glu〉thabs dang rdzu 'phrul man ngag nga la 'dzoms//da lta'i dus su mi bkol nam zhig bkol//nga yis bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis gtong //nyin srib gnyis kyi bar nas rta zhig rgyug/(rta'i mig sgra 'tshub/ dmag mi 'ga' 'tshab 'tshub kyi ngang nas yar pho brang la brdidīsna mi ga nyen brda/ bdud dpung rang re'i mtha' mtshams la slebs byung /dmag mi kha/ nyen brda/ bdud dpung rang re'i mnga' khongs la btsan 'dzul byed du slebs song /dmag mi ga nyen brda/ bdud tshogs kyis gsod bcom 'phrog gsum byed kyin gda'/ha ri/ (khong dgod shor te)nyin nyin/ mtha' mtshams dmag 'khrug zang zing langs pa 'di/go skabs bzang po gnam nas lhung ba 'dra/dpal mo/ (ha ma go bar)a mchod lags/(ha rishā dpal mo'i rna rtsar gtam shab shub cig bshad pas)dazlokta ri /daspya //la mo gnyis g.yo sgyu'i ngang nas gad mo shor )lizhes ha ri dang dpal mo gnyis 'phar spyang ngan 'brel dang lkog g.yo ngan jus kyis rgyal bu g.yul sar brdzangs pa'i rjes su yid 'phrog ma med par bya rgyu'i bsam ngan bcangs pa dang / 'khrab tshan gsum pa 66nag nyes che — 316 —

ba'i lkog g.yo sa las/ a mchod ha ris ngan sngags la brten nas thog mar yab rgyal po'i mtshan lam dkrigs pa dang / de nas gom pa rim bgrod kyi tshul gyis rmi lam la log 'grel byas te rnam rtog bslangs pa dang / de nas mo 'debs pa dang mo tshig la 'grel rgyag pa sogs thabs brgya jus stong gis yid 'phrog ma 'dzin bzung byed pa la bka' 'bebs su bcug mod/ 'on kyang yid 'phrog lha mo dri za'i yul du 'phur bas/ mjug mthar rgyal bu nor bzang g.yul sa nas phyir log ste ha ri dang dpal mo gnyis la khrims thag nan mo bcad pa red/zlos gar 'di'i nang gi ldog phyogs kyi mi sna ni ha ri dang dpal mo gnyis yin pa gong du smos zin la/ drang phyogs kyi mi sna ni yid 'phrog lha mo dang nor bzang / rgya gar lha mo/ tshe ring dbang mo rnams red/de yang yid 'phrog lha mo ni lta bas chog mi shes pa dang / mdza' ba la 'gyur ba med pa/ khog na g.yo sgyu dang gya gyu med pa/ blo rig pa gsal zhing lag las kur mkhas pa/ byams snying rje che zhing khog rgya yangs pa zhig yin pa ni btsun mo gzhan rnams la tshem bu 'drub tshul khrid pa dang / nor bzang la re ba zhus te btsun mo lnga brgya bo rang rang gi 'dod mos ltar phyir pha yul la log tu bcug pas mtshon zhing / nor bzang bis kyang / 66sgeg nyams ldan pa'i mdzes ma 'di ru med/ /zhen kha log pa'i gzugs can mdun na gnas/ /thugs yid brtse ba'i 'ja' tshon dgung du yal/ /brdzus spras wa mo mdun du mchongs nas yong / / zhes yid 'phrog ma dang dpal mo gnyis bsdur ba las kyang rtogs nus/ nor bzang ni dpa' zhing rtul phod pa dang / rang tshugs yod pa/ snying rus che zhing bzod bsran che ba/ las 'bras la rtsis bsher shes pa/brtse gdung gi ched du rgyal srid kyang 'dor thub pa/ blo rig pa rgod cing thabs la mkhas pa bcas yin pa ni zlos gar gyi mgo mjug bar gsum kun nas — 317 —

rtogs thub pa red/rtsom stangs kyi cha nas/ zlos gar gyi mi sna dang gnas yul/ dus tshod gsum 'du phul che dgos pa'i blang bya dang mthun par byas shing / 〈〈nor bzang gi rnam thar 〉〉las byung ba'i don rkyen te/ rngon pas yid 'phrog lha mo 'dzin bzung byas te nor bzang la phul ba'i byung rim rnams ma bris par/thad kur dri za'i rgyal pos yid 'phrog lha mo mi yul du mngags yong ba ltar bris pa dang / mi sna je zhung du btang ba dang / byung rim la 'phri snon 'os 'tsham byas par ma zad/ 〈〈nor bzang gi rnam thar 〉〉du btsun mo lnga brgya bo ldog phyogs kyi mi sna ltar bris yod na'ang / de ltar bris pa'i dge mtshan yang lta ba po la bden snang ster ba'i ched de/ gna' mi'i gtam dpe la lha gcig la ma 'grig na gzhan skyon dang / kun la ma 'grig na rang skyon/mi zhes pa ltar gzhung drang gshis bzang gi yid 'phrog ma la thams cad dgra ru langs don ga la yod/ mi sna'i skad cha rnams la rang gshis yod pa dang / phal skad kyi rang bzhin ldan pa/ bya byed nyams 'gyur gyi khyad chos yod pa/ rtsom rig gi rang bzhin dang shugs bstan gyi khyad chos kyang yod par ma zad/ mo tshig dang ka rtsom bris pa la yang nyams 'gyur gyis phyug cing / 'gal 'thab dza drag yin pa dang / byung rim la gya gyu 'gyur ldog ldan zhing / rmi lam dang 'char snang / rdzu 'phrul bcas yod pa'i 'char yan ring lugs kyi mtshon thabs spyad pa yang shin tu legs/gzhan yang bod kyi zlos gar mkhas pa rdo rje thar gyi 〈〈gzugs kyi nyi ma 〉〉dang / 〈〈na bza' gong ma〉〉/ 〈〈rgyal sras nor bzang 〉〉dang / rdo rje thar dang ku'o pheng gnyis kyi 〈〈btsan po'i pho nya〉〉/ dpal 'bum rgyal dang ku'o pheng gnyis kyi 〈〈gser gyi skya rengs 〉〉sogs kyang glu gar phul du byung ba yin mod/'dir re re bzhin ma spros so//— 318 —

sa bcad gsum pa/ bod kyi glu bro zlos gar chen mo la dga' 'os pa'i grub 'bras blangs pa/bod kyi glu bro zlos gar chen mo gleng dgos na/ zlos gar mkhas pa rgan 'phags pa skyabs ni mi brjod thabs med kyi mi sna gal chen zhig yin/khong ni spyi lo 1945lo'i zla drug par mtsho sngon zhing chen thung te rdzong 'ba' khug zhang tsher nag sde bar skyes pa dang / 1964lor bya bar zhugs/1967lor krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i sgyu rtsal sde khag nas mthar phyin pa dang / 1987lor nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i rgya'i skad yig sde khag nas slob mthar phyin/snga gzhug tu mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul glu gar tshogs pa'i 'khyab ston pa dang 'khrab khrid pa/ tshogs gtso/ mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul rig gnas cu'i cu krang / mtsho sngon zhing chen rig gnas thin sgyu rtsal khru'u yi khru'u krang gzhon pa/ mtsho sngon zhing chen mi rigs glu bro zlos gar gling gi gling gtso bcas kyi 'gan bzhes pa dang / krung go zhabs bro mkhan mthun tshogs skabs bzhi pa dang lnga pa'i las 'dzin pa/ mtsho sngon zhing chen rtsom rig sgyu rtsal las rigs mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs kyi u yon/ mtsho sngon zhing chen zhabs bro mkhan mthun tshogs skabs gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i kru'u zhi dang / rgyal khab rim pa'i rtsom sgrig 'khyab khrid pa chen mo yang yin no/ /da lta'i bar du khong gis dngos su 'khrab ston byas pa dang / rtsom sgrig dang 'khrab khrid byas pa'i brtsams chos che 'bring chung gsum bsdoms pas — 319 —

drug cu lhag yod/ khong nyid 'khrab mkhan gtso bo yin pa'i bod kyi bro gar 〈(rsā thang gi dgu tshugs 〉〉zhes pa la 1972lor mtsho sngon rig rtsal 'khyab ston steng phul byung 'khrab ston gyi bya dga' thob pa dang / khong gis bsgyur rtsom byas pa'i kha shāgs 〈〈du ba gcod pa 〉〉zhes pa ni mtsho sngon du dar ba'i kha shags kyi thog kṣiṃ nga rsha/sa 'khrab gzhung brtsams shing spyi khyab 'khrab khrid pa byas pa'i bod kyi glu bro zlos gar chen mo 〈〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed 〉〉la/ 1982lor mtsho sngon zhing chen rig rtsal mnyam 'dzoms 'khrab ston khrod phul byung zlos gar rnam grangs kyi bya dga' thob pa dang / rgyal khab btsugs nas lo 'khor so lnga lon pa'i mtsho sngon phul byung rig rtsal brtsams chos kyi bya dga' thob pa ma zad/ rgyal khab rig gnas pu'u dang / rgyal khab mi rigs las u/ spyi tshogs tshan rig gling / krung go dmangs khrod rtsom rig mthun tshogs bcas kyi mnyam 'brel bya dga' yang thob/〈〈spro ba'i bod pa 〉〉(zhabs bro )zhes par rgyal khab btsugs nas lo 'khor bzhi bcu lon pa'i mtsho sngon zhing chen phul byung rig rtsal brtsams chos kyi bya dga' dang / 〈〈yang sos kyi glu sgra 〉〉(zhabs bro 〉la rgyal khab btsugs nas lo 'khor zhe lnga lon pa'i mtsho sngon zhing chen phul byung rig rtsal brtsams chos kyi bya dga'/ 〈〈dpyid kyi kha btags ring mo 〉〉la skabs gsum pa'i (1988lo)rgyal yongs brnyan 'phrin rig rtsal 4 skar 'od bya dga' mi ang gnyis pa bcas thob/gzhan yang / khong gis 'khyab gzhung rtsom sgrig dang 'khrab khrid gcig lcogs kyi 'gan 'khur ba bod kyi glu bro zlos gar chen mo 〈〈bdud 'dud 〉〉dang / bod kyi zhabs bro glu gar 〈〈lha'i rigs kyi zhing bkod〉〉/ snyan tshig glu bro zlos gar 〈〈khri gshog rgyal mor phul ba'i glu dbyangs 〉〉sogs yod/— 320 —

nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la gsar rtsom byas pa'i bod kyi zhabs bro zlos gar chen mo 〈〈ge sar rgyal po 〉〉dang / glu bro zlos gar 〈〈gling ge sar bro ra chen mo〉〉/gdod ma'i skye khams dang mi rigs gyon chas kyi glu bro zlos gar chen mo 〈〈thang bod gna' lam 〉〉(bod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal dang / yul chos/ dpal 'byor/glu dbyangs/ gyon chas sogs phyogs yongs nas mtshon yod )bcas la thun mong spra yin pa'i mi rigs kyi khyan chos dang mtsho bod mtho sgang sa gnas kyi khyad /sdu ༷//lor gsar rtsom byas pa'i yul chos kyi tshan sgrig zhabs bro chen mo 〈〈a sngon yangs shing dog mo phyug 〉〉ces pa la/ thengs gnyis pa'i rgyal yongs kyi grangs nyung mi rigs rig rtsal lhan 'dzoms 'khyab ston steng brtsams chos la gser gyi rtags ma dang / 'khrab ston la dngul gyi rtags ma thob/ 'di'i khrod kyi 〈〈gangs ri'i rnam shes 〉〉dang / 〈〈mdzes pa'i nub mtsho〉〉/〈〈stong ri'i rmi lam〉〉/〈〈yul phyogs kyi nyams 'gyur〉〉/〈〈tsong kha'i khyad chos〉〉/〈〈mtho sgang gi 'bod sgra〉〉/ 〈〈dwangs gtsang rma 'bru rdza gsum 〉〉bcas rtsed tshan bdun la bya dga'i rnam grangs bcu phrag lhag thob/ 2003lor khong gis dbu 'dzin dang / rtsa 'dzugs/ bcos bsgrigs bcas byas pa'i glu bro chen mo 〈〈mtsho sngon du kha chad byas pa 〉〉zhes par skabs dang po'i krung go'i mtsho sngon mi rigs rig gnas yul skor dus chen gyi 'go tshugs mdzad sgo'i 'khyab ston steng bya dga' ang dang po dang / 2004lo'i mtsho sngon zhing chen phul byung brtsams chos kyi bya dga' thob/ ched 'khrab glu bro 〈〈khu nu'i zhabs bro 〉〉dang /bod kyi snyan tshig glu bro zlos gar 〈〈ge sar bro ra chen mo 〉〉gnyis la zhing chen yongs kyi rig rtsal skong 'khrab gsar rtsom gyi bya dga' ang gnyis pa thob klu bro zlos gar chen mo 〈〈thang bod gna' lam 〉〉la/ 2006lo'i zhing chen yongs kyi rig rtsal skong 'khyab bya dga' ang dang po thob/— 321 —

khong gis jus 'god dang rtsom sgrig 'khrab khrid byas pa'i mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul btsugs nas lo bzhi bcu 'khor ba'i dga' ston steng gi 'go tshugs mdzad sgo'i rig rtsal 'khrab ston dang / mtsho sngon zhing chen skabs dang po'i rma 'bru'i 'byung khungs kyi sgyu rtsal dus ston 〈〈gzab rgyas kyi mtsho sngon po'i mchod pa 〉〉ni rgya che zhing sngar med gsar gtod cig yin pas/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi yul skor pa dang lta mkhan mang po bkugs shing mtsho sngon gyi dril bsgrags la byas rjes bla na med pa bzhag mdor na/ rgan 'phags pa skyabs ni mtsho sngon gyi skad grags che ba'i sgyu rtsal 'khrab ston pa dang rtsom sgrig 'khrab khrid pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ bod rgya skad gnyis kyi 'khrab gzhung rtsom mkhan zhig kyang yin/de yang nga tshos gong gi don tshan gnyis par ngo sprod byas zin pa'i glu gar ni gtso bo 'khyab ston pa'i glu gzhas la brten nas mi sna gsar bzo byed pa dang / zlos gar gyi nang don 'khrab ston byed pa zhig yin zhing / don tshan 'dir ngo sprod bya rgyu'i glu bro zlos gar la kyag kyog ldan pa'i zlos gar gyi byung rim yod pa dang / snyan 'jebs yid 'ong gi glu gzhas yod pa ma zad/ lus kyi nyams 'gyur dang rkang lag gi stangs stabs phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod phyir/pasham du dbye zhib bya rgyu'i 〈〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed 〉〉ni phyi mar gtogs pa na/tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ 〈〈ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〉〉ni dus yun ring por bod khams yul gru kun tu dar khyab che la/ nang don rgya che zhing phun sum tshogs pa dang / mi sna mang zhing sgrig gzhi la rngam brjid ldan pa'i sgrung rabs chen mo zhig red/ de lta bu'i rngam brjid ldan pa'i sgrung rabs chen mo ni zlos gar sgyu rtsal gyis blangs na rdzogs mtha' med pa dang / spyad na 'dzad mtha' med pa'i 'byung khungs yin na yang / zlos gar du bcos bsgrigs byas na — 322 —

dka' khag shin tu mang por 'phrad srid de/ gcig nas sgrung dpe gang zhig zlos gar du btang na lta mkhan rnams kyi yid dbang 'phrog nus pa dang /gnyis nas zlos gar ni gar stegs steng nas 'khrab ston byed dgos pa dang /mi sna byung rim gnas yul rnams 'du phul che dgos pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos la dmigs na/ sgrung dpe rnams byung rim rnyog 'dzing che zhing mi sna'i grangs 'bor rgya che la/ gnas yul yang mang po zhig yod pas ji ltar gcig 'du byed dgos pa dang / gsum nas mi sna de dag gi ngag gi dbyangs rta dang / lus kyi gyon chas dang nyams 'gyur/ rkang lag gi stangs stabs dang rol mo sogs gang zhig la gzhi 'dzin rgyu dang ji ltar sngar med gsar gtod byed rgyu'i gnad don bcas shin tu mang /des na/ rgan 'phags pa skyabs lags kyis dka' ngal de dag sel ched/snga gzhug tu reb gong lcang skya dang/ bla brang bkra shis 'khyil/ dbus gtsang sa khul bcas kyi a lce lha mo dang / thung te gser lags dgon pa'i mi la ras pa'i 'cham dang thung te shar tshang gi dri med kun ldan/ brag dkar sprel rdzong gi sha ba mgon po rdo rje'i 'cham/ khri ka mdzo sna dang ske ba'i dmangs khrod kyi ge sar/ gzhan yang dgon pa gang mang gi 'cham gyi rigs sna tshogs la thengs mang por gzigs rtog la phyin pa dang / 'bag dang gyon chas kyi rigs rnams lha bzo mang por bcar 'dri byas/ khu ta'i 'khyab stangs gcig pu yang khri ka ske ba'i bun khrang thar ces pa'i drung du snga phyir thengs lnga la slob tu song / skabs de'i srid jus kyi dbang gis thengs rjes ma ma gtogs thengs sngon ma bzhi la dge rgan gyis ma khrid pa red/ der brten/ 1981lor 'khrab ston byas pa'i 〈〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed 〉〉ni/ lo ngo du mar gra sgrig gi bya ba phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs shing / bod kyi 'cham dang a lce lha mo/ dmangs khrod kyi ge sar sogs las nying bcud kyi cha sdud len byas pa dang / nad logs dang phyi gling — 323 —

gi glu bro zlos gar gyi sgyu rtsal thabs rtsal la zur lta byas par ma zad/ 〈〈ge sar sgrung 〉〉la zhib 'jug dang sgrung pa re 'ga' la bcar 'dri byas te/ bod kyi mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang sa gnas kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i glu bro zlos gar chen mo 〈〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed 〉〉ces pa dngos su 'khyab ston byas pa dang / de ma thag bod rigs mang tshogs kyis dang len dang dga' bsu thob/〈〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed 〉〉ces pa'i zlos gar 'di ni gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung 〈〈rta rgyug rgyal 'jog 〉〉dang 〈〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed 〉〉gnyis 'phri snon dang bzo bcos byas te rtsom sgrig byas shing khyon bsdoms 'khrab yol bdun dang 'khrab tshan lnga yod/sngon 'gro'i 6 rta rgyug rgyal 'jog mi las/ dung pa gnyis kyis phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad la dung brda btang ba na/ gling gi spyi dpon khra rgan gyis rgya dang sog po/ mon/ kha che la sogs pa'i phyogs yongs kyi mgron po rnams la/ 6 nga gling dkar lha sde'i rta rgyug rgyal 'jog da lta 'go rtsom rgyu yin/ ya/ sa gling dkar stod kyi bu rgod tsho/ bu rgod po su yin de ring blta/ rta 'do ba gang mgyogs de ring shes/ de ring gi rgyal gyi mgo ma ni/ sga skya lo tshang gi mdzod bdag yin/ sman 'brug chung lha mo'i gtan grogs yin/ sa gling dkar lha sde'i rgyal po yin mi zhes khrom du bsgrags pa na/ dwangs shing snyan pa'i rta mchog gi 'tsher skad dang mnyam du rta pho rkyang rgod g.yer ba dang jo ru gnyis skad cig glog dang 'dra bar rgyal kha blangs/ jo rus gser rmog gyon te khri la bzhugs/khra rgan gyis bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi lha dar dkar po 'dom gsum can zhig mthon por btegs te/ 8 a khu'i tsha bo lags/ de ring gi nyi ma bzang po/skar ma bzang po/ bkra shis don grub kyi nyi ma 'di nas bzung / khyed ni gling dkar lha sde'i rgyal po yin/ 'gro drug skyong ba'i pha ma yin/ khyed kyi mtshan la skyes bu bsam pa'i don grub dang / rgyal po'i mtshan la 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal — 324 —

por gsol ba yin :zhes bsgrags shing / 'brug mos gser sder du gser dkar bzhag khro thung rgyugs ma 'dur gyis thon pa dang mnyam du hor gyi than bya khwa ta'i than skad grags/ ge sar gyis mda' gzhu cha gcig blangs te khu ta grags pa'i phyogs su 'phangs pa dang / 66gong smad bar gsum gyi 'khor 'bangs dang phyogs yongs kyi mgron po'i tshogs kyis legs par nyon cig nga ge sar rgyal po byon pa nas/ bdud nag po'i mi khral bcad pa yin/ hor ser po'i zog khral yod pa min/ lho 'dzam bu gling na gling dkar mdzes/ rgyal 'bangs bde skyid phun sum tshogs zhes tha tshig bsgrags pa bris/'khyab tshan dang po 6 klu btsan 'dul ba'i dus la bab ces pa las/gling seng 'brug stag rtse pho brang gi ra ba'i nang du/ 'khel thags bu mo 'bum skyid kyis she'u gnyis 'khrid de thags rgyal ba bkra shis don grub bsgrigs nas dag gtsang byas rjes/ thags rogs ma rnams bos te skud pa bkal nas thags btags/ skabs der rlung nag 'tshub ma 'khor/ kha nag mun nag 'thibs/ sprin nag sbra nag tsam zhig gi nang du bdud nag po'i pho nya gnyis gling stag rong dpon po khro thung gis bsang brda btang ba ltar thon te/ sha ba gnyis bsad/ bu mo tsho g.yas bsgyel g.yon bsgyel byas/ 'khel thags bu mo 'bum skyid 'phrogs/ khra rgan gyis de mthong bas khong khro drag po langs/ khro thung gan rkyal du g.yugs/ brda rnga drag tu brdungs pas ge sar rgyal po phebs shing gling lha a ne gong sman rgyal mo sprin dkar las gzugs brnyan bstan te ge sar la lung bstan/ snang ngu dang rgya tsha gnyis kyis re re nas bdud 'dul bar 'gro ba khas len byas shing 'brug mos ge sar bdud du phebs par bshol btab na'ang / ge sar gyis rgya tsha zhal dkar rang gi rgyal tshab tu bskos nas bdud klu btsan 'dul bar lam la chas pa bris/'khyab tshan gnyis pa tsa than byas chag sgo gling la bskor mizhes pa ru/ khā — 325 —
