ta gling la phyin nas 'brug mo'i mdzub rgyan g.yu chung nam mkha' 'od chung khyer yong ste/ hor gu yangs gnam gyi rgyal po la gling dkar stod kyi gnas tshul dang / sga skya lo seng lcam 'brug mo'i gnas tshul rnams sba gsang med par zhus/shan pas gur dkar la hor dmag gling du drangs na mtha' ma hor ser po pham par 'gyur ba'i gnas lugs brjod na yang / gur dkar gyis khu ta'i phung dkrug dang gling ma gzhi dpon po khro thung gi gtam la nyan te/ hor dmag gling la 'dren rgyu'i bka' phab pa bris/'khyab tshan gsum pa 6 pho brang bsrung phyir dmar 'dzing byas zhes pa ru/ dgun grang ngar che ba'i skabs su/ gling seng 'brug stag rtse'i pho brang gi mkhar sgo ru/ rgya tsha dang 'brug mo/ khra rgan sogs kyis hor dmag phyir ldog pa'i thabs su tshar yag ma 'brug mor brdzus pa khro thung gis nang rul byas nas gur dkar la bshad pas/ gur dkar gyis hor ridamag mngags te yang bskyar gling gi pho brang du tshur rgol byas pa la gling dmag gis kho tsho dang dmar 'dzing byas/ snang ngu g.yu stag gis hor gyi pa dur zhig dang mdung 'gran byas pa la/ pa dur des snang ngu'i ngo ya ma lon par bros/ snang ngus ded pa na ring chung zhig gi rgyab nas gab sbas byas nas bsgugs yod pa'i hor gyi a lnga mtheb drug gis mda' 'phangs te snang ngu 'jig rten mi yul dang bral/ hor dmag rnams mkhar seng 'brug stag rtse'i nang du blugs/ seng lcam 'brug mo dang dar bza' gnyis hor dmag nas btsan gyis khrid/ rgya tsha gnas gzhan zhig nas rmas lci mo phog pa dang / 'brug mo hor gyis 'phrogs pa thos pas ra mdar yong ste gur dkar gsod par brtsams pa na/ shan pas ci yin 'di yin ma shes par thang nas mdung zhig blangs te sngon du bsrings pas/ tshur rgyug 'ongs pa'i rgya tsha'i pho bar phog shan pas rgya tsha la snying gtam zhus pas/rgya tshas rang gi mog steng gi ru dar cig blangs te shan par sprad cing / 'brug — 326 —

mor srung skyob bya ba dang / ge sar rgyal po myur du 'byon pa'i brda gtong dgos pa'i las bcol byas tshul bris/'khrab tshan bzhi pa lha mun rub btson nas ge sar dran mizhes pa ru/'brug mo ser po hor gyi btson khang du sdod skabs/ gur dkar dang khro thung gnyis kyis 'brug mo'i blo kha skor bar kha ta byas kyang ma phan/ der shan pa mngags pa la/ shan pas 'brug mo spun gnyis la rgya tsha bkrongs pa dang / gur dkar gyis hor gyi dar shing ring mo'i rtse la rgya tsha'i dbu btags tshul gyi gsang ba rnams bshad de rgya tsha'i ru dar 'brug mo la byin/ a ne gong sman rgyal mos sprin dkar gyi gseb na khrung khrung gnyis btang ba dang / 'brug mos rgya tsha'i ru dar ngos su khrag gi yi ge bris te ge sar la bskur ba bris/'khyab tshan lnga pa tsa blo dang thabs kyis dgra ya btul mizhes pa ru/ hor gyi gnam ni nag thib thib/ mkha' ru sprin nag lings se ling / hor gyi sa ni mun rub rub/ kha char bu yug 'tshubs se 'tshub/ hor gyi gur mo che'i nang du ngu sgra dang 'bod sgra/yar rgyug dang mar rgyug 'tshab 'tshub lang long du gyur pa ste/ gnam lcags thog dang 'dra bar bar snang nas babs pa'i ge sar gyi mda' mo zhig gis the'u rang bla lcags med par bzos/ gur dkar gyis rgyug thengs gnyis la mda' de 'bal grabs byas kyang mda' mo las 'od 'phros te nye bar btud ma nus/ khro thung gis 'brug mos 'bal nus pa shes te 'brug mo spyan 'dren du bcug pa dang / 'brug mos lha mda' gser stong ma de 'bal ba la gser skyems dgos par smras pas/ shan pas 'brug mo'i thabs bkod ltar gser skyems dkar yol gsum khyer yong ba'i gcig gi nang du dug nag gnam sa 'bar ba btab ste byin/ 'brug mos dug chang de gur dkar la drangs pa na/ khu tas shes te 'brug mo dang shan pa gnyis bzung nas thag nag gis bkyigs/ skabs der ge sar rgyal po rgya nag tshong pā zhig tu sprul ba dang /— 327 —

'dan ma ras pa rgan pa zhig tu sprul nas slebs shing hor pa rnams mgo rmongs par byas/ cang ma 'gor bar/ dga' bde chos skyang ber nag dang dpa' chung nya tsha a brtan/ dgra lha rtse rgyal sogs kyis gling dmag khrid nas thon/ khrung khrung gnyis kyis khu ta bsad/ ge sar gyis gur dkar bzung zhing shan pa rme ru rtse ser po hor gyi mnga' bdag la bskos pa bris/tsa mjug sdud pa'i gar :zhes pa ru/ gling seng 'brug stag rtse'i pho brang du/gling pho mo rgan gzhon rnams kyis lus la dus chen gyi rgyan gos spras te/ ge sar gyis rgyal kha blangs par dga' ston gyi zhabs bro 'khrab/ dgra lha rtse brgyad dang dmag mi gnyis kyis gur dkar dang bdud rgan klu btsan gyi mgo bo sprer sdong nas phyogs bzhi'i dgra bzhi 'dul ba'i ched du gsur la phud pa gis rnyinā/ na nga tshos 'di las shes thub pa ni/ 'khrab gzhung rtsom mkhan gyis 〈〈rta rgyug rgyal 'jog 〉〉dang 〈〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed 〉〉gnyis 'phri snon bzo bcos byas te brtsams pa yin mod/ 'on kyang bzo bcos ji 'dra brgyud kyang /ge sar rgyal po ni btsan po'i gnya' gnon gyi tho ba dang nyam chung mtha' skyong gi pha ma/ nag po bdud kyi kha gnon dang dkar po chos kyi rgyab rten/ mgon med kyi mgon skyabs dang kha 'thor la 'du ra sgrig mkhan yin pa'i brjod don gtso bo de ma dor zhing / bden dge mdzes gsum dang rdzun sdig dme gsum bar gyi 'thab rtsod ni 'khrab gzhung 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum du khyab yod/ der ma zad 'khrab gzhung 'di'i nang gi byung rim gyi skud sne yang sgrung dpe dang 'dra bar khro thung gi nang rul dang bdud kyi pho nyas me bza' 'bum skyid 'phrogs pa dang / hor gur dkar gyis ge sar bdud yul du song shul du 'brug mo 'phrogs pas/ mtha' mjug bdud dang hor gnyis cham la phab pa red/ de lta bu'i skud sne ni 〈〈rā ma ya ṇa 〉〉dang 〈〈gzhon nu zla med 〉〉— 328 —

las kyang srin pos sī ta 'phrogs pa dang / snang ba 'bum ldan gyi dmag gis yid 'ong ma 'phrogs pa la brten nas 'thab 'khrug bslangs pa sogs rgyal khab mi 'dra ba dang mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i rtsom rig brtsams chos las mthong thub/ de lta bu'i brjod don gtso bo dam du bzung nas/ sgrung dpe khrod kyi mi sna mang po je nyung du btang ba dang / byung rim dang gnas yul mang po gcig bsdus byas/ dper na/ rgya tsha zha lus mda' mo gcig gis the'u rang bla lcags thal bar btang ba de ge sar gyi mda' ru bsgyur ba dang / ge sar rgyal po snga gzhug tu bla ma gser zhu can dang / nya chen po/ 'jang gi mo ma/ 'dzom pa spun gsum/ rgya phrug thang rnyed bcas su sprul ba de rgya nag tshong pa zhig tu brdzus pas 'bus par byas pa dang / 'brug mos 'phrin pa lan gsum btang ba gcig gis 'thus par byas pa dang / mjug mthar gur dkar dang bdud rgan gnyis kyi mgo bo khyer yong ba sogs 'khyab gzhung rtsom pa pos thabs mkhas kyis 'phri snon dang bzo bcos byas pas/ sgrung dpe'i cha tshang rang bzhin la gtor brlag ma byas par dus tshod thung ngu zhig las ches dza drag gi byung rim rnams lta mkhan dag gi gzigs mor phul ba red/'khrab gzhung 'di las mi sna gtso bo dag gi khyad chos bzung ba yang shin tu legs te/ ge sar gyi lha yi rang bzhin dang mi yi rang bzhin gnyis kyi cha ldan pa'i dpa' bo'i gzugs brnyan dang / seng lcam 'brug mo'i mdzes sdug dang blo brtan 'gyur med kyi gzugs brnyan/ spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan gyi spyi sems las sgor sems med pa'i khyad chos/ 'dan ma'i thabs mkhas dang rgya tsha dang snang ngu'i dpa' ngar/ shan pa'i blo dkar dang blang dor la mkhas pa'i khyad chos/ khro thung gi g.yo sgyu dang snar ma'i ngang tshul/ gur dkar gyi rmongs rtul dang chags sred che ba'i khyad chos/ khu ta'i g.yo sgyu dang phung dkrug byed pa'i ngang tshul sogs drang phyogs kyi mi sna dang ldog phyogs kyi mi sna rnams bris — 329 —

pa gson nyams ldan zhing rang gshis kyi khyad chos mngon gsal dod/ gsham du dpe mtshon tsam bkod na/ge sar gyi skor la smyo sngon 'gro sa las/ sna rta pho rkyang rgod g.yer ba dang jo ru gnyis/ skad cig glog dang 'dra bar rgyal kha blangs mizhes pa dang / zu ge sar spro ba'i ngang / 6 gong smad bar gsum gyi 'khor 'bangs dang phyogs yongs kyi mgon po'i tshogs kyis legs par nyon cig nga ge sar rgyal po byon pa nas/ bdud nag po'i mi khral bcad pa yin/ hor ser po'i zog khral yod pa min/ lho 'dzam bu'i gling na gling dkar mdzes/ rgyal 'bangs bde skyid phun sum tshogs mi zhes pa dang / 'khrab tshan lnga pa/ 6 blo dang thabs kyis dgra ya btul mi zhes pa ru/ the'u rang mchod khri steng du babs pa'i ge sar gyi mda' mthong bas/ hor gyi rgyal blon tsho 'jigs shing rtab rtab por gyur te 'dzul sa'i khung ma rnyed pa sogs kyis ge sar rgyal po ni dpa' zhing rtul phod pa/snyan grags phyogs bzhir khyab pa/ dgra mgo rdung ba'i tho ba/ nyam chung skyong ba'i pha ma/ bod mgo nag mi yi mgon skyabs su gyur pa'i dpa' bo zhig yin pa bstana'/brug mo'i 'gyur med brtse gdung gi skor la/ 'khyab tshan lnga pa zu blo dang thabs kyis dgra ya btul mizhes pa ru/ 6 hor ser po'i btson du lo gcig 'gor/ /hor gur dkar 'phung 'dres thabs brgya bkol/ /nga 'brug mo'i yid sems bsgyur na bsam/ /bsgyur ma thub rang tshugs je brtan yin/ /mi zhes 'brug mos btson du blangs pa'i glu kho nas kyang mtshon nus/khro thung gi g.yo sgyu dang nang rul/ snar ma yin pa'i skor la/ sngon 'gro 6 rta rgyug rgyal 'jog mi las/ jo rus rgyal kha blangs pa la khro thung gis 6 a ho ho mi zhes ngu skad 'don bzhin brang brdungs/ rjes su myur du bzo lta bsgyur te gdong la ngu ma dgod kyi 'dzum zhig shar te skad 'dar ba'i ngang tsa rgyal po — 330 —

rin po che'i sku tshe zhabs pad brtan par shog zhes pa dang / 'khrab tshan dang po sna klu btsan 'dul ba'i dus la bab mi ces par/ 6 bdud nag po'i pho nya gnyis gling stag rong dpon po khro thung gis gsang brda btang ba ltar thon byung mizhes pa dang /khro thung / (skad 'dar bzhin )a khu'i tsha bo lags/bdud klu btsan la ngo ya byed mi rung / bdud klu btsan la ngo ya byas na/ chag 'jig chen po rjes nas kās ༵ / a khu khro thung / stag ma mthong gong la ngu rgyu zhig dgra ma 'phrad sngon la 'dar rgyu zhigade 'dra'i skrag don ci yod/khro thung /min/ ma red ma red/'dan ma/ a khu khro thung / mi mkhas pa yin min bshad na shes/ bu dpa' bo yin min 'thab na shes/khyed rang bdud la thengs gcig phebs na/khro thung / (skrag snang gis phyi nur yang yang byas te)min min ge sar byon na 'osakhu〉 ge sar byon na 'os/ zhes pa dang / 'khrab tshan gsum pa 6 pho brang bsrung phyir dmar 'dzing byas zhes pa ru/rgya tsha/ ma gzhi dpon po khro thung de/ hor shan pas 'phyi khung nas bzung /kho de nas hor ser sgar la khrid/dmag tshogs/ci byas/rgya tsha/ tshar yag ma 'brug mor brdzus te hor dmag phyir bzlog pa'i thabs bkod pa thams cad kho nang rul byas te gur dkar la bshad/dmag tshogs/ awa la thong de'i glo snying kha nas len rgyu de/snang ngu g.yu stag sa khu/ a ne lags/ nga song nas a khu khro thung (myur bar bsgyur te )phe kho khro thung wa thong de'i mgo ske bregs nas yong / ('gro grabs byas/rgya tshas bkagashe(3 — 331 —

zhes pa dang /6 mun rub btson nas ge sar dran zhes pa ru/gur dkar/ (had de yud tsam bsdad de/ khro thung bos te 'brug mo la kha brda gyis zhes lag brda brgyab )khro thung / (skad 'dar ba'i ngang )a/sgo ne 'brug mo/rnye lus thob pa lan gcig red/'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal myong don ci la yod/( glu ) hor gu yangs gnam gyi rgyal po khong //skyes pho sgo khong 'dra sa na med// rgyu 'byor ba hor 'dra gang na med//( brjod ) khong gi btsun mo byas na/ bzang lags/ khong gi btsun mo byas na/ bzang lags/ ri'adrug mo/ (zhe sdang drag tu langs te )( glu ) gdon gyi steng la 'dre rgan bsnan/ /'phar sbyang gnyis ka mnyam du 'brel//kṣiṃ nas mi bshad dgu bshad byas/(brjod ) zhabs 'dren khyod/pha7zhes pa sogs las khro thung ni g.yo sgyu che zhing khrel dang ngo tsha med pa/ ham sems che zhing sems gnag pa/ nang du 'ud shob che zhing phyi la snar ma'i ngang tshul ston pa/ gyod dang kha mchu gnyis kyi gzhi ma yin pa bstan pa dang / ge sar sgrung las med du mi rung ba'i mi sna zhig yin pas/ kha dpe la yang khro thung ma thung na ge sar ge mi sar zhes pa'i bshad srol mchis/gzhan yang shan pa'i drang bden dang blang dor la mkhas pa/ gur dkar gyi skabs rer snying khams che zhing skabs rer snar ma'i ngang tshul ston pa dang /chags sred che zhing rmongs rtul yin pa/ khwa tas rang bzhin rnams kyang 'khyab — 332 —

sazhung 'di las dngos shugs brgyud gsum gyis bris pa zhib cha che zhing gson nyams ldan/zlos gar 'di'i sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs kyi cha nas kyang gong du smos pa ltar glu bro zlos gar gyi khyad chos gzhir bzung zhing / mi sna'i nyams 'gyur dang /rkang lag gi stangs stabs/ ngag gi smra brjod/ rol dbyangs kyi snyan cha dang brjid nyams sogs phyogs gang thad nas snga na med pa'i nyams 'gyur gyis phyug cing khyad chos 'bur du thon yod/gzhan yang rgan 'phags pa skyabs kyi 〈〈bdud 'dul 〉〉dang 〈〈gling ge sar bro ra chen mo〉〉/ 〈〈thang bod gna' lam 〉〉dang / chab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring gis rtsom sgrig byas pa'i 〈〈'jang phrug 〉〉sogs kyang glu bro zlos gar chen mo yin zhing 'dir re re bzhin ngo sprod ma byas so/ /sa bcad bzhi pa/ gtam brjod zlos gar gyi myu gu la skyes stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba/bod kyi gtam brjod zlos gar gyi myu gu ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang 'bus shing / des bod kyi rtsom rig gi skyed tshal du rtsom lus kyi me tog gsar pa zhig bsnan/ bod kyi rtsom stegs dang gar stegs steng du rtsom lus gsar pa 'di byung ste cang ma 'gor bar/ rang nyid kyi sgyu rtsal 'gugs nus phyogs yongs nas bla lhag gis gsal ston byas pas/ de ma thag bod rigs mi dmangs kyis dang len dang dga' bsu bla na med pa thob/bod kyi gtam brjod zlos gar gyis rgyal khab phyi nang gi gtam brjod zlos gar gyi sgyu rtsal thabs rtsal sdud len dang / a lce lha mo'i mi rigs kyi khyad — 333 —

chos dam 'dzin byed pa'i srol bzang rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel byas par ma zad/ rjod byed tshig gi cha nas brjod pa gsal zhing dwangs pa/ mi dang bya ba'i gnas skabs la khel ba/ gson nyams can gyi ming brda 'dem zhing yul khams de'i skad la bstun ci thub byas pas/ skye bo mtha' dag mgu zhing tshim par byed la/ brjod bya don gyi thad nas kyang bod rigs mi dmangs la cha rgyus yod pa dang spro ba yod pa'i brjod bya ste/ gcig nas lo rgyus thog gi skad grags can gyi mi sna'i mdzad rjes mtshon pa dang / gnyis nas ngag rtsom grags can bcos bsgrigs byed pa dang / gsum nas da lta'i dus su byung ba'i mi don ngo ma brjod gzhi byas te snying po bsdus shing 'tsho ba dngos las 'phags par byed pa'o/ /zlos gar rtsom pa pos phyogs 'di dag la sems shugs yod rgu bton pas/ spyir bshad na gtam brjod zlos gar ni rtsom rig gi rnam pa gsar pa zhig yin yang / mang tshogs rnams kyis rang rtogs kyis dang len dang rtsis mthong byed cing / mgyogs myur ngang mdo dbus mtho sgang du gtam brjod zlos gar gyi myu gu la rtsa ba tshugs shing 'dab ma rgyas par gyur pa red/bod yig gi steng nas gtam brjod zlos gar gyi 'khrab gzhung bris te/thog mar grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs pa ni bod ljongs gtam brjod zlos gar tshogs pa'i rgan bsod nams tshe ring red/bsod nams tshe ring ni hrang he'i zlos gar slob gling nas mthar phyin cing / zlos gar gyi gzhung lugs la phyogs sgo mo nas slob gnyer byas myong la/'khrab gzhung 'bri ba'i shes bya sna tshogs la byang cha yod/ khong 'tsho gnas byed sa lha sa yin pas lha sa'i yul skad la byang cha yod pa dang / bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi yul srol dang rig gnas lo rgyus la cha rgyus che bar ma zad/ nam rgyun 'tsho bar zab zhugs dang rtog dpyod zhib 'jug byas pas gsar rtsom la rmang gzhi brtan po zhig bting / de'i mtshungs su khong gi bod yig gi chu tshad mtho zhing — 334 —

rtsom 'bri'i 'dun pa che ba dang / lo na gzhon zhing 'jon thang che ba bsam blo gtong mkhas shing sdug rus che ba bcas kyis brtsams chos mang po gcig rjes gnyis mthud du spel/ khong gis 'khrab tshan bdun can gyi gtam brjod zlos gar 〈〈a khu ston pa 〉〉sogs bris par ma zad/ 'bras dkar dang kha shags kyi brtsams chos kyang mi nyung ba zhig bris/〈〈gser 'jig dang dpal skyid 〉〉la thengs dang po'i rgyal yongs kyi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi gzengs bstod dpyad bsdur las zlos gar rtsom rig gi bya dga' thob pa dang / dngos su 'khrab ston byed skabs rgya che ba'i lta mkhan rnams kyis gdeng 'jog mthon po gnang / zlos gar 'di'i rgyu cha ni bod kyi dmangs khrod rtsom rig las blangs na yang / mi sna'i gsar bzo dang / byung rim gyi bkod sgrig skad cha'i bkol spyod bcas kyi thad nas gtam brjod zlos gar gyi khyad chos dang bod kyi 'tsho ba dngos gzhir bzung ste bzo bcos dang las snon byas yod/zlos gar 'di'i byung rim mdor bsdus ni/ gzhon nu gser 'jig dang bu mo dpal skyid gnyis chung chung lu gu 'tsho rogs dang yang chung me tog 'thu rogs yin zhing / 'jig rten gyi 'tsho ba dang chung ngu'i dus kyi mdza' mthun gyi srad bus kho gnyis kyi sems kyi rtsa ba gzhi gcig tu stel bar ma zad/ dungs pa'i 'dab ma lhan cig tu rgyas pa dang mthun pa'i me tog kyang chabs cig tu bzhad/ kho gnyis gnyen sgrig pa'i nyin la/ rgyal pos rang gi mnga' thang dbang cha la brten nas dpal skyid 'phrogs te rang gi sras kyi chung mar len par brtsams pa na/ gser 'jig gis ma bzod par kha spro kha nas langs/ zhe spro gting nas langs te rang gcig pu rgyal po'i pho brang du dpal skyid skyob tu song bas pho brang gi sgo nas bsad do/ /gser 'jig sbyin sreg byed skabs/dpal skyid me ru mchong zhing / du ba dkar po zhig 'phyur te byi'u chung gnyis — 335 —

su gyur pa dang smyo gser 'jig dang dpal skyid mi ces sgrog cing / rang dbang gis a sngon dbyings nas 'phur skyod byas/zlos gar 'di ni bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng gi ches thog ma'i skyo gar yin zhing / bod rig na gzhon gyi slad med kyi brtse gdung la phul ba'i bstod glu zhig yin pa ma zad/ gdug rtsub che ba'i dbang sgyur gral rim gyi nyes spyod la ngo rgol byed pa'i gtug bsher zhig kyang red/dpal skyid ni zlos gar 'di'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo yin zhing / kho mo'i khyad par can gyi skye khungs dang myong brgyud kyis zlos gar 'di'i 'gal 'thab gtso bo grub/ dpal skyid kyi skyed yum sgrol ma rghaṃ mdzes ni blon chen grags pa dbang phyug gi gzhis ku'i dud tshang zhig gi bu mo yin zhing / chung dus nas gzugs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa zhig yin stabs/ blon chen grags pa dbang phyus sha la sbrang bu 'khor ba ltar btsan dbang rjes 'ded btang bas mthar kho mo blon chen grags pa dbang phyug gi chung ma mi byed ka med byung / de nas lo shas song rjes sgrol ma lha mdzes la mngal chags shing zla ngo drug 'gor dus/blon chen grags pa dbang phyug gis yang mi tshang gzhan zhig gi bu mo mdzes ma zhig mthong nas khyim du bsus te gnyen sgrig byas shing / de rjes sgrol ma lha mdzes sgo'i phyir phud pa red/ skabs de dus grags pa dbang phyug gi gzhis ma'i phyugs rdzi a khu bsam 'grub kyis kho mor snying rje nas dus yun zla ba kha shas ring sbas nyar byas/ de nas skye zla shar zhing gzugs po gsos nas bde blag ngang lha skyid btsas mod/ 'on kyang lus po zhan pa'i rkyen gyis tshe ma zin par dus chos su gyur/ de nas a khu bsam 'grub kyis bu mo dpal skyid drin chen pos bskyangs shing / mi gzhan la lug 'tsho sa nas rnyed byung zhes bshad nas lo ngo bcu tsam la mnyam du 'tsho ba rol/ 'on kyang chu 'tshog pa'i snod yod na yang gtam 'tshog pa'i mi med zer ba ltar blon chen grags pa dbang — 336 —

phyug gis a khu bsam 'grub la phru gu zhig yod pa'i gnas tshul de ha go nas rtsad gcod byas stabs/ a khu bsam 'grub kyis rang la gnod 'tshe mi phog pa'i ched du ha cang blos mi thongs pa'i ngang lha 'bab skyid gzhong gi gser 'jig gi pha ma gnyis la bcol bas/ gser 'jig dang dpal skyid gnyis khyim gcig nas lag chags shing / rim gyis brtse gdung gi mdud rgyas bcings pa'i mdza' mthun gyi sems pa dkar po de gnyis skad cig tsam la'ang 'bral thabs med par gzhi gcig tu mthun song /zlos gar 'di las dgra gnyen dang / skyid sdug bzang ngan/ brtse gdung gi 'du 'bral sogs stabs bde'i ngang lhug brjod byas pa ma yin par/'di'i rin thang ni spyi tshogs kyi gnad don gal chen zhig gsed 'grol byed pa ste/ khe drag dang stobs 'byor 'dzoms pa rnams kyis dbul phongs dang nyam chung pa rnams la mnar gcod byed pa dang / nyam chung rnams kyis cher rlom rnams la ngo rgol byed pa mtshon/ bstan bya 'di mtshon pa'i ched du zlos gar 'di ru gser 'jig dang / dpal skyid/ a khu bsam 'grub sogs drang phyogs kyi mi sna'i rlabs che ba'i snang brnyan dang / bla na med pa'i gshis bzang / rang srog blos gtong phod pa'i snying stobs bcas 'bri bzhengs byas yod par ma zad/ grags pa dbang phyug sogs ldog phyogs kyi mi sna'i shes med dang bsam med/ khram pa dang rdzun ma'i bya spyod dang de dag gi ngo gnong 'os pa'i mjug 'bras ngan pa yang brko 'bri byas yod/gser 'jig dang dpal skyid gnyis kyis mi rnams la shan shugs gting sprab cig bzhag yod pa ni/ zhe gdug rtsub kyis blo sems bsgyur mi thub pa de da/ gser 'jug dang dpal skyid gnyis kyi brtse dung skor la 'khrab gzhung du 'di ltar bkod yod de/ — 337 —

dpal skyid/(gzhas btang ba )mtshar ba'i spang rgyan me tog /g.yu chung sbrang mar gtad yod/sems pa'i g.yu chung sbrang ma//de la 'bab pa los bsams//nga dang g.yu chung sbrang ma/ /sems pa'i mthun rtsa gcig rme//zhim pa'i sbrang rtsi'i ro bcud//mnyam spyod byung na dga' ba//gser 'jig (btang ba'i gzhas )spang gshong bde mo'i thog gi/spang rgyan ngo mtshar che ba//sems pa'i spang rgyan me tog /thugs sems lhod po gnang dang / /g.yu chung sbrang ma'i sems pa//spang rgyan khyed la gtad yod/ /zhim pa'i sbrang rtsi'i ro bcud/ /mnyam du spyod pa los bsams/ //ser 'jig dpal skyid/ ngas khyod la skad cha tshig kha shas shig bshad da sa/ sdu/ kā/da/ (rang gi snying kha gnon bzhin du shes jo khyed rang gsungs dang /— 338 —

gser 'jig (blo stobs cher bskyed kyis )dpal skyid/ ngas bsam blo thengs mang btang tshar/ phyis 'byung mi tshe 'di'i ring la nga dang mnyam du 'tsho trī skyes rgyu sbyong na ngas sdug mnyam myong dang skyid mnyam skyel mtha' gcig tu da rti/pa lad skyi/ da/ sdug mnyam myong /skyid mnyam skyel/gser 'jig de ga red/ phyis 'byung nged gnyis skyid la kha'i rtswa la mnyam bza' dang /sdug sngon mo'i chu la mnyam 'thung byas na bsams/⑫gcig sems gcig la shor ba'i mdza' grogs zung gis/ gzhas tshig la brten nas phan tshun gyi mdza' sems dang re smon bstan pa ma zad/ sdug mnyam myong dang skyid mnyam skyel gyi dam bca' brtan po yang snying la bkod/de lta bu'i lhad med kyi bsam blo gtong phyogs dang blo brtan 'gyur med kyi chod sems kyis/ gzhug phyogs nas gdug rtsub can gyi rgyal blon la 'thab 'dzing dbyis phyin pa byed rgyu'i brjod don la rmang gzhi bting ba red/rgyu 'byor bas yid sems mi g.yo ba'i thad la/ 'khrab tshan dang po dang bzhi par dpal skyid kyis blon po dang rgyal po gnyis la lan smras pa'i skad cha tshan pa gnyis las rtogs thub ste/ skad cha des kho mo'i 'jig rten lta tshul dang sbya tshe'i lta tshul shes nus par ma zad/ yang dag pa'i bsam tshul yang shes thub blon chen/ mdzes ma khyed rang nga tsho'i ri rab rgyal po'i gser dngul pho brang nang gdan zhu byas na dgongs 'char e yod/ rgyun du gsol chas cog tse bco brgyad/ na bza' gos chen sna lnga/ dbu la rin chen gser dngul/ 'khor la g.yog 'bangs brgya phrag de lta bu'i bsod nams yod pa'i mdzes ma ni gnam 'og na ha cang dkon po red da/dpal skyid/ gyin/(kha gcus )yi — 339 —

lan 'di la spyir yig 'bru gcig ma gtogs med na yang / des btsun mo'i thob go sa dang mnga' thang longs spyod snang med du bskyur pa mtshon par ma zad/ bod rigs bud med nas dbang sgyur pa'i dbang cha la dpa' ngar che ba'i sgo nas ngo rgol byas pa yang mtshon/rgyal pos/ yid 'ong mdzes ma dpal skyid lags/ ngos kyi skad cha ma g.yeng snyan gyis legs par gson/ ngos de ring thag ring gi yul 'bum ldan rgyal gzhis nas lha 'bab skyid gzhong gi phyogs la ngos kyi rgyal sras kun dga' zla chen la btsun mo 'dem du yong ba yin/ da lam khyed ni ngos kyi blo la shin tu babs song bas khyed kyis 'di lta'i 'dod don sgrub par mdzod cigadapal skyid/ (hon thor nas )lags/ mi dbang rgyal po/ gnyom chung dbul phongs kyi bu mo nga ni yul lha 'bab skyid gzhong 'di'i yul chu 'thungs nas 'tsho ba skyel 'dod pa las mi dbang rgyal po'i pho brang nang du phyin bsam ༵ ni rtsa ba nas med/ nga gser bya ngang pa chags sa chu dang brten sa chu las da go spri gi dri ched dag las dpal skyid kyi bza' zla'i lta ba dang bde skyid kyi lta ba rtogs nus te/ yul lha 'bab skyid gzhong gi ri chu la dga' ba dang brtse bas 'grogs pa'i gtan grogs la dungs pa las gzhan/ rgyal po'i pho brang gi mnga' thang longs spyod la lta rin med pa dang / btsun mo'i thob go sa la gces rin med par bsams/ spyir skad cha thung ngu zhig ma gtogs med na yang / des ma bsams sa nas nga rgyal gyis rgyud sbos/ snang ba 'ur langs pa'i rgyal po de nyid yid phya dung nge ba dang / sems skyo chad de ba zhig tu btang zhing /yid gnyis blo bral du gyur pa red/zhe gdug rtsub kyis blo sems bsgyur mi thub pa'i thad la/ zlos gar 'di las rno ngar che zhing spobs pa ldan pa'i skad cha dang / rnag thog khab gtsag gi — 340 —

sgyug rtse la brten nas/ kun gyi snying nad sangs par byed pa'i 'phyor 'bri skor zhig bkod yod de/ dper na/ grags pa dbang phyug gis dpa' dang dpung la brten nas dpal skyid 'phrog par brtsams pa na/ gser 'jig gis ni ya nga dang bag tsha spu tsam yang med par ngo ya byas pa ste/gser 'jig (khros te ) hin/ nga 'di gar gson por bsdad pa'i rjes la khyed tshos kho mo la lag pa rgyag rtsis ma byed/blon chen/ 'o/ rang gi kha gtam de so so'i lus po las che ba 'dug gi'o na/ ngas khyod rang gson por gang 'dra bsdad song bltas chog(zer nas 'khor g.yog gzhan gnyis la lag brda zhig btang ba dang /de gnyis dpal skyid kyi rtsar yong nas kho mo 'dzin par byas/ gser 'jig ni khong khro'i me lce 'bar bzhin par kho mo skyob par phyin pas gri thogs pa'i 'khor g.yog gnyis kyis bkag stabs kho tsho dang 'dzing mo byas/ gser 'jig ni gri rtsed la mkhas stabs g.yog gnyis kyis glags 'khel thabs med pa de blon chen gyis mthong nas khos rang nyid kyi ral gri phyar te mdun du 'thab kyang pham par gyur/)rgya zlogā tshekā/ (dpal skyid la 'jus yod pa'i g.yog gnyis la )shogam gang 'khoX wakhrig de gnyis kyis dpal skyid glod nas gri phyar te mnyam rub rgyag par yong / gser 'jig ni de bas dpa' ngar ldan pa'i stag phrug cig dnga'adra bar kho tsho mi lnga bo de re re nas pham nyes su btang ba dang / gri g.yug thengs gcig la gri'i rtse mo de blon chen gyi mig g.yas par phog)blon chen/ a tsha/ nga'i nga'imig mig(sdug skad chen po rgyag bzhin du ral gri yang lag nas shor te mig g.yas par spar mo bkab nas bsdad/ skabs de dang bstun nas gser 'jig — 341 —

gis dpal skyid rang gi rtsar 'then/)azlos gar 'dir bltas te mtshams 'dir slebs tshe/ mi rnams kyis gdug rtsub la bag mi tsha ba'i gser 'jig gi dpa' ngar la bstod bsngags byed par ma zad/ da dung kho rang brtse bas 'grogs pa'i gtan grogs srung ba'i phyir du dgra mi sha bo las rgyal ba la thal mo mi deb rang dbang med/a khu bsam 'grub kyang zlos gar 'di'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo zhig red/khong ni blon chen grags pa dbang phyag gi phyugs rdzi rkyen pa dang / dgra gnyen dang chags sdang gi dbye ba gsal zhing / grogs mched dang spun zla la rogs skyob byed pa khur du khyer yod par ma zad/ gso dpyad la mkhas shing / shes rgya dang pher yod/ spyang grung 'dzoms pa sha stag yin pas/ gnad 'gag la thug tshe thabs mkhas kyis 'thab rtsod dang / mthun pa'i grogs dang gnyen nye du la stobs shugs dang thar lam byin pa dang / sdang dgra bo la mtshang 'byin dang rdung rdeg byas pa sogs rgan rabs pa zhig gi shes rgya dang pher yod/ khog yangs dkyel che'i mi gshis bzang po de mngon yod/a khu bsam 'grub kyis grogs spun zla dang gnyen nye du la ji ltar brtse bas 'grogs pa dang gces par bskyangs pa red ce na/ zlos gar 'di las sems 'gul thebs pa'i dpe mtshon gyi don rkyen 'ga' bris yod de/ gal te a khu bsam 'grub kyis dpal skyid kyi skyed yum la srung skyob ma byas na dpal skyid skyes med pa dang / gal te dpal skyid brtse bas ma bskyangs na gog po 'gog tsam nas lo bcu'i khar 'bud mi nus pa dang / gal te a khu bsam 'grub kyis lo bcu lon pa'i bu mo dpal skyid lha 'bab skyid gzhong grong du ma bskyal na grags pa dbang phyug gis lkog nas gnod 'tshe byas zin zhing dpal skyid dang gser 'jig gnyis kyang mnyam du bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol mi nus/grags pa dbang phyug gis rgyal po la dpal skyid 'phrog dgos pa'i g.yo thabs — 342 —

'then skabs/ a khu bsam 'grub kyis rang nyid kyi tshe srog la mi bsams par grags pa dbang phyug la mda' 'phangs te mnyam 'jog bya dgos pa'i tha tshig bsgrags pa dang / gser 'jig gis dpal skyid skyob phyir rgyal po'i pho brang du hol rgyugs byed skabs/ a khu bsam 'grub dngangs skrag gis/ 46gser 'jigabu rang mgyogs por par log chu chen gyi zheng la ma bltas na/ pho gsar gyi rkyal de smyo rkyal red/ bu rang a khu'i ngag la nyon la phyir song zhes dang /smyo gser 'jig bu rang glen pa'i las ka rtsa ba nas ma byed ang / spyang kir dkar nag yod pa ma red mi ces don med du tshe srog blos gtong mi rung bar gdams pa dang / a khu bsam 'grub rgyal po'i pho brang du btson bkag byas pa'i dpal skyid dang 'phrad skabs/ kho mor lan chags mi yong ba'i ched du ngo mi shes pa'i tshul bstan te gsang brda btang ba dang / a khu bsam 'grub kyis thabs mkhas kyis rgyal po la lha skyid rang gi skye yul lha 'bab skyid gzhong gi kun bzang shar ri'i rtse la bsang gsol gtong bar zhus pa'i dmigs yul ni/dpal skyid dang gser 'jig gnyis mnyam du bros byol bya ba'i ( lam du 'gyur ldog byung bas don de ma 'grub ) phyir yin pa dang / a khu bsam 'grub kyis thabs brgya jus stong gis dpal skyid la 'phrad cing rang nyid kyi lta tshul brjod de kho mo'i sems na gra sgrig yod par byas/ de dag gis a khu bsam 'grub kyis dpal skyid kyi las dbang la thugs khur tshad med byas pa mtshon par ma zatā/ a khu bsam 'grub ni khog yangs dkyel che yin pa gsal bar bstan ga~X ra dā/jig dang dpal skyid gnyis kyi skyo gar gyi 'byung rtsa ni blon chen grags pa dbang phyug red/ rtsom pa pos khong khro'i me lce shin tu 'bar zhing /gnad du khel zhing don la gzhol ba'i sgo nas grags pa dbang phyug gi shes med dang bsam med/ khram dang g.yo sgyu/ phyin ci log gi bsam blo/ gdug rtsub — 343 —

che ba'i mi gzhi/ ngo tsha 'os pa'i mjug 'bras sogs sha thon rus thon du bris shing / ngan dgu tshang ba'i ngo gdong gi seng ras dmar rjen du bshus te lta mkhan rnams kyi gzigs mor bkrams pa red/grags pa dbang phyug ni 6 kha 'jam po dar dkar 'dra ba/ gting nag po tsher ma 'dra ba/ khram g.yo sgyu rgya mtsho'i 'dam ltar yod mi la/ byams snying rje til 'bru tsam yang med pa'i mir rdzus gcan gzan zhig yin pas dpal skyid kyi a ma la mkho dus rdo rje dang mi mkho dus gdon rdzas ltar sgo phyir sprad pa dang / tshong pa zhig tu brdzus te rgyal sras kun dga' zla chen la btsun mo 'tshol du phyin te 'bangs mi sdug la sbyar bar ma zad/ rgyal po la lkog nas gnas tshul yar zhu byas te bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa'i gnyen ston de khyo shug kha 'bral gyi ya nga ba'i nyin mor btang ba dang / gser 'jig la dpal skyid 'tshol rogs byed mdog gis sgo srung lag gi mdung 'phrogs te gser 'jig bsad pa sogs wa mo las g.yo sgyu che zhing / spyang ki las gdug rtsub che ba'i tshul mngon pa red/yin na'ang / lo rgyus kyi 'khor lo ni grags pa dbang phyug gi phyin ci log gi 'dod 'dun ltar ma 'khor ba dang / don dngos kyang grags pa dbang phyug gi stong bsam bzhin bab col yin mi srid/ grags pa dbang phyug la smin pa'i 'bras bu ni/ gser 'jig gis gri g.yugs te mig ya gcig zhar du bcug pa dang / a khu bsam 'grub kyi mda' mo gcig gis en tsam gyis bsad pa dang / rang gis thabs brgya jus stong gis gnod bskyel te gces pa'i srog dang bral ba'i dpal skyid kyang ma gzhir rang gi bu mo yin zhing / mjug mthar grags pa dbang phyug ces pa'i bdud rgan sdig to can de smyos te/ skabs rer 'ong 'ong zer nas bong bu'i skad rgyag pa dang / lan rer a'o a'o zer nas khyi'i zug skad rgyag pa red/ rgyal po'i sras po yang shi mig gson la re ste shi ba — 344 —

dang / gar stegs steng nas rgyal pos rang gi bu shi ba la cho nge 'don pa dang mnyam du/ gser 'jig dang dpal skyid gnyis bye'u gnyis su gyur te yangs shing rgya che ba'i a sngon dbyings nas lding skor rgyag pa dang / dus dang rnam pa kun tu phan tshun gyi sems pa gcig tu 'brel zhing / ngan shags dang 'thab mo med par phan tshun brtse bas 'grogs shing mnyam du 'phur ro/ /zlos gar 'di la bltas tshar rjes/ mi re'i sems la gser 'jig dang dpal skyid gnyis gzhan gyi gnod 'tshe thebs te gces pa'i srog dang bral ba red snyam mod/ yin na yang kho gnyis kyi bkur 'os shing snying nye ba'i snang brnyan de lham me lhan ne lhang nger yid kyi me long ngos su yang yang 'char bar ma zad/ kho gnyis shi zin na yang gson pa dang 'dra la/ grags pa dbang phyug dang rgyal po gnyis ma shi gson por yod na yang / gdug rtsub dang smyo ham gyi las ngan pa kho na bsags pas/ mthar sdug bsngal mu mtha' med par gyur cing / don dngos su kho tsho ni shi ba las kyang thu/zlos gar 'di'i bsam blo'i nang don gting zab cing yid 'gugs kyi nus pa ldan pa las gzhan/ rjod byed tshig la'ang snyan 'jebs yid dbang 'phrogs pa'i dbus gtsang gi gzhas dang / tshig rgyag gtam dpe/ dpe chos sogs bkol bas thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan/ dper na/ gser 'jig dang dpal skyid gnyis kyi gnyen sgrig gi ston thog tu na gzhon rnams kyi sems khong gi re 'dun mtshon pa'i tshig rgyag cig yod pa 'di lta ste/bu/ skyid pa'i lha 'bab skyid gzhung / bu mo me tog 'dra ba/ /sems la yod pa'i bu mo'i/ /thugs la ga re dgongs byung / /bu mo/ lang tsho dar ba'i rngon pa/ /

dka' ba'i las la brtson pa/ /khyed tsho thugs g.yeng ma gnang //bu mos skug nas bsdad chog/bu/ khu byug gsung skad snyan pas//dpyid shar gsung brda gnang byung / / —mda' mo 'ben la phog song //snying gtam sems la zug song //bu mo/ la 'di mthon po'i rtse la/ /sha ba brtse gdung zab pas/ sha dang yu mo'i 'dod sems//mthon po'i ri la bkod yod/ /gong gi tshig rgyag las zhing grong gi bu bu mo rnams kyi dga' spro tshad med pa mthong thub na yang / dpal skyid rgyal po'i pho brang du yod skabs lha 'bab skyid gzhong gi phyogs la kha gtad de blangs pa'i skyo glu ni de lta bu zhig min te/( gzhas) byams brtse'i ma gcig yod kyang //de yi bzhin ras ma mjal /sems pa'i gtan grogs yod kyang //de dang gson bral byas byung //bya gcig yin na dga' ba//gnam 'phang bcad de phyin chog /byi'u gcig yin na dga' ba//gshog rtsal ngom nas 'phur chog/sems sdug bu mo nga ni//rgyal po'i tshang du lus song //— 346 —

zhes pa'i gzhas 'di la nyan rjes/ lta mkhan rnams kyis zhing pa bu mo 'di'i sems pham yid skyo'i myong brgyud la snying rje dang / las 'bras la rtsis bsher mi shes shing mi lus bdud sems kyi mnga' bdag gi gtum spyod la snying nad bzod du med pa skyed par byed pa ma zad/ lta mkhan rnams kyang dpal skyid dang 'dra bar sems khra mo smug gis btums te ci yin 'di yin mi shes pa'i sems khral zhig ngang gis 'byung ngo //mi sna'i las gleng khrod du bkol ba'i gtam dpe rnams kyang 'os shing 'tsham ste/ dper na/ dpal skyid kyis a khu bsam 'grub ci'i phyir nam rgyun kho mor lta ru mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan 'dri skabs/ a mas bshad rgyur/ 6 lung ba'i phu thag ring thung 'di gom gsum ma spos na ha go gi ma red/ chu bo'i gting tshad zab min 'di chu'i dkyil la ma slebs na ha go gi ma red/ 'jig rten 'di'i skyid sdug gi dka' ngal ga tshod yod med ni rang so so'i mjing bar ma 'khri na de'i lci yang de ha go gi ma red mi ces pas dpal skyid kyis a khu bsam 'grub kyi dka' ngal shes pa dang / gzhan yang / 4 g.yag gis chu 'thung ma 'dod na gnya' nas mnan pas mi phan mi zhes dang / 6 las kha la nyan na bsam don 'grub/ gtam snying la bzhag na rgyal kha 'thob mices dang / lha khyung dar ma'i lo la nam 'phang gcod/ gnam kha zheng che rung ya mi nga / bu dar ma'i lo la 'jig rten 'grim/ sa kha zheng che rung ya mi nga sogs mtshon shugs che zhing gzhan la nges pa ster tshabs che ba'i gtam dpes phyug pas skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur mthor 'degs byas yod/rgan bsod nams tshe ring gis gsar rtsom byas pa'i 'khyab gzhung gzhan zhig yod pa ni 〈〈a khu ston pa 〉〉zhes pa de red/ de ni bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus /dri sdo ṭā // thog ma yin zhing / 'khrab ston gyi skabs su dga' bsu dpag — 347 —

a khu ston pa ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi kha na rlung ltar grag pa'i mi sna spyang grung 'dzoms shing rnam rig rgod po can zhig yin/ khong la yag chos dang btsog chos zhes pa'i mthong ba kun smon gyi gtam rgyud lu gu'i rgyud ltar brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig yod pa rnams kyis bod kyingag rtsom gyi gar stegs steng nas go gnas gal chen zhig bzung yod/ yin na yang / a khu ston pa'i gtam rgyud de gtam brjod zlos gar du sgrig rtsom byas te gar stegs steng 'khrab pa ni thengs dang po red/ gtam rgyud de ni bod rigs mi dmangs la cha rgyus che ba'i brjod bya zhig yin pas/ rtsom pa pos sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas a khu ston pa'i snang brnyan slar bzhengs byas te/ gcig nas lta mkhan rnams la a khu ston pa'i gtam rgyud kyi gdod ma'i rnam pa ste slob gso'i don snying ldan pa'i nying bcud la lta thub par bya ba dang / gnyis nas gdod ma'i rnam pa mthor 'degs dang gsar gtod bya ba ste phyogs de la sems shugs mi dman pa bton zhing / lhag par gsham gyi gnad 'gag 'ga' gtsigs su bzung ba ste/ 1 a khu ston pa dang / rdzong dpon khram rgan wa mo/ phyag mdzod rwa gog mchu to bcas kyi steng du 'gal 'thab 'du bar byas te/ 'khyab gzhung de'i byung rim cha tshang spyi tshogs kyi rgyab ljongs nges can zhig tu tshod 'dzin byas pas sa gnas kyi khyad chos mngon gsal ldan/ 2 a khu ston pa dang rdzong dpon bar gyi 'thab rtsod brjod byar 'dem pa la dpe mtshon gyi rang bzhin ches cher ldan zhing kun gyi snying nad sangs byed cig yin pas/ gtso gnad 'bur du thon zhing ltad mo ba la bag chags gting zab cig bzhag 3 sa khu ston pa'i spyang grung 'dzoms shing thabs la mkhas pa/ dgod bro ba'i khyad chos ldan pa/ gzhan phan lhag bsam che ba/ dbang sgyur pa la 'thab rtsod byed phod pa dang byed mkhas pa'i rang gshes kyi khyad chos sor bzhag byas te/ snying nye zhing gus par 'os pa/ bla na med cing cha tshang ba'i dpe gzhi'i snang brnyan zhig — 348 —

'bri bzhengs byas pa bcas so/ /'phan po sa cha dpe gzhi'i khor yug tu 'dem pa dang / rdzong dpon dang phyag mdzod gnyis 'thab rtsod bya yul du 'dem pa la don snying ldan zhing mang tshogs kyi rmang gzhi brtan po mchis te/ ngag rgyun la 'phan po'i yul ni nam rgyun a khu ston pa 'gro 'dug byed sa yin zhing / rdzong dpon dang phyag mdzod /nyis ni yul khams de bdag bzung byed mkhan gyi sa gnas kyi rgyal po lta bu da/de yang 'go tshugs pa'i le tshan du 'di lta bu'i gzhas tshig cig mchis te/khyed ser ba dgung nas 'bab gyur kyang / /nga ser 'gog sngags pa 'og na yod/ /sprin dum bu dgu la ma btang na//nga ser 'gog sngags pa min pa'i rtags//khyed ser ba dgung nas 'bab gyur kyang / /sprin nag po'i kha lo nga yis sgyur//ngas g.yu 'brug thang la ma 'phangs na/ /nga ser 'gog sngags pa min pa'i rtags//drin chen po'i ma dang pha yul gnyis/ /nyam chung chung mi ser rnam pa la//nga a khu ston pas mi phan na/ /ja lan de chus 'jal ma red dam//zhes pa'i dmangs gzhas 'di las/ a khu ston pa dang nyam chung mi ser tsho gcig sems gcig tu 'brel zhing / gdug rtsub can gyi dbang sgyur pa rnams bya dka' byed gtad kyi gnas su bskyal te/ mi ser rnams kyi snying nad sangs pa byed par khong la yid ches dang chod sems yod pa —bstan/— 349 —

'khrab gzhung 'dir gdam gses byas pa'i dpe gzhi'i don rkyen gyis sku ngo dag gi skyug bro ba'i bsam sbyor la zur za gang legs byas pa dang / a khu ston pa'i dpa' ngar dang spyang grung 'bur thon gyis bstan/ de yang dpe gzhi'i don rkyen la gsham gyi phyogs gsum gyi nang don yod de/dang po/ thabs mkhas kyis ma rungs dpon ngan la chad pa bcad de kho tsho ci bya gtol med kyi gnas su bskyal ba ste/ dper na/ rdzong dpon gyi lcam mo ni skyi ther zhig yin pa la/ a khu ston pas dbu skra 'dzugs par khas 'ches te snyung bu yis skra btsugs pas/ lha lcam gyis zug rngu ma bzod par ngag nas skad ngan shor ba dang / mgo nas khrag dmar tsa ra ra bzhur ba lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa/ blo rig pa dang thabs bkod pa la brten nas/ sku ngo la mdzod khang gi dngos po 'bangs mi ser la ster du bcug pa ste/ dper na/ mar khral mi sprod pa'i thabs la 'khyab gzhung las ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i brjod gtam bris yod pa 'di lta ste/a khu na re/ ( ha las mdog gis ) a tsi/ da dngos gnas dpe bsags pa red/ bu rang gis rang gi bong bur yag po mi lta bar ga re byed/ngas bu rang la bong rte'u yag po byas nas ltos zhes ske la yi ge 'bri 'bri byas nas mngags ma byung ngam/ da bong te'u yis 'o ma tshang ma btung tshar yod na/rku ngo'i mar khral 'di/mar khral gang 'dra byas nas sku ngo na re/ ga re/bong bu'i mar lcam na re/ (ha las te )a tsi/ da sprang po de tshos nga la bong mar dkrogs nas skyel gyi yod pa red/lcam na re/ ngo ma dpe bsags song / bong mar zos na lkugs par 'gyur ba min nam/phyag mdzod na re/ red lags/ de 'dra byas yong bsam ma byung / ( tshig — 350 —

pa za bzhin a khu la ) ka ye/ khyod rang gis mi ngan de tsho tshang ma tshur bos shogangs ga ler byas nas bkod pa bshad chogaskyo sa khra na re/ bu chung / nged gnyis khong tshor skad gtong du 'gro/ (mar ba dbye ngo na re/ hin/ 'di 'dra dpe srid dogs med/ sa steng 'dir rang dang rang 'dra'i rdzong dpon nga che nga btsan zer mkhan tshos ngas bong mar zos pa go na rjes su nga mi'i dkyil la gdong ga 'dra bstan dgos pa red/( a khu dang mi ser rnams yar yong )phyag mdzod na re/ za 'dre khyed tshos sku ngo la bong mar 'bul dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam/mi ser ka na re/ lags/ sku ngo chen po —dgongs pa dwangs pa zhig de sngon nga tshos lo ltar bong mar 'bul dus phyag mdzod sku zhabs kyis 'grig gi ma red ces bka' bkyon tshig gcig kyang gnang ma myong stabs/ nga tsho'i bsam par sku ngo lhan rgyas bong mar bzhes rgyu thugs mnyes po gnang gi 'dug bsams nas bong mar 'bul gyi yod/phyag mdzod na re/ ga re/ sus khyod tshor bong mar khyer shog zer gyi 'dug gam/ khyed tshos bskyal yong ba de bong mar yin pa sus shes kyi red/a khu na re/ lags/ rdzong yongs kyi mi ser su zhig la'ang 'bri mar 'bu/ji yas rtsa ba nas med pa de phyag mdzod sku zhabs kyis mkhyen gyi yod shag la bzlog 'a //da na re/ de de de/ khyod rang rkub btsum nas sdod/sku ngo na re/ ( phyag mdzod la kha gtad nas ) de sngon kho tshos bskyal yong ba'i mar da dung gnyer tshang nang mang 'od 'dug gam/phyag mdzod na re/ lags/da dung mang po yod/

sku ngo na re/ kwa ye/ ston pa khyod rang da lta lam sang phyag mdzod sku zhabs dang mnyam du phyin nas gnyer tshang nang yod pa'i bong mar de tsho tshang ma phyi la g.yug par rgyug dang / ri.a /sbu rda re/ lags so/ (skyod grabs su lha lcam la ser sna skyes te a khu la smra/ sdum na re/ a khu/ gang gis bong mar yag po dbye 'byed shes kyi yod dam/a khu na re/ lags/ de las sla po red/ 'bri mar dang bong mar gnyis kyi kha dog rtsa ba nas 'dra gi ma red/phyag mdzod na re/ ga 'dras ze/a khu na re/ bong mar ni 'bri mar las ser gyi red/ 'bri mar ni bong mar las dkar gyi red sku ngo na re/ khyod rang mgyogs tsam phyin nas bong mar tshang ma phyi la g.yugs shog6)de ltar a khu ston pa dang mi ser rnams kyis de nas bzung mar khral 'jal mi dgos par ma zad/ da dung sngon chad 'jal ba'i mar thams cad bgo bsha' byas te 'tsho ba legs bcos byas pa red/gsum pa/ sku ngo'i zhabs zhur bsdad na yang dka' las myangs ma dgos par ma zad/ thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas gla cha sngar bzhin blangs pa/ dper na/ a khu ston pa sku ngo chen po'i zhabs phyir sdod skabs/ sku ngos kho la cha rkyen gsum brtsis pa ste/ sku ngo'i zhabs phyir sdod pa'i ring la nyi ma rer spag phor ba gang re ma gtogs zos mi chog pa dang / sku ngo yod sa nas gzhas btang mi chog pa dang / sang lo kham bu'i me tog shar ma thag lcam mo la dbu skra bzang thag chod cig 'dzugs dgos zhes na yang / a khu ston pas ja mdong mo phyed ka dang — 352 —

rtsam pa bre bcu shong ba'i phor ba'i nang du rtsam pa zos pa dang / nam rgyun sku ngo'i mdun nas rnam thar btang ba ma zad/ lha lcam gyi skra 'dzugs khul gyis mgo la snyung bus 'dzer te khrag bzhur du bcug pa dang / lha lcam gyi rgyan cha'i sgam chung nang gi gser dngul nor bu'i rigs rnams 'bangs mi ser la bkram pa dang / a khu ston pas sku ngo la mdzod khang gi 'bru rnams 'bangs la bu lon gtong du bcug ste sang lo 'bru bun la zu gro ldab gcig misprod par a khu ston pas khas blangs shing / mjug mthar bro 'khrab mkhan khag cig bos yong nas bro ldab cig 'khrab ste mgo bskor ba sogs/ mdor na a khu ston pas ra rta rgod po ji 'dra zhig yin na yang srab nas dam por bzung tshar na skrag dgos pa rtsa ba nas med mi ces 'bangs mi ser la bsgos pa ltar/ dpon ngan dag gi zhan cha bzung nas 'bangs mi ser la bde skyid bskrun te/ smyo nyam dman rnams spyang zhing grung la cher rlom rnams glen zhing lkugs pa'i mi bden don de gsal bshad byas/gzhan yang / 'khrab gzhung 'dir smyo mi ngan la dbang byung na chu la bre 'jal du 'jug mi dang / 6 rgyal po'i bka' las blon po'i rta lcag btsan/’ 6 kho bong bur nyal stangs bcod brgyad yod na/ nga tshong par slong stangs bcu dgu yod/mi ra bsad de lug snar dgos pa zhig dang / khyi brdungs te phag pa 'drog dgos pa zhig bzos chog mi g.yul thag chod dus spag thag chod/’ lha pho rab gcig gi blo rtse las/pho 'bring gsum gyi gros bsdur dga'/mi khul bong bus khur na rgya lam gyi rked pa na don med/mi kha stong nang gi tshig stong /lag stong nang gi phyag rgya/mi zhes pa sogs kyi gtam dpe dang / 6 'dogs khyi zer dus/ gzugs stobs bong bu las che ba/ spu mdog gser 'od chem chem/ral pa seng ge las rdzig pa/ rna cog rgya khyi las 'drong ba/ sug mthil ka ba las sbom pa/ sder mo khyung las rno ba/mi zhes dang / smyo sems skyid pa nyi ma shar ba lta — 353 —

bu dang / lus bde ba bdud rtsir rol ba bzhin nyazhes pa'i dpe rnams la gson nyams ldan zhing phal skad kyi rang bzhin ldan par ma zad/ 'dre dkar dang gzhas tshig bkod pa rnams kyang 'os shing 'tshams la yid dbang 'phrog par byed do/ /sa bcad lnga pa/ rang rgyal gyi glog brnyan lo rgyus steng gi bod skad kyi glog brnyan dang po/bcings 'grol gyi rjes su mkhas pa'i dbang po gsung rab rgya mtsho mchog gtso byas te thog mar glog brnyan sgra bsgyur gyi bya ba bsgrubs shing / da lta'i bar du rgyal khab phyi nang gi glog brnyan dang brnyan 'phrin zlos gar bgrang gis mi lang ba bod skad du bsgyur pa ma zad/ nang logs kyi glog brnyan bsgyur skrun khang dang brnyan 'phrin zlos gar bsgyur skrun khang gis kyang rgya skad kyi lam nas bod kyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i glog brnyan dang brnyan 'phrin zlos gar bsgyur skrun byas/ rmang gzhi de'i steng nas da lta rang rgyal gyi glog brnyan lo rgyus steng 'khrab khrid pa dang gzhung rtsom pa po/ 'khyab ston pa dang mdzes rtsal pa bcas bod rigs yin pa'i glog brnyan thengs dang po'am/ bod rigs kyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i bod skad kyi glog brnyan dang po/ rgyal spyi'i glog brnyan 'gran bsdur du zhugs nas bya dga' mang po thob pa'i bod skad kyi glog brnyan dang po 〈〈snying 'jags kyi ma ṇi rdo 'bum 〉〉zhes pa byung ba des/ rang rgyal gyi glog brnyan lo rgyus steng snga na med cing gzi brjid ldan pa'i rdo ring zhig bslangs pa red/bod rigs 'khrab khrid pa'i thog ma padma tshe brtan ni spyi lo 1969lor mtsho sngon zhing chen mtsho lho bod rigs rang skyong khul du skyes/ 1991lo nas — 354 —

1995lo'i bar nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo nas slob sbyong byas shing /2000nas bzung nub byang mi rigs slob grwa nas rtsom rig gi hro hri bton/2002wa 2004lo'i bar pe cin glog brnyan slob gling nas zab sbyong byas pa dang / 2004lor pe cin hi ma la ya glog brnyan brnyan 'phrin rig gnas khyab spel tshad yod kung zi gsar du btsugs/ khong gis 1991lo nas bzung snga gzhug tu 〈〈bod ljongs rtsom rig 〉〉dang / 〈〈bod ljongs sgyu rtsal〉〉/ 〈〈mi rigs rtsom rig〉〉/ 〈〈sbyang char 〉〉sogs su bod yig dang rgya yig gi sgrung 'bring dang sgrung thung bzhi bcu lhag dang / bsgyur rtsom bcu phrag lhag dpyad rtsom du ༵ spel bar ma zad/ (shālo/ 4po 〉zhes pa'i rnam thar chen mo zhig kyang rnying /dri ༷kā/ba gzhung rtsom sgrig dang 'khrab khrid byas pa'i 〈〈snying 'jags kyi ma ṇi rdo 'bum 〉〉las/ lo sar tshes gcig nas tshes gsum bar gyi dus yun thung ngu'i nang du bande chung chung zhig dgon pa nas rang yul du thon pa dang / rang yul nas dgon par log pa'i lam bar gyi gnas tshul dang /dgon pa dang gong sde ru byung ba'i gnas tshul rnams dal lhod zhi 'jags kyis lta mkhan gyi spyan lam du bshams yod/ spyir glog brnyan 'di'i byung rim la kyag kyog dang rnyog 'dzing mi ldan zhing mi sna'i bar gyi 'gal 'du dza drag min na yang / gtam rgyud de'i shugs la bstan pa'i nang don dang lta mkhan rnams la gsod 'grol byas pa'i gnad don ni phun sum tshogs pa zhig mchis te/ ban phrug de'i dgon pa dang pha yul gyi 'tsho ba'i khyad par bris pa brgyud nas/ khyim pa dang rab byung pa'i bar gyi 'gal 'brel/ chos lugs rig gnas dang tshong las dpal yon gnyis kyi 'gal 'thab/ dngos yod 'tsho ba dang lha sgrung bar gyi khyad par/ bod kyi rig gnas dang mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas bar gyi 'gal ba/ rgan rabs dang gzhon rabs gnyis mi bsam blo'i 'khyer — 355 —

so mi 'dra ba'i khyad par sogs mtshon yod la/ bod mi'i brtse gdung dang mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba/ blang dor gyi lta ba/ mi tshe dang ma 'ongs par mno bsam btang yod pas/ glog brnyan de'i rin thang dang go bab sogs la nged cag su // byi/ rung bsam gzhig dang gdeng 'jog bya rgyu ni 'os 'gan zhig tu 'ga' gshāka sna/nga gtam rgyud bkod sgrig thad nas kyang gnad 'gag gi phyogs /ngab //sa' ṭwāṃ nā/tsho ba'i chu tshad je mthor song ba dang bstun nas brnyan 'phrin dar khyab byung yod la/ des mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba dang bsam blo la shan shugs thebs dang thebs bzhin yod phyir/ brnyan 'phrin 'di'i nang du'ang med du mi rung ba'i grub cha zhig tu gyur cing byung rim 'phel rgyas la'ang 'brel ba dam po yod/ gtam rgyud kyi mgo yang dgon pa'i nang gi gsar byung gi dngos po ste brnyan 'phrin gyis bande'i yid dbang 'phrog pa nas brtsams yod la/ bande des rang gi phu bos brnyan 'phrin zhig nyos pa shes nas pha yul du song zhing / zlos gar 'khrab sa nas kha rog tu khyim la song nas brnyan 'phrin la bltas pa dang / de nas u tshugs kyis brnyan 'phrin dgon par bskyal du bcug nas a khu la lta ru bcug mjug mthar brnyan 'phrin gyis bad phrug gi blo kha bsgyur ba dang / gtam rgyud khrod kyi mi sna yongs la'ang shan shugs thebs pas/ byung rim gyi 'phel rgyas la phreng ba thag brgyus lta bu'i nus pa thon zhing bsam blo'i snying po mtshon pa la'ang nus pa gal chen thon/2 〈〈thang sin bla ma'i rtogs brjod〉〉/glog brnyan 'di'i nang du 〈〈thang san bla ma'i rtogs brjod 〉〉ni mu 'brel brnyan 'phrin zlos gar gyi tshul du bkod sgrig byas yod/ rtogs brjod — 356 —

'di'i rtsom pa po wu'u khreng en ni sangs rgyas chos lugs pa zhig min/ rtogs brjod 'di las thang sin bla ma dge slob rnams nub phyogs su dam pa'i chos len du song ba bris yod na'ang / don dngos su rgya mi rigs kyi bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin rig gnas kyis nang bstan rig gnas la gsed 'grel byas pa zhig red/ da lta'i dus la slebs pa na/ rtogs brjod de mu 'brel brnyan 'phrin zlos gar du bsgyur skrun byas shing / de yang don la tshong las spro g.yeng rig gnas kyis skad grags che ba'i rtogs brjod de 'grel bshad byas pa zhig red/lo ngo gang mang gi ring la/ rtogs brjod 'di rtsom rig gam/ brnyan 'phrin/ tha na rig gnas kyi rnam pa la brten nas mi rnams kyis phu chos len 'jal skor gyi spyod lam 'di'i ngos 'dzin la shugs rkyen thebs shing / de ni ngo mtshar zhing dka' ba brgya phrag brgyud pa'i gtam rgyud cig tu sems/ 'khrab khrid pa padma tshe brtan gyis dmigs yul yod pa'i sgo nas byung rim de 'dra zhig bkod sgrig byas pa la brten nas/ bod mi'i 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi ches spyir btang gi gnas tshul te/ bande'i a khu stod nyi ma lha sar mjal skor du 'gro ba 'bur du dod pa ma zad/ deng dus 'tsho ba'i khrod gnas 'jal byed pa ni chos lugs pa zhig la mtshon na ches rgyun ldan dang ches snying stobs ldan pa'i chod sems shig yin pa las/ ngo mtshar rang bzhin dang lha 'dre'i gnod pa yod mi srid pa mtshon yod/ de bas/ glog brnyan 'di ru rtogs brjod de bkod sgrig byas pas byung rim phra rab kyi sgrig bkod thad nas bltas na glog brnyan 'di'i bsam blo'i don snying khong du chud yod pa mtshon thub/3 8〈dri med kun ldan gyi rnam thar〉〉/bod kyi lha mo 〈〈dri med kun ldan gyi rnam thar 〉〉ni glog brnyan 'di'i khrod nas 6 gtam rgyud khrod kyi gtam rgyud cig tu brtsis chog ban phrug de pha — 357 —

yul du log rjes/ rang gi phu bo dang phu bo'i grogs po rnams kyis dri med kun ldan gyi rnam thar 'khrab ston byas/ 'khrab khrid pas skabs der rgyal bu dri med kun ldan gyis rang gi lcam mo dang sras sras mo/ tha na rang gi dpral ba'i mig kyang sbyin nus pa'i gtong phod pa'i gshis ka bris shing / skabs de'i 'khyab ston dang dbyangs rta yis lta mkhan rnams la sems 'gul thebs su bcugargyal bu dri med kun ldan gyi rnam thar gyis bod kyi rig gnas kyi bla na med pa'i kun spyod mtshon yod mod/ 'tsho ba dngos las glu mkhan bro ba'i chos bshad dang / chos btsongs te 'tsho ba rol thabs byed pa'i ngang tshul can mang ba'ang shugs la bstan te/ dri med kun ldan 'khrab mkhan gyis mtshon pa'i mi rnams la rgyal bu'i bla med mdzad spyod la slob dgos pa'i re ba bton/ rnam thar gyi 'khrab ston mjug rdzogs rjes/ 'khyab ston pa rnams lta mkhan dang mnyam du deng rabs kyi zhabs bro 'khrab pa des don dngos dang phugs bsam gyi khyad par dang / chos pa dang 'jig rten pa'i khyad par/ srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng rabs rig gnas kyi 'gal ba dang phog thug mtshon yod pas/gom pa rim bgrod kyi tshul du glog brnyan gyi bsam blo'i snying po bstan/4 a khu bzod pa dang khong gi ma ṇi'i rdo 'bum/a khu bzod pa ni ban phrug dang kho'i a pha gnyis pha yul du log pa'i lam bar du 'phrad pa'i ma ṇi rko mkhan zhig yin zhing / khos ban phrug la ma ṇi yig drug cig brko rgyu khas blangs yod/ 'on kyang / ban de pha bu gnyis dgon par 'gro skabs a khu bzod pa dus chos su gyur/ glog brnyan las a khu bzod pa'i skor gyi tshan pa gnyis byung ba des don dngos su glog brnyan gyi ming byang la ram 'degs kyi nus pa thon pa red/ 'khrab khrid pa padma tshe brtan gyis ma ṇi'i rdo 'bum ni chos dang sku brkos pa'i rdo yin la/ de ni bod mi rigs kyi bsam pa'i rten sa yin zer/ tshan pa de gnyis las bod mi rigs kyi sems kyi — 358 —

rten sa mtshon yod par ma zad/ tshe mi rtag pa dang / bod kyi rig gnas skor zhig rgyun skyong mkhan med par nyams rgyad du 'gyur bzhin pa mtshon yod pas/glog brnyan gyi bstan bya mtshon pa la nus pa gal chen thon/glog brnyan khyad du 'phags pa zhig la mtshon na/ gtam rgyud legs po zhig dang / bsam blo'i don snying legs po zhig yod dgos pa ma zad/ da dung sgra /zugs gnyis kyi brda spyod thabs la'ang khyad 'phags kyi rang bzhin ldan da saglo/ ga brnyan 'di'i par ris (mirsā)thad kyi khyad chos gtso bo ni glog brnyan hril po las phal cher 'gul skyod med par gtan 'jags par ris la brten nas par len byas yod pas/ phyogs gcig nas snying 'jags kyi ma ṇi rdo 'bum zhes pa'i 4 nying 'jags sa kyi don dang mthun la/ phyogs gcig nas 'khrab khrid pas glog brnyan las bstan pa'i rig gnas mi 'dra ba gnyis kyi 'gal 'thab la bzung ba'i phyi rol yul dang mthun pa'i rnam 'gyur mtshon pa ste/ 'khrab khrid pas gsungs pa ltar/ khos tsa bod kyi rig gnas dang phyi yong rig gnas gnyis kyi 'gal 'thab la legs min gyi shan mi 'byed mi ces pa dang mthun/ gtan 'jags par ris mang po bed spyod byas pas glog brnyan hril po la 6 snying 'jags 9kyi mdzes sdug lam srol zhig grub 'dugasgra gdangs kyi thad nas kyang gtso bo bcos ma ma yin pa'i rang byung gi sgra yin pas/ glog brnyan hril po'i don rkyen brjod pa'i lam srol dang mthun te/ dper na/ ban phrug dang khyim mi rnams kyis brnyan 'phrin skor gyi kha brda byed skabs phyi nas phyugs zog gi 'ba' sgra grags yong ba des/ srol rgyun gyi phyugs las dang deng rabs rig gnas kyi 'gal 'thab de sgra gdangs kyi steng nas mtshon par byas/tshon mdangs kyi phyogs nas kyang gtso bo rang byung gi tshon mdangs spyad — 359 —

yod pas/ glog brnyan hril po'i lam srol dang gcig gyur byung yod/ der ma zad/ bod khams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yul ljongs par du blangs pas glog brnyan hril por tshon mdangs bsnan/mdor na/ glog brnyan 'dis bsam blo'i nang don dang sgra gzugs kyi phyogs gnyis thag gcod byas pa legs pas bod rang gi glog brnyan gyi 'dzugs skrun la dbu legs po zhig btsugs so/ / (le'u 'di rtsom mkhan ni bkra gis rin chen yin/)dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/0)btsun pa tshul khrims rin chen gyi 〈〈bod kyi rig gnas lnga'i rnam gzhag〉〉/1981lor mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 40par gsal/6)khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i 〈〈rgyan gyi bstan bcos dbyangs can ngag gi rol mtsho〉〉/ 1986lor bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 67par gsal/()mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung gi 〈〈snyan ngag me long gi spyi don sdeb legs rig pa'i 'char sgo zhes bya ba bzhugs so〉〉/ 1981lor kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe spun byas pa'i shog ngos 135par gsal/6)bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉〉/ 'gyur med kyis bsgrigs/ 1993lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 15ge~X/zlo pye~X⑪/ ⑨⑩⑩⑩⑩⑩⑩⑩bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs 〈〈lho yi dri gzhon〉〉/ 'gyur med kyis bsgrigs/ 1993lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dpe skrun byas pa'i shog ngos 525pa dang / shog ngos 573pa/ shog ngos 529 530pa/ shog ngos 536 537pa/ shog ngos 550go 551pa/ shog ngos 558pa/ shog ngos 5314 533pa/ shog ngos 472— 473pa/ shog ngos 488pa/ shog ngos 498pa/ shog ngos 1384 140pa/ shog ngos 159pa/ shog — 360 —
ga ngos 1454 146pabacad tshe'i zur za'i gtam brjotsho/kā dpe skrun khang gis dpe /

le'u lnga pa/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom pa po'i tshogs pa/sa bcad dang po/ dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i rtsom stegs/lo ngo bcu phrag gcig ring gi sna rig gnas gsar brje :yi zing cha 1976lo'i lo smad du mjug sgril bar khyab bsgrags byas pa dang / skabs de'i mi rnams kyi thun mong gi bsam tshul du/ mi 'gyangs par bod mi rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'di'ang rgyal yongs dang mtshungs par bcings grol byas tshun gyi lo ngo nyer bdun dang khyad par che ba'i dus skabs gsar pa zhig tu zhugs 'gro la/ sgrung gtam dang snyan ngag lhug rtsom/ 'khyab gzhung bcas com rig las rigs su'ang de lta bu'i rnam pa zhig 'byung bar re sgug byas 'dugayin na'ang / lo rgyus kyi rkyen gyis bod bcings 'grol btang ba nas dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i bar bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal thad ha lam shog stong du lus pa'i tshul du snang zhing / sgrung gtam gsar rtsom thad de las kyang yid skyo ba zhig ste lo ngo sum cu'i ring gsar rtsom gyi zhing sar 'bru rdog gcig kyang sdud rgyu ma yong ba'i lo nyes byung ba red/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas bzung / nye rabs kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom thad sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'phel rgyas chen po byung la/ bsam blo rgya che zhing gsar gtod byed phod pa'i bod mi rigs kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po yang char rjes kyi sha mo brdol ba bzhin byung bas/ rgan dar gzhon gsum mnyam 'brel gyi rtsom pa po'i dpung khag — 362 —

cig chags pa des/ 'phel med sor gnas kyi bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig gi rnam pa de mjug sgril nas rang mi rigs kyi yig thog nas dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i lam bu zhig gsar gtod byas pa ma zad/ rang cag gi gsar rtsom lag len la gnas tshul dngos kyi thog nas ra sprod byas pa ni/ rang mi rigs kyi yi ge bkol te gsar rtsom byas na/ da gzod bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig la dbyar mtsho rgyas pa bzhin 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i mdun lam 'od stong ldan pa zhig yod pa gsal mtshon byas shing / mi rigs shig gi 'phel rgyas 'gro tshul gyi mtshon byed ni mi rigs rang gi rtsom pa po'i rtsom rig yin pas dus skabs gsar ba 'di'i nang mi rigs rang nyid kyi rtsom pa po gang mang zhig skyed sring byung yod pa dang / mi rigs rang nyid kyi skad yig la brten nas gsar rtsom byed pa'i rtsom pa po'i dpung khag cig 'tshar longs byung yod pa de ni bod rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rtsom rig bya gzhag 'phel rgyas legs po yong ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyu cha zhig tu gyur pa dang / de'i khrod du yon tan gyis phyug pa'i rgan rabs pa dang / blo gsar gzhon nu/ zhing pa dang 'brog pa/ bud med rnams yod pa dang / rtsom pa po'i dpung khag lo re bzhin rgya bskyed du 'gro ba'i don dngos kyi thog nas bod rigs kyi rtsom rig de lo rgyus kyi dus skabs gsar pa zhig tu slebs yod la/ rtsom pa po'i dpung khag stobs ldan zhig kyag kyog gi 'gro lam brgyud de 'tshar longs yong bzhin yod pa de ni dus skabs gsar pa'i dmigs bsal gyi chos nyid cig yin/lhas par dga' 'os pa zhig ni bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom lo rabs brgyad cu bar zhugs rjes gna' rabs rtsom rig dang bsdur na 'gyur ldog chen po byung yod pa tshags med du rtogs thub ste/ lo rgyus steng mtho rim skya ser te gtso bo ser mo ba'i mkhas pas bod kyi rtsom stegs sgor bzung byed pa'i rnam pa rtsa ba nas bsgyur ba dang / skyes khungs phal bar 'khrungs pa'i rtsom — 363 —

rig gsar pa'i mi rabs gcig bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi dpung shugs gtso bor gyur pa de ni lo rgyus kyi dbye mtshams ldan pa'i 'gyur ldog cig red/de las kyang gal che ba ni brtsams chos mi nyung ba zhig sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs kyi thad la thod brgal gsar pa byung / lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i rtsom rig gis srol rgyun rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal nying bcud rgyun 'dzin byas pa ma zad/ bod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dang lo rgyus rig gnas zung 'brel dam po byas pas/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi rtsom srol gsar pa zhig tu grub 'dug cing / des bod kyi rtsom rig sngar las bla lhag gis gong du spel bar skul 'ded kyi nus pa chen po bton dang 'don bzhin yod pa red/don dngos steng deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa ni dus rabs 'di'i gong gi lo rabs brgyad cu ba'i stod tsam nas 'go btsugs pa dang / kha min don gyis bcings grol byas tshun gyi lo ngo nyer bdun dang 'brel ba yod la khyad par yang ha cang che ba'i dus rim zhig tu slebs song /lha rig gsar dus skabs kyi bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi gnas tshul dngos der yid skyo zhing mug pa'i rnam 'gyur zhig 'chang yod stabs/ sgrung gtam snyan ngag sogs rtsom rig gsar rtsom thad bsam blo'i 'khyer phyogs rigs gnyis byung pa ste/dang po ni/ sna g.yon mi gyi chab srid lam lugs dang smyo ham gyi lo zla'i nang byung ba'i mi chos dang 'gal ba'i smyo ham gyi bya spyod la skyon zhib dang 'gyod bshags byed pa'i sgrung gtam dang snyan ngag ( srol rgyun gyi lus bsten pa shas che )gi lus mang po zhig thon pa dang / gnyis pa ni/ bod kyi rin thang bral ba'i srol rgyun rig gnas la bstod bsngags dang / tang gi mi rigs srid jus kyi 'od stong 'phros 'og mi rigs rig gnas gong du spel 'dod kyi bsam blo brtan po dang / 'dun pa drag po/ lo rgyus 'os 'gan bcas brjod bya'i srog tu bsten pa red/ mi rnams kyis dus skabs gsar pa'i nang bod kyi rtsom rig — 361 —

gsar rtsom la slar gso dang bskyar dar gyi rnam pa zhig 'byung bar rang nus gang 'dzoms 'bul bzhin yod/lo rabs bdun cu'i mjug tsam du don grub rgyal gyi sgrung gtam 〈〈pad mtsho 〉〉dang 〈〈'brug mtsho 〉〉(〈〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur 〉〉steng bkod pa dang /)dpal 'byor gyi 〈〈me tog ldum ra'i nang gi klan ka 〉〉(1980lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsomarig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb gsum pa )〈〈sprul sku 〉〉(1981lo'i 〈〈spang char 〉〉deb gsum par)/ don grub rgyal gyi rang mos snyan ngag 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉sogs ni (1983lo'i 〈〈sbyang char 〉〉deb gnyis par )'brug sgra zhig dang mtshungs par bod kyi rtsom rig gi sa gzhi de yom yom du 'dar bar byas/ bcos sgyur sgo 'byed byas nas lo gnyis gsum tsam gyi nang deng rabs bod kyi sgrung gtam dang snyan ngag lhug rtsom bcas 'bri rtsom byed pa'i gom pa 'di ltar spos song ba dang / de yi rjes su dam por 'brang mkhan (sgrung gtam gyi thad nas )byams pa chos 'dzoms kyi 〈〈yang cun me tog 〉〉(1982lo'i 〈2sbrang char 〉〉deb dang po 〉dang / rnam grol gyi 〈〈char shul gyi nags tshal 〉〉(1982lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb gsum pa)/ lhun grub kyi 〈〈rta nag sgrog 'gros 〉〉(1982lo'i 〈〈sgrang char 〉〉deb gnyis pa)/ rig 'dzin gyi 〈〈dpe tshab sprod pa 〉〉(1983lo'i 〈〈sbyang char 〉〉deb dang po)/ thub bstan gyi 〈〈a chung gis rta nyos pa 〉〉(1983lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb dang po)/ skal bzang tshe brtan gyi 〈〈dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu 〉〉(1983lo'i 〈〈zla zer 〉〉deb gsum pa)/ rin chen tshe dga'i 〈〈bkra shis don grub gnyen sgrig byed pa'i snga rjes su 〉〉(1983lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb lnga pa)/ rdo rje rin chen gyi 〈〈a ma'i sems 〉〉(1985lo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb gsum pa)/ lha rgyal tshe ring gi 〈〈dngul gyi sor gdub 〉〉(198'gyulo'i 〈〈zang char 〉〉deb gnyis pa )sogs kyis sgrung gtam gsar — 365—

rtsom de 'phel lam cung yangs shing gsar pa zhig la gtad pa dang /1985lo nas bzung tshe ring don grub kyi 〈〈lam 〉〉dang / rdo rje mkhar gyi 〈〈ca de〉〉/ban de bkra shis kyi 〈〈'chi bdag gi zhags pas zin dus〉〉/rnam sras kyi 〈〈mi rabs gsum gyi 'phrug lu〉〉/ gcan tsha rdo rje rin chen gyi 〈〈lhan 'dzoms〉〉/ a smyon bkra shis don grub kyi 〈〈spyang gi lug rdzi dang kho'i chung ma〉〉/rang sgra'i 〈〈'dre rkang to〉〉/ bkra shis dpal ldan gyi 〈〈phyi nyin gyi gnam gshes de ring las legs pa yong nges〉〉/ bstan pa yar rgyas kyi 〈〈dus gcig la byung ba'i gtam rgyud gnyis〉〉/ stag 'bum rgyal gyi 〈〈sde dpon 〉〉sogs sgrung gtam thung 'bring mod po zhig byung ba dang / dus skabs gsar pa 'di'i nang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho lags kyis mi rigs rang gi skad dang yig thog nas bton pa'i sgrung ring thog ma 〈〈skal bzang me tog 〉〉1982lor dpe skrun byas pa nas da bar du/ bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon/ kun su'u sogs su rtsom pa po glang mdun dpal 'byor dang bkra shis dpal ldan/ bstan pa yar rgyas/ stag 'bum rgyal/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar/ bkra bha/ nag po skal bzang / rang sgra/ tshe brtan rdo rje sogs kyis sgrung ring khyon bsdoms pas rnam grangs bcur son pa tsam dpe skrun dang 'grem spel byas pa dang / bod kyi rtsom rig byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus steng yang bskyar grub 'bras g.yur za ba thob pa red/de yang snyan ngag dang lhag par snyan ngag gsar pa la mtshon na/ 〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉yi rjes su dam por 'brang mkhan ljang bu lags kyis 〈〈rna thang gyi mgyogs bris 〉〉dang (1985lo'i 〈〈rdzang char 〉〉deb dang por)/ 〈〈'bod pa 〉〉(1985lo'i 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉deb lnga pa 〉yis snyan ngag gi bgrod lam gsar pa zhig phye ba dang / der mthud nas 〈〈g.ya' shing gi lo ma 〉〉dang 〈〈dmar po khrag gi glu 〉〉sogs bstud mar spel ba dang / 1986lor snyan ngag pa 'ju skal bzang gis 〈〈tun hong la gnas skor du phyin pa 〉〉zhes — 366 —

pa dang / nor sde'i 〈〈bcos ma'i me tog 〉〉spel nas snyan ngag gsar pa'i lam du gcig rjes gcig gis mnan pa'i rnam pa dga' 'os pa zhig shar ba dang /1986lo nas rin chen bkra shis kyi 〈〈rbab chu 〉〉dang / nor sde'i 〈〈nga yi rgyugs shog〉〉/ bkra bha'i 〈〈rus sbal〉〉/ gangs dga'i 〈〈rgyang lta 〉〉dang 〈〈slobs byung /dpyid kyi mdza' mo〉〉/gangs rtsen gyi 〈〈rmi lam dang mngon sum〉〉/dpa' rtse'i 〈〈nga ni gangs dkar gyi 'dab ma zhig yin〉〉/ dur bu rnam grags kyi 〈〈'bod pa'i g.yab mo〉〉/ lag ldan gyi 〈〈mos 'dun〉〉/ chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring gi 〈(drod yal ba'i sor gdub〉〉/ gangs phrug gi 〈〈dran rten〉〉/ rgod phrug dpal 'byor gyi 〈〈dpyid kyi lha mo〉〉/ o rgyan rdo rje'i 〈〈mtho sgang gi rlung 〉〉/gangs zhun gyi 〈〈ngo mong dang kho mo'i rje'u〉〉/ khyung thar rgyal gyi 〈〈nyi ma dang nyi ma'i lug khya〉〉/ stobs ldan gyi 〈〈skyed tshal gyi dpyid dpal〉〉/ g.yu zhun gyi 〈(phyug rdzi/lam〉〉/rom dkon mchog gi 〈〈dzi bo'i glu dbyangs〉〉/'brug lha rgyal gyi 〈〈'od kyi lang tsho〉〉/ sman lha skyabs kyi 〈〈gnas la 'gro ba'i bu mo〉〉/ gcan me stag gi 〈〈rmas phog pa'i nam mkha'〉〉/ skyabs chen bde grol gyi 〈〈na zug 'jags thub pa'i phyir khyod la bos 〉〉zhes pa sogs spel ba des bod kyi snyan ngag gsar pa'i lding khang gi bzo bkod la rmang gzhi brtan po zhig chags par byas/ yin na'ang deng rabs bod kyi snyan ngag gsar pa'i rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom gyi rdog 'gros dus gcig la bsgyur ba min pa'i dbang gis/ kho tsho'i bris pa'i snyan ngag la'ang rang rang gi rtsom lugs dang gshis nyams mi 'dra ba re yod pa red/bod kyi rtsom byung lo rgyus steng lhug rtsom ni 'phel rgyas cung dal ba'i rtsom lus shig yin na'ang / dus skabs gsar pa'i nang skal bzang rdo rje'i 〈〈ngo mtshar gzi byin 'bar ba'i a skyes rma chen〉〉/ rma rgyal gyi 〈〈mi don phug ron gyis dpyad pa'i gtam rgyud〉〉/ 'phrin las chos grags kyi 〈〈mnga' ris su — 367 —

gna' shul grags can 'tshol zhib tu skyod pa'i zin jo〉〉/ chab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring gi 〈〈lan gru'i dpyid dpal〉〉/ don grub rgyal gyi 〈〈rkang lam phra mo 〉〉sogs kyis thog drangs pas bod kyi deng rabs lhug rtsom gyi gsar rtsom la mtsho bod mtho sgang gi sa phyogs kun tu ljang myug rnam par rgyas shing me tog lhug par bzhad pa/ 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i lang tsho ngoms 'dug pa ni don la gnas pa zhig yin/ 1983lo nas 'bum skyabs kyi 〈〈nga ni rtswa phran 'di la dga' 〉〉zhes pa dang / bsod nams dpal 'byor gyi 〈〈na gzhon rtsen pa'i zlos gar〉〉/ rmongs grol gyi 〈〈bya glag〉〉/ blo gros myu gu'i 〈〈'pho 'gyur〉〉/ tshe dbang gi 〈〈rang byung chu tshan mthong ba'i snang tshul〉〉/ stobs rgyal gyi 〈〈'od dang mun pa'i skyon yon skor cung gleng ba〉〉/ gcod pa don grub kyi 〈〈mnyen 'jam rtswa'i glu sgra〉〉/ dkon lo'i 〈〈gzi rtsa sde dgu'i mdzes ljongs〉〉/ sangs grol gyi 〈〈dgu chu'i glu dbyangs〉〉/ gnya' blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi 〈〈sgo〉〉/ don kun grub pa'i 〈〈gangs seng dkar mo〉〉/ sgom pa bkra shis kyi 〈〈rdza ri'i khrod kyi chu phran〉〉/ phag mo bkra shis kyi 〈〈rdo pha bong zhig gi yon tan〉〉/ mgon po bkra shis kyi 〈〈gro ma'i me tog〉〉/ rdo rje gcod pa'i 〈(zwa thang / me tog gi 'jig rten〉〉/ bu bzhi bsam pa'i don grub kyi 〈〈sngon pa'i tshal gyi ngo mtshar gzigs mo 〉〉sogs snga gzhug tu 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dang 〈〈sgrang char〉〉 〈〈zla zer〉〉/ 〈〈mtsho sngon mang tshogs sgyu rtsal 〉〉bcas rtsom rig dus deb steng spel ba des dus skabs gsar ba'i bod kyi lhug rtsom la sngar med kyi tshe srog gsar ba sbyin pa dang 'phel rgyas kyi gom stabs brtan zhing g.yo ba med la/ stobs kyis khengs shing shugs dang ldan pa zhig byas/ lhag par du 'phrin las chos grags kyi 〈〈gtsang khul gyi gnas chen khag la lta skor du phyin pa'i mthong thos 〉〉dang / nya nag pa ba res kyi lhug rtsom bsdus deb 〈〈sngon mo spang las 'khrungs pa'i sems kyi rol mo〉〉/ sdong yon tan rgya mtsho'i lhug rtsom bsdus — 368 —

deb 〈〈skad cha'i lang tsho 〉〉sogs dpe skrun byas pa des bod kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng mi sger gyi lhug rtsom bsdus deb byung myong med pa'i rnam pa de rtsa ba nas mjug sgril ba dang / bod kyi deng rabs lhug rtsom 'phel rgyas kyi mdun lam rgya che zhing khod yangs pa'i lam chen zhig btod pa red/dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i mjug dang dgu bcu pa'i 'gror slebs tshe/ deng rabs rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi dpyad bsdur dang rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi lag len khrod rtsom rig gi 'du shes gtso bo phyogs gnyis nas mngon bzhin yod de/ gcig nas rtsom rig gis dngos yod la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i bzhed dgongs te/ dngos yod dang sgyu rtsal gnyis zung 'jug byed dgos pa las/ sgyu rtsal de ga dus yin yang dngos yod la g.yol byol bya mi rung zhing / de bzhin du dngos yod kyis kyang sgyu rtsal gyi mgrin par dpyang thag gis mi sdom pa byed dgos/ kho tsho'i bsam par rtsom rig dang deng rabs kyi mi tshe/ chab srid/ chos lugs bcas la 'brel ba dam po yod pas/ mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i nyams myong mtshon pa'i rtsom rig la spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i shan mi zhugs pa byed dka' na'ang / rtsom rig ni chab srid dang chos lugs dril sgrog byed pa'i lag cha tsam byed du mi rung bar 'dod/ gnyis su rtsom rig la deng rabs kyi 'du shes drag po zhig yod dgos par dgongs pa dang / kho tsho'i bsam par deng rabs 'du shes ni tshad mtho ba'i sna 'dzoms shig yin pa dang / de ni deng rabs rtsom rig gi rtsa ba'i khyad chos shig tu'ang ngos 'dzin gyin yod de/ bod kyi rtsom rig gis nges par bod mi dang bod kyi spyi tshogs/ mi dang mi/ mi'i tshe srog bcas la kha phyogs dgos pa dang / de ltar byas na da gzod rtsom rig gi gshis nus mi 'dor bar bsam gyin yod/ deng rabs rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal thad/ gtso bo deng rabs spyi tshogs su mi'i nyams myong nas 'go brtsams te dngos yod kyi brjod thabs dang mngon chung gi mtshon thabs — 369 —

zung la nan bcag byas yod pa red/bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dus rabs nyer gcig par slebs na'ang /'od stong 'bar ba'i grub 'bras rlabs chen blangs song zhes sgrog mi 'os te/mi rigs gzhan dang bsdur na sgyu rtsal la gzhan dring mi 'jog cing gsar rtsom la rang gshis yod pa/ rtsom mkhan rang nyid kyi nyams myong dang lag len khrod byung ba'i gtan chags kyi rang bzhin nges can zhig ldan pa'i gshes lugs dang / mdzes dpyod kyi phugs 'dun/ sgyu rtsal gyi nus pa sogs rgya tshad la longs pa'i rtsom pa po da dung yang shin tu nyung ba'i tshad du lus 'dug snyam/de ltar red mod kyang / gal te rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi 'phel kha phun sum tshogs pa dang / deng rabs rtsom rig gis dus rabs kyi sgra gdangs dang snang brnyan/deng rabs kyi mi'i myong tshor mtshon pa'i sgyu rtsal grub 'bras thad bltas na//lhasdo sbyo/ / gzhi khyon rgya che ba'i dus skabs shig tu slebs 'dug ces sa bcad gnyis pa/ deng rabs kyi rtsom pa po'i tshogs pa/lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas dgu bcu pa'i mjug bar du/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir gsar skyes gzhon nu rnams kyis rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed pa'i rnam dpyod dang blo spobs ches cher ngom pa dang / de ni skyes stobs kyi dpal 'bar ba'i deng rabs bod kyi rtsom pa po'i tshogs pa'i thog ma'i rnam pa yin/ na gzhon blo gsar rnams ni rtsom rig gi ma 'ongs pa'i re ba yin mod kyang /bcings 'grol btang tshun gyi lo ngo sum bcu'i ( 1949wa 1978) nang 6 g.yon gyi chab srid bsam blo dang srid jus kyi dbang du gyur pa ma zad/ mi — 370 —

rnams goms srol rnying pa'i 'dam las kyang thar thub med pa'i dbang gis na gzhon rtsom pa por nang sems nas phyi'i spyod pa'i bar gdam ga'i rang dbang ha lam med la/ lus sems la sdug bsngal sbyin pa'i gzugs med kyi zhags pa zhig gis yun ring du bcings pas/ skabs de dag gi na gzhon rtsom pa po'i bsam blo ni bstod rtsom ( gtso bo snyan ngag 〉rkyang rkyang 'bri ba'i rkang lam gu dog po zhig tu btsud 'dug de las ldog ste dus rabs sngon ma'i mjug gi na gzhon rtsom pa po rnams don dngos steng skabs de'i rtsom rig las rigs thad kyi stobs shugs gtso bor gyur yod pa dang / sngon chad dang mi 'dra ba'i phyogs gzhan zhig ni/ rtsom pa po'i 6 tshogs pa mi zhig tu lta bzhin pa'i na gzhon rtsom pa po'i dpung khag nang mdo dbus khams gsum gang gi mi'ang yod pa dang /bsam blo'i 'khyer so rigs mang zhing phyogs so sor 'brel thub pa zhig yin/'di lta bu'i bsam blo phun sum tshogs pa ni rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi nyams len steng dang / sgyu rtsal dang len byed phyogs bcas su mngon par byed/ dus rabs sngon ma'i mjug gi na gzhon rtsom pa po mang che ba lo nyi shu nas lnga bcu'i bar gyi rtsom pa po yin la/ kho tsho'i nang 'ga' zhig gis lo rabs brgyad cu'i 'gor brtsams chos spel ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis lo rabs dgu bcu'i nang nas rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed 'go brtsams pa'ang yod/ nga tshos 'dir rtsom pa po'i tshogs pa'i nang bgrang bsam pa ni/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ glang mdun dpal 'byor/ byams pa chos 'dzoms/ rnam grol/ rig 'dzin/ thub bstan/ tshe ring don grub/ rin chen tshe dga'/ bkra shis dpal ldan/ bstan pa yar rgyas/ reb gong rdo rje mkhar/ bkra bha/ nag po skal bzang / stag 'bum rgyal/ a smyon bkra shis don grub/ rin chen bkra shis/ rang sgra/ skal rdor/gcan tsha rdo rje rin chen/ rnam sras/ tshe ring g.yang skyid/ rgyal mtshan/ chab 'gag rdo rje tshe ring / bsod nams dpal 'bar/ blo gros myu gu/ stobs rgyal/— 371 —

gcod pa don grub/ dkon lo/ gnya' blo gros rgyal mtshan/ don kun grub pa/ lha rgyal tshe ring / sgom pa bkra shis/ 'phrin las chos grags/ ldan grol/ seng gshong rdo rje gcod pa/ nya nag pa ba res/ ldong yon tan rgya mtsho/ 'ju skal bzang o rgyan rdo rje/ ljang bu/ lha rgyal tshe ring / mkhas grub/ mog chung phur ba/ gangs zhun/ khyung thar rgyal/ gcan me stag rams tshe bho/ g.yu zhun/ dpal lha/ 'brug mo skyid/ bde skyid sgrol ma/ padma 'tsho/ dpal mo/ sman lha skyabs/ dpa' rtse/ skal bzang lha mo/ lcags mo 'tsho/ chab spel tshe dpal/ bkras gling chung bdag dur bu rnam grags/ rgod phrug dpal 'byor/ zhi bde nyi ma/ ldong chu shel/ gzungs phyug skyid/ rgya grol/ gangs bu dga' skyed/ snyan bzang g.yang skyabs rgyal/ chas pa rta mgrin tshe ring sogs yin pa dang / kho tsho ni deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig gi gdong len pa sha stag yin/ deng rabs rtsom rig dar spel byas nas yun ring ma 'gor bar/ spyi tshogs steng bshad tshul 'dra min sna tshogs thon pa dang /lhag par du snyan ngag gsar par mtshon na 'os min gyi dmod tshig mi nyung ba zhig khur ba nga tsho tshang ma'i sems su gsal ler yod/ de'i mtshungs su snyan ngag la gsar rnying gi dbye ba phye zhing snyan ngag las rigs su rim gyis kha bral du 'gro bar nye ba'i snang tshul yid skyo ba zhig khyab yong ba dang / ches snga ba'i lo shas nang snyan ngag gsar rnying gnyis kyis rang rang gi ming dang mi mtshungs pa'i las dbang bskyangs pa ni/ mi mang che ba'i snang ngor snyan ngag rnying pa ni lang tsho dar zhing yid du mdzes pa'i gzhon nu ma zhig dang 'dra la/ snyan ngag gsar pa ni rgas 'khogs dang mi sdug pa'i gnyer mas gdong yongs khebs pa'i bud med rgan pa 'chi lam snyeg pa zhig tu mthong ba'ang yod/ snyan ngag gsar pa'i nang khul du'ang rtsom pa po 'ga' zhig ( snyan ngag 'bri mi shes bzhin du btsan gyis 'bri ba'i rigs )gis snyan rtsom 'bri skabs bsam gzhig dang kun rtog mi 'phro bar gzhan rtsom ngo bshu rgyag sha sha byed pa de — 372 —

gzhan pas bshad spyad kyi 'dzin lung du mi 'gro ba ga la srid/ phal cher spyi tshogs yongs kyis rnam 'gyur ya ma zung zhig bzung 'dug pa'i gnas tshul 'og rang cag gi snyan ngag gsar pa'i rtsom pa po rnams kyis dwa phrug gi las dbang skyong ba'i snyan ngag gsar pa de rang nyid la gtogs pa'i snyan ngag tu bsam pa dang / de'i ched du re ba rum gang gnyer nas mi lo sum bcu tsam song bar/ mig sngar snyan ngag gsar pa 'di bod kyi rtsom rig gi khyim tshang chen mo'i nang gzugs gzhi bde thang dang bsam blo zab mor phyin pa'i khyim mi gtso bo zhig gi thob thang ldan 'dugalo rabs brgyad cu pa'i dkyil tsam nas bod kyi rtsom stegs su/ phyi gling ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa dang rtsom rig snyan ngag skor gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang gsar rtsom byed thabs skor gyi rtsom yig dang brtsams chos grags can bod yig tu bsgyur nas ngo sprod byas pas/ deng rabs bod kyi rtsom pa po'i mthong thos kyi rgya bskyed pa red/ dper na/ 〈〈sheg si thar gyi zlos gar sgrung gtam 〉〉(tshe dbang rnam rgyal gyis bsgyur )dang / jo me si the lar gyi 〈〈a ma'i snyan ngag 〉〉('ju skal bzang gis bsgyur)/ 〈〈bdag gi khu bo lus li 〉〉(sangs rgyas kyis bsgyur)/〈〈dus rabs dang rig gnas/mtshan nyid rig pa dang grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom skor gleng ba 〉〉(don grub dbang 'bum gyis brtsams)/ 〈〈a'e mir gsang zhib pa 〉〉(thang hre tses bsgyur)/ 〈〈khu ba lhab lhub tu 'bab pa 〉〉('jam dpal rgya mtshos bsgyur)/yi dam tshe ring gi 〈〈snyan ngag gi bla srog bshad pa 〉〉dang 〈〈ye ho'i mtsho mo la bsngags pa'i brag ca'i dbyangs snyan〉〉/ o hin ros 〈〈ma'i ji'i legs skyes〉〉/mo po sang gi 〈〈mgul rgyan〉〉/ chi khi chu'i 〈〈mdog 'gyur ba'i 'brug〉〉/ kor ci'i 〈〈rgya mtsho'i khug rta 〉〉sogs 〈〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal 〉〉dang 〈〈sbyang char 〉〉steng spel ba des bod kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po'i ljang myug rgyas par char — 373 —

chu'i nus pa thon pa bston mi nus la/ dus rabs sngon ma'i mjug tu nub gling dang rgya nang nas 'ongs pa'i sgrung gtam dang snyan ngag lhug rtsom phul byung can dang rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs dag bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi thon khungs gal chen zhig yin pa ma zad/ deng rabs bod kyi rtsom pa po mang che shos slob grwa chen mo ba yin pas khong tshos phyi gling gi rtsom rig gzhung lugs pa dang rtsom pa po grags can ya li si tod dang pu'u wa la'o/ ma'o po sang / thor si tha'e/ ti te lo/ ko te/ hu'e thu man/ pa'e lun/ zhu'e la'e/ ci tshe/ tha'e kor/phu'u zhi cin/ nya'e lu'u ta sogs gang rung gi sgrung gtam dang snyan ngag rtsom rig gzhung lugs la bltas yod srid pas de rnams kyi bsam blo dang sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs kyi shan zhugs pa'ang lugs dang mthun pa zhig yin/ de bzhin du rgya nag gi snyan ngag pa ku'o mo ru'o dang / zhus kri ma'o/ wun dbyi tu'o/ li cin hpha/ ta'e wang hru'u/ pen kri lin/ ho chi hphang / a'e ching / ku'o zha'o khron/pa'e hwa/ li'u hra ho/ hong zhang / hri kri/ pe ta'o/ ku'u khreng / hru'u thing sogs kyang bod kyi snyan ngag gsar pa'i rtsom pa po rnams la mtshon na gsal cha yod cing ngo shes su gyur 'dug pas tshad nges can zhig nas bshad na bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dang lhag par snyan ngag gsar pa'i pho brang 'di'i bzod bkod dang bzhengs skrun la bsam blo dang sgyu rtsal zung nas shan shugs gang 'tsham re thebs yod pa dang / de bas bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig 'di rgyu med rkyen med du gnam nas lhung 'ongs pa zhig ga la yin/ de ni 'dzam gling mi rigs kun gyi rtsom rig gi rkang la rol zhing bcud kyis gsos pa zhig yin/rgyu mtshan de'i dbang gis de snga skabs shig mi rigs gzhan gyi rtsom rig dang bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig bar gyi 'brel ba dam po 'dir bshad tshul sna tshogs byung ba dang / snang tshul de dag deng rabs rtsom rig ( lhag par snyan ngag gsar pa ) la dgag pa rgyag byed kyi khungs lung du'ang bsten bzhin yod/— 374 —

bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig las snyan ngag gsar pa la mtshon na/ bod kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag gi rgyun 'dzin dang snyan ngag 'bri rtsom thad 〈〈snyan ngag me long 〉〉rtsom lugs la gsar gtod rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ldog 'byung rgyu dang /de'i gal chen rang bzhin la snyan ngag pa skor zhig gis ngos zin gting zab cig byas yod mod/ 'on kyang / lag len dngos nang du mthong chen byed 'os pa/ /shā 'bras shig thon par da dung lam thag ring po zhig 'gro dgos pa sa bcad gsum pa/ snyan deb gsar pa ni snyan stegs 'jigs pa'i ka gdung yin/bod khul yongs su dus deb dang tshags par so so'i steng / snyan ngag gsar pas par ngos nges can zhig zin 'dug na'ang / de ni khyab spel byed thabs khrod kyi lhu tshigs gcig tsam las ma 'das/ gal srid dus deb dang tshags par gyis snyan ngag gsar pa spel ba des spyi tshogs steng rtsom rig gi rnam pa gsar pa 'di rgya khyab tu dang len byas pa'i tshab byed du 'gro ba yin na/ de'i byas rjes gtso bo khyab spel gyi steng la 'jog 'os shing / de lta na snyan deb gsar pa bsgrigs nas dpe skrun bya ba'i 'gan 'khri de legs 'grub byed rgyu shin tu gal che'o/ /gna' nas da lta'i bar du/ snyan rtsom dpe deb tu sgrig par dge mtshan che ste/ phyogs gcig nas dus skabs so so'i rtsom yig gsog 'jog dang nyar tshags/ gcig nas gcig brgyud de khyab gdal du gtong ba'i phan nus yod pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas mngon sum ma yin pa'i sgo nas snyan rtsom gyi — 375 —
