rin thang la gdeng 'jog dang rtsom yig tshad ldan zhig gi sgrom gzhi bzhengs skrun byed bzhin yod/ bod kyi tshig rgyan rig pa'i gzhung mtha' dag ni srol rgyun dang ches snga shos kyi tshad ldan gyi mtshon byed cig yin/ gsar gtod kyi lam du jog 'gros bsgyur ma thag gi snyan ngag gsar par mtshon na/ 'di lta bu rang gis rang la legs bcos dang tshad ldan can du brtson len byed pa ni thog ma nyid nas 'go brtsams song ba dang / bod kyi snyan stegs gsar pa de brtan brling zhig chags 'ongs par 'brel ba dam po yod/ snyan deb gsar pas kyang gna' rabs tshad ldan gsung rab dang mtshungs par mi rnams kyi sems ngor yal dka' ba'i rtags mtshan zhig slong thub/ 6 brtsams chos dus deb sogs kyi steng spel ba ni/ brtsams chos de mi gzhan la sprad pa brgyud nas rtsom yig gang yin yang legs grub kyi tshad du slebs pa'i dmigs yul yin/brtsams chos shig don ngo mar rang tshugs rang bdag dang / gsar gtod byas pa'i bya dngos shig tu 'gyur ched/ nges par rang nyid kyi gsar gtod mkhan dang kha bral bar byas te/ mi tshogs kyi dbus su kher rkyang du rang nyid kyi lam du bskyod dgos/mi ①zhes pa yis snyan deb sogs dpe skrun byed pa'i dgos nges rang bzhin dang gal chen rang bzhin bstan 'dug dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs dgu bcu'i dkyil tsam du slebs pa na/ 〈〈gangs 'dabs kyi sems pa 〉〉yis snyan stegs kyi khu sum de yongs su gtor ba dang / yi dam tshe ring lags kyis snyan deb de'i gleng gzhi las 6 〈〈gangs 'dabs kyi sems pa 〉〉ni khyung chen gyi gshog pa brkyangs pa dang mtshungs la/ gangs seng gi ngar skad bsgrags pa dang 'dra ste/ de ni kha ba ri pa'i deng rabs rtsom rig gi gom 'gros sgyur 'go tshugs pa'i mtshon rtags khyad du thon pa zhig yin pas/ nga tshor dga' ba bskyed cing / skul ma thebs su bcug mi ②ces pas snyan deb gsar pa ni snyan ngag gsar pa'i stegs bu 'degs byed kyi ka ba dang gdung — 376 —

ma lta bu yin pa gsal ston byas yod/der mthud nas 〈〈snang bu'i rtsom btusawa snyan ngag deb 〉〉dang / dus rabs gsar pa'i 'go tshugs ma thag tu snyan rtsom 〈〈gzu mig dgu ba 〉〉dag dpe skrun dang 'grem spel byas pa ni/ bod kyi snyan ngag gsar pa'i lo rgyus steng rmang bting ba lta bu'i don snying ldan pa red/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi rtsom rig lo rgyus steng snyan ngag dang snyan ngag gsar pa ni nam yang rtsom rig gsar pa'i gsar rtsom khrod dpe skrun dang 'grem spel gyi phyogs gtso bo yang zin 'dug stabs/ snyan ngag gsar pa snyan stegs 'degs byed kyi ka gdung lta bu yin pa ma zad/ rtsom rig gsar pa'i stegs bu ril por gson shugs rgyas par byed pa'i sgul shugs kyang yin/ bod kyi snyan stegs su nye ba'i lor dpe skrun byas pa'i snyan deb gsar pa la nga tshos kha mi tshang ba'i bsdoms rtsis shig byas na/〈〈lang tsho'i rbab chu 〉〉dang 〈〈bzho lung 〉〉/ 〈〈gangs 'dabs kyi sems pa〉〉/〈〈lngang bu'i rtsom btus wa snyan ngag deb〉〉/ 〈〈snyan rtsom gzu mig dgu ba〉〉/〈〈mtho sgang gi rlung 〉〉/ 〈〈lho bzhud kyi chu 'dzin〉〉/ 〈〈snyan ngag gi mig chu〉〉/〈〈ka kha'i 'ja' yig〉〉/ 〈〈mkha' la 'phyo ba'i yid kyi brtse rlabs〉〉/ 〈〈kha ba dkar po〉〉/〈〈dung sems kyi 'dab ma〉〉/〈〈nyi ma'i mgron po〉〉/〈〈kha ba'i rnam shes〉〉/ 〈〈ngas khyod rang khu sim mer bzhag〉〉/ 〈〈snyan ngag gis slar yang kho bo btsal〉〉/ 〈〈gangs ri'i brtse dung 〉〉/ 〈〈skya rengs lha mo'i 'bod bad〉〉/ 〈〈sa gzhi dang kho mo'i gsang ba〉〉/ 〈〈kha ba'i mi lam〉〉/ 〈〈mi khom pa'i gnas dang de'i bdag po 〉〉sogs mang ba dang snyan ngag gsar pa khyab spel gtong ba'i phyogs nas bltas na/ snyan deb gsar pa'i phan nus de gzhan gang gis kyang tshab byed dka' ste/ thog mar/ dus deb dang tshags par steng snyan ngag gsar pa'i par ngos cung mang du 'dzin na'ang / gzhi rtsa'i thog rtsom yig gzhan dag gi brtsams chos khrod thar thor du bkram pa dang / snyan ngag rkyang rkyang 'god — 377 —

pa'i dus deb 〈〈gangs rgyan me tog 〉〉spel nas lo mang po song med/ rgyu mtshan de'i stabs kyis nga tshos rtsom pa po ga ge mo zhig gi snyan rtsom klog skabs cha tshang dang spyi yongs kyi tshor ba zhig ster dka' ba red/ de las ldog ste 〈〈gangs 'dabs kyi sems pa 〉〉la par grangs 3000la slebs 'dug pas dus deb dang tshags par gyis rtsom pa po zhig gi brtsams chos snyan deb ltar yongs khyab zhig khyab spel byed thabs bral phyir/ nga tshos snyan deb par skrun la dga' bsu byed 'os pa las smod pa bor ba ni shin tu mi rigs pa'i gnas so/ /lung ༵༵༵ /sngar sad zi kha pa'e yi 〈〈rtsom rig spyi tshogs rig pa 〉〉zhes pa hang kro'u mi dasangs dpe sgrun khang gis 1987lor dpe skrun byas pa'i rgya yig par bzhi'i shog ngos 3 pa~X dris sdom/ tshe ring gi 〈〈gangs 'dabs kyi sems pa 〉〉zhes pa mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun nang gis 1994lor dpe skrun byas pa'i 〈〈gleng gzhi 〉〉las gsal/— 378 —

/sdu /sna (shā shā sna/kā pa/ sbyong ༵ skyabs/bod kyi2deng rabs rtsom rig zhib 'jug//blimiX 'i ཿkha/na/ hūm̐ bye/lha byebye tram̐ krā bying hā/ /spya dīkā gāswā sgri/ /nga /gaurdo ༷shā/gasmun// rnyiX ༷/shā hārshadzinā the snra snan hwa dpe tshong khang //bye 1kyishā sna// lju5 sduX twe rnyi sdo/ smo gā /bye /tā ༵ rte sdig khang /byebye ༷// ni thengs/ ṅgeX/ smo byi( pa/ /zhu sapo/ yaktadri//
